Kyekà ikwàmii abɔ̈ɔ̈l bàkäl bàŋàbwaay ukɔl a mbwo. Mpal bàwem ba naa Yɛsu wàmulyaŋ tsütsü, ba bàsɛmà mukuub in'kwɛŋ: «Mwol, Mwan a David, isyääm!»
Un'sɛŋ a baar katsüŋà musà in'kwɛŋ, wɛɛ ba bàsöönà mulaal: «Mwol, Mwan a David, isyääm!»
Yɛsu waa kàmbär, waa kabel, waa kafuul naa: «Ininà bɛ làkwen naa mɛ in'kyer ntɔn bɛ?»
Ba bun'fuur naa: «Mwol, kyer naa mii abi idubà.»
Yɛsu waa kasyääm, kabä u mii. Apan sye, mii aba waa myàdubà, waa bun'läb.
Umpal bàsin ba tsütsü a Yɛlusàlɛm, anà bàtöl ba tsütsü a Bɛtefazɛ, udu a mɔŋ a In'te a olive, apan Yɛsu kàtöm abɔ̈ɔ̈l uboo a alɔŋki ande,
waa kàtɛn a ba naa: «Làkyen u bul lanà kusà a bɛ, pa làkàkɔlà bɛ, bɛ làkàman ntsür bàfàbel anɛs wàŋàbäm un'siŋ anà mwan awa ukɔl. Làtsuuŋ wa, lan'twääl ayà pà.
Isàkal naa mbuur kan'tɛn undiir anà bɛ, lun'fuur naa: "Mwol we anà mfun aya". Làgyägyä, ba bàyàwɛy ya ntɔn mukyà.»
Yàkäl ya abà, ntɔn ndaa kàtɛn ŋangɔɔm yi ikwe:
«Tɛn a un'sɛŋ a Siyɔnà naa: Le, mfum angye wàmuyà akà ngye, wàŋàyɔl a làbɔ̈ɔ̈n anà wàŋàlaar udu a ntsür bàfàbel an, anà udu anɔ, mwan a ntsür afàsyen buur.»
Alɔŋki bàkyen ba, ba bàkyer asànaa kaswɛŋ Yɛsu.
Ba bàtwääl ntsür bàfàbel an anà mwan awa, waa bàyɛɛl ipfɛy aba udu a ya. Yɛsu kàbwaay udu a ya.
Un'sɛŋ a baar kàyɛɛl ipfɛy awa u mbwo, bumwɛy bàtsüülà an'kɔkà a in'te waa bàyɛɛlà ma u mbwo.
In'sɛŋ a baar myàyikyeenà kusà a Yɛsu anà myàyun'labà myàkäl muyisà in'kwɛŋ naa: «Ɔsana akà Mwan a David! Wɛy mbuur awà ayà kà ikɔb a Mwol ukäl wàŋàsaak! Ɔsana kà ikal a dudu!»
Mpal kàbilà nde u Yɛlusàlɛm, bul lanswà làkyer ani anà làkäl mufuulà naa: «Nà wawà?»
In'sɛŋ waa myàfuurà naa: «Ŋangɔɔm Yɛsu, un'nsi Nasàlɛr u Ngalilɛ.»
Yɛsu kàbilà u làpaŋ a ndwà a Nzam, nde kàböŋ atɛɛl a an'yà banswà bàkäl kwo, kàbuum mɛsà a agyɛɛŋ a ngim anà an'kir a ayääl a an'yem.
Nde kàtɛn a ba naa: «Bàsön naa: "Ndwà amɛ bàsabeelà naa ndwà a ngyamàkà", wɛɛ bɛ, bɛ ya làkyàbuul mboo a mbüüb!»
Ikwàmii anà ikar bàyàsin tsütsü apà nde uboo a ndwà a Nzam, nde waa kakɔɔr.
Wɛɛ mpal bàmɛn andweer a angaŋ anà alɔɔŋ a Un'kɔɔn ndaa impà kàkyer Yɛsu anà in'kwɛŋ bàsyee baan uboo a ndwà a Nzam: «Ɔsana akà Mwan a David!», ba bàwem nkyɛl,

waa bàtɛn a nde naa: «Nkye ngye akiweemà ndaa bàtɛɛnà ba?» Yɛsu kafuur naa: «Inye. Nkye bɛ, bɛ làtäŋ anki akà ikikye ndaa bàsön yi: "Nkye ngye kàyöŋà nsyäŋà u mun a ambɛy anà yà baan abà kà an'bɛɛl?"»
Apan laa kàsawɛy nde, waa kàkyen Bɛtani, ntsü kàkàbɔ̈ɔ̈n nde.
Taaŋtyà ututu, mpal kàkäl nde u mbwo mufurà bul a kölàköl, Yɛsu kàwem ngyal.

Nde kàmɛn un'te a an'fige ukɔl a mbwo, nde kàsin tsütsü apà wa, wɛɛ nde undiir kàmɛn anki, nà nkay mpɛl. Apan nde kàtɛn a un'te naa: «Ngye afàsàbɔr anki imbɛŋ!» Taaŋ nsil alan, un'te laa kàyöm wa.
Mpal bàmɛn alɔŋki abun, ba bàkyer abem, waa bàtɛn naa: «Un'te a an'fige kan'yɔm aben u mbalà mwɛy?»

Yɛsu kafuur naa: «Mɛ, mɛ ndandaa alàkyään: isàkal naa bɛ làbye anà làkwikilà, ukɔɔn nkyɛɛr, bɛ lan'kwo mukyer kànà ndaa an'kyer mɛ yi akà un'te wà anki, wɛ bɛ lan'kwo mutɛn itàkal a mɔŋ wà naa: "Lwomà pà, kyen kabü u ngyäl", ya sye ikal abun.
Undiir wanswà làlɔm bɛ unsà làkwikilà u ngyamàkà, bɛ làkyer asàwal wa.»
Mpal kàbilà Yɛsu u ndwà a Nzam, amfum a angaŋ anà andweer a un'sɛŋ bàyàsin anà bun'fuul umpal kàkäl nde mulɔŋ: «Unsà ikɔ̈b nà ayikyer ngye indiir abi? Nà kapɛ ikɔ̈b aki?»
Yɛsu kafuur naa: «Mɛ sye in'we anà mfuul mwɛy ntɔn bɛ. Isàkal naa bɛ làman'pà mfuur, mɛ sye waa alakyään naa unsà ikɔ̈b nà mɛ in'kyerà bya.
Ndüümà a Ywan yàfü ken? U du lɛɛ akà baar?» Wɛɛ ba bàsyeelà mbaaŋ ba a ba naa: «Kya bi isàtɛn naa: "U du", nde ayifuul naa: "Ntɔn nkye mpa lun'si bɛ làkwikilà?"
Wɛɛ bi isàfuur naa: "Baar", bi itiin un'sɛŋ a baar bɔɔmà, ntɔn ba banswà bàkyàyöb naa Ywan wà ŋangɔɔm.»
Apan, ba bàfuur akà Yɛsu naa: «Bi iyöb anki.» Waa nde sye kafuur naa: «Mɛ sye alàkyään anki unsà ikɔ̈b nà in'fàkyer mɛ indiir abi.»
«An'kyän abɛ mye aben? Mbuur mwɛy kàkäl anà baan abaal bɔ̈ɔ̈l. Nde kàsin apà wàtàtwɛb, waa kàtɛn a nde naa: "Mwan amɛ, kyen kasäl ŋàbà u ywaŋ a vin."
Mwan awà kàfuur naa: "Aay, mɛ in'kwen anki." Ungö a taaŋ, nde kàsɔɔm ankyän, waa kàkyen.
Kàsin nde apà mwan wàyweel, nde kàtɛn ndaa nsil ya. Mwan awà kàfuur naa: "Inye, taa". Wɛɛ nde kàkyen anki.
Nà uboo a ba bàbɔ̈ɔ̈l kàkyer ukwen a taarànde?» Ba naa: «Wàtàtwɛb.» Yɛsu kàtɛn a ba naa: «Ndandaa mɛ alàkyään: afüür a itɛr anà akaar a pasàsɛ bàsàfwel kusà a bɛ uboo a Imwol a Nzam.

Ntɔn Ywan kàyi akà bɛ u mbwo a balàbal, wɛɛ bɛ, bɛ làkwikilà lun'si anki. Wɛɛ afüür a itɛr anà akaar a pasàsɛ bun'si làkwikilà. Itàkal naa bɛ làkyàman ya abwɛy, wɛɛ bɛ, bɛ làbuul anki mpem ntɔn mukun'sà làkwikilà.
«Làwem nsim yumwɛy: Nkum mwɛy kàkön vin u ywaŋ. Nde kàdiŋà la a làpaŋ, nde kàtöŋ ikal mukaam mbɛŋ anà ndwà a ikyɛɛŋ. Ungö apan nde kàpɛ la akà atɛɛr a man, waa kàkyen mukàyilyaŋ.
Mpal làkwe taaŋ abwo mbɛŋ, nde kàtöm asyääl ande akà atɛɛr a man ntɔn muwal mbɛŋ a vin.
Atɛɛr a man bàkör asyääl aban, umwɛy bun'düb, umwɛy bun'dwä, umwɛy bun'käm in'kul.
Nde kàfàtɔm asyääl asin mbɔɔn bàŋàlyaŋ bàtàtwɛb, wɛɛ atɛɛr a man bakyer ifà imwɛy kya.
Mumay, nde kàtöm mwan ande, waa kàtɛn naa: "Ba bàyàkàkömà mwan amɛ."
Wɛɛ mpal bàmɛn atɛɛr a man mwan awà, ba bàtɛn ba a ba naa: "Le ikyee ande. Làyi bi kun'dwä, waa bi iwal ywaŋ ande!"
Apan, ba bun'tɛ mpi, bun'tɔɔm u nsà a ywaŋ a vin, waa bun'dwä.»
Abun, Yɛsu kafuul naa: «Ŋàbawà, ŋaywaŋ asàkyer aben ntɔn atɛɛr a man abà?»
Ba bun'fuur naa: «Nde baar abe abà akyer asadwa ukɔɔn aman ngyɛb, nde asàwal ywaŋ a vin, waa usàpà la akà atɛɛr a man asin ban'kwo mukun'pà mbɛŋ u taaŋ a taaŋ.»
Yɛsu kàtɛn a ba naa: «Nkye bɛ làtäŋ anki akà ikikye uboo a Ndaa Aŋàsɔn: "Nkɔŋ bàpiy atööŋ, ya yàbulà nkɔŋ a twɛrà a ndwà. Kyaki kyà isal a Mwol, ndaa mwɛy yubem u mii abi!"»
«Mɛ, mɛ in'fàlakyään naa: Imwol a Nzam bàkyer asàladuum, waa bàsàpà akà un'sɛŋ awà asàbɔr mbɛŋ.
[Mbuur asàbwà udu a nkɔŋ ayi akyer asàpàpää, anà ya isàbweel mbuur, mbuur awun akyer asàbwàbwamà.»]
Mpal bàwem andweer a angaŋ anà Amfarisi nsim ande ayi, ba bàkyer ayöb naa nde kàtɛɛnà a ba.
Undiir awun, bàleŋà ba ipöl mukun'kɔr, wɛɛ ba bàmɛn bɔɔmà a iköŋ a baar byàwɛlà Yɛsu asànaa ŋangɔɔm.
Yɛsu kàfàtɛn a ba unsà nsim naa:
«Imwol a du kyà asànaa mfum mwɛy kàyöŋà un'kyɔm atà bɔr ntɔn mwan baal ande.
Nde kàtöm asyääl ande mukàbel baar ntɔn un'kyɔm awà, wɛɛ ba bàkwen anki muyà.
Nde kàfàtɔm asyääl asin ntɔn mukàtɛn a baar bàbel naa: "Le, mɛ an'lɔn isa byanswà: mɛ an'dwa in'dim a ngɔɔmà anà ntsür a may amɛ, indiir byanswà byan'kwo. Làyi kà un'kyɔm atà bɔr!"
Wɛɛ ba bàwɛl ya asànaa an'yääm a ngway, ba bàkyen isal aba: umwɛy u ywaŋ ande, wumwɛy u yà ande.
Bumwɛy bàkör asyääl, waa bamɛɛy an'kyeey, waa badwä.
Mfum kàwem nkyɛl, waa kàtöm aŋità ande mudwa adwää baar aban, waa bàwuul bul aba mbaa.
Apan, nde kàtɛn a asyääl ande naa: "Un'kyɔm atà bɔr kan'kwo, wɛɛ baar bàbel ndöŋ batɛy.
Abun, làkyen kà an'kuun a mbwo, làtwääl kà un'kyɔm atà bɔr baar banswà làkàman bɛ."
Asyääl abà laa bàkyen ba u mbwo, bàköŋà ba baar banswà bàmɛn ba, baar abe anà abwɛŋ. Ndwà a un'kyɔm atà bɔr waa yàyöl a baar bàbel.
Mfum kàbilà ntɔn muler baar bàbel, waa kàmɛn mbuur mwɛy mpa kàbwäär ipfɛy a un'kyɔm.
Nde waa kun'fuul: "Un'sam amɛ, ngye apà ayàbilà aben ukɔɔn ipfɛy a un'kyɔm?" Mbuur awà ndaa kàsi anki.
Apan, mfum waa kàtɛn a asyääl naa: "Lun'bäm in'siŋ kà in'kɔl anà kà an'kɔɔ, lun'piy u làpib a nsà. Kwo iyàkal ilel anà nkwoor a an'din."
Abun, bàfàbel baar mbɔɔn, wɛɛ bàfàwal ikikye mpɛl.»
Apan, Amfarisi bàkàköŋ ntɔn muleŋ naa ba ndaa bun'lwab aben u ntɛɛn ande ŋakwo.

Ungö apan, ba bun'tööm alɔŋki aba anà baar a Ɛlɔdi ntɔn mutɛn a nde naa: «Un'lɔɔŋ, bi ikyàyöb naa ngye loor afàtà anki: ngye afàlɔŋ mbwo a Nzam unsà ndandaa yanswà ukɔɔn alab an'kyän a mbuur asin, ntɔn ngye afàler anki imbuur a baar.
Abun, ikyään, ngye akasii aben: mbwo yàmwo lɛɛ yatɛy mufur itɛr akà Sɛzar?»
Wɛɛ Yɛsu kàkyer ayöb an'kyän an'be aba, waa kafuur naa: «Baar a mpem yweel, ntɔn nkye lan'lwab bɛ ndaa?
Lan'swɛŋ ngim bàfàfur ayà itɛr.» Ba waa bun'mɛɛy itɛr a ngim mwɛy.
Waa Yɛsu kafuul naa: «Idiim anà ikɔb bi byà nà?»
Ba bun'fuur naa: «Byà Sɛzar.» Apan nde kàtɛn a ba naa: «Abun, làpɛ indiir a Sɛzar akà Sɛzar, indiir a Nzam, akà Nzam.»
Mpal bàwem ba mfuur ayi, ba bàkyer abem, laa bàsun'wɛy ba, waa bàkyen.
Ilä nsil akin, Asadusi bàsin tsütsü apà Yɛsu. Ba bà baar bàfàtɛn naa ngwiiyà kà ukwà yatɛy. Ba bun'fuul naa:
«Un'lɔɔŋ, Mɔsɛ kàtɛn naa: "Isàkal naa mbuur kan'kwà ukɔɔn baan, un'tɔŋ ande asàbääl un'kweel a un'dim, ntɔn nde uböör un'tɔŋ ande baan."
Akà bi bàkäl anà atɔŋ nsambwaar. Wàtàtwɛb kàkäl wàŋàbääl. Nde kàkü ukɔɔn abɔr, waa kàsàwɛy un'kyay ande akà un'tɔŋ ande.
Ya yàkäl abà akà wàyweel, wàtär, tii akà wànsambwaar.
Ungö a ba banswà, un'kaar awun waa kàkü.
Mpal bàsàwiyà baar kukwà, uboo a ba bànsambwaar, un'kaar awà asàkal un'kyay anà? Ntɔn ba banswà bàkäl adim ande!»
Yɛsu kafuur naa: «Bɛ, bɛ làbaŋàdiimà mbwo, ntɔn bɛ làyöb anki itàkal Ndaa Aŋàsɔn, itàkal ngwal a Nzam.
Ntɔn, mpal bàsàwiyà baar, abaal anà akaar bàfàsàtà anki bɔr, wɛɛ ba bàsàkal asànaa akyeey u du.
Unsà ndaa iler ngwiiyà a baar kà ukwà, nkye bɛ làtäŋ anki ndaa kàtɛn Nzam a bɛ naa:
Mɛ, mɛ in'wà Nzam a Abàlam, Nzam a Isak anà Nzam a Yakɔb? Nde kà wà Nzam a akü anki, wɛɛ wà baar a mɔ̈ɔ̈.»
In'sɛŋ a baar bàwem an'lɔɔŋ ande, ma màkyer atwà.
Mpal bàwem Amfarisi naa Yɛsu an'dübà Asadusi mun, laa bàköŋ ba,
umwɛy uboo a ba, un'lɔɔŋ a un'kɔɔn, waa kun'fuul ntɔn mukun'lwab ndaa:
«Un'lɔɔŋ, nswɛɛŋ nà ayà kölàköl uboo a Un'kɔɔn?»
Yɛsu kun'fuur naa: «"Ngye asàkwen Mwol, Nzam angye, u mpem angye wanswà, u mɔ̈ɔ̈ angye wanswà, anà kan'kyän angye manswà."
Ayi nswɛɛŋ a kölàköl anà yàtàtwɛb.
Yàyweel yà mfun sye àyi: "Ngye asàkwen un'tɔŋ angye asànaa ngye ŋakwo."
Un'kɔɔn wanswà anà aŋangɔɔm bàtoo u nswɛɛŋ ayi yàyweel.»
Amfarisi bàkäl aŋàköŋ, waa Yɛsu kafuul naa:
«An'kyän abɛ myà aben ntɔn Klistɔ? Nde wà mwan anà?» Ba bun'fuur naa: «Wà David.»
Nde kàtɛn a ba naa: «Abun, aben David, u mbwo a Dweelà, kun'beelà nde Mwol mpal kàtɛn nde naa:
Mwol kàtɛn a mwol amɛ naa: Bwaay u kɔɔ amɛ libaal, tii mpal in'sàsà mɛ aŋankir angye ungyɛl a in'kɔl angye.»
«Isàkal abun naa David afun'bel "Mwol", aben nde kan'kwo mufàkal mwan a David?»
Akà mbuur mwɛy kàsàkwo anki mukun'fuur akà ndaa mwɛy. Sɛmà ilä akin, akà mbuur mwɛy kàfàsi anki mukun'fuul ndaa.
Apan, Yɛsu kàtɛn a un'sɛŋ a baar anà alɔŋki ande naa:
«Alɔɔŋ a Un'kɔɔn anà Amfarisi bàkyàbwaay u kir a Mɔsɛ.
Undiir awun, làler yinà yanswà ban'kwo mutɛn ba a bɛ. Wɛɛ twon lan'lab nkyeer aba, ntɔn ba bàfàkyer anki ayà bàfàtɛn ba.
Ba bàfàbäm indiir a buur anà bàfàtälà bya udu a ipaay a baar. Wɛɛ ba ŋakwo bàfàkwen anki mukaal bya a làpin.
Nsyääl aba yanswà yà ntɔn baar bamɛn. Ba bàfàbwaar inkwà abye anà ndaa a Nzam, in'lɛl a ipfɛy aba myà bwɛlàbwɛl.
Ba bàfàkwen mubwaay kà ikal atàtwɛb kà in'kyɔm, anà kà an'kir atàtwɛb u ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà,
ba bàfàkwen naa baar bapɛ mbɔr a làkoo kà ikal a un'sɛŋ anà baar babel naa "Un'lɔɔŋ".
Wɛɛ bɛ, bɛ twon bàmàlabel "Un'lɔɔŋ", ntɔn bɛ làbye awà Un'lɔɔŋ mwɛy mpɛl, bɛ banswà làbà atɔŋ.
Twon lan'bel mbuur u mɛɛn "Taa", ntɔn bɛ làbye awà umwɛy mpɛl, Taa awà u du.
Twon bàmàlabel sye "un'lɔɔŋ", ntɔn bɛ un'lɔɔŋ asin watɛy, Klistɔ mpɛl.
Mbuur a kölàköl uboo a bɛ asàkal un'syääl abɛ.
Mbuur wanswà asàsɛn an'pɛy bàkyer asun'tyeey, wɛɛ mbuur a làbɔ̈ɔ̈n bàkyer asun'sɛɛn.»
«Ngyɛb akà bɛ, bɛ alɔɔŋ a un'kɔɔn anà Amfarisi a mpem yweel! Bɛ làfàbäm mbwo a Imwol a du akà baar. Bɛ ŋàkwo làfàbilà anki kwo, wɛɛ bɛ làfàtsuŋ baar akwà bàfàkwen mubilà.»

[«Ngyɛb akà bɛ alɔɔŋ a Un'kɔɔn anà Amfarisi, baar a mpem yweel! Bɛ làfàgyɔɔr kà an'kɔɔ a akweel adim indiir aba byanswà, wɛɛ taaŋ nsil la, bɛ làbàmusà ngyamàkà a bwɛlàbwɛl ntɔn baar bàlamɛn. Undiir awun, ntaaŋàmbar abɛ isàkal yàŋàdiir an'din!»]

«Ngyɛb akà bɛ alɔɔŋ a Un'kɔɔn anà Amfarisi a mpem yweel! Bɛ, bɛ làwàmuyikyà ntsü yanswà u mɛɛn anà udu a ngyäl ntɔn mubuul mpem a mbuur mwɛy, wɛɛ nde usàlakyey, apan bɛ làmun'biil u yaaŋ a mbaa mbalà yweel yàŋàsöön bɛ.»
«Ngyɛb akà bɛ, asyeen a ikwàmii! Bɛ làfàtɛn naa: "Undiir watɛy isàkal naa mbuur kan'dyà kyän kà idwà. Wɛɛ isàkal naa nde kan'dyà la u wɔl a ndwà a Nzam, apan nde kan'kyey ipepey."
Insil, ikwàmii! Undiir nà kan'söön uteer: wɔl, lɛɛ idwà akwà kyan'buul wɔl undiir a in'kyɛɛl?
Bɛ làfàtɛn sye naa: "Undiir watɛy isàkal naa mbuur mwɛy kan'dyà kyän udu a mɛsà afub ibɔɔn. Wɛɛ isàkal naa nde kan'dyà kyän unsà kab alà udu a mɛsà afub ibɔɔn, apan nde kan'kyey ipepey."
Ikwàmii! Undiir nà kan'söön mfun, ibɔɔn akyà udu a mɛsà a ibɔɔn, lɛɛ mɛsà a ibɔɔn akwà myan'buul ibɔɔn aki undiir a in'kyɛɛl?
Lalan, mbuur wanswà afàdyà kyän udu a mɛsà a ibɔɔn, nde sye afàdyà udu a mɛsà a ibɔɔn anà indiir byanswà abyà udu pa,
mbuur afàdyà kyän kà idwà, afàdyà kyän kà idwà anà akà mbuur afàkal uboo kwo,
mbuur afàdyà kyän u mbwo a du afàdyà kyän u mbwo a kir a Imwol a Nzam anà akà mbuur afàbwaay kwo.»

«Ngyɛb akà bɛ, bɛ alɔɔŋ a Un'kɔɔn anà Amfarisi, baar a mpem yweel! Bɛ làfàpà akà Nzam un'te mwɛy uboo a in'te kwem, in'te asànaa mɛntɛ, fɛnwil anà kümin. Wɛɛ bɛ, bɛ làfàpiy indiir byan'söön mfun uboo a Un'kɔɔn asànaa balàbal, nsyääm anà lää: abi indiir lan'kwo bɛ mukyer ukɔɔn apiy byumwɛy.
Asyeen aŋàkwàmii! Bɛ làfàkɔr imwe kun'lɛɛ, wɛɛ bɛ làfàmin mpoonà!»
«Ngyɛb akà bɛ, alɔɔŋ a Un'kɔɔn anà Amfarisi a mpem yweel! Bɛ làfàsɔŋ nsà a kɔɔb anà yà làlɔŋà, wɛɛ boo a ma làŋàyɔl a indiir a küb anà làmpfɛɛl abɛ.
Umfarisi aŋàkwàmii! Tàsɔŋ boo a kɔɔb, ntɔn nsà sye ipɔŋà.

«Ngyɛb akà bɛ, alɔɔŋ a Un'kɔɔn anà Amfarisi, baar a mpem yweel! Bɛ làbà asànaa an'dii aŋàkiir un'swɛn a pɛɛl: u nsà ma mye anà ntwɛn, wɛɛ ubɔɔ ma màŋàyɔl a in'kwo a baar aŋàkwà anà ipɔɔn byà ifà ifà.
Abun bɛ sye, u nsà bɛ làkamɛnà asànaa baar a balàbal umii a un'sɛŋ, wɛɛ ubɔɔ, bɛ làbà aŋàyɔl a mpem yweel anà an'kyän an'be.»
«Ngyɛb akà bɛ, alɔɔŋ a Un'kɔɔn anà Amfarisi a mpem yweel! Bɛ làfàtööŋ aŋangɔɔm abɛ an'dii, anà bɛ làfàsà ntwɛn kà an'dii a baar a balàbal,
waa bɛ làfàtɛn naa: "Yàlàkal naa bi ikäl utaaŋ a bànkaa abi, bi kàlàbwà anki mbwo mwɛy anà ba ntɔn mutyaŋ an'kil a aŋangɔɔm."
Abun, bɛ lan'tà imbäl bɛ ŋakwo naa bɛ làbà baan a baar bàdwä aŋangɔɔm.
Apanà, làkölà isal bàsɛmà bàtaaràbɛ!
Ntäy, a iyäy! Nkye bɛ làkyàkwo mutiin ntaaŋàmbar a yaaŋ a mbaa?

Undiir awun, làwem: mɛ, mɛ amàlatööm aŋangɔɔm, aŋan'yeerà anà alɔɔŋ a Un'kɔɔn. Bɛ làsàdwa amwɛy anà làsabɛɛrà u kulunsi, làsàkam bumwɛy an'füm u ndwà a nköŋ abɛ anà làsamɛɛy nkwaaŋ u bul a bul,
ntɔn an'kil a baar a balàbal màpää u mɛɛn isàbwà udu a bɛ, sɛmà an'kil a Abɛl mbuur a balàbal tii akà an'kil a Zakàlye, mwan a Balaki, awà làdwä bɛ uboboo a idwà anà mɛsà a ibɔɔn.
Undiir awun, waa mɛ amàlakyään ndandaa naa: mpay a ube abà banswà isàbwà u du a un'tswe a nkööl a ŋàbà!»

«Yɛlusàlɛm, Yɛlusàlɛm, ngye, ngye mbuur afàdwa aŋangɔɔm anà afàtà bumwɛy katööm Nzam in'kul. Mbalà kwe kàkwen mɛ muböbà baan angye ikal imwɛy apà mɛ asànaa ngwän a nkɔɔ ufàböbà wa baan awa u ngyɛl a an'paab ande, wɛɛ ngye, ngye kàsàkwen anki!
Undiir awun, ndwà angye bàsawɛy yà ipɔl.
Kyakin, waa mɛ amakyään ndandaa naa: Sɛmà ŋàbawà, bɛ mɛ làfàsaman anki tii làsàtɛn bɛ naa: "Wɛy nsaak ikäl akà mbuur awà ayà kà ikɔb a Mwol!"»
Yàmɛnà naa Yɛsu kàtoo nde u ndwà a Nzam anà kàkäl nde mukyà, alɔŋki ande bàyàsin apà nde ntɔn mukun'swaŋ ntööŋ a ndwà a Nzam.
Nde waa kàfuur naa: «Nkye bɛ làkimanà indiir abi byanswà? Ndandaa mɛ alàkyään, akà nkɔŋ mwɛy ifàsàsal anki udu a nkɔŋ yumwɛy. Ya yanswà ikyer asàpää.»
Yɛsu kàkäl wàŋàbwaay udu a mɔŋ a in'te a ɔlive, alɔŋki bàsin apà nde, waa bàtɛn a nde naa: «Ikyään taaŋ isàyà ndaa ayi, idiim nà isàswaŋ ngyeel angye anà ntsüü a mɛɛn.»
Yɛsu kafuur naa: «Làkäl kà igyɛɛŋ, wɛy mbuur ukɔɔn alakur.
Ntɔn baar mbɔɔn bàsàyà kà ikɔb amɛ, waa bàsàtɛn naa: "Mɛ in'wà Klistɔ!" Ba bàsàkur baar mbɔɔn.
Bɛ làsàwem naa bye anà ità anà in'bää a ità. Twon lan'tɛɛr: indiir abi ikyer ayà, wɛɛ bya kà ntsüü anki.
Un'sɛŋ mwɛy asànwaan anà un'sɛŋ wumwɛy, imwol mwɛy anà imwol kyumwɛy, kà itiir a nsi imwɛy imwɛy, ngyal ikyer asàkal anà mɛɛn ikyer asàtɛɛr.
Wɛɛ indiir abi byanswà byàsàkal nsɛmà a usaay.
Apan, bàsàlasà u ngyɛb aŋàdiir, waa bàsàladwa. In'sɛŋ myanswà ikyer asàlayiiŋ ntɔn ikɔb amɛ.
Apan, bàmbɔɔn bàsàpiy làkwikilà aba, ba bàsàmɛɛn nku ba a ba, anà bàsàyiiŋ ba a ba.
Aŋangɔɔm a loor mbɔɔn bàkyer asàmbarà, waa bàsàbwiy baar mbɔɔn.
Ukwen a baar mbɔɔn bàsàbwà mpye, ntɔn ube bàkyer asàsöönà.
Wɛɛ mbuur asàsà muküünà tii u ntsüü, asàwà mɔ̈ɔ̈.
Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ là Imwol alà bàkyer asàkyään la u mɛɛn manswà. Kya isàkal imbäl ntɔn in'sɛŋ myanswà. Apan waa ntsüü isàyà.»
«Lalan, mpal làsàman bɛ lingyoomà mbɔɔn alà kàtɛn ŋangɔɔm Danyel lan'bilà kà ikal a in'kyɛɛl, - wɛy mbuur akataŋà uyöb! -
Apan, wɛy baar bàsàkal u Yuday, bàtiin uboo a myɔŋ,
wɛy mbuur asàkal udu a nsyä a ndwà, ukɔɔn ayàtɔlà ntɔn muwal indiir abyà uboo a ndwà ande,
wɛy mbuur awà u ywaŋ ande, ukɔɔn afurà ndwà ntɔn mukàwal ipfɛy ande.
Ngyɛb akà akaar aŋayöm anà akaar bàsàkal munüü baan kà ilä abin!
Làyamà ntɔn bɛ làkɔɔn asàtiin u paŋà a làbe, itàkal kà ilä a saba!
Ntɔn, umpal ayin, isàkal anà ngyɛb aŋàdiir mpa aŋàtàkal fà nsɛmà a mɛɛn tii ŋàbà, anà ya sye ifàsàkal anki akà ikikye.
Yàlàkal naa Nzam ukɔ̈ɔ̈n atyey ilä abin, akà mbuur mwɛy kàlàwà anki mɔ̈ɔ̈. Wɛɛ, ntɔn baar kàsɔ̈ɔ̈l nde, ilä abin isàkal byàŋàtyeey.
Apan, isàkal naa mbuur mwɛy kan'tɛn a bɛ naa: "Làler, Klistɔ awà kà!" Itàkal naa: "Nde awunà kunà!", twon lun'kyey.
Ntɔn aklistɔ a loor anà aŋangɔɔm a loor bàkyer asàmbarà, bàsàkyer idiim a kölàköl anà impà ntɔn mukur baar, kya ipöl isàkal, itàkal baar bàŋàsɔɔl.
Làler, mɛ ya amàlaweey kusà.»
«Abun, isàkal naa bàmàlakyään naa: "Làler, nde wà u nsye a ipɔl!", twon lan'kyà. "Nde wà kà ikal a mpey", twon lan'kyey.
Ntɔn, ngyeel a Mwan a mbuur isàkal asànaa muŋyä ufàpàrà wa fà mper làfàsɛnà taaŋ tii mper làfàkàminà la.
Ntsü yanswà iwà ndom, nɛn ayifàdyà in'twaŋ ifàkàköŋ kwo.»
«Taaŋ a mbɔɔn tɛy ungö a mpay a kölàköl yà ilä abin, taaŋ làsàbwà làpib, nsöŋ ifàsàpà anki kyɛɛy a wa, mbwaar ikyer asàbwà fà du, ngwal a du ikyer asàni.
Apan, idiim a Mwan a mbuur isàmɛnà u du, apan in'sɛŋ myanswà amyà u mɛɛn ikyer asàlaal, mya isàman Mwan a mbuur wàmuyà uboo a itööm a du anà unkaak a ngwal anà làkoo.
Nde asàtɔm akyeey ande anà mfuŋ a kölàköl, waa ba bàsàtüüb baar kàsɔ̈ɔ̈l nde u mper yànà, fà nswɛŋ a du tii nswɛŋ yumwɛy.»
«Làyöb an'lɔɔŋ man'fà unsà un'te a fige: isàkal naa an'kɔkà ande man'bulà an'dà an'dà anà nkay sye yan'too, làyöb apan naa paŋà aŋàbwaŋ là tsütsü.
Abun, akà bɛ sye, mpal làsàman bɛ indiir abi byanswà, làyöb naa Mwan a Mbuur wà tsütsü a minambwo a ndwà abɛ.
Ndandaa mɛ alàkyään, nkööl ayi isàkal aŋàlyaŋ anki kusà a ndaa ayi muyà.
Du anà mɛɛn màkyer asàlyaŋ, wɛɛ ndaa amɛ isàlyaŋ anki akà ikikye.»
«Wɛɛ akà mbuur mwɛy uyöb anki ilä kya anà taaŋ la, itàkal akyeey, itàkal Mwan, nà Taa mpɛl.
Asànaa ndaa yàlyaŋ utaaŋ a Nɔwà, ngyeel a Mwan a mbuur isàkal abun sye.
Ntɔn, u paŋà alan, kusà ikül a mbul muyööl mɛɛn, baar bàkäl mudyà, munwà, mutà an'bɔr anà mupà baan aba an'bɔr tii ilä kàbilà Nɔwà kà an'swà.
Ba bàmɛnà anki akà ube mwɛy tii ilä màyöl an'dà anà masyen ma ba banswà. Ya isàkal sye abun umpal usàyà Mwan a mbuur.
Apan, abaal bɔ̈ɔ̈l bàsàkal kan'ywaŋ: umwɛy bàkyer asun'syen, wumwɛy bàkyer asun'wɛy.
Akaar bɔ̈ɔ̈l bàsàkal muyir: umwɛy bàkyer asun'syɛn, wumwɛy bàkyer asun'wɛy.
Abun, làkäl kà igyɛɛŋ, ntɔn bɛ làyöb anki ilä usàyà Mwol abɛ.
Bɛ làkyàyöb: yàlàkal naa ŋandwà akiyöbà naa taaŋ nà mbüüb usàyà u mpib, nde kàlikalà kà igyɛɛŋ anà nde kàlun'wɛyà anki mubilà u ndwà ande.
Undiir awun, bɛ sye làkäl aŋàlɔ̈ɔ̈n, ntɔn Mwan a mbuur asàyà u taaŋ mpa làsàyöb bɛ.»
«Abun, nà awà un'syääl a lää anà wàŋàlɔ̈ɔ̈n awà kàpɛ nkum buur a asyääl a ndwà ande ntɔn mukapà isa u taaŋ a taaŋ?
Un'sak akà un'syääl awà usyetaan nkum ande, taaŋ usàyà nde, wàmukyer abà!
Ndandaa mɛ alàkyään, nde asun'pà buur a indiir ande byanswà.
Wɛɛ, isàkal naa nde wà un'syääl un'be, nde asàyweer naa: "Nkum amɛ usyefurà anki agyägyä",
anà nde ubulà mudüb atɔŋ ande bà isal, mudyà anà munwà ikal imwɛy a in'yöör a man,
nkum a un'syääl awà asàyà kà ilä anà u taaŋ mpa uyöb nde.
Nde akyer asun'böŋ anà asun'pà ntaaŋàmbar ikwe a baar a mpem yweel: kwo isàkal ilel anà nkwoor a an'din.»
«Apan, Imwol a du isàkal asànaa baan asye ankɔr bàwɛl minà aba ntɔn mukàbwey a un'dim aba.
Atyeen uboo a ba bàkäl insil, atyeen bàkäl aŋan'yeerà.
Insil bàwɛl ba minà, ba bàsyen anki may.
Asye aŋan'yeerà, bàwɛl ba minà, ba bàwɛl anà may unsà in'laŋ.
Kyekà baal atà bɔr kàkyer itaan muyà, undiir awun ba banswà bàbɔ̈ɔ̈n ba.
Uboboo a mpib, ba bàwem làso làmwɛy: "Le baal atà bɔr! Làkyen kàlabwey anà nde!"
Apan, asye ankɔr banswà bàwiyà ba, ba bàsɛmà mulɔn minà aba.
Asye insil bàtɛn a asye aŋan'yeerà naa: "Lipɛ bi ndam a may, ntɔn minà abi myàmudim."
Aŋan'yeerà bàfuur naa: "Aay, may ikwo anki ntɔn bɛ anà bi. Làkyen kàlasöm akà baar bàfàyälà ma."
Mpal bàkyen ba mukàsom ma, baal atà bɔr laa kàyàkɔlà nde. Asye akwà bàkäl aŋàlɔ̈ɔ̈n bàbilà mbwo mwɛy anà nde u ndwà atà bɔr, waa bàdübà ibeenà.
Ungöngö, asye ankɔr bumwɛy bàyi ba, ba bàtɛn naa: "nkum, nkum, iduub!"
Wɛɛ nde kafuur naa: "Mɛ alàkyään ndandaa naa mɛ alàyöb anki."
Undiir awun, làkäl aŋàlɔ̈ɔ̈n taaŋ lanswà. Ntɔn bɛ làyöb anki itàkal ilä, itàkal taaŋ.»
«Ya isàkal asànaa mbuur mwɛy kàkyà nkyeen, nde kàbel asyääl ande, waa kapɛ indiir ande.
Nde mbuur mwɛy kun'pɛ itɛr ityeen, akà wumwɛy ibyeel, akà wumwɛy sye imwɛy mpɛl, mbuur mbuur asànaa awà un'kanà ande. Apan nde waa kàkyen.
Mbuur awà kàwɛl itɛr ityeen, kàkyen musal anà byà, waa kàwɛl bweel a itɛr ityeen asin.
Ifà imwɛy sye anà mbuur awà kàwɛl itɛr ibyeel, nde kàwɛl bweel a ibyeel asin.
Wɛɛ mbuur awà kàwɛl imwɛy mpɛl, nde kàtim fu, waa kàyee ngim a nkum ande.»
«Ungö a ilä mbɔɔn, nkum a asyääl abà waa kàyàfurà, waa kàlɔ̈m naa ba bun'swɛŋ nsyääl a ngim ande.
Mbuur awà kàwɛl itɛr ityeen, kàsin nde, waa kàswɛŋ ityeen asin, waa kàtɛn naa: "Nkum amɛ, ngye kampɛ itɛr ityeen, le ityeen asin kàtwey mɛ."
Nkum ande kàtɛn a nde naa: "Yubwaŋ, ngye awà un'syääl aŋàbwaŋ anà wàlää. Ngye kàkäl wàlää unsà indiir ikikye, mɛ in'sasà udu a byàmbɔɔn. Yà, saŋ anà nkum angye.
Mbuur kàwɛl itɛr ibyeel kàsin nde sye, waa kàtɛn naa: "Nkum amɛ, ngye kampɛ itɛr ibyeel, le ibyeel asin kàtwey mɛ abi."
Nkum ande kàtɛn a nde naa: "Yubwaŋ, ngye awà un'syääl aŋàbwaŋ anà wàlää. Ngye kàkäl wàlää unsà indiir ikikye, mɛ in'sasà udu a byàmbɔɔn. Yà, saŋ anà nkum angye."

Mbuur kàwɛl itɛr imwɛy mpɛl, kàsin nde sye, waa kàtɛn naa: "Nkum amɛ, mɛ in'kyàyöb naa­ ngye awà mbuur a ndaa a ngwal: Ngye afàbwo kà ikal mpa kàkön ngye, ngye afàköŋà kà ikal mpa kàmwɛŋ ngye.
Mɛ kàmɛn bɔɔmà, lalan kàkàdye mɛ itɛr angye u mɛɛn, le undiir angye awà."
Wɛɛ nkum ande kun'fuur naa: "Un'syääl un'be, un'bwal! Ngye kàkiyöbà naa mɛ in'fàbwo kà ikal mpa kàkön mɛ anà mɛ in'fàköŋà kà ikal mpa kàmwɛŋ mɛ.
Abun yàlàbwaŋ naa ngye atɔ̈l ngim amɛ u bank: u mfurà amɛ, mɛ in'làkàtwey undiir amɛ anà bweel udu.
Abun, lun'lwom itɛr akin, làpɛ kya akà mbuur awe abyà itɛr kwem.
Ntɔn, bàsàpà akà mbuur awe anà indiir mbɔɔn, waa nde usàkal abyà byàŋàsöön mbɔɔn, wɛɛ bàsàlwom akà mbuur akwà mpa awe anà undiir, bàsàlwom itàkal undiir kàkäl nde awà.
Akà un'syääl akɔ̈ɔ̈n ndöŋ wà, lun'tɔɔm u làpib u nsà: kwo isàkal ilel anà nkwoor a an'din."»
«Mpal usàyà Mwan a mbuur unsà làkoo ande anà akyeey banswà, apan nde asàbwaay udu a kir a làkoo ande.
In'sɛŋ myanswà myàsàköŋ kusà ande. Nde asàkaab baar amwɛy anà bumwɛy, asànaa un'seey ufàkaab nde in'kɔk anà ntab.
Nde in'kɔk asasà u kɔɔ ande libaal, ntab u kɔɔ ande likaar.
Apan, mfum asàtɛn a baar bàsàkal u kɔɔ ande libaal naa: "Làyi, bɛ baar kàsaak Taaràmɛ. Làbilà ubɔɔ a imwol akyà bàlɔ̈ɔ̈n ntɔn bɛ sɛmà bàkyer mɛɛn.
Ntɔn mɛ, mɛ kàkäl anà ngyal, bɛ lan'pɛ isaa adyà. Mɛ kàkäl anà mfwää, bɛ lan'pɛ undiir anwà. Mɛ kàkäl ungyey, bɛ waa lan'wɛl,
mɛ kàkäl wànsàpɔl, bɛ waa lan'bwää. Mɛ kàkäl anà ukyal, bɛ waa làyan'ler. Mɛ kàkäl u bɔlokà, bɛ waa làyan'ler."
Apan, baar a balàbal bàsun'fuur naa: "Mwol, mpal nà kamɛn bi anà ngyal, waa bi kapɛ isaa adyà, itàkal anà mfwää, waa bi kapɛ undiir anwà?
Mpal nà kamɛn bi ungyey, waa bi kawɛl, itàkal wànsàpɔl waa bi kabwää?
Mpal nà kamɛn bi anà ukyal itàkal u bɔlokà, waa bi kàyaler?"
Mfum usafuur naa: "Mɛ, mɛ alakyään ndandaa: mbalà yanswà ayà làkyer bɛ indiir abi akà umwɛy ubɔɔ a bibaan akye bà, abà atɔŋ amɛ, bɛ bya làkyer akà mɛ."»
«Abun, nde asàtɛn a baar bàsàkal u kɔɔ ande likaar naa: "Baar aŋàküül! Làkyà kunà! Làkyen u mbaa a mbul a in'tye ayà bàyöŋà ntɔn ileŋ anà akyeey ande!
Ntɔn mɛ kàkäl anà ngyal, wɛɛ bɛ udyà lan'pɛ anki. Mɛ kàkäl anà mfwää, wɛɛ bɛ undiir anwà lan'pɛ anki.
Mɛ kàkäl ungyey, wɛɛ bɛ lan'wɛl anki, wànsàpɔl, wɛɛ bɛ lan'bwää anki. Mɛ kàkäl anà ukyal anà u bɔlokà, wɛɛ bɛ làyan'ler anki."
Apan ba bàsun'fuur naa: "Mwol, mpal nà kamɛn bi anà ngyal itàkal anà mpfwää, itàkal un'ngyey, itàkal wànsàpɔl, itàkal anà ukyal, itàkal u bɔlokà, waa bi mpa kabay?"
Mfum waa usafuur naa: "Mɛ, mɛ alàkyään ndandaa: mbalà yanswà mpa làkyer bɛ indiir abi byanswà akà umwɛy ubɔɔ a bibaan abi, bɛ bya sye làkyer anki akà mɛ."
Baar abà bàsàkyà u ntaaŋàmbar a mbul a in'tye, wɛɛ baar a balàbal u mɔ̈ɔ̈ a mbul a in'tye.»
Mpal kàmay Yɛsu nswɛɛŋ ayi yanswà, nde kàtɛn a alɔŋki ande naa:
«Bɛ làkyàyöb naa un'kyɔm a Pak ayàkal ungö a ilä byeel: Mwan a mbuur bàkyer ayun'yälà, ntɔn bun'bɛɛrà u kulunsi.»
Apan, andweer a angaŋ anà andweer a un'sɛŋ a Ayudà bakyer aköŋ u ndwà a Undweer a angaŋ Kayifa.
Ba bàtsül mukɔr Yɛsu u mbwo a loor anà mukun'dwa.
Wɛɛ, ba bàtɛɛnà naa: «Wɛy ya ikɔɔn akal umpal bàkyɔɔmà ba, manà lingyoomà làyàbwà uboo a un'sɛŋ.»
Yɛsu kàkäl u Bɛtani u ndwà a Simɔn ŋabay.
Un'kaar mwɛy kàyàsin apà nde anà un'laŋ wàŋàyɔl a may a usɔŋ bàfàbel naa albatre. Ma mà ntal mbɔɔn. Nde kàtyaŋ ma udu a un'tswe a Yɛsu mpal kàkäl nde mudyà.
Mpal bàmɛn alɔŋki abun, ba bàmɛn ube mbɔɔn, waa bàtɛn naa: «Ntɔn nkye ubii a tub abà?
Yàlàbwaŋ muyälà may a usɔŋ amà u ntal a mbɔɔn, waa ngim ayin bàlàpà aŋàlàmbwà!»
Mpal kàyöb Yɛsu an'kyän aba, nde kàtɛn a ba naa: «Ntɔn nkye làpà bɛ un'kaar wà mpay? Nde kan'kyer ndaa aŋàbwaŋ ntɔn mɛ.
Ntɔn aŋàlàmbwà bà anà bɛ ilä byanswà, wɛɛ mɛ, mɛ in'wà anki anà bɛ ilä byanswà.
Kan'tyaŋ nde may a usɔŋ mà udu a ndür amɛ, nde kan'lɔɔn ndyee amɛ.
Ndandaa mɛ alakyään: mper yanswà bàsàkàkyään Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ, u mɛɛn manswà, bàsakyäänà sye ndaa kan'kyer un'kaar wà, ntɔn mukun'yɔbà.»
Apan, Yudasi Isikalyɔt, umwɛy uboo a alɔŋki kwem aŋiyweel bà Yɛsu, kàkàman andweer a angaŋ,
waa kàtɛn a ba naa: «Ininà bɛ lan'pà, waa mɛ alàpà awà?» Ba bun'pɛ itɛr a ngim an'kwem an'tär.
Sɛmà apan, Yudasi kàyileŋà ipöl aŋàbwaŋ ntɔn mukapɛɛl awà.
Ilä a tàtwɛb kyà un'kyɔm a mampà màkɔ̈ɔ̈n ful, alɔŋki bàyi akà Yɛsu mukun'fuul naa: «Ngye akwen naa bi ikàlɔn ken ikal adyà ngye Pak?»
Yɛsu kàtɛn a ba naa: «Làkyen u bul a kölàköl, akà mbuur mwɛy, lun'kyään naa: "Un'lɔɔŋ an'tɛn naa: Taaŋ amɛ là tsütsü, mɛ anà alɔŋki amɛ in'yàdyà Pak u ndwà angye."»
Alɔŋki bàlɔ̈ɔ̈n Pak asànaa kaswɛŋ Yɛsu.
Mpal a sisye, Yɛsu kàkäl u mɛsà anà Bàkwem Aŋiyweel.
Mpal bàkäl ba mudyà, Yɛsu kàtɛn naa: «Ndandaa mɛ alàkyään: umwɛy uboo a bɛ ayan'mɛɛn nku.»
Ba bàmɛn ngyɛb mbɔɔn, waa bàsɛmà mukun'fuul umwɛy umwɛy naa: «Mwol, nkye mɛ?»
Yɛsu kafuur naa: «Mbuur awà kan'biil kɔɔ mbwo mwɛy anà mɛ uboo a làlɔŋà a isaa, mbuur nsil awà ayan'mɛɛn nku.
Mwan a mbuur wàmukyà asànaa Ndaa Aŋàsɔn ikyäänà ya ntɔn nde. Wɛɛ ngyɛb akà mbuur amɛɛn Mwan a mbuur nku! Yàlàkal ubwaŋ naa mbuur awà bàkɔɔn a un'bɔr!»
Yudasi, mbuur ayun'yälà, kun'fuul naa: «Mwol, nkye mɛ?» Yɛsu kun'fuur naa: «Ngye ŋakwo an'tɛn.»
Umpal bàkäl ba mudyà, Yɛsu kàwɛl mampà, ungö kàsaak nde ma, nde kàtsül ma, kàpɛ alɔŋki ande, waa kàtɛn naa: «Mää, làdi, ayi yà ndür amɛ.»
Ungö, nde kàwɛl kɔɔb a vin, ungö mufuur an'tɔɔn, nde kàpɛ ba, waa kàtɛn naa: «Lànü la bɛ banswà,
ntɔn mamà an'kil amɛ, an'kil a un'tüüb, màpää ntɔn un'kàbɔ a baar, ntɔn ndwääl a nkul a man'be aba.
Mɛ, mɛ alàkyään naa: sɛmà apanà, mɛ in'fàsànwà anki vin tii ilä in'sànwà mɛ vin akün mbwo mwɛy anà bɛ uboo a Imwol a Taaràmɛ.»
Ungö mutɔl an'diim a un'kyɔm, ba bàtoo ntɔn mukyà mɔŋ a In'te a ɔlive.
Apan, Yɛsu kàtɛn a alɔŋki ande naa: «U mpib a ŋàbà, bɛ banswà làkyer abwà ntɔn mɛ. Ntɔn bàsön naa: "Mɛ, mɛ in'sàdwa un'kyɛɛŋ a in'kɔk, waa in'kɔk a làböl myàsàtà upay."
Wɛɛ, mpal in'sàwiyà mɛ, mɛ in'sàlafweel u Ngalilɛ.»
Petɔlà kàwɛl ndaa, waa kàtɛn naa: «Itàkal naa ba banswà ban'bwà ntɔn ngye, wɛɛ mɛ, mɛ in'sàbwà anki akà ikikye.»
Yɛsu kàtɛn a nde naa: «Mɛ, ndandaa mɛ akyään: u mpib nsil ayi, kusà a nkɔɔ mutàbeel, ngye ayan'tɔn mbalà tär.»
Petɔlà kàtɛn a nde naa: «Itàkal naa mɛ in'kyer akwà anà ngye, aay, mɛ in'satɔn anki.» Waa alɔŋki banswà bàtɛn sye mun mwɛy wa.
Yɛsu kàyàkɔlà anà alɔŋki ande kà ikal mwɛy bàfàbel Ngɛtɛsɛmani, waa kàtɛn a ba naa: «Sàlàbwaayà pà, mpal in'kàyamà mɛ kunà.»
Ungö apan nde kàsyen Petɔlà anà baan a Zebeday babaal bàbɔ̈ɔ̈l, waa kàsɛmà muman ngyɛb anà bɔɔmà aŋàdiir.
Apan nde kàtɛn a ba naa: «Mpem amɛ yàŋàyɔl a ngyɛb mbɔɔn tsütsü a ukwà. Sàlakälà pà anà làgyɛɛŋ anà mɛ.»
Nde kàkyen u kikwɛl, waa kàbü, ntabwey u mɛɛn, waa kàyamà abà: «Taa, kya mbwo isàkal, wɛy kɔɔb là làlyaŋ ukwɛl apà mɛ! Itàkal naa abwɛy, kyer ukwen angye, wɛɛ kà bàmɛ anki.»
Nde kan'yà ntsü bàkäl alɔŋki ande batär, waa kàmaman bàŋàbɔ̈ɔ̈n. Nde kan'tɛn a Petɔlà naa: «Abà, nkye bɛ làkal anki anà ngwal mukyɛɛŋ itàkal taaŋ làmwɛy anà mɛ!
Làkyɛɛŋ anà làyamà, ntɔn bɛ làkɔ̈ɔ̈n abwà u ndɛb. Dweelà làŋàyɔl a ngwal, wɛɛ ndür ye anà ukwarà.»
U mbalà yàyweel, nde kàkyà ukwel, waa kàyamà abà: «Taaràmɛ, isàkal naa ikwe anki naa kɔɔb làlyaŋ, naa mɛ in'kɔ̈ɔ̈n anwà la, wɛy ukwen angye bàkäl!»
U mbalà asin kàfàyà nde apà alɔŋki ande, nde kàfaman bàŋàbɔ̈ɔ̈n, ntɔn mii aba myàkäl myàŋàbwà buur.
Yɛsu waa kàsawɛy, waa kàkyen ukwɛl, waa kàyamà mbalà yàtär, wàmufuur ndaa nsil ya.
Apan, kàyi nde apà alɔŋki, nde kàtɛn a ba naa: «Fàlabɔ̈ɔ̈nà, fàlàyöörà! Kyekà taaŋ bàyälà ba Mwan a mbuur kà an'kɔɔ a baar abe lye tsütsü.
Làmbarà! Tsweenà! Le mbuur kàman'yälà wà tsütsü!»
Umpal kàkäl nde muyäämà, Yudasi, umwɛy uboo a Bàkwem Aŋiyweel kàyàkɔlà anà iköŋ a baar mbɔɔn bàtöm andweer a angaŋ anà andweer a un'sɛŋ. Ba bàkäl anà an'kɔm anà nköl.
Mbuur kun'yälà, kapɛ idiim ki: «Mbuur wanswà in'kàböbà mɛ, mbuur wa nde awun. Lun'kör.»
Taaŋ nsil alan, Yudasi kàsin apà Yɛsu, waa kàtɛn a nde naa: «Un'lɔɔŋ, mbɔr angye!» Waa kun'böbà.
Yɛsu kàtɛn a nde naa: «Un'sam, kyer undiir ayeel ngye.» Apan, laa bàsin ba, bun'tɛ ba mpi, waa bun'kör.
Umwɛy uboo a baar bàkäl a Yɛsu, kàsilà kɔɔ, waa kàtwey kɔm ande, laa kàkäm nde un'syääl a undweer a angaŋ, waa kun'tsül tsü.
Apan, Yɛsu waa kàtɛn a nde naa: «Fuur kɔm angye kà ikal a la, ntɔn baar banswà bàfàsyääl kɔm, bàsàkwà a kɔm.
Nkye ngye ayöb anki naa mɛ an'kwo in'lɔ̈ɔ̈m akà Taaràmɛ, nde sye kan'tööm in'lwaaŋ kwem aŋiyweel myà akyeey làgyägyä?
Ndaa Aŋàsön ayà itɛɛnà naa ya ikal abà, yàlàkwo aben?»

Utaaŋ alan, Yɛsu kàtɛn a iköŋ a baar naa: «Bɛ, bɛ lan'yà anà an'kɔm anà nköl ntɔn muyan'kɔr asànaa mɛ iwà un'dwää baar! Ilä byanswà mɛ kàkäl aŋàbwaay u ndwà a Nzam mulɔŋ, wɛɛ bɛ lan'nkör anki.
Wɛɛ ayi yanswà yan'yà ntɔn Ndaa Aŋàsɔn a aŋangɔɔm ikwe.» Apan, alɔŋki banswà bàkyer asun'kɔɔb, waa bàtiin.
Baar abà bàkör Yɛsu bun'syen akà undweer a angaŋ Kayifa, ikal bàköŋ alɔɔŋ a Un'kɔɔn anà andweer.
Petɔlà kàyun'labà ukwɛl tii u làpaŋ a undweer a angaŋ. Nde kàbilà u làpaŋ, waa kàbwaay ikal imwɛy anà aseey ntɔn muler naa ya ikàtsü aben.
Amfum a angaŋ anà Làbay a nsaŋ a kölàköl lanswà bàleŋà imbäl a loor ntɔn Yɛsu ntɔn bun'tsüül mbar a ukwà.
Itàkal naa ambäl a loor mbɔɔn bàkyer ayàmɛnà, wɛɛ ba bàmɛn anki akà imbäl mwɛy. Ungöngö, abɔ̈ɔ̈l waa bàyàmɛnà,
waa bàtɛn naa: «Mbuur wà kàtɛn naa: "Mɛ an'kwo in'bwaab ndwà a Nzam, waa in'fàtɔŋ ya ungö a ilä itär."»
Undweer a angaŋ laa kàmbarà nde, waa kàtɛn a Yɛsu naa: «Nkye ngye undiir afuur anki unsà ya yanswà bafüünà baar bà?»
Wɛɛ Yɛsu kàkälà a duu. Waa undweer a angaŋ kàtɛn a nde naa: «Mɛ amaswaŋ kà ikɔb a Nzam a mɔ̈ɔ̈, tɛn a bi, isàkal naa ngye, ngye awà Klistɔ, Mwan a Nzam.»
Yɛsu kun'fuur naa: «Ngye an'tɛn ya. Wɛɛ mɛ, mɛ alàkyään naa semà apanà, bɛ làsàman Mwan a mbuur akyàbwaay u kɔɔ a ibaal a Ngwal anà wàmuyà udu a an'töb a du.»
Apan, undweer a angaŋ kàkaam ipfɛy ande, waa kàtɛn naa: «Nde wàmubɛy! Bi ambäl nkye ifàkyer abà! Apanà bɛ lan'wem mbɛɛy ande!
An'kyän abɛ mà aben?» Ba bàfuur naa: «Nde akyà ukwà.»
Apan ba bun'tsül an'te u ntabwey, bun'düb iki, bumwɛy bun'käm an'füm.
Ba bàtɛn a nde naa: «Ɛɛ, Klistɔ, bulà ŋangɔɔm ntɔn bi! Ikyään, nà kàmakam mbar?»
Kyekà Petɔlà kàkäl aŋàbwaay u nsà, uboo a làpaŋ. Un'syääl mwɛy wun'kaar kàsin apà nde, waa kàtɛn a nde naa: «Ngye sye, ngye kàkäl anà Yɛsu, un'nsi Ngalilɛ.»
Wɛɛ nde kàtön u mii a baar banswà, waa kàtɛn naa: «Mɛ, mɛ in'yöb anki naa ngye ininà atɛɛnà.»
Nde kàkäl mukyà mper akà munàmbwo a làpaŋ, mpal kun'mɛn un'syääl asin wun'kaar anà kàtɛn nde a baar bàkäl paa: «Mbuur wà kàkäl a Yɛsu un'nazɔrya.»
Nde kàfàtɔn mbalà asin, waa kàdi kyän naa: «Mɛ, mɛ mbuur awà un'yöb anki.»
Ungö ikye, baar bàkäl paa bàsin apà Petɔlà, waa bàtɛn a nde naa: «Ndandaa, ngye sye awà umwɛy uboo a baar banà, ntɔn ntɛɛn angye ikaswaŋà ubwaŋàbwaŋ.»
Apan, nde kàsɛmà mudyà kyän anà muŋan naa: «Mɛ, mɛ un'yöb anki mbuur awà!» Apan sye nkɔɔ mwɛy waa kàbel.
Petɔlà kàyɔbà ndaa kàtɛn Yɛsu naa: «Kusà nkɔɔ mutàbel, ngye ayan'tɔn mbalà tär.» Laa kàtoo nde, waa kàlel a un'kwoon wanswà.
Ututu tutu, andweer a angaŋ anà andweer a un'sɛŋ bàköŋ ntɔn mutsüül Yɛsu mbar a ukwà.
Ba bun'bäm in'siŋ, bun'twääl, waa bun'pɛ akà kuvɛrnɔ̈ɔ̈r Pilatu.
Apan, Yudasi mbuur kun'yälà, umpal kàwem nde naa Yɛsu bàmutsüül mbar a ukwà, nde kàfuur an'kyän, waa kàyàfuur itɛr a ngim an'kwem an'tär akà andweer a angaŋ anà andweer a un'sɛŋ.
Waa kàtɛn naa: «Mɛ, mɛ kàkyer ube muyälà an'kil ikɔ̈ɔ̈n ube!» Wɛɛ ba bun'fuur naa: «Kwo akà bi nkye? Nsaŋ angye ŋakwo!»
Yudasi kàwɔm itɛr a ngim bya uboo a ndwà a Nzam, laa kàtoo nde, waa kàkàbäm un'siŋ.
Andweer a angaŋ bàwɛl ngim ayi, waa bàtɛn naa: «Ikwe tɛy musà ngim ayi uboo a un'naaŋ a ndwà a Nzam, ntɔn ya yà ngim a an'kil.»
Ungö bàköŋ ba, ba bàsöm ywaŋ akà un'boom a mpfwee ntɔn mudye angyey.
Undiir awun, bàfàbel ba ywaŋ alà naa "ywaŋ a an'kil" tii ŋàbawà.
Apan, ndaa kàtɛn ŋangɔɔm Yɛlɛmya waa yàkwe: «Ba bàwɛl itɛr an'kwem an'tär byà ngim, ntal bàtsül baan a Isàlɛl mukun'som,
waa ba bàpɛ ya ntɔn ywaŋ a un'boom a mpfwee asànaa kàswɛŋ Mwol abun.»
Yɛsu kàkäl kusà a kuvɛrnɔ̈ɔ̈r. Kuvɛrnɔ̈ɔ̈r kun'fuul naa: «Nkye ngye awà mfum a Ayuda?» Yɛsu kun'fuur naa: «Ngye ŋakwo an'tɛn.»
Wɛɛ utaaŋ bun'füünà andweer a angaŋ anà andweer a un'sɛŋ, nde akà ndaa mwɛy kàfuur anki.
Apan Pilatu kàtɛn a nde naa: «Nkye ngye aweemà anki ndaa yanswà bafüünà ba yi?»
Nde kun'fuur anki akà undiir mwɛy. Abà, kuvɛrnɔ̈ɔ̈r kàbem mbɔɔn.
Yàmɛnà naa kà un'kyɔm wanswà, kuvɛrnɔ̈ɔ̈r kàkäl anà nkääl mutsuuŋ mbuur a bɔlokà mwɛy ntɔn un'sɛŋ, mbuur kàkwenà un'sɛŋ ŋakwo.
Apan kàkäl anà mbuur a bɔlokà mwɛy wàŋàtoo làpaan ikɔb ande Yɛsu Barabas.
Abun, Pilatu kàfuul iköŋ a baar bàkwe pa naa: «Nà bɛ làkwen naa mɛ alàwɛɛy awà, Yɛsu Barabas, lɛɛ Yɛsu bàfàbel Klistɔ?»
Ntɔn nde kàkyer ayöbà naa ba Yɛsu bun'pɛɛl awà ntɔn un'köl aba.
Umpal kàkäl Pilatu mutɛɛnà ndaa u làbay a nsaŋ, un'kyay ande kun'tööm ndaa naa: «Twon an'bilà u ndaa a mbuur a balàbal wun, ntɔn ŋàbawà mɛ an'man mpay mbɔɔn u ndwɛy ntɔn nde.»
Andweer a angaŋ anà andweer a un'sɛŋ bàsiinà iköŋ a baar a ngwal naa ba bàlɔ̈m Barabas anà bàdwä Yɛsu.
Kuvɛrnɔ̈ɔ̈r kàfafuul naa: «Nà mɛ in'wɛy uboo a ba bàbɔ̈ɔ̈l?» – Ba naa: «Barabas!»
Pilatu kafuul naa: «Abun, ininà mɛ in'yàkyer anà Yɛsu bàfàbel Klistɔ?» Ba banswà bàfuur naa: «Wɛy bun'bɛɛrà u kulunsi!»
Pilatu kafuul naa: «Abun, ube nà nde kàkyer?» Wɛɛ ba bàsöönà musà in'kwɛŋ: «Wɛy bun'bɛɛrà u kulunsi!»

Umpal kàmɛn Pilatu naa nde undiir asin afàkyer watɛy, wɛɛ lingyoomà làmusöönà, nde kàwɛl an'dà, kàywɛb mpin u mii a un'sɛŋ, waa kàtɛn naa: «Mɛ, mɛ un'baranki watɛy unsà an'kil a mbuur wà. Ayin nsaŋ abɛ ŋakwo!»
Wɛɛ un'sɛŋ wanswà kàfuur naa: «Wɛy an'kil ande màbü udu abi anà udu a baan abi!»
Apan, Pilatu katsuuŋ awà Barabas. Wɛɛ akà Yɛsu, ungö akun'kam an'füm, nde kapɛ awà ntɔn bun'bɛɛrà u kulunsi.
Aŋità a kuvɛrnɔ̈ɔ̈r bàsyen Yɛsu u làpaŋ a Pilatu, un'lwaaŋ a aŋità wanswà waa kun'diŋà.
Ba bun'sɔɔl ipfɛy, waa bun'bwää kàzak a tsöö.
Ungö apan ba bun'tööŋ mpà a ibyääl yà nsyeenà, waa bun'bwää kà un'tswe, anà bun'si ibwiy u kɔɔ ande libaal. Ungö, ba bàbü an'köm, waa bun'sɛɛ naa: «Mfum a Ayudà, mbɔr angye!»
Ba bun'tsüülà an'tɛ, bàwɛlà ibwiy, waa bun'kämà kya kun'tswe.
Ungö amukun'sɛɛ, ba bun'sɔɔl kàzak, waa bàfun'bwää ipfɛy ande, waa bun'syen ntɔn bàkun'bɛɛrà u kulunsi.
Umpal bàkäl ba mutoo u bul, ba bàbweey anà un'nsi Sirɛn mwɛy ikɔb ande Simɔn. Aŋità bun'siinà a ngwal musyen kulunsi a Yɛsu.
Mpal bàtöl ba kà ikal mwɛy bàfàbel naa Ngɔlɔngɔta, iswaŋà naa «Ikal a Bɔl a Un'tswe.»
Akun, ba bun'nüü vin aŋàtüüb a undiir a nyän. Mpal kàkyee nde la, laa kàtön nde munwà la.
Mpal bàmay ba mukun'bɛɛrà u kulunsi, ba bàtɔɔm löb ntɔn mukab ipfɛy ande.
Ungö, ba bàkäl aŋàbwaay paa mukun'lerà.
Udu a un'tswe ande, ba bàsön isin a ndaa a nkweel ande: «Mbuur wà wà Yɛsu, mfum a Ayudà.»
Apan, baar abe bɔ̈ɔ̈l babɛɛrà sye u kulunsi mbwo mwɛy anà nde, umwɛy u kɔɔ a ibaal, wumwɛy u kɔɔ a ikaar.
Alyaaŋ a mbwo bàkyer un'bɛyà, bàmunii un'tswe,
waa bàtɛɛnà naa: «Ngye mbuur afàbwiy ndwà a Nzam anà afàtɔŋ ya unsà ilä itär, tswà mɔ̈ɔ̈ angye, ngye ŋakwo, isàkal naa ngye awà Mwan a Nzam, tɔlà u kulunsi!»
Mbwo mwɛy sye, amfum a angaŋ anà alɔɔŋ a Un'kɔɔn anà andweer bàkyer un'sɛɛ, waa bàtɛɛnà naa:
«Nde kàtsü baar bumwɛy mɔ̈ɔ̈, wɛɛ nde ukwe anki mutswà mɔ̈ɔ̈ ande ŋakwo! Nde wà Mfum a Isàlɛl, wɛy nde utɔlà apanà u kulunsi, waa bi iyàsà làkwikilà amu nde.
Nde kàsi làkwikilà akà Nzam, wɛy Nzam kun'tsuuŋ apanà, isàkal naa nde akyun'kwen. Ntɔn nde kàtɛn naa: "Mɛ in'wà Mwan a Nzam."»
Itàkal baar abe akwà bàbɛɛrà u kulunsi mbwo mwɛy anà nde, bàkyer un'too sye.
Sɛmà midi, làpib làkyer abwà u mɛɛn manswà tii u taaŋ làtär ungö a midi.
Ntsü a taaŋ làtär ungö a midi, Yɛsu kàsi in'kwɛŋ a ngwal: «Ɛli, Ɛli, lema sabaktani» iswaŋà naa «Nzam amɛ, Nzam amɛ, ntɔn nkye aman'piy ngye?»
Amwɛy uboo a baar bàkäl pa, mpal bun'wem ba, ba bàtɛɛnà naa: «Le, nde kan'bel Ɛli!»
Umwɛy uboo a ba kàkaamà ntiin, kàkàwal für làmwɛy, kànwɛmà la uboo a man a nyän, laa kàsi nde la u kite, waa kun'pɛ ntɔn munwà.
Bumwɛy bàtɛn naa: «Tàmbar bi itàler nkye Ɛli akyàyà mukun'tswà mɔ̈ɔ̈!»
Apan Yɛsu kàfàkuub un'kwɛŋ a ngwal, waa kàkü.
Taaŋ nsil alan, u ndwà a Nzam, rido a idwà làkyer akaamà uboboo fà du tii ngyɛl. Mɛɛn màkyer atɛɛr, nkɔŋ yàkyer abàbaarà,
an'dii màkyer adubà, ndür a baar inkyɛɛl mbɔɔn bàkü yàkyer awiyà:
bàtoo ba kan'dii, ungö a uwiyà, waa bàbilà uboo a bul in'kyɛɛl, waa bàmɛnà akà baar mbɔɔn.
Mpal bàmɛn ba ntɛɛr a mɛɛn anà ndaa yàbü, kaptɛn anà aŋità bàkäl anà nde museyà Yɛsu, bàmɛn bɔɔmà a kölàköl, waa bàtɛn naa: «Ndandaa, mbuur awà kàkäl Mwan a Nzam!»
Paa bàkäl anà akaar mbɔɔn bàleerà ukwɛl. Ba bàyilabà Yɛsu sɛmà Ngalilɛ ntɔn muyun'syääl.
Uboo a ba, bàkäl Màlye un'si Magàdala, Màlye ngwän a Zyak anà Yɔsɛfi, anà un'kyay a Zebeday.
Mpal làbü sisye, aŋun'naaŋ mwɛy un'nsi Arimatɛ, ikɔb ande Yɔsefi, awà kàbulà sye un'lɔŋki a Yɛsu, waa kàyàkɔlà.
Mbuur awà kàkàman Pilatu, waa kàlɔ̈ɔ̈m ndom a Yɛsu. Apan Pilatu kàswɛŋ naa bun'pɛ ayà.
Yɔsɛfi kàwɛl ya, kàläl ya ipfɛy a pɛɛl kyàkün,
waa kàkàtɔl ya uboo a an'dii akün amà bun'fuun u nkɔŋ. Ungö, nde kàbuum nkɔŋ ntɔn mudübà munàmbwo a an'dii. Waa kàkyen.
Màlye un'nsi Magàdalà anà Màlye wumwɛy bàkäl paa, bàŋàbwaay u sim a an'dii.
Taaŋtyà, ilä kyàlääb ngyööŋ a un'kyɔm a saba, amfum a angaŋ anà Amfarisi bàkyen mbwo mwɛy akà Pilatu,
waa bàtɛn a nde naa: «Nkum, bi kan'yɔbà naa ŋaloor wà, mpal kàkäl nde anà mɔ̈ɔ̈, kàtɛɛnà naa: "Ungö a ilä itär, mɛ in'sàkyer awiyà."

Abun, swaŋ baar musey an'dii ande tii kà ilä kyàtär, uman naa alɔŋki ande bàyàyib ndür ande anà bàyàtɛn a un'sɛŋ naa: "Nde kàkyàwiyà uboo a akü." Apan loor ande làsàsöön làtàtwɛb.»
Pilatu kàtɛn a ba naa: «Làwɛl aŋità abà. Làkyen kàlasey an'dii asànaa làkwen bɛ.»
Abun, bàkyen ba, ba bàbäm nkɔŋ yàkäl u munàmbwo a deŋdeŋ, waa bàsàsà aseey.
Ungö a saba, u nsɛmà a ilä atàtwɛb kyà mpɔsà, Màlye un'nsi Magàdalà anà Màlye wumwɛy, bàkyen mukàler an'dii.
Kà imbürà, mɛɛn laa màtɛɛr ma ngwal: un'kyeey a Mwol kàfü du, waa kàbuum nkɔŋ anà kàbwaay udu aya.
Nde kàkäl asànaa munyä, ipfɛy ande byàkäl byàpɛɛl asànaa für.
Aseey bàwem bɔɔmà mbɔɔn, waa bàbulà asànaa baar aŋàkwà.
Wɛɛ un'kyeey kàtɛn a akaar aban naa: «Bɛ, bɛ twon lan'man bɔɔmà. Mɛ, mɛ in'kyàyöb naa bɛ làwàmuleŋ Yɛsu awà bàbɛɛrà u kulunsi.
Nde apà watɛy, nde kan'wiyà kukwà asànaa kàtɛn nde. Yää, làmɛn ikal kàkäl nde aŋàbɔ̈ɔ̈n.
Làkyen agyä, kàlakyään alɔŋki ande naa: "Nde kàkyàwiyà uboo a akü, nde kan'fwel u Ngalilɛ, bɛ làyàkuman kwo." Le, mɛ amàlakyään.»
Làgyägyä, ba bàlwomà kan'dii u ntiin bàŋàyɔl a bɔɔmà anà un'sak mbɔɔn, waa bàkàkyään alɔŋki ande.
Umbalà mwɛy, Yɛsu kàyàbwey anà ba, waa kàtɛn naa: «Mbɔr abɛ!» Ba bàsin tsütsü apà nde, bun'tɛ mpi kà in'kɔl, waa bun'kömà.
Apan, Yɛsu kàtɛn a ba naa: «Twon lan'man bɔɔmà. Kàlakyään atɔŋ amɛ bàkyen Ngalilɛ: ba bàyan'man kwo.»
Mpal bàkäl akaar u mbwo, amwɛy uboo aseey a an'dii bayi u bul, waa bàkyään amfum a angaŋ ndaa yanswà yàlyaŋ.
Amfum a angaŋ bàköŋ anà andweer, waa bàpɛ ngim mbɔɔn akà aŋità,
waa baswɛŋ naa: «Bɛ làyàtɛn naa: "Bi kàkäl bàŋàbɔ̈ɔ̈n u mpib, alɔŋki ande waa bàyun'yib."
Kya isàkal naa kuvɛrnɔ̈ɔ̈r kan'yöb ya, bi ikyer ayun'kwaam mpem ntɔn bɛ làkɔ̈ɔ̈n abwà u ndaa.»
Ba bàwɛl ngim ayin, waa bàläb ndaa yanswà baswɛŋ amfum a angaŋ anà andweer. Làsaŋ a ndaa ayi làkyàpää akà Ayudà tii ŋàbawà.
Alɔŋki bàkwem aŋimwɛy bàkyen Ngalilɛ, udu a mɔŋ kaswɛŋ Yɛsu.
Mpal bun'mɛn ba, laa bun'kömà ba. Wɛɛ bumwɛy uboo aba bàkyey anki naa awà nde.
Yɛsu kàsin tsütsü apà ba, waa kàtɛn naa: «Ikɔ̈b kyanswà bàkyan'pà u du anà u mɛɛn.
Làkyen akà in'sɛŋ myanswà, labuul alɔŋki, ladümà kà ikɔb a Taa, anà kyà Mwan, anà kyà Dweelà In'kyɛɛl,
anà lalɔŋ mukyer ndaa yanswà kàlaswɛŋ mɛ. Wɛɛ akà mɛ, mɛ in'wà anà bɛ ilä byanswà tii u ntsüü a mɛɛn.»
MALAKƆ
Nsɛmà a Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ là Yɛsu Klistɔ, Mwan a Nzam:
Uboo a un'kaan a ŋangɔɔm Yɛsay bàsön naa: «Le, mɛ an'tɔm un'kyeey amɛ kusà a ngye ntɔn mulɔn mbwo angye.
Ndaa mwɛy yàmusà in'kwɛŋ u nsye a ipɔl: Làlɔ̈n mbwo a Mwol, làsuub myäy ande.»
Apan Ywan Un'düümà kàkàmɛnà u nsye a ipɔl, muyilɔŋ baar mubuul mpem anà muwal ndüümà, ntɔn badwääl nkul a man'be.
-Itiir a Yuday kyanswà anà baar a Yɛlusàlɛm banswà bàkyeenà akà nde, bàkyeyà man'be aba, waa nde kàfadümà u Yɔrdan.
Ywan kàkäl aŋàbwaar ipfɛy a in'kà a ntsür bàfàbel naa shamo anà un'kab a iban a ntsür kyàŋàkwam u lɔŋ ande. Nde kàdyee mpay anà bwey a nsye.
Nde kàkyäänà naa: «Mbuur kàman'söön u ngwal wàmuyà ungö a mɛ. Mɛ in'kwo anki munye ntɔn mutsuuŋ in'siŋ a idyaar ande.
Mɛ, mɛ kàladümà kan'dà, wɛɛ nde, nde ayàladümà u Dweelà Inkyɛɛl.»
Yàmɛnà naa kà ilä abin Yɛsu kàfü Nasàlɛr u Ngalilɛ. Ywan kun'dümà u Yɔrdan.
Pa kàtoo nde kan'dà, nde kàmɛn du làmudubà. Dweelà kàyàtyà udu a nde asànaa nkokà.
Ndaa yàfü du, yàtɛn naa: «Ngye awà Mwan amɛ wà nkween. Mpem amɛ yanswà ye amu ngye.»
Kà imbürà, Dweelà kun'siinà u nsye a ipɔl.
Kwo, Satanà kun'lwɛb ilä an'kwem an'nà. Nde kàkälà anà ntsür a ndwaŋ, akyeey bun'syäälà.
Ungö bàyälà ba Ywan, Yɛsu kàkyen Ngalilɛ. Kwo nde kàkyäänà Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ là Nzam anà mutɛn naa:
«Taaŋ lan'kwo, Imwol a Nzam kyan'tol tsütsü. Làbuul mpem abɛ! Làsi làkwikilà amu Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ!»
Umpal kàkäl nde mulyäŋ kà un'kɔɔl a ɛwà a Ngalilɛ, nde kàmɛn Simɔn anà Andrɛ, un'tɔŋ a Simɔn, bàmutɔɔm an'kwen aba kà ɛwà: ba bàkäl alɔ̈ɔ̈b a nsö.
Yɛsu kàtɛn a ba naa: «Yàlan'läb, waa mɛ in'yàlabuul alɔ̈ɔ̈b a baar.»
Apan sye, ba bàsàwɛy an'kwen aba, waa bun'läb.
Kàsin nde ikye, nde kàmɛn Zyak mwan a Zebeday anà un'tɔŋ ande Ywan. Ba bàkäl uboo a bwaar aba mulɔn an'kwen.
Apan sye, nde waa kabel. Ba bàsàwɛy taaràba Zebeday uboo a bwaar anà baar a isal, waa bun'läb.
Yɛsu anà alɔŋki ande ban'bilà u Kapɛrnawum. Apan sye, ilä a saba, nde kàbilà u ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà, waa kàlɔɔŋà.
Baar bàkäl mubem an'lɔɔŋ ande, ntɔn nde kàlɔɔŋà asànaa mbuur awe anà ikɔ̈b, wɛɛ kà asànaa alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn anki.
Kyekà uboo a ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà akun, mbuur mwey kàkäl anà dweelà a làbe, nde kàsi in'kwɛŋ:
«Yɛsu, un'nsi Nasàlɛr, ininà ngye akwen akà bi? Nkye ngye ayi ntɔn muböŋ bi? Mɛ in'kyàyöb naa ngye awà nà: ngye awà Ŋun'kyeel a Nzam!»
Yɛsu kun'swɛŋ a ngwal naa: «Kal a duu! Too uboo a mbuur wà!»
Dweelà a làbe waa làtoo, lun'nini, làmuyisà un'kwɛŋ a kölàköl.
Baar banswà bàkäl mubem, waa bàsyeelà mbaaŋ ba a ba naa: «Ndaa nà ayi? An'lɔɔŋ akün màŋàyɔl a ikɔ̈b! Nde wàmuswaŋ an'dweelà an'be a ngwal, ma sye màmukun'wem!»
Làsaŋ a nde làpää agyägyä kà itiir a nsi a Ngalilɛ kyanswà.
Pa bàtoo ba u ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà, ba bàkyen anà Zyak anà Ywan u ndwà a Simɔn anà Andrɛ.
Kyekà ukwà a Simɔn wun'kaar kàkäl aŋàbɔ̈ɔ̈n ntɔn nde kàkäl anà làbwey a mpye. Apan sye, ba bàsam Yɛsu ntɔn nde.
Nde kàsin tsütsü, kun'käär u kɔɔ, waa kun'mbaar. Làbwey a mpye waa làtoo, nde waa kàsɛmà mukasyääl.
Làsisye, ungö a miinà a taaŋ, ba bun'twäälà baar an'kyal banswà anà baar bàkäl anà an'dweelà an'be.
Bul lanswà làyàköŋ u munàmbwo.
Yɛsu kàkɔɔr baar mbɔɔn bàkäl anà an'kyal a ifà ifà. Nde kàtwey sye insɔŋà mbɔɔn. Nde kàwɛy anki mbwo akà insɔŋà musà ndaa. Ntɔn mya, mya myàkyun'yöbà.
Ututu tutu, Yɛsu kàsubà nde, kàtoo u ndwà, waa kàkyen u mpey. Akun nde kàkäl muyamà.
Simɔn anà baar bamwey bàkäl anà nde bàkyer akun'leŋ.
Utaaŋ bun'mɛn ba, ba bàtɛn a nde naa: «Baar banswà bàmuyaleŋ.»
Yɛsu kafuur naa: «Tsweenà ikal asin, kan'bul a tsütsü, ntɔn mɛ in'kàkyään sye Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ kwo. Mɛ, mɛ kàtoo ntɔn la.»
Nde waa kàyilyaaŋà u Ngalilɛ wanswà mulɔŋ uboo a ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà anà muböŋ insɔŋà.
Yàmɛnà naa ŋukyal a bay mwɛy kàsin apà nde, kàbü an'köm, waa kàtɛn naa: «Kya ngye akyàkwen, ngye an'kwo an'pöŋ.»
Yɛsu kun'wɛm ngyɛb mbɔɔn, kàsɛn kɔɔ, kun'bä, waa kàtɛn naa: «Mɛ an'kwen, pɔŋà!»
Umbalà mwɛy bay waa làlwomà, nde waa kàpɔŋà.
Apan, Yɛsu kun'fuur ndwà ande,
ungö mukun'pà nswɛɛŋ yi: «Twon an'sam ndaa ayi akà mbuur mwɛy. Wɛɛ ngye, kyɛn kamɛnà akà ngaŋ, waa akàpà an'kab a mpööŋ asànaa kàlɔ̈m Mɔsɛ, ntɔn mukaswaŋ naa ngye an'kɔrà.»

Pa kàkyen nde, nde kàsɛmà mukyään u ndaa a ngwal anà mupay làsaŋ a ndaa ayi. Kyakin Yɛsu kàmɛn anki mbwo mukàmɛnà u mii a baar banswà kan'bul an'köl an'köl, wɛɛ nde kàkälà u nsà, u mpey. Waa baar bàfwee mper anà mper, bàyee akà nde.
Ungö a ilä, Yɛsu kàfurà Kapernawum. Làsaŋ làpää naa nde kàkäl u ndwà.
Baar mbɔɔn bàyàköŋ paa. Akà ikal kyàkäl anki, itàkal tsütsü a munàmbwo a ndwà. Ikal kyàfàkal anki, itàkal u nsà. Nde kakyäänà Ndaa.
Apan, baar bun'twääl mbuur aŋàkwɛkà.
Wɛɛ ba bàkwe anki mukun'twaal kà ikal kàkäl nde ntɔn baar bàkäl mbɔɔn, ba bàmɛn nsyä udu a ikal kàkäl nde, waa bàpfuul mun ntɔn mutyeey ipɔy kàkäl mbuur aŋàkwɛkà.
Mpal kàmɛn Yɛsu làkwikilà aba, nde kàtɛn a mbuur aŋàkwɛkà naa: «Mwan amɛ, mɛ amadwääl nkul a man'be angye.»
Alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn amwɛy bàkäl aŋàbwaay paa, bàmuyweerà u mpem aba naa:
«Ntɔn nkye mbuur wà kan'tɛn nde abwɛy? Nde wàmubɛy Nzam. Nà kan'kwo mudwa nkul a man'be isàkal naa kà Nzam mpɛl anki?»
Abà kàyöb nde unsà dweelà ande ndaa bayweerà ba uboo a ba ŋakwo, Yɛsu kàtɛn a ba naa: «Ntɔn nkye làbà bɛ anà an'kyän atub amà u mpem abɛ?
Undiir nà akɔ̈ɔ̈n mpay mutɛn akà mbuur aŋàkwɛkà: "Bàmadwääl nkul a man'be angye", lɛɛ mutɛn naa: "Mbarà, sɛn ipɔy angye, kyen"?
Abun, ntɔn bɛ làyöb naa Mwan a mbuur wɛ anà ikɔ̈b mudwääl baar nkul a man'be u mɛɛn pà.» Apan, nde kàtɛn a mbuur aŋàkwɛkà naa:
«Mɛ amaswaŋ, mbarà, sɛn ipɔy angye, kyen ndwà angye!»
Baal awà waa kàmbarà, apan sye nde kàsɛn ipɔy ande, waa kàtoo u mii a baar banswà. Apan ba banswà bàmɛn ndaa yubem, waa bàsyäŋà Nzam, bàtɛɛnà naa: «Bi ŋàtàman anki abà akà ikikye!»
Yɛsu kàfàkyà kà un'kɔɔl a ɛwà. Un'sɛŋ a baar wanswà kàkyeenà akà nde, waa nde kalɔɔŋà.
Umpal kàkäl nde mulyaŋ, nde kàmɛn Lɛvi, mwan a Alfɛ, kan'bwaay kà ikàl bàfàfur itɛr, waa kàtɛn a nde naa: «Yan'läb!» Nde waa kàmbarà, waa kun'läb.
Ungö apan Yɛsu kàkàdyà u ndwà a Lɛvi. Afüür a itɛr mbɔɔn anà baar abe bàdyee mɛsà mwɛy anà nde, anà alɔŋki ande sye. Ntɔn baar abe bàkäl mbɔɔn muyun'lab.

Uboo a alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn bàkäl anà Amfarisi. Mpal bàmɛn ba naa Yɛsu akadyaa ikal imwɛy anà baar abà banswà, ba bàtɛn a alɔŋki ande naa: «Abà aben? Ntɔn nkye udyaa nde anà afüür a itɛr anà baar abe?»
Yɛsu kàwem nde abwey, nde kàtɛn a ba naa: «Kà baar abye anà ngwal u ndür anki abye anà mfun a un'ngaŋ, wɛɛ aŋakyal. Mɛ kàyi anki mubel baar a balàbal, wɛɛ baar abe.»
Ilä mwɛy alɔŋki a Ywan anà Amfarisi bàkäl mukin mbɔr. Ba bàyàtɛn a Yɛsu naa: «Ntɔn nkye bi alɔŋki a Ywan anà alɔŋki a Amfarisi ifàkin mbɔr, wɛɛ alɔŋki angye mbɔr bàfàkin anki?»
Yɛsu kafuur naa: «Nkye baar ban'bel kà un'kyɔm atà bɔr ban'kwo mukin mbɔr umpal awà un'tɛɛl a bɔr paa? Umpal awà un'tɛɛl a bɔr anà ba, ba bàkwo anki mukin mbɔr.
Wɛɛ ilä ikyer asàyà, umpal bàsàlwom ba un'tɛɛl a bɔr uboo a ba, ba bàsàkin mbɔr ilä akin.
«Akà mbuur mwɛy ukwe anki mubaay ikaam a ipfɛy akün udu a ipfɛy aŋànün, naa tɛy, ikaam akün ban'kwɛy iyànaan yar a ipfɛy aŋanün, tuun waa làyàyàmà.
Akà mbuur mwɛy ukwe anki musà man akün u mbeen aŋanün, naa tɛy, man akün laa ipfuul ma mbeen aŋanün, laa ipää ma: man anà mbeen sye waa ikyà bwà. Aay, akà man akün, mbeen sye yàkün!»
Yàmɛnà naa ilä a saba mwɛy, Yɛsu kàkäl mulyaaŋ uboo a an'ywaŋ a blɛ. Alɔŋki ande bàsɛmà mubwo imfà u mbwo bayikyeenà ba.
Amfarisi bàtɛɛnà a nde naa: «Ler ndaa bàkyerà ba ilä a saba! Yà ikin.»
Waa nde kafuur naa: «Nkye bɛ làtäŋ anki akà ikikye ndaa kàkyer David umpal kàkäl nde u làkɔɔŋ anà kàwem nde ngyal, nde anà baar bàkäl anà nde?
Aben, umpal kàkäl Abyatar undweer a angaŋ, kàbilà nde u ndwà a Nzam, kàwɛl nde mampà bàfàpà ibɔɔn, kàdi nde ma anà kàpɛ nde baar bàkäl anà nde, itàkal naa ma angaŋ mpɛl bàfàdyà?»
Apan, Yɛsu kàtɛɛnà a ba naa: «Saba bàkyer ntɔn mbuur, wɛɛ kà mbuur anki ntɔn saba.
Kyakin, Mwan a mbuur wà nkum itàkal sye wà saba.»
Ungö, Yɛsu kàfàbilà u ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà. Uboo kwo kàkäl anà baal mwɛy wàŋàkwɛkà kɔɔ.
Baar bàkäl musey Yɛsu ntɔn muyöb naa nkye nde akyer un'kɔɔr ilä a saba, ntɔn ba bun'füün.
Nde waa kàtɛn a baal aŋàkwɛkà kɔɔ naa: «Mbarà! yà uboboo pà.»
Apan nde kàtɛn a ba naa: «Nkye bàkyàpà mbwo ilä a saba mukyer yàŋàbwaŋ lɛɛ yà ube, mutswà mɔ̈ɔ̈ lɛɛ mudwa?» Wɛɛ ba bàkäl a kul.
Kyakin Yɛsu kaler nde intwɛn, kawem nde ngyɛb sye ntɔn mpem ambe aba, waa kàtɛn a baal awun naa: «Sɛn kɔɔ a ngye.» Nde waa kàsɛn la, la waa làkɔɔrà.
Pa bàtoo Amfarisi, laa bàkàköŋ ba anà baar a Ɛlɔdi ntɔn ba bàleŋ mbwo mudwa Yɛsu.
Yɛsu kàkyen u mpey anà alɔŋki ande kà un'kɔɔl a ɛwà. Un'kàbɔ a baar bàfü Yɛlusàlɛm anà itiir a nsi a Ngalilɛ, Yuday,
Idumɛ, u sim a ngyäl a Yɔrdan, Tir anà Sidɔn, bàyi akà Yɛsu ntɔn bàwem ba làsaŋ a indiir byanswà kàkyerà nde.
Nde kàswɛŋ alɔŋki ande naa ba bun'lɔ̈ɔ̈n bwaar làmwɛy ntɔn baar bàkɔɔn akun'sà un'süküün.
Ntɔn kàkɔɔrà nde baar mbɔɔn, baar banswà bàkäl anà mpay u ndür bun'bweelà ntɔn mukun'ba.
Apan sye an'dweelà an'be, mpal mun'mɛnà ma, ma mun'bweelà kà in'kɔl, waa bun'syee in'kwɛŋ naa: «Ngye awà Mwan a Nzam!»
Wɛɛ nde katsüŋ a ngwal naa ba bàkɔ̈ɔ̈n un'mɛɛy.
Ungö, Yɛsu kàbeenà udu a mɔŋ, kàbel baar kàkwen nde. Ba bàyi apà nde.
Nde kàkyer itsuŋ a baar kwem aŋiyweel ntɔn muyikal anà nde anà mukatɔm mukàlɔŋ
anà ikɔ̈b muböŋ insɔŋà.
Le, Bàkwem Aŋiyweel ba abà: Simɔn, Yɛsu kun'pɛ ikɔb a Petɔlà,
Zyak, mwan a Zebeday anà un'tɔŋ ande Ywan. Nde ba kapɛ ikɔb a Bwanɛrgɛsi, iswaŋà naa «baar abà asànaa idum»,
Andrɛ, Filipo, Bàtɛlàmay, Màtay, Tuma, Zyak mwan a Alfɛ, Tadɛ, Simɔn mbuur a mankay,
anà Yudas Iskalyɔt, nde awun sye mbuur kun'yälà.
Ungö apan Yɛsu kàyi u ndwà mwɛy. Un'sɛŋ a baar kàfàkàköŋ kwo, lalan ba bàsàkwo anki itàkal mudyà.
Mpal bàwem baar a ywar ande abwɛy, ba bàyi mukun'lwom, ntɔn ba bàtɛɛnà naa: «Nde kan'yiŋ!»
Alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn bàyàtyà fà Yɛlusàlɛm bàtɛɛnà naa: «Bɛlzebul wà uboo ande!» Anà sye naa: «Nde insɔŋà ayibɔ̈ŋ u mbwo a mfum a insɔŋà!»
Apan Yɛsu waa kabel, waa kàtɛn a ba unsà nsim naa: «Nkye Satanà kan'kwo uböŋ Satanà?
Isàkal naa imwol mwɛy kyàŋàkaabà anà kya ŋakwo, imwol akin ifàtsim anki.
Isàkal naa ywar mwɛy làŋàkaabà anà la ŋakwo, ywar alan làfàtsim anki.
Kya Satanà usànwan anà nde ŋakwo, nde wàŋàkaabà, nde utsim anki, yànde yan'wà.

«Akà mbuur mwey ukwe anki mubilà u ndwà a ŋangwal anà ugyɔɔr indiir ande, isàkal naa nde ŋàtun'bäm anki ŋangwal awun in'siŋ. Manà nde kàmubäm in'siŋ, apan laa ugyɔɔr nde indiir byanswà abyà uboo a ndwà ande.
Ndandaa mɛ alàkyään, baan a baar bàkyer asadwääl nkul a ndaa aba yanswà: man'be anà mbɛɛy mbɔɔn isàtoo u mun aba.
Wɛɛ mbuur asàbɛy Dweelà In'kyɛɛl, nde bàsun'dwääl anki nkul akà ikikye. Ntɔn ube ande bà bàmbul a in'tye.»
Yɛsu kàtɛɛnà nde abwɛy ntɔn ba bàtɛɛnà naa: «Nde we anà dweelà a làbe.»
Ngwän anà atɔŋ a Yɛsu bàyi anà bàmbär u nsà, waa bàtöm mbuur mukun'bel.
Un'sɛŋ a baar kàkäl aŋàbwaay apà ande. Waa bàtɛn a nde naa: «Le, ngwa anà atɔŋ angye babaal anà bakaar bàmukaleŋà u nsà.»
Nde kafuur naa: «Maa anà atɔŋ amɛ bànà?»
Apan, nde kàler baar bàkäl aŋàbwaay apà nde, waa kàtɛn naa: «Làler maa anà atɔŋ amɛ!
Mbuur wanswà afàsyääl ukwen a Nzam, nde wà un'tɔŋ amɛ wàbaal, un'tɔŋ amɛ wà un'kaar anà maa.»

Yɛsu kàfàsɛmà mulɔŋ kà un'kɔɔl a ɛwà. Un'sɛŋ a baar mbɔɔn kàköŋ tsütsü apà nde, lalan kàbilà nde u bwaar, la làkäl udu a an'dà, waa kàbwaay. Baar banswà bàkäl u mɛɛn, usà ntsü akà an'dà.
Nde ba kalɔɔŋà indiir mbɔɔn unsà nsim. Nde kàtɛɛnà a ba unsà an'lɔɔŋ ande naa:
«Làwem. Le, un'köön kàtoo mukɔn.
Umpal kàyimwaŋà nde, yar a mbɛŋ làmwɛy làbü u mbwo: nɛn waa yàyi, waa yàdi ya.
Yar lumwɛy làbü kà ikal kyàkäl anà in'kul, mɛɛn a mbɔɔn màkäl anki. La làtoo agyàgyà ntɔn mɛɛn màkäl anki mbɔɔn u ngyɛl.
Mpal kàbalà mwäänà, laa làkuŋà la, waa làyöm ntɔn ukɔɔn in'swɛy.
Lumwɛy làbü uboo a nsyeenà. Nsyeenà yàyɛl ya, ya waa yun'fwee, la waa mpa làtwey mbɛŋ.
Mbɛŋ yumwɛy yàbü uboo a mɛɛn aŋàbwaŋ, waa yàmɛn, yàyɛl, yàbör mbɛŋ mbɔɔn: imwɛy an'kwem an'tär, imwɛy an'kwem an'syaam, imwɛy nkam.»
Nde kàtɛɛnà naa: «Wɛy mbuur awe anà an'tsü awem, uwem!»
Mpal kàkäl Yɛsu u mpey, baar bàyun'labà anà Bàkwem Aŋiyweel, bun'fuulà ntɔn nsim.
Nde kàtɛɛnà a ba naa: «Akà bɛ, ngyee a Imwol a Nzam bàkyàlapà. Wɛɛ akà baar abà u nsà, indiir byanswà byàfàlyaŋ unsà nsim,
ntɔn abun, "itàkal naa ba bàkyer aleerà, ba bàkɔɔn aman, itàkal naa ba bàkyer aweemà, ba bàkɔɔn ayöb, manà ba bàyàbuul mpem anà bàyadwääl un'pi a nkul!"»
Nde kàfàtɛn a ba naa: «Bɛ, bɛ làyöb anki nsim ayi! Abun bɛ làyàyöb aben nsim yanswà?
Un'köön kan'kɔn Ndaa.
Le, baar abà u mbwo, kà ikal bàkön Ndaa: mpal bàwem ba, Satanà abwà ayà, waa ulwom Ndaa bàkön uboo aba.
Bumwɛy bakön udu a nkɔŋ: bà baar, mpal bàfàwem ba Ndaa, ba bàbwà awal ya unsà un'sak.
Wɛɛ uboo a ba in'swɛy myatɛy, ba bà baar a ansɔŋà: isàkal naa lingyoomà lan'yà itàkal nkwaaŋ ntɔn Ndaa, laa bàbwà ba.
Bumwɛy bakön uboo a nsyeenà: bà baar bàwem Ndaa,
wɛɛ nkyän a mɛɛn, untaam a in'naaŋ anà ngyal a indiir asin asin byàbilà bya, laa iküünà bya Ndaa, ya waa mpa ibɔr mbɛŋ.
Bumwɛy bakön u mɛɛn aŋàbwaŋ. Ba bà baar bàfàwem Ndaa, bàfàwal ya, waa bàfàbɔr mbɛŋ: imwɛy an'kwem an'tär, imwɛy an'kwem an'syaam, imwɛy nkam.»
Yɛsu kàtɛn a ba naa: «Nkye mwinà afàyà ntɔn musà ungyɛl a kantin itàkal ungyɛl a itäb? Nkye kà ntɔn mutɔl udu a ikɔlà a un'te a wa anki?
Ntɔn undiir mwɛy wàŋàyee watɛy mpa usàmɛnà u mii, ndaa mwɛy yànkuu yatɛy mpa isàmɛnà u mwäänà.
Wɛy mbuur awe anà an'tsü awem, uwem!»
Nde waa kàfàtɛn a ba naa: «Làkäl kà igyɛɛŋ ntɔn ndaa làkaweemà bɛ. Làsii làsyäälà bɛ musi, làsii nsil alan bàsàsyääl akà bɛ, la làsàkal aŋàkwɛy ntɔn bɛ.
Ntɔn bàsàpà akà mbuur awɛ anà undiir, wɛɛ akà mbuur mpa awe anà undiir, bàsàlwom itàkal undiir ufàsi nde mukal anà wa.»
Nde kàfàtɛn a ba naa: «Imwol a Nzam kyà asànaa mbuur mwɛy kan'mwaŋ nkɔɔn u mɛɛn.
Nde utàkal aŋàbɔ̈ɔ̈n, utàkal wàŋàwiyà, mpib anà mwäänà, nkɔɔn yan'mɛn anà yan'yɛl, nde uyöb anki naa yà aben.
Mɛɛn ma ŋakwo màfàtàtwey bite, ungö imfà, ungö apan mbɛŋ aŋàkɔlà yan'yööl imfà.
Pa isöŋ mbɛŋ, ba bàsà impye, ntɔn la paŋà abwo.»
Yɛsu kàfàtɛn naa: «Ininà bi kan'kwo musi a Imwol a Nzam, itàkal naa nsim nà bi kan'kwo mutà ntɔn muswaŋ kya?
Kya kyà asànaa imbɛŋ ikikye bàkön u mɛɛn. Kya kyan'söön ukye uboo a mbɛŋ yanswà ayà u mɛɛn.
Wɛɛ isàkal naa ban'kɔn kya, kya kyan'laar, kyan'bulà aŋàsöön ndon yanswà uboo a làpaŋ, waa isà an'kɔkà. Apan, nɛn a du waa iyàtɔŋ an'yaab.»
Yà u mbwo a nsim mbɔɔn a tub ayi nde kàkyäänà Ndaa, ntɔn baar bàkäl kà isii ban'kwo ba mukun'wem.
Nde kàyäämà anki anà ba ukɔɔn asyääl nsim, wɛɛ nde kàbuulà ya yanswà akà alɔŋki ande u mpey.
Ilä nsil kya, làsisye, Yɛsu kàtɛn a alɔŋki ande naa: «Tsweenà bi isabà.»
Ba bàsàwɛy un'sɛŋ a baar, waa bun'syen uboo a bwaar kàkäl nde, an'bwaar asin màkäl tsütsü apà nde.
Ikül laa kyàyi kya. Ibɔ a an'dà byàbilà uboo a bwaar, waa byàyöölà la.
Wɛɛ akà nde, nde kàkäl aŋàbɔ̈ɔ̈n kà ita a bwaar, un'tswe udu a ibɔm. Alɔŋki ande bun'wiy, waa bàsi in'kwɛŋ: «Un'lɔɔŋ, nkye ngye ube amanà anki naa bi ikü?»
Yɛsu waa kàsubà, kàŋän ikül, waa kàtɛn a ɛwà naa: «Kal akul! Bäm mun!» Ikül laa kyàkwamà kya, duu a kölàköl waa làbilà.
Apan nde kàtɛn a ba naa: «Ntɔn nkye làbà bɛ mutɛɛr? Nkye bɛ ŋàtàsà anki làkwikilà?»
Matɛɛr mawɛl ma, ba waa bàtɛɛnà ba a ba naa: «Abà nde wà nà, waa itàkal ikül anà ɛwà byàmukun'weemà?»
Ungö apan ba bàkɔlà u sim lumwɛy là ɛwà, u nsi a Bàngɛlàsà.
Pa kàtoo Yɛsu u bwaar, baal mwɛy wàŋàyɔl a an'dweelà an'be kàyàtoo kà an'dii, waa kàyàbwey anà nde.
Nde kàfabwaayà kà an'dii. Akà mbuur mwɛy kàfàkwo anki mukun'bäm itàkal dwaaŋ.
Ntɔn mbalà mbɔɔn ba bàfun'bäämà iswɛɛy anà dwaaŋ, wɛɛ nde kàtsüülà mya. Akà mbuur mwɛy kàkwe anki mukun'kyäämà.
Taaŋ lanswà, mpib anà mwäänà, nde kàkäl muyità nsay uboo a an'dii anà u myɔŋ, wàmuyikuub in'kwɛŋ anà muyikàkaam ndür a in'kul.
Umpal kàmɛn nde Yɛsu ukwɛl, nde kàkyen ntiin, waa kàbü an'köm kusà a nde,
waa kàkuub in'kwɛŋ anà mutɛn naa: «Ininà akà mɛ anà ngye, Yɛsu, Mwan a Nzam a Dudu? Mɛ amabɔɔn kà ikɔb a Nzam, twon aman'pà mpay!»
Ntɔn Yɛsu kàtɛɛnà a nde naa: «Dweelà a làbe, too unsà mbuur wà!»
Nde kun'fuul naa: «Ikɔb angye nà?» Nde kun'fuur naa: «Ikɔb a mɛ "Un'kàbɔ", ntɔn bi ibà mbɔɔn.»
Nde waa kun'bɔ̈ɔ̈nà mbɔɔn, ntɔn nde ukɔɔn akaböŋ u nsi ayin.
Kyekà, mper akà mɔŋ, làkäl anà làböl a kölàköl là ngul làkäl muyidyà.
An'dweelà an'be màbɔ̈ɔ̈n Yɛsu naa: «Itöm uboo a ngul ntɔn bi ibilà amu ya!»
Yɛsu kapɛ mbwo. Apan laa màtoo ma, màbilà ma uboo a ngul, làböl, fà iköl a mɔŋ, làkàbwà kà ɛwà. Ya yàkäl isii a nsaab yweel, waa làminà.
Aseey a ngul batiin ba, ba bàkàpay làsaŋ uboo a bul anà kà itsuŋ a ndwà. Apan baar waa bàyi muman ndaa yàlyaaŋ.
Mpal bàyàtol ba tsütsü apà Yɛsu anà bàmɛn ba aŋadweelà an'be akyàbwaay, akyàbwaar anà akyàkal a duu, nde mbuur kàkäl anà Un'kàbɔ, ba bàmɛn bɔɔmà.
Baar bàmɛn ya yanswà yàlyaŋ, ba bakyäänà ndaa yàbweel mbuur aŋadweelà an'be anà ngul.
Apan ba bàsɛmà mukun'bɔɔn naa nde ulwomà kà itiir a nsi aba.
Umpal kàkäl Yɛsu mubilà u bwaar, mbuur awà kàkäl anà an'dweelà an'be kun'lɔ̈ɔ̈m naa
Yɛsu kun'pɛ anki mbwo, wɛɛ nde kàtɛn a nde naa: «Furà ndwà a ngye, ntsü akà atoŋ angye, waa akakyään ndaa yanswà kàmakyer Mwol unsà ngyɛb ande.»
Apan, baal awà kàkyen nde, nde kàsɛmà mukyään indiir a kölàköl byanswà kàkyer Yɛsu akà nde u Dɛkapɔl. Baar banswà bakyer abemà.
Mpal kàfurà Yɛsu sim lumwɛy u bwaar, un'sɛŋ a baar mbɔɔn kàyàkɔ̈ŋ apà nde. Nde kàkäl kà un'kɔɔl a ɛwà.
Apan umwɛy uboo a amfum a ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà, ikɔb ande Zayirɔs, umpal kàmɛn nde Yɛsu, nde kàbü kà in'kɔl ande,
waa kun'bɔ̈ɔ̈n mbɔɔn, mutɛn naa: «Mwan un'kye amɛ wà un'kaar wà tsütsü mukwà, yun'si an'kɔɔ ntɔn nde ukɔɔrà, uwü mɔ̈ɔ̈!»
Yɛsu kàkyen mbwo mwɛy anà nde. Un'sɛŋ a baar mbɔɔn kàyun'labà, waa kàyun'bàbääbà.
Kyekà kàkäl anà un'kaar mwɛy kàyitoo an'kil mbul kwem aŋiyweel.
Nde kàmɛn mpay mbɔɔn muyikyà akà ingaŋ mbɔɔn, kàmay indiir ande byanswà, ukɔɔn aman ubwaŋ. Wɛɛ ukyal ande bàkyer afàsöönà mbɔɔn.
Umpal kàwem un'kaar awà ndaa bàtɛɛnà baar ntɔn Yɛsu, nde kàkül ungö, uboo a un'sɛŋ a baar, waa kàbä ipfɛy ande.
Ntɔn nde kàtɛɛnà nde ŋàkwo naa: «Isàkal naa mɛ in'tàba akà ipfɛy ande mpɛl, mɛ in'kyɛr awà mɔ̈ɔ̈.»
Taaŋ nsil alan sye an'kil ande waa màtsü mutoo, nde kàyöb u ndür ande naa nde kan'kɔɔrà unsà ukyal ande.
Apan sye, Yɛsu waa kàyöb naa ngwal mwɛy yan'too u ndür ande, nde kàbulà uboboo a un'sɛŋ a baar, waa kàfuulà naa: «Nà kan'ba ipfɛy amɛ?»
Alɔŋki ande bàtɛɛnà a nde naa: «Ngye akimanà naa un'sɛŋ a baar wàmukabàbääbà, wɛɛ ngye afuulà naa: "Nà kàman'ba?"»
Wɛɛ nde kàleerà umbil ande ntɔn muyöb naa un'kaar nà kan'kyer abà.
Apan, abà kàyöb un'kaar awun ndaa yun'yeel, unsà bɔɔmà anà matɛɛr, nde kàyàbwà kà in'kɔl a Yɛsu, waa kàtɛn a nde ndandaa yanswà.
Yɛsu kàtɛn a nde naa: «Mangwa, làkwikilà angye làmatswà mɔ̈ɔ̈. Kyen a duu, wɛy naa ngye akɔɔrà unsà ukyal angye.»
Nde kàkäl aŋàtàmay anki muyääm, umpal bàyi baar bàfü ndwà a mfum a ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà, waa bàtɛn naa: «Mwan angye wà un'kaar kan'kwà. Ntɔn nkye mufàtwääl Un'lɔɔŋ nkwom?»
Wɛɛ Yɛsu kàsàlab anki ndaa ayi, waa kàtɛn a mfum a ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà naa: «Twon an'man bɔɔmà, sà làkwikilà mpɛl.»
Abun, nde kàpɛ anki mbwo akà mbuur mukun'swà, nà Petɔlà, Zyak, anà un'tɔŋ ande Ywan mpɛl.
Ba ban'kɔlà u ndwà a mfum a ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà. Yɛsu kan'man baar ban'kal udu udu, bàmulel, bàmusà in'kwɛŋ mbɔɔn.
Nde kan'bilà, waa kan'tɛn a ba naa: «Ntɔn nkye minii ami anà ilel abi? Mwan kà wàŋàkwà anki, nde wàŋàbɔ̈ɔ̈n.»
Ba bàkyer un'sɛɛ. Wɛɛ nde kàtwey baar banswà, waa kàwɛl nà taarande anà ngwän a mwan anà baar bàyun'swà. Apan nde kan'bilà u suk kàkäl mwan.
Nde kan'tà kɔɔ a mwan mpi, waa kan'tɛn a nde naa: «Mwan un'kaar, mɛ amaswaŋ, wiyà!»
Apan sye, mwan un'kaar waa kàmbarà, waa kàsemà mukyà, - nde kàkäl ayà mbul kwem aŋiyweel. Apan, ba bàkäl unsà ubem mbɔɔn.
Yɛsu kaswɛŋ a ngwal naa akà mbuur mwɛy ukɔɔn ayöb, waa kàtɛn naa ba bun'pɛ isaa adyà.
Yɛsu kàlwomà kà ikal akin, waa kan'yà bul ande, alɔŋki ande bàkäl mukun'lab.

Ilä a saba, nde kàsɛmà mulɔŋ u ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà. Baar mbɔɔn bàweemà nde bàkäl mubem, waa bàtɛɛnà naa: «Nde indiir abi byan'fà ken? Amà an'yeerà a nkye ifà bun'pɛ, waa an'kɔɔ ande ikakyerà isal a ngwal a ngwal a tub abi?
Nkye nde kà sharpantye anki, mwan a Màlye, un'tɔŋ a Zyak, anà Yɔsɛ, anà Yude, anà Simɔn? Nkye atɔŋ ande bakaar kà bà anki uboo a bi apà?» Kyakin bàbööl ba kyà ntɔn làkwikilà aba.
Apan Yɛsu kàtɛɛnà a ba naa: «Ŋangɔɔm bàfun'bɛy nà u bul ande, u mbil ande anà u ndwà ande mpɛl.»
Nde kàsàkwo anki mukyer akà impà mwɛy kwo, wɛɛ nde kàsi nà an'kɔɔ udu a ndam a aŋatoo, waa kakɔɔr.
Nde kàbemà ntɔn mpa bàkäl ba anà làkwikilà. Ungö apan nde kàyilyaaŋà kan'bul a tsütsü muyilɔŋ.
Nde kàbel Bàkwem Aŋiyweel, kàsɛmà mukatɔm abɔ̈ɔ̈l abɔ̈ɔ̈l, kapɛ ikɔ̈b udu a an'dweelà an'be,
waa kaswɛŋ naa: «Twon lan'wal akà undiir mwɛy ntɔn mbwo, nà unsɔk mpɛl. Twon lan'wal isaa adyà, itàkal ngɔɔr, itàkal ngim uboo a un'di,
wɛɛ làbwäär idyaar, twon lan'bwaar an'kàzak an'mɔ̈ɔ̈l.»
Nde kàfàtɛn a ba naa: «Isàkal naa kà ikal imwɛy, bɛ lan'bilà u ndwà mwɛy, làbwaay paa tii umpal làsàlwomà bɛ kà ikal akin.
Isàkal naa kà ikal imwɛy bàlawɛl anki, bàlawem anki, làlwomà apan, làkɔɔb un'twà a in'kɔl abɛ. Kya isàkal imbäl ntɔn ba.»
Alɔŋki bàkyen ba, ba bàkyäänà naa baar bàkyer abuul mpem.
Ba bàyiböŋà insɔŋà mbɔɔn, bàkiirà aŋatoo mbɔɔn may, waa bakɔɔrà.
Mfum Ɛlɔdi kàwem naa bàtaa Yɛsu din, ntɔn ikɔb ande kyàtoo làpaan. Baar bàtɛɛnà naa: «Ywan Un'düümà kan'wiyà kukwà! Undiir awun awà nde anà ikɔ̈b mukyer indiir a ngwal a ngwal.»
Bumwɛy bàtɛɛnà naa: «Nde wà Ɛli.» Bamwey sye naa: «Nde wà ŋangɔɔm asànaa umwɛy uboo a aŋangɔɔm.»
Mpal kàwem Ɛlɔdi ndaa ayi, nde kàtɛɛnà naa: «Ywan akwà kàtsül mɛ un'tswe, kan'wiyà!»
Abun, Ɛlɔdi kàswɛŋ mukɔr Ywan anà bun'si u bɔlokà, ntɔn kàbääl nde Ɛlɔdyas awà kàkäl un'kyay a un'tɔŋ ande Filipo.
Ntɔn Ywan kàtɛɛnà a Ɛlɔdi naa: «Mbwo yatɛy ngye muwal un'kyay a un'tɔŋ angye!»
Undiir awun Ɛlɔdyas kàyiiŋ nde Ywan, waa kàkweenà mukun'dwa. Wɛɛ nde kàsàkwo anki,
ntɔn Ɛlɔdi kàtiinà Ywan bɔɔmà, abà kàyöb nde naa nde wà mbuur a balàbal anà wà in'kyɛɛl, laa kun'tii nde. Mpal kun'wɛɛmà nde, ya yun'pää mpay mbɔɔn. Wɛɛ nde kàkweenà mukun'wɛm.
Kyekà, Ɛlɔdyas ipöl aŋàbwaŋ kàmɛn ilä a un'kyɔm a mböör a Ɛlɔdi. Nde awà kàpɛ udyà akà ayɔl ande anà amfum a aŋità ande, anà akà abyääl a Ngalilɛ.
Mwan a Ɛlɔdyas wà un'kaar waa kàyàkyen. Ɛlɔdi anà baar kàbel nde bàmɛn un'sak mbɔɔn. Mfum kàtɛn a mwan un'kaar naa: «Lɔm undiir wanswà akwen ngye, mɛ in'kyer ayapà wa.»
Nde kun'dyeel kyän naa: «Undiir wanswà ayàlɔm ngye, mɛ in'kyɛr ayapà, itàkal naa yar a mɛɛn a imfum amɛ.
Mwan un'kaar kàtoo u ndwà, waa kàtɛn a ngwän naa: «Ininà mɛ in'lɔm?» Nde waa kàfuur naa: «Un'tswe a Ywan Un'düümà.»
Nde kàfurà agyägyä akà mfum, waa kun'lɔ̈ɔ̈m: «Mɛ in'kwen naa ngye an'pɛ agyägyä udu a làlɔŋà, un'tswe a Ywan Un'düümà!»
Mfum kàwem ngyɛb. Wɛɛ, ntɔn kyän ande anà baar kàbel nde, nde kàkwen anki utön mukun'pà.
Apan sye, mfum kàtöm un'seey mwɛy anà nswɛɛŋ mutwal un'tswe a Ywan Un'düümà. Un'seey kàkyen u bɔlokà, waa kàtsül un'tswe a Ywan,
kàtwääl wa udu a làlɔŋà, waa kàpɛ wa akà mwan un'kaar. Waa mwan un'kaar kàpɛ wa akà ngwän.
Mpal bàwem alɔŋki a Ywan làsaŋ alan, ba bàyàwal ndom ande, waa bàsi ya kan'dii mwɛy.
Yàmɛnà naa mpal bàyàfurà antööm, ba bàkɔ̈ŋ apà Yɛsu, ba bun'sam ndaa yanswà bàkyer ba anà bàlɔɔŋà ba.
Nde kàtɛn a ba naa: «Bɛ bumwɛy, làyi u mpey, làyöör ikye u nsye a ipɔl.» Ntɔn baar mbɔɔn bàkälà muyaa anà mukyeenà, waa ba bàkäl anki itàkal anà taaŋ mudyà.
Lalan bàkyen ba, ba mpɛl, uboo a bwaar u mpey, u nsye a ipɔl.
Baar batääl mukyà, bàmbɔɔn laa bayöb ba. Apan, fà an'bul manswà, ba bàkyen ntiin ntiin kà in'kɔl, waa bàfweel kà ikal bàkwen ba mukyà.
Umpal katoo Yɛsu u bwaar, nde kàmɛn un'sɛŋ a baar mbɔɔn, ngyɛb waa yun'wɛl ntɔn ba, ntɔn ba bàkäl asànaa in'kɔk myakɔɔn aleer, waa kàsɛmà mukalɔŋ indiir mbɔɔn.
Taaŋ làkyen mbɔɔn, alɔŋki bàsin apà Yɛsu, waa bàtɛn a nde naa: «Ikal ki kyà ipɔl, taaŋ sye lan'kyà mbɔɔn.
Afuur baar bà, ba bàkyà u bitsuŋ a ndwà anà an'bul a tsütsü mukàsom isaa adyà.»
Wɛɛ nde kafuur naa: «Lapɛ udyà bɛ ŋakwo!» Ba bàtɛn a nde naa: «Nkye bi ikàsom mampà a itɛr a ngim nkam yweel ntɔn bi ipɛ ba udyà?»
Nde waa utɛn a ba naa: «Mampà an'kwe bɛ làwe amà? Kàlaler!» Ungö muler, ba ban'tɛn naa: «An'tyeen, anà nsö yweel.»
Apan, nde kaswɛŋ naa ba bàsi baar banswà unsà an'kab bàŋàbwaay udu a un'lɛŋ un'bu.
Baar bàbwaay unsà in'lwaaŋ a nkam anà myà an'kwem an'tyeen.
Yɛsu kàwɛl mampà man'tyeen anà nsö yàyweel, nde kàler u du, kàsaak ma, kàtsül ma, waa kàpɛ akalɔŋki ntɔn mukääb baar banswà.
Ba banswà bàdi, waa bàyüür.
Ba bàsyen in'lwaŋ kwem aŋiyweel myàŋàyɔl a itiir a mampà anà byà nsö byàsäl.
Baar bàdi mampà bàkäl abaal nsaab tyeen.
Apan sye, Yɛsu kàswɛŋ alɔŋki ande mubilà u bwaar anà mufweel kusà a nde, u sim a ɛwà lumwɛy, u ntsü a Bɛtesayidà, umpal nde ŋakwo usàpay nde un'sɛŋ a baar.
Ungö mupay ba, nde kàbeenà u mɔŋ mukàyamà.
Làsisye, bwaar làkäl lan'tol uboboo a ɛwà, nde kàsàkal nde mpɛl u mɛɛn.
Muman naa alɔŋki ande bàmunwan a ngwal muluk nkay ntɔn un'pöb kàyee lisà, tsütsü a taaŋtyà, nde kan'yà mper akà ba wàmuyikyà udu a ɛwà, waa kàlasoonà.
Mpal bun'mɛn ba wàmuyikyà udu a ɛwà, ba bàsi naa bwo kàkäl, waa bàsi in'kwɛŋ.
Ntɔn ba banswà bàkyer un'man, lingyoomà waa lawɛl. Wɛɛ apan, nde kàyäm anà ba, waa kàtɛn a ba naa: «Làwɛl ibaal! Wà mɛ, twon lan'man bɔɔmà!»
Apan, nde kàbilà u bwaar apà ba, un'pöb waa kànye. Uboo a ba ŋakwo, ba bàbemà mbɔɔn.
Kutɛn aŋàbwaŋ, ba bàsàyöb anki mbuul a impà a mampà, ntɔn mpem aba yàkäl bwoor.
Ungö a nsaabà, ba bàtɔlà u mɛɛn a Ngɛnɛsàlɛr, waa bàbäm bwaar aba.
Pa bàtoo ba u bwaar, baar waa bàyöb Yɛsu,
waa bàkyen ntiin kà itiir a nsi akin kyanswà, waa bàsɛmà mukun'twääl aŋukyal udu a ipɔy kà ikal kyanswà bàweemà ba naa Yɛsu wà kwo.

Ntsü yanswà kàbilà nde: uboo an'bul itàkal an'bul a kölàköl, itàkal kà itsuŋ a ndwà, baar bàtɔ̈ɔ̈là aŋukyal u làbay, waa bun'bɔ̈ɔ̈nà naa nde kawɛy ba bàbä itàkal làpan a ipfɛy ande mpɛl. Abun baar abà bàtɛɛ kya mpi bàkyer akɔɔrà.
Amfarisi anà alɔɔŋ a un'kɔɔn amwɛy bàfü Yɛlusàlɛm ban'köŋ apà Yɛsu.
Ba ban'man naa alɔŋki ande amwɛy bàmudyà anà an'kɔɔ a ŋingyäy, iswaŋà naa ukɔɔn aywɛy ma.
Ntɔn Amfarisi, itàkal Ayudà banswà, bàfàdyà anki ukɔɔn aywɛy an'kɔɔ ubwaŋàbwaŋ, mulab nkääl a andweer.
Ba bàsàfà mukàlyaaŋ, ba bàfàdyà anki kusà mutàpöŋ. Ye anà nsyääl asin mbɔɔn yindweer bàfàlab ba: mpööŋ a an'kɔɔb, yà an'buuŋ anà yan'lɔŋà.
Amfarisi anà alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn ban'fuul Yɛsu naa: «Ntɔn nkye alɔŋki angye mpa bàfàlab ba in'kɔɔn a andweer, wɛɛ ba bàfàdyà anà an'kɔɔ a ŋingyäy?»
Nde waa kàtɛn a ba naa: «Yɛsay kàtɛ ngɔɔm aŋàbwaŋ ntɔn bɛ baar a mpem yweel, ntɔn bàsön naa: "Un'sɛŋ wà mɛ làkoo afan'sà udu a ndem mpɛl, wɛɛ mpem aba yukwɛl anà mɛ."
Ngyamàkà bàfan'sà ba yà bunàbun, ntɔn nsyääl bàfàlɔŋ ba yan'kyän a baar."
Bɛ nswɛɛŋ a Nzam làfàsà ukɔl, wɛɛ bɛ làfàndäär anà nsyääl a baar.»
Nde kàfàtɛn a ba naa: «Bɛ làfàtɔn ubwaŋàbwaŋ nswɛɛŋ a Nzam ntɔn mukaar nkääl abɛ!
Ntɔn Mɔsɛ kàtɛn naa: "Sà làkoo akà taaràŋà anà ngwa", sye naa: "Wɛy mbuur ato taarànde anà ngwän, ukyen ukwà."
Wɛɛ bɛ, bɛ làfàtɛn naa: mbuur usàtɛn a taarànde itàkal a ngwän naa: "Undiir alàwal ngye akà mɛ wà Kɔrban", ikaswaŋà naa "kab in'kyɛɛl",
bɛ làmun'pà mbwo naa nde ukɔɔn akyer akundiir mwɛy ntɔn taarànde itàkal ntɔn ngwän."
Lalan, bɛ làfàdwa Ndaa a Nzam ntɔn nkääl a andweer abɛ làfàlɔŋ bɛ. Bɛ làfàkyer sye indiir asin mbɔɔn byà ifà aki.»
Ungö apan, Yɛsu kàfàbel un'sɛŋ a baar, waa kàtɛn a ba naa: «Lan'wem bɛ banswà, làyöb naa:
Akundiir mwɛy tɛy afàfà nsà awafàbilà uboo a mbuur afun'buul wàŋingyäy. Wɛɛ indiir ifàtoo u mbuur ifun'buul wàŋingyäy.»
[Kya mbuur mwɛy usàkal anà an'tsü awem, wɛy nde uwem!]
Umpal kàbilà Yɛsu u ndwà, ukwɛl a un'sɛŋ a baar, alɔŋki ande bun'fuulà ntɔn itim aki.
Nde kàtɛn a ba naa: «Nkye anà bɛ sye, abun bɛ un'yɛnà watɛy? Nkye bɛ làyöb anki naa undiir mwɛy tɛy afafà nsà anà afàbilà uboo a mbuur ukwe anki mukun'buul wàŋingyäy,
ntɔn wa ufàbilà anki u mpem ande, wɛɛ kan'bäl ande, ungö wa akyà u nkuràndwà?» Abun nde kàkyäänà naa isaa byanswà byàŋàpɔŋà.
Nde waa kàtɛn naa: «Ndaa ifafà uboo a mbuur, ya ifun'buul wàŋingyäy.
Ntɔn an'kyän an'be ifàtoo fà boo, fà mpem a baar: ipasàsɛ, küb, ndwääl a baar,
intswem, ngyal a in'naaŋ, an'kyän an'be, loor, mɔ̈ɔ̈ a isak isak, intwɛn, mbɛɛy, nsɛɛn a an'pɛy, unsil.
Indiir ibe abi byanswà byàfàtoo uboo, waa byàfàbuul mbuur wàŋingyäy.»
Yɛsu kàlwomà nde apan, nde kàkyen itiir a Tir. Nde kàbilà u ndwà mwɛy, nde kàkwen anki naa akà mbuur mwɛy uyɔ̈b. Wɛɛ yàkwe anki naa nde ukäl aŋàyee.
Yàmɛnà naa un'kaar mwɛy, mwan ande wun'kaar kàkäl anà dweelà a làbe. Pa kàwem nde làsaŋ a Yɛsu, laa kàyi nde, waa kàbü kà in'kɔl ande.
Un'kaar awà kàkäl ungɛlɛki, un'nsi Fɛnisi u Siri. Nde kàlɔ̈ɔ̈mà akà Yɛsu naa nde uböŋ unsɔŋà unsà mwan ande wun'kaar.
Yɛsu kàtɛɛnà a nde naa: «Wɛy baan bàtàyuur, kàyubwaŋ anki muwal isaa a baan ntɔn mutɔɔm bya akà bimbwà.»
Nde wà kun'fuur naa: «Ndandaa, Mwol, itàkal bimbwà, ungyɛl a mɛsà, byàfàdyà mfür a isaa a baan.»
Apan Yɛsu kàtɛn a nde naa: «Ntɔn ndaa ayi, kyen: unsɔŋà kan'too u mwan angye wun'kaar.»
Nde kàfura ndwà ande, waa kàmɛn mwan ande wàŋàsilà udu a itäb: unsɔŋà akyàtoo amu nde.
Yɛsu kàlwomà nde itiir a Tir, nde kàfurà ntsü a ɛwà a Ngalilɛ u mbwo a Sidɔn, waa kàlyaŋ itiir a Dɛkapɔl.
Baar bun'twääl nkiin mwɛy kàyäämà a mpay, ba bun'bɔ̈ɔ̈n naa nde kun'si kɔɔ.
Apan, Yɛsu kun'syen ukɔl, ukwel a un'sɛŋ a baar, kun'biil mpin kan'tsü, kàtsül an'te, waa kun'bä u làlem.
Ungö nde kàsɛn mii u du, kànyääm ikye, waa kàtɛn a nde naa: «Efàfàta!» Ikaswaŋà naa: «Dubà!»
Kà imbürà, an'tsü ande waa màdubà, làlem ande waa làtsuŋà, waa kàyäämà ubwaŋàbwaŋ.
Yɛsu kaswɛŋ naa ba bàkɔɔn asam akà mbuur mwɛy. Wɛɛ kàsin aswaŋà nde, ba bàsin apayà làsaŋ.
Ba bàkäl mubem mbɔɔn, waa bàtɛɛnà naa: «Indiir byanswà nde kan'kyer ubwaŋ! Nde wàmukyer naa ikwan'tsü bàwem, nkiin bàsi ndaa!»
Kà ilä abin un'sɛŋ a baar mbɔɔn kàkyer afàköŋ. Wa kàkäl anki anà indiir adyà, Yɛsu kàbel alɔŋki ande, waa kàtɛn a ba naa:
«Mɛ aman ngyɛb mbɔɔn ntɔn un'sɛŋ a baar wà, ntɔn, le, ŋàbà ilä itär abà ba anà mɛ, wɛɛ ba undiir adyà watɛy.
Wɛɛ, kya mɛ in'safuur an'bul aba anà ngyal, ba bakyer akàyɔn u mbwo. Bàmbɔɔn uboo aba bàfü kwɛl.»
Alɔŋki ande bun'fuur naa: «U nsi ipɔl ayi, ntsü nà ban'kwo bi muman undiir adii ba, waa ba bàyuur?»
Nde kafuul naa: «Bɛ làwe amà mampà an'kwe?» Ba bàtɛn naa: «Nsambwaar».
Apan nde kàswɛŋ un'sɛŋ a baar mubwaay u mɛɛn. Ungɔ̈ apan nde kàwɛl mampà nsambwaar, kàfuur an'tɔɔn, kàtsül ma, waa kàpɛ ma akalɔŋki ntɔn ba bàkäb. Ba bàkäb ma akun'sɛŋ a baar wanswà.
Ba bàkäl sye anà binsö imwɛy. Ungɔ̈ musaak bya, nde kàtɛn naa ba bàkäb bya sye.
Baar waa bàdi, waa bàyüür. Ba bàsyen in'lwaŋ, in'lwaŋ nsambwaar myà itsü byàsäl.
Kyekà baar bàkäl isii a nsaab nà. Ungö apan nde wakapay,
apan sye nde kàbilà u bwaar anà alɔŋki ande, waa bàkyen itiir a Dalmanutà.
Amfarisi bàyi ba, waa bàsɛmà musà mbaaŋ anà Yɛsu ntɔn mukun'lwab ndaa. Ba bun'lɔ̈ɔ̈m impà kyan'fà du.
Nde kàŋyäm mbɔɔn unsà an'kyän ande, waa kàtɛn naa: «Ntɔn nkye baar a nkööl ayi bàlɔɔmà ba impà? Ndandaa mɛ alàkyään, baar a nkööl ayi akidiim a impà mwɛy bàsapà anki.»
Ungö apan kàsawɛy nde, nde kàfàbilà u bwaar, waa kàkyen sim a ɛwà lumwɛy.
Alɔŋki bàkyärà mpiim muwal mampà, waa bàkäl alà làmwɛy mpel u bwaar.
Yɛsu kaswɛŋ naa: «Le, làkäl kigyɛɛŋ ntɔn ful a Amfarisi anà là Ɛlɔdi.»
Ba bàsyeelà mbaaŋ ba a ba ntɔn ba bàkäl anki anà mampà.
Yɛsu kàmɛn nde abun, waa kàtɛn a ba naa: «Ntɔn nkye làsyeelà bɛ mbaaŋ ntɔn lan'kɔɔn bɛ mampà? Nkye bɛ ŋàtàwal anki un'yɛnà, waa bɛ mpa làyöbà? Nkye mpem abɛ yàŋàbwà bwoor?
Bɛ làwe anà mii, nkye bɛ làkamanà anki? Bɛ làwe anà an'tsü, nkye bɛ làkawɛɛmà anki? Nkye bɛ làfàkayöbà anki:
mpal kàtsül mɛ mampà an'tyeen ntɔn abaal nsaab tyeen, in'lwaŋ aŋàyɔl a itsü in'kwe bɛ làsyen?» Ba bàtɛn a nde naa: «Kwɛm aŋiyweel.»
«Wɛɛ mpal kàtsül mɛ mampà nsambwaar ntɔn abaal nsaab nà, in'lwaŋ in'kwe myàŋàyɔl a itsü bɛ làsyen?» Ba waa bàtɛn naa: «Nsambwaar.»
Nde waa kàtɛn a ba naa: «Nkye bɛ ŋàtàyöb anki?»
Ba ban'tol Bɛtesayidà. Waa bun'twääl ikwàmii mwɛy, bun'bɔ̈ɔ̈n naa nde kun'bä.
Nde kàtɛ ikwàmii mpi u kɔɔ, waa kun'twey u nsà a bul. Nde kun'fül an'te u mii, kun'si an'kɔɔ, waa kun'fuulà naa: «Nkye ngye akimanà undiir?»
Nde kun'duub mii, waa kàtɛɛnà naa: «Mɛ in'täälà baar, mɛ ba amanà asànaa in'te, wɛɛ ba bàmuyikyà.»
Apan Yɛsu kàfun'sà an'kɔɔ udu a mii. Baal awà waa kàmɛn ubwaŋàbwaŋ. Nde kàkyer akɔrà, waa kamɛnà indiir byanswà umwɛy umwɛy.
Lalan Yɛsu kun'fuur nde ndwà ande, waa kun'kyään naa: «Twon an'bilà akikikye uboo a bul.»
Yɛsu kàkyen anà alɔŋki ande u ntsü an'bul a tsütsü anà Sɛzarɛ a Filipo. U mbwo, nde kàfuul alɔŋki ande naa: «Baar bàfàtɛn naa mɛ in'wà nà?»
Ba waa bun'fuur naa: «Ywan Un'düümà, bumwɛy, Ɛli, bumwɛy naa umwɛy uboo a aŋangɔɔm.»
Nde waa ufàfuul: «Wɛɛ bɛ ŋakwo làtɛn naa mɛ in'wà nà?» Petɔlà waa ufuur: «Ngye awà Klistɔ.»
Yɛsu kaswɛŋ a ngwal naa ba bàkɔɔn ayäm akà mbuur mwɛy ntɔn nde.
Apan, nde kàsɛmà mukalɔŋ naa: «Mwan a mbuur akyer aman mpay mbɔɔn. Andwer, amfum a angaŋ anà alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn bàkyer un'tɔn, bàkyer un'dwa, waa ungö ilä itär nde akyer awiyà.»
