Ndaa ayi nde kàtɛɛnà kimii imii. Apan Petɔlà kun'naan ukɔl, waa kàsɛmà mukun'ŋän.
Wɛɛ nde waa kàbulà, kàler alɔŋki ande, kàŋän Petɔlà, waa kàtɛn naa: «Satanà, kyen ungö a mɛ! Ntɔn ngye akayweerà anki indiir a Nzam, wɛɛ indiir a baar.»
Ungö nde kàbel un'sɛŋ a baar anà alɔŋki ande, waa kàtɛn a ba naa: «Isàkal naa mbuur akwen mukan'lab, wɛy nde ukɔɔb ndür ande, usɛɛn kulunsi ande, waa kan'lab.
Ntɔn mbuur usàkwen mutii mɔ̈ɔ̈ ande, wa asàkyà bwà, wɛɛ mbuur usàpiy mɔ̈ɔ̈ ande ntɔn mɛ anà làsaŋ aŋàbwaŋ, nde asàtswà wa.
Bweel nà mbuur kan'kwo muwal uman naa nde kan'wal mɛɛn manswà, wɛɛ mɔ̈ɔ̈ ande ukyà bwà?
Abun, ininà mbuur kan'kwo mupà ntɔn musɔɔm mɔ̈ɔ̈ ande?
Ntɔn mbuur usàwem mɛ nswɛn anà ndaa amɛ uboo a nkööl ayi yinswem anà yube, Mwan a mbuur sye asun'wem nswɛn mpal usàyà nde unsà làkoo a Taarànde, anà akyeey in'kyɛɛl.»
Yɛsu kàfàtɛn a ba naa: «Ndandaa mɛ alàkyään, amwɛy uboo a baar bà pà, bàsàkwà anki kusà muman Imwol a Nzam kyàmuyiyà anà ngwal.»
Ungö ilä isyaam, Yɛsu kàwɛl Petɔlà, Zyak anà Ywan, waa kasyen u mpey udu a mɔŋ a bwɛlàbwɛl. Nde kàyoolà ifà u mii a ba,
ipfɛy ande byàbulà byà tsɛk tsɛk, anà pɛɛl làmwɛy mpa kan'kwo akà un'yiir mwɛy mutwey.
Ɛli kàyàmɛnà anà Mɔsɛ akà ba. Ba bàkayäämà a Yɛsu.
Petɔlà kàtɛn a Yɛsu naa: «Un'lɔɔŋ, yubwaŋ naa bi ikäl apà. Wɛy bi imbaar ntɛn, ntɛn tär: mwɛy ntɔn ngye, mwɛy ntɔn Mɔsɛ, mwɛy ntɔn Ɛli.»
Nde kàyöb anki naa nde nkye utɛɛnà, ntɔn matɛɛr màkyer awal.
Un'böŋ mwey kàyafwee wa, ndaa mwɛy yàtoo uboo un'böŋ awà naa: «Awà wà Mwan amɛ wà nkween. Lun'wem!»
Ungö apan, bàler ba umbil aba, ba bàsàman anki akà mbuur mwɛy, Yɛsu mpɛl anà ba.
Umpal bàyàtyà ba u mɔŋ, nde katsüŋ mukyään itàkal akà mbuur mwɛy ndaa bàmɛn ba, tii mpal usàwiyà Mwan a mbuur uboo a akü.
Ba bàkyer akaar nswɛɛŋ ayi, wɛɛ ba bàfuulà ba a ba naa: «Ikaswaŋà aben "ngwiiyà uboo a akü"?»
Apan ba bun'fuul naa: «Ntɔn nkye alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn bàfàtɛn ba naa: "Ɛli akyer atwab atàyà"?»
Nde kàtɛn a ba naa: «Yabwɛy naa Ɛli atàyà muyàfuur indiir byanswà u mbwo. Wɛɛ ntɔn nkye bàsön ba ntɔn Mwan a mbuur naa nde akyɛr aman mpay mbɔɔn, bun'wal asànaa undiir a bunàbun?
Wɛɛ mɛ alàkyään naa Ɛli kàkyàyà, baar bun'kyer ndaa yanswà bàkwen ba, asànaa bàsön ya ntɔn nde.»
Mpal bàyafurà ba akà alɔŋki, ba bàmɛn un'sɛŋ a baar mbɔɔn apà ba anà alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn bàmusyeelà mbaaŋ anà ba.
Pa kàmɛn wa Yɛsu, un'sɛŋ a baar wanswà laa kàbamà wa, waa kàkyeenà ntiin mukun'pà mbɔr.
Nde waa kafuul naa: «Ininà bɛ làsyeelà mbaaŋ anà ba?»
Baal mwɛy uboo a un'sɛŋ a baar kun'fuur naa: «Un'lɔɔŋ, mɛ amatwääl mwan amɛ wàbaal: nde we anà dweelà a nkiin.
Ikal kyanswà lun'kaar la, la lun'bwiy u mɛɛn, mwan ugyɔrà an'te, laa ukwoor nde an'din ande, waa ubwà un'sey. Mɛ an'tɛn a alɔŋki angye naa ba bàböŋ la, wɛɛ ba bàsàkal anki anà ngwal.»
Nde waa utɛn a ba naa: «Nkööl ikɔ̈ɔ̈n làkwikilà, tii nkye taaŋ mɛ insàkal anà bɛ? Tii mpal nà mɛ in'sàkaŋ mpem ntɔn bɛ? Lan'twääl awà.»
Ba waa bun'twääl. Umpal làmɛn dweelà a làbe Yɛsu, la làni mwan a ngwal, mwan kàbü u mɛɛn, waa kàyisilà wàmuyigyɔrà an'te.
Yɛsu kàfuul taarànde naa: «Sɛmà taaŋ nà ya ifun'yeel?» Nde waa kàten naa: «Sɛmà imbɛy ande.
Mbalà mbɔɔn la làfun'tɔɔm u mbaa anà kan'dà ntɔn mukun'dwa. Wɛɛ, isàkal naa ngye an'kwo mukyer undiir, yà ibay, ntɔn ngyɛb angye akà bi!»
Yɛsu waa kàtɛn a nde naa: «Isàkal naa ngye an'kwo! ... Indiir byanswà byàŋàkwo akà mbuur awe anà làkwikilà.»
Apan sye, taar a mwan kàsi un'kwɛŋ naa: «Mɛ an'sà làkwikilà! Mbay ntɔn an'kɔɔn mɛ làkwikilà!»
Yɛsu, abà kàmɛn nde un'sɛŋ a baar wàmuyàkɔ̈ŋ, nde kàswɛŋ dweelà a làbe, waa kàtɛn naa: «Dweelà a nkiin anà ikwan'tsü, mɛ amaswaŋ, too ubɔɔ a mwan wà, twon an'fyefurà!»
Dweelà làsi in'kwɛŋ, waa lun'ni a ngwal. Mwan kàbulà asànaa wàŋàkwà, lalan bàmbɔɔn bàteenà ba naa: «Nde kan'kwà.»
Wɛɛ Yɛsu kun'tɛ mpi u kɔɔ, kun'mbaar, nde waa kàmbarà.
Mpal kàfurà Yɛsu ndwà, alɔŋki ande bun'fuul ukɔl naa: «Wɛɛ bi, ntɔn nkye mpa ikwe bi muböŋ dweelà a làbe alanà?»
Nde kàtɛn a ba naa: «Dweelà a tub alà làfàtoo u ngyamàkà mpɛl.»
Ba bàlwomà apan, waa bàsoonà Ngalilɛ. Yɛsu kàkwen anki naa baar bàyɔ̈b.
Ntɔn nde kàlɔɔŋà alɔŋki ande, waa kàtɛɛnà a ba naa: «Mwan a mbuur bàkyer ayun'yälà kàn'kɔɔ a baar, ba bàkyer ayun'dwà, waa ilä itär ungö a ndwääl ande, nde akyer ayàwiyà.»
Ba bàyöbà anki ndaa ayin, wɛɛ ba bàweemà bɔɔmà mukun'fuul.
Ba bàkyen Kapɛrnawum. Umpal kàkäl nde u ndwà, Yɛsu kàfuul alɔŋki ande naa: «Ininà bɛ làyisyeelà mbaaŋ u mbwo?»
Wɛɛ ba bàkäl akul, ntɔn u mbwo, ba bàyisyeelà mbaaŋ ba a ba ntɔn muyöb naa nà awà mbuur a kölàköl.
Yɛsu kàkyer abwaay, waa kàbel Bàkwen Aŋiyweel, waa kàtɛn a ba naa: «Isàkal naa mbuur akwen mukäl wàtàtwɛb, wɛy nde ukäl wàngöngö anà un'syääl a baar banswà.»
Apan nde kàwɛl mwan mwɛy, waa kun'si uboboo a ba. Ungö akun'böbà mpi, nde kàtɛn a ba naa:
«Mbuur awal mwan asànaa wà kikɔb amɛ, nde kan'wal mɛ ŋakwo: mbuur kàman'wal, kà mɛ anki nde kan'wal, wɛ Mbuur kan'töm.»
Ywan waa kàtɛn a Yɛsu naa: «Un'lɔɔŋ, bi kàmɛn mbuur mwɛy wàmuböŋ an'dweelà an'be kikɔb angye, wɛɛ bi kàleŋ mukun'tsuŋ mukyer abun ntɔn nde bi kàfilabà anki.»
Wɛɛ Yɛsu kàtɛn naa: «Twon làmutsuŋ, ntɔn kà we anà mbuur anki kan'kwo mukyer impà kà ikɔb amɛ, waa ungö apan nde ufàtɛn ube ntɔn mɛ.
Abun, mbuur mpa afàtɔn bi wà anà bi.
Mbuur wanswà asàlapà kɔɔb a an'dà anwà, ntɔn bɛ làbà baar a Klistɔ, mɛ alàkyään ndandaa, bweel ande làsàkyà anki bwà.
«Wɛɛ mbuur wanswà asiinà umwɛy uboo a bibaan ban'sà làkwikilà bà akà mɛ mubwà unsà ube, yan'söön ubwaŋ akà nde naa bun'bäm nkà a kölàköl u bway, waa bun'tɔɔm kà ɛwà.
Isàkal naa kɔɔ angye làfasyen nkuur unsà ube, tsul la. Ntɔn yan'söön ubwaŋ naa ngye abilà u mɔ̈ɔ̈ kɔɔ làmwɛy, akwànaa ngye mukal amà an'kɔɔ an'mɔ̈ɔ̈l, waa akyà yaaŋ a mbaa mpa làfàdim. [
Kwo, "in'swab myàfàkwà anki, mbaa ifàdim anki akà ikikye."]
Isàkal naa làkɔl angye làfasyen nkuur unsà ube, tsul la. Ntɔn yan'söön ubwaŋ naa ngye abilà u mɔ̈ɔ̈ anà too, akwànaa ngye mukal amyà in'kɔl myeel, waa akyà yaaŋ a mbaa. [
Kwo, "in'swab myàfàkwà anki, mbaa ifàdim anki akà ikikye."]
Isàkal naa dii angye làfasyen nkuur unsà ube, kwol la. Ntɔn yan'söön ubwaŋ naa ngye abilà imwol a Nzam anà dii làmwɛy, akwànaa ngye mukal amyà mii myeel, waa batɔɔm u yaaŋ a mbaa.
Kwo, in'swab myàfàkwà anki, mbaa ifàdim anki akà ikikye.
«Abun, mbuur wanswà asàlyaŋ u mbaa, asàwal muŋ ntɔn mupɔŋà.
«Muŋ wà undiir aŋàbwaŋ, wɛɛ ntsà awa isàwà, bɛ ya làfuur aben? Làkäl anà muŋ uboo abɛ ŋakwo, làkäl unsà duu uboo amwɛy anà bumwɛy.»
Yɛsu kàlwomà nde apan, nde kàkyen itiir a nsi a Yuday, u sim a Yɔrdan lumwɛy. In'sɛŋ a baar myàfàköŋ apà nde, nde kàfalɔɔŋà asànaa nkääl ande.
Amfarisi bàsin tsütsü apà nde ntɔn mukun'fuul naa: «Nkye mbwo yàmwo baal muböŋ un'kyay ande.»
Yɛsu kafuur naa: «Ininà Mɔsɛ kàlaswɛŋ?»
Ba bàtɛn naa: «Mɔsɛ kàpɛ mbwo musɔn ukaan a nkaabà anà muböŋ un'kaar.»
Yɛsu waa kàtɛn a ba naa: «Yà ntɔn bwoor a mpem abɛ waa nde kàlapɛ nswɛɛŋ ayi.
Wɛɛ u nsɛmà a nkyeer, Nzam "kakyer baal anà un'kaar".

Lalan baal asàwɛy taarànde anà ngwän, waa usàbääb a un'kyay ande,
290a08006b	waa ba bàbɔ̈ɔ̈l bàsabulà ndür mwɛy. Apan, ba bàfàkal anki abɔ̈ɔ̈l, wɛɛ ndür mwɛy.
290a090038	Abun, wɛy mbuur ukɔɔn akaab ayi kàtüüb Nzam.»
Mpal bàkäl ba u ndwà, alɔŋki bàfun'fuul ntɔn ndaa ayi.
Nde kàtɛn a ba naa: «Baal usàwɛy un'kyay ande, usàbääl un'kyay asin, nde kan'tà inswem akà wàtàtwɛb.
Isàkal naa un'kaar kan'wɛy un'dim ande, usàwal wàsin, nde wà un'kaar inswem.»
Baar bàtwäälà baan ntɔn nde kabä, wɛɛ alɔŋki bàŋän ba.
Mpal kàmɛn nde abun, Yɛsu kàmɛn ube, waa kàtɛn a ba naa: «Làwɛy baan bàyi akà mɛ! Twon làmatsuŋ, ntɔn Imwol a Nzam kye a baar abà asànaa ba.
Ndandaa mɛ alàkyään, mbuur mpà awal Imwol a Nzam asànaa mwan, nde kya usàbilà anki.»
Ungö, nde kàbööbà baan, waa kasi an'kɔɔ ntɔn mukasaak.
Mpal kàkäl Yɛsu mukyà, mbuur mwɛy kàyi u ntiin, waa kàbü an'köm kusà ande, waa kun'fuul naa: «Un'lɔɔŋ aŋàbwaŋ, mɛ in'kyer aben muwal bweel a mɔ̈ɔ̈ a mbul a in'tye?»
Yɛsu kàtɛn a nde naa: «Ntɔn nkye aman'bel ngye aŋàbwaŋ? Akà mbuur mwɛy wàŋàbwaŋ watɛy isàkal naa kà Nzam mpɛl anki.
Ngye akiyöb in'kɔɔn: "Twon an'dwà, twon an'tà inswem, twon an'yib, twon an'tà imbäl a loor, twon an'kyer mbuur ube, sà làkoo akà taaràŋà anà ngwa."»
Mbuur waa kun'fuur naa: «Un'lɔɔŋ, ayin yanswà mɛ in'kyer afàlab sɛmà imbɛy amɛ.»

Yɛsu kun'ler nde, waa kun'kwen, waa kàtɛn a nde naa: «Undiir mwɛy mpɛl kàmakɔ̈ɔ̈n: kyen, yälà indiir angye byanswà, pà ngim ya akà aŋàlàmbwà, waa ngye asàwal un'naaŋ u du. Ungö apan, yan'läb.»
Wɛɛ u ndaa ayi, nde kàbü mpye, waa kàkyen u ngyɛb mbɔɔn. Ntɔn nde kàkäl anà indiir mbɔɔn.
Yɛsu kàler umbil ande, waa kàtɛn a alɔŋki ande naa: «Yà mpay mbɔɔn akà aŋin'naaŋ mubilà kà Imwol a Nzam!»
Alɔŋki bàmɛn mpay ntɔn ndaa ande. Wɛɛ Yɛsu kàfàtɛn a ba naa: «Baan amɛ, yà mpay mbɔɔn mubilà kà Imwol a Nzam!
Mpay yatɛy mbɔɔn akà mpoonà mubilà u mun a nsway akwànaa ŋun'naaŋ mubilà kà Imwol a Nzam.»
Ba bakyer abem mbɔɔn, waa bàtɛɛnà ba a ba naa: «Abun, nà kan'kwo muwà mɔ̈ɔ̈?»
Yɛsu kaler, waa kàtɛn naa: «Ya ikwe anki akà baar, wɛɛ akà Nzam yanswà ikyer afàkwo.»
Petɔlà kàsɛmà mutɛn a nde naa: «Le bi, bi kàkyàwɛy indiir byanswà ntɔn mulab ngye.»
Yɛsu waa kàtɛn a nde naa: «Ndandaa mɛ alàkyään, isàkal naa mbuur an'sàwɛy ndwà, atɔŋ abaal, atɔŋ akaar, ngwän, taarànde, baan, an'ywaŋ ntɔn mɛ anà ntɔn Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ,
nde asàwal mbalà nkam aŋàsöönà u paŋà alà, ndwà, atɔŋ abaal, atɔŋ akaar, ngwän, baan, an'ywaŋ, - anà nkwaaŋ - anà u paŋà làyà, mɔ̈ɔ̈ a mbul a in'tye.
Lalan, bàtàtwɛb mbɔɔn bàsàkal bàngöngö, bàngöngö bàsàkal bàtàtwɛb.»

Ba bàkäl u mbwo mubeenà Yɛlusàlɛm. Yɛsu kàyikyeenà kusà a ba. Ba bàkäl mutɛɛr, baar bàyun'labà bàkal u bɔɔmà. Apan nde kàfàwal Bàkwem Aŋiyweel anà nde, waa kàsɛmà mukakyään ndaa ayà ikun'bweel:
«Le, bi iwàmubeenà Yɛlusàlɛm, akun Mwan a mbuur bàkyer akun'yälà akà amfum angaŋ anà akà alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn. Ba bàkun'tsüül mbar a ukwà, waa bàkun'yälà kan'kɔɔ a baar mpa abà Ayudà,
bàkyer akun'sɛ, bàkyer akun'tsul an'te, bàkyer akun'kam an'füm anà bàkyer akun'dwa, wɛɛ ungö a ilä itär, nde akyer asàwiyà.»
Apan, Zyak anà Ywan, baan a Zebeday, bàkyen tsütsü apà Yɛsu, waa bàtɛn a nde naa: «Un'lɔɔŋ, bi ikwen naa ngye akyer ntɔn bi undiir kalɔ̈ɔ̈m bi.»
Nde waa kàtɛn a ba naa: «Ininà bɛ làkwen naa mɛ in'kyer ntɔn bɛ?»
Ba bun'fuur naa: «Ipɛ mbwo bi mubwaay u làkoo angye, umwɛy u kɔɔ angye là ibaal, wumwɛy u kɔɔ angye là ikaar.»
Yɛsu kàtɛn a ba naa: «Bɛ làyöbà anki undiir làlɔɔmà bɛ. Nkye bɛ làn'kwo munwà kɔɔb a mpay in'yànwà mɛ, itàkal naa muwal ndüümà ayin'yàwal mɛ?»
Ba bàtɛn a nde naa: «Bi kan'kwo.» Yɛsu waa kàtɛn a ba naa: «Kɔɔb in'yànwà mɛ, bɛ làkyer ayànwà la, ndüümà in'wal mɛ, bɛ làkyer ayàwal ya.
Wɛɛ mubwaay u kɔɔ amɛ là ibaal itàkal là ikaar, kà mɛ anki an'kwo mupà: ikal abi byà ntɔn baar kàlɔ̈ɔ̈n Nzam bya.»
Bàkwen bumwɛy bàwem ba ndaa ayin, ba bàmɛn Zyak anà Ywan ube.
Apan Yɛsu kabel, waa kàtɛn a ba naa: «Bɛ, bɛ làkyàyöb naa baar bàfàmɛnà asànaa amfum a in'sɛŋ bàfasà ungyɛl a in'kɔl aba, baar an'köl an'köl bàfàswaŋ ba ikɔ̈b aba.
Ya ikwe anki mukal abwɛy uboo abɛ. Wɛɛ isàkal naa mbuur akwen mukal wàkölàköl uboo abɛ, wɛy nde ukäl un'syääl abɛ,
mbuur wanswà akwen mukal wàtàtwɛb uboo abɛ, nde akal un'sɔ a baar banswà.
Lalan Mwan a mbuur kàyi anki ntɔn bun'syääl, wɛɛ nde kàyi ntɔn musyääl anà mupà mɔ̈ɔ̈ ande asànaa nkwiy ntɔn baar mbɔɔn.»
Ba bàtöl Yɛlikɔ. Umpal kàkäl Yɛsu mutoo u bul alan anà alɔŋki ande anà un'sɛŋ a baar mbɔɔn, ikwàmii Bartimɛ, mwan baal a Timɛ, kàkäl aŋàbwaay ukɔl a mbwo mulɔɔmà.
Mpal kàwem nde naa awɛy Yɛsu un'nsi Nasàlɛr kàkäl, nde kàsɛmà mukuub in'kwɛŋ: «Mwan a David, Yɛsu, nsyääm!»
Bàmbɔɔn bun'swɛŋà naa nde ukäl akul, wɛɛ nde kàsöönà mulaal: «Mwan a David, nsyääm!»
Yɛsu waa kàmbär, waa kàtɛn naa: «Lun'bel!» Ba bàbel ikwàmii, waa bàtɛn a nde naa: «Wal ibaal, mbarà, nde kàmabel.»
Apàn, nde kàpiy kàzak ande, waa kàmbarà, kàparà ntiin mukyà akà Yɛsu.
Yɛsu kun'fuul naa: «Ininà ngye akwen mɛ mukyer ntɔn ngye?» Ikwàmii kun'fuur naa: «Un'lɔɔŋ, wɛy mɛ in'fàman!»
Yɛsu kàtɛn a nde naa: «Kyen, làkwikilà angye làmatswà mɔ̈ɔ̈.» Apan sye nde waa kàfàman, waa kàyilabà Yɛsu u mbwo.
Mpal bàtɔ̈l ba tsütsü a Yɛlusàlɛm, tsütsü a Bɛtfagɛ anà Bɛtani, mper a mɔŋ a In'te a Ɔlive, Yɛsu kàtöm abööl uboo alɔŋki ande,
waa kàtɛn a ba naa: «Làkyen u bul lanà kusà a bɛ: Pa làkàbilà bɛ uboo a la, bɛ làkàman mwan a ntsür bàfàbel naa anɛs, udu awa mbuur ŋàtàlaar anki. Làtsuuŋ wa, lan'twääl awà.
Isàkal naa mbuur kan'tɛn a bɛ naa: "Ntɔn nkye làkyerà bɛ abun?" Lun'fuur naa: "Mwol we anà mfun a wa, waa làgyägyä nde ayàfuur wa apà."»
Apan, ba waa bàkyen, waa bàmɛn mwan anɛ wàŋàbäm u nsà tsütsü a munàmbwo, u balàbal. Ba bàtsuuŋ wa.
Baar amwɛy bàkäl paa bafuul naa: «Ntɔn nkye làtsuuŋà bɛ mwan anɛ?»
Ba bafuur asànaa kàtɛn Yɛsu, ba waa bawɛy musyen wa.
Ba bàsyen mwan anɛ akà Yɛsu, waa bàyeel ipfɛy aba udu a wa, Yɛsu waa kàbwaay udu a wa.
Baar mbɔɔn bàyeel ipfɛy aba u mbwo, bumwɛy ibwiy a nkay bàtsüülà ba kan'ywaŋ.
Baar bàyikyeenà kusà anà baar bàyilabà bàkäl muyisà in'kwɛŋ naa: «Ɔsana! Nsaak ikäl akà mbuur ayà kikɔb a Mwol!
Nsaak ikal kà imwol kyan'yà, imwol a taaràbi David! Ɔsana kà ikal a dudu!»
Yɛsu kàkyen Yɛlusàlɛm, waa kàbilà u ndwà a Nzam. Ungö muler indiir byanswà byàkäl apà nde, taaŋ sye làkäl làŋàkyà, waa kàtoo, kàkyen Bɛtani anà Bàkwem Aŋiyweel.
Taaŋtyà, umpal bàtoo ba u Bɛtani, Yɛsu kàwen ngyal.
Apan waa kàtääl un'te a an'fige kàkäl anà nkay, nde kàkàler wa naa nkye nde akyàman undiir mwɛy. Wɛɛ mpal kàsin nde tsütsü, nde kàmɛn nkay mpɛl, ntɔn la làkäl anki paŋà a an'fige.
Lalan kàtɛn nde a wa naa: «Wɛy mbuur mwɛy ukɔɔn asàdyà imbɛŋ angye akà ikikye!» Alɔŋki ande waa bàwem.
Ba bàtöl Yɛlusàlɛm. Yɛsu kàbilà u ndwà a Nzam, waa kàsɛmà muböŋ baar bàyäälà anà bàsöömà u ndwà a Nzam: nde kàbuum mɛsà a agyɛɛŋ a ngim anà an'kir a ayääl a nkokà,
nde kàwɛy anki akà mbuur mwɛy mulyaaŋ anà undiir u ndwà a Nzam.
Nde kàlɔɔŋà, waa kàtɛɛnà a ba naa: «Nkye bàsön anki naa: "Ndwà amɛ bàsabeelà ndwà a ngyamàkà ntɔn in'sɛŋ myanswà"? Wɛɛ bɛ, bɛ ya làkyàbuul mboo a mbüüb!»
Amfum a angaŋ anà alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn bàwem ba ndaa ayin, ba bàleŋà mbwo mukun'dwa. Ntɔn ba bun'weemà bɔɔmà, ntɔn an'lɔɔŋ ande màtü un'sɛŋ a baar.
Mpal làbü sisye, Yɛsu anà alɔŋki ande waa bàtoo u bul a kölàköl.
Mpal bàkal ba mulyaaŋ u tutu, ba bàmɛn un'te a an'fige wàŋàyɔm tii kà in'swɛy awa.
Petɔlà kàyɔbà nde, laa kàtɛn nde naa: «Un'lɔɔŋ, ler, un'te a an'fige akwà kàküül ngye kan'yɔm wanswà.»
Yɛsu kafuur naa: «Làkäl anà làkwikilà akà Nzam.

Ndandaa mɛ alàkyään, isàkal naa mbuur kan'tɛn a mɔŋ wà naa: "Lwomà apan, kyen kàbü u ngyäl", ukɔɔn asà nkyɛɛr u mpem ande, wɛɛ nde usi làkwikilà naa ndaa kan'tɛn nde ikyer akwo, ya sye laa isàkwo ya ntɔn nde.
Lalan mɛ alàkyään naa: indiir byanswà làlɔm bɛ unsà ngyamàkà, làkäl anà làkwikilà naa bɛ bya lan'wal, bya byàbɛ.
Umpal làwà bɛ umbäär u ngyamàkà, isàkal naa bɛ làwe anà nkir a mbuur, lun'dwääl nkul, waa Taaràbɛ awà u du uyàladwääl sye nkul a ibii abɛ. [
Wɛɛ bɛ làsàkɔɔn adwääl nkul a ibii, Taaràbɛ awà u du uyàladwääl anki sye nkul a ibii abɛ.]»
Ba ban'yàfurà Yɛlusàlɛm. Umpal kàkäl Yɛsu muyiyoolà uboo a ndwà a Nzam, amfum a angaŋ, alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn anà andweer bàyàsin apà nde,
waa bàtɛn a nde naa: «Unsà ikɔ̈b nà akyerà ngye indiir abi? Itàkal naa nà kapɛ ikɔ̈b mukyer bya?»
Yɛsu kàtɛn a ba naa: «Mɛ alàsà mfuul mwɛy mpɛl, lan'fuur, waa mɛ in'yàtɛn a bɛ naa unsà ikɔ̈b nà mɛ in'kyerà indiir abi.
Nkye ndüümà a Ywan yàfü du lɛɛ akà baar? Lan'fuur!»
Ba bàyweerà ba a ba naa: «Kya bi isàtɛn naa: "U du", nde ayifuul naa: "Ntɔn nkye mpa lun'si bɛ làkwikilà?"
Wɛɛ, nkye bi itɛn naa: "Akà baar"...? - Ba bàtiinà un'sɛŋ a baar bɔɔmà, ntɔn ba banswà bàsii naa Ywan kàkäl ŋangɔɔm ndandaa.»
Lalan bàfuur ba akà Yɛsu naa: «Bi iyöb anki.» Apan Yɛsu waa kàtɛn a ba naa: «Mɛ sye alàkyään anki unsà ikɔ̈b nà mɛ in'kyerà indiir abi.»

Apan Yɛsu kàsɛmà muyääm a ba unsà nsim naa: «Mbuur mwɛy kàkön ywaŋ a vin. Nde kàdiŋà la a làpaŋ. Nde kàtöŋ ikal mukaam mbɛŋ anà ndwà a ikyɛɛŋ. Ungö apan nde kàpɛ la akà baar musyääl a la, waa kàkyen.
Utaaŋ mubwo, nde kàtöm un'syääl ande mwɛy akà baar bàfàkyer vin ntɔn muwal akà ba kab a isaa lànde.
Baar abà bàtɛ un'syääl awà mpi, bun'düb, waa bun'fuur an'kɔɔ ipɔl.
Nde kàfatööm un'syääl asin. Awà sye, ba bun'düb kun'tswe, waa bun'tö.
Nde kàtöm wàsin, wawun sye ba bàkyer un'dwà, anà bàsin sye mbɔɔn: bumwɛy bàkyer adüb, bumwɛy bàkyer adwa.
Nde kàsàsal awà nà mwan ande mwɛy mpɛl wà nkween. Nde kun'töm ungöngö, waa kàtɛn naa: "Ba bàyàkàkömà mwan amɛ."
Wɛɛ baar bàfàkyer vin bàtɛn ba a ba naa: "Le ikyee ande. Làyi bi kun'dwä, waa ywaŋ làyàkal làbi!"
Apan, ba bun'tɛ mpi, bun'dwä, waa bun'tɔɔm unsà a ywaŋ a vin.»
«Apan ŋàywaŋ asàkyer aben? Nde akyer asàyà, akyɛr asàswaŋ baar mukadwa, waa usàpà ywaŋ akà baar asin.
Nkye bɛ làtäŋ anki itiir a ndaa ki uboo a Ndaa Aŋàsɔn: "Nkɔŋ bàpiy atööŋ, yàkyàbulà nkɔŋ a twɛrà.
Ayi ndaa yàfü akà Mwol: ya yà ndaa ubem u mii a bi!"»
Ba bàleŋà ipöl mukun'kɔr, wɛɛ ba bàtiinà un'seŋ bɔɔmà. Ba bàkyer ayɔ̈b naa nde nsim ayi kàtɛ ntɔn ba. Apan ba bàsun'wɛy, waa bàkyen.
Ungö apan, ba bun'tööm Amfarisi amwɛy anà baar a Ɛlɔdi ntɔn ba bun'lwɛb ndaa u mbwo a ntɛɛn ande ŋakwo.

Ba bàyàtɛn a nde naa: «Un'lɔɔŋ, bi ikyàyöb naa ngye awà swalaa anà ngye afàlab anki ukwen a mbuur mwɛy: ngye afàler anki ntabwey a baar, wɛɛ ngye afàlɔŋ mbwo a Nzam unsà ndandaa. Nkye bàkyàpà mbwo, lɛɛ tɛy, mufur itɛr akà Sɛzar? Nkye bi ikyer afur lɛɛ ifur anki?»
Wɛɛ nde, abà kàyöb nde mpem yweel aba, nde kàtɛn a ba naa: «Ntɔn nkye làman'lwab bɛ? Lan'twääl itɛr a ngim, mɛ in'kwen muman kya.»
Ba bun'twääl imwɛy. Yɛsu waa kafuul naa: «Ntabwey anà ikɔb ki udu akya byà nà?» Ba bàfuur naa: «Byà Sɛzar.»
Yɛsu waa kàtɛn a ba naa: «Làpɛ indiir a Sɛzar akà Sɛzar, indiir a Nzam akà Nzam.» Ba bàkyer abemà ntɔn nde.
Asadusu amwɛy ban'yà akà Yɛsu. Baar abà bàfàtɛn naa akü bàfàwiyà anki. Ba bun'fuulà abà:
«Un'lɔɔŋ, Mɔsɛ kàsɔn abà ntɔn bi: "Isàkal naa baal mwɛy un'tɔŋ ande kan'kwà, kan'sàwɛy un'kaar, ukɔɔn awɛy baan, wɛy nde ubääl un'kweel un'dim awà ntɔn mupà un'tɔŋ ande mbɛŋ."
Bàkäl anà atɔŋ nsambwaar. Wàtàtwɛb kàkyer abääl, waa kàkü ukɔɔn asàwɛy mwan.
Wàyweel kàbääl un'kaar awun, waa kàkü ukɔɔn asàwɛy mwan. Wàtär sye abun,
ba bànsambwaar bàsàwɛy anki akà mwan mwɛy. Ungö a ba bànswà, un'kaar sye waa kàkü.
U ngwiiyà, mpal bàsàwiyà akü, nde asàkal un'kyay a nà uboo a ba? Ntɔn ba bànsambwaar bàkyer un'bääl!»
Yɛsu kakyään naa: «Ntɔn bɛ làyöb anki Ndaa Aŋàsɔn, itàkal ngwal a Nzam, waa bɛ lan'diimà mbwo, kabwɛy anki?
Abun, mpal bàsàwiyà baar uboo a akü, ba bàsàbääl anki akyay, itàkal adim, wɛɛ ba bàsàkal asànaa akyeey u du.
Ntɔn ngwiiyà a akü, nkye bɛ làtäŋ anki, uboo a un'kaan a Mɔsɛ, unsà nsim a ibwiy a mbaa, ndaa kàtɛn Nzam a nde naa: "Mɛ in'wà Nzam a Abàlam, Nzam a Izak anà Nzam a Yakɔb."
Nde kà wà Nzam a akü anki, wɛɛ wà baar a mɔ̈ɔ̈. Bɛ làkadiimà mbwo mbɔɔn.»
Un'lɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn mwɛy awà kàwem nsyeel a mbaaŋ aba, kàkyer ayöb naa Yɛsu kafuur ubwaŋ, laa kàsin nde, waa kun'fuul naa: «Un'kɔɔn nà wàtàtwɛb unsà in'kɔɔn myanswà?»
Yɛsu kàfuur naa: «Wàtàtwɛb awà: "Isàlɛl, wem, Mwol Nzam abi, Mwol wà mwɛy,
ngye ayàkwen Mwol Nzam angye unsà mpem angye yanswà, unsà mɔ̈ɔ̈ angye wanswà, unsà an'kyän angye manswà anà unsà ngwal angye yanswà."
Wàyweel awà: "Ngye ayàkwen un'tɔŋ angye asànaa ngye ŋakwo." In'kɔɔn asin myatɛy myasöön ami.»
Un'lɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn kàfàtɛn naa: «Un'lɔɔŋ, ngye an'tɛn ndandaa: Nde wà nde mpɛl, wàsin watɛy,
waa, mukun'kwen u mpem ande yanswà, kun'yɛnà ande wanswà, u ngwal ande yanswà, anà mukwen un'tɔŋ ande asànaa nde ŋakwo, yan'söön ibɔɔn byanswà anà an'kab.»
Yɛsu kàmɛn nde naa nde kan'fuur a un'yɛnà, waa kàtɛn a nde naa: «Ngye kwel watɛy anà Imwol a Nzam.» Ungö apan, akà mbuur mwɛy kàfun'sà anki mfuul.
Apan, Yɛsu kàlɔɔŋà u ndwà a Nzam, waa kàtɛɛnà naa: «Ya ye aben naa alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn ban'kwo mutɛn naa Klistɔ wà mwan a David?
David ŋakwo kàtɛn u ngwal a Dwɛɛl In'kyɛɛl naa: "Mwol kàtɛn a mwol amɛ naa: Bwaay u kɔɔ amɛ là ibaal, tii mpal in'sàsà mɛ ayiiŋ angye u ngyɛl in'kɔl angye."
David ŋakwo kun'bel Mwol, apan nde mwan ande wà aben?» Un'sɛŋ a baar mbɔɔn kun'weemà unsà un'sak.
Unsà an'lɔɔŋ ande, nde kàtɛɛnà naa: «Làkäl kà igyɛɛŋ ntɔn alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn: ba bàfàkwen muyilyaaŋ anà mvwɛl, naa bapɛ mbɔr kà ikal a nköŋ,
bàfàsɔɔl an'kir amà kusà uboo a ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà anà ikal atàtwɛb kà in'kyɔm.
Ba bàfàduum indiir a akweel adim, taaŋ nsil alan ba bàfasà ngyamàkà a bwɛlàbwɛl. Nsaŋ aba isàkal yà kölàköl!»
Apan Yɛsu kàbwaay kusà a insak a an'kab, waa kàlerà naa baar bàkàsaa aben ngim uboo a kya. Aŋin'naaŋ bàmbɔɔn bàsye mbɔɔn.
Un'kweel a un'dim wàŋàlàmbwà waa kàyi, waa kàsi bitɛr a ngim ibyeel, byàsànten.
Yɛsu kàbel alɔŋki ande, waa kàtɛn a ba naa: «Ndandaa mɛ alàkyään, un'kweel a un'dim wàŋàlàmbwà wà kàn'sà yàŋàsöön baar banswà bàsaa uboo a insak.
Ntɔn baar banswà ban'pà ngim ikɔ̈ɔ̈n ndöŋ akà ba. Wɛɛ nde, nde kan'wal unsà làmbwà ande ntɔn mupà yinà yanswà kàkäl nde ayà ntɔn mɔ̈ɔ̈ ande.»
Umpal kàkäl Yɛsu mutoo u ndwà a Nzam, umwɛy uboo a alɔŋki ande kàtɛn a nde naa: «Un'lɔɔŋ, le! In'kul nà myàkölàköl, ndwà nà yàkölàköl!»
Yɛsu waa kàtɛn a nde naa: «Ngye akimanà ndwà a kölàköl yi! Akà nkɔŋ mwɛy ifàsàsal anki udu a nkɔŋ yumwɛy. Ya yanswà ikyer asàbwabà.»
Yɛsu kàkäl aŋàbwaay u mɔŋ a in'te a ɔlive, kusà a ndwà a Nzam. Petɔlà, Zyak, Ywan anà Andrɛ bun'fuulà ukɔl naa:
«Isam, mpal nà ndaa ayi isàyà, idiim nà isàswaŋ naa indiir abi byanswà ikyer asàkwo.»
Apan, Yɛsu kàsɛmà mutɛn a ba naa: «Làkäl kà igyɛɛŋ, mbuur twon amàlakur.
Ntɔn baar mbɔɔn bàsàyà kà ikɔb amɛ, waa bàsàtɛn naa: "Wà mɛ", waa ba bàsàkur baar mbɔɔn.
Mpal làsàwem bɛ làsaŋ a ità anà in'bää a ità, twon lan'man bɔɔmà: yubwaŋ naa bya itàyà, wɛɛ bya kà isàkal ntsüü anki.
Ntɔn un'sɛŋ mwɛy asànwaan a un'sɛŋ wumwɛy, imwol mwɛy a imwol kyumwɛy, kà ikal imwɛy imwɛy, mɛɛn ikyer asàtɛɛr, ngyal ikyer asàkal. Indiir abi byanswà byà nsɛmà a in'swaŋ.

Làkäl kà igyɛɛŋ. Bàkyer asàlayälà u mbay a nsaŋ anà u ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà, basàlakam iki, bɛ làsàkàsà in'lɔn kusà a amfum a itiir a mɛɛn anà kusà a amfum a nsi ntɔn mɛ: kya isàkal imbäl ntɔn ba.
Ntɔn Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ bàkyer atàkyään la akà in'sɛŋ myanswà.
Mpal bàsàlasyen ntɔn mukàlayälà, twon lan'kyɛɛr kusà naa bɛ nkye làyàkàtɛn, wɛɛ ya bàsàlapà utaaŋ alan, làtɛn ya. Ntɔn kà bɛ anki làsàtwey mun, wɛɛ Dweelà Inkyɛɛl.
Un'tɔŋ asàyälà un'tɔŋ ande ntɔn bun'dwä, taa asàyälà mwan ande, baan bàsàbɛy aböör aba, waa bàsatsüül ukwà.
Baar banswà bàkyer asàlayiiŋ ntɔn ikɔb amɛ. Wɛɛ mbuur asàkaŋ mpem tii u ntsüü, asàwà mɔ̈ɔ̈.
«Mpal làsàman bɛ lingyoomà aŋàdiir lan'bwaay kà ikal mpa lan'kwo la mukal, - wɛy mbuur akataŋà uyöb! Apan, wɛy baar bàsàkal u Yuday, bàtiin uboo a myɔŋ,
wɛy mbuur asàkal udu a mpaan a ndwà, ukɔɔn asàtɔlà ntɔn muwal undiir u ndwà ande,
wɛy mbuur asàkal u ywaŋ, ukɔɔn afurà ndwà ntɔn mukàwal ipfɛy ande.
Ngyɛb akà akaar bàsàkal anà an'yöm anà akakaar bàsànüü ilä abin!
Làyamà naa ndaa ayi ikɔ̈ɔ̈n asàyà u paŋà a làbe!
Ntɔn, ilä abin isàkal ilä a mpay aŋàdiir mpa aŋàtàman fà nsɛmà a mɛɛn kàkyer Nzam tii papanà, anà ya ifàsàkal anki akà ikikye.
Yàlàkal naa Mwol ukɔɔn atyey ilä abi, akà mbuur mwɛy mɔ̈ɔ̈ kàlàwà anki. Wɛɛ, ntɔn baar kàsɔ̈ɔ̈l nde, nde kàtyey ilà abi.
Abun, isàkal naa mbuur kan'tɛn a bɛ naa: "Le, Klistɔ awà kà!" Itàkal naa: "Le, awunà kunà!", twon làmukyey.
Ntɔn Aklistɔ a loor anà aŋangɔɔm a loor bàkyer asàtoo, waa bàsàkyer idiim anà impà ntɔn mukur, itàkal sye baar aŋàsɔɔl, kya mbwo isàkal.
Abun bɛ, bɛ làkäl kà igyɛɛŋ! Indiir abi byanswà mɛ kàkyàlaweey kusà.
«Wɛɛ kà ilä abin, ungö a mpay aŋàdiir ayin, taaŋ làsàbwà làpib, nsöŋ ufàsàpà anki kyɛɛy awa,
mbwaar isàfà du waa isàbwà, ngwal a du ikyer asàni.
Apan ba bàsàman Mwan a mbuur wàmuyà uboo a un'böŋ unsà ngwal mbɔɔn anà làkoo.
Apan nde asàtɔm akyeey anà asàböbà baar kàsɔ̈ɔ̈l nde kà an'twɛrà man'nà, fà nswɛŋ a mɛɛn tii u nswɛŋ a du.
«Làyöb lwɛŋ lan'fà uboo a nsim a un'te a fige: an'kɔkà màsàbulà bɔɔlàbɔɔl, nkay isàfulà, bɛ lan'yöb naa un'tye wà tsütsü.
Asànaa bɛ sye, mpal làsàman bɛ indiir abi byan'yà, làyöb naa Mwan a mbuur wà tsütsü u munàmbwo.
Ndandaa mɛ alàkyään: nkööl ayi isàlyaŋ anki kusà ndaa ayi yanswà mukwo.
Du anà mɛɛn màkyer asàlyaaŋ, wɛɛ ndaa amɛ isàlyaaŋ anki akà ikikye.
«Wɛɛ ilä kya itàkal taaŋ la, akà mbuur mwɛy uyöb anki bya, itàkal akyeey a du, itàkal Mwan, akà mbuur mwɛy, nà Taa mpɛl.
Làkäl kà igyɛɛŋ, làduub mii abɛ, ntɔn bɛ làyöb anki mpal nà ya isàkwo.
Ya isàkal asànaa mbuur mwɛy kan'kàlyaaŋ: nde an'sàwɛy ndwà ande, an'sàpà ikɔ̈b akà asyääl ande, mbuur mbuur anà isal ande, waa uswaŋ un'kyɛɛŋ a munàmbwo muduub mii.
Lalan, làduub mii, ntɔn bɛ làyöb anki mpal usàyà nkum a ndwà, làsisye lɛɛ u mpöŋàmpöŋ, u mbeel a nkɔ lɛɛ u tutu,
manà nde uyà kà imbürà, waa kàlaman bàŋàbɔ̈ɔ̈n.
Ndaa in'tɛɛnà mɛ yi a bɛ, mɛ in'tɛɛnà a baar banswà: Làduub mii!»
Byàsäl ilä ibyeel Pak anà un'kyɔm a mampà ikɔ̈ɔ̈n ful mukwo, amfum a angaŋ anà alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn bàleŋà impeenà mukɔr Yɛsu, waa bun'dwa.
Ntɔn ba bàtɛɛnà naa: «Kà uboo a un'kyɔm anki, manà lingyoomà layàbilà uboo a un'sɛŋ.»

Yɛsu kàkäl u Bɛtani u ndwà a Simɔn ŋabay, mpal kàkäl nde u mɛsà mudyà, un'kaar mwɛy kàyi anà làbuuŋ aŋàyɔl a may a usɔŋ a ndandaa màntal mbɔɔn. Nde kàduub la, waa kun'tsüül udu a un'tswe.
Baar bumwɛy bàkäl paa bàmɛn ube, waa bàtɛɛnà ba a ba naa: «Ntɔn nkye mubi may a usɔŋ amà abà?
Yàlàbwaŋ naa bàyälà ma màŋàsɔ̈ɔ̈nà nkam tär yà itɛr a ngim, waa bàlàpà aŋàlàmbwà!» Ba bàpɛlà un'kaar awà.
Wɛɛ Yɛsu kàtɛn naa: «Lun'si a duu. Ntɔn nkye lun'paa bɛ mpay? Nde kan'kyer undiir aŋàbwaŋ akà mɛ.
Ntɔn aŋàlàmbwà bɛ làbà anà ba taaŋ lanswà, bɛ lan'kwo mukakyer ubwaŋ mpal làkwen bɛ, wɛɛ mɛ, mɛ anà bɛ watɛy taaŋ lanswà.
Undiir kàkwen nde mukyer, nde kan'kyer wa: kusà nde kan'tsuul ndür amɛ may a usɔŋ ntɔn ndyee aya.
Ndandaa mɛ alàkyään, ntsü yanswà bàsàpay Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ, u mɛɛn manswà, bàsataa ndaa kan'kyer un'kaar wà ntɔn muyɔbà mɔ̈ɔ̈ ande.»
Yudas Iskaryɔt, umwɛy uboo a alɔŋki Kwem Aŋiyweel, kàkyen akà amfum a angaŋ ntɔn mukàyàlà Yɛsu.
Ba bàkäl kà un'sak ntɔn làsaŋ alan. Ba bàdirà mukun'pà ngim. Apan nde kàleŋà ipöl aŋàbwaŋ mukun'yälà.
Ilä atàtwɛb kyà mampà ikɔ̈ɔ̈n ful, ilä bàfàdwa in'tö a in'kɔk ntɔn isaa a Pak, alɔŋki a Yɛsu ban'tɛn a nde naa: «Ikal nà ngye akwen bi ikàyilà ntɔn ngye akàdyà Pak?»
Apan Yɛsu kàtöm alɔŋki ande bɔ̈ɔ̈l, waa kàtɛn a ba naa: «Làkyen u bul a kölàköl, bɛ làkàman baal mwɛy we anà làbuuŋ a an'dà ayàmɛɛn anà bɛ, lun'läb.
Ikal kyanswà ukàbilà nde, làtɛn akà ŋàndwà naa: "Un'lɔɔŋ kan'tɛn naa: Làken suk in'dyà mɛ Pak anà alɔŋki amɛ?"
Nde akàlaswaŋ suk a du làkölàköl làŋakwo anà indiir byanswà. Ngiil ntɔn bi, bɛ làkàkyer kwo.»
Alɔŋki bàkyen ba, bàtɔ̈l ba u bul a kölàköl, ba bàmɛn asànaa kàtɛn nde a ba, waa bàyöŋà Pak.
Mpal làbü sisye, Yɛsu kàyi anà Bàkwem Aŋiyweel.
Umpal bàkäl ba u mɛsà bàmudyà, nde kàtɛn naa: «Ndandaa mɛ alàkyään, umwɛy uboo a bɛ awàmudyà anà mɛ, akyer ayan'yälà.»
Alɔŋki bàmɛn ngyɛb mbɔɔn, waa bàsɛmà mukun'fuul umwɛy umwɛy: «Nkye an'kwo ikäl mɛ?»
Nde kàtɛn a ba naa: «Umwɛy uboo a Bàkwem Aŋiyweel, kan'dümà kɔɔ ande mbwo mwɛy anà mɛ uboo làlɔŋà.
Ntɔn Mwan a mbuur akyer akyà asànaa bàsön ya ntɔn nde, wɛɛ ngyɛb akà mbuur ban'yälà Mwan a mbuur u mbwo a nde! Yàlàkal ubwaŋ mbɔɔn akà nde naa bàkɔɔn un'bɔr!»
Utaaŋ adyà, Yɛsu kàwɛl mampà, ungö musaak ma, nde kàtsül ma, waa kapɛ, waa kàtɛn naa: «Làwɛl, ayi yà ndür amɛ.»
Waa kàwɛl kɔɔb, ungö mufuur an'tɔɔn, nde kapɛ la, waa ba banswà bànü unsà la.
Yɛsu kàtɛn a ba naa: «Amà an'kil amɛ, an'kil a nkwà màtyaŋà ntɔn bàmbɔɔn.
Ndandaa mɛ alàkyään: mɛ in'fàsànwà anki akà ikikye vin tii ilä in'sànwà mɛ vin akün kà imwol a Nzam.»
Ungö mutɔɔl an'diim, ba bàtoo ntɔn mukyà mɔŋ a in'te a Ɔlive.
Yɛsu kàtɛn a ba naa: «Bɛ, bɛ banswà làkyer asan'kɔɔb, ntɔn bàsön naa: "Mɛ in'sàdwa un'kyɛɛŋ, waa in'kɔk isàtà upay."
Wɛɛ mɛ, ungö a ngwiiyà, mɛ in'sàfweel kusà a bɛ u Ngalilɛ.»
Petɔlà kàtɛn a nde naa: «Itàkal naa baar banswà bàmakɔɔb, wɛɛ mɛ, mɛ in'sakɔɔb anki.»
Yɛsu waa utɛn a nde naa: «Ndandaa mɛ akyään: ŋàbawà, mpib nsil ayi, kusà nkɔɔ mubel mbalà yweel, ngye, ngye ayan'tɔn mbalà tär.»
Wɛɛ nde, nde kàfàfuur a ngwal: «Mɛ, itàkal naa mɛ in'kyer akwà anà ngye, aay, mɛ ngye in'satɔn tɛy.» Ba banswà bàkäl mun mwɛy wa.
Apan ba bàyàkɔlà kà ikal mwɛy bàfàbel naa Ngɛtɛsɛmani, Yɛsu waa kàtɛn a alɔŋki ande naa: «Sàlàbwaay pà, umpal in'kàyamà mɛ.»
Ungö nde kàsyen Petɔlà, Yakɔb anà Ywan. Apan nde kàsɛmà muwem matɛɛr anà ngyɛb mbɔɔn.
Nde kàtɛn a ba naa: «Mɔ̈ɔ̈ amɛ wàŋàyɔl a ngyɛb yan'kwo mudwa. Sàlasäl pà, làkyɛŋ.»
Nde kàkyen u kikwɛl, waa kàbü an'köm, kàyamà naa kya mbwo isàkal, taaŋ alà làlyaaŋ ukwɛl apà nde.
Nde kàtɛɛnà naa: «Taa, indiir byanswà akà ngye ikyer afàkwo, lwom kɔɔb a mpay aŋàkir là apà mɛ. Itàkal abwɛy, kà ndaa in'kwen mɛ anki, wɛɛ ayan'kwen ngye.»
Ungö apan nde kan'yà, kan'man ba bàŋàbɔ̈ɔ̈n, waa kan'tɛn a Petɔlà: «Simɔn, ngye an'bɔ̈ɔ̈n? Nkye ngye asàkal anki anà ngwal mukyɛŋ itàkal akà taaŋ làmwɛy?
Làkyɛŋ, làyamà, ntɔn bɛ làkɔ̈ɔ̈n abwà u ndɛb. Dweelà làŋàyɔl a ngwal, wɛɛ ndür ye anà gyɔ̈ɔ̈là.»
Nde kàfàkyà u kikwɛl, waa kàyamà wàmufuur ndaa nsil ya.
Apan, nde kàyi mbalà asin, waa kàfaman bàmubɔ̈ɔ̈n, ntɔn mii aba myàkäl myàŋàbwà buur. Ba waa mpa bàyöb naa bun'fuur aben.
U mbalà yàtär kan'yà nde, nde kan'tɛn a ba naa: «Làläb mubɔ̈ɔ̈n, làyöör. Yan'wà! Taaŋ lan'kwo: le, Mwan a mbuur bàmuyälà kà an'kɔɔ a baar abe.
Làmbarà, tsweenà! Làler, mbuur kàman'yälà wà tsütsü.»
Umpal kàkäl nde muyäämà, Yudasi, umwɛy uboo a Bàkwem Aŋiyweel, kàyàkɔlà anà iköŋ a baar mbɔɔn bàtöm andweer a angaŋ anà andweer a un'sɛŋ. Ba bàkäl anà an'kɔm anà nköl.
Mbuur kun'yälà, kapɛ idiim ki: «Mbuur wanswà in'kàböbà mɛ, mbuur wa nde awun. Lun'kör, lun'syen unsà ikyɛɛŋ.»
Pa kàyàkɔlà nde, nde kàsin apà Yɛsu, waa kàtɛn a nde naa: «Un'lɔɔŋ!» Waa kun'böbà.
Apan bumwɛy bun'tɛ mpi, waa bun'kör.
Umwɛy uboo a baar bàkäl paa, kàtwey kɔm, waa kàkäm un'syääl a Mfum a angaŋ, waa kun'tsül tsü.
Yɛsu kàtɛn a ba naa: «Nkye mɛ in'wà un'dwää baar waa bɛ làyi anà an'kɔm anà nköl ntɔn mukan'kɔr?
Mɛ kàkäl anà bɛ u ndwà a Nzam ilä byanswà mulɔŋ, bɛ làsan'kɔr anki. Wɛɛ ayi yan'yà ntɔn Ndaa Aŋàsɔn ikwe.»
Apan ba banswà bàsun'wɛy, waa bàtiin.
Mwan baal mwɛy wàŋàbwaar làpye làmwɛy mpɛl waa kàyun'labà. Waa bun'kör,
wɛɛ nde kàsàpiy làpye alan, waa kàtiin wànsàpɔl.
Ba bàsyen Yɛsu akà mfum a angaŋ, ikal bàköŋ amfum a angaŋ bànswà, andweer anà alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn.
Petɔlà kàyilabà Yɛsu ukwel tii uboo a làpaŋ, u làbay a ndwà a mfum a angaŋ. Nde kàbwaay anà aŋità muywar mbaa.
Kyekà andweer a angaŋ anà Làbay a nsaŋ a kölàköl bàkäl muleŋ imbäl a loor ntɔn Yɛsu ntɔn bun'dwä, wɛɛ ba kya bàmɛnà anki.
Ntɔn bàmbɔɔn bàtɛɛ imbäl a loor ntɔn nde, wɛɛ bya byàkyeena anki balàbal.
Baar amwɛy waa bàyàmbarà, waa bàyataa loor ntɔn nde naa:
«Bi kàwem nde wàmutɛn naa: "Mɛ in'yàbwaab ndwà a Nzam bàtöŋ yi kàn'kɔɔ a baar, wɛɛ ungö a ilä itär mɛ in'yàtɔŋ yàsin mpa bàkyer kan'kɔɔ a baar."»
Wɛɛ, itàkal abà, imbäl aba kyàkwe anki balàbal.
Apan Mfum a angaŋ kàmbarà nde uboo a nköŋ, nde kàfuul Yɛsu naa: «Nkye ngye afuur anki akà undiir mwɛy unsà imbäl bàtaa baar bà ntɔn ngye?»
Wɛɛ Yɛsu kàkäl akul, waa mpa kàfuur akà ikikye. Mfum a angaŋ kun'fuul mbalà asin: «Nkye ngye awà Klistɔ, Mwan a Nzam aŋàsaak?»
Yɛsu waa kàfuur naa: «Mɛ in'wà nde, bɛ làsàman Mwan a mbuur waŋàbwaay u kɔɔ ibaal a Ŋangwal, wàmuyà uboo in'böŋ a du.»
Apan, Mfum a angaŋ kàkaam ipfɛy ande, waa kàtɛn naa: «Bi ambäl nkye ifàkyer abà!
Bɛ lan'wem mbɛɛy. Bɛ lan'tɛn aben?» Ba banswà bun'tsüül mbar a ukwà.
Bamwɛy uboo a ba bun'tsüülà an'te, bun'fwee ntabwey, bun'kämà iki, waa bàtɛɛnà a nde naa: «Tà ngɔɔm!» Aseey waa bun'yab a mbar.
Petɔlà kàkäl u ngyɛl uboo a làpaŋ umpal kàyi un'syääl mwɛy wun'kaar wà mfum a angaŋ,
nde kàmɛn Petɔlà wàmuywar mbaa, nde kun'syebà, waa kàtɛn a nde naa: «Ngye sye, ngye kàkäl anà Yɛsu un'nsi Nasàlɛr.»
Wɛɛ nde kàkyer atɔn, waa kàtɛn naa: «Mɛ in'yöb anki. Mɛ in'yöb anki naa ngye nkye akwen mutɛn.» Ungö, waa kàtoo u nsà mukyà ikal bàfabilà. [Apan nkɔɔ waa kàbel.]
Un'syääl wun'kaar kun'mɛn nde, waa kàfàtɛn a baar bàkäl paa naa: «Mbuur wà, wà umwɛy uboo a ba!»
Wɛɛ nde waa kàfàtɔn. Ungö apan, baar bàkäl paa bàfàtɛn a Petɔlà naa: «Ndandaa, ngye awà umwɛy uboo a ba, ntɔn ngye, ngye awà un'nsi Ngalilɛ.»
Wɛɛ nde kàsɛmà mudyà kyän anà musà in'küül: «Mɛ un'yöb anki mbuur lan'saamà bɛ.»

Utaaŋ nsil alan, nkɔɔ mwɛy waa kàbel u mbalà yàyweel, apan Petɔlà kàyɔbà ndaa kun'kyään Yɛsu: «Kusà nkɔɔ mutàbel mbalà yweel, ngye ayan'tɔn mbalà tär.» Apan, nde kàtoo u ntiin, waa kàlel.
U tutu tutu, amfum a angaŋ bàköŋ anà andweer, anà alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn anà Làbay a nsaŋ làkölàköl lanswà. Ba bàbäm Yɛsu in'siŋ, bun'syen anà bun'pɛ akà Pilatu.
Pilatu waa kun'fuul naa: «Nkye ngye awà mfum a Ayudà?» Yɛsu waa kun'fuur naa: «Ngye ŋàkwo an'tɛn.»
Amfum a angaŋ bun'füünà indiir mbɔɔn.
Pilatu kàfun'fuulà naa: «Nkye ngye ndaa afuur anki akà ikikye? Ngye akiweemà indiir mbɔɔn bàfüünà ba ngye!»
Wɛɛ Yɛsu kàsàfuur anki akà ndaa mwɛy, abun Pilatu waa kàbem.
Kà un'kyɔm wanswà, Pilatu kàkäl anà nkääl mutsuuŋ mbuur a bɔlokà mwɛy, mbuur kàlɔ̈ɔ̈mà un'sɛŋ.
Kyekà mbuur mwɛy ikɔb ande Barabas kàkäl u bɔlokà anà aŋàlingyoomà abà bàdwä mbuur umpal làbü lingyoomà.
Un'sɛŋ a baar kàbeenà, waa kàsɛmà mukun'lɔ̈ɔ̈m naa nde kapɛ asànaa nkääl ande.
Pilatu kàfuul naa: «Nkye bɛ làkyàkwen mɛ alàwɛɛy mfum a Ayudà?»
Ntɔn nde kàkyer ayöb naa ba Yɛsu bun'yälà ntɔn un'köl aba.
Wɛɛ amfum a angaŋ bàsiinà un'sɛŋ ntɔn Pilatu katsuuŋ awà Barabas.
Pilatu kàfàtɛn a ba naa: «Abun bɛ làkwen naa mɛ nkye in'kyer anà mbuur làfàbel bɛ mfum a Ayudà?»
Ba bàfàsà in'kwɛŋ: «Un'bɛɛrà u kulunsi!»
Pilatu kàtɛɛnà a ba naa: «Ube nà nde kàkyer bà?» Wɛɛ ba bàsöönà musà in'kwɛŋ: «Un'bɛɛrà u kulunsi!»
Pilatu kàkwen mupà un'sɛŋ un'sak, waa katsuuŋ Barabas. Apan nde kàswɛŋ naa bàkäm Yɛsu an'füm, waa kun'yälà ntɔn bun'bɛɛrà u kulunsi.
Aŋità bàsyen Yɛsu uboo a làpaŋ a kuvɛrnɔ̈ɔ̈r u pɛlàtwal, waa bàbel làböl lanswà.
Ba bun'bwää kàzak a tsöö, waa bun'tɔ̈ɔ̈l mpà a nsyeenà bàtöŋ ba kun'tswe.
Ba bàsɛmà mukun'pà mbɔr naa: «Mbɔr, mfum a Ayudà!»
Ba bun'kämà un'bii kun'tswe, bun'tsüülà an'te, anà bàbwee an'köm kusà ande ntɔn mukömà.
Ungö amukun'sɛɛ, ba bun'lwom kàzak a tsöö, waa bun'fuur ipfɛy ande. Apan ba bun'twey u nsà a bul ntɔn bàkun'bɛɛrà u kulunsi.
Mbuur mwɛy, ikɔb ande Simɔn, un'nsi Sirɛn, taar a Alɛksandre anà Rufus, kàfü ndwaŋ, anà kàkäl mulyaaŋ. Aŋità bun'siinà a ngwal musyen kulunsi.
Ba bàsyen Yɛsu kà ikäl mwɛy ikɔb a kya Ngɔlàngɔta, ikaswaŋà naa: «Ikal a köl a un'tswe.»
Ba bun'pɛɛ vin aŋàtüüb a dyam, wɛɛ Yɛsu kàtön munwà la.
Ungö bun'bɛɛrà ba u kulunsi, ba bàkäbà ipfɛy ande, waa bàtɛɛ löb ntɔn muyöb naa mbuur mbuur ininà uwal.
Ba bun'bɛɛrà u kulunsi u taaŋ làwà làtutu.
Isin a ndaa bàsön muswaŋ ntsüül a ukwà ande yàkäl abà: «Mfum a Ayudà.»
Ba bàbɛɛrà sye baar abe abɔ̈ɔ̈l u bikulunsi ukɔl a Yɛsu, mwɛy u kɔɔ ande là ibaal, umwɛy u kɔɔ ande là ikaar. [
Apan itiir a Ndaa Aŋàsɔn yi laa kyàkwe kya: «Nde bun'täŋ unsà ulwaŋ a baar abe.»]
Baar bàlyaaŋà u mbwo bun'töö, bànii in'tswe, waa bàtɛɛnà naa: «Imbye itàkal ngye atàman! Ngye awee naa abwiy ndwà a Nzam, waa afàtɔŋ ya kà ilä itär,
tswà mɔ̈ɔ̈ angye, ngye ŋankwo, tɔlà u kulunsi!»
Amfum a angaŋ anà alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn bàsɛɛ, ba a ba, waa bàtɛɛnà naa: «Nde kàtsü baar asin mɔ̈ɔ̈, wɛɛ nde ukwe anki mutswà mɔ̈ɔ̈ nde ŋakwo!
Wɛy Klistɔ, mfum a Isàlɛl utɔlà apanà u kulunsi, waa bi iman, waa bi isà làkwikilà!» Baar bàbɛɛrà u kulunsi mbwo mwɛy anà nde, bun'töö sye.
U midi làpib làkyer abwà u mɛɛn manswà tii u taaŋ làtär ungö a midi.
Apan, u taaŋ làtär, Yɛsu kàsi un'kwɛŋ a ngwal: «Ɛlɔyi, Ɛlɔyi, lɛma sabaktani?» Ikaswaŋà naa: «Nzam a mɛ, Nzam a mɛ, ntɔn nkye aman'wɛy ngye?» -
Bamwɛy uboo a baar bàkäl paa bun'weemà ba, waa bàtɛɛnà naa: «Làwem, nde kan'bel Ɛli!»

Mbuur mwɛy kàkaamà ntiin, kànwɛmà ikaam a ipfɛy unsà vin a nkyään, nde kàbäm kya u nswɛŋ a un'bii, waa kàsilà kya akà Yɛsu ntɔn nde unü, wàmutɛn naa: «Làdil, bi iler naa nkye Ɛli akyun'tɔɔl u kulunsi!»
Wɛɛ Yɛsu kàsi un'kwɛŋ a ngwal, waa un'swey kàtoo.
Rido a idwà làkaamà itiir byeel fà du tii u ngyɛl.
Kaptɛn kàkäl paa kusà a nde, mpal kàmɛn nde naa nde kàkü aben, waa kàtɛn naa: «Ndandaa mbuur wà kàkäl Mwan a Nzam!»
Bàkäl anà akaar amwɛy sye bàleerà ukwɛl. Uboo a ba, bàkäl Màlye un'nsi Magàdala, Màlye ngwän a Zyak Un'kye, anà Yɔsɛ, anà Salɔmɛ.
Ba bàkäl akaar bàyun'labà anà bàyun'syäälà mpal kàkäl nde u Ngalilɛ, anà akaar asin mbɔɔn bàbeenà Yɛlusàlɛm anà nde.
Sisye làkäl aŋàbwà, kya kyàkal ilä ayöŋà, iswaŋà naa ilä kyàfweel saba,
un'byääl mwɛy wà làbay a nsaŋ, Yɔsɛfi un'nsi Alimatɛ, kàyàkɔlà paa. Nde sye kàfadilà Imwol a Nzam. Nde kàwɛl ibaal mukyà akà Pilatu ntɔn mulɔm ndom a Yɛsu.
Pilatu kàbem muwem naa nde abwà akwà. Nde kàbel kaptɛn, waa kun'fuul naa nkye nde kàkü itaan.
Ungö kàyöb nde u mbwo a kaptɛn, nde kàpɛ mbwo akà Yɔsefi muwal ndom.
Ungö musom làpye a pɛɛl, nde kàtɔɔl ndom u kulunsi, kàläl ya uboo a làpye, kàsi ya kà an'dii bàfuun uboo a nkɔŋ, waa kàbuum nkɔŋ a kölàköl ntɔn mudübà an'dii.
Màlye un'nsi Magàdalà anà Màlye ngwän a Yɔsɛ bàleerà ikal basi ndom.
Ungö ilä a saba, Màlye un'nsi Magàdalà, anà Sàlomɛ anà Màlye ngwän a Zyak, bàsöm may a usɔŋ ntɔn mumwaŋ u ndür a Yɛsu.
Ilä atàtwɛb kyà mpɔsà, ba bàkyen an'dii u tutu, mpal làsɛnà taaŋ.
Ba bàtɛɛnà ba a ba naa: «Nà akà ibuum nkɔŋ yinà u mun a an'dii?»
Wɛɛ umpal bàler ba, ba bàmɛn naa nkɔŋ yàkäl aŋàbuum ukɔl.
Ba bàbilà uboo a an'dii, bàmɛn un'tö mwɛy wàŋàbwaay u kɔɔ ibaal, akyàbwaar mvwɛl a pɛɛl. Matɛɛr waa mawɛl.
Wɛɛ nde kàtɛn a ba naa: «Twon lan'man bɔɔmà, bɛ làwàmuleŋ Yɛsu un'nsi Nasàlɛr awà bàbɛɛrà u kulunsi. Nde akyàwiyà, nde ufàkal anki apà. Làler ikal bun'tɔ̈ɔ̈l.
Wɛɛ làkyen kàlakyään alɔŋki ande, anà Petɔlà sye, naa: "Nde amàkaladil u Ngalilɛ. Bɛ làyàkun'man kwo, asànaa kàlakyään nde."»
Apan, ba bàtoo, waa bàtiin ukwɛl a an'dii, ntɔn matɛɛr anà lingyoomà màkyer awal. Ba bàkyään anki itàkal undiir mwɛy akà mbuur umwɛy, ntɔn ba bàkäl u bɔɔmà.

(note: The most reliable and earliest manuscripts do not include Mark 16:9-20.) Ungö a ngwiiyà ande kà ilä atàtwɛb kyà mpɔsà u tutu, Yɛsu kàtwab akàmɛnà akà Màlye un'nsi Magàdalà awà kàböŋ nde an'dwelà an'be, an'dweelà nsambwaar.
Nde kàkàkyään ndaa ayi akà baar bàkälà anà nde. Ba bàkälà u ngyɛb anà mulelà.
Wɛɛ mpal bàwem ba nde wàmutɛɛnà naa: «Yɛsu wà anà mɔ̈ɔ̈, mɛ in'kyun'man!», ba bun'si anki làkwikilà.
Ungö apan, Yɛsu kàkàmɛnà ifà asin akalɔŋki abɔ̈ɔ̈l bàkäl u mbwo mukyà ndwaŋ.
Ba bàyàfurà, waa bàkyään ya akà bumwɛy. Wɛɛ ba, ba sye basi anki làkwikilà.
Ungö apan, Yɛsu kàkàmɛnà akà Bàkwem Aŋimwɛy umpal bàkäl ba mudyà, waa kapɛl ntɔn bàkɔ̈ɔ̈n ba làkwikilà anà ntɔn bwoor a mpem aba bàtön ba mukyey baar bun'mɛn wàŋàwiyà.
Nde waa kàtɛn a ba naa: «Làkyen u mɛɛn manswà mukyään Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ akà nkyeer yanswà.
Mbuur asàsà làkwikilà anà asàwal ndüümà, nde asàwà mɔ̈ɔ̈, wɛɛ mbuur mpa asàsà làkwikilà, nde bàsun'tsüül mbar.
Làler idiim isaswaŋà naa baar bà bàkyàsà làkwikilà: Kà ikɔb amɛ ba bàsàböŋ insɔŋà, ba bàsàtɛn ndaa a kün,
ba bàsàtà ntäy mpi kà an'kɔɔ, bàsànwà ipöm, wɛɛ kyà ube isakyer anki, ba bàsàsà abɛy an'kɔɔ, waa ba bàsàkɔɔrà.»
Abun, ungö muyäm anà ba, Mwol Yɛsu bun'syen du, waa kàbwaay u kɔɔ a Nzam là ibaal.
Wɛɛ akà ba, ba bàkyen mukàkyään Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ u mɛɛn manswà. Mwol kàsälà anà ba, waa kàtää imbäl u mbwo a idiim a impà kàkyerà nde muswaŋ naa an'lɔɔŋ aba mà ndandaa.
LUKÀ
Un'sam Tyɔfil. Baar mbɔɔn bàbön musɔn ndaa yàlyaaŋ uboo a bi.
Ba ya bàsön asànaa bàkyään baar bàmɛn ya u mii fà nsɛmà anà bàbulà asyääl a ndaa a Nzam.
Lalan mɛ sye kàläb mɛ ndaa ayi pànsi pànsi fà nsɛmà aya. Un'byääl Tyɔfil, yubwaŋ naa mɛ asöön ndaa ayi.
In'kyer mɛ abà ntɔn ngye ayöb naa an'lɔɔŋ kàwɛl ngye mà ndandaa.
Mpal kàkäl Ɛlɔdi mfum a Yuday, kàkäl anà ngaŋ mwɛy wà itsuŋ a angaŋ a Abya ikɔb ande Zakàlye. Un'kyay ande, mbuur a mbil a Alɔn, ikɔb ande Làsàbɛr.
Ba bàbɔ̈ɔ̈l bàkäl baar a balàbal u mii a Nzam. Ba bàfalabà ubwaŋàbwaŋ in'kɔɔn myanswà anà nswɛɛŋ yanswà yà Mwol.
Wɛɛ ba bàkäl anki anà baan ntɔn Làsàbɛr kàbör anki, ba bàbɔ̈ɔ̈l bàkäl aŋànün.
Ilä mwɛy, Zakàlye kàkäl musal ingaŋ ande kusa a Nzam, ntɔn la làkäl taaŋ a itsuŋ aba musal.
Mulab nsyääl a angaŋ, löb làbü akà nde ntɔn mubilà uboo a idwà a Mwol ntɔn musà tswà mbaa kwo.
Umpal musà tswà mbaa, un'sɛŋ a baar wanswà kàkäl u nsà muyamà.
Kà imbürà, un'kyeey a Mwol mwɛy kàyàmɛnà akà Zakàlye: nde kàmbär u kɔɔ a ibaal a mɛsà a tswà.
Mpal kàmɛn Zakàlye un'kyeey awà, lileŋ làkyer un'wal, bɔɔmà làkyer un'kaar.
Wɛɛ un'kyeey kàtɛn a nde naa: «Zakàlye, twon an'man bɔɔmà, ntɔn Nzam akyàwem ngyamàkà angye: un'kyay angye Làsàbɛr ayaböör mwan baal. Ngye ayun'pà ikɔb a Ywan.
Nde asàkal ntwà a un'sak mbɔɔn ntɔn ngye. Baar mbɔɔn sye bàsàman un'sak ntɔn mböör ande.
Ntɔn nde asàkal mbuur a kölàköl u mii a Mwol. Nde usanwaa anki vin, itàkal man manswà bàfàyɔr. Nde asàkal aŋàyɔl a Dweelà In'kyɛɛl sɛmà dum a ngwän.
Nde asàfuur baan a Isàlɛl mbɔɔn akà Mwol awà Nzam aba.

Nde isal ande asàkyer u dweelà anà u ngwal asànaa ŋangɔɔm Ɛlya, ntɔn mutüüb bàtaa anà baan aba, mufuur baar a un'tswe ngwal muyweer asànaa baar a balàbal. Nde asàboom un'sɛŋ aŋàlɔ̈ɔ̈n ntɔn Mwol.»
Zakàlye kàtɛn a un'kyeey naa: «Mɛ ya in'yàyöb aben? Ntɔn mɛ in'wà un'nün anà umpal ayi un'kyay amɛ sye wàŋànün.»
Un'kyeey kun'fuur naa: «Mɛ, mɛ in'wà Ngàbàlye. Mɛ in'fàkal tsütsü apà Nzam, nde kan'töm muyäm anà ngye anà mukakyään ndaa aŋàbwaŋ ayi.
Le, ngye ayàbulà nkiin, ngye ayàkwo anki musà ndaa tii mpal isàkwo ndaa ayi, ntɔn ngye ndaa amɛ akyey anki. Ndaa ayi isàmɛnà umpal ya paa.»
Umpal ayin, baar banswà bàkäl mudilà Zakàlye u nsà, bàmukabemà naa nde kan'kàkyer itaan uboo a idwà.
Wɛɛ mpal kàyàtoo nde, nde kàkwe anki muyäm anà ba, apan ba waa bàyöb naa nde kan'man impà kà idwà. Muyäm a ba, nde kàyaswaŋà mpin, mun kàkälà wàŋàdübà.
Umpal kàmay nde ilä a isal ande u ndwà a Nzam, nde kàfurà ndwà ande.
Ungö a ilä, un'kyay ande Làsàbɛr kàkäl yöm. Apan nde kàkàyee ngɔn tyeen. Nde kàtɛɛnà naa:
«Abà ubwaŋ a Mwol kan'kyer nde akà mɛ: ŋàbawà nde kan'tɔɔm ileer ande udu a mɛ ntɔn mulwom nswɛn amɛ u mii a baar banswà.»
U ngɔn wàsyaam, Nzam kàtöm un'kyeey Ngàbàlye u bul mwɛy là Ngalilɛ ikɔb a la Nasàlɛr,
akà mwan un'kaar unkɔr awà kàtɛ Yɔsefi mbuur a mbil a David ntüüm, ikɔb ande Màlye.
Un'kyeey kàbilà u ndwà ande waa kàtɛn naa: «Mbɔr angye, Mwol kan'swaŋ ubwaŋ ande mbɔɔn akà ngye, nde wà anà ngye.»
Màlye kàmɛn ndaa yubem, waa kàyayweerà naa mbɔr ayi ikaswaŋà aben.
Apan, Un'kyeey kàtɛn a nde naa: «Màlye, twon an'man bɔɔmà, ntɔn Nzam kàmaswaŋ ukwen ande banswà.
Le, ngye ayàkal yöm, ngye ayàbɔr mwan baal, ngye ayun'pà ikɔb a Yɛsu.
Nde asàkal mbuur a kölàköl, bàsun'beelà Mwan a Nzam a Dudu. Mwol Nzam asun'sà u kir a imfum a nkaa ande David.
Nde asàyaal ipepey u ndwà a Yakɔb, imwol ande sye isàtsü anki.»
Màlye waa kàtɛn a un'kyeey naa: «Ya abwɛy iyàkal aben ntɔn mɛ ŋàtàkal anki anà baal?»
Un'kyeey kun'fuur naa: «Dweelà In'kyɛɛl ayàkal udu angye, ngwal a Nzam a Dudu ikyer ayafwee asànaa kilàpib. Lalan mwan in'kyɛɛl ayàbɔr ngye bàsun'beelà Mwan a Nzam.
Le, un'tɔŋ angye Làsàbɛr sye we anà yöm a mwan baal unsà inün ande. Bàfatɛɛnà naa nde wà ikɔb, wɛɛ ŋàbawà yöm ande là u ngɔn wàsyaam.
Ntɔn undiir kan'kwo mukɔ̈ɔ̈n Nzam watɛy.»
Apan Màlye kàfuur naa: «Mɛ in'wà un'tsüüŋ a Mwol. Wɛy ndaa yanswà an'tɛn ngye ikäl abwɛy.» Un'kyeey waa kàsun'wɛy.
Ungö apan, Màlye kàkyen agyägyä u bul mwɛy udu a mɔŋ u mɛɛn a Yuday.
Nde kàbilà u ndwà a Zakàlye, waa kàpɛ Làsàbɛr mbɔr.
Kyekà, umpal kàwem Làsàbɛr mbɔr a Màlye, mwan kànini uboo a an'bäl ande. Làsàbɛr kàyöl a Dweelà In'kyɛɛl,
waa kàsi in'kwɛŋ: «Nzam kàkyapà làpɛɛm aŋàsöönà akaar banswà, mwan ayàbɔr ngye we anà làpɛɛm a Nzam.
Làkoo alà lan'fà ken naa ngwän a Mwol amɛ uyi akà mɛ?
Ler, umpal kan'wem mɛ mbɔr angye, mwan awà kan'bäl amɛ kan'nini ntɔn un'sak mbɔɔn.
Ngye awà un'kaar aŋun'sak, ngye kàsi làkyän naa Mwol ayàkyer ndaa kakyään nde.»
Waa Màlye kàtɛn naa: «U mɔ̈ɔ̈ amɛ wanswà mɛ in'kwen usyäŋà Mwol,
mpem amɛ yan'yɔl a un'sak ntɔn Nzam, Un'tswää a mɔ̈ɔ̈ amɛ,
ntɔn nde kàtɔɔm ileer ande udu a làbɔ̈ɔ̈n a un'tsüüŋ ande. Lalan, sɛmà apanà ngyääl yanswà isatɛɛnà a mɛ naa un'kaar aŋun'sak,
ntɔn Ŋangwal kàkyer indiir a kölàköl ntɔn mɛ. Ikɔb ande kyà in'kyɛɛl,
U mbul a intye nde wàŋàyɔl a ngyɛb ntɔn baar bàfun'kyɛɛl.
Nde kàswɛŋ ikɔ̈b ande musyääl ngwal a kɔɔ ande: nde kàpay baar aŋàyɔl a uyɔl u mpem aba,
nde kàtyeey amfum kà an'kir aba mà imfum anà kàsɛɛn baar a làbɔ̈ɔ̈n.
Nde kàyööl aŋangyal a indiir mbɔɔn, wɛɛ nde aŋin'naaŋ kafuur an'kɔɔ a ipɔl.
Nde kàbay un'tsüüŋ ande Isàlɛl: nde kàyɔbà ngyɛb ande asànaa kàswɛŋ nde bànkaa abi,
akà Abàlam anà ikyee ande kyà mbul a in'tye.»
Màlye kàkäl isii a ngɔɔn tär akà Làsàbɛr, apan waa kàfurà ndwà ande.
Taaŋ a Làsàbɛr mubɔr làkwe la, nde kàbör mwan baal.
Baar a tsütsü anà baar a mbil ande bàwem ba naa Mwol kan'swaŋ ngyɛb ande mbɔɔn akà nde, ba bàsäŋà anà nde.
Ilä kyànaan ungö a mböör ande, ba bàyi mutsul mwan. Ba bàkweenà mukun'pà ikɔb a taarànde Zakàlye.
Wɛɛ ngwän kàtɛn naa: «Aay, bàyun'beelà Ywan!»
Ba bàtɛn a nde naa: «Aa, u ndwà abɛ mbuur awe anà ikɔb akyɛy watɛy!»
Abun, ba waa bàfuul taarànde muswaŋà mpin ntɔn muyöb naa ikɔb nà nde ukwen mupà mwan ande.
Zakàlye kàlɔ̈m kilàbää, waa kàsɔ̈n abà: «Ndandaa ikɔb ande Ywan.» Baar banswà bàkyer abem.
Apan sye, ndaa a Zakàlye waa yàsabà, waa kàsɛmà musà Nzam làkoo.
Abun, baar a tsütsü bàmɛn bɔɔmà. Ndaa ayi baar bàsaamà ya u myɔŋ a Yuday myanswà.
Baar banswà bàweemà ya bàkäl muyweerà anà mutɛn naa: «Kimwan aki ayàkal aben?» Ndandaa kɔɔ a Mwol làkäl anà nde.
Taarànde Zakàlye kàkäl aŋàyɔl a Dweelà In'kyɛɛl, waa kàbulà mutà ngɔɔm anà mutɛn naa:
«Wɛy Mwol uwɛl nsaak, Nzam a un'sɛŋ a Isàlɛl, ntɔn nde kàyàler anà kàtsuuŋ wa kà isɔ.
Nde kàtwey Un'tswää a mɔ̈ɔ̈ a ngwal ntɔn bi uboo a ndwà a un'tsüüŋ ande mfum David.
Ayi ndaa kàkyään nde itaan u mun a aŋangɔɔm ande bà in'kyɛɛl:
ntsuuŋ abi kà an'kɔɔ a aŋankir abi anà kà an'kɔɔ a baar bàfàkyer bi ube.
Nde kàswɛŋ ubwaŋ ande akà bànkaa abi. Nde sye kàdiimà anki kyän ande là in'kyɛɛl.
Ndandaa, Nzam kàdi kyän akà nkaa abi Abàlam,
mukà itsuuŋ kà ikɔ̈b a aŋankir abi anà mukà ipà mbwo mukun'syääl ukɔɔn bɔɔmà,
ntɔn bi ikälà baar a in'kyɛɛl anà bàbalàbal kusà ande kà ilä a mɔ̈ɔ̈ abi byanswà.
Wɛɛ ngye mwan amɛ, bàsabeelà ŋangɔɔm a Nzam a dudu, ntɔn ngye asàfwel kusà a Mwol ntɔn muyilà mbwo ande
anà mulɔŋ un'sɛŋ ande naa nde akyer ayà mutswà nde mɔ̈ɔ̈ ntɔn nde ayun'dwääl nkul a man'be ande.
Nzam abi wàŋàyɔl a ngyɛb, lalan kà itööm nde pɛɛlà làfü du asànaa taaŋ làfàsɛnà la,
ntɔn mupɛɛlà baar abà uboo a làpib anà u mbwo a ukwà, ntɔn musyen bi u mbwo a duu.»
Mwan wa kàkäl muyɛl u ndür anà u dweelà. Nde kàkälà u nsye a ipɔl tii mpal kàyàmɛnà nde u mii a un'sɛŋ a Isàlɛl.
Mpal ayin, Sɛzar Angus kàtöm un'kaan ntɔn mutaŋ baar banswà u mɛɛn a Lɔmà.
Ntääŋ a baar atàtwɛb ayi yàkäl mpal kàkäl Kirinüs mfum a Siri.
Baar banswà bàkyeenà mukàsɔn ikɔb aba mbuur mbuur u bul kàfü nde.
Yɔsefi sye kàmbarà u Nasàlɛr bul a Ngalilɛ ntɔn mukyà Bɛtɛlɛm bul a Yuday ntɔn nde kàkäl mbuur a ywar anà mbil a David,
ntɔn mukàsɔn ikɔb ande anà kyà un'kyay ande Màlye awà kàkäl anà yöm.
Mpal bàkäl ba u Yɛlusàlɛm, taaŋ a Màlye mubɔr làkyer akwo,
nde kàbör mwan baal ande wàtàtwɛb. Nde kun'läl ipfɛy, waa kun'byee uboo a unkwak ntɔn ba bàmɛn anki ikal u ndwà a angyey.
U ntsü ayin sye aseey bàfabɔ̈ɔ̈nà u nsà uboo a an'ywaŋ muyiler in'kɔk aba u mpib.
Wɛɛ, le, un'kyeey a Mwol mwɛy kàyàmɛnà akà ba, làkoo a Mwol sye làswɛŋ pɛɛlà a la. Ba bàwɛn bɔɔmà mbɔɔn.
Wɛɛ un'kyeey kàtɛn a ba naa: «Twon lan'wem bɔɔmà, ntɔn mɛ amàlatwääl làsaŋ aŋàbwaŋ làyàpà un'sak akà baar banswà:
U mpib aŋàbà, u bul a David, bàmàlaböör Un'tswää a mɔ̈ɔ̈ mwɛy, nde wà Klistɔ, wà Mwol.
«Bɛ làyun'man unsà idiim ki: mwan aŋàlal ipfɛy, wàŋàbyee uboo a unkwak.»
Kà imbürà, akyeey a du mbɔɔn waa bàyun'taan, bàmusà Nzam làkoo, bàmutɛn naa:
«Làkoo akà Nzam kà ikal a dudu, duu u mɛɛn uboo a baar bàfun'kwen!»
Mpal bàsawɛy akyeey ntɔn mufurà du, aseey bàtɛn ba a ba naa: «Tsweenà Bɛtelɛm bà, bi ikàman ndaa yan'bwà kwo, ndaa kàmisam Mwol.»
Ba bàkyen agyägyä, waa bàmɛn Màlye anà Yɔsefi, anà mwan akɔɔ wàŋàbyee uboo a unkwak.
Mpal bun'mɛn ba, ba bàsam ndaa kakyään un'kyeey ntɔn mwan akɔɔ awun.
Baar banswà bàweemà indiir bàtɛɛnà aseey, bàmɛn ndaa yubem.
Ndaa ayi yanswà Màlye ya kàkäärà u mpem, waa kàfayɔbà ya taaŋ lanswà.
Aseey waa bàfurà, bàmuyisà làkoo anà muyisyäŋà Nzam, ntɔn indiir byanswà bàwem ba anà bàmɛn ba, byàbü balàbal asànaa kakyään un'kyeey.
Ilä kyànaan ungö a mböör, taaŋ mutsul mwan làkwe la, ba bun'pɛ ikɔb a Yɛsu, ikɔb kakyään un'kyeey kusà ngwän mukal yöm.
Apan, taaŋ mupöŋ ndür làkwe la ntɔn Yɔsefi anà Màlye asànaa kàswɛŋà un'kɔɔn a Mɔsɛ, ba bàsyen mwan u ndwà a Nzam a Yɛlusàlɛm ntɔn mukun'swaŋ akà Mwol,
ntɔn bàsön uboo a un'kɔɔn a Mwol abà: «Mwan baal a nswɛm wanswà bun'sà ukɔl ntɔn Mwol.»
Yàlɔ̈m sye naa ba bàpɛ ibɔɔn asànaa ukalɔɔmà un'kɔɔn nsil awà, «nkokà un'kyay anà un'dim, itàkal in'tö a an'yem myeel.»
U Yɛlusàlɛm kàkäl anà mbuur mwɛy ikɔb ande Simɛyɔ. Mbuur awà kàkäl wàbalàbal anà inzaam, nde kàfadilà mbuur ayàlwom ngyɛb a Isàlɛl. Dweelà In'kyɛɛl kàkäl anà nde,
waa kun'kyään naa nde usàkwà anki kusà muman Klistɔ a Mwol.
Dweelà kun'syen u ndwà a Nzam. Umpal bàyàtwaal aböör a Yɛsu mwan aba ntɔn mukyer ndaa kàlɔ̈ɔ̈mà un'kɔɔn,
Simɛyɔ kun'wɛl kà an'kɔɔ ande, waa kàsyäŋà Nzam, waa kàtɛn naa:
«Mwol, mpalàbà ngye an'kwey ilää angye: ngye an'kwo awɛy un'tsüüŋ angye ukü a duu.
Ntɔn mɛ an'man Un'tswää a mɔ̈ɔ̈ amɛ u mii,
Un'tswää a mɔ̈ɔ̈ kàlɔ̈ɔ̈n ngye ntɔn in'sɛŋ myanswà,
Nde wà pɛɛlà ntɔn mupà kyɛɛy akà in'sɛŋ a mɛɛn anà nde asàkal làkoo ntɔn un'sɛŋ angye Isàlɛl.»
Taarànde anà ngwän bàkäl mubem indiir kàtɛɛnà Simɛyɔ ntɔn Yɛsu.
Simɛyɔ kun'si kɔɔ, waa kàtɛn a Màlye ngwän a Yɛsu naa: «Le! Mwan wà ayàkal mbuur ayàtyeey, taaŋ lumwɛy ayàmbaar baar mbɔɔn kà Isàlɛl. Nde ayàkal isi a Nzam iyàtwaal nkaabà,
abun an'kyän aŋàyee u mpem a baar mbɔɔn màsàmɛnà u leŋ. Wɛɛ akà ngye ŋakwo Màlye, usaay bàsapfuul mpem asànaa kɔm.»
Kàkäl sye anà ŋangɔɔm un'kaar ikɔb ande Anà, mwan a Fanwel, mbuur a un'sɛŋ a Asɛr. Nde kàkäl un'nün. Nde kàkäl mbul nsambwaar anà un'dim kàbääl nde kà isyee ande,

ungö, nde kàbulà un'kweel un'dim. Nde kàkäl ayà mbul an'kwem naan aŋinà. U mɔ̈ɔ̈ ande wanswà nde kàbwaayà u ndwà a Nzam musyäälà Nzam mpib anà mwäänà: nde kàkälà mukin mbɔr anà muyamà.
Nde kàyàkɔlà sye taaŋ nsil alan, wàmuyisyäŋà Nzam. Nde kàkäl mukyään ndaa a Yɛsu akà baar banswà bàkälà mudilà naa Nzam ukɔɔr Yɛlusàlɛm.
Mpal bàmay ba mukyer ndaa yanswà kàlɔ̈ɔ̈mà un'kɔɔn a Mwol, Yɔsefi anà Màlye bàfurà bul aba Nasàlɛr u Ngalilɛ.
Mwan kàkäl muyɛl anà mubulà ngwal. Nde kàkäl aŋàyɔl a an'yeerà, kɔɔ a Nzam làkäl anà nde.
Aböör a Yɛsu bàfakyeenà Yɛlusàlɛm mbul wanswà mukàdyà Pak.
Mpal kàkäl Yɛsu mbul kwen aŋiyweel, ba bun'syen Yɛlusàlɛm asànaa ikääl aba.
Mpal yàwü nköŋ, ba waa bàfurà, wɛɛ mwan Yɛsu kàsàsal u Yɛlusàlɛm, aböör ande bàyöb anki.
Ba bàsii naa nde wa anà atɔŋ aba bàtüüb ba mbwo, ba bàkyer mwäänà mwɛy muyikyà, waa bàsɛmà muyun'leŋ uboo a atɔŋ aba anà uboo a asam aba.
Wɛɛ ba bun'mɛn anki. Apan ba bàfurà Yɛlusàlɛm mukun'leŋ.
Ungö ilä itär ba bun'mɛn u ndwà a Nzam kàkyàbwaay uboboo a alɔɔŋ a un'kɔɔn. Nde kàkäl muweemà ba anà musà ba mfuul.
Baar banswà bàweemà ndaa ande bàkäl mubem ntɔn un'yɛnà ande anà mfuur a ndaa ande.
Mpal bun'mɛn aböör ande, ba bàkyer abem, lalan ngwän kàtɛn nde a nde naa: «Mwan amɛ, ntɔn nkye amà ikyer ngye abà? Ler, taaràŋà anà mɛ, bi kan'kyɛɛr mbɔɔn muyaleŋ.»
Nde waa kafuur naa: «Ntɔn nkye làyan'leŋ bɛ? Bɛ làyöb anki naa mɛ in'kyer akyer isal a taaràmɛ?»
Wɛɛ ba bàsàyöb anki ndaa kàtɛɛnà nde.
Apan Yɛsu kàfurà Nasàlɛr anà ba. Nde kàkyer afalabà ndaa aba. Ndaa ayi yanswà ngwän ya kàkäärà u mpem ande.
Yɛsu kàkäl muyɛl unsà ndür anà unsà an'yeerà. Nde sye kàpɛɛ un'sak akà Nzam anà akà baar.
Mbul wàkwem aŋityeen wà imfum a Mfum Tibɛr Sɛzar, umpal kàkäl Pɔnsɔ Pilatu kuvɛrnɔ̈ɔ̈r u Yuday, Ɛlɔdi u Ngalilɛ, un'tɔŋ ande Filipo u Itürɛ anà u Trakɔnit, Lizanyas u Abilɛn,
anà umpal a andwer a angaŋ Anà anà Kayifa, ndaa a Nzam yàyi akà Ywan mwan a Zakàlye, u nsye a ipɔl.
Nde kàyilyaaŋà u nsi yanswà yà tsütsü a ngyäl a Yɔrdan muyilɔŋ baar mubuul mpem anà mukadümà ntɔn badwääl nkul a man'be aba
asànaa bàsön ya uboo a un'kaan a ndaa a ŋangɔɔm Yɛsay naa: «Yi ndaa a mbuur akasaa in'kwɛŋ u nsye a ipɔl: "Làlɔ̈ɔ̈n mbwo a Mwol, làsuub myäy ande.
Un'baan wanswà akyer ayàyɔl, mɔŋ wanswà anà iköl kyanswà ikyer ayàtye, mbwo aŋàkwàkwarà ikyer ayàsubà, mbwo aŋàkwà bàkyer ayàlɔn."
Mbuur wanswà ayàman mɔ̈ɔ̈ kàpɛ Nzam.»
In'sɛŋ a baar myàyee akà Ywan ntɔn nde kadümà. Nde kàtɛɛnà a ba naa: «Mbil a iyäy, nà kàlaswɛŋ mutiin nkyɛl iyà ungö?
Làswɛŋ u nsyääl abɛ naa bɛ lan'buul mpem, wɛɛ twon lan'tɛn u mpem abɛ naa: "Abàlam wà nkaa abi." Ntɔn mɛ alàkyään naa Nzam kan'kwo utwey ikyee a Abàlam unsà nkɔŋ yi.
Làler, fà itaan nkwar ya tsütsü mutsul in'te kà in'swɛy a mya: un'te wanswà mpa afàbɔr mbɛŋ aŋàbwaŋ bàkyer ayun'tsul, waa bàyun'tɔɔm u mbaa.»
Baar bun'fuulà naa: «Apɛy bi waa ikyer aben?»
Nde waa kàfuur naa: «Wɛy mbuur awe abyà inkur byeel upɛ imwɛy akà mbuur akɔ̈ɔ̈n a kya, wɛɛ mbuur awe anà isaa adyà ukyer sye abà.»
Afüür a itɛr sye bàyi ntɔn badümà, waa bàtɛn a nde naa: «Un'lɔɔŋ, bi ikyer aben?»
Nde waa kafuur naa: «Twon lan'kwɛy undiir udu a indiir bàlaswɛŋ mukyer.»
Aŋità sye bàfuul naa: «Atöl bi ikyer aben?» Nde waa kafuur naa: «Twon lan'gyɔɔr undiir a mbuur, twon lan'yib, làkyey làfur abɛ mpɛl.»
Baar bàkäl anà ngyal muyöb naa nkye Ywan wà Klistɔ bàdilà ba.

Nde kàtɛn a baar banswà naa: «Mɛ, mɛ in'kàladümà kà an'dà, wɛɛ mbuur ayàyà ungö amɛ kàman'söön u ngwal, mɛ in'kwe anki musɔɔl in'siŋ a sàbar ande. Nde bɛ ayàladümà u Dweelà In'kyɛɛl anà u mbaa.
Nde we anà impye ande u kɔɔ ntɔn mukaab mbɛŋ anà un'lɛŋ. Nde mbɛŋ ayàsà uboo a ikɔr ande, wɛɛ nde un'lɛŋ ayàtɔɔm u mbaa mpa ifàdim.»
Abun Ywan kàswɛŋà ndaa asin mbɔɔn akà un'sɛŋ mukyer anà kun'kyäänà Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ.
Apan sye Ywan kàtɛɛnà a Ɛlodi, mbuur kàfayaalà u Ngalilɛ, ntɔn kàbääl nde Ɛlɔdyas, un'kyay a un'tɔŋ ande, anà ntɔn nde kàkyer ube asin bà ifà ifà,
nde kàfàkwɛy ube asin musà Ywan u bɔlokà.
Yàmɛnà naa baar banswà bàkyeenà mukàwal ndüümà. Yɛsu sye kàkàwal ndüümà. Mpal kàkäl nde muyamà, du waa làdubà,
Dweelà In'kyɛɛl kàyi udu ande kà imbuur imbuur asànaa yem. Ndaa yan'fà du yan'tɛn naa: «Ngye, ngye awà Mwan in'kwen mɛ, mɔ̈ɔ̈ amɛ wanswà we amu ngye.»
Yɛsu kàkäl ayà tsütsü mbul an'kwem an'tär taaŋ kàsɛmà nde isal ande asànaa bàsii baar naa nde wà mwan a Yɔsɛfi, mwan a Ɛli,
mwan a Matat, mwan a Lɛvi, mwan a Mɛlshi, mwan a Zanayi, mwan a Yɔsɛfi,
mwan a Matatyas, mwan a Amɔs, mwan a Nawum, mwan a Ɛsli, mwan a Nangay,
mwan a Maat, mwan a Matatyas, mwan a Sɛmɛy, mwan a Yɔsɛk, mwan a Yɔda,
mwan a Ywanan, mwan a Yɛsa, mwan a Zɔrɔbabɛl, mwan a Salatyɛl, mwan a Nɛri
mwan a Mɛlki, mwan a Adi, mwan a Kɔsam, mwan a Ɛlmadam, mwan a Ɛr,
mwan a Yɛsu, mwan a Ɛlyɛzɛr, mwan a Yɔrim, mwan a Matat, mwan a Lɛvi,
mwan a Simɛyɔ, mwan a Yudà, mwan a Yɔsɛfi, mwan a Yɔnam, mwan a Ɛlyakim,
mwan a Mɛlɛya, mwan a Mɛna, mwan a Matatar, mwan a Natan, mwan a David,
mwan a Isayi, mwan a Yɔbɛd, mwan a Booz, mwan a Salà, mwan a Nasɔn,
mwan a Aminadab, mwan a Admin mwan a Arni, mwan a Ɛsrɔm, mwan a Farɛs, mwan a Yudà,
mwan a Yakɔb, mwan a Isak, mwan a Abàlam, mwan a Tara, mwan a Nashɔr,
mwan a Sɛrush, mwan a Ragɔ, mwan a Falɛk, mwan a Ɛbɛr, mwan a Salà,
mwan a Kaynam, mwan a Alàpakàsad, mwan a Sɛm, mwan a Nɔwà, mwan a Lamɛk,
mwan a Matusala, mwan a Ɛnɔk, mwan a Yɛred, mwan a Màlalɛyɛl, mwan a Kɛnan,
mwan a Ɛnɔs, mwan a Sɛt, mwan a Adam, mwan a Nzam.
Yɛsu kàkäl aŋàyɔl a Dweelà In'kyɛɛl mpal kàfü nde Yɔrdan, Dweelà kun'syen u nsye a ipɔl,
ikal kun'lɛb Satanà ilä an'kwem an'nà. Ilä abin byanswà nde akundiir kàdi anki. Mpal byàwü ilä abi, nde kàwem ngyal.
Satanà kàtɛn a nde naa: «Isàkal naa ngye awà Mwan a Nzam, swaŋ nkɔŋ yi ibulà nsɔ.»
Yɛsu kun'fuur naa: «Bàsön naa: "Mbuur usàkal anki anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ ntɔn nsɔ mpɛl."»
Satanà kun'syen ududu, kun'swɛŋ imfum a mɛɛn byanswà,
waa kàtɛn a nde naa: «Mɛ in'yapà ikɔ̈b ki kyanswà, un'naaŋ anà làkoo a imfum bi byanswà, ntɔn bya mɛ bàpɛ, mɛ sye in'fàpà akà mbuur wanswà in'kwen mɛ.
Isàkal naa ngye an'bwà an'köm kusà a mɛ, ayi yanswà iyàkal yà ngye.»
Yɛsu kun'fuur naa: «Bàsön naa: "Ngye asàbwà an'köm kusà a Mwol, Nzam angye, ngye sye ayàsyääl nde mpɛl."»
Satanà kàfun'syen u Yɛlusàlɛm, kun'si udu a ndwà a Nzam, waa kàtɛn a nde naa: «Isàkal naa ngye awà Mwan a Nzam, tɔɔmà sɛmà pà tii u nsi, ntɔn bàsön naa:

Nde ayàswaŋ in'kyeey ande ntɔn ngye, ntɔn ba batii,
2a040b005f	anà ba sye bàsawal kan'kɔɔ aba ntɔn làkɔl angye làkɔ̈ɔ̈n abööl u nkɔŋ.»
Yɛsu kun'fuur naa: «Bàsön naa: "Ngye asun'kur anki Mwol, Nzam angye".»
Pa kàmay nde ndɛb yanswà, Satanà waa kàlwomà tsütsü apà Yɛsu tii utaaŋ asin.
Yɛsu kàkäl aŋàyɔl a ngwal a Dweelà mpal kàfurà nde Ngalilɛ. Làsaŋ ande làpää kà itiir a nsi aki kyanswà.
Nde kàyilɔŋà uboo a ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà. Baar banswà bàkyer un'sà làkoo.
Apan, Yɛsu kàkyen Nasàlɛr ikal kàyɛl nde. Asànaa ifà ande, nde kàbilà u ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà ilä a saba. Nde kàmbarà ntɔn mutaŋ,
ba bun'pɛ un'kaan a ŋangɔɔm Yɛsay. Nde kàduub wa, waa kàmɛn ikal bàsön naa:

«Dweelà a Mwol là udu amɛ, ntɔn nde kan'si an'kɔɔ ntɔn mukyään Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ akà aŋàlàmbwà, nde kan'töm mukyään ntsuuŋà akà baar aŋàkwɛlà, anà akà ikwàmii muman, mutsuuŋ baar bàŋàmɛɛy nkwaaŋ,
mukyään mbul usàswaŋ Mwol kab angway ande.»
Ungö apan nde kàdübà un'kaan awun, kàpɛ wa akà un'syääl, waa kàbwaay. Uboo a ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà, mii myanswà myàkäl muler nde.
Apan nde kàsɛmà mutɛn a ba naa: «Itiir a Ndaa a Nzam an'taŋ mɛ yi, akà bɛ baar làweemà ya, ya yan'kwo ŋàbawà.»
Baar banswà bun'tɛɛlà imbäl: ba bàkäl mubem ntɔn ndaa aŋàbwaŋ iyatoo u mun ande, wɛɛ ba bàtɛɛnà naa: «Wà mà mwan a Yɔsɛfi!»
Apan Yɛsu waa kàtɛn a ba naa: «Mɛ inkyàyöb naa bɛ làyan'tɛɛl itim ki: "Ungaŋ, kɔɔr ngye ŋakwo, bɛ làyàtɛn naa kyer u bul angye asànaa kàkyer ngye u Kapɛrnawum."
Wɛɛ mɛ, mɛ alàkyään ndandaa naa akà ŋangɔɔm mwɛy ufun'wal u nsi ande watɛy.
Mɛ alàkyään ndandaa, akweel adim bàkäl mbɔɔn u taaŋ a Ɛli kà Isàlɛl mpal mbul mpa kànɔ̈ wa mbul tär a ngɔn syaam. Ngyal yàkyer abilà u mɛɛn manswà,
wɛɛ Ɛli bun'töm anki akà umwɛy uboo a ba, bun'töm akà un'kweel un'dim mwɛy u Sarɛpta, u mɛɛn a Sidɔn.
Baar a ukyal a bay sye bàkäl mbɔɔn kà Isàlɛl utaaŋ a ŋangɔɔm Ɛlisya, ba banswà bàkɔɔrà anki, Naaman un'nsi Siri mpɛl.»
Baar banswà uboo a ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà bàwem nkyɛl mbɔɔn mpal bàwem ba indiir abi byanswà.
Waa bàmbarà, bun'böŋ u bul aba, bun'syen udu a mɔŋ bàtöŋ bul aba ntɔn mukun'siinà waa nde ukàbwà u ngyɛl.
Wɛɛ Yɛsu kàlyaaŋ uboo aba, waa kàkyen.
Apan Yɛsu kàtyà Kapɛrnawum, bul a Ngalilɛ. Nde kàlɔɔŋà ilä a saba.
Baar bàmɛn ndaa yubem ntɔn nde kàlɔɔŋà a ikɔ̈b.
U ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà kàkäl anà mbuur mwɛy kàkäl anà dweelà a làbe. Mpal kàmɛn nde Yɛsu, nde kàsi in'kwɛŋ:
«Aa! Yɛsu un'nsi Nasàlɛr, ngye ininà akwen ntɔn bi? Ngye ayi ntɔn muböŋ bi? Mɛ in'kyàyöb naa ngye awà nà, ngye awà Ŋun'kyɛɛl a Nzam.»
Yɛsu waa kun'ŋän, waa kàtɛn naa: «Kal a duu, too uboo a mbuur wà.» Dweelà a làbe lun'bwiy u nsi, waa làtoo ukɔɔn akun'kyer ube.
Baar banswà bàkäl u bɔɔmà, waa bàtɛɛnà ba a ba naa: «Ndaa nà ayi? Nde wà mutɛɛnà a ngwal anà ikɔ̈b a an'dweelà an'be, ma sye màmutoo!»
Làsaŋ ande làpää kà itiir a nsi akin.
Yɛsu kàtoo u ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà, waa kàkyen ndwà a Simɔn. Ukwà a Simɔn kàkäl anà làbwey a mpye mbɔɔn. Ba bun'bɔ̈ɔ̈n mukun'kɔɔr.
Yɛsu waa kànyee udu ande, waa kàböŋ ukyal aban. Umpal bàtoo ba u ndür ande, nde waa kàsubà, waa kàsɛmà mukasyääl.
U làbwàmpib, baar bàkäl anà baar a an'kyal mà ifà ifà batwäl akà Yɛsu. Nde kasi an'kɔɔ, ba waa bàkɔɔrà.
An'dweelà an'be sye màtoo anà in'kwɛŋ anà màtɛn naa: «Ngye awà Mwan a Nzam.» Wɛɛ Yɛsu katsüŋ a ngwal ntɔn ba bàkɔ̈ɔ̈n afàtɛn, ntɔn ba bàkyer ayöbà naa nde kàkäl Klistɔ.
Taaŋtyà ututu, Yɛsu kàkyer atoo, waa kàkyen kikal a mpey. Baar mbɔɔn bàkyer ayun'leŋà. Mpal bun'mɛn ba, ba bàkwen mukun'tà mpi ntɔn nde ukɔɔn asawɛy.
Wɛɛ nde kàtɛn a ba naa: «Mɛ in'kyer akàpay Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ là imwol a Nzam kà an'bul mumwɛy, ntɔn ndaa kan'töm Nzam yayi.»
Nde kàlɔɔŋà u ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà u Yuday.
Yàmɛnà naa ilä mwɛy Yɛsu kàkäl tsütsü a ɛwà a Ngɛnàsàlɛr, baar mbɔɔn bàkyer un'diŋà ntɔn muwem ndaa a Nzam.
Nde kàmɛn an'bwaar an'mɔ̈ɔ̈l mà ipɔl kà un'kɔɔl a an'dà ntɔn aŋama bàkäl musɔŋ an'kwen aba.
Nde kàlär uboo a bwaar làmwɛy, la làkäl là Simɔn, waa kun'lɔ̈ɔ̈m naa nde usiinà la ikyee uboo a an'dà. Nde waa kàbwaay, kàlɔɔŋà baar uboo a bwaar.
Mpal kàmay nde mulɔŋ, nde kàtɛn a Simɔn naa: «Làkyen uboboo a an'dà, làtɔɔm an'kwen abɛ kan'dà ntɔn mulwab nsö.»
Simɔn kun'fuur naa: «Un'lɔɔŋ, bi kan'kyer mpib aŋun'kiinà, wɛɛ bi akà undiir imɛn anki. Ntɔn ngye aman'swaŋ, mɛ in'kyer atɔɔm an'kwen.»
Ungö mutɔɔm ma, ba bàsiim nsö mbɔɔn, an'kwen màkäl tsütsü mukaamà.
Ba bàbel atɔŋ aba bàkäl uboo a bwaar lumwɛy ntɔn ba babay. Ba waa bàyi, bàyööl an'bwaar màmɔ̈ɔ̈l: ma màkäl tsütsü muminà ntɔn buur a nsö.
Mpal kàmɛn Simɔn abun, nde kàbü kà in'kɔl a Yɛsu, waa kàtɛn naa: «Mwol, lwomà tsütsü apà mɛ, ntɔn mɛ in'wà mbuur a man'be.»
Ntɔn nde anà atɔŋ ande matɛɛr màkyer awal ntɔn bàsiim ba nsö mbɔɔn.
Atɔŋ ande Zyak anà Ywan, baan a Zebàday, bàkäl sye asànaa nde. Apan, Yɛsu waa kàtɛn a Simɔn naa: «Twon an'man bɔɔmà, sɛmà apanà ngye an'bulà un'lɔ̈ɔ̈b a baar.»
Ungö bàmay ba mutwey an'bwaar u nkankyel, ba bàsàwɛy ma, waa bàläb Yɛsu.
Yàmɛnà naa Yɛsu kàkäl u bul mwɛy, ŋun'kyal a bay kun'mɛn nde, nde kàbü kusà ande, waa kun'bɔ̈ɔ̈n naa: «Mwol, kya ngye asàkwen, mpööŋ.»
Yɛsu kàsilà kɔɔ ande, waa kun'bä, waa kàtɛn a nde naa: «Mɛ an'kwen, pɔŋà!» Taaŋ nsil alan bay waa làlwomà.
Ungö apan nde kun'tsüŋ naa: «Twon an'kyään mbuur asin ndaa ayi. Wɛɛ, kyen akà ngaŋ ntɔn nde kaler, ungö waa ngye apà an'kab kàswɛŋ Mɔsɛ ntɔn mpööŋà angye, waa kya ikal imbäl ntɔn ba.»
Apan, làkoo ande làkyer apää ntsü yanswà, baar mbɔɔn bàyee ntɔn muwem ndaa ande anà muleŋ nkɔɔr unsà an'kyal aba.
Wɛɛ nde kàkyeenà kà ikal a mpey ntɔn mukàyamà Nzam.

Yàmɛnà naa ilä mwɛy Yɛsu kàkäl mulɔŋ. Amfarisi anà alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn bàkäl paa sye ban'bwaay. Ba bàfü an'bul manswà mà Ngalilɛ, mà Yuday anà Yɛlusàlɛm. Ngwal a Mwol yàkäl a Yɛsu ntɔn mukɔɔr abɛy.
Apan sye, baar amwɛy bàtwäl mbuur mwɛy aŋàkwɛkà udu a ipɔy. Ba bàleŋà mukun'biil uboo a ndwà anà bun'tɔɔl kusà a Yɛsu.
Abà bàmɛn ba naa mbwo abilà yatɛy ntɔn baar bàkäl mbɔɔn, ba bàpfuul mun u mpaan a ndwà, waa bun'tɔɔl kusà a Yɛsu u mii a baar banswà.
Mpal kàmɛn nde làkwikilà aba, Yɛsu kàtɛn naa: «Mbuur wà, mɛ amadwääl nkul a man'be angye.»
Amfarisi anà alɔɔŋ a Un'kɔɔn waa bàyweerà u mpem aba naa: «Nà mbuur awà? Nde wàmubɛy Nzam. Nà kan'kwo mudwa nkul a man'be isàkal naa kà Nzam anki?»
Wɛɛ Yɛsu kàyöb nde ankyän aba, waa kàtɛn a ba naa: «An'kyän nà bɛ làwe amà u mpem abɛ?
Undiir nà akɔ̈ɔ̈n mpay mutɛn: Bàmadwääl nkul angye, lɛɛ mutɛn naa: Mbarà, kyen?
Apanà, yubwaŋ bɛ làyöb naa Mwan a mbuur we anà ikɔ̈b mudwääl baar nkul a man'be aba u mɛɛn pà.» Nde kàswɛŋ mbuur aŋàkwɛkà naa: «Mɛ amaswaŋ, mbarà, sɛn ipɔy angye, furà ndwà angye.»
Taaŋ nsil alan, u mii a baar banswà, laa kàmbarà nde, kàsɛn nde ipɔy ande, waa kàfurà ndwà ande wàmuyisà Nzam làkoo.
Baar banswà bàkäl mubem, waa bàsyäŋà Nzam. Unsà bɔɔmà ba bàtɛɛnà naa: «Bi kan'man indiir ibaŋ ŋàbawà.»
Ungö apan Yɛsu kàtoo nde, nde kàmɛn un'füür a itɛr mwɛy ikɔb ande Lɛvi kan'bwaay kà ikal a isal ande. Nde kàtɛn a nde naa: «Yan'läb.»
Nde sye laa kàsàwɛy nde indiir byanswà, waa kun'läb.
Lɛvi kàwɛl Yɛsu unsà ubwaŋ banswà u ndwà ande. Afüür a itɛr mbɔɔn anà baar asin bàkäl mudyà anà nde u mɛsà.
Amfarisi anà alɔɔŋ a Un'kɔɔn bàkyer aŋüŋün, waa bàtɛn a alɔŋki a Yɛsu naa: «Ntɔn nkye làkadyaa bɛ ikal imwɛy anà afüür a itɛr anà baar a man'be?»
Yɛsu kafuur naa: «Kà baar abye anà ngwal u ndür anki bye anà mfun a un'ngaŋ, wɛɛ aŋukyal.
Mɛ kàyi anki muleŋ mbuul a mpem a baar a balàbal, wɛɛ mbuul a mpem a baar a man'be.»
Amfarisi bàtɛn ande naa: «Alɔŋki a Ywan anà alɔŋki abi bàfàkin mbɔr mbalà mbɔɔn anà muyamà Nzam, wɛ alɔŋki angye isal aba udyà anà unwà.»
Nde kafuur naa: «Nkye asam a mbuur kan'tà bɔr ban'kwo bàkin mbɔr isàkal naa nde wà paa anà ba?
Ilä kyà paa bàsàlwom ba un'tɛɛl a bɔr, apan ba waa bàsàkin mbɔr.»
Nde kàfatɛɛl nsim yi: «Akà mbuur mwɛy ukwe anki muwal itɛɛnà a ipfɛy akün ntɔn mubaay ipfɛy aŋànün. Ntɔn itɛɛnà akin iyàpà anki ubwaŋ unsà ipfɛy aŋànün.
Akà mbuur mwɛy sye ukwe anki musà man akün uboo a mbeen itaan: naa tɛy, man akün iyàpfuul mbeen itaan, waa ipää, mbeen sye waa ikyà bwà.
Yubwaŋ musà man akün u mbeen akün.
Akà mbuur mwɛy ukwe anki mukwen man akün isàkal naa nde akyàfuràtànwà man itaan, ntɔn nde ayàtɛn naa: "Man a itaan mà ntsà."»
Yàmɛnà naa ilä a saba mwey, Yɛsu kàkäl mulyaaŋ uboo a an'ywaŋ a blɛ. Alɔŋki ande bàbwee imfà, ungö mupfipfiy bya kà an'kɔɔ aba, waa bàdyee mbɛŋ a bya.
Amfarisi amwɛy bàkäl paa bàtɛn a ba naa: «Ntɔn nkye làkyerà bɛ ndaa mpa bàfàkyer kà ilä a saba?»
Yɛsu kafuur naa: «Nkye bɛ làtäŋ anki ndaa kàkyer David mpal kàwem nde ngyal anà baar bàkäl anà nde?
Nde kàbilà u ndwà a Nzam, kàwɛl mampà ufàpà ibɔɔn akà Nzam laa kàdi nde, mumwɛy nde kàpɛ akà baar bàkäl anà nde, itàkal naa ma angaŋ mpɛl bàfàdyà.»
Nde waa kàfàkwɛy abà: «Mwan a mbuur wà mfum a saba.»
Yàmɛnà sye naa ilä a saba kyumwɛy Yɛsu kàbilà u ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà, waa kàlɔɔŋà. Uboo kwo kàkäl anà mbuur kàkäl anà kɔɔ ibaal làŋàkwɛkà.
Alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn anà Amfarisi bàkäl musyebà Yɛsu a duu ntɔn muyöb naa nkye nde akyer akɔɔr mbuur ilä a saba, ntɔn ba bun'bämà ndaa.
Wɛɛ nde kàkyer ayöb an'kyän aba, waa kàbel mbuur kàkäl anà kɔɔ aŋàkwɛkà: «Mbarà, mbar uboboo pà.» Mbuur awà waa kàmbarà, waa kàmbär uboboo a baar.
Yɛsu waa kafuul naa: «Mɛ in'kwen muyöb: Nkye yubwaŋ mukyer ubwaŋ lɛɛ mukyer ube ilä a saba? Mutswà mɔ̈ɔ̈ a mbuur lɛɛ mukɔɔn atswà wa ilä a saba?»
Ungö apan, Yɛsu kàler ba banswà, waa kàtɛn a mbuur awun naa: «Sen kɔɔ angye.» Nde sye waa kàsen la, laa làkɔɔrà la.
Alɔɔŋ a Un'kɔɔn anà Amfarisi bàwem nkyɛl, waa bàsɛmà mutɛn ba a ba naa ba ininà bàkyer akà Yɛsu.
Mpal ayin Yɛsu kàlär udu a mɔŋ ntɔn mukàyamà. Nde kwo kàkyer mpib aŋun'kiinà muyamà Nzam.
Taaŋtyà, nde kàbel alɔŋki ande, waa kàsɔ̈ɔ̈l kwem aŋiyweel uboo a ba, nde kapɛ ikɔb naa antööm:
Simɔn, nde kun'pɛ ikɔb a Petɔlà, un'tɔŋ ande Andrɛ, Zyak, Ywan, Filipo, Bàtelàmay,
Màtay, Tuma, Zyak mwan a Alfɛ, Simɔn mbuur a mankay,
Yudà mwan a Zyak, anà Yudas Iskaryɔt, mbuur ayun'yälà.

Ungö apan nde kàyàtyà anà ba, waa bàmbär kà ikal mwɛy kyà ibär, ikal bàkäl alɔŋki ande mbɔɔn anà un'kàbɔ a baar: baar a Yuday lanswà, bà Yɛlusàlɛm, anà baar bàfü un'kɔɔl a an'dà, a Tir anà Sidɔn.
Ba bàyi ntɔn mukun'wem anà ba bàkɔɔrà unsà an'kyal aba. Baar bàkäl anà an'dweelà an'be, bàkyer akɔɔrà.
Baar banswà bàleŋà muba nde u ndür, ntɔn ngwal mbɔɔn yàkatoo u ndür ande, ya yàkɔɔrà ba banswà.
Apan Yɛsu kàler alɔŋki ande, waa kàtɛn naa: «Un'sak akà bɛ aŋàlàmbwà, ntɔn imwol a Nzam kye anà bɛ!
Un'sak akà bɛ baar làwe anà ngyal mpalàbà, ntɔn bɛ làkyer asàyuur! Un'sak akà bɛ baar làlelà ŋàbawà, ntɔn bɛ làkyer asàsɛ!
«Un'sak asàkal akà bɛ isàkal naa ba bàmàlàyiiŋ, bàmàlàböŋ, bàmàlato, bàmàlapiy asànaa undiir a ŋingyäy ntɔn Mwan a mbuur!
Làkäl unsà un'sak mpal isàkwo ndaa ayin ntɔn bweel abɛ làsàkal mbɔɔn u du, ntɔn bànkaa aba bàkyerà abà akà aŋangɔɔm.»
«Wɛɛ ngyɛb akà bɛ, aŋun'naaŋ, ntɔn bɛ ndɛɛl abɛ lan'wal nsil apà.
Ngyɛb akà bɛ baar lan'yuur mpalàbà, ntɔn bɛ làsàwem ngyal. Ngyɛb akà bɛ baar làsɛɛ mpalàyi, ntɔn bɛ làsàkal kun'saabà anà uboo a ilel.
Ngyɛb, isàkal naa baar bàfàtɛn ndaa aŋàbwaŋ mpɛl akà bɛ, ntɔn bànkaa aba bàkyerà abà akà aŋangɔɔm a loor.
«Wɛɛ bɛ baar banswà làweemà mɛ, mɛɛ alàkyään abà: Lakwen ayiiŋ abɛ, làkyer ubwaŋ akà baar bàfàlakyer ube,
làfuum làpɛɛm akà baar bàfàlaküül anà làyamà ntɔn baar bàfàlatwee.
Isàkal naa mbuur kàmapà mbar u twam, fàlɛɛ twam lumwɛy. Isàkal naa mbuur kan'gyɔɔr inkur angye, twon amun'tsuŋ muwal kàzak angye.
Pà akà mbuur wanswà kan'lɔm, wɛɛ twon an'lɔm undiir angye akà mbuur kan'gyɔɔr wa.
Undiir wanswà akwen ngye naa baar bàkyer akà ngye, kyer abun sye akà baar bumwɛy.
Isàkal naa ngye afàkwen baar bàfakwen, ngye bweel nà an'wal uboo kwo? Baar abɛ sye bàfàkwen baar bàfakwen.
Isàkal naa ngye ubwaŋ afàkyer akà baar bàfakyer ubwaŋ, ngye bweel nà an'wal uboo kwo? Baar abɛ sye bàfàkyer abun.
Isàkal naa ngye afàsɔɔm baar an'sà ngye làkyän naa ba bàkyer asafuur, bweel nà ngye an'wal? Ntɔn baar abɛ sye bàfàpà akà baar abɛ ntɔn ba sye bàfàwal asànaa ban'pà ba.

Làkwen ayiiŋ abɛ, làkyer ubwaŋ, làpɛ ukɔɔn adil bweel. Waa bweel abɛ làsàkal làkölàköl, bɛ sye làsàkal baan a Mwol a du, ntɔn nde afàswaŋ ubwaŋ ande akà baar bàfàfuur ube kà ikal a ubwaŋ anà akà baar abɛ.
Làkäl baar aŋàyɔl a ukwen ntɔn Taaràbɛ wàŋàyɔl a ukwen.»
«Twon lan'tsüül baar nsaŋ, waa bɛ sye mpa bàsàlatsüül nsaŋ. Twon lan'pà baar ikwàndwà, waa bɛ sye mpa bàsàlapà ikwàndwà. Làdwääl nkul, waa bɛ sye bàsàladwääl nkul.

Làpɛ, waa bɛ bàsàlapà: bàsàyööl mpàkɔr a kölàköl a ipfɛy abɛ a mbäl aŋàbwaŋ, yàŋàkinà, yàŋàndyeer, yàŋàpää. Ntɔn Nzam an'kab ande akà bɛ nde asàsi unsà isii làfàsyääl bɛ ntɔn baar bumwɛy.»
Yɛsu kàfàtɛn a ba u itim naa: «Nkye ikwàmii kan'kwo musyen ikwàmii wumwɛy? Nkye ba bàbɔ̈ɔ̈l bàkàbwà anki u fu?
Un'lɔŋki ukwe anki mulyaaŋ un'lɔɔŋ ande. Wɛɛ un'lɔŋki afàsyääl ndaa a un'lɔɔŋ ande afàbulà asànaa un'lɔɔŋ ande.
Ntɔn nkye amanà ngye isɛrà a un'lɛŋ akyà u dii a un'tɔŋ angye, wɛ ngye amanà anki kyɔɔl là u dii angye?

Ngye an'kwo aben mutɛn a un'tɔŋ angye naa: "Un'tɔŋ, yà mɛ alwom isɛrà a un'lɛŋ ki u dii angye", ngye mbuur mpa akamanà kyɔɔl alà u dii angye? Mbuur a mpem yweel, twab atàlwom kyɔɔl là u dii angye, ungö apan ngye waa ayàman ubwaŋàbwaŋ ntɔn ngye alwom isɛrà a un'lɛŋ ki u dii a un'tɔŋ angye.»
Yɛsu kàfàtɛn naa: «Un'te aŋàbwaŋ ufàbɔr anki mbɛŋ ambe, un'te un'be sye ufàbɔr anki mbɛŋ aŋàbwaŋ.
Ntɔn un'te wanswà bàfàyöb unsà mbɛŋ a wa. Fige bàfàkwol anki unsà ibwiy a nsyeenà, rɛzɛ sye bàfàbwo anki u mikyɛl.
Mbuur aŋàbwaŋ afàwal ndaa aŋàbwaŋ unsà an'kyän aŋàbwaŋ màfàtoo u mpem ande, wɛɛ mbuur un'be afàwal ndaa a mbe unsà an'kyän ande mube. Ntɔn ndaa yanswà ufàtɛn mbuur ifàfà u mpem ande.»
«Wɛɛ Ntɔn nkye lan'beelà bɛ naa Mwol, Mwol, wɛɛ bɛ ndaa amɛ làfàlab anki?
Mɛ in'kyer ayàlàswaŋ naa mbuur afàwem ndaa amɛ anà afàsyääl ya, nde wà nà:

Nde wà asànaa mbuur kàkwen mutoŋ ndwà ande, kàkyer atim, ufàtim, waa kàmɛn nkɔŋ ntɔn musà un'bään a ntööŋ udu a nkɔŋ ayi. Mbul a ngwal kànɔ̈ wa, un'pöb a ngwal kàni wa ndwà ayin, wɛɛ ndwà ayin yàbü anki ntɔn ya bàtɔ̈ŋ udu a nkɔŋ.
Wɛɛ mbuur afàwem ndaa amɛ wɛɛ nde ya ufàsyääl anki, wà asànaa mbuur kàtɔ̈ŋ ndwà ande udu a ansɛŋ ukɔɔn un'bään, ibɔɔ a an'dà laa byà ni bya ndwà ayin, laa yàbwabà ya.»
Ungö mutɛn a baar ndaa yanswà kàkwen nde mutɛn, Yɛsu kàkyen Kapɛrnawum.
Un'tsüüŋ a kaptɛn mwɛy aŋità a Lɔmà kàfakweenà nde mbɔɔn kàkäl anà ukyal, tsütsü mukwà.
Mpal kàwem nde làsaŋ a Yɛsu, nde kàtöm abyääl a Ayudà ntɔn ba bàkun'bɔɔn naa nde uyàkɔɔr un'tsüüŋ ande.
Ba waa bàyi akà Yɛsu, bun'bɔ̈ɔ̈n, waa bàtɛn naa: «Mbuur wà kan'kwo muwal bweel aŋàkwo,
ntɔn nde afàkwen nsi abi, nde sye kàtöŋ ndwà a nköŋ abi a ngim ande ŋakwo.»

Yɛsu kàkyen anà ba. Mpal kàkäl nde tsütsü a ndwà a mbuur awun, mbuur wa kàtɔ̈m asam ande ntɔn mutɛn naa: «Mwol, twon an'pà ndür ngye mpay. Mɛ in'wà mbuur a man'be, mɛ in'kwe anki muwal ngye u ndwà amɛ.
Lalan mpa in'yi mɛ, mɛ ŋakwo. Tɛn ngɔk mwɛy ntɔn un'tsüüŋ amɛ ukɔɔrà.

Ntɔn mɛ ŋakwo in'wà mfum u ngyɛl, wɛɛ mɛ in'we anà aŋità in'fàler mɛ, mɛ in'sàtɛn a umwɛy naa: "Kyen", laa ukyà nde. Mɛ in'sàtɛn a wàsin naa: "Yà", laa uyà nde. Mɛ in'sàtɛn a un'tsüüŋ amɛ naa: "Kyer abà", laa ukyer nde.»
Mpal kàwem Yɛsu ndaa ayi, nde kàkyey kaptɛn awà, waa ubulà, uler baar banswà bàyun'labà, waa kàtɛn naa: «Mɛ, mɛ alàkyään, itàkal kà Isàlɛl mɛ ŋàtàman anki làkwikilà a mbɔɔn abà.»
Baar kàtöm kaptɛn, bàfurà ba ndwà ande, ba bàmɛn un'tsüüŋ ande wàŋàkɔɔrà.
Yàkäl naa ilä kyàlääb pa, Yɛsu kàkyen bul mwey ikɔb a la Nayin. Alɔŋki ande anà un'sɛŋ a baar bàkäl mukyà anà nde.
Mpal kàkäl nde tsütsü a bul alan, iköŋ a baar kyàkäl mukàdyee ndom, mwan baal mwɛy mpɛl wà un'kweel a un'dim mwɛy. Baar a bul alan mbɔɔn bàkäl anà nde.
Mpal kun'mɛn Mwol, ngyɛb yàkyer un'käär, waa kun'kyään naa: «Twon an'lel!»
Nde kàsin tsütsü a un'böl, waa kàbä wa. Baar bàyisyeenà wa laa bàmbär ba. Nde waa kàtɛn naa: «Mwan baal, mɛ amaswaŋ, wiyà!»
Ndom waa ubwaay, waa usɛmà muyäm. Yɛsu waa kun'fuur akà ngwän.
Baar banswà bàkäl u bɔɔmà anà musyäŋà Nzam, waa bàtɛɛnà naa: «Ŋangɔɔm a kölàköl kan'too uboo a bi, Nzam kan'yàbay baar ande.»
Làsaŋ a Yɛsu alà làkyer apää u Yuday lanswà anà kà an'bul a tsütsü manswà.
Alɔŋki a Ywan bàkyer un'kyäänà ndaa ayi.
Nde kàbel abɔ̈ɔ̈l uboo a ba, waa katöm akà Mwol ntɔn ba bun'fuul naa: «Nkye ngye awà Klistɔ awà ayàyà, lɛɛ bi ikyer adil wàsin?»
Mpal bàkɔlà ba apà Yɛsu, ba bàtɛn a nde naa: «Ywan Un'düümà kàmitɔm akà ngye ntɔn muyöb naa nkye ngye awà mbuur awayàyà, lɛɛ bi ikyer adil wàsin?»
Taaŋ nsil alan, Yɛsu waa ukɔɔr baar a an'kyal mbɔɔn, baar bàkäl anà an'too anà baar bàkäl anà an'dweelà an'be, waa uduub mii a ikwàmii mbɔɔn.

Nde kafuur abà: «Kàlun'kyään Ywan ndaa yanswà lan'man anà lan'wem bɛ: Ikwàmii bàmuman, ikar bàmumbarà, baar a ukyal a bay bàmupɔŋà, ikwan'tsü bàmuwem, ndom yàmuwiyà, ndaa a Nzam bàmulɔŋ akà aŋàlàmbwà.
Un'sak akà mbuur mpa asàpiy làkwikilà ande amu mɛ.»
Ungö a nkyeen a alɔŋki a Ywan, Yɛsu kàsɛmà mutà imbäl a Ywan: «Bɛ ininà làkàler u nsye a ipɔl? Kite a iful kànini un'pöb?
Wɛɛ bɛ ininà làkàler? Mbuur kàbwäärà a ntwɛn? Làler, baar bàfàbwaar ipfɛy a ntal anà bàfàkal unsà un'naaŋ, bàfàkal uboo a ndwà a amfum.
Bɛ ininà làkàler? Ŋangɔɔm mwɛy? Ndandaa mɛ alàkyään, nde kan'söön ŋangɔɔm.
Nde wà mbuur awà bàsön naa: "Le, mɛ an'tɔm un'kyeey amɛ kusà angye, ntɔn muyilà mbwo angye kusà a ngye."
«Mɛ alàkyään naa uboo a baar banswà kàbör un'kaar, akà umwɛy kàmusöön watɛy. Wɛɛ kimbuur ikikye uboo a Imwol a Nzam kàmun'söön.»
Baar banswà bàweemà ndaa ande, itàkal afüür a itɛr, bàkyer akyey naa Nzam wà balàbal, lalan bàkyeenà ba mukàwal ndüümà a Ywan.
Wɛɛ amfarisi anà alɔɔŋ a Un'kɔɔn bàtön ndaa kàkwen Nzam ntɔn ba anà ndüümà a Ywan.
Yɛsu kàfàtɛn naa: «Mɛ baar a taaŋ alà an'kwo mukasi anà nà? Ba bà asànaa bànà?
Ba bà asànaa baan bàfàmbàmbar u balàbal anà bàfàtɛn ba a ba naa: Bi kàlabɛɛrà mfuŋ, wɛɛ bɛ làkyen anki, bi kàlàtɔ̈ɔ̈l an'diim a ilel, wɛɛ bɛ làlel anki.
Ntɔn Ywan Un'düümà kàkyer ayà, kàdyee anki nsɔ, kànwee anki man, wɛɛ bɛ làtɛɛnà naa: Nde we anà dweelà a làbe.
Mwan a mbuur kan'yà, akyer adyà, akyer anwà, wɛɛ bɛ làtɛn naa: "Awà wà ndyeel anà un'nweel a man, un'sam a afüür a itɛr anà baar a man'be."
Wɛɛ an'yeerà a Nzam, baar bàfàman naa ma màbalàbal bà baar bàfàkyey ma.»
Yàmɛnà naa umfarisi mwɛy kàbel Yɛsu mukàdyà u ndwà ande. Yɛsu kàbilà nde u ndwà a mbuur awun, waa kàsɛmà mudyà u mɛsà.
U bul alan kàkäl anà un'kaar a pasàsɛ mwɛy. Mpal kàwem nde naa Yɛsu wàmudyà u ndwà a mbuur awun, nde kàyàbilà anà làbuuŋ a pɛɛl làŋàyɔl a may a usɔŋ,
nde kàbü ungö a Yɛsu kà in'kɔl ande. Nde kàkäl mulel, nsaaŋ ande yàbwee kà in'kɔl a Yɛsu, waa kàkɔɔmà ya a ntswe ande, kàndüürà mya, waa kàkiirà mya may a usɔŋ.

Un'mfarisi awà kàbel Yɛsu u ndwà ande kàmɛn nde abun, laa kàyweerà nde u mpem naa: «Mbuur wà ulàkal ŋangɔɔm a ndandaa, nde akyer alàyöb naa un'kaar awà wà nà, nde akyer alàyöb naa nde wà un'kaar a pasàsɛ.»
