Yɛsu kun'fuur u ndaa a dudu naa: «Simɔn, mɛ in'we anà kindaa muyäm anà ngye.» Nde kàfuur naa: «Un'lɔɔŋ, yäm.»
Yɛsu naa: «Ilä mwɛy un'pɛɛl a nkul mwɛy kàkäl anà asɔ̈ɔ̈m abɔ̈ɔ̈l. Wàtàtwɛb kàlun'fuur an'falà nkam tyeen, wàyweel an'falà an'kwem an'tyeen.
Baar abà bàbɔ̈ɔ̈l bàkäl anki anà ngim mukun'fuur. Nde waa kadwääl nkul. Uboo a baar abà bàbɔ̈ɔ̈l, nà ayun'kwen aŋàsöön?»
Simɔn kun'fuur naa: «Mɛ in'kasii naa mbuur awà kàdwääl nde nkul a mbɔɔn.» Yɛsu naa: «An'man, ngye an'yweer ubwaŋ.»

Ungö apan, Yɛsu waa uler un'kaar awun, waa utɛn a Simɔn naa: «Ngye akyun'manà un'kaar wà? In'bilà mɛ u ndwà angye, ngye an'dà an'pɛ anki muywɛy in'kɔl, wɛɛ nde, nde mya kan'ywɛy a nsaaŋ ande anà kan'kɔɔm mya a ntswe ande.
Ngye mɛ andüür anki, wɛɛ nde, sɛmà in'bilà mɛ nde uyɔ̈n anki mundüür in'kɔl amɛ.
Ngye mɛ may a usɔŋ an'tsüül anki kun'tswe, wɛɛ nde, nde kan'tsuul may a usɔŋ kà in'kɔl amɛ.
Lalan mɛ akyään naa bàkyun'dwääl nkul a man'be ande manswà, ntɔn nde kan'kwen mbɔɔn. Wɛɛ mbuur akwà bàmun'dwääl nkul a man'be ikikye, nde akwen sye ikikye.»
Waa nde kàtɛn a un'kaar awun naa: «Mɛ amadwääl nkul a man'be angye.»
Baar bumwɛy bàkäl anà nde bàtɛɛnà u mpem naa: «Mbuur awà wà nà, nde mudwääl baar nkul a man'be aba?»
Waa Yɛsu kàtɛn a un'kaar awun naa: «Làkwikilà angye làmatswà mɔ̈ɔ̈, kyen unsà duu.»
Yàkäl naa ungö a an'taaŋ, Yɛsu kàkyen uboo a an'bul a kölàköl anà an'bul ikikye ntɔn mulɔŋ anà mupay làsaŋ a Ndaa Aŋàbwaŋ yà Imwol a Nzam, alɔŋki bàkwem aŋiyweel bàkäl anà nde
anà akaar amwɛy kàkɔɔr nde unsà an'dweelà an'be anà an'kyal mà ifà ifà: Màlye bàfabeelà un'nsi Magàdala, uboo ande insɔŋà nsambwaar myàtoo,
Zyan, un'kyay a Shuzà mbuur a isal a Ɛlɔdi, Suzan, anà akaar asin bàyibayà Yɛsu anà alɔŋki ande unsà indiir aba.
Baar mbɔɔn bàfü an'bul a kölàköl bàyàköŋ apà Yɛsu. Nde katɛɛl nsim yi:
«Un'köön mwɛy kàtoo mukàkɔn mbɛŋ ande. Umpal kàmwɛŋ nde ya, yar làmwɛy làbü u mbwo: baar bàndyaar ya, nɛn a du waa yàdi ya.
Yar lumwɛy làbü udu a nkɔŋ: mpal yàmɛn ya, bite laa byàyöm bya, ntɔn mɛɛn màkäl màŋàyɔm.
Yar lumwɛy làbü uboo a nsyeenà: nsyeenà yàyɛl mbwo mwɛy anà in'te, waa yàfwee mya.
Yar lumwɛy làbü u mɛn aŋàbwaŋ: mpal làyɛl la, la làbör mbɛŋ mbɔɔn: imbɛŋ mwɛy kyàbör mbɛŋ nkam anà nkam.» Yɛsu waa kàkwɛy abà: «Wɛy mbuur awe anà an'tsü awem uwem.»
Alɔŋki ande bun'fuul naa nsim ayi iswaŋà aben.

Nde kafuur naa: «Bweel a bɛ là naa bɛ làkyàyöb ngyee a imwol a Nzam, wɛ akà baar bumwɛy, ndaa ayi bàfakyään unsà nsim. Ntɔn, "itàkal naa ba bàkyer aleerà, ba bàkɔ̈ɔ̈n aman, "itàkal naa ba bàkyer aweemà, ba bàkɔ̈ɔ̈n ayöb."»
«Mpalàbà làwem mbuul a nsim ayi: Mbɛŋ yà ndaa a Nzam.
Kɔl a mbwo, là baar bàfàwem ndaa a Nzam, wɛɛ Satanà waa uyàlwom ya u mpem aba ntɔn ba bàkɔ̈ɔ̈n asà làkwikilà anà bàkɔ̈ɔ̈n awà möö.

Udu a nkɔŋ yà baar bàfàwem ndaa a Nzam anà bàfàwal ya unsà un'sak, wɛɛ ba ya bàfàkaar anki u mpem aba, làkwikilà aba bwɛl latɛy. La in'swɛy myatɛy, isàkal naa mpay yan'yà, ba ban'piy làkwikilà aba.
Mbɛŋ yàbü u nsyeenà yà baar bàfàwem ndaa a Nzam, wɛɛ ba ya bàfàküünà a mpay anà ngyal a indiir a mɛɛn. Abun ya ifàbɔr anki mbɛŋ.
Mbɛŋ yàbü u mɛn aŋàbwaŋ yà baar bàfàwem ndaa a Nzam anà bàfàwal ya unsà un'sak, bàfàkaar ya u mpem aba anà bàfàsyääl ya. Ya ifàbɔr mbɛŋ.»
Yɛsu kàläb abà: «Akà mbuur mwey ukwe anki mukyä mwinà waa ukümà wa kantin, itàkal usi wa ungyɛl a itäb. Wɛɛ nde wa asà udu a ikɔlà a un'te ntɔn baar bàbilà u ndwà bàmɛn pɛɛlà.
Undiir wanswà wàŋàyee ŋàbawà, akyer asàmɛnà u pɛɛlà. Undiir wanswà wà unku, baar bàkyer asàyöb wa, wa sye asàmɛnà u leŋ.
Làlɛɛ an'tsü abɛ ntɔn muwem ubwaŋàbwaŋ, ntɔn bàsàkwɛy akà mbuur awe anà undiir, wɛ akà mbuur mpa awe anà undiir bàsàlwom undiir ufàsi nde naa nde we anà wa.»
Yàmɛnà naa ngwän anà atɔŋ a Yɛsu bàyi muyàbwey anà nde, wɛɛ yàkäl mpay ba mukun'man ntɔn baar bàkäl mbɔɔn.
Baar bun'kyään naa: «Ngwa anà atɔŋ angye bà unsà, ba bàkwen mukaman.»
Nde kafuur naa: «Maa anà atɔŋ amɛ bà baar bàfàwem ndaa a Nzam anà bàfàsyääl ya.»
Yàlɔ̈m naa ilä mwɛy, Yɛsu kàbilà u bwaar a kölàköl anà alɔŋki ande, waa kàtɛn a ba naa: «Tsweenà bi isabà sim a ɛwà.» Ba waa bàkyen.
Mpal bàkäl ba mubweel, Yɛsu waa kàbɔ̈ɔ̈n. Kà imbürà, un'pöb a ngwal kàyi udu a ɛwà. An'dà waa màsɛmà mubilà u bwaar, ba bàkäl u mpay a ukwà.

Alɔŋki bàsin tsütsü apà Yɛsu, waa bun'wiy anà in'kwɛŋ u mun: «Un'lɔɔŋ, Un'lɔɔŋ, bi abà ikwà!» Nde waa usubà, waa uŋän un'pöb anà ibɔ a kölàköl byà an'dà: bya waa byàkwamà, duu waa làbilà.

Apan, Yɛsu kàtɛn a alɔŋki ande naa: «Làkwikilà abɛ làken?» Wɛɛ ba bàkäl u bɔɔmà anà unsà ubem, ba bàtɛɛnà ba a ba naa: «Baal awà wà nà? Nde wàmuŋän un'pöb anà ibɔ a an'dà, bya sye byàmukun'weemà.»
Ba bàkɔlà u mɛɛn a Ngɛlàsà u sim a Ngalilɛ.

Pa kàtɔ̈l Yɛsu làkɔl u mɛɛn, mbuur mwɛy wà bul alan kàkäl anà insɔŋà mbɔɔn, nde kàyi akà Yɛsu. Sɛmà itaan nde kàkälà nsàpɔl. Nde kàkweenà anki mukal u ndwà, nde kàfabwaayà uboboo a an'dii.
Mpal kàmɛn nde Yɛsu, nde kabü kà in'kɔl ande, waa kàlal in'kwɛŋ mutɛn u ndaa a ngwal naa: «Yɛsu, Mwan a Nzam a Dudu, mɛ anà ngye un'tüüb nà? Mɛ amabɔɔn, twon aman'pà mpay.»

Yɛsu waa kàböŋ insɔŋà myàkäl uboo a mbuur awà. Ntɔn mya myun'bilà itaan. Ba bàfun'bäämà an'dwaaŋ anà impaaŋ a in'te kà an'kɔɔ anà kà in'kɔl ntɔn nde ukɔ̈ɔ̈n atiin. Wɛɛ nde kàkyer afatsuulà mya myanswà, insɔŋà myun'syeenà u nsye a ipɔl.
Yɛsu waa kun'fuul naa: «Ikɔb angye nà?» Nde kàfuur naa: «Un'kàbɔ.» Ntɔn insɔŋà mbɔɔn myàbilà amu ande.
Insɔŋà amin myàbɔ̈ɔ̈n Yɛsu naa nde ukɔ̈ɔ̈n akatɔm uboo a un'baan.
Wɛɛ tsütsü apan làkäl anà làböl a ngul làmuyidyà udu a mɔŋ, lalan myàlɔ̈m mya akà Yɛsu naa mya myàbilà uboo a ngul. Nde waa kapɛ mbwo.
Apan, insɔŋà myàtoo mya unsà mbuur awun, mya myàbilà u ngul ayin, làböl a ngul waa làparà ntiin fà iköl a mɔŋ, laa làkàbwà la kà an'dà, waa làminà.
Aseey bàmɛn ba abun, laa bàtiin ba, bàkyen ba mukàpay làsaŋ kà an'bul anà kà itsuŋ a ndwà.
Baar bàyi ntɔn muyöb naa ya yàlyaaŋ aben. Mpal bàyàtol ba tsütsü apà Yɛsu, bàmɛn ba ŋukɔŋ akyàbwaay kà in'kɔl a Yɛsu, akyàbwaar, akyàkal a duu, ba bàmɛn bɔɔmà.
Baar bàkäl paa mpal kàkɔɔr nde ŋukɔŋ, bàkyäänà baar naa nde kun'kɔɔr aben.
Kyakin baar a Ngɛlàsa banswà bàkäl ba u bɔɔmà, waa bàlɔ̈m akà Yɛsu mulwomà apà ba. Nde kàbilà u bwaar ntɔn mufurà.
Mbuur awà kàkɔɔrà unsà an'dweelà an'be kàlɔ̈m akà Yɛsu naa nde uyilyaaŋ anà nde, wɛɛ Yɛsu kun'fuur naa:
«Furà ndwà angye, kyen kakyään ndaa yanswà kan'kyer Nzam akà ngye.» Lalan mbuur awà kàkàpay nde làsaŋ a ndaa yanswà kàkyer Yɛsu akà nde u bul lanswà.
Mpal kàfurà Yɛsu Ngalilɛ, baar banswà bun'wɛl unsà ubwaŋ banswà, ntɔn ba bàkäl mukun'dilà.
Apan mbuur mwɛy ikɔb ande Zayirɔs laa kàyi nde. Nde kàkäl mfum a ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà. Nde kàbü kà in'kɔl a Yɛsu, waa kun'bɔ̈ɔ̈n naa nde ukyen ndwà ande:
mwan ande mwɛy mpɛl wà un'kaar wà tsütsü mbul kwem aŋiyweel kàkäl musyäämà mɔ̈ɔ̈. Yɛsu waa kàkyen ndwà a mbuur awun. Apan, baar mbɔɔn bàyibääbà u mbil a ndür ande.
Uboo a baar aban kàkäl anà un'kaar mwɛy kàyimanà an'kil mbul kwem aŋiyweel. Nde kàdwä ngim mbɔɔn akà angaŋ, wɛɛ nde kàkɔɔra anki.
Nde kàsin tsütsü ungö a Yɛsu, waa kun'bä u làpan a ipfɛy ande. Taaŋ nsil alan an'kil laa màtsü ma mutoo.
Yɛsu waa kàfuul naa: «Nà kàman'ba?» Wɛɛ akà mbuur mwɛy kàkyey anki. Petɔlà waa kàtɛn a nde naa: «Ambà Un'lɔɔŋ, baar bàmasà uboboo, bà mbɔɔn bà imbäm'dir anà ngye.»
Nde waa kàtɛn naa: «Mbuur akyer an'ba: mɛ in'kyer awem naa dweelà a ngwal mwɛy lan'too u ndür amɛ.»

Un'kaar awun kàmɛn nde naa undiir kàkyer nde kan'mɛnà u mii a baar, laa kàsin nde tsütsü apà Yɛsu, kàbü nde kà inkɔl ande, waa kàtɛn u mii a baar ntɔn nkye kun'bä nde anà muswaŋ naa taaŋ nsil alan nde waa kàkɔɔrà.
Yɛsu kàtɛn a nde naa: «Mangwa, làkwikilà angye làmatswà mɔ̈ɔ̈, kyen unsà duu.»
Nde kàkäl anki aŋàtàmay mutɛn mpal kàyi mbuur kàfü ndwà a mfum a ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà. Waa kun'kyään naa: «Mwan angye wà unkaar kan'kwà, twon afun'twääl Un'lɔɔŋ nkwom.»
Mpal kàwem Yɛsu abwɛy, nde kàtɛn a Zayirɔs naa: «Twon an'man bɔɔmà, sà làkwikilà mpɛl, mwan angye akyer akɔɔrà.»
Mpal kàkɔlà nde, Yɛsu kàkwen anki naa baar asin bàbilà u ndwà, wɛ Petɔlà, Ywan, Zyak, taar anà ngwän a mwan mpɛl.
Ntsü yanswà baar bàkäl mulel. Yɛsu waa kàtɛn naa: «Twon lan'lel, nde ukü anki, nde kan'bɔ̈ɔ̈n twaal.»
Wɛɛ ba bàkyer un'sɛɛ, ntɔn ba bàkyer ayöbà naa nde kàkäl aŋàkwà.
Apan, Yɛsu kàtɛ kɔɔ a kimwan un'kaar awun mpi, waa kàtɛn a nde u ndaa a ngwal naa: «Mwan amɛ, wiyà!»
Laa kàwiyà nde, waa kàmbarà. Yɛsu kàswɛŋ naa ba bun'pɛ udyà.
Aböör a mwan un'kaar awun matɛɛr màkyer awal. Wɛɛ Yɛsu katsüŋ mukyään mbuur asin ndaa ayin.
Yɛsu kàtüüb antööm bàkwem aŋiyweel, waa kapɛ ngwal anà ikɔ̈b muböŋ insɔŋà myanswà anà mukɔɔr an'kyal.
Ungö apan, waa katöm mukàpay làsaŋ a Imwol a Nzam anà mukɔɔr an'kyal.
Nde kàtɛn a ba naa: «Twon lan'wal undiir ntɔn mbwo: itàkal unsɔk, itàkal ngɔɔr, itàkal isaa, itàkal ngim. Twon lan'syen inkur byeel.
Isàkal naa bàmàlawal u ndwà mwɛy, làbwaay apan tii taaŋ làsàlwomà bɛ kà ikal akin.
Isàkal naa mbuur kàlawɛl anki, làlwomà u bul alan, sàlàkɔɔb un'twà a in'kɔl abɛ: kya isàkal imbäl ibe ntɔn ba.»
Apan, alɔŋki bàkyen ba, ba bàyilyaaŋà bul a bul muyikyään Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ anà muyikɔɔr abɛy.
Mfum Ɛlɔdi kàwem nde ndaa ayi yanswà, nde kàyweerà naa nde akyer aben. Ntɔn baar mbɔɔn bàtɛɛnà naa Ywan kan'wiyà,
bumwɛy naa Ԑlya kan'fàmɛnà, wɛɛ bumwɛy naa umwɛy uboo a aŋangɔɔm bà itaan kan'wiyà.
Wɛɛ Ɛlɔdi kàtɛɛnà naa: «Mɛ Ywan kàkyun'tsul un'tswe: nà mbuur wa in'fiweemà mɛ làsaŋ a tub lalɛy?» Nde kàleŋà mukun'man.
Mpal bàyàfurà antööm, ba bàkyäänà Yɛsu indiir byanswà bàkyer ba. Nde kawɛl, waa kasyen ukɔl, u bul mwɛy ikɔb a la Bɛtesayidà.
Baar mbɔɔn bàyöb ba naa Yɛsu anà alɔŋki ande bà u bul alan, laa baläb ba. Yɛsu kawɛl nde, laa kakyäänà nde ndaa a imwol a Nzam. Nde kàkɔɔr sye baar bàkäl anà ngyal akɔɔrà.

Mpal bàmɛn antööm bàkwem aŋiyweel naa taaŋ lan'sɛmà muminà, ba bàsin tsütsü apà Yɛsu, waa bun'kyään naa: «Apay baar, ba bàkyen kà an'bul anà u bitsuŋ a ndwà byà tsütsü ntɔn ba bàkàleŋ ikal abɔ̈ɔ̈n anà isaa adyà ntɔn bi apà ibà u nsye a ipɔl.»
Yɛsu waa kafuur naa: «La pɛ udyà bɛ ŋakwo.» Ba waa bun'fuur naa: «Bi iwe amà mampà tyeen anà nsö yweel, tɛn naa bi ŋakwo ikàsom isaa ntɔn mbul a baar wà.»
Abaal bàkäl isii a nsaab tyeen. Yɛsu naa: «Làswɛŋ baar bàbwaay an'kwem an'tyeen, an'kwem an'tyeen.»
Ba bàkyer abun, bàpɛ baar banswà ikal abwaay.
Yɛsu kàwɛl mampà mà an'tyeen anà nsö yàyweel, waa kàler u du, kàfuur an'tɔɔn akà Nzam. Ungö apan waa kàtsül mampà anà nsö, waa kàpɛ alɔŋki ande ntɔn mupà akà baar banswà.
Baar banswà waa bàdi, bàyüür. Itiir a mampà byàsäl mbɔↄn, bya byàyööl in'lwaŋ kwem aŋiyweel.
Ilä mwɛy Yɛsu kàkäl muyamà u mpey anà alɔŋki ande, waa kafuul naa: «Baar bàfàtɛn naa mɛ in'wà nà?»
Ba bàfuur naa: «Ywan Un'düümà, bumwɛy, Ԑlya, bumwɛy, umwɛy uboo a aŋangɔɔm kan'wiyà.»
Nde waa kafuul naa: «Wɛɛ bɛ ŋakwo làtɛn naa mɛ in'wà nà?» Petɔlà waa kàfuur naa: «Ngye awà Klistɔ a Nzam.»
Yɛsu katsüŋ mukyään mbuur akà ikikye.
Nde waa kàfàkwɛy naa: «Mwan a mbuur akyer aman mpay mbɔɔn. Andweer, amfum a angaŋ anà alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn bàkyer un'tɔn, bàkyer un'dwa, waa ilä kyàtär nde akyer awiyà.»
Ungö, nde waa kàtɛn akà baar banswà: «Isàkal naa mbuur akwen mukan'lab, wɛy nde ukɔɔb ndür ande, usɛn buur ande ilä byanswà, wɛy nde kan'läb.
Ntɔn mbuur usàkwen muyee möö ande, wa asàkyà bwà. Wɛɛ mbuur usàpiy möö ande ntɔn mɛ, nde asàtswà wa.
Bweel nà mbuur kan'kwo muwal isàkal naa nde kan'wal mɛɛn manswà, wɛɛ mɔ̈ɔ̈ ande ukyà bwà?
Mbuur usàwem mɛ nswɛn anà ndaa amɛ, Mwan a mbuur sye asun'wem nswɛn mpal usàyà nde unsà làkoo ande anà là Taa anà là akyeey in'kyɛɛl.
Ndandaa mɛ alàkyään, bàmbɔɔn uboo abɛ bàyàkal aŋàtàkwà anki kusà muman Imwol a Nzam.»
Kà isii a ilä naan ungö a ndaa ayi, Yɛsu kàwɛl Petɔlà, Ywan anà Zyak, nde kàlär udu a mɔŋ ntɔn mukàyamà.
Mpal kàkäl nde muyamà, ntabwey ande waa yàsɔɔmà, ipfɛy ande kyàbulà kyà in'ŋyäŋ a pɛɛl.
Apan, baar bɔ̈ɔ̈l bàkäl muyääm anà nde, ba bàkäl Mɔsɛ anà Ԑlya,
ban'yàmɛnà uboo a làkoo, bàmuyäämà ndaa ukàmay Yɛsu isal ande u Yɛlusàlɛm u mbwo a nkweel ande.
Petɔlà anà bumwɛy bàkäl anà nde bàbɔ̈ɔ̈n twaal aŋàkir. Umpal bàsubà ba, ba bàmɛn làkoo a Yɛsu anà baar bööl bàkäl anà nde.

Umpal bàkaabà baar aban anà Yɛsu, Petɔlà kàtɛn a nde naa: «Un'lɔɔŋ, yà ubwaŋ naa bi ikäl apà, bi imbaar ntɛn, ntɛn tär: mwɛy ntɔn ngye, mwɛy ntɔn Mɔsɛ anà mwɛy ntɔn Ԑlya.» Kutɛn aŋàbwaŋ nde kàyöb anki undiir kàtɛɛnà nde.
Umpal kàkäl nde mutɛn, un'böŋ mwɛy waa kafwee. Alɔŋki bàkäl u bɔɔmà mpal bàmɛn ba naa ba ban'bilà uboo a un'böŋ.
Uboo a un'böŋ ndaa waa itoo, waa itɛn naa: «Awà mwan amɛ, mwan kàsɔ̈ɔ̈l mɛ. Lun'wem!»
Ungö a ndaa ayi, ba bàsàman Yɛsu aŋàyen mpɛl. Wɛɛ mpal ayin, ndaa ayi yanswà ba bàkäärà u mpem, ba akà mbuur mwɛy bàkyään anki.
Taaŋtyà, ba bàkäl muyàtyà u mɔŋ, baar mbɔɔn bàyi mubwey a Yɛsu.
Waa le, uboo a baar abà, mbuur mwɛy kàlal in'kwɛŋ: «Un'lɔɔŋ, mɛ amabɔɔn, un'ler mwan baal amɛ! Mwan baal mwɛy awà mpɛl.
Dweelà a làbe làsun'bilà, kà imbürà nde asà in'kwɛŋ, laa lun'bwiy la, waa ugyɔrà an'te. La làfun'wɛy anki agyä, nde afàkwà lɛy.
Mɛ an'bɔɔn alɔŋki angye naa ba bun'böŋ, wɛɛ ba bàsàkwo anki.»
Yɛsu waa kaŋän: «Bɛ làbà baar làkɔ̈ɔ̈n làkwikilà, baar abe! mɛ anà bɛ ilä ikwɛ in'yàfàkal anà mukàlakaar?» Waa ubulà akà mbuur awun: «Un'twääl mwan angye!»
Umpal kàkäl mwan musin tsütsü apà Yɛsu, dweelà a làbe lun'bwiy u mɛɛn, lun'ni a ngwal. Wɛɛ Yɛsu kàŋän dweelà a làbe, waa kàkɔɔr mwan awun, kun'fuur akà taarànde.
Baar banswà bàkäl unsà ubem muman ibaŋ a Nzam. Mbuur wanswà kàkäl mubem ndaa kàkyerà Yɛsu, nde kàtɛn a alɔŋki ande naa:
«Làkäär ndaa alàkyään mɛ yi apanà: Mwan a mbuur bàkyer ayun'yälà kà an'kɔɔ a baar.»
Wɛ alɔŋki ande bàyöb anki ndaa ayi. Mbuul a ya bàkyer ayee ntɔn ba bàkɔ̈ɔ̈n ayöb. Ba bàmɛn bɔɔmà mufuul Yɛsu mbuul a ya.
Isür kyàkyer abilà uboo a antööm: ba bàkwen muyöb naa nà kan'söön uboo a ba.
Yɛsu kàyöb nde an'kyän aba, nde kàtɛ mwan umbɛy mpi u kɔɔ, kun'si tsütsü apà nde,
waa kàtɛn a ba naa: «Mbuur awal mwan wà kà ikɔb amɛ, nde kan'wal mɛ ŋakwo, waa mbuur kàman'wal, nde kan'wal mbuur kan'töm. Ntɔn mbuur awà ikikye uboo abɛ, nde awun awà mbuur a kölàköl.»
Ywan waa kàsɛmà mutɛn naa: «Un'lɔɔŋ, bi kàmɛn mbuur mwɛy wàmuböŋ an'dweelà an'be kà ikɔb angye, wɛɛ bi kun'tsüŋ mukyer abun ntɔn nde ngye ufalab anki anà bi.»
Yɛsu waa kàfuur naa: «Twon làmutsuŋ, ntɔn mbuur mpa afàtɔn bɛ, nde wà anà bɛ.»
Taaŋ a Yɛsu mulwomà u mɛɛn làkäl tsütsü mukwo, nde kàsi ukwen mbɔɔn mukyà Yɛlusàlɛm.
Nde kàtöm akyeey kusà ande. Mpal bàkäl ba u mbwo, ba bàbilà u bul mwɛy là Samalya ntɔn mukun'yiil ikal.
Wɛɛ baar a Samalya bàtön mukun'wal ntɔn nde kàkäl mukyà Yɛlusàlɛm.
Mpal bàmɛn ba abun, alɔŋki ande Zyak anà Ywan bun'lɔ̈ɔ̈m naa: «Mwol, ipɛ mbwo bi iswɛŋ ipar a mbaa ifi du, kyabweel, waa ba bàkuŋà.»
Wɛɛ Yɛsu kàbulà nde ntsü bàkäl ba, waa kaŋän.
Waa ba bàkyen bul asin.
Mpal bàkäl ba u mbwo, mbuur mwɛy kàyi nde, kàtɛn a Yɛsu naa: «Mɛ in'kyer ayalab ntsü yanswà ayàkyà ngye.»
Yɛsu waa kun'fuur naa: «In'kyɛŋ mye anà an'fu, nɛn a du ye anà an'yaab, wɛ Mwan a mbuur ikal musà un'tswe kyatɛy.»
Yɛsu waa kàtɛn a mbuur mwɛy naa: «Yan'läb!» Mbuur awà waa kàtɛn a nde naa: «Mwol, an'pɛ mbwo mɛ in'tàkàdyee taa.»
Yɛsu waa kun'fuur naa: «Wɛy akü bàdyee akü aba. Wɛɛ ngye, kyen kapay làsaŋ a Imwol a Nzam!»
Mbuur asin waa kàtɛn a nde naa: «Mɛ in'kyer ayalab, wɛɛ ngye tan'pà mbwo mɛ in'kàpà atɔŋ amɛ mbɔr a ntsüü.»
Yɛsu waa kun'fuur naa: «Mbuur kan'sà kɔɔ ande mulem ywaŋ ande anà kan'wɛy la ntɔn mukyer undiir asin, nde ukwe anki uboo a Imwol a Nzam.»
Ungö apan, Yɛsu kàfàsɔɔl alɔŋki bumwɛy an'kwem nsambwaar aŋiyweel, waa katöm abɔ̈ɔ̈l abɔ̈ɔ̈l, ntɔn ba bàkyen kusà ande uboo a an'bul anà ntsü yanswà kàkwe nde mubilà.
Nde waa kàtɛn a ba naa: «Isaa uboo a ywaŋ byà mbɔɔn, wɛɛ baar abwo bya bà ikikye. Làlɔ̈m akà Mwol ŋaywaŋ mutɔm baar a isal mbɔɔn ntɔn ba bàbwe bya.
Làkyen: mɛ amàlatɔm asànaa baan a in'kɔk uboo a nkwee.
Twon lan'syen ngim, itàkal ngɔɔr, itàkal an'sàbar, wɛɛ twon lan'mbar u mbwo ntɔn muyipà baar mbɔr.
U ndwà yanswà làbilà bɛ, tàlatɛɛnà naa: "Wɛy duu làkäl udu a ndwà yi."
Isàkal naa we anà mbuur a duu u ndwà ayin, duu abɛ làyàbwaay udu ande, naa tɛy, duu làyàfurà akà bɛ.
Làkäl u ndwà ayin, làdi, lànü undiir wanswà bàlapà ba, ntɔn mbuur a isal afàwal làfur ande. Twon lan'kyà ndwà a ndwà.
U bul lanswà làbilà bɛ isàkal naa bàmàlawal, làdi undiir wanswà bàlapà ba,
làkɔɔr abɛy, lakyään naa: "Imwol a Nzam kyan'sin tsütsü apà bɛ."
Wɛɛ u bul lanswà làbilà bɛ, isàkal naa bàlawɛl anki, làkyen unsà an'balàbal ala, làtɛn naa:
Bi kan'kɔɔb un'twà a bul abɛ kan'dyaar bi kà in'kɔl, wɛɛ làyöb naa Imwol a Nzam kyà tsütsü.
Mɛ alàkyään naa ilä a nsaŋ, Sɔdɔm bàsun'pa anki mpay aŋàsöönà mpay a baar a bul alan.»

«Ngyɛb akà ngye Kɔrazin! Ngyɛb akà ngye Bɛtesayidà! Ntɔn, ilàkal naa impà bàkyer akà bɛ, bàkyer u Tir anà u Sidɔn, abà itaan baar aba bàkyàbuul mpem, bàkyàbwaar ngɔɔr anà bàkyàkübà un'twà.
Lalan ilä a nsaŋ, Tir anà Sidɔn mpay a mbɔɔn bàsapà anki asànaa bàsàpà ba bɛ.
Waa ngye, ngye Kapɛrnawum, ngye akasii naa ngye asàlaar du? Ngye asàtyà an'lɔŋ!
Mbuur usàwem bɛ, nde mɛ kan'wem, mbuur usàlapiy, nde mɛ kan'piy. Wɛɛ mbuur apiy mɛ, nde kan'piy mbuur kan'töm.»
Alɔŋki an'kwem nsambwaar aŋiyweel bàyàfurà unsà un'sak, waa bàtɛn naa: «Mwol, kà ikɔb angye itàkal insɔŋà bàkyer akà iweemà.»
Yɛsu waa kafuur naa: «Mɛ kàkimanà Satanà kàbwee nde fà du asànaa munyä.
Le, Mɛ akyàlapà ikɔ̈b mundyaar udu a ntäy anà nye, anà udu a imfum a Satanà, wɛɛ akà undiir mwɛy ukwe anki mukyer bɛ ube.
Wɛɛ bɛ twon lan'man un'sak naa insɔŋà myàkyer alàwem, wɛɛ bɛ làmɛn un'sak naa ikɔb abɛ ban'sɔn u du.»

Taaŋ nsil alan, u mbwo a Dweelà In'kyɛɛl, Yɛsu kàyöl a un'sak, waa kàtɛn naa: «Taa, Mwol a du anà mɛɛn, mɛ amasyäŋà, ntɔn kàyee ngye indiir abi akà aŋayeerà anà akà aŋuyɛnà, wɛɛ ngye bya kàswɛŋ akà baan ambɛy. Ɛɛ, Taa, ngye kàkwen naa ya ikäl abà.»

«Taaràmɛ kàkyan'pà indiir byanswà, wɛɛ akà mbuur mwɛy tɛy uyöb Mwan, isàkal naa kà Taa anki, anà mbuur mwɛy tɛy uyöb Taa, isàkal naa kà Mwan anki anà mbuur kan'kwen Mwan mukyään ndaa ayi.»
Ungö apan, waa kàbulà ntsü bàkäl alɔŋki ande, waa kàtɛn a ba mpɛl naa: «Un'sak mbɔɔn akà mii ikamanà ndaa làmanà bɛ yi!
Ntɔn mɛ alàkyään naa aŋangɔɔm anà amfum mbɔɔn bàkwen muman ndaa làmanà bɛ yi, wɛɛ ba ya bàsàman anki, muwem ndaa làweemà bɛ yi, wɛɛ ba ya bàsàwem anki.»
Un'lɔɔŋ a un'kɔɔn mwɛy kàmbarà ntɔn mulwab Yɛsu ndaa, waa kàtɛn naa: «Un'lɔɔŋ, ininà mɛ in'kyer ntɔn muwal möö a mbul a in'tye?»
Yɛsu kun'fuur naa: «Uboo a un'kɔɔn ininà bàsön? Ngye akataŋà aben?»
Nde kàfuur naa: «Ngye ayàkwen Mwol, Nzam angye, unsà mpem angye yanswà, unsà mɔ̈ɔ̈ angye wanswà, unsà ngwal angye yanswà, unsà an'kyän angye manswà, anà un'tɔŋ angye asànaa ngye ŋakwo.»
Yɛsu waa kàtɛn a nde naa: «Ngye an'fuur ubwaŋ. Kyer abun, waa ngye ayàkal anà möö.»
Wɛɛ nde kàkwen muwal iböŋ anà mufuul Yɛsu naa: «Un'tɔŋ amɛ nà?»
Yɛsu waa kàfuur naa: «Mbuur mwɛy kàfü Yɛlusàlɛm mutyà Yɛlikɔ. Baar abɛ laa bun'käär ba, bàgyɔɔr ba indiir ande byanswà, bun'düb ba, bàkyen ba anà bàsun'wɛy ba tsütsü a ukwà.
Ngaŋ mwɛy kàkäl mutyà u mbwo ayin. Mpal kàmɛn nde mbuur awun, nde kàlyaaŋ ukɔl.
Un'lɛvi mwɛy sye kàkɔlà kà ikal akin, kun'mɛn nde, waa kàköl.
Wɛɛ un'samàlya mwɛy kàkäl u mbwo ande mulyaaŋ. Mpal kàmɛn nde mbuur awà, ngyɛb laa yun'käär yà.
Nde kàsin tsütsü, kun'bäm ipfɛy kà iwà ande, kun'tyaŋ may anà man, waa kun'si udu a mpoonà ande, kun'syen u ndwà a angyey, waa kun'bay.

Taaŋtyà nde kàwɛl ndiim yweel, laa kàpɛ nde ya akà ŋandwà a angyey, waa kàtɛn a nde naa: "Sun'bay mbuur wà, isàkal naa ngye an'sàtwey ngim mbɔɔn yan'söön yi, mɛ in'yafuur umpal in'yàfurà mɛ."
«Uboo a baar abà batär, nà awà un'tɔŋ a mbuur kàbü wà kà an'kɔɔ a baar abe?»
Un'lɔɔŋ a un'kɔɔn waa kun'fuur naa: «Mbuur akwà kun'wem ngyɛb.» Yɛsu naa: «Kyen, ngye sye kakyer abun.»
Umpal kàkäl Yɛsu u mbwo anà alɔŋki ande, nde kàbilà u bul mwɛy, un'kaar mwɛy ikɔb ande Màtà kawɛl u ndwà ande.
Nde kàkäl anà un'tɔŋ ande wà un'kaar ikɔb ande Màlye. Mwan un'kaar awà kàbwaay kà in'kɔl a Mwol ntɔn muweemà ndaa ande.

An'kyän a Màtà manswà màkäl mukyer isal a ifà ifà, laa kàyàmɛnà nde kà ikal kàkäl Yɛsu, waa kàtɛn a nde naa: «Mwol, ngye ube akamanà anki naa un'tɔŋ amɛ kàman'sööl isal byanswà aŋayen? Un'swɛŋ nde uyan'bay.»
Mwol waa kun'fuur naa: «Màtà, Màtà, ngye akamanà mpay anà akayoolàyoolà ntɔn indiir mbɔɔn.
Wɛɛ, undiir mwɛy awà ndöŋ. Kyakin Màlye kan'sɔɔl kab aŋàbwaŋ mpa bàsun'lwom.»
Yàmɛnà naa ilä mwɛy Yɛsu kàkäl muyamà kà ikal mwɛy. Umpal kàmay nde, un'lɔŋki ande mwɛy kàtɛn a nde naa: «Mwol, ilɔŋ muyamà asànaa Ywan kàlɔŋ nde alɔŋki ande.»
Nde waa kàtɛn a ba naa: «Mpal làyamà bɛ, làtɛn abà: "Taa! Wɛy ikɔb angye ikäl kyà in'kyɛɛl, wɛy imwol angye iyi.
Ipɛ ŋàbà isaa abi byà ilä a ilä.
Idwääl nkul asànaa ifàdwääl bi nkul akà baar bàfikyer ube. Twon an'pà mbwo naa bi ibilà u ndɛb."»
Nde waa kàfàtɛn a ba naa: «Isàkal naa umwɛy uboo a bɛ we anà un'sam, waa nde ukyen akà nde uboboo a mpib ntɔn mulɔm akà nde naa. "Un'sam, nsɔɔm nsɔ tär,
ntɔn un'sam amɛ mwɛy kan'fà kwɛl, kan'yàkɔlà apanà u ndwà amɛ, wɛɛ mɛ undiir un'pà watɛy."
Wɛɛ, isàkal naa uboo a ndwà ande un'sam ande awun kan'fuur naa: "Twon aman'sà lingyoomà, ibeenà kyàŋàbäm, baan amɛ anà mɛ ŋakwo ibaŋàbɔ̈ɔ̈n, mɛ in'fàsubà anki ntɔn mupà ngye nsɔ."
Ndandaa mɛ alàkyään, isàkal naa nde usubà anki mukun'pà ya ntɔn nde wà un'sam ande, nde akyer ayàsubà mukun'pà undiir wanswà awe nde awà mfun ntɔn un'sam ande wàmusà muküünà.
Wɛɛ mɛ, mɛ alàkyään naa: Làlɔ̈m, waa bàlapà. Làleŋ, waa bɛ làyàman. Làbɛɛrà, waa bàyàladuub.
Ntɔn mbuur wanswà afàlɔm akyer afàwal, mbuur afàleŋ akyer afàman, anà bàfàduub akà mbuur afàbɛɛrà.
Isàkal naa umwɛy uboo a bɛ wà taa, nkye nde kan'kwo mupà mwan ande ntäy isàkal naa nde kàmulɔ̈ɔ̈m nsö?
Itàkal naa nde kan'lɔm kyà, waa nde kun'pà lànye?
Isàkal naa bɛ baar abe làkyàyöb mupà baan abɛ indiir aŋàbwaŋ, wɛɛ Taa u du waa mpa upà Dweelà In'kyɛɛl akà baar bàmulɔ̈ɔ̈m?»
Yàlɔ̈m naa ilä mwɛy Yɛsu kàböŋ unsɔŋà mwɛy kàbuulà mbuur mwɛy nkiin. Ungö a ntoo a unsɔŋà awun, nkiin waa kàsɛmà musà ndaa, baar banswà bàkäl unsà ubem.
Wɛɛ baar bumwɛy uboo a ba bàtɛɛnà naa: «Nde ayisyääl ikɔ̈b a Bɛlzebul, mfum a insɔŋà, ntɔn muböŋ insɔŋà.»
Baar bumwɛy waa bàlɔ̈m naa nde ukyer impà kyan'fà du ntɔn mukun'si.
Yɛsu abà kàyöb nde an'kyän aba, waa kàtɛn a ba naa: «Imwol kyanswà kye anà nkaabà uboo a kya, kya ikyer afàpää: Ndwà ibwà udu a ndwà yumwɛy.
Isàkal naa Satanà wà un'yiiŋ ande ŋakwo, imwol ande iyàtsim aben? Ntɔn bɛ làtɛɛnà naa mɛ in'kaböŋà insɔŋà kà ikɔ̈b a Bɛlzebul.
Isàkal naa mɛ insɔŋà in'kaböŋà kikɔ̈b a Bɛlzebul, baan abɛ insɔŋà bàfàböŋ kà ikɔ̈b a nà? Lalan ba ŋakwo bàsàkal atsüül a nsaŋ abɛ.
Wɛɛ, isàkal naa mɛ insɔŋà in'yiböŋ a làpin a Nzam, iswaŋà naa imwol a Nzam kyàkyàtol akà bɛ.
Uman naa mbuur a ngwal awe anà an'tà màŋàkwo wàmuler ndwà ande, indiir ande mbuur uyàba anki.
Wɛɛ, isàkal naa mbuur asin kàmun'söön u ngwal kan'yà, kan'wal iböŋ udu ande, nde kun'gyɔɔr an'tà ande manswà kàsyee nde làkyän, waa ukab indiir byanswà kàmun'gyɔɔr nde.
«Mbuur mpa awà anà mɛ nde wà un'yiiŋ amɛ, wɛɛ mbuur mpa ayàtüüb anà mɛ ntɔn muböbà, nde wàmupay.
«Isàkal naa dweelà a làbe lan'too uboo a mbuur, la làfàkyà nsye a ipɔl muleŋ ikal akàyöör. La usàkɔɔn aman ikal ayöör laa làtɛn la naa: "Mɛ in'furà ndwà amɛ kàfü mɛ."
Mpal làyàfurà la, la làsàman ya yàŋàkɔɔm, indiir byanswà byàŋayöŋà ubwaŋàbwaŋ,
laa ukyà nde, ukàwal nde an'dweelà nsambwaar mà mun'söön u nkyɛl, ma màbilà u ndwà, waa màbwaay. Apan mpay a mbuur awà laa isöönà ya mpay yàtàtwɛb.»
Yàmɛnà naa mpal kàkäl Yɛsu mutɛɛnà abwɛy, un'kaar mwɛy kàmbarà uboo a baar, waa kàtɛn u ndaa a ngwal naa: «Un'sak akà un'kaar kakäär kà an'bäl ande anà kanüü an'bɛɛl ande!»
Nde waa kàfuur naa: «Aay, un'sak aŋasöönà akà baar bàweemà ndaa a Nzam anà bàsyäälà ya.»
Umpal ban'yàköŋ baar apà Yɛsu, nde kàsɛmà mutɛn naa: «Baar a mpalàbà bà baar abe: ba bàlɔɔmà idiim, wɛɛ ba idiim asin bàman anki, idiim nsil kyà Yɔnas.
Lalan, asànaa Yɔnas kàkäl nde idiim ntɔn baar a Ninive, abun sye Mwan a mbuur uyàkal nde idiim ntɔn baar a mpalàbà.

Kà ilä a nsaŋ, mfum a ngyɛl wà un'kaar akyer asàmbarà kusà a baar a mpalàbà ntɔn mukapà ikwàndwà, ntɔn nde kàfü ntsü a kwɛl muyàwem an'yeerà a Salɔmun. Wɛɛ apà we anà mbuur kan'söön Salɔmun.

Kà ilä a nsaŋ, baar a Ninive bàkyer asàmbarà kusà a baar a mpalàbà ntɔn mukapà ikwàndwà, ntɔn baar a Ninive bàbuul mpem umpal bàwem ba an'lɔɔŋ a Yɔnas. Wɛɛ apà we anà mbuur kan'söön Yɔnas!
«Akà mbuur mwɛy ukwe anki mukyä mwinà waa nde uyee wa, itàkal naa nde usi wa u ngyɛl a kantin. Wɛɛ nde wa asà udu a un'te bàfàsà mwinà ntɔn baar bàbilà u ndwà bàmɛn pɛɛlà.
Mii angye myà mwinà a ndür angye: isàkal naa mii angye myà ubwaŋ, ndür angye yanswà ikal uboo a pɛɛlà, wɛɛ mii angye isàkal anà ukyal, ndür angye yanswà ikal uboo a làpib.
Duub mii angye ubwaŋàbwaŋ, wɛy pɛɛlà a ndür angye làkɔ̈ɔ̈n abwà làpib.
Abun, isàkal naa ndür angye yanswà yà uboo a pɛɛlà, akà ikal mwɛy kyatɛy uboo a làpib, ya yanswà iyàkal uboo a pɛɛlà, asànaa mwinà ufàpà wa ngye ŋakwo pɛɛlà a in'ŋyäŋ ande.»
Yàmɛnà naa mpal kàmay Yɛsu mutɛn, umfarisi mwɛy kun'bel ntɔn mukàdyà u ndwà ande. Yɛsu kàbilà nde, waa kàbwaay u mɛsà.
Umfarisi awun kàkyer abem muman naa Yɛsu kàtàywab anki kusà mudyà.
Wɛɛ Mwol waa kàtɛn a nde naa: «Le ndaa abɛ Amfarisi: Bɛ làfàsɔŋ nsà a an'kɔɔb anà an'lɔŋà, wɛɛ uboo bɛ làbà aŋàyɔl a làmfɛɛl anà nkyɛl mbɔɔn.
Angwöy Mbuur akwà kàkyer nsà, nde boo kàkyer anki?
Làpɛ akà aŋàlàmbwà indiir abyà uboo a an'kɔɔb anà uboo a an'lɔŋà abɛ, waa indiir byanswà byàyàkal byà in'kyɛɛl ntɔn bɛ.

«Wɛɛ ngyɛb akà bɛ Amfarisi! Bɛ làfàpà mwɛy uboo a kwem wà nkay ifàsà indiir ntsà asànaa un'dül anà köb anà nkay adyà asin yà ifà ifà, wɛɛ bɛ làfàkyer anki ndaa a balàbal anà ukwen a Nzam: undiir làlàkyer bɛ ukɔɔn adiimà indiir byumwɛy.
Ngyɛb akà bɛ Amfarisi, ntɔn bɛ làfàkwen an'kir a làkoo u ndwà a nköŋ. Bɛ làfàkwen naa baar bàlapɛ mbɔr kà ikal a nköŋ.
Ngyɛb akà bɛ! Bɛ làbà asànaa an'dii mpa bàfàman baar anà bàfàndyaar ba ukɔɔn ayöb.»
Umwɛy uboo a alɔɔŋ a Un'kɔɔn, kàtɛn a nde naa: «Un'lɔɔŋ, akatɛɛnà ngye abwɛy, ngye bi akatoo sye!»
Yɛsu waa kàfuur naa: «Ngyɛb akà bɛ sye, alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn! Ntɔn bɛ làfàtɔɔl buur a mpay musɛn akà baar, wɛɛ bɛ la làfàba anki akà u làpin làmwɛy.
Ngyɛb akà bɛ, ntɔn bɛ làfàtɔŋ an'dii a aŋangɔɔm bàdwä bàtaaràbɛ!
Abun iswaŋà ubwaŋàbwaŋ naa bɛ lan'kyey ndaa bàkyer bàtaaràbɛ: ba bàdwä aŋangɔɔm, wɛɛ bɛ, bɛ làtɔŋà an'dii aba!
Lalan Nzam kàtɛn nde unsà an'yweerà ande naa: "mɛ ba in'satööm aŋangɔɔm anà antööm, ba bàsàdwa bumwɛy anà bàsàmɛɛy bumwɛy nkwaaŋ."
Lalan an'kil a aŋangɔɔm màpää fà nsɛmà a mɛɛn bàsàtälà udu a un'tswe a baar a mpalàyi,
sɛmà an'kil a Abɛl tii an'kil a Zakàlye awà bàdwä uboboo a mɛsà a ibɔɔn anà idwà. Ndandaa mɛ alàkyään, buur a an'kil a baar abà banswà bàsàtälà udu a un'tswe a baar a mpalàyi!
«Ngyɛb akà bɛ alɔɔŋ a Un'kɔɔn, bɛ làkyàduum nsab ufàduub ndaa a un'yɛnà. Bɛ ŋakwo làfàbilà anki, bɛ sye làfàtsuŋ baar bumwɛy bàfàkwen mubilà kwo.»
Yàmɛnà naa umpal kàtoo Yɛsu u ndwà, alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn anà Amfarisi bàkun'nüün ntɔn mukun'fuul ndaa yà ifà ifà:
ba bàkäl mukun'lwab ndaa, ntɔn ba bàwɛl ndaa ayifà u mun ande ntɔn ba bun'füün.

Yàmɛnà naa utaaŋ nsil alan, baar nsaab bàkyer ayàköŋ, ba bàndyàndyaar ba a ba kà in'kɔl. Yɛsu kàtàsɛmà mutɛn a alɔŋki ande naa: «Làduub mii abɛ ntɔn ful a Amfarisi, iswaŋà naa ukwen a loor.
Ndaa yanswà yàŋàyee ikyer asàmɛnà u mii, ndaa a unku ikyer asàtoo.
Lalan ndaa yanswà làsàtɛn bɛ u làpib, bàkyer asàwem u mwäänà answà, wɛɛ ndaa yanswà làsàŋüŋün bɛ u mun a tsü uboo a suk aŋàdübà, isàbulà ndaa a kuub in'kwɛŋ udu a nsyä a ndwà.
«Asam amɛ, mɛ alàkyään naa: twon lan'man bɔɔmà a baar bàfàlɔ ndür mpɛl, wɛɛ mpa bàkwe mufàkyer undiir asin.
Mɛ in'kyer alàswaŋ nà bɛ lan'kwo mutiin bɔɔmà: làtiin mbuur awe anà ikɔ̈b mukàlàtɔɔm u yaaŋ a mbaa ungö a nkweel. Ndandaa mɛ alàkyään, bɛ bɔɔmà làtiin nde!»
«nkye Insɔɔr ityeen bàfàyälà anki ndiim yweel? Wɛɛ Nzam ufàdiimà anki akà umwɛy uboo a bya.
Yumwɛy ayi: Itàkal ntswee abɛ yanswà yàŋàtaŋ. Twon lan'man bɔɔmà, ntɔn bɛ lan'söön insɔɔr mbɔɔn u ntal.
«Wɛɛ mɛ alàkyään naa mbuur wanswà asàtà imbäl amɛ u mii a baar, Mwan a mbuur sye asun'tɛɛl imbäl u mii a akyeey a Nzam.
Wɛɛ mbuur wanswà asàswaŋ ngaal u mii a baar naa nde mɛ kan'yöb anki, nde sye bàsun'yöb anki u mii a akyeey a Nzam.
Isàkal naa mbuur kan'twe Mwan a mbuur, nde bàsun'dwääl nkul, wɛ mbuur asàto Dweelà In'kyɛɛl, usàwal anki ndwääl a nkul.
«Mpal bàsàlasyen ba u ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà ntɔn mukàlatsüül nsaŋ, itàkal kusà a amfum, itàkal kusà a an'yɔl, twon lan'man mpay naa bɛ un'lɔn làkàsà aben, bɛ ndaa nà làkàtɛn.
Ntɔn Dweelà In'kyɛɛl akyer asàlalɔŋ taaŋ nsil alan ndaa lan'kwo bɛ mutɛn.»
Yàmɛnà naa uboo a un'sɛŋ a baar mbuur mwɛy kàtɛn a Yɛsu naa: «Un'lɔɔŋ, un'swɛŋ un'tɔŋ amɛ mukab anà m un'naaŋ abi.»
Yɛsu waa kun'fuur naa: «Un'sam amɛ, nà kan'si ntɛɛn abɛ, itàkal nkalsà mukab un'naaŋ abɛ?»
Nde waa kàtɛn a ba naa: «Làwem ubwaŋàbwaŋ: twon lan'kal anà ngyal mukal anà indiir mbɔɔn, ntɔn mɔ̈ɔ̈ a mbuur kà wà uboo a indiir ande anki, itàkal naa nde wà ŋun'naaŋ.»
Apan nde katɛɛl nsim yi: «An'ywaŋ a ŋun'naaŋ mwɛy màtwey isaa mbɔɔn.
Nde kàsɛmà muyweer: "Mɛ in'kyer aben? Ntɔn mɛ ikal musà isaa amɛ abi byanswà kyatɛy."
Apan nde kàtɛn naa: "Mɛ in'yàkyer abà: Mɛ in'kyer ayàpay ikɔr amɛ byanswà ntɔn mutɔŋ byàkölàköl, waa in'yàsà mbɛŋ amɛ yanswà anà isaa amɛ byumwɛy.
Ungö apan mɛ in'yàtɛn a mɛ ŋakwo naa: Mɔ̈ɔ̈ amɛ, ngye awe anà isaa mbɔɔn ntɔn mbul mbɔɔn. Yweer, dyà, nwà, man un'sak."
Wɛɛ Nzam waa kàtɛn a nde naa: "Insil! U mpib a ŋàbà nsil awà ngye akyer akwà. Ayi yanswà an'lɔn ngye ntɔn ngye, nà asàman ubwaŋ a ya?"»
Yɛsu kàkwɛy naa: «Abun, ya yabwɛy sye ntɔn mbuur afàköŋà un'naaŋ mbɔɔn ntɔn nde ŋakwo, wɛɛ nde ukɔ̈ɔ̈n akal ŋun'naaŋ ntɔn Nzam.»
Apan Yɛsu kàfàtɛn a alɔŋki ande naa: «Lalan m alàkyään naa: Twon lan'man mpay ntɔn mɔ̈ɔ̈ abɛ anà mutɛɛn naa bɛ ininà làyàdyà, itàkal naa ntɔn ndür abɛ naa bɛ ininà làyàbwaar.
Ntɔn mɔ̈ɔ̈ kan'söön isaa anà ndür yan'söön ipfɛy.
Làler inkaak, bya ifàkɔn anki, ifàbwo anki, bya ikɔr byatɛy, wɛɛ Nzam akyer afadii. Bɛ lan'söön nɛn!
Nà uboo a bɛ, ntɔn ngyɛb ande, kan'kwo mukwɛy akà ilä mwɛy u mɔ̈ɔ̈ ande?
Isàkal naa bɛ làkwe anki mukyer undiir ikikye, ntɔn nkye làmanà bɛ mpay ntɔn indiir byumwɛy?
Làler iful a an'ywaŋ ifàyɛl bya: bya byàfàsal anki, byàfàtɔŋ anki, wɛɛ mɛ alàkyään naa itàkal Salɔmun unsà un'naaŋ ande wanswà kàsàbwaar anki asànaa bya.
Isàkal naa Nzam afàbwää iteerà abyà u ywaŋ ŋàbà wɛɛ nkàswo bya bàyàtɔɔm u mbaa, waa Nzam mpa uyàlabwää, bɛ aŋàlàkwikilà ikikye.
Wɛɛ bɛ, twon lan'man mpay ntɔn udyà anà unwà abɛ, twon lan'kal u ngyɛb.
Ntɔn indiir abi byanswà baar mpa bàyöb Nzam u mɛɛn mà bàfàleŋ bya taaŋ lanswà. Wɛɛ bɛ, Taaràbɛ akyàyöb naa bɛ làbye anà mfun a bya.
Wɛɛ bɛ, tàlaleŋà imwol a Nzam, waa bàsàlakwɛy indiir abi byanswà.»
«Twon an'man bɔɔmà, ngye làböl ikikye! Ntɔn Taaràbɛ kàkwen mukàlapà imwol.

Làyälà indiir abɛ, làpɛ ngim akà aŋàlàmbwà. Làkyer in'di a ngim mpa ifàbwà an'tär. Làyee in'naaŋ abɛ u du, waa mya mpa myàtäy. Mbüüb bàyàkwo anki muwal mya, anà nsɛɛl sye idyà anki mya.
Ntɔn ikal awà in'naaŋ abɛ, ikal sye iwà mpem abɛ.
Làkäl kà igyɛɛŋ musal anà indiir a isal abɛ u kɔɔ. Làwɛy minà abɛ myàkäl myàŋàlɛɛmà.
Làkäl asànaa asyääl bàkadilà nkum aba kàkyen mukàbäl un'kyay, ntɔn ba bun'duub ndwà isàkal naa nde kan'yàfura anà kan'bɛɛrà. Mpal uyàfurà nde, ubɛɛrà nde, waa ba bun'duub ndwà.
Un'sak akà asyääl usyetaan nde bàmuleerà mpal uyàfurà nde! Mɛ ndandaa alàkyään, nde ŋakwo asàbwaar ipfɛy a isal, asàpà ba ikal abwaay anà isaa.
Isàkal naa nde kan'yà uboboo a mpib, itàkal naa u nkɔɔ atàtwɛb, un'sak akà asyääl akwà usàtaan nde bàŋàleer!»
«Làyöb ubwaŋàbwaŋ naa isàkal naa ŋandwà akyàyöb taaŋ uyà mbüüb, nde uyun'wɛy anki mubilà u ndwà ande.
Bɛ sye, làduub mii abɛ, ntɔn bɛ làyöb anki taaŋ usàyà Mwan a mbuur.»
Apan Petɔlà waa kun'fuul naa: «Mwol, nsim ayi yà ntɔn bi mpɛl lɛɛ ntɔn baar banswà?»
Mwol waa ufuur naa: «Nà un'syääl a balàbal anà ŋun'yɛnà awà kan'kwo nkum ande mupà buur muler asyääl anà mupà umwɛy umwɛy isaa ande u taaŋ a taaŋ?
Un'sak akà un'syääl awà, isàkal naa nkum ande amàyun'taan mukyer isal akin!
Mɛ alàkyään ndandaa, nde asun'sà mfum udu a un'naaŋ ande wanswà.
Wɛɛ, isàkal naa un'syääl kan'yweer u mpem ande naa: "Nkum amɛ kan'kyer itaan muyàfurà." Nde usɛmà mudüb baar a isal abaal anà bakaar, isal ande udyà, unwà anà uyɔr man,
apan nkum ande asyefurà ilä mpa kun'dilà nde anà u taaŋ mpa uyöb nde. Apan nkum ande asun'pà ntaaŋàmbar aŋàsöönà, nde asun'sà uboo a un'lwaaŋ a atsüüŋ mpa bàfàlab nswɛɛŋ.
Un'syääl akwà awà ayöb naa nkum ande ininà ufàkwen, wɛɛ nde ufàkwen anki mukyer ya anà mulɔ̈ɔ̈n ya kusà, nde asàwal an'füm mbɔɔn.

Wɛɛ un'syääl akwà mpa uyöb naa nkum ande inina ukwen ntɔn nde, isàkal naa nde an'kyer ube, ntaaŋàmbar ande isàkal ikikye. Isàkal naa mbuur kàwɛl mbɔɔn, bàsun'lɔ̈ɔ̈m sye mbɔɔn. Isàkal naa bàmapà mbɔɔn, bàsalɔ̈ɔ̈m sye mbɔɔn.»
«Mɛ kàyi muyàtɔɔm mbaa u mɛɛn. Wɛɛ mɛ in'kwen naa ya ikäl yàŋàlɛɛmà.
Ye anà ndüümà mwɛy mɛ in'wal, mɛ waa in'wà u ngyɛb mbɔɔn tii umpal isàkwo ya!
Nkye bɛ làsii naa mɛ kàyi ntɔn mutwaal duu u mɛɛn? Ŋaa, mɛ alàkyään naa nkaabà.
Yan'mɛnà naa sɛmà ŋàbawà, u ywar a baar atyeen nkaabà yan'bilà, atär bàkwen anki abɔ̈ɔ̈l, aböɔ̈l bàkwen anki atär,

taa ukwen anki mwan ande wà baal, mwan baal ukwen anki taarànde, maa ukwen anki mwan ande wà un'kaar, mwan un'kaar ukwen anki ngwän, maa ukwen anki un'kyay a mwan ande, un'kyay a mwan ukwen anki ukwà ande wà un'kaar.»
Ungö apan, Yɛsu waa kàtɛn sye a baar banswà naa: «Umpal làfàman bɛ itööm ntsü làfàmina taaŋ, bɛ làfàtɛn naa: "Mbul akyer anɔ", wa sye afàkyer anɔ.
Isàkal naa un'pöb an'fà ngyɛl, bɛ làfàtɛn naa: "Ŋàbà mwäänà akal mbɔɔn", wa sye afàkal mbɔɔn.
Baar a mpem yweel! Bɛ làkyàyöb ndaa yan'kwo mulyaaŋ u mɛɛn anà u du, wɛɛ ntɔn nkye mpa làyöb bɛ ndaa a mpalàyi?»
«Ntɔn nkye bɛ ŋakwo mpa làyöb bɛ musɔɔl ndaa a ndandaa?

Isàkal naa we anà mbur kàmafüün, wɛɛ bɛ làwàmukyà làbay a nsaŋ, leŋ ipöl muyöŋà anà nde mpal làbà bɛ u mbwo. Abun nde ngye uyàfasyen anki akà ntɛɛn, ntɛɛn ayàfapà anki akà un'kyɛɛŋ, un'kyɛɛŋ uyàfabiil anki u bɔlokà.
Kya naa tɛy, mɛ akyään ndandaa, ngye kwo asàtoo anki isàkal naa ngye ngim ande yanswà ŋàtàfur anki.»
Umpal ayin, baar amwɛy bàyi mukyään Yɛsu naa Pilatu kàdwä aben Angalilɛ taaŋ bàkäl ba mupà ibɔɔn akà Nzam.
Yɛsu kafuur naa: «Bɛ làsii naa Angalilɛ abà bàsöön Angalilɛ bumwɛy unsà man'be, lalan bàmɛn ba mpay a tub ayi?
Mɛ in'tɛn a bɛ naa ŋaa. Wɛɛ bɛ làsàkɔɔn asɔɔmà, bɛ banswà sye làsàkwà asànaa ba.
Itàkal baar kwem aŋinaan bàkü mpal yabweel ndwà a bwɛlàbwɛl a Silɔwɛ, bɛ làsii naa ba bàkäl anà man'be màŋasöönà baar a Yɛlusàlɛm banswà?
Mɛ in'tɛn a bɛ naa ŋaa. Isàkal naa bɛ mpem làbuul anki, bɛ banswà làkyer asàkwà.»
Apan nde katɛɛl nsim yi: «Mbuur mwɛy kàkäl anà un'te adyà wàŋàkɔn uboo a làpaŋ ande. Ilä mwɛy nde kàkwen mubwo mbɛŋ, wɛɛ nde kàmɛn anki akà mwɛy.

Abun nde kàtɛn a mbuur kàfalerà làpaŋ a in'te adyà ande naa: "Le, abà mbul tär in'yaa mɛ muyàbwo mbɛŋ kà un'te awà, wɛɛ mɛ akà imwɛy in'manà anki. Tsul wa: mɛ in'manà anki isin usaa nde làpib a bunàbun uboo a làpaŋ amɛ."
Mbuur awun naa: "Un'lɔɔŋ, tàfun'wɛy mbul awà! Mɛ in'yàbuun mɛɛn u mbil a wa, mɛ in'yàsà nkay:
taaŋ lumwɛy ilä iyà ungö wa akyer ayàbɔr. Kya naa tɛy, ngye waa asun'tsul."»
Yàmenà naa ilä a saba mwɛy Yɛsu kàkäl mulɔŋ u ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà.
Wɛɛ le, uboo kwo kàkäl anà un'kaar mwɛy dweelà a làbe lun'buulà aŋàkwɛkà abà mbul kwem aŋinaan: nde kàkäl aŋàtöör, kàkwee anki mumbar aŋàsubà alää.
Mpal kun'mɛn Yɛsu, nde waa kun'bel, kàtɛn a nde naa: «Un'kaar, ngye an'kɔɔrà unsà nkwɛkà angye!»
Nde kàsi an'kɔɔ ande udu a un'kaar awà, taaŋ nsil alan un'kaar waa kàsubà, laa kàsɛmà nde musyäŋà Nzam.

Wɛɛ mfum a ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà kàwem nkyɛl ntɔn Yɛsu kàkɔɔr nde mbuur ilä a saba. Apan nde kàtɛn a baar banswà naa: «Ilä mukyer isal byà isyaam, làyi kà ilä abin ntɔn bàlakɔɔr, wɛɛ kà ilä a saba anki!»
Mwol waa kun'fuur naa: «Bɛ làbà baar a loor! Mbuur wanswà uboo abɛ afàbäm ngɔɔmà ande itàkal ntab ande kà ikal ufàdyà wa anà mukun'nüü ilä a saba. Kabwɛy anki?
Wɛɛ un'kaar wà, mwan a Abàlam kàkör Satanà wà mbul kwem aŋinaan, bàlun'kɔɔr anki in'siŋ ande ntɔn ŋàbà ilä a saba?»
Mfuur a Yɛsu ayi yàpɛ nswɛn akà ayiiŋ ande, wɛɛ baar banswà bàmɛn un'sak ntɔn ndaa aŋàbwaŋ kàkyerà nde.
Yɛsu kàfàtɛn naa: «Imwol a Nzam kyà asànaa ininà?
Kya kyà asànaa imbɛŋ ikikye kan'wal mbuur mwɛy anà kan'tɔɔm nde uboo a làpaŋ ande: kya waa imɛn, iyɛl, ibulà un'te, nɛn a du waa itöŋ an'yaab kà an'kɔkà a wa.»
Nde kàkwɛy naa: «Mɛ imwol a Nzam in'sii anà ininà?
Kya kyà asànaa ful kàwɛl un'kaar mwɛy waa kàtüüb la anà an'kɔɔb an'tär mà mfufu a mampà. Ungö apan mfar yanswà laa yàfül ya.»
Yɛsu kàyilyaaŋà uboo a an'bul a kölàköl anà mà ikikye muyilɔŋ anà muyisin tsütsü a Yɛlusàlɛm.
Mbuur mwɛy kun'fuul naa: «Mwol, nkye baar ikikye mpɛl bàsàwà mɔ̈ɔ̈?» Nde waa kàfuur naa:
«Làkyer ngwal mubilà u kimunàmbwo, ntɔn mɛ alàkyään naa baar mbɔɔn bàsàleŋ mubilà wɛɛ ba bàsàkwo anki.»
«Mpal usàsubà ŋandwà anà usàbäm nde ndwà, isàkal naa bɛ lan'sàsal u nsà, bɛ làtàbɛɛrà ibeenà unsà làbɔ̈ɔ̈n lanswà: "Mwol, iduub!" Nde bɛ asàlafuur naa: "Bɛ làbà baar a ken?"
Apan, bɛ làsàtɛn a nde naa: "Wɛɛ bi laa kàdi anà kànü u mii angye, ngye kàlɔɔŋà kà an'balàbal anà bi."
Nde afàsàlafuur naa: "Bɛ làbà baar a ken. Làlwomà apà mɛ, bɛ baar làfàkyer man'be."
Akun isàkal ilel anà nkwoor a an'din mpal làsàman bɛ Abàlam, Isak anà Yakɔb anà aŋangɔɔm banswà uboo a Imwol a Nzam, wɛɛ bɛ ŋakwo bàkyàlapiy unsà.
Apan, baar bàsàfà ntsü làfàsɛnà taaŋ, ntsü làfàminà la, ntaal anà ngyɛl, ba bàsàwal ikal u mɛsà kà Imwol a Nzam.
Lalan baar a ngöngö bàsàbulà baar atàtwɛb, wɛɛ baar atàtwɛb bàsàbulà baar a ngöngö.»
Umpal ayin, Amfarisi amwɛy bàyi ba, ba bàtɛn a Yɛsu naa: «Lwomà pabà, kyen ntsü asin, ntɔn Ɛlɔdi akwen mukadwa.»
Yɛsu waa kafuur naa: «Làkyen kàlun'kyään un'kyɛŋ awun: ŋàbà anà nkàswo mɛ in'wà muböŋ insɔŋà anà mukɔɔr aŋakyal, nkàswo wunà isal amɛ iyàkal aŋàwà.
Wɛɛ mɛ in'kyer alab mbwo amɛ ŋàbà, nkàswo anà nkàswo wunà, ntɔn ŋangɔɔm ukwe anki mukwà kà ikal asin mpa akyà Yɛlusàlɛm.

Aa, Yɛlusàlɛm! Yɛlusàlɛm! Ngye an'may aŋangɔɔm, ngye an'dwa baar ufàtɔm Nzam a in'kul. Mbalà kwe mɛ kàkwen muböbà baan angye tsütsü apà mɛ asànaa nkɔɔ ufàfwee wa an'tsül u ngyɛl a an'paab ande. Wɛɛ bɛ ya làsàkwen anki!
Isàkal abun ndwà abɛ bàkyer apiy bwà. Ɛɛ, sɛmà ŋàbawà bɛ mɛ làfàsan'man anki tii mpal làsàtɛn bɛ naa: "Wɛy un'sak ukäl akà mbuur kan'yà kà ikɔb a Mwol."»
Yàmɛnà naa ilä a saba mwɛy mfum a Amfarisi mwɛy kàbel Yɛsu mukàdyà u ndwà ande. Baar bàkäl paa bàkäl musey nde ubwaŋàbwaŋ.
Wɛɛ le, mbuur aŋàyàyam u ndür kàkäl aŋàmbar kusà a nde.
Yɛsu kàsi ndaa, waa kàtɛn a alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn anà Amfarisi naa: «Nkye bàkyàpà mbwo lɛɛ tɛy mukɔɔr mbuur ilä a saba?»
Wɛɛ ba ndaa bàsi anki. Apan Yɛsu laa kàbä nde mbuur awun, waa kun'kɔɔr, kun'sweŋ mufurà ndwà ande.
Ungö apan, nde waa kàtɛn a ba naa: «Nà uboo abɛ, isàkal naa mwan ande itàkal ngɔɔmà ande kan'bwà uboo a fu, mpa kun'twey nde a agyägyä, ilä a saba?»
Wɛɛ ba sye bàsàkwo anki mufuur.
Mpal kàmɛn nde naa baar bàbel bàkäl musɔɔl ikal atàtwɛb, nde kàtɛ nsim yi:
«Isàkal naa mbuur kàmabel mukàdyà ilä atà bör ande, twon an'kàbwaay kà ikal a imfum. Taaŋ lumwɛy uboo abɛ we anà mbuur kan'söön ngye unsà imfum
anà mbuur kàlabel, ngye anà nde, uyàtɛn a ngye naa: "Sun'wɛy ikal ki." Uboo a nswɛn, ngye akàbwaay kà ikal a ngöngö.

Wɛɛ, manà bàmabel, kyen kabwaay kà ikal a ngöngö. Abun, mpal uyàbilà mbuur kabel, nde waa kakyään naa: "Un'sam amɛ, kye anà ikal aŋasöön ubwaŋ ntɔn ngye, yabwaay udu kà". Abun ngye ayàkal aŋasyäŋà u mii a baar bàkäl anà ngye u mɛsà.
Lalan, mbuur afàsɛɛn an'pɛy bàkyer afun'tyeey, mbuur afàtyà bàkyer afun'sɛn.»

Ungö Yɛsu waa kàtɛn a mbuur kun'bel naa: «Isàkal naa ngye apà baar udyà, twon an'bel asam angye, atɔŋ angye, baar a mbil angye, itàkal aŋun'naaŋ bàfàkal tsütsü apà ngye, ntɔn ba sye bàfàsabel mufuur ayi yanswà an'kyer ngye.
Wɛɛ, isàkal naa ngye apà isaa akà baar, bel aŋàlàmbwà, baar aŋàyɔm in'kɔl, ikar, ikwàmii.
Waa ngye ayàkal kà un'sak ntɔn baar aban ndöŋ yatɛy musafuur asànaa an'kyer ngye. Waa Nzam usakwɛy mpal bàsàwiyà baar a balàbal kà ukwà.»
Yàmɛnà naa ungö apan, umwɛy uboo a baar bàbel waa kàtɛn a Yɛsu naa: «Un'sak akà mbuur asàwal ikal mpal bàsàdii baar uboo a Imwol a Nzam!»
Waa Yɛsu kun'fuur naa: «Ilä mwɛy, mbuur mwɛy kàwɛl baar u ndwà ande ntɔn udyà a kölàköl. Waa nde kàbel baar mbɔɔn.
Taaŋ a udyà làkwe la, nde kàtöm un'syääl ande mukàswaŋ baar kàbel nde naa: "Làyi apanà, ntɔn ndaa yanswà yan'kwo."
Wɛ ba banswà bàkal mun umwɛy wa, waa bàlɔ̈m ndwääl a nkul. Wàtàtwɛb kun'kyään naa: "Mɛ an'som ywanŋ làmwɛy, mɛ in'kyer akyà mukàler la. Mɛ amabɔɔn, ndwääl nkul."
Wumwɛy naa: "Mɛ an'som adim atyeen anà akyay atyeen bà ngɔɔmà. Mɛ in'kyer akàsi ya. Mɛ amabɔɔn, ndwääl nkul."
Wumwɛy sye naa: "Mɛ an'bääl làbenàben alà, mɛ in'kwe anki muyà."

Taaŋ kàyàfurà un'syääl awun, nde kàkyään nkum ande ndaa ayi yanswà bàtɛn ba. Lalan ŋandwà kàwem nde nkyɛl, kàswɛŋ nde un'syääl ande naa: "Kyen agyägyä! Kyen u mbay anà kan'balàbal a bul, twaal pabà aŋàlàmbwà, baar aŋàkwɛkà, ikwàmii, ikar."
Ungö a taaŋ, un'syääl waa kàyàkyään nkum ande naa: "Mwol, mɛ an'kyer asànaa an'swɛŋ ngye, wɛɛ ikal a ipɔl byà paa."
Nkum ande naa: "Kyen u mbwo yanswà, u mbil a mpaŋ, siinà baar bàbilà, ntɔn ndwà amɛ iyöl abar.
Wɛɛ mɛ, mɛ alàkyään ndandaa naa akà mbuur mwɛy uboo a baar kàbel mɛ ulɛr anki isaa amɛ!"»
Yàmɛnà naa mbul a baar kàyikyeenà a Yɛsu, nde waa kàbulà, waa kàtɛn a ba naa:
«Isàkal naa mbuur an'yà akà mɛ, wɛɛ nde udiimà anki taarànde, ngwän, un'kyay ande, baan ande, atɔŋ ande babaal anà bakaar, itàkal ndür ande ŋakwo, nde ukwe anki mukal un'lɔŋki amɛ.
Mbuur mpa usɛn buur ande anà mpa ulab mɛ, nde ukwe anki mukal un'lɔŋki amɛ.
Abà, nà uboo abɛ akwen mutɔŋ ndwà a bwɛlàbwɛl, nde uwal anki taaŋ muyweer ntɔn muyöb naa nde kwe uyàtwey, nkye nde ayàkwo mumay ndwà ande?
Naa tɛy, nde uyàmay anki mutɔŋ ungö musà un'bään, baar banswà bàsamanà ya bàkyer asun'sɛ.
Ba bàsàtɛn naa: "Làler mbuur kàsɛmà mutɔŋ, wɛ nde kàkwe anki mumay."

Itàkal naa mfum mwɛy wà tsütsü muleŋ ngwiy a mfum asin. Nde uwal anki taaŋ mubwaay anà muyweer naa nkye nde akyàkwo muwal iböŋ kusà a mbuur awe abà baar nsaab an'kwem mööl isàkal naa nde ŋakwo we abà baar nsaab kwem?
Nde usàman naa nde ukwo anki, nde atɔm in'kyeey mpal awà un'yiiŋ ande u kwɛlàkwɛl ntɔn muyöŋà duu.
Ya ye abun sye ntɔn bɛ: uboo abɛ, mbuur mpa ukwen mukɔɔb ubwaŋ ande banswà ukwe anki mukal un'lɔŋki amɛ.»
«Muŋ wà undiir aŋàbwaŋ, wɛɛ ntsà awa isàwà, ya bàyun'fuur a nkye?
Wa bàfàsàsyääl anki itàkal ntɔn mɛɛn, itàkal ntɔn mudii ndon. Undiir kan'saal: upiy wa bwà u nsà. Wɛy mbuur awe anà an'tsü awem uwem.»
Yàmɛnà naa afüür a itɛr anà baar asin babe, ba banswà bàsin tsütsü apà Yɛsu ntɔn mukun'wem.
Amfarisi anà alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn bàŋüŋün anà bàtɛn naa: «Mbuur wà ayiwal baar abɛ anà ayidyà ikal imwɛy anà ba.»
Wɛɛ Yɛsu katɛɛl nsim yi:
«Nà uboo abɛ we amyà in'kɔk nkam, wɛ umwɛy udiimà, nkye nde usàwɛy anki in'kɔk an'kwem wà aŋiwà u nsye ntɔn mukàleŋ umwɛy kan'diimà wà tii mpal usàman nde wa?
Mpal usàman nde wa, unsà un'sak nde, nde wa asàsà kà an'pɛy.
Mpal uyàfurà nde ndwà ande, nde abel asam ande anà baar a tsütsü, waa utɛn naa: "Làsäŋ anà mɛ, ntɔn un'kɔk amɛ kàdiimà kan'mɛnà."
Abun sye, mɛ ndandaa alàkyään, un'sak mbɔɔn asàkal u du isàkal naa mbuur un'be mwɛy kan'buul mpem, wɛɛ kà ntɔn an'kwen wà aŋiwà mpa bàwe anà mfun a mbuul a mpem.»
«Itàkal naa, nà un'kaar mwɛy we abyà itɛr a ngim kwem, wɛɛ imwɛy kyan'diimà. Nkye nde ukyää anki mwinà, ukɔ̈ɔ̈m ndwà anà uyaal ntsü yanswà tii mpal uyàfàman nde kya?
Wɛɛ umpal uman nde kya, nde abel asam ande anà baar a tsütsü anà mutɛn naa: "Làsäŋ anà mɛ, ntɔn itɛr a ngim amɛ kyàdiimà kyan'mɛnà."
Abun sye, mɛ alàkyään naa un'sak mbɔɔn afàkal akà akyeey a Nzam isàkal naa mbuur un'be mwɛy kan'buul mpem.»
Yɛsu waa kàfàtɛn naa: «Mbuur mwɛy kàkäl abà baan abaal bɔ̈ɔ̈l.
Mwan wà umbɛy kàtɛn a taarànde naa: "Taa, mpɛ kab a indiir làmɛ." Taaràba kakääb indiir ande.
Ungö a ilä, mwan umbɛy awun kàwɛl indiir ande byanswà, laa kàyälà nde bya, waa kàkyen nsi a kwɛl. Wɛɛ akun nde kàtay un'naaŋ ande uboo a lingyoomà.
Mpal kàmay nde indiir ande byanswà, ngyal a ngwal yàbilà u nsi ayin, laa kàsɛmà nde muleŋ udyà.
Apan, nde kàkàleŋ isal akà mbuur mwɛy wà nsi ayin. Mbuur awà kun'töm u nsye mukàdii ngul ande.
Wɛɛ an'kyän ande màkäl naa nde udi itàkal isaa a ngul, wɛɛ mbuur un'pà bya kàkäl anki.
Apan, nde kàfuur an'kyän, waa kàtɛn naa: "Asyääl a taa akwe bàfàdyà asànaa bàkwen ba, wɛɛ mɛ kà in'wà mukwà a ngyal.
Mɛ in'kyer ambarà, in'kyer akyà akà taa, waa in'kàtɛn a nde naa: Taa, mɛ an'kyer man'be akà Nzam anà akà ngye.
Mɛ in'kwe anki mufàkal mwan angye. Ngwɛl asànaa umwɛy uboo a asyääl angye."
Apan laa kambarà nde, kàfurà nde akà taarànde. Nde kàkäl anki ŋàtàtol, mpal kun'mɛn taarànde ukwɛl, laa kun'wem nde ngyɛb mbɔɔn, kàkyen nde ntiin, kun'bwirà nde, waa kundüür.
Mwan laa kàtɛn nde a taarànde naa: "Taa, mɛ kàkyer man'be akà Nzam anà akà ngye, mɛ in'kwe anki mufàkal mwan angye …"
Wɛɛ taarànde kàswɛŋ asyääl ande: "Làkyen agyägyä, kàlaleŋ ipfɛy kyan'söön ntwɛn, lun'bwää, lun'si làpɛr u làpin, lun'bwää an'sàbar aŋàbwaŋ.
Wɛɛ làtwääl un'tö a ngɔɔmà a may, làdwä wa. Bi ikyer adyà, bi ikyer ataam
ntɔn mwan amɛ kàkäl awàŋàkwà, nde kan'wiyà, nde kàkyer adiimà, wɛɛ mɛ amun'man." Laa bàsɛmà ba mutaam.
Taaŋ nsil alan, mwan wà nswɛm kàkäl kà an'ywaŋ. Mpal kàkäl nde u mbwo muyàfurà, kàkɔlà nde tsütsü a ndwà, laa kàwem nde an'diim anà an'kyen.
Nde kàbel umwɛy uboo a asyääl, waa kun'fuul naa ndaa nà ikalyaaŋà.
Un'syääl kun'fuur abà: "Un'kɔm angye an'yàfurà. Taaràŋà kan'dwa un'tö a ngɔɔmà a may ntɔn nde an'yàfurà anà mɔ̈ɔ̈."
Lalan, mwan wà nswɛm kàwen nde nkyɛl, waa kàtön mubilà u ndwà. Taarànde laa kàyàtoo nde, waa kun'lɔ̈ɔ̈m mubilà.

Wɛɛ nde kàtɛn a taarànde naa: "Le, mɛ an'kyer mbul anà mbul musyääl ngye: mɛ ndaa angye mwɛy akà ikikye in'fàbɛy anki. Wɛɛ, akà mbalà mwɛy ngye un'tö a ntab kan'pɛ anki ntɔn mutaam anà asam amɛ.
Wɛɛ mwan angye, mbuur kan'kàtay indiir angye byanswà anà akaar a pasàsɛ kan'yàfurà, ntɔn nde, ngye an'dwa un'tö a ngɔɔmà a may!"
Taarànde naa: "Mwan amɛ, ngye awà anà mɛ taaŋ lanswà, indiir amɛ byanswà byà byàngye.
Wɛɛ, yubwaŋ naa bi ikäl kà un'sak, ntɔn un'tɔŋ angye wà asànaa mbuur kàkü waa kan'wiyà, ntɔn nde kàkyer adiimà, waa kan'mɛnà."»
Yàmɛnà naa Yɛsu kàtɛn a alɔŋki ande naa: «Ŋun'naaŋ mwɛy kàkäl anà mfum a isal ande. Baar laa bàyun'füün ba naa nde afàtaam anà indiir ande.
Ŋun'naaŋ waa kun'bel, waa kàtɛn a nde naa: "Ndaa nà mɛ in'weemà ntɔn ngye? Nswɛŋ nsyääl angye, ntɔn ngye ayàfàlab anki musyääl indiir amɛ."
Mfum a isal kàsɛmà muyweer: "Mɛ in'kyer aben, ntɔn nkum amɛ kàman'lwom muler isal ande? In'bulà mulem an'ywaŋ? Mɛ ngwal yatɛy. In'sɛmà muyilɔm akà baar? Yà ndaa a nswɛn.
Aa, mɛ an'man naa mɛ ininà in'kyer ntɔn baar ban'wɛl u ndwà aba mpal bàyan'lwom kà isal amɛ."
Ungö apan, nde kàbeelà umwɛy umwɛy aŋankul a nkum ande. Nde kàtɛn a mbuur wàtàtwɛb naa: "Ngye kwɛ apà akà nkum amɛ?"
Nde kun'fuur naa: "Ngungulà nkam yà may." Nde waa kàtɛn naa: "Le un'kaan a nkul angye, bwaay pabà, kyer agyägyä, sɔn an'kwem an'tyeen."
Ungö nde waa kàtɛn a wumwɛy naa: "Atöl ngye kwe?" Nde naa: "Ngɔɔr nkam mwɛy yà mbɛŋ a imbab." Mfum a isal naa: "Mà un'kaan a nkul angye, sɔn an'kwem naan."
Abun, nkum kàkyer un'syäŋà un'be un'syääl awà ntɔn mankay ande. Iswaŋà naa baan a nsi yi ban'söön mankay kusà a atɔŋ aba akwà abà baan a pɛɛlà.
Wɛɛ mɛ alàkyään naa: Làtɛ isaam a in'naaŋ a loor myà mɛɛn mà. Abun, umpal myàsàkɔɔn mya, waa mya isàlawal kà ikal a mbul a in'tye.
Isàkal naa mbuur wà balàbal unsà indiir ikikye, nde asàkal sye wàbalàbal unsà indiir mbɔɔn. Wɛɛ isàkal naa mbuur wà ŋaloor unsà indiir ikikye, nde asàkal sye ŋaloor unsà indiir mbɔɔn.
Lalan, isàkal naa bɛ balàbal batɛy musyääl un'naaŋ a loor a mɛɛn mà, nà kan'kwo mukàlapà un'naaŋ a ndandaa?
Isàkal naa bɛ balàbal batɛy unsà indiir a baar asin, nà ayàlapà indiir abɛ ŋakwo?

Akà un'syääl mwɛy tɛy kan'kwo musyääl ankum bɔ̈ɔ̈l. Ya iyàmɛnà naa nde ayàkyey umwɛy, nde ayàtɔn wumwɛy, itàkal naa nde ayàpà mɔ̈ɔ̈ ande akà umwɛy, nde ayàyiiŋ wumwɛy. Bɛ làkwe anki musyääl Nzam anà ngim u taaŋ làmwɛy la.»
Yàmɛnà naa Amfarisi bàwem ba ndaa ayi yanswà, ba bàsɛɛ Yɛsu, ntɔn ba bàkweenà ngim.
Wɛɛ nde kàtɛn a ba naa: «Bɛ làbà baar làfàswaŋ u mii a baar naa bɛ làbà balàbal, wɛɛ Nzam akiyöb boo a mpem abɛ. Undiir bàfàman baar naa wa wà làkoo, Nzam wa afàman wà ŋingyäy.
«Taaŋ a Un'kɔɔn anà là in'kaan a aŋangɔɔm làtsü apà Ywan. Sɛmà taaŋ alan, Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ là Imwol a Nzam ban'kyään, anà mbuur mbuur wà mukyer ngwal ntɔn mubilà kwo.
Du anà mɛɛn man'kwo isàdiimà, wɛɛ akà isɛrà mwɛy kyà Un'kɔɔn isàdiimà anki.
«Baal wanswà kàkaabà anà un'kyay ande, usàkàwal un'kyay asin, nde kan'tà inswem, wɛɛ baal wanswà asàwal un'kaar kàkaabà anà un'dim ande, nde kan'tà inswem.
«Taaŋ mwɛy kàkäl anà ŋun'naaŋ mwɛy kàfàbwaarà ubwaŋàbwaŋ ipfɛy a ntal. Ilä byanswà isal ande udyà anà utaam.
Ŋàlàmbwà mwɛy ikɔb ande Lazar kàfabɔ̈ɔ̈nà u mun a làpaŋ a ŋun'naaŋ awà, nde kàkäl anà inkyar u ndür ande.
Nde kàlàkwen mudyà mfür a mampà yàbwee u mɛsà a ŋun'naaŋ. Apan sye mbwà yàyee mulɛɛr inkyar ande.
Yàmɛnà naa ŋàlàmbwà waa ukü, akyeey a Nzam laa bun'syen ba akà Abàlam. Ŋun'naaŋ sye waa ukü, waa bun'dyee.
Kà an'lɔŋ, ŋun'naaŋ kàkäl uboo a mpay yà mbɔɔn. Mpal kàler nde u du laa kàmɛn nde ukwɛl Lazar tsütsü apà Abàlam.
Apan nde kàlaal in'kwɛŋ: "Taaràmɛ Abàlam, ngwem ngyɛb! Tɔm Lazar, nde udüma nswɛŋ a làpin ande kà an'dà, nde kan'nɔ̈ lànyaŋ a an'dà u làlem amɛ, ntɔn mɛ in'wà u mpay mbɔɔn uboo a mbaa yi."

Wɛɛ Abàlam kun'fuur naa: "Mwan amɛ, yɔbà ubwaŋ banswà kàmɛn ngye u mɔ̈ɔ̈ angye taaŋ kàkäl ngye u mɛɛn, wɛɛ Lazar kàkäl u mpay taaŋ lanswà. Mpalabà, apà, Lazar wà kà un'sak, wɛɛ ngye awà u mpay aŋasöönà.
Yumwɛy ayi: Uboo a bi anà bɛ we anà un'baan a kölàköl. Ilàtàkal naa ukwen bàkäl, bi ikwe anki musoonà wa, itàkal naa mufà akà bi muyà akà bɛ, itàkal naa mufà akà bɛ muyà akà bi."
Ŋun'naaŋ waa kàtɛn naa: "Isàkal abwɛy, mɛ amabɔɔn, taa, tɔm Lazar u ndwà a taaràmɛ,
ntɔn mɛ in'we abà atɔŋ abaal atyeen, nde ukakyään, manà ba sye bàyàlab mbwo a mpay ayi."
Abàlam naa: "Atɔŋ angye bye anà Mɔsɛ anà aŋangɔɔm, wɛy ba bawem."
Nde naa: "Ŋaa, taa Abàlam, manà mbuur kan'fà an'lɔŋ, kan'kyà akà ba, ba bàkyer ayàbuul mpem."
Abàlam waa kun'fuur naa: "Isàkal naa ba bàkwe anki muwem Mɔsɛ anà aŋangɔɔm, ba sye bàyàkwo anki muwem akà ikikye mbuur kan'fà an'lɔŋ."»
Ungö apan, Yɛsu kàtɛn a alɔŋki ande naa: «Yà ndandaa naa taaŋ lanswà baar ban'kwo bàbü u man'be, wɛɛ ngyɛb akà mbuur awà mbwo ntɔn mbweel a un'tɔŋ ande.
Yubwaŋ akà nde naa bun'bäm nkɔŋ a kölàköl u bway anà bun'tɔɔm u ngyäl, akwà naa nde mubwiy umwɛy uboo a baan ambɛy bà.
Làkäl kà igyɛɛŋ ntɔn bɛ ŋakwo! Isàkal naa un'tɔŋ angye kan'kyer man'be, un'pɛ an'lwɛŋ. Nde usàsɔɔmà, un'dwääl nkul.
Itàkal naa nde kàmakyer ube mbalà nsambwaar kà ilä mwɛy wɛɛ nde akayaa akà ngye taaŋ lanswà naa nde akyer asɔɔmà, un'dwääl nkul.»
Yàmɛnà naa ilä mwɛy antööm bàtɛn a Mwol naa: «Kwɛy làkwikilà abi.»

Mwol waa kàfuur naa: «Isàkal naa ndandaa bɛ làbye anà làkwikilà làtàkal ikikye asànaa imbɛŋ a làpɔ̈ɔ̈là, bɛ lan'kwo muswaŋ un'te a kölàköl naa: "Tsumà pà, kyen kambär uboo a ngyäl!" Wa akyer alàwem.»

Yɛsu kàkwɛy naa: «Bi itàwal naa umwɛy uboo abɛ ukäl anà un'tsüüŋ ande isal ande mulem, taaŋ lumwɛy mudii ntsür. Uman nde kan'fà an'ywaŋ kan'yàfurà, nkye nde ayàtɛn a nde naa: "Yà agyägyä, bwaay u mɛsà"?
Aay, nde ayàtɛn a nde naa: "Ndääm isaa, bwaar ubwaŋ, yà yan'pɛ udyà, manà mɛ an'may mudyà anà munwà, ungö ngye sye waa ayàdyà anà ayànwà."
Nkye nkum kan'kwo mupà ndä akà un'tsüüŋ ande ntɔn nde kan'kyer isal kyanswà kun'swɛŋ nde?
Ya sye ye abwɛy ntɔn bɛ. Isàkal naa bɛ lan'kyer isal kyanswà bàlaswɛŋ, làtɛn naa: "Bi ibà atsüüŋ ikɔ̈ɔ̈n ndöŋ: bi kan'kyer isal kan'kwo bi mukyer."»
Yàmɛnà naa Yɛsu kàkäl mukyà Yɛlusàlɛm, nde kàsoonà ndel a Samalya anà Ngalilɛ.
Mpal kàkäl nde tsütsü mubilà u bul mwɛy, aŋakyal a bay kwem bàyi akà nde, ba bàmbär u kwɛl
waa bàsɛn ndaa: «Yɛsu, Un'lɔɔŋ, iwem ngyɛb!»
Mpal kamɛn Yɛsu, nde kàtɛn a ba naa: «Làkyen kàlamɛnà akà angaŋ.» Mpal bàkäl ba u mbwo, laa bàkɔɔrà ba.
Umwɛy uboo aba kàmɛn nde naa nde kan'kɔɔrà, waa kàyàfurà, wàmuyisyäŋà Nzam u ndaa a dudu.
Apan, waa kàbü, ntabwey u mɛɛn, kà in'kɔl a Yɛsu, waa kun'kömà. Mbuur awà kàkäl un'nsi Samalya.
Waa Yɛsu kàtɛn naa: «Ba bàkwem bàkyer akɔɔrà, wɛɛ bàken baar wà bumwɛy?
Akà mbuur mwɛy ukäl anki anà an'kyän muyàfurà ntɔn mukömà Nzam, ilàkɔɔn akal ungyey abarankye wà?»
Apan Yɛsu kàtɛn a nde naa: «Mbarà, kyen, làkwikilà angye làmatswà mɔ̈ɔ̈.»
Ilä mwɛy Amfarisi bàfuul Yɛsu naa imwol a Nzam isàyà mpal yɛn. Yɛsu kafuur naa: «Imwol a Nzam iyà anki asànaa undiir a ubem.
Bàsàtɛn anki naa: "Làler, kya aki kà." Taaŋ lumwɛy naa: "Kya kyà kunà." Ntɔn, làyöb naa Imwol a Nzam kyà uboo a bɛ.»
Apan nde waa kàtɛn a alɔŋki ande naa: «Taaŋ là paa làsàkwen bɛ muman Mwan a mbuur itàkal ilä mwɛy mpɛl, wɛɛ bɛ làsun'man anki.
Ba bàsàlakyäänà naa: "Làler kunà!", taaŋ lumwɛy naa: "Làler kà!" Wɛɛ twon lan'kyà, twon lan'kaamà ntiin.
Ilä a Mwan a mbuur isàkal asànaa muŋyä ufàparà wa udu, anà ufàpà wa kyɛɛy awa ntsü anà ntsü.
Wɛɛ kusà nde akyer atàman mpay mbɔɔn anà baar a mpalàbà bàkyer un'tɔn.
Lalan ndaa yàlyaaŋ utaaŋ a Nɔwa, isàkal sye kà ilä a Mwan a mbuur.
Baar bàkyer afadyaa, bàkyer afanwaa, bàkyer afataa an'bɔr, bàkyer afapaa baan aba an'bɔr, tii ilä kàbilà Nɔwà kà an'swà. An'dà màyööl ma mɛɛn, laa bàkü ba banswà.
Isàkal sye asànaa utaaŋ a Lɔti: baar bàkyer afadyaa, bàkyer afanwaa, bàkyer afasoomà, bàkyer afayälà, bàkyer afakɔnà, bàkyer afatɔŋà.
Wɛɛ ilä kàtoo Lɔti u Sɔdɔm, mbul a in'kul a mbaa laa kàfü wa du, kàdwä wa ba banswà.
Ya isàkal abà sye kà ilä a Mwan a mbuur usàmɛnà nde.
Ilä akin, mbuur asàkal udu a nsyä a ndwà ande, ufàsàbilà anki u ndwà ntɔn mukàwal indiir ande, ifà imwɛy sye akà mbuur asàkal kan'ywaŋ usàkwo anki mufurà ndwà ande.
Làyɔbà un'kyay a Lɔti!
Mbuur asàkwen muyee mɔ̈ɔ̈ ande, wa asàkyà bwà, wɛɛ mbuur asàkɔɔb mɔ̈ɔ̈ ande, akyer asàwal wa.
Mɛ alàkyään naa: u mpib ayin, baar bɔ̈ɔ̈l bàsàkal ibɔ̈ɔ̈n imwɛy: umwɛy bàkyer asun'syen, umwɛy bàkyer asun'wɛy.
Akaar bɔ̈ɔ̈l bàsàkal mutswà ikal imwɛy: un'mwɛy bàkyer asun'syen, un'mwɛy bàkyer asun'wɛy.
Abaal bɔ̈ɔ̈l bàsàkal kà ibɔr: umwɛy bàkyer asun'syen, un'mwɛy bàkyer asun'wɛy.»
Alɔŋki ande bun'fuul naa: «Mwol, ndaa ayi isàkal ken?» Waa nde kafuur naa: «Ntsü isàkal ndom, akun sye inkaak isàköŋ bya.»
Ilä mwɛy Yɛsu katɛɛl nsim yi ntɔn muswaŋ ba naa ba bàkyer ayamà taaŋ lanswà, bàkɔ̈ɔ̈n ayɔɔn:
«U bul mwɛy, kàkäl anà ntɛɛn mwɛy. Nde Nzam kàfun'weemà anki, nde mbuur wanswà kàfun'manà naa wa undiir a bunàbun.
U bul nsil alan kàkäl sye anà un'kweel a un'dim mwɛy kàfayaa taaŋ lanswà akà nde ntɔn nde ulɔ̈ɔ̈n ndaa ande, nde kàtɛɛnà naa: "Mpɛ iböŋ udu a un'yiiŋ amɛ!"
Taaŋ mbɔɔn ntɛɛn awà kàkyer atɔnà, wɛɛ mpal mwɛy nde kàtɛn u mpem ande naa: "Yà ndandaa naa mɛ Nzam bɔɔmà in'fun'man anki, mɛ sye akà mbuur mwɛy làkoo in'fun'sà anki,
wɛɛ asànaa un'kweel a un'dim wà kàman'sà pfwopfwo, mɛ in'kyer un'lɔ̈ɔ̈n ndaa ande, naa tɛy, usinayaa nde abà, nde ayan'twääl lingyoomà."»
Apan Mwol waa ufàkwɛy naa: «Làwem ndaa kan'tɛn ntɛɛn un'be wà!
Wɛ bɛ làsii naa Nzam uyàpà anki iböŋ agyägyä akà baar ande kàsɔ̈ɔ̈l nde, bàfun'bel mpib anà mwäänà? Nde ayàbwiy mpib mukyer abà?
Mɛ, mɛ alàkyään naa nde ba iböŋ ayapà agyägyä. Wɛɛ, nkye mpal usàyà Mwan a mbuur, nde akyer asàtaan làkwikilà u mɛɛn?»
Ungö apan Yɛsu kàfàtà nsim ntɔn baar bàfàkyey uyɔl naa ba bà baar a balàbal anà bàfàbɛy baar bumwɛy.
Nde kàtɛn abà: «Baar bööl bàkaanà u ndwà a Nzam mukàyamà: umwɛy kàkäl Umfarisi, wumwɛy un'füür a itɛr.

Umfarisi kàkäl umbär anà muyamà u mpem ande naa: "Ɔɔ Nzam, mɛ amafuur an'tɔɔn ntɔn mukɔɔn akal asànaa baar bumwɛy, aŋunkaam, baar mpa abà balàbal, baar a inswem, itàkal asànaa un'füür a itɛr wà.
Mɛ in'fàkin mbɔr ilä byeel u mpɔsà mwɛy, in'fàpà kwen unsà indiir nkam amɛ byanswà."
Un'füür a itɛr kàkäl ukɔl, nde kàkwen anki musuub ntabwey ande. Wɛɛ nde kàyabɛɛrà itɔl ande, waa kàtɛɛnà naa: "Ɔɔ Nzam, ngwem ngyɛb ntɔn mɛ in'wà mbuur a man'be!"

Ndandaa mɛ alàkyään, un'füür a itɛr Nzam kun'twey mbuur a balàbal mpal kàfurà nde ndwà ande, wɛɛ kà Umfarisi anki. Ntɔn mbuur wanswà afàsɛnà bàkyer afun'tyeey, wɛɛ mbuur afàtyà bàkyer afun'sɛɛn.»
Umpal ayin yàmɛnà naa baar bàyàtwaal baan ambɛy akà Yɛsu ntɔn nde kasi an'kɔɔ. Alɔŋki bàmɛn ba abun, waa baŋän.
Yɛsu waa kabel, waa kàtɛn naa: «Lawɛy baan bàyi apà mɛ! Twon làmatsuŋ, ntɔn imwol a Nzam kye a baar abà asànaa ba.
Mɛ ndandaa alàkyään, mbuur mpa awal imwol a Nzam asànaa mwan, nde kya usàbilà anki.»
Mfum mwɛy kàfuul Yɛsu naa: «Un'lɔɔŋ aŋàbwaŋ, mɛ in'kyer aben muwal möö a mbul a in'tye?»
Yɛsu kàtɛn a nde naa: «Ntɔn nkye aman'bel ngye aŋàbwaŋ? Akà mbuur mwɛy wàŋàbwaŋ watɛy, usàkɔɔn akal Nzam mpɛl.
Ngye akiyöb in'kɔɔn: "Twon an'tà inswem, twon an'lɔ, twon an'yib, twon an'tà imbäl a loor, sà làkoo akà taaràŋà anà ngwa."»
Wɛɛ nde kun'fuur naa: «Ayin yanswà mɛ in'kyer afàlab sɛmà imbɛy.»
Ungö kàwem nde abwɛy, Yɛsu kun'fuur naa: «Undiir mwɛy mpɛl kàmasääl: Yälà indiir angye byanswà, waa akääb ngim ayin aŋàlàmbwà, waa ngye asàwal un'naaŋ u du. Ungö, yan'läb!»
Umpal kàwem mbuur awà abwɛy, nde kàmɛn mpay mbɔɔn u mpem ande, ntɔn nde kàkäl ŋunaaŋ a kölàköl.
Yɛsu kàmɛn nde naa ŋun'naaŋ kan'kwamà ndür, nde kàtɛn naa: «Yà mpay akà aŋin'naaŋ mubilà uboo a Imwol a Nzam!
Lalan mpay yatɛy akà mpoonà mubilà u mun a nsway akwà naa ŋun'naaŋ mubilà uboo a Imwol a Nzam.»
Baar bun'weemà bàtɛn naa: «Woo, abwɛy nà kan'kwo muwà mɔ̈ɔ̈?»
Yɛsu kafuur naa: «Indiir mpa bàfàkwo baar, akà Nzam bya mpay byatɛy.»
Apan Petɔlà waa kàtɛn naa: «Atöl bi, bi kàsàwɛy indiir abi ŋakwo ntɔn mulab ngye.»
Yɛsu kàtɛn a ba naa: «Ndandaa mɛ alàkyään, isàkal naa ntɔn imwol a Nzam, mbuur an'sàwɛy ndwà ande, un'kyay ande, atɔŋ ande, aböör ande itàkal baan ande,
nde asàwal mbɔɔn u mpalàyi, wɛɛ umpal isàyà nde asàwal mɔ̈ɔ̈ a mbul a in'tye.»
Yàmɛnà naa Yɛsu kàwɛl Bàkwen Aŋiyweel tsütsü apà nde, waa kàtɛn a ba naa: «Làler, bi ibeenà Yɛlusàlɛm, ndaa yanswà bàsön aŋangɔɔm ntɔn Mwan a mbuur ikyer akàkwo.
Lalan ba bàyun'pà kà an'kɔɔ a baar mpa bàyöb Nzam, ba bàkyer ayun'sɛ, bàkyer ayun'to, bàkyer ayun'tsul an'te.
Ungö apan ba bàkyer ayun'kam an'füm, waa bàyun'dwa. Wɛɛ kà ilä kyàtär nde akyer ayàwiyà.»
Wɛɛ alɔŋki ande bàyöbà anki akà undiir unsà ndaa ayin, mbuul aya bàkyer ayee, ba bàyöb anki naa Yɛsu nkye kàkwen mutɛn.
Mpal kàkäl Yɛsu tsütsü a Yɛlikɔ, ikwàmii mwɛy kàkäl aŋàbwaay ukɔl a mbwo wàmulɔɔmà akà baar.
Mpal kàwem nde làso a baar bàkäl mulyaaŋ, nde kàfuul naa nkye ikalyaaŋà.
Ba bun'kyään naa Yɛsu un'nsi Nazàlɛr wàmulyaaŋ.
Nde kàkuub in'lalà: «Yɛsu, Mwan a David, ngwem ngyɛb!»
Baar bàyikyeenà kusà bun'tsüŋà musà làso, wɛɛ nde kàsöönà mukuub in'lalà: «Mwan a David, ngwem ngyɛb!»
Yɛsu laa kàmbär nde, waa kàswɛŋ naa bun'twääl awà. Mpal kàtöl ikwàmii tsütsü apà nde, Yɛsu kun'fuul naa:
«Ngye ininà akwen mɛ mukyer ntɔn ngye?» Ikwàmii kun'fuur naa: «Mwol, wɛy mɛ in'fàman.»
Wɛɛ Yɛsu waa kàtɛn a nde naa: «Fàman! Làkwikilà angye làmakɔɔr.»
Apan sye laa kàfàman nde, kàläb nde Yɛsu, wàmuyisyäŋà Nzam. Baar banswà bàmɛn ba abun laa bàsyäŋà ba Nzam.
Ilä mwɛy Yɛsu kàbilà u Yɛlikɔ, nde kàlyaaŋ uboo a la.
Wɛɛ le, kwo kàkäl anà mbuur ikɔb ande Zakay. Nde kàkäl mfum a afüür a itɛr, nde kàkäl ŋun'naaŋ.
Nde kàkweenà muman naa Yɛsu kàkäl nà, wɛɛ nde kàkwe anki ntɔn baar bàkäl mbɔɔn, ntɔn nde kàkäl ikökö.
Nde kàkaamà ntiin kusà, waa kàlär udu a un'te ntɔn nde umɛn Yɛsu ntɔn nde ayàlyaaŋ paa.
Mpal kàkɔlà Yɛsu kà ikal akin, nde kàler u du, waa kàtɛn a nde naa: «Zakay, yatɔlà agyägyä, mɛ ŋàbà in'kàbɔ̈ɔ̈n u ndwà angye.»
Zakay kàtɔlà agyägyä, waa kàwɛl Yɛsu unsà un'sak.
Mpal bàmɛn baar abun, ba banswà bàkyer aŋüŋün, waa bàtɛn naa: «Làler, nde akyer akàbɔ̈ɔ̈n u ndwà a mbuur a man'be wà!»
Wɛɛ Zakay laa kàmbär nde, waa kàtɛn a nde naa: «Mwol, wem, mɛ in'pà boboo a indiir amɛ akà aŋàlàmbwà, isàkal naa mɛ kàgyɔɔr undiir a mbuur, mɛ un'fuur mbalà nà udu a wa.»
Apan Yɛsu kàtɛn ntɔn nde naa: «Ŋabawà mɔ̈ɔ̈ kan'bilà u ndwà ayi, ntɔn nde sye wà mwan a Abàlam.
Ntɔn Mwan a mbuur kàyi muleŋ anà mutswà mɔ̈ɔ̈ a baar bàdiimà mbwo.»
Umpal bàkäl ba muweemà ndaa ayi, Yɛsu kàläb mutà nsim mwɛy. Ntɔn nde kàkäl tsütsü a Yɛlusàlɛm, wɛɛ ba bàsii naa Imwol a Nzam ikyer amɛnà apanà.
Làwem ndaa kàtɛn nde: «Mbuur mwɛy wà ywar a imwol kàkäl tsütsü mukyà nsi a kwɛl ntɔn bun'si mfum. Ungö nde waa kàyàfurà nsi ande.
Nde kàbel baar kwem uboo a asyääl ande, waa kàpɛ akà umwɛy umwɛy itɛr a wɔl. Ungö apan nde kaswɛŋ mutà yà a ngim ayin ntɔn ya ibör yàsin tii mpal usyefurà nde.
Wɛɛ mbuur awà, baar a nsi ande bàfun'kwenà anki. Lalan bàtöm ba akyeey ungö ande ntɔn mutɛn naa: "Bi ikwen anki naa mbuur awun uyaal u nsi abi!"
Ungö bun'si ba mfum, nde kàfurà nsi ande. Nde kàbel asyääl akwà kàpɛ nde ngim ntɔn muyöb naa ya ininà yàbör.
Wàtàtwɛb kàyi nde, kàtɛn naa: "Un'lɔɔŋ, itɛr a wɔl angye kyan'bɔr itɛr kwem."
Apan, Nkum ande naa: "Yubwaŋ mbɔɔn, ngye awà un'syääl aŋàbwaŋ! Ngye an'syääl balàbal unsà undiir ikikye, mɛ amasà mfum a an'bul a kölàköl kwem."
Wàyweel waa kàyàsin, waa kàtɛn naa: "Un'lɔɔŋ, itɛr a wɔl a ngye kyan'bɔr ityeen asin."
Nkum waa kàtɛn ande sye naa: "Yubwaŋ, mɛ amasà mfum a an'bul a kölàköl an'tyeen."
Ungöngö, umwɛy waa kàyi, waa kàtɛn naa: "Mwol, itɛr a wɔl angye kyaki: mɛ kya kàyee uboo a itɛɛnà a ipfɛy.
Lalan mɛ kàmɛn bɔɔmà angye, ntɔn ngye awà mbuur a ndaa a ngwal, ngye afàwal ngim kà ikal mpa kàsi ngye, ngye afàbwo ywaŋ mpa kàkön ngye."

Nde waa kàtɛn a nde naa: "Un'syääl un'be! Mbar angye mɛ in'tsul unsà ndaa angye ŋakwo! Ngye kàkyer ayöb naa mɛ in'wà mbuur a ndaa a ngwal, in'fàwal ngim kà ikal mpa kàsi mɛ, in'fàbwo ywaŋ mpa kàkön mɛ.
Wɛɛ ntɔn nkye mpa kàsi ngye ngim amɛ u bank? U mfurà amɛ, mɛ in'làwal bweel!"
Apan nde kàswɛŋ akà baar bàkäl paa: "Làduum itɛr a wɔl kin akà nde, làpɛ kya akà mbuur awe abyà kwem!"
Ba waa bàtɛn a nde naa: "Un'lɔɔŋ, nde we abyà kwem!"
Mɛ alàkyään naa: "mbuur awe anà bya bàkyer asun'kwɛy, wɛɛ mbuur mpa awe undiir bàkyer asun'lwom itàkal kindam awe nde akyà!
Wɛɛ ayiiŋ amɛ akwà mpa bàkwen naa mɛ in'käl mfum, latwääl pà, ladwä u mii amɛ!"»
Ungö mutɛn abà, Yɛsu kàkyen kusà a un'sɛŋ a baar kàkäl mubeenà Yɛlusàlɛm.
Mpal kàsin nde tsütsü apà Bɛtfagɛ anà Bɛtani, tsütsü apà mɔŋ bàfàbel naa mɔŋ a in'te a ɔlivɛ, nde kàtöm alɔŋki bööl kusà,
waa kàtɛn naa: «Làkyen u bul lanà u sim. Bɛ làsàkɔlà, bɛ làkàman mwan a anɛ wàŋabäm, udu awa mbuur ŋàtàlaar anki. Lun'tsuuŋ, lun'twääl pà.
Wɛɛ isàkal naa mbuur amàlafuul naa: "Ntɔn nkye làtsuuŋà bɛ wa?" Lun'fuur naa: "Mwol we anà mfun a wa."»
Umpal bàkyen antööm, ba bàmɛn asànaa kàtɛn Yɛsu.
Utaaŋ bàkäl ba mutsuuŋ mwan a anɛ wa, aŋawa bafuul naa: «Ntɔn nkye làtsuuŋà bɛ wa?»
Ba bàfuur naa: «Mwol we anà mfun a wa.»
Apan ba bàsyen mwan a anɛ akà Yɛsu. Ba bàyeel ipfɛy aba udu a ntsür, waa bàbay Yɛsu mulaar udu awa.
Mpal kàkäl nde muyikyà, baar bàyiyeelà ipfɛy aba u mbwo.
Utaaŋ kàkäl nde tsütsü a Yɛlusàlɛm, u mbumà a mɔŋ a in'te a ɔlive, un'kàbɔ a alɔŋki wanswà kàkäl mukömà Nzam unsà un'sak, u ndaa a ngwal, ntɔn impà byanswà bàmɛnà ba.
Ba bàtɛɛnà naa: «Wɛy Nzam usaak mfum kan'yà kà ikɔb a Mwol! Duu u dudu anà làkoo akà Nzam.»
Uboo a un'kàbɔ awà bàkäl anà Amfarisi amwɛy, ba bàtɛn a Yɛsu naa: «Un'lɔɔŋ, aswɛŋ alɔŋki angye bàwɛy musà làso.»
Yɛsu waa kafuur naa: «Mɛ alàkyään naa ba bàsàkal a duu, in'kul ikyer a kuub in'kwɛŋ.»
Mpal kàkäl Yɛsu tsütsü a bul a kölàköl anà kàmɛn nde la, nde kàkyer alel ntɔn la,
anà kàtɛn nde naa: «Ngye sye alàyöb ŋàbà naa ngye akyer aben muman duu! Wɛɛ apanà ndaa ayi yàŋayee u mii angye!
Ntɔn ngye, ilä abyà iyà ungö ayiiŋ angye bàkyer asasà uboboo a ibä, bàkyer asadiŋà anà bàsaküünà ntsü yanswà.
Ba bàkyer asapay ipepey, ngye anà baar angye. Ba bàsàwɛy anki un'kul udu a un'kul wumwɛy, ntɔn ngye kàyöb anki taaŋ kàyi Nzam muyaler!»
Ungö apan Yɛsu kàbilà u ndwà a Nzam, waa kàsɛmà muböŋ ayääl,
waa kàtɛn a ba naa: «Bàsön naa: "Ndwà amɛ isàkal ndwà a ngyamàkà." Wɛɛ bɛ ya lan'buul mboo a mbüüb!»
Yɛsu kàlɔɔŋà ilä byanswà u ndwà a Nzam. Amfum a angaŋ, alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn anà abyääl a baar banswà bàleŋà mukun'dwa.
Wɛɛ ba bàyöbà anki naa ba bàkyer aben mukɔr nde, ntɔn baar banswà bàkäl muweemà nde ubwaŋàbwaŋ.
Yàmɛnà naa ilä mwɛy, Yɛsu kàkäl mulɔŋ baar u ndwà a Nzam anà mupay Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ. Amfum a angaŋ, alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn anà andweer bàyi
mukun'fuul naa: «Ikyään, unsà ikɔ̈b nà akakyerà ngye indiir abi, nà kapɛ ikɔ̈b udu a bya?»
Yɛsu kafuur naa: «Mɛ sye in'kwen mukàlafuul undiir mwɛy. Lan'kyään:
Ywan nà kun'töm mudümà baar? Du lɛɛ baar?»
Wɛɛ ba bàbulà muyweer ba a ba naa: «Bi isàfuur naa: "Du kun'töm", nde ayifuul naa: "Ntɔn nkye mpa lun'kyey bɛ?"
Wɛɛ bi isàtɛn naa: "Baar bun'töm", baar banswà bàyilom in'kul, ntɔn ba bàkyàyöb naa Ywan kàkäl ŋangɔɔm.»
Apan ba bun'fuur naa: «Bi iyöb anki naa nde kàfü ken.»
Yɛsu waa kàtɛn a ba naa: «Aay, mɛ sye alàkyään anki naa nà kan'pɛ mbwo mukyer indiir abi.»

Apan nde kàfàtɛɛl un'sɛŋ nsim yi: «Mbuur mwɛy kàkön ywaŋ a vin. Nde kàsɔ̈ɔ̈m la akà baar bàfàkyer vin ntɔn ba bàkyer isal aba uboo kwo. Ungö nde kàkyen nsi a kwɛl. Nde kwo kàkyer taaŋ mbɔɔn.
Taaŋ abwo mbɛŋ làkwe la, nde kàtöm un'syääl ande mwɛy akà baar aban ntɔn ba bun'pɛ kab lànde. Wɛɛ akyeer a man laa bàdüb ba un'syääl awun, waa kàfurà an'kɔɔ ipɔl.
Ŋaywaŋ kàtöm un'syääl asin. Nde awà sye bàkyer un'düb, bàkyer un'to, waa bun'fuur an'kɔɔ ipɔl.
Nde kàfàtɔm un'syääl wàtär. Awun sye bun'yɔ̈ɔ̈l, waa bun'böŋ.
Ŋaywaŋ kàyweer naa: "Mɛ in'kyer aben? Mɛ in'tɔm mwan baal amɛ in'fàkwen mɛ, mɛ in'sii naa ba bàkyer akun'sà làkoo."
Wɛɛ mpal bun'mɛn akyeer a vin, ba bàyweerà ba a ba naa: "Làler ikyee! Yää bi kun'dwä waa ywaŋ a vin làyàbulà làbi."
Laa bun'böŋ ba, waa bun'dwä. «Apan ŋaywaŋ asàkyer aben ntɔn ba?
Nde ŋakwo akyer asàyà, nde asàdwa akyeer a man abà banswà, waa usàsɔɔm ywaŋ akà baar asin.» Mpal bàwem baar ndaa ayi yanswà, ba bàtɛn naa: «Ndaa a tub ayi isàbwà anki!»
Wɛɛ Yɛsu kaler nde, waa kàtɛn naa: «Ndaa bàsön yi iswaŋà aben: "Nkɔŋ bàpiy atööŋ a ndwà, "yàbulà nkɔŋ a twɛrà."
«Mbuur wanswà asàbwà udu a nkɔŋ ayin akyer asàbɔɔ. Wɛɛ isàkal naa nkɔŋ ayi yan'bweel mbuur, nde akyer asàpää nwamnwam.»
Taaŋ nsil alan, alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn anà amfum a angaŋ bàkwen mukɔr Yɛsu, ntɔn ba bàkyer ayöb naa nde nsim yi ba kàtɛɛl, wɛɛ ba bàtiinà un'seŋ bɔɔmà.

Apan ba bàsɛmà musey Yɛsu. Lalan bun'tööm ba baar bàfakurà naa ba bà baar aŋàbwaŋ. Baar abà bàlàlwab Yɛsu ndaa unsà mfuul mwɛy ntɔn ba bàwɛl iböŋ mukun'yälà akà abyääl anà akà mfum a nsi.
Baar aban bàtɛn a nde naa: «Un'lɔɔŋ, bi ikyàyöb naa ndaa afàtɛn ngye anà afàlɔŋ ngye yà ndandaa. Ngye afàler anki ntabwey a mbuur mupà nde ikwàndwà, wɛɛ ngye afàlɔŋ ndandaa mbwo a Nzam.
Wɛɛ bi ikwen muyöb naa nkye un'kɔɔn abi kà ipaa mbwo bi mufur itɛr akà Sɛzar lɛɛ tɛy?»
Wɛɛ Yɛsu kàyöb nkwɛɛr a ba, waa kàtɛn a ba naa:
«Lan'swɛŋ itɛr a ngim. Ntabwey anà ikɔb ki udu a kya byà nà?» Ba bàfuur naa: «Byà Sɛzar.»
Apan Yɛsu kàtɛn a ba naa: «Abun, làpɛ yà Sɛzar akà Sɛzar, yà Nzam akà Nzam.»
Lalan ba bàsàman anki ube unsà yinà yanswà kàtɛɛnà nde u mii a baar. Ba bàkäl mubem mfuur ande, ba ndaa bàfàsà anki.
Yàmɛnà naa Asadusu amwɛy bàyi akà Yɛsu. Ba baar bàfàtɛn naa akü bàfàwiyà anki. Ba bun'fuul,
waa bàtɛn a nde naa: «Un'lɔɔŋ, Mɔsɛ kà ipɛ un'kɔɔn aŋàsɔn: "Isàkal naa mbuur aŋàkwɛl kan'kwà ukɔɔn asàwɛy baan, un'tɔŋ ande asàwal un'kyay kàkäl wànde ntɔn mupà ikyee akà un'kü."
Kyekà, bàkäl anà atɔŋ nsambwaar. Wàtàtwɛb kàkyer abääl, ungö waa kàkü ukɔɔn abɔr.
Wàyweel waa kàbääl un'kaar kàsàwɛy bweel ande,
wàtär sye abun. Ya yàkäl abun ntɔn ba bànsambwaar: ba bàkü ukɔɔn abɔr.
Ungö apan un'kaar sye waa kàkü.
Abun, ilä bàsàwiyà akü, un'kaar awà asàkal un'kyay a nà? Ntɔn ba bànsambwaar bàkyer un'bääl.»
Wɛɛ Yɛsu kafuur naa: «Abaal anà akaar a nsi yi bàkyer afàbääl,
wɛɛ abaal anà akaar bàsɔ̈ɔ̈l muwiyà kà ukwà anà mukal anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ taaŋ làsàyà, bàsàbääl anki.
Ba bàfàsàkwà anki, ba bà asànaa akyeey a du. Ba bà baan a Nzam, ntɔn ba baan a ngwiiyà.
Mɔsɛ ŋakwo kàtɛn ubwaŋàbwaŋ naa akü bàkyer asàwiyà. Uboo a nsim a ibwiy a mbaa, nde Mwol Nzam kun'bel Nzam a Abàlam, Nzam a Isak, Nzam a Yakɔb.»
Yɛsu kàfàkwɛy naa: «Mwol wà Nzam a baar a möö, nde kà wà Nzam a akü anki, ntɔn akà nde baar banswà bye anà mɔ̈ɔ̈.»
Alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn amwɛy bàtɛn a nde naa: «Un'lɔɔŋ, ngye an'tɛn ubwaŋ.»
Abun ba nde ndaa bàfun'fuul anki.
Yɛsu kàtɛn a ba naa: «Ban'kwo mutɛn aben naa Klistɔ wà mwan a David?
Ntɔn David atɛɛnà nde ŋakwo uboo a un'kaan a an'diim naa: "Mwol kàtɛn akà Mwol amɛ: "Bwaay u kɔɔ amɛ là ibaal,
mɛ in'kwen mubwiy ayiiŋ angye ntɔn ba bàbulà ikal angye mutɔɔl in'kɔl."
David kun'bel Mwol: Klistɔ kan'kwo mufàkal mwan a David?»
Ilä mwɛy, mpal kàkäl un'sɛŋ wanswà mulab an'lɔɔŋ ande, Yɛsu kàtɛn a alɔŋki ande naa:

«Làkäl kà igyɛɛŋ ntɔn alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn: isal aba uyilyaaŋ anà mvwɛl anà bàfàkwɛn naa bàyapà mbɔr u balàbal. Ba bàfàsɔɔl an'kir amà kusà uboo a ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà anà ikal a làkoo u mɛsà adyà a kölàköl.
Ba bàfàduum indiir a akweel a adim byanswà, taaŋ nsil alan ba bàfàsà ngyamàkà a bwɛlàbwɛl ntɔn baar bamɛn: nsaŋ aba isàkal yà kölàköl.»
Yàmɛnà naa ilä mwɛy, mpal kàkäl Yɛsu muler, nde kàmɛn aŋin'naaŋ bàmusà an'kab aba uboo a insak a an'kab.
Nde kàmɛn sye un'kweel un'dim mwyɛ wàŋàlàmbwà wàmusà an'falà mɔ̈ɔ̈l.
Nde kàtɛn naa: «Ndandaa mɛ alàkyään: un'kweel un'dim wàŋàlàmbwà wà kan'pà yàŋàsöön baar banswà.
Ntɔn baar bumwɛy banswà ban'pà ngim ikɔ̈ɔ̈n ndöŋ akà ba, wɛɛ nde, unsà làmbwà ande, nde kan'pà yinà yanswà ikäl ntɔn mɔ̈ɔ̈ ande.»
Ilä mwɛy, baar amwɛy bàkäl mukan in'kul anà indiir byàpɛɛ ntwɛn a ndwà a Nzam, wɛɛ Yɛsu kàtɛn naa:
«Ilä byà paa mpa usàsaal akà un'kul mwɛy udu a un'kul wumwɛy uboo a bya làmanà bɛ bi: bya byanswà byàsàkyer apää.»
Apan ba waa bun'fuul naa: «Un'lɔɔŋ, ndaa ayi isàlyaaŋ mpal nà? Undiir nà asàswaŋ ngyeel a ndaa ayi?»
Yɛsu kàfuur naa: «Làkäl kà igyɛɛŋ, mbuur twon amàlakur. Ntɔn baar mbɔɔn bàsàyà kà ikɔb amɛ, waa bàsàtɛn naa: "Mɛ in'wà Klistɔ!" Anà: "Taaŋ lan'kwo!" Wɛɛ twon làmalab.
Mpal làsàwem bɛ naa ità anà lingyoomà byan'yà, twon lan'man bɔɔmà: yubwaŋ naa bya itàyà abun kusà, wɛɛ bya kà ntsüü anki.»
Apan nde waa kàtɛn a ba naa: «Isàmɛnà naa nsi mwɛy yàmunwan anà nsi yumwɛy, imwol mwɛy anà imwol kyumwɛy.
Mɛɛn ikyer asàtɛɛr ngwal. Kà ikal mbɔɔn ngyal mbɔɔn anà an'fway màkyer asàbilà, ndaa a bɔɔmà yà ifà ifà ikyer asàtoo, idiim a kölàköl byàkyer asàmɛnà u du.

Wɛɛ kusà a ndaa ayi yanswà, bàkyer asàlakɔr, bàkyer asàlamɛɛy nkwaaŋ, bàkyer asàlasyen u làbay a nsaŋ a amfum a ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà, waa bàsàlatɔɔm u bɔlokà. Ntɔn ikɔb amɛ, bàkyer asàlasyen akà amfum a nsi anà akà amfum a itiir a nsi.
Indiir abi byanswà isàlayeel ntɔn bɛ làkäl anà mbwo mutà imbäl.
Twon lan'yweer kusà naa bɛ làkyer aben musàsà un'lɔɔn abɛ.
Mɛ ŋakwo in'kyer asàlapà ndaa anà an'yeerà mpa bàsàtɔn ayiiŋ abɛ itàkal musà mbaaŋ.
Baar bàsàlayälà bà aböör anà atɔŋ abɛ, baar a tsütsü a bɛ anà asam abɛ, ba bàsàdwa baar mbɔɔn uboo a bɛ.
Baar banswà bàkyer asàlayiiŋ ntɔn mɛ.
Wɛɛ akà làtswe abɛ làmwɛy làsàdiimà anki.
Abun, ntɔn nkääŋ a mpem abɛ, bɛ làsàwà mɔ̈ɔ̈.
«Wɛɛ mpal làsàman bɛ naa aŋità ban'diŋà Yɛlusàlɛm, apan làyöb naa mpää a la yà tsütsü.
Apan, wɛy baar a Yuday bàtiin udu a myɔŋ. Wɛy baar abà u Yɛlusàlɛm bàtoo agyägyä. Wɛy baar abà u bitsuŋ a ndwà bàkɔ̈ɔ̈n abilà u bul a kölàköl!
Ntɔn ilä abin isàkal ilä a bweel, ntɔn Ndaa Aŋàsɔn yanswà ikwe.
Ngyɛb akà akaar bàsàkal anà an'yöm anà akaar bàsàkal munüü baan ilä abin! Ntɔn ntaan isàkal uboo a nsi yi, anà nkyɛl ntɔn un'sɛŋ wà.
Baar a nsi yi bàsadwa a kɔm, bumwɛy bàsasyen asɔ u nsi a ingyey, wɛ Yɛlusàlɛm làsàbulà là baar mpa bàyöb Nzam tii mpal isàwà isɔ.
«Idiim ikyer asàkal uboo a taaŋ, uboo a nsöŋ anà unsà mbwaar. U mɛɛn baar banswà bàsàkal mutɛɛr a bɔɔmà ntɔn làso anà ibɔ a an'dà a ngyäl.
Lalan baar mbɔɔn bàsàkwà a bɔɔmà muyweer ndaa isàbwà u mɛɛn manswà, ntɔn ngwal a du yanswà ikyer asàni.
Apan, baar bàsàman Mwan a mbuur wàmuyà uboo a itööm unsà ngwal anà làkoo mbɔɔn.
Taaŋ isàlyaŋ ndaa ayi yanswà, làsuub un'tswe anà làsi un'kanà, ntɔn ntsuuŋ abɛ isàkal tsütsü.»
Apan Yɛsu katɛɛl nsim yi: «Làler un'te a maŋ anà in'te myanswà:
Bɛ làsàman naa mya myan'fulà, bɛ lan'yöb bɛ ŋakwo naa paŋà a mbul là tsütsü.
Ya sye yabun mpal làsàman bɛ naa ndaa ayi yan'yà, làyöb naa Imwol a Nzam kyà tsütsü.
Mɛ ndandaa alàkyään, nkööl ayi isàlyaŋ anki kusà a ndaa ayi yanswà mukwo.
Du anà mɛɛn màkyer asàlyaaŋ, wɛɛ ndaa amɛ isàlyaaŋ anki akà ikikye.
«Làkäl kà ikyɛɛŋ bɛ ŋakwo ntɔn an'kyän abɛ màkɔ̈ɔ̈n abwà mpye ntɔn udyà mbɔɔn, unwà mbɔɔn anà ngyɛb ntɔn indiir a mɛɛn mà, naa tɛy, ilä aki isàyàlataan kà imbwirà imbwirà.
Ntɔn kya isàbwà asànaa an'tɛy udu a baar a mɛɛn banswà.
Làkäl kà ikyɛɛŋ, làyamà taaŋ lanswà, ntɔn bɛ làkäl anà ngwal mutiin ndaa iyà yi yanswà anà musàkal umbär kusà a Mwan a mbuur.»
U mwäänà Yɛsu kàlɔɔŋà u ndwà a Nzam, wɛ sisye nde kàkyeenà mukàtyeey taaŋ u mɔŋ bàfàbel naa mɔŋ a in'te a ɔlive.
Ututu tutu, un'sɛŋ wanswà kàkyeenà akà nde u ndwà a Nzam ntɔn mukun'wem.
Un'kyɔm a mampà màkɔ̈ɔ̈n ful bàfàbel Pak làsin tsütsü.
Amfum a angaŋ anà alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn bàleŋà mudwa Yɛsu, wɛɛ ba bàweemà bɔɔmà a un'sɛŋ.
Apan, Satanà kàbilà u mpem a Yudas Iskaryɔt, umwɛy uboo a Bàkwem Aŋiyweel.
Yudas kàkyen akà amfum a angaŋ anà amfum a aleer a ndwà a Nzam ntɔn nde ukàyäm anà ba muyöb naa nde Yɛsu ayun'yälà aben.
Ba bàkäl kà un'sak, waa bàyilà naa ba bàyun'pà ngim.
Nde waa kàkyey. Sɛmà apan, nde kàleŋà ipöl aŋàbwaŋ muyälà Yɛsu kà unku, ntɔn baar banswà bàkɔ̈ɔ̈n ayöb.
Yàmɛnà naa ilä a mampà màkɔ̈ɔ̈n ful, ilä bàfàdwa in'tö a in'kɔk ntɔn Pak kyàkwe kya,
Yɛsu kàtöm Petɔlà anà Ywan, waa kaswɛŋ naa: «Làkyen kàlayilà ndyeel a Pak.»
Ba bun'fuul naa: «Ngye akwen naa bi la ikàyilà ken?»
Yɛsu kafuur naa: «Le, mpal làkàbilà bɛ u bul a kölàköl, bɛ làkàman mbuur mwɛy anà làbuuŋ a an'dà. Lun'läb tii u ndwà ukàbilà nde.
Bɛ làkàtɛn a ŋandwà abà: "Un'lɔɔŋ kan'tɛn a ngye naa: Làken suk in'dyà mɛ Pak anà alɔŋki amɛ?"
Waa nde ukàlaswaŋ, u ndwà adu, suk a kölàköl làŋalɔɔn ubwaŋàbwaŋ, ikal làkàyilà bɛ Pak kyakin.»
Ba waa bàkyen, bàmɛn ndaa yanswà asànaa kàtɛn Yɛsu, waa bàyilà isaa a Pak.
Taaŋ làkwe la, Yɛsu kàkäl u mɛsà anà antööm.
Nde kàtɛn a ba naa: «Mɛ, mɛ kàkwen mbɔɔn mudyà Pak alà anà bɛ kusà muman mpay.
Lalan, mɛ ndandaa alàkyään naa mɛ in'fàsàdyà anki la tii ilä isàmɛnà mbuul a la uboo a Imwol a Nzam.»
Apan, nde kàwɛl kɔɔb, kàfuur an'tɔɔn, waa kàtɛn naa: «Làwɛl kɔɔb là, làkäb la bɛ a bɛ,
ntɔn mɛ alàkyään naa sɛmà apanà mɛ in'fàsànwà anki vin tii mpal isàyà Imwol a Nzam.»
Ungö apan, nde kàwɛl mampà, waa kàfuur an'tɔɔn akà Nzam, kàtsül ma, kapɛ, waa kàtɛn naa: «Ayi ndür amɛ bàpɛ ntɔn bɛ. Làkyer abà ntɔn mukan'yɔbà.»
Ungö a udyà, nde kàwɛl kɔɔb, waa kàtɛn naa: «Lalà kɔɔb a un'tüüb akün kan'kyer bi unsà an'kil amɛ amiyàpää ntɔn bɛ.
Wɛɛ le, mbuur ayàyälà mɛ wà papà u mɛsà anà mɛɛ.
Ntɔn Mwan a mbuur wàmukyà asànaa bàtsül ya, wɛɛ ngyɛb akà mbuur kàmun'yälà!»
Apan, ba bàbulà mufufuul ba a ba naa uboo a ba nà ayàkyer undiir a tub awà.
Yàmɛnà naa ilä mwɛy alɔŋki bàsyeelà mbaaŋ ba a ba: ba bàkwen muyöb naa uboo a ba nà awà mbuur a kölàköl.
Yɛsu kàtɛn a ba naa: «Amfum a in'sɛŋ bàkyer afandyaar, baar abye anà ikɔ̈b udu a ba bàfàleŋ naa babel baar aŋàbwaŋ.
