Kà yubwaŋ anki bɛ mukyer abà, yubwaŋ naa mbuur a kölàköl uboo a bɛ ukäl umbɛy, wɛɛ mbuur akayaalà ukäl asànaa un'syääl.
Uboo a an'kyän abɛ, nà awà kölàköl? Mbuur kan'bwaay u mɛsà lɛɛ mbuur akapaa isaa? Kà mbuur kan'bwaay u mɛsà anki? Wɛɛ mɛ, mɛ uboo a bɛ in'wà asànaa un'syääl.
Bɛ lan'ndäär u ndür amɛ taaŋ lanswà an'man mɛ mpay.
Lalan, asànaa kan'pɛ Taaràmɛ Imwol, mɛ sye amàlapà kya:
Bɛ làsàdyà anà làsànwà u mɛsà anà mɛ, uboo a imwol amɛ, bɛ làsàbwaay udu a kir a imfum ntɔn mutsul nsaŋ a in'sɛŋ a Isàlɛl myàkwem aŋiyweel.»
Yàmɛnà naa Yɛsu kàtɛn a Simɔn Petɔlà naa: «Simɔn, Simɔn! Le, Satanà kàkyer alɔm naa nde kàlasɛk asànaa bàfàsɛk mbɛŋ mukaab ya anà isɛrà.
Wɛɛ mɛ kàyamà ntɔn ngye, ntɔn làkwikilà angye làkɔ̈ɔ̈n abwà. Wɛɛ ngye, ilä asyefurà ngye akà mɛ, pà atɔŋ angye ngwal.»
Simɔn kàtɛn a nde naa: «Mwol, mɛ an'kyey mukyà anà ngye, itàkal u bɔlokà, itàkal kà ukwà.»
Yɛsu waa kun'fuur naa: «Simɔn, mɛ ndandaa akyään, ŋabawà, kusà nkɔɔ mubel, ngye akyer an'tɔn mukan'yöb mbalà tär.»
Ungö apan, nde kàtɛn a ba naa: «Taaŋ kàlatöm mɛ ukɔɔn ngim, ngɔɔr anà an'sàbar, nkye we anà undiir kàlakɔ̈ɔ̈n?» Ba waa bàfuur naa: «Akà undiir.»
Apan, nde kàtɛn a ba naa: «Wɛɛ papanà, isàkal naa mbuur we anà ngim, uwɛl ya, isàkal sye naa mbuur we anà ngɔɔr, uwɛl wa, isàkal naa mbuur kɔm latɛy, uyälà inkur ande, usöm làmwɛy.
Ntɔn mɛ alàkyään naa yubwaŋ naa undiir aŋàsɔn wà ukwe amu mɛ: "Nde bun'täŋ uboo a adwää baar."»
Waa ba bàtɛn naa: «Mwol, le an'kɔm mɔ̈ɔ̈l amà.» Yɛsu kafuur naa: «Man'kwo!»
Yàmɛnà naa Yɛsu kàkyer atoo, waa kàkyen u mbwo a mɔŋ a in'te a ɔlive asànaa ifà ande. Alɔŋki waa bun'läb.
Mpal kàtöl nde kà ikal akin, nde kaswɛŋ naa: «Làyamà, ntɔn bɛ làkɔ̈ɔ̈n abwà u ndɛb.»
Wɛɛ nde, nde kàkyen ukɔl a ba kà isii a bwɛl ufàkàbwà un'kul awà ban'lom, kàbü an'köm, waa kàyamà
abà: «Ɔɔ Taa, kya ngye asàkwen, lwom kɔɔb là tsütsü apà mɛ! Wɛɛ taaŋ lanswà, wɛy bàkäl ukwen angye, kà bàmɛ anki.» [
Apan, un'kyeey mwɛy waa kàyamɛnà akà nde ntɔn mukun'pà ngwal.
Yàmɛnà naa nkyän yàkyer un'kaar, nde kàfàyamà nswɛy nswɛy, kyaŋ a ndür ande waa làbulà asànaa bin'kul a an'kil byàbwee u mɛɛn.]
Ungö a ngyamàkà ayi, nde waa kàmbarà, kàsin tsütsü apà alɔŋki ande, nde kamɛn bàkyàbɔ̈ɔ̈n a ngyɛb.
Apan, nde kàtɛn a ba naa: «Ntɔn nkye lan'bɔ̈ɔ̈n bɛ? Làmbarà! Làyamà ntɔn bɛ làkɔ̈ɔ̈n abwà u ndɛb.»
Nde kàkäl mutɛn, mpal kàkɔlà un'kàbɔ a baar. Mbuur bàfabeelà Yudas, umwɛy uboo a Bàkwem Aŋiyweel, kàkäl kusà a ba. Nde kàsin tsütsü apà Yɛsu ntɔn mukundüür.
Waa Yɛsu kàtɛn a nde naa: «Yudas, ngye Mwan a mbuur un'yälà a ndüür?»
Mpal bàmɛn baar bàkäl a Yɛsu naa ndaa yan'täy, ba bun'fuul naa: «Un'lɔɔŋ, nkye bi isyääl an'kɔm abi ntɔn munwan?»
Utaaŋ nsil alan, umwɛy uboo a ba kàkäm un'syääl a undweer a angaŋ mwɛy kɔm, waa kun'ywaŋ tsü a ibaal.
Wɛɛ Yɛsu kàtɛn naa: «Làwɛy, yan'kwo!» Apan, nde kàbä tsü a mbuur awun, waa kun'kɔɔr.
Apan, Yɛsu kàtɛn a amfum a angaŋ, a an'kaptɛn a ndwà a Nzam anà andwer a baar bàyi ntɔn mukun'kɔr: «Nkye mɛ in'wà un'dwää a baar waa bɛ làyi anà an'kɔm anà nköl?
Mɛ kàkälà anà bɛ ilä byanswà u ndwà a Nzam, wɛ akà mbuur kan'bä anki. Apanà là taaŋ abɛ anà ngwal a mpib.»
Apan ba bun'te mpi, waa bun'syen u ndwà a amfum a angaŋ. Petɔlà kàyilabà ukwɛl.
Baar bàyöbà mbaa uboo a làpaŋ. Petɔlà kàbwaayà uboo a baar bàkäl ukɔl a ya.
Un'syääl mwɛy wà un'kaar kun'mɛn tsütsü a ba, laa kun'syebà u kyɛɛy a mbaa, waa kàtɛn naa: «Le, mbuur wà sye kàkäl anà nde.»
Wɛɛ nde kàkyer un'tɔn, waa kàtɛn naa: «Un'kaar wà, mɛ nde un'yöb anki.»
Ungö a taaŋ ikikye, mbuur asin kàmɛn nde Petɔlà, kàtɛn a nde naa: «Ngye sye awà umwɛy uboo a baar bà!» Petɔlà naa: «Mbuur wà, mɛ mwo watɛy!»
Tsütsü ungö a taaŋ làmwɛy, mbuur asin waa ufàtɛn a ngwal yanswà: «Ndandaa, mbuur wunà kàkäl anà nde ntɔn nde wà un'nsi Ngalilɛ.»
Petɔlà kàfuur naa: «Mbuur wà, mɛ in'yöb anki naa ngye nkye akwen mutɛn.» Taaŋ nsil alan, nde kàkäl anki aŋàtàmay mutɛn, nkɔɔ waa kàbel.
Mwol kàbulà nde, waa kàler Petɔlà. Apan Petɔlà kàyɔbà ndaa kun'kyään Mwol: «Kusà nkɔɔ mutàbel ŋàbawà, ngye ayan'tɔn mbalà tär!»
Apan laa kàtoo nde, waa kàlel ubwaŋàbwaŋ.
Baar bàkäl muler Yɛsu bàkyer akun'sɛɛ anà kun'dübà.
Ba bun'bäämà ipfɛy u mii, waa bun'fuulà naa: «Le! Tà ngɔɔm! Ikyään nà kàmadwa!»
Laa bun'töö ba in'tswe asin myà ifà ifà.
Mpal làsɛnà taaŋ, nkööŋ a andweer a un'sɛŋ, amfum a angaŋ anà alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn bàkyer aköŋ, waa bun'syɛn u làbay a nsaŋ a kölàköl,
waa bàtɛn naa: «Isàkal naa ngye, ngye awà Klistɔ, ikyään.» Yɛsu kàtɛn a ba naa: «Mɛ in'sàlakyään, bɛ làyàkyey anki,
mɛ in'sàlafuul, bɛ làyan'fuur anki.
Wɛɛ, sɛmà apanà, Mwan a mbuur ayàkal wàŋàbwaay u kɔɔ a ibaal a ngwal a Nzam.»
Apan ba banswà bàtɛn naa: «Iswaŋà naa ngye awà Mwan a Nzam!» Yɛsu kàtɛn naa: «Bɛ ŋakwo lan'tɛn naa mɛ in'wà nde.»
Apan, ba bàtɛn naa: «Bi mfun a imbäl ifàkal anki. Bi ŋakwo kan'wem u mun ande.»
Yàmɛnà naa un'kàbɔ a baar wanswà kàkyer ambarà, waa kàsyen Yɛsu kusà a Pilatu.
Akun, ba bàsɛmà mukun'füün abà: «Bi kan'man mbuur wà wàmutwaal lingyoomà uboo a un'sɛŋ abi: Nde akatsuŋà baar mufur itɛr akà Sɛzar, nde kan'tɛn sye naa nde wà Klistɔ, mfum!»
Apan Pilatu kun'fuul naa: «Nkye ngye awà mfum a Ayudà?» Yɛsu waa kun'fuur naa: «Ngye ŋakwo an'tɛn.»
Pilatu kàtɛn a amfum a angaŋ anà un'kàbɔ a baar naa: «Mɛ in'manà anki undiir kan'kwo mɛ mupà mbuur wà ikwàndwà.»
Wɛɛ ba bàsi unkiiŋ mutɛn naa: «Nde ayimbaar baar mukyer ube unsà an'lɔɔŋ ande u Yuday lanswà sɛmà u Ngalilɛ tii apà.»
Mpal kàwem Pilatu ndaa ayi, nde kafuul naa nkye mbuur awà wà un'nsi Ngalilɛ.
Umpal kàyöb nde naa nde wà mbuur a ikal ufàyaal Ɛlɔdi, nde kun'töm akà Ɛlɔdi. Taaŋ nsil alan Ɛlɔdi kàkäl u Yɛlusàlɛm.
Ɛlɔdi kàkäl unsà un'sak mbɔɔn muman Yɛsu, ntɔn sɛmà itaan nde kàkwen mukun'man, ntɔn yinà kàweemà nde, nde kàleŋà naa nde utàman akà impà mwɛy.
Nde kun'si mfuul mbɔɔn, wɛɛ Yɛsu kàsàfuur anki akà ikikye.
Taaŋ nsil alan, amfum a angaŋ anà alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn bàmbärà paa, bàmukun'füünà a nkyɛl.
Apan, Ɛlɔdi anà aŋità ande bun'mɛn asànaa undiir a bunàbun, waa bun'sɛɛ, bun'bwää inkur aŋàbwaŋ. Ɛlɔdi kun'fuur akà Pilatu.
Ɛlɔdi anà Pilatu bàkäl ayiiŋ, wɛɛ sɛmà ilä akin ba bàbulà asam.
Abun, Pilatu kàbel amfum a angaŋ, abyääl anà un'sɛŋ,
waa kàtɛn a ba naa: «Bɛ lan'twääl mbuur wà naa nde wàmubuul an'kyän a un'sɛŋ. Wɛ mɛ, mɛ amun'fuul u mii abɛ, mɛ in'sàman anki undiir kan'kyer nde uboo a indiir byanswà lun'füünà bɛ.
Ɛlɔdi sye usàman anki ube ande, lalan kàman'fuur nde awà. Abun, mbuur wà undiir ukyer nde watɛy awà ban'kwo mukun'dwa.
Mɛ in'swaŋ baar amɛ bun'käm an'füm, waa mɛ un'wɛy.»
Kà un'kyɔm a Pak wanswà Pilatu kàkäl anà nkääl mukatsuuŋ mbuur a bɔlokà mwɛy.
Wɛɛ un'sɛŋ wanswà kàsɛmà musà in'kwɛŋ: «Idwääl mbuur wà! Un'tsuuŋ Barabas!»
Barabas awà bun'si ba u bɔlokà ntɔn lingyoomà làbü uboo a bul anà nde sye kàdwä mbuur.
Wɛ Pilatu kàkwen muwɛy Yɛsu, waa kàfàtɛn mbalà asin a ba,
wɛɛ ba bàkuub in'kwɛŋ, waa bàtɛn naa: «Un'bɛɛrà u kulunsi! Un'bɛɛrà u kulunsi!»
Wɛɛ nde kàfafuul mbalà yàtär: «Ube nà nde kan'kyer? Mɛ in'sàman anki akà ube mwɛy ntɔn nde ukwe mukwà. Abun, mɛ in'pà mbwo naa bun'pɛ an'füm waa mɛ un'wɛy.»
Wɛɛ ba bàsi unkiiŋ u ndaa a ngwal naa bun'bɛɛrà u kulunsi. In'kwɛŋ aba myàwɛl iböŋ.
Lalan Pilatu kàyer akyey nde ndɔ̈ɔ̈m aba.
Nde kàtsuuŋ mbuur kàbilà bɔlokà ntɔn lingyoomà anà nkweel a mbuur mwɛy, waa kapɛ Yɛsu ntɔn ba bun'kyer undiir bàkweenà ba.
Wɛɛ mpal bàkäl ba mukun'syen, ba bàbweey anà mbuur mwɛy kàkäl u mbwo kàfü nde itsuŋ a ndwà, ikɔb ande Simɔn un'nsi Sirɛn, ba bun'siinà a ngwal mubay Yɛsu musyen kulunsi ungö.
Un'kàbɔ a baar kàkäl muyilab. Akaar sye bàkäl mbɔɔn muyilel anà muman ntaan ntɔn nde.
Yɛsu kàbulà ntsü akà ba, waa kàtɛn a ba naa: «Akaar a Yɛlusàlɛm, twon lan'lel ntɔn mɛ! Làlel ntɔn bɛ ŋakwo anà baan abɛ,
ntɔn le, làyöb naa ilä iyàyà bàyàtɛn naa: "Un'sak akà akaar ikɔb anà akaar mpa bàbör anà mpa bànüü baan."
Apan baar bàsàbulà mutɛn a myɔŋ a bwɛlàbwɛl naa: "Làbü udu a bi!" A myɔŋ a ikökö: "Lifwee!"
Ntɔn isàkal naa un'te a un'bu bàmukyer abà, ya isàkal aben ntɔn un'te aŋàyɔm?»
Yàmɛnà sye naa ba bàsyen, mbwo mwɛy anà Yɛsu, baar bɔ̈ɔ̈l bàfakyerà baar ube, ntɔn bàkadwa sye.
Mpal bàtöl ba kà ikal mwɛy ikɔb akya «Bɔl a un'tswe», ba bàbɛɛrà Yɛsu u kulunsi anà baar bööl abà, umwɛy u kɔɔ ande là ibaal, wumwɛy u kɔɔ ande là ikaar.
Waa Yɛsu kàtɛn naa: «Taa, adwääl nkul, ntɔn ba bàyöb anki ndaa bàkyerà ba.» Ba bàkäb ipfɛy ande mutà löb.
Un'sɛŋ kàkäl paa muleerà. Wɛɛ abyääl bàkäl musɛɛ nde, waa bàtɛɛnà naa: «Nde kàtsü baar asin mɔ̈ɔ̈, wɛy nde utsü mɔ̈ɔ̈ nde ŋakwo isàkal naa nde wà Klistɔ, mbuur kàsɔ̈ɔ̈l Nzam.»
Aŋità sye bàkäl mukun'sɛɛ. Ba bàsin tsütsü apà nde, waa bun'pɛɛ man a nkyään,
waa bàtɛɛnà naa: «Isàkal naa ngye awà mfum a Ayudà, tswà mɔ̈ɔ̈ ngye ŋakwo.»
Udu a nde yàkäl anà ndaa aŋàsɔn abà: «Mbuur wà, wà mfum a Ayudà.»
Umwɛy uboo a baar abe bàkäl u kulunsi waa kun'töö, waa kàtɛn a nde naa: «Nkye ngye kà Klistɔ anki? Tswà mɔ̈ɔ̈ ngye ŋakwo anà bi mwo sye.»
Wɛɛ wumwɛy waa kun'pɛl, kàtɛn a nde naa: «Ngye Nzam bɔɔmà un'tiin anki, ngye mbuur an'wal ntaaŋàmbar nsil ya?
Akà bi, bi ube abi kan'fur, wɛ nde undiir ube ukyer nde watɛy.»
Waa kàkwɛy naa: «Yɛsu, ngyɔbà mpal asàyà ngye kà imwol angye.»
Yɛsu waa kun'fuur naa: «Mɛ ndandaa akyään, ŋabawà ngye akal u du anà mɛ.»
Sɛmà tsütsü a taaŋ a midi tii taaŋ làtär ungö a midi làpib làkyer abwà u nsi yanswà.
Taaŋ làkäl lan'minà, rido a kölàköl làkäl uboo a ndwà a Nzam làkyer akaamà u boboo.
Apan Yɛsu kàsi in'kwɛŋ waa kàtɛn naa: «Taa, mɛ mɔ̈ɔ̈ amɛ an'fuur akà ngye.» Ungö mutɛn ndaa ayi, laa kàkü nde.
Muman ndaa yàlyaaŋ yi, kaptɛn a Lɔmà kàsi Nzam làkoo anà kàtɛn naa: «Ndandaa mbuur wà kàkäl mbuur a balàbal.»
Ungö apan, in'kàbɔ a baar myanswà myàyi muyàler ibaŋ a ndaa aki, bàfurà bàmuyibɛɛrà kà itɔl.
Asam a Yɛsu banswà anà akaar bàyilabà nde sɛmà Ngalilɛ, bàmbärà ukwɛl mulerà ndaa yàlyaaŋà.
Yàmɛnà naa kàkäl anà mbuur mwɛy ikɔb ande Yɔsɛfi, nde kàkäl mbuur a làbay a nsaŋ a kölàköl, mbuur aŋàbwaŋ anà wàbalàbal.
Nde kàkäl anki un'sak anà atɔŋ ande baar a Làbay a Nsaŋ a kölàköl ntɔn ayà bàtsül ba anà bàkyer ba. Nde kàkäl mbuur a bul a Yuday ikɔb la Arimatay, waa kàdilà ngyeel a Imwol a Nzam.
Nde kàkàlɔm ndür a Yɛsu akà Pilatu.
Ungö mutɔl ya u kulunsi, nde kàläl ya uboo a làpye a ntal, waa kàsi ya kà an'dii akün bàfuun uboo a nkɔŋ anà mpa aŋàtàsà mbuur.
Kya kyàkäl ilä muyöŋà ntɔn saba làkäl tsütsü musɛmà.
Akaar bàläbà Yɛsu sɛmà Ngalilɛ bàläb Yɔsɛfi. Ba bàleerà an'dii anà muyöb naa ba ndür a Yɛsu bàtɔl aben.
Ungö, bàfurà ba ndwà aba, ba bàyilà may a usɔŋ anà an'nanàsi. Apan waa bàkyɛɛl saba asànaa Un'kɔɔn utɛɛnà wa.
Ilä a làmiŋ ututu tutu, akaar bàkyen kà an'dii, bàsyen may a usɔŋ bàläm ba.
Ba bàmɛn naa nkɔŋ yàkäl u mun a an'dii bàkyàbuum ukɔl.
Waa bàbilà, wɛɛ ba bàmɛn anki ndür a Mwol Yɛsu.
Kyekà mpal bàkäl ba mubem ndaa ayi, wɛɛ le, baar bɔ̈ɔ̈l bàŋàbwaar ipfɛy a in'ŋyäŋ bàyàmɛnà tsütsü apà ba.
Bɔɔmà lawɛl la, laa bàtsüüm ba u mɛɛn, waa bàtɛn a ba naa: «Ntɔn nkye làleŋà bɛ mbuur a mɔ̈ɔ̈ uboo a akü?
Nde papà watɛy, nde akyàwiyà. Làyɔbà ndaa kàlakyään nde mpal kàkäl nde u Ngalilɛ
anà kàtɛn nde naa: "Yubwaŋ naa Mwan a mbuur bun'yälà akà baar abe, bun'bɛɛrà u kulunsi, waa nde uwiyà kà ilä kyàtär."»
Apan ba bàyɔbà ndaa a Yɛsu.
Ba bàlwomà kà an'dii, waa bàkàkyään ndaa ayi yanswà akà Bàkwem Aŋimwɛy anà akà alɔŋki bumwɛy banswà.
Akaar aban bàkäl Màlye a Magàdalà, Zwan anà Màlye ngwän a Zyak. Akaar bumwɛy bàkäl anà ba bàkàkyään ndaa nsil ayi akà antööm.
Wɛɛ ba làkwikilà bàsi anki ntɔn ya yàkäl asànaa ndwɛy a mwäänà.
Itàkal abwɛy, Petɔlà waa kàmbarà, kàpaarà ntiin mukyà an'dii, laa kànyee nde, kàmɛn nde in'siŋ a ipfɛy mpɛl, waa kàfurà ndwà ande wàmuyibem ndaa yàlyaaŋ.
Yàmɛnà naa ilä nsil akin, alɔŋki bööl bàkäl mukyà bul mwɛy ikɔb a la Ԑmayüs, la làkäl isii an'taaŋ mɔ̈ɔ̈l mà dwaan a Yɛlusàlɛm.
Ba bàkäl muyiyääm ndaa yanswà yàlyaaŋ.
Mpal bàkäl ba muyiyääm, Yɛsu ŋakwo kàsin tsütsü apà ba, waa uyikyà mbwo mwɛy anà ba.
Ba bàkyer un'manà, wɛɛ mii a ba myapɛɛ anki mbwo muyöb naa awà nde.
Yɛsu kàtɛn a ba naa: «Bɛ ininà làyiyääm u mbwo làyikyà bɛ?» Ba waa bàmbär, anà ngyɛb yanswà.
Umwɛy uboo a ba ikɔb ande Klɔpas waa kun'fuul: «Ngye, ngye awà un'nsi Yɛlusàlɛm umwɛy mpɛl mpa uyöb indiir ikalyaaŋà ilä abi?»

Nde waa kafuul naa: «Ininà bà?» Ba waa bun'fuur naa: «Ndaa yàbweel Yɛsu un'nsi Nasàlɛr! Nde kàkäl ŋangɔɔm a ngwal. Nde ya kàswɛŋ unsà nsyääl ande anà ndaa ande kusà a Nzam anà kusà a un'sɛŋ wanswà.
Wɛɛ amfum a angaŋ abi anà abyääl abi bàkyer aben mukun'yälà ntɔn bun'tsüül mbar a ukwà, waa bun'bɛɛrà u kulunsi.
Wɛɛ bi, bi kàsi làkyän naa nde mbuur ayàkɔɔr Isàlɛl. Udu a ayi yanswà, wɛɛ le, ŋàbawà ilä kyàtär sɛmà yan'lyaaŋ ndaa ayi yanswà.
Yà ndandaa naa akaar amwɛy uboo a un'tüüb abi bàyikyään ndaa a ubem: ba bàkyen ututu tutu kà an'dii,
wɛɛ ba bàmɛn anki ndür ande. Waa ba bàyikyään sye naa akyeey a du bàyàmɛnà akà ba ntɔn mukakyään naa nde we anà mɔ̈ɔ̈.
Bumwɛy uboo abi waa bàkyen kà an'dii, ba bàmɛn asànaa bàtɛn akaar, wɛɛ ba nde bun'mɛn anki.»
Apan Yɛsu waa kàtɛn a ba naa: «Ɔɔ bɛ baar làkɔ̈ɔ̈n un'yɛnà, u mpem mpa ifàyöb agyägyä ndaa yanswà bàtɛn aŋangɔɔm!
Yàlɔ̈m anki naa Klistɔ umɛn mpay ayi yanswà, waa ubilà u làkoo ande?»
Ungö, nde kakyään indiir byanswà bàsön ntɔn nde sɛmà Mɔsɛ tii aŋangɔɔm banswà.
Mpal nsil ayin, ba bàtöl tsütsü a bul bàkäl ba mukyà. Yàmɛnà asànaa Yɛsu alab mbwo ande.
Wɛɛ ba bun'si muküünà, waa bàtɛn naa: «Kal anà bi, ngye akimanà naa taaŋ làmuminà, mpib yàmubwà.» Nde kàbilà u ndwà ntɔn mukal anà ba.
Nde kàbwaay u mɛsà anà ba, waa kàwɛl mampà, ungö mufuur antɔɔn, nde kàtsül ma, waa kapɛ.
Apan, mii aba waa myàdubà, bun'yöb ba, wɛɛ taaŋ nsil alan, laa kàyaalà nde kusà aba.
Ba waa bàsàbulà mutɛn un'tɔŋ a un'tɔŋ naa: «Mpem abi yàböl anki mpal uyitɛɛn nde u mbwo anà uyibuul nde Ndaa Aŋàsɔn?»
Taaŋ nsil alan waa bàmbarà, waa bàfurà Yɛlusàlɛm. Akun ba bàmɛn Bàkwem Aŋimwɛy ban'köŋ anà baar bàkäl anà ba.
Ba banswà bawɛl ubwaŋ. Apan ba bàtɛn a ba naa: «Ndandaa Mwol akyàwiyà, nde amɛnà akà Simɔn.»
Apan alɔŋki bɔ̈ɔ̈l abà bakyään indiir byanswà byàlyaaŋ u mbwo anà ba Yɛsu bun'yöb aben mpal kàtsül nde mampà.
Mpal bàkäl ba muyäämà abà, Yɛsu ŋakwo kàyàmɛnà uboo a ba, waa kàtɛn naa: «Duu làkäl anà bɛ.»
Wɛɛ ba bàkäl unsà ubem anà u bɔɔmà ntɔn ba bàsii naa ba ban'man buulà.
Nde waa kàtɛn a ba naa: «Ntɔn nkye lan'bulà bɛ udu udu? Ntɔn nkye nkyɛɛr yan'bilà ya u mpem abɛ?
Làler an'kɔɔ amɛ anà in'kɔl amɛ: awà mɛ. Lan'tɛ mpi anà làler! Ntɔn buulà ufàkal anki anà in'twaŋ anà in'kwo. Wɛɛ bɛ làkimanà naa mɛ in'we anà mya.»
Mpal kàtɛɛnà nde abwɛy, nde kàkälà muswaŋ an'kɔɔ ande anà in'kɔl ande.
Abun, unsà un'sak, ba bàkwe anki musà làkwikilà, ba bàkäl mubem. Apan nde waa kafuul naa: «Nkye bɛ làwe anà undiir adyà apà?»
Ba bun'pɛ itsu a nsö aŋàyaŋ.
Nde kàwɛl kya, waa kàdi kya u mii aba.
Ungö, nde kàtɛn a ba naa: «Bɛ lan'man ndaa kàtɛn mɛ a bɛ mpal kàkäl mɛ anà bɛ: "Yubwaŋ naa ndaa yanswà bàsön ntɔn mɛ uboo a Un'kɔɔn a Mɔsɛ, Aŋangɔɔm anà An'diim yan'mɛnà u mii."»
Apan nde kaduub un'yɛnà ntɔn ba bàyöb Ndaa Aŋàsɔn.
Wɛɛ nde kàtɛn a ba naa: «Bàsön naa: "Klistɔ ayàman ntaan, nde akyer ayàwiyà kà ilä kyàtär,
waa bàyàlɔŋ kà ikɔb ande akà baar a in'sɛŋ myanswà, sɛmà Yɛlusàlɛm, naa ba bàkyer asɔɔmà, waa bàwal ndwääl a nkul a man'be aba.
Bɛ làbà ambäl a indiir abi byanswà.
Waa mɛ, mɛ in'yàlatööm undiir kàlapɛ Taa ilää. Wɛɛ akà bɛ, làkäl apà uboo a bul a kölàköl tii mpal làsàyɔl bɛ anà ngwal isàfà du.»
Ungö, nde kasyen u nsà a bul a tsütsü a Bɛtani, nde kàsɛn an'kɔɔ ande, waa kasaak.
Mpal kàkäl nde mukasaak, nde kàkaabà anà ba, waa bun'syen u du.
Wɛɛ akà ba, ungö mukun'sà làkoo, ba bàfurà Yɛlusàlɛm unsà un'sak mbɔɔn.
Wɛɛ ba bàkälà taaŋ lanswà u ndwà a Nzam musyaŋà Nzam.
YWAN
U nsɛmà kàkäl Ndaa, Ndaa kàkäl anà Nzam, Ndaa kàkäl Nzam.
Nde kàkäl u nsɛmà anà Nzam.
Indiir byanswà bàkyer u mbwo a nde, kà we anà undiir anki bàkɔ̈ɔ̈n akyer u mbwo a nde.
Mɔ̈ɔ̈ kàkäl amu nde, mɔ̈ɔ̈ wa kàkäl pɛɛlà a baar.
Pɛɛlà wàmunyɛŋ uboo a mpib, wɛɛ mpib bun'yöb anki.
Kàkäl anà mbuur mwɛy, ntööm a Nzam, ikɔb ande Ywan.
Nde kàyi asànaa mbäl, ntɔn mutɛɛl pɛɛlà imbäl, ntɔn baar banswà bàsi làkwikilà u mbwo a nde.
Nde kàkäl anki pɛɛlà, wɛɛ nde kàkäl ntɔn mutɛɛl pɛɛlà imbäl.
Ndaa kàkäl pɛɛlà a ndandaa. Kàyi nde u mɛɛn, nde àfàpà kyɛɛy akà mbuur wanswà.
Nde kàkäl u mɛɛn, mɛɛn màyàmɛnà u mbwo ande, wɛɛ mɛɛn mun'yöb anki.
Nde kàyi ntsü akà bànde ŋakwo, wɛɛ ba bun'wɛl anki.
Wɛɛ akà baar bun'wɛl, akà baar bàfàsà làkwikilà kà ikɔb ande, nde kapɛ ikɔ̈b mubulà baan a Nzam.
Baar abanà babör anki unsà an'kil, itàkal unsà ukwen a ndür, itàkal unsà ukwen a mbuur, wɛɛ unsà ukwen a Nzam.
Ndaa kàbwäär ndür, nde kàkäl uboo a bi, wàŋàyɔl a kab a ngway anà ndandaa. Bi kàkyàman làkoo ande, làkoo a Mwan baal mwɛy mpɛl kàfü akà Taa.
Ywan amun'tɛɛl imbäl, waa kan'kyään naa: «Le mbuur akwà kàtɛn mɛ naa: "Mbuur awayà ungö a mɛ kàfweel kusà a mɛ, ntɔn nde kàkäl kusà a mɛ."»
Abun, unsà ukwà ande, bi banswà kàwɛl kab a ngway udu a kab a ngway.
Isàkal naa un'kɔɔn bàpɛ u mbwo a Mɔsɛ, kab a ngway anà ndandaa byàyi u mbwo a Yɛsu Klistɔ.
Akà mbuur mwɛy kàmɛn anki Nzam akà ikikye, Mwan baal mwɛy mpɛl awà Nzam, awà uboo a Taa kà imɛɛy awà.
Le imbäl kàtɛ Ywan mpal amfum a Ayudà a Yɛlusàlɛm bun'tööm ba angaŋ anà alɛwi ntɔn mukun'fuul naa: «Ngye, ngye awà nà?»
Nde kàkyer kyey mufuur, waa kàtɛn naa: «Mɛ, mɛ kà in'wà Klistɔ anki.»
Waa ba bun'fuul naa: «Waa ngye awà nà bà? Nkye ngye awà Ɛli?» Nde kàfuur naa: «Aay, mɛ kà in'wà nde anki.» - «Nkye ngye awà Ŋangɔɔm?» Nde kàfuur naa: «Aay.»
Abun, ba bàtɛn a nde naa: «Ngye awà nà bà? Ntɔn bi ikàpà mfuur akà baar bitöm. Ngye atɛn aben ntɔn ngye ŋakwo?»
Nde kàtɛn naa: «Mɛ, mɛ in'wà "ndaa a mbuur ifàsà in'kwɛŋ u nsye a ipɔl: Làlɔ̈ɔ̈n alää mbwo a Mwol!"» asànaa kàtɛn ŋangɔɔm Yɛsay.
Kyekà baar abà bàtöm bàkäl Amfarisi.
Ba bàläb mufun'fuul, waa bàtɛn naa: «Isàkal naa ngye kà Klistɔ anki, itàkal Ɛli, itàkal Ŋangɔɔm, ntɔn nkye akadümà ngye?»
Ywan kàfuur naa: «Mɛ, mɛ in'kadümà kà an'dà. Uboo a bɛ we anà mbuur mwɛy mpa làyöb bɛ,
nde wàmuyà ungö a mɛ. Mɛ in'kwe anki musɔɔl in'siŋ a idyäär ande.»
Indiir abi byanswà byàlyaaŋà u Bɛtani, u sim a Yɔrdan, mper kàfadümà Ywan.
Taaŋtyà, nde kan'man Yɛsu wàmuyà ntsü akà nde, waa kàtɛn naa: «Le Mwan a un'kɔk a Nzam awalwom man'be a mɛɛn.
Awà mbuur akwà kàtɛn mɛ naa: "Ungö a mɛ, we anà mbuur ayà, nde kàfweel itaan, ntɔn nde kàkyàtàkal."
Mɛ ŋakwo sye kun'yöbà anki. Wɛɛ ntɔn nde muyàmɛnà akà un'sɛŋ a Isàlɛl, waa mɛ kàyi mudümà kà an'dà.»
Ywan kàtɛ imbäl ande naa: «Mɛ, mɛ kàmɛn Dweelà kan'fà du, kan'yàtyà asànaa yem, waa kàn'yàbwaay udu a nde.

Mɛ, mɛ kun'yöbà anki, wɛɛ mbuur akwà kan'töm mudümà kà an'dà, kan'kyään naa: "Mbuur ayàman ngye naa Dweelà kan'yàtyà anà kan'yàbwaay udu a nde, nde awun ayàdümà u Dweelà In'kyɛɛl."
Mɛ, mɛ kàkyàman anà kàkyàtà imbäl naa nde, nde wà Mwan a Nzam.»
Taaŋtyà, Ywan kàfàkal ikal nsil kya anà alɔŋki abɔ̈ɔ̈l uboo alɔŋki ande.
Mpal kàsyebà nde Yɛsu wàmulyaaŋ, nde kàtɛn naa: «Le Mwan a un'kɔk a Nzam!»
Alɔŋki abà bàbɔ̈ɔ̈l bàwem ndaa kàtɛn Ywan, ba bàläb Yɛsu.
Yɛsu kàbulà ungö, waa kàmɛn ba bàmuyun'lab, nde kafuul naa: «Ininà bɛ làleŋà?» Ba bàfuur naa: «Rabi - iswaŋà naa Un'lɔɔŋ - ngye afàkal ken?»
Nde kàtɛn a ba naa: «Làyi, waa bɛ làkàman.» Apan sye laa bun'läb ba, bàmɛn ba ikal kàfakalà nde, waa bàkäl apà nde ilä akin, la làkäl taaŋ lànà ungö a midi.
Andrɛ, un'tɔŋ a Simɔn Petɔlà, kàkäl umwɛy uboo a abɔ̈ɔ̈l bàwem Ywan anà bàläb Yɛsu.
Kusà a nde mukàman mbuur asin, nde kàtàkàman un'tɔŋ ande ŋakwo Simɔn, waa kàtɛn a nde naa: «Bi kan'swaal Mɛsya!» Ikaswaŋà naa «Klistɔ». –
Nde kun'syen akà Yɛsu. Yɛsu kun'ler a lää, waa kàtɛn a nde naa: «Ngye, ngye awà Simɔn, mwan a Ywan, ngye, ngye bàyabeelà Sɛfas.» Ikɔb aki ikaswaŋà naa Petɔlà.
U taaŋtyà, Yɛsu kàwɛl an'kyän mukyà Ngalilɛ. Nde kàbwey a Filipo, waa kàtɛn a nde naa: «Yan'läb!»
Kyekà Filipo kàkäl un'nsi Bɛtesayidà, bul làmwɛy anà Andrɛ anà Petɔlà.
Nde kàkàman Natanayɛl, waa kun'kyään naa: «Bi, bi ban'swaal mbuur akwà bàsön unsà Un'kɔɔn a Mɔsɛ anà unsà aŋangɔɔm. Mbuur wa Yɛsu, mwan a Yɔsɛfi, un'nsi Nasàlɛr.»
Natanayɛl waa kàtɛn a nde naa: «Nkye undiir aŋàbwaŋ sye kan'kwo utoo u Nasàlɛr?» Filipo naa: «Yà, man.»
Umpal kàmɛn Yɛsu Natanayɛl wàmuyàsin tsütsü apà nde, nde kàtɛn ntɔn nde naa: «Le un'nsi Isàlɛl umwɛy wà ndandaa, awà akɔ̈ɔ̈n loor uboo a nde.»
Natanayɛl kun'fuul naa: «Ngye mɛ an'yöb aben?» Yɛsu naa: «Kusà Filipo mutabel, mɛ amɛn itaan umpal akäl ngye u ngyɛl a un'te a fige.»
Apan Natanayɛl kàfàfuur naa: «Rabi, ngye, ngye awà Mwan a Nzam, ngye, ngye awà mfum a Isàlɛl!»
Yɛsu kun'fuur naa: «Nkye ntɔn amakyään mɛ naa: mɛ amɛn u ngyɛl a un'te a fige, waa ngye an'sà làkwikilà? Ngye, ngye ayàman indiir mbɔɔn byan'söön bi.»
Nde kàfàkwɛy naa: «Ndandaa, ndandaa mɛ alàkyään, bɛ làsàman du lan'dubà, akyeey a Nzam bàmubeenà anà bàmutyà udu a Mwan a mbuur!»
Kyekà, ilä kyàtär, kàkäl anà un'kyɔm a bɔr mwɛy u Kana, u Ngalilɛ. Ngwän a Yɛsu kàkäl kwo.
Yɛsu sye bàkyer un'bel anà alɔŋki ande kà un'kyɔm awà.
Yàmɛnà naa man màkyer awà. Ngwän a Yɛsu kàtɛn a nde naa: «Ba vin latɛy.»
Wɛɛ Yɛsu kun'fuur naa: «Un'kaar wà, ngye anà mɛ inina? Taaŋ amɛ ŋàtàkwo anki.»
Ngwän waa kàtɛn a asyääl naa: «Làkyer yinà yanswà utɛn nde a bɛ.»
Paa màkäl anà an'buuŋ, an'buuŋ an'syaam mà nkɔŋ, amà bàfasyäälà Ayudà ntɔn mupöŋ ndür. U làbuuŋ làmwɛy man'kwo ibilà isii a an'litre an'kwem an'tär aŋitär.
Yɛsu kàswɛŋ asyääl naa: «Làyööl an'dà uboo a an'buuŋ mà.» Ba sye waa bàyööl ma tii u mɔɔl.
Yɛsu kàtɛn a ba naa: «Apanà, làtɛɛ an'dà anà làsyen ma akà mfum a un'kyɔm.» Ba waa bun'syeen ma.
Kàkyee nde, an'dà màkäl man'bulà vin. Nde kàyöb anki naa vin alà lan'fà ken. Wɛɛ asyääl bàtɛɛ an'dà bàkyer ayöb. Apan sye nde kàbel ŋabɔr,
waa kàtɛn a nde naa: «Baar banswà bàfàtapà vin aŋàbwaŋ. Ungö, isàkal naa baar ban'yɔr, waa bapà vin làkɔ̈ɔ̈n ntsà. Wɛɛ ngye, ngye vin a ntsà akyer asàlɔɔn tii apanà!»
Ayi nsɛmà a idiim a Yɛsu yàlyaaŋ u Kana a Ngalilɛ. Nde kàmɛɛy làkoo ande, alɔŋki ande waa bun'si làkwikilà.
Ungö apan, Yɛsu kàtyà Kapɛrnawum anà ngwän, anà atɔŋ ande anà alɔŋki ande. Ba kwo bàkyer anki ilä mbɔɔn.
Pak a Ayudà làkäl tsütsü mukwo, Yɛsu waa kàbeenà Yɛlusàlɛm.
Nde kàmɛn ayääl a ngɔɔmà, in'kɔk, an'yem anà agyɛɛŋ a ngim sye bàkyàbwaay uboo a ndwà a Nzam.
Abun, nde kàkyer füm a in'siŋ, waa kàböŋ ba banswà u ndwà a Nzam, anà ngɔɔmà, anà in'kɔk aba. Nde kàpay ngim a agyɛɛŋ anà kàbuum mɛsà aba.
Nde kàtɛn a ayääl a an'yem naa: «Làlwom indiir abi byanswà pà! Twon lan'buul ndwà a Taaràmɛ ndwà atà yà!»
Alɔŋki ande bàyɔbà naa bàsön abà: «Ukwen a ndwà angye bàkyer asan'kwiiy.»
Apan, amfum a Ayudà bun'fuul naa: «Idiim nà an'kwo ngye mukyer, ntɔn muswaŋ naa ngye awe anà ikɔ̈b mukyer abà?»
Yɛsu kafuur naa: «Làbwaab ndwà a Nzam yi, ungö a ilä itär mɛ in'yàmbaar ya.» –
Apan, Ayudà abà bàtɛn a nde naa: «Yàlɔ̈m mbul an'kwem an'nà aŋisyaam mutɔŋ ndwà ayi, wɛɛ ngye, ngye ya ayàmbaar ungö a ilä itär?»
Wɛɛ, kyekà, ndwà a Nzam kàtɛɛnà nde yàkäl ndür ande ŋakwo.
Ungöngö, umpal kàwiyà Yɛsu uboo a akü, alɔŋki ande waa bàyɔbà naa nde kàkyàtɛn abà. Kyakin bàsi ba làkwikilà amu Ndaa Aŋàsɔn anà amu ndaa kàtɛn nde.
Utaaŋ kàkäl Yɛsu u Yɛlusàlɛm, umpal a un'kyɔm a Pak, bàmbɔɔn bàsi làkwikilà kà ikɔb ande ntɔn idiim kàfakyerà nde.
Wɛɛ Yɛsu, nde ba làkwikilà kasyeelà anki, ntɔn nde kàkyayöb ba banswà ubwaŋàbwaŋ.
Nde kàkäl anki anà mfun naa bun'tɛɛl imbäl ntɔn mbuur, ntɔn nde ŋakwo kàkyer ayöbà naa ininà abyu mpem a mbuur.
Kàkäl anà mbuur mwɛy kiböl a Amfarisi ikɔb ande Nàkàdim. Nde kàkäl umwɛy uboo a amfum a Ayudà.

Nde kàyi u mpib akà Yɛsu, waa kàtɛn a nde naa: «Rabi, bi ikyàyöb naa ngye awà un'lɔɔŋ an'fà akà Nzam, ntɔn akà mbuur mwɛy ukwe anki mukyer idiim asànaa afàkyer ngye, isàkal naa uboo ande Nzam watɛy.»
Yɛsu kun'fuur naa: «Ndandaa, ndandaa, mɛ akyään: Isàkal naa mbuur bun'bör anki wàkün, nde ukwe anki muman Imwol a Nzam.»
Nàkàdim kun'fuul naa: «Nkye mbuur aŋànün kan'kwo bàfun'bɔr mbalà asin? Nkye nde kan'kwo ufàbilà mbalà yàyweel kà an'bäl a ngwän waa bàfun'bɔr?»
Yɛsu kun'fuur naa: «Ndandaa, ndandaa, mɛ akyään: akà mbuur mwɛy ukwe anki mubilà kà Imwol a Nzam, isàkal naa nde bun'bör anki kà an'dà anà u Dweelà.
Ayà ban'bɔr unsà un'sön yà un'sön, ayà ban'bɔr unsà Dweelà, yà dweelà.
Twon an'bem isàkal naa mɛ an'tɛn a ngye naa: "Yan'kwo naa bàfabɔr mböör a du."
Un'pöb afàful mper ayà ukwen wa. Ngye awem làso awa, wɛɛ ngye ayöb anki naa wa kan'fà ken, itàkal naa wa sye akyà ken. Ayi yà ndaa ifàlyaaŋ uboo a mbuur wanswà awà ban'bɔr u Dweelà.»
Apan Nàkàdim kun'fuul naa: «Ndaa ayi yan'kwo mukal aben?»
Yɛsu kun'fuur naa: «Ngye, ngye awà un'lɔɔŋ atoo làpan kà Isàlɛl, waa ngye indiir abi ayöb anki!
Ndandaa, ndandaa, mɛ akyään: bi ifàtɛn ya iyöb bi, bi ifàtà imbäl a yakwà kàmɛn bi. Wɛɛ bɛ, bɛ làkwen anki làkyey imbäl abi.
Isàkal naa bɛ làkakyeyà anki mpal alàkyäänà mɛ indiir a mɛɛn, bɛ làyàkyey aben isàkal naa mɛ amàlakyään indiir a du?
Ntɔn, akà mbuur ŋàtàbeenà anki du, nà Mwan a mbuur mpɛl awà kàfü du.
Asànaa Mɔsɛ kàmbaar nde ntäy u nsye a ipɔl, abun sye bàsàmbaar Mwan a mbuur,
ntɔn mbuur wanswà asà làkwikilà amu nde, ukäl anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ a mbul a in'tye.
Abun Nzam kàkwen mɛɛn mbɔɔn, lalan kàpɛ nde Mwan baal ande mwɛy mpɛl, ntɔn mbuur wanswà asà làkwikilà amu nde ukɔ̈ɔ̈n akyà bwà, wɛɛ nde ukäl anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ a mbul a in'tye.
Ntɔn Nzam kàtöm anki Mwan baal ande u mɛɛn ntɔn mudwa mbuur ndwà, wɛɛ ntɔn mɛɛn iwü mɔ̈ɔ̈ u mbwo a nde.
Mbuur afàsà nde làkwikilà bun'tsüül anki nsaŋ. Mbuur mpa afàsà làkwikilà, bàkyun'tsüül mbar itaan, ntɔn nde kàsi anki làkwikilà amu ikɔb a Mwan baal mwɛy mpɛl a Nzam.
Nsaŋ ya yi: pɛɛlà làyi u mɛɛn, wɛɛ baar bàkwen làpib kà ikal a pɛɛlà, ntɔn nsyääl aba yàkäl yàmbe.
Abun, mbuur wanswà afàkyer ube, nde kan'tɔn pɛɛlà anà nde sye kan'kaabà anà la, manà nsyääl ambe ande iyàmɛnà u leŋ.
Mbuur wanswà afàkyer ndandaa, nde afàyà ntsü awà pɛɛlà, ntɔn nsyääl ande amu Nzam imɛnà u leŋ.»
Ungö apan, Yɛsu kàkyen Yuday anà alɔŋki ande. Nde kàbwaay kwo anà ba anà kàpɛɛ ndüümà.
Ywan sye kàpɛɛ ndümà u Ɛnɔ tsütsü a Salim, ntɔn an'dà màkäl mbɔɔn kwo. Baar bàyee akà nde, waa bàwɛlà ndüümà.
Ntɔn Ywan kàkäl anki aŋàtàbilà bɔlokà.
Kyekà, nsyeel a mbaaŋ yàkyer abwà uboo a alɔŋki a Ywan anà Un'yudà mwɛy unsà ndaa iler mpɔɔŋà a ndür.

Ba bàyàman Ywan, waa bun'fuul naa: «Rabi, mbuur akwà kàkälà anà ngye u sim a Yɔrdan lumwɛy, nde akwà kàtɛɛlà ngye imbäl, le nde sye wàmupaa ndüümà anà baar banswà bàkyeenà akà nde!»
Ywan kafuur naa: «Akà mbuur mwɛy ukwe anki muwal undiir asin udu a undiir bun'pɛ fà du.
Bɛ, bɛ ŋakwo làbà ambäl amɛ mpal kàtɛn mɛ naa: "Mɛ, mɛ kà in'wà Klistɔ anki, wɛɛ mɛ in'wà mbuur bàtöm kusà a nde."
Mbuur awe anà un'kyay, nde wà un'dim. Wɛɛ akà un'sam ande afàkal ukɔl, wàmukun'wemà, ndaa a un'dim yàmukun'paa un'sak. Awà un'sak amɛ, wa wàŋàkwo.
Yubwaŋ naa nde uyɛl, wɛɛ mɛ, mɛ in'tyà.
«Mbuur kan'fà du, wà udu a baar banswà. Mbuur awà u mɛɛn, wà mbuur a mɛɛn, ndaa ande yà ndaa a mɛɛn. Mbuur kan'fà du wà udu a baar banswà,
nde afàtà imbäl a indiir kàmɛn nde anà kàwem nde, wɛɛ akà mbuur mwɛy afàkyey imbäl ande watɛy.
Mbuur afàwal imbäl ande, kan'bɛɛrà inyɛm naa Nzam wà ndandaa.
Ntɔn mbuur kàtöm Nzam afàtɛn ndaa a Nzam, ntɔn nde afun'pà Dweelà aŋàkwo.
Taa akwen Mwan, waa kàpɛ indiir byanswà kà an'kɔɔ ande.
Mbuur afàsà làkwikilà ande amu Mwan, we anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ a mbul a in'tye. Mbuur mpa afàsà làkwikilà amu Mwan usàman anki mɔ̈ɔ̈, wɛɛ nkyɛl a Nzam isàkal udu a nde.»
Mpal kàyöb Yɛsu naa Amfarisi bàwem naa nde kàfakyerà anà kàfadümà alɔŋki aŋàsöön Ywan,
- Kutɛn aŋàbwaŋ, Yɛsu kàfadümà anki nde ŋakwo, wɛɛ alɔŋki ande. - Mpal kàwem Yɛsu indiir bàtɛɛnà baar,
nde kàlwomà u Yuday, waa kàfurà Ngalilɛ.
Mukyà kwo, yàlɔ̈m naa nde atsul uboo a Samalya.
Apan, nde kàtöl bul a Samalya mwɛy ikɔb a la Sikar, tsütsü a ywaŋ kàpɛ Yakɔb mwan ande Yɔsɛfi
ntsü làkäl fu a an'dà a Yakɔb. Ntɔn yɔ̈ɔ̈n a mbwo, Yɛsu kàkäl wàŋàbwaay kà un'beel a fu. La làkäl isii a taaŋ a midi.
Un'kaar un'nsi Samalya mwɛy kàyi mutɛɛ an'dà. Yɛsu kàtɛn a nde naa: «Mpɛ an'dà anwà.»
Ntɔn alɔŋki ande bàkäl aŋàkyà bul mukàsom isaa adyà.

Wɛɛ un'kaar awà, un'nsi Samalya awà, kàtɛn a nde naa: «Aben? Ngye Un'yudà, ngye awe anà yɔr mulɔm an'dà anwà, akà mɛ, un'kaar mwɛy, un'nsi Samalya mwɛy?» - Kutɛn aŋàbwaŋ, Ayudà un'tüüb watɛy anà Asamalya. -
Yɛsu kun'fuur naa: «Ilàkal naa ngye ayöb kab a Nzam anà mbuur wa kan'tɛn wà a ngye naa: "Mpɛ an'dà", ngye mbuur alun'lɔ̈ɔ̈m an'dà, waa nde ulapà an'dà a mɔ̈ɔ̈.»
Un'kaar waa kàtɛn a nde naa: «Mwol, ngye akà kantin latɛy, fu a an'dà la sye làŋàtyà mbɔɔn. Ngye an'dà a mɔ̈ɔ̈ ma màfàken?
Nkye ngye an'söön taaràbi Yakɔb, mbuur kà ipɛ fu alà anà kànü an'dà mwo nde ŋakwo, anà baan ande anà itɔŋà ande?»
Yɛsu kun'fuur naa: «Mbuur wanswà anwà an'dà mà, afàsàwem mfwää a an'dà,
wɛɛ mbuur asànwà an'dà insun'pà mɛ, nde ufàsàwem anki mfwää a an'dà akà ikikye, wɛɛ an'dà insun'pà mɛ isàbulà amu nde ntwà isàfuunà ntɔn mɔ̈ɔ̈ a mbul a in'tye.»
Apan, un'kaar kàtɛn a nde naa: «Mwol, mpɛ an'dà ma, ntɔn mɛ in'kɔ̈ɔ̈n afàsàwem mfwää a an'dà, waa mɛ mpa in'fàsàyà mutɛɛ an'dà apà.»
Yɛsu kàtɛn a nde naa: «Kyen, un'bel un'dim angye, waa ayàfurà pà.»
Un'kaar kun'fuur naa: «Mɛ un'dim watɛy.» Yɛsu naa: «Ngye awe anà iböŋ mutɛn naa: "Mɛ un'dim watɛy."
Ngye kàkäl abà adim atyeen, baal awà ngye awà apanà, kà wà un'dim angye anki. Abun, ngye an'tɛn ndandaa.»
Apan, un'kaar kàtɛn a nde naa: «Mwol, mɛ in'manà naa ngye awà ŋangɔɔm.
Bàtaaràbi, bàfakömà udu a mɔŋ wà, wɛɛ bɛ, bɛ làtɛn naa ikal kyan'kwo mukömà kyà u Yɛlusàlɛm.»
Yɛsu waa kàtɛn a nde naa: «Un'kaar, nkyey, taaŋ làmuyà alà mpa làsàkömà bɛ Taa itàkal udu a mɔŋ awà, itàkal u Yɛlusàlɛm.
Bɛ, Asamàlya, bɛ làfàkömà Nzam mpa làyöb bɛ. Bi, Ayudà, bi ifàkömà Nzam iyöb bi, ntɔn mɔ̈ɔ̈ afàyà u mbwo a Ayudà.
Wɛɛ taaŋ làmuyà, la sye lan'yà, mpal aŋankömà a ndandaa bàsakömà ba Taa u Dweelà anà u ndandaa, ba bà aŋankömà ufàleŋ Taa.
Nzam wà Dweelà, kyakin baar bàfun'kömà bun'kömà unsà dweelà anà unsà ndandaa.»
Un'kaar waa kàtɛn a nde naa: «Mɛ, mɛ in'kyàyöb naa Mɛsya, iswaŋà naa Klistɔ, asàkyer ayà. Mpal usàyà nde, nde asikyään indiir byanswà.»
Yɛsu kun'fuur naa: «Mɛ, mɛ in'wà nde, mɛ mbuur in'yäämà wà anà ngye.»

Umpal bàyàfurà alɔŋki, ba bàmɛn ndaa mwɛy yubem ntɔn nde kàkäl muyäämà anà un'kaar. Wɛɛ akà mbuur mwɛy uboo aba kàkwe anki mukun'fuul naa: «Ngye nkye akwen akà nde?» Sye naa: «Ininà ngye akayäämà anà nde?»
Apan, un'kaar kàsàwɔm làbuuŋ ande paa, waa kàkyen bul, waa kàtɛn a baar naa:
«Yàlamɛn mbuur mwɛy kan'tɛn a mɛ indiir byanswà kàkyer mɛ. Nkye nde kà wà Klistɔ anki?»
Kyakin bàtoo ba u bul, bàyi ba mper akà nde.
Apan sye, alɔŋki bun'siinà naa: «Rabi, dyà!»
Wɛɛ nde kàtɛn a ba naa: «Mɛ, mɛ in'we anà isaa adyà, isaa mpa làyöb bɛ.»
Kyakin alɔŋki bàtɛɛnà ba, ba a ba naa: «Nkye ikyàkal naa mbuur mwɛy kun'twääl isaa adyà?»
Yɛsu kàtɛn a ba naa: «Isaa adyà amɛ, byà ntɔn mukyer ukwen a mbuur kan'töm anà mukwey isal ande.
Bɛ, nkye bɛ làfàtɛn anki bɛ ŋakwo naa: "Yan'sal nsöŋ nà mubwo isaa." Wɛɛ mɛ, mɛ alàkyään naa làduub mii abɛ, anà làler an'ywaŋ: mbɛŋ yan'söŋ anà yan'kwo mubwo!
Un'bweel kan'wal làfur ande itaan anà kan'böbà mbɛŋ ntɔn mɔ̈ɔ̈ a mbul a in'tye, ntɔn mbuur kan'kɔn anà mbuur kan'bwo, bàmɛn un'sak ba bàbɔ̈ɔ̈l.
Abà, un'sim afàtɛn ndandaa naa: "Umwɛy afàkɔn, umwɛy afàbwo."
Mɛ, mɛ kàlatöm mukàbwo mbɛŋ làkɔ̈ɔ̈n aman bɛ mpay, baar asin bàsöön mwäänà. Wɛɛ bɛ, bɛ lan'bilà unsà bweel a isal aba.»
Asamalya mbɔɔn bàsi làkwikilà amu Yɛsu ntɔn imbäl kàtɛ un'kaar naa: «Nde kan'tɛn amɛ indiir byanswà kàkyer mɛ.»
Undiir awun, mpal bàyàkɔlà ba tsütsü apà nde, ba bun'bɔ̈ɔ̈n mukal anà ba. Yɛsu kàbwaay paa ilä byeel.
Abun sye, un'kàbɔ a baar kàsi làkwikilà ntɔn ndaa kàtɛɛnà nde ŋakwo.
Waa ba bàtɛɛnà a un'kaar naa: «Bi kan'sà anki làkwikilà ntɔn ndaa kà ikyään ngye, wɛɛ ntɔn bi ŋakwo kàmuwem, waa bi kan'yöb naa ndandaa nde wà Un'tswää a mɔ̈ɔ̈ a mɛɛn.»
Ungö a ilä byeel, Yɛsu kàlwomà apan, waa kàkyen Ngalilɛ.
Nde kàkyään nde ŋakwo naa: «Ŋangɔɔm bàfun'pà anki làkoo u nsi ande ŋakwo.»
Umpal kàtöl nde u Ngalilɛ, baar a itiir a nsi akin bun'wɛl ubwaŋ, ntɔn ba bàkyer aman indiir byanswà kàkyer nde kà un'kyɔm, ntɔn ba sye bàkyen un'kyɔm.
Apan Yɛsu kàfurà Kana u Ngalilɛ, ntsü kàbuul nde an'dà vin. Kàkäl anà undweer a mfum a aŋità mwɛy, mwan ande wàbaal kàkäl anà ukyal u Kapɛrnawum.
Mpal kàwem nde naa Yɛsu kan'yà u Yuday a Ngalilɛ, waa kàkun'man anà kun'bɔ̈ɔ̈n naa nde utyà anà ukɔɔr mwan baal ande awà kàkäl tsütsü mukwà.
Yɛsu kàtɛn a nde naa: «Isàkal naa bɛ làmɛn anki idiim anà impà, bɛ làsà anki làkwikilà akà ikikye!»
Mfum aŋità awà kun'fuur naa: «Mwol, tyà kusà a mwan amɛ mukwà.»
Yɛsu waa kàtɛn a nde naa: «Kyen, mwan angye we anà mɔ̈ɔ̈.» Mbuur awà kàsi làkwikilà u ndaa kàtɛn Yɛsu a nde, waa kàkyen.
Umpal kàkäl nde mutyà, baar a isal ande bàkàbwey ande, waa bun'kyään naa: «Mwan angye kan'wà mɔ̈ɔ̈!»
Apan, nde kàfuul ba naa taaŋ nà mwan ande ukayà, ba bun'fuur naa: «Làbwɛy a mpye làlwomà ywenà, utaaŋ atàtwɛb, ungö a midi.»
Taarànde kàyɔbà naa làkäl taaŋ nsil lalɛy alà kun'kyään Yɛsu naa: «Mwan angye we anà mɔ̈ɔ̈». Apan, nde anà ndwà ande yanswà bàsi làkwikilà amu Yɛsu.
Kyaki kyà idiim a impà kyàyweel kàkyer Yɛsu u mfuurà ande u Ngalilɛ fà Yuday.
Ungö a indiir abi byanswà, kàkäl anà un'kyɔm a Ayudà, waa Yɛsu kàbeenà Yɛlusàlɛm.
Kyekà, u Yɛlusàlɛm, tsütsü a munàmbwo a In'kɔk, kyàkäl anà itɛy a an'dà bàfàbel un'sà Ɛbɛlyɔ naa Bɛtesdà. Kya kyàkäl anà myäy, myäy in'tyeen.
Ungyɛl a myäy ami un'kàbɔ abɛy bàkäl musil: ikwàmii, aŋibweel anà ikar bàkäl mudil naa an'dà inini,
ntɔn utaaŋ làmwɛy un'kyeey a Mwol mwɛy kàfatɔlà uboo a itɛy, waa kàfanii an'dà. Un'bɛy atàtwɛb kàfatɔlà kan'dà aŋàni, kàkyer afakɔɔrà itàkal naa ukyal ande abɛy bàkaben.
Kwo kàkäl anà ikar mwɛy kàkäl anà ukyal mbul an'kwem an'tär aŋinaan.
Utaaŋ kun'mɛn Yɛsu wàŋàbɔ̈ɔ̈n anà kàyöb nde naa nde kàbɛl itaan, nde kun'fuul naa: «Nkye ngye akyàkwen akɔɔrà?»
Ikar kun'fuur naa: «Mwol, mɛ in'we anki anà mbuur akan'tɔɔm uboo a itɛy umpal ifàsɛmà an'dà munini. Umpal in'kyà mɛ, mbuur asin kan'tɔɔmà kusà a mɛ.»
Yɛsu kàtɛn a nde naa: «Mbarà, sɛn ipɔy angye, kyen.»
Apan sye, baal awà waa kàkɔɔrà, kàsɛn ipɔy ande, waa kàsɛmà mukyà. Kyekà, ilä akin kyàkäl ilä a saba.
Apan, amfum a Ayudà bàfuul baal awà kàkɔɔrà naa: «Ŋàbà ilä a saba, ngye mbwo musyen ipɔy angye yatɛy.»
Wɛɛ nde kafuur naa: «Mbuur awà kan'kɔɔr, atɛn a mɛ naa: "Wal ipɔy angye, kyen."»
Ba bun'fuul naa: «Nà mbuur awà atɛn a ngye naa: "Wal ipɔy angye, kyen"?»
Wɛɛ mbuur awà kàkɔɔrà, kàyöbà anki naa nà kun'kɔɔr, ntɔn Yɛsu kàbilà uboo a iköŋ a baar bàkäl kà ikal akin.
Ungöngö, Yɛsu kàfun'man uboo a ndwà a Nzam, waa kàtɛn a nde naa: «Le, apanà ngye awà ŋàkɔɔrà. Twon an'fàkyer man'be, ntɔn undiir aŋàsöön ube ukɔɔn afayeel.»
Baal awà kàkàkyään amfum a Ayudà naa Yɛsu kun'kɔɔr.
Lalan Ayudà bàmɛɛyà ba Yɛsu nkwaaŋ, ntɔn nde indiir abi kàkyerà ilä a saba.
Wɛɛ Yɛsu kafuur naa: «Tii lalà Taa wàmusal, mɛ sye in'wàmusal.»
Ntɔn ndaa ayi, amfum a Ayudà bàyileŋà ipöl mbɔɔn mukun'dwa, kànà ntɔn kàbɛyà nde saba anki, wɛɛ ntɔn kàtɛɛnà nde naa Nzam wà Taarànde ŋakwo, abà nde mumɛnà làsii làmwɛy anà Nzam.

Apan Yɛsu kàfàwal ndaa, waa kàtɛn a ba naa: «Ndandaa, ndandaa mɛ alàkyään, Mwan ukwe anki mukyer akà undiir mwɛy nde ŋakwo, wɛɛ nà wa akwà ufàman nde mukyer akà Taa. Ntɔn indiir byanswà ufàkyer Taa, Mwan sye afàkyer bya.
Ntɔn Taa akwen Mwan, anà nde sye afun'swaŋ indiir byanswà ufàkyer nde ŋakwo. Nde afàsun'swaŋ indiir mwɛy byàkölàköl byan'söön abi ntɔn bɛ làsàkal unsà ubem.
Ntɔn, asànaa Taa ufàwiy nde akü anà ufapà nde mɔ̈ɔ̈, abun sye Mwan afàpà mɔ̈ɔ̈ akà mbuur awukwen nde.
Taa ufàtsüül anki mbuur nsaŋ, wɛɛ nde ikɔ̈b atsul nsaŋ kyanswà kàpɛ akà Mwan,
ntɔn baar banswà bàsi Mwan làkoo asànaa bàfàsà ba Taa làkoo. Mbuur mpa afàsà Mwan làkoo, nde sye Taa awà kun'töm ufun'sà anki làkoo.»

Nde kàkwɛy naa: «Ndandaa, ndandaa mɛ alàkyään, mbuur wanswà afàwem ndaa amɛ anà afàsà làkwikilà amu mbuur kan'töm, nde we anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ a mbul a in'tye, nde uyà anki u nsaŋ, wɛɛ nde kàkyàtoo itaan unsà ukwà, nde kàkyàwal mɔ̈ɔ̈.
Ndandaa, ndandaa mɛ alakyään, taaŋ làmuyà - la sye lan'kwo - alà bàsàwem akü ndaa a Mwan a Nzam. Baar bàsàwem ya, bàsàkal anà mɔ̈ɔ̈.
Ntɔn, asànaa Taa awà nde anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ amu nde ŋakwo, nde kàpɛ mbwo akà Mwan mukal anà mɔ̈ɔ̈.
Nde kun'pɛ ikɔ̈b mutsul nsaŋ, ntɔn nde wà Mwan a mbuur.
Twon lan'man ndaa yubem unsà ya, ntɔn taaŋ làmuyà alà bàsàwem baar banswà abà uboo a an'dii ndaa ande.
Baar bàkyer indiir aŋàbwaŋ bàsàwiyà ntɔn muwal mɔ̈ɔ̈, wɛɛ baar bàkyer indiir ibe, ba bàsàwiyà ntɔn nsaŋ.

Mɛ, mɛ in'kwe anki mukyer akà undiir mwɛy mɛ ŋakwo: mɛ in'fàtsul nsaŋ a ndaa in'fàwem mɛ, lalan mbar in'fàtsul mɛ yà balàbal, ntɔn mɛ in'fàleŋ anki ukwen amɛ ŋakwo, wɛɛ mɛ in'fàleŋ ukwen a mbuur kan'töm.
«Ilàkal naa mɛ kàtɛɛ imbäl ntɔn mɛ ŋakwo, kya kyàlàkal anki kyà ndandaa.
Wɛɛ mbuur asin afan'tɛɛl imbäl anà mɛ sye in'kyàyöb naa imbäl ufan'tɛɛl nde kyà ndandaa.
Bɛ, bɛ làtöm akyeey akà Ywan, nde waa kàtɛɛl ndandaa imbäl.
Akà mɛ, mɛ mfun a imbäl a mbuur kyatɛy, wɛɛ an'tɛn mɛ abà, ntɔn bɛ làwü mɔ̈ɔ̈.
Ywan kàkäl asànaa mwinà aŋàkyää wàmupà pɛɛlà: u taaŋ làmwɛy bɛ làkwen muman un'sak a pɛɛlà ande.
Wɛɛ mɛ, mɛ in'we anà imbäl aŋàsöön kyà Ywan, ntɔn isal abyà kan'pɛ Taa mukyer, isal nsil bya in'fàkyer mɛ bi anà bya ifan'tɛɛl imbäl ntɔn muswaŋ naa Taa kan'töm.
Taa awà kan'töm nde ŋakwo kàtɛ imbäl ntɔn mɛ. Wɛɛ bɛ, bɛ làwem anki akà ikikye ndaa ande, bɛ làmɛn anki akà ikikye ntabwey ande.
Ndaa ande yatɛy amu bɛ, ntɔn bɛ mbuur kun'töm làfun'sà anki làkwikilà.
Bɛ, bɛ làfàlab pànsi pànsi Ndaa Aŋàsɔn, ntɔn bɛ làfàsi naa bɛ làwal mɔ̈ɔ̈ a mbul a intye uboo aya: kyekà ya ŋakwo ifàtà imbäl ntɔn mɛ!
Wɛɛ bɛ, bɛ làkwen anki muyà akà mɛ ntɔn muwal mɔ̈ɔ̈.
«Mɛ in'fàwal anki làkoo làfàfà akà baar.
Wɛɛ mɛ in'kyàyöb naa amu bɛ ukwen batɛy akà Nzam.
Mɛ, mɛ kàyi kà ikɔb a Taa, wɛɛ bɛ, bɛ làtön mukan'wal. Isàkal naa mbuur asin kan'yà kà ikɔb ande ŋakwo, bɛ làkyer asun'wal!
Aben, nkye bɛ lan'kwo mukal anà làkwikilà, bɛ baar làkoo abɛ làfàfà akà bɛ a bɛ, anà mpa làfàleŋ làkoo làfàfà akà Nzam mpɛl?
Bɛ twon lan'si naa mɛ in'sàkyer alafüün kusà a Taa. Mbuur afüünà bɛ Mɔsɛ awà làsi bɛ làkyän abɛ.
Kyakin, yàlàkal naa bɛ làsi làkwikilà amu Mɔsɛ, bɛ làlàsà làkwikilà akà mɛ sye, ntɔn nde kàsön ntɔn mɛ.
Wɛɛ isàkal naa bɛ làsi anki làkwikilà u ndaa kàsön nde, bɛ lan'kwo aben musà làkwikilà u ndaa amɛ?»
Ungö a indiir abi, Yɛsu kàsabà sim a ɛwà a Ngalilɛ lumwɛy, akyà bàfàbel sye naa Tibɛryade.
Iköŋ a baar mbɔɔn kyàkäl muyun'lab, ntɔn bàmɛn ba idiim kàkyerà nde udu a abɛy.
Kyakin Yɛsu kàbeenà nde udu a mɔŋ, kàbwaay nde paa anà alɔŋki ande.
Pak, un'kyɔm a Ayudà, làkäl tsütsü mukwo.
Kyekà, kàsɛn nde mii, nde kàmɛn iköŋ a baar mbɔɔn kyan'yà akà nde, nde kàfuul Filipo naa: «Bi kan'kwo musom ken mampà ntɔn baar bà bàdi?»
- Kàtɛn nde abà ntɔn mubilà Filipo u mpem, ntɔn akà nde, nde kàkyer ayöbà naa nde ininà uyàkyer. -
Filipo kun'fuur naa: «Itàkal làfur a mbul mwɛy lun'syääl a an'ywaŋ làkwo anki musom mampà isàkal naa mbuur mbuur awal itàkal kitsu.»
Umwɛy uboo a alɔŋki ande, ikɔb ande Andrɛ, un'tɔŋ a Simɔn Petɔlà, kàtɛn a nde naa:
«Mwan baal mwɛy awà apà, nde we anà mampà an'tyeen mà ɔrze anà bibaan a nsö byeel. Wɛɛ indiir abi nkye byan'kwo mukyer akà un'kàbɔ a baar?»
Yɛsu kàtɛn naa: «Laswɛŋ baar bàbwaay.» Ikal akin kyàkäl anà in'lɛŋ mbɔɔn. Baar waa bàbwaay, ba bàkäl abaal isii a nsaab tyeen.
Apan, Yɛsu kàwɛl mampà, kàfuur an'tɔɔn, waa kàkäb akà baar bàkäl paa. Nde kàkyer abun sye ntɔn nsö: nde kapɛɛ yinà yanswà bàkweenà ba muwal.
Umpal bàyüür ba, Yɛsu kàtɛn a alɔŋki ande naa: «Làköŋà itiir byan'sal, ntɔn akà undiir ukɔ̈ɔ̈n akyà bwà.»
Ba bàköŋà bya, waa bàyööl in'lwaŋ, in'lwaŋ kwem aŋiyweel a itiir a mampà an'tyeen mà ɔrzɛ byàsääl akà baar bàdi.
Mpal bàmɛn baar impà kàkyer nde, ba bàtɛn naa: «Ndandaa mbuur awà, wà Ŋangɔɔm awayà u mɛɛn!»
Wɛɛ Yɛsu, abà kàyöb nde naa ba bàkyer ayun'wal a ngwal ntɔn mukun'sà mfum, nde kàfàkyà u mpey aŋàyen udu a mɔŋ.
Mpal làbü sisye, alɔŋki ande bàyàtyà kà un'kɔɔl a ɛwà,
ba bàbilà u bwaar làmwɛy, waa bàsɛmà mubweel ɛwà ntɔn mukyà Kapɛrnawum. Làpib làkäl lan'bwà itaan, Yɛsu kàkäl anki aŋàtataan.
Un'pöb angwal kàkäl muful, ɛwà kyàkäl munini.
Ba bàkäl ban'kyer an'kilɔmɛtre an'tyeen, itàkal an'syaam, ba bàmɛn Yɛsu wàmuyikyà udu a an'dà, wàmuyàsin tsütsü a bwaar. Apan bɔɔmà làkyer akaar.
Wɛɛ Yɛsu kàtɛn a ba naa: «Wà mɛ, twon lan'man bɔɔmà!»
Ba bàkwen mukun'wal u bwaar, wɛɛ la làkäl lan'tol u mɛɛn kà ikal akyà bàkyen ba.
U taaŋtye, iköŋ a baar bàsàsal u sim lumwɛy, bàmɛn ba naa bwaar làkäl làmwɛy mpɛl paa, naa Yɛsu sye kàkyen anki mbwo mwɛy anà alɔŋki ande uboo a bwaar aba, wɛɛ ba, bàkyen ba mpɛl aŋàyen.
Apan sye, an'bwaar asin màfü Tibɛryade, màyàkɔlà tsütsü kà ikal bàdi ba mampà, ungö kàfuur Mwol an'tɔɔn.
Wɛɛ utaaŋ kàmɛn iköŋ a baar naa itàkal Yɛsu, itàkal alɔŋki ande bàkäl anki paa, baar bàbilà kà an'bwaar, waa bàkyen Kapɛrnawum mukàleŋ Yɛsu.
Utaaŋ bun'mɛn ba u sim a ɛwà lumwɛy, ba bàtɛn a nde naa: «Rabi, ngye apà an'yàkɔlà taaŋ nà?»
Yɛsu kafuur naa: «Ndandaa, ndandaa mɛ alàkyään, kà ntɔn impà làmɛn bɛ anki waa bɛ, bɛ làyan'leŋ, wɛɛ ntɔn làdi bɛ mampà anà làyüür bɛ.
Twon lan'sal ntɔn isaa abyà ifàtay, wɛɛ ntɔn isaa ifàlam ntɔn mɔ̈ɔ̈ a mbul a in'tye, bya akwà usàlapà Mwan a mbuur, ntɔn nde wà mbuur kàsi Taa Nzam inyɛm ande.»
Apan, ba bun'fuul naa: «Ininà bi kan'kwo mukyer ntɔn musal isal a Nzam?»
Yɛsu kafuur naa: «Isal udilà Nzam akà bɛ kyà musà làkwikilà amu mbuur kàtöm nde.»
Apan ba bun'fuur naa: «Wɛɛ ngye, idiim nà ngye akyer ntɔn bi imɛn anà bi kasi làkwikilà? Ininà ngye afàsal?
Bànkaa abi bàdi mane u nsye a ipɔl, asànaa bàsön ya naa: "Isaa kapɛ nde mudyà byà làmpà làfü du."»
Apan Yɛsu kàtɛn a ba naa: «Ndandaa, ndandaa mɛ alàkyään, kà Mɔsɛ tɛy kàlapɛ làmpà a du, wɛɛ Taa amɛ afàlapà làmpà a du là ndandaa.
Ntɔn làmpà a Nzam là mbuur kan'fà du anà kan'pà mɔ̈ɔ̈ u mɛɛn.»
Apan, ba bàtɛn a nde naa: «Mwol, ipɛ taaŋ lanswà làmpà alà.»
Yɛsu kàtɛn a ba naa: «Mɛ, mɛ in'wà làmpà a mɔ̈ɔ̈. Mbuur awayà akà mɛ usàwem anki ngyal akà ikikye, mbuur awà asà làkwikilà amu mɛ, usàwem anki mfwää akà ikikye.
Wɛɛ, mɛ ya kàkyàtɛn a bɛ naa: bɛ làkyàman, wɛɛ bɛ làsaa anki làkwikilà.
Baar banswà kan'pà Taa bàsàyà akà mɛ, anà mbuur ayà akà mɛ, mɛ in'sun'piy anki,
ntɔn kàyàtɔlà mɛ fà du, kà mukyer ukwen amɛ ŋakwo anki, wɛɛ mukyer ukwen a mbuur awà kan'töm.
Le, ukwen a mbuur awà kan'töm abà: naa mbuur wanswà kan'pɛ nde ukɔ̈ɔ̈n akyà bwà, wɛɛ mɛ un'wiiy kà ilä a ntsüü.
Abun, ukwen a Taaràmɛ abà: mbuur wanswà aman Mwan anà asà làkwikilà amu nde, ukäl anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ a mbul a in'tye, waa mɛ, mɛ in'sun'wiiy kà ilä a ntsüü.»
Sɛmà apan, Ayudà bàbulà muŋüŋün ntɔn kàtɛn nde naa: «Mɛ, mɛ in'wà làmpà làfü du.» –
Ba waa bàfatɛɛnà naa: «Nkye nde kà Yɛsu, mwan a Yɔsɛfi anki? Nkye bi taarànde anà ngwän kayöb anki? Aben nde kan'kwo mukyey uyɔl apanà naa: "Mɛ an'yàtɔlà fà du"?»
Wɛɛ Yɛsu kafuur naa: «Twon lan'ŋüŋün bɛ a bɛ.
Akà mbuur mwɛy ukwe anki muyà akà mɛ isàkal naa Taa awà kan'töm kun'naan anki, waa mɛ, mɛ insun'wiiy kà ilä a ntsüü.
Aŋangɔɔm bàsön abà: "Nzam asàlɔŋ ba banswà." Mbuur wanswà kàwem Taa anà kàkyey an'lɔɔŋ ande, ayà akà mɛ.
Ikaswaŋà naa akà umwɛy kàmɛn anki Taa akà ikikye, nà mbuur mwɛy awà kàfü akà Nzam, nde awà kàmɛn Taa.
Ndandaa, ndandaa, mɛ alàkyään: mbuur asà làkwikilà we anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ a mbul a in'tye.
Mɛ, mɛ in'wà làmpà a mɔ̈ɔ̈.
Bànkaa abɛ bàdi manɛ u nsye a ipɔl, wɛɛ ba bàkyàkwà.
Wɛɛ làmpà làyàtɔlà fà du, là naa mbuur adyà la ukɔɔn akwà.

Mɛ, mɛ in'wà làmpà alye anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ làfü du. Isàkal naa mbuur kan'dyà unsà làmpà alà, nde asàkal anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ a mbul a in'tye. Làmpà alà in'sàpà mɛ, lun'sön a ndür amɛ an'pà mɛ ntɔn mɛɛn ikäl anà mɔ̈ɔ̈.»
Apan, Ayudà bàsyeelà mbaaŋ a ngwalàngwal ba a ba: «Aben mbuur wà kan'kwo mupà bi un'sön a ndür ande naa bàdi wa?»
Abun, Yɛsu kakyään naa: «Ndandaa, ndandaa mɛ alàkyään: isàkal naa bɛ làdi anki un'sön a ndür a Mwan a mbuur anà bɛ lànü anki an'kil ande, bɛ mɔ̈ɔ̈ làsàkal awà anki.
Mbuur awadyà un'sön a ndür amɛ anà anwà an'kil amɛ, nde we anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ a mbul a in'tye, waa mɛ, mɛ insun'wiiy kà ilä a ntsüü.
Ntɔn un'sön a ndür amɛ wà isaa a ndandaa byàdyà anà an'kil amɛ mà man a ndandaa.
Mbuur awadyà un'sön a ndür amɛ anà anwà an'kil amɛ, nde wà amu mɛ anà mɛ in'wà amu nde.
Asànaa Taa awà kan'töm awà nde anà mɔ̈ɔ̈, mɛ sye in'wà anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ u mbwo ande. Abun, mbuur asan'dyà, nde asàkal anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ u mbwo amɛ:
Alà là làmpà làyàtɔlà fà du. La kà latɛy asànaa la akwà bàdi bànkaa abɛ. Ba, ba bàkyàkwà. Wɛɛ mbuur asàdyà làmpà là, nde asàkal anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ a mbul a in'tye.»
Indiir abi nde kàlɔɔŋà u ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà u Kapɛrnawum.
Ungö bàwem ba Yɛsu, bàmbɔɔn uboo a alɔŋki ande bàtɛn naa: «Ndaa ayi yà bwoor! Nà kan'kwo muwem ya?»
Wɛɛ nde kayöb nde ŋakwo naa alɔŋki ande bàkäl mukun'twe ntɔn ndaa ayi, waa kàtɛn a ba naa: «Nkye ndaa ayi yàmàladii ukyal?
Akya isàkal naa bɛ lan'man Mwan a mbuur wàmubɛɛnà mper kàkäl nde kusà?
Dweelà làfàpà mɔ̈ɔ̈, wɛɛ un'sön a ndür wà undiir mwɛy ndöŋ watɛy. Ndaa an'tɛn mɛ a bɛ yà dweelà anà mɔ̈ɔ̈.
Wɛɛ bamwɛy uboo abɛ bàfàsà anki làkwikilà.» Abun, Yɛsu kàkyer ayöbà fà nsɛmà naa bànà mpa bàsye làkwikilà anà nà kàlun'yälà.
Nde kàkwɛy naa: «Kyakin kàlakyään mɛ naa: "akà mbuur mwɛy ukwe tɛy muyà akà mɛ, isàkal naa ya Taa kun'pɛ anki."»
Fà apan, alɔŋki ande mbɔɔn bàkyer alwomà, waa bàwɛy muyikyà anà nde.
Apan, Yɛsu kàtɛn a Bàkwem Aŋiyweel naa: «Atöl bɛ, nkye bɛ làkwen anki mukyà?»
Simɔn Petɔlà kun'fuur naa: «Mwol, bi ikyà akà nà? Ngye awe anà ndaa a mɔ̈ɔ̈ a mbul a in'tye.
Bi, bi kàkyàsà làkwikilà anà kàkyàyöb naa ngye, ngye awà Ŋun'kyɛɛl a Nzam.»
Yɛsu kafuur naa: «Nkye kà mɛ anki kàlasɔ̈ɔ̈l, bɛ Bàkwem Aŋiyweel? Kyekà umwɛy uboo abɛ wà ileŋ!»
Abun, nde kàtɛɛnà ntɔn Yudasi, Mwan a Simɔn Isikalyɔt. Ntɔn nde wumwɛy uboo a Bàkwem Aŋiyweel awà kàlun'yälà.
Ungö apan, Yɛsu kàyilyaaŋà u Ngalilɛ. Nde kàkwen anki muyilyaaŋ u Yuday, ntɔn amfum a Ayudà bàleŋà mukun'dwa.
Kyekà, un'kyɔm a ndwà a ntɛn a Ayudà kàkäl tsütsü.
Apan, atɔŋ a Yɛsu bàtɛn a nde naa: «Lwomà apà, kyen Yuday, ntɔn alɔŋki angye sye bàmɛn isal akyerà ngye bi.
Akà mbuur mwɛy ufàkyer anki undiir u nku isàkal naa nde akwen umɛnà. Ntɔn akakyerà ngye indiir abi, wɛy ngye ŋakwo sye amɛnà u mii a baar.»
Abun, atɔŋ ande ŋakwo bun'si anki làkwikilà.
Apan Yɛsu kàtɛn a ba naa: «Taaŋ amɛ ŋàtàkwo anki. Wɛɛ akà bɛ, taaŋ lanswà là ubwaŋ.
Mɛɛn ikwe tɛy mukàlayiiŋ, wɛɛ mɛ, nde akyer afan'yiiŋ, ntɔn mɛ in'fàtà imbäl naa isal ande byà ibe.
Kyakin, bɛ, bɛ làbeenà un'kyɔm. Akà mɛ, mɛ in'beenà tɛy un'kyɔm, ntɔn taaŋ amɛ ŋàtàkwo anki.»
Ungö mutɛn abà, nde kàsàbwaay u Ngalilɛ.
Wɛɛ mpal bàkyen atɔŋ ande un'kyɔm, apan, nde sye kàbeenà aŋàyen, kà u mii a baar anki, wɛɛ asànaa u nku.
Umpal a un'kyɔm, amfum a Ayudà bàyun'leŋà ba, waa bàtɛɛnà naa: «Wàken nde bà?»
Baar bàsyeelà mbaaŋ mbɔɔn ntɔn nde uboo a nköŋ. Amwɛy naa: «Nde wà mbuur aŋàbwaŋ». Wɛɛ bumwɛy naa: «Ŋaa, nde wà muyibwiy baar ndwaŋ.»
Itàkal abun, akà mbuur mwɛy kàtɛɛnà anki u mii a baar, ntɔn ba bàtiinà amfum a Ayudà bɔɔmà.
Un'kyɔm kàkäl kan'tol uboboo, Yɛsu kàbeenà ndwà a Nzam, waa kàlɔɔŋà.
Amfum a Ayudà bàmɛn ndaa yubem, waa bàtɛɛnà naa: «Aben nde uyöbà, nde mbuur mpa kàtäŋ?»
Yɛsu kafuur naa: «An'lɔɔŋ amɛ kà man'fà akà mɛ anki, wɛɛ màmbuur kan'töm.
Isàkal naa mbuur akwen mukyer ukwen a Nzam, nde asàyöb naa nkye an'lɔɔŋ amà man'fà akà Nzam, lɛɛ mɛ in'wà mutɛn kà ikɔb amɛ ŋakwo.
Mbuur afàtɛn ntɔn nde ŋakwo, afàleŋ làkoo ande ŋakwo. Wɛɛ mbuur afàleŋ làkoo a mbuur kun'töm, nde wà mbuur a ndandaa, usɔɔr akà nde batɛy.
Nkye kà Mɔsɛ anki kàlapɛ Un'kɔɔn? Wɛɛ akà umwɛy uboo abɛ ufàsyääl anki wa. Ntɔn nkye làkwen bɛ mukan'dwa?»
Iköŋ a baar kyun'fuur naa: «Ngye awe anà un'sɔŋà! Nà akwen akadwa?»
Yɛsu kafuur naa: «Mɛ, mɛ an'kyer isal imwɛy, wɛɛ bɛ banswà, bɛ lan'bem!
Ntɔn Mɔsɛ kàlaswɛŋ mukyɛy baan abaal - ya sye yàfü anki akà Mɔsɛ, wɛɛ yàfü akà bànkaa - waa bɛ làfàkyɛy baal mwɛy ilä a saba.
Isàkal naa bɛ lan'kwo mukyɛy baal mwɛy ilä a saba ukɔɔn abɛy Un'kɔɔn a Mɔsɛ, ntɔn nkye làman'wem bɛ nkyɛl ntɔn an'kɔɔr mɛ baal aŋun'kiinà ilä a saba?
Twon lan'tsul mbar ntɔn ubwaŋ a nsà, wɛɛ làtsül mbar a balàbal.»
Ndam a baar uboo a baar a Yɛlusàlɛm bàtɛɛnà naa: «Nkye wà kà mbuur bàyileŋ ba mudwa anki?
Le, nde wàmutɛn u mii a baar, wɛɛ akà mbuur a un'sà nso watɛy! Nkye amfum abi ban'kyey naa ndandaa nde wà Klistɔ?
Mpal usàyà Klistɔ, akà mbuur mwɛy usàyöb anki ntsü kan'fà nde. Wɛɛ baal wà, bi ikyàyöb ntsü kan'fà nde.»

Apan, umpal kàlɔɔŋà Yɛsu u ndwà a Nzam, nde kàsi un'kwɛŋ: «Bɛ, bɛ làkyan'yöb! Bɛ làkyàyöb ntsü an'fà mɛ! Wɛɛ mɛ, mɛ kàyi anki mɛ ŋakwo, mbuur awà kan'töm wà ndandaa. Bɛ, bɛ lun'yöb anki.
Mɛ, mɛ in'kyun'yöb, ntɔn mɛ kàfü akà nde, nde sye kan'töm.»
Apan, ba bàleŋ mukun'kɔr, wɛɛ akà mbuur kun'bä anki, ntɔn taaŋ ande làkäl aŋàkwo anki.
Uboo a iköŋ, baar mbɔɔn bàsi làkwikilà amu nde. Ba bàtɛɛnà naa: «Nkye mpal usàyà Klistɔ, nde asàkyer impà aŋàsöön abyà ukyerà mbuur wà?»
In'ŋün myàkäl uboo a iköŋ a baar ntɔn Yɛsu, myàyàböl kà an'tsü a Amfarisi. Apan, andwer a angaŋ anà Amfarisi waa bàtöm aseey ntɔn mukun'kɔr.
Yɛsu kàtɛn naa: «Mɛ, mɛ in'wà anà bɛ taaŋ ikikye, ungö mɛ in'kyà ntsü akà mbuur kan'töm.
Bɛ làkyer asan'leŋ, wɛɛ bɛ làsan'man tɛy, ntɔn bɛ làkwe anki muyà kà ikal in'sàkal mɛ.»

Fà apan, amfum a Ayudà bàsɛmà mufuul ba a ba naa: «Nde apɛy ayàkyà ken ntɔn bi ifàkɔɔn un'man? Nkye nde apɛy ayàkàtaan Ayudà akwà bàpää uboo a Angɛlɛki? Nkye nde apɛy Angɛlɛki usàkàlɔŋ?
Ikaswaŋà aben ndaa utɛn nde ayɛy naa: "Bɛ, bɛ làkyer asan'leŋ, wɛɛ bɛ làsan'man tɛy, naa sye bɛ làkwe tɛy muyà kà ikal in'sàkal mɛ"?»
Ilä a ntsüü a un'kyɔm kyàkäl ilä mwɛy kyà kölàköl. Yɛsu kàkäl umbär wàmukyäänà naa: «Isàkal naa mbuur we anà mfwää, wɛy nde uyi akà mɛ, waa unwà.
Mbuur awe anà làkwikilà amu mɛ, "ngyäl a an'dà a mɔ̈ɔ̈ isàtoo u mpem ande", asànaa itɛɛnà Ndaa Aŋàsɔn.»
Kàtɛɛnà nde abunà, yà ntɔn Dweelà bàlàwal baar bàlàsà làkwikilà aba amu nde. Umpal ayin, Dweelà kàkäl aŋàtàpà anki, ntɔn Yɛsu kàkäl anki aŋàtàwal làkoo.
Amwɛy uboo iköŋ bàwem ndaa ayi, ba bàtɛɛnà naa: «Ndandaa mbuur awà, wà Ŋangɔɔm!»
Bumwɛy bàtɛɛnà naa: «Nde wà Klistɔ!» – Wɛɛ bumwɛy bàfuur naa: «Nkye Klistɔ sye an'kwo utoo u Ngalilɛ?
Nkye Ndaa Aŋàsɔn itɛɛnà anki naa nde asàkal mbuur a ywar a David, nde asàfà Bɛtelɛm, bul kàkälà David?»
Apan, iköŋ kyàkaabà ntɔn nde.
Amwɛy uboo a ba bàkweenà naa bun'kör, wɛɛ akà mbuur mwɛy kàkwe anki mukun'ba.
Aseey bàyàfurà ba akà andweer a angaŋ anà Amfarisi, ba bafuul naa: «Ntɔn nkye mpa làtwääl bɛ Yɛsu?»
Aseey bàfuur naa: «Akà mbuur mwɛy ŋàtàtɛn anki akà ikikye asànaa nde!» –
Apan, Amfarisi bafuul naa: «Nkye anà bɛ sye, nde akyàlabwiy ndwaŋ?
Nkye we anà umwɛy uboo a amfum itàkal uboo a Amfarisi, kàsi làwikilà amu nde?
Wɛɛ baar abà, baar mpa bàyöb Un'kɔɔn akà ikikye, ba bàŋàküül!»
Wɛɛ umwɛy uboo a Amfarisi, Nàkàdim akwà kàkàman Yɛsu itaan, kàtɛn a ba naa:
«Nkye Un'kɔɔn abi afàtsüül mbuur mbar ukɔɔn atun'wem anà muyöb naa nde nkye kan'kyer?»
Ba bun'fuur naa: «Nkye ngye sye awà un'nsi Ngalilɛ? Leŋ, ngye ayàman naa akà ŋangɔɔm mwɛy ufàtoo anki u Ngalilɛ akà ikikye.»
Ungö apan, mbuur mbuur kàfurà ndwà ande.
Yɛsu kàkyen mɔŋ a In'te a olive.
Ututu tutu, nde kàyàfurà u ndwà a Nzam. Un'sɛŋ a baar wanswà kàyi akà nde, nde waa kàbwaay, waa kàsɛmà mulɔŋ.
Apan, alɔɔŋ a Un'kɔɔn anà Amfarisi bun'twääl un'kaar mwɛy bàkör ba wàmutà inswem, waa bun'tɔɔl uboboo a baar banswà,
waa bàtɛn a Yɛsu naa: «Un'lɔɔŋ, un'kaar wà bàmun'kɔr wàmutà inswem.
Unsà un'kɔɔn, Mɔsɛ kà iswɛŋ mutà akaar a tub abà in'kul. Waa ngye, ngye an'tɛn aben bà?»
Bàtɛɛnà ba abà ntɔn ba bun'lwɛb ndaa, anà ba bàkäl anà undiir ban'kwo ba mukun'füün. Wɛɛ Yɛsu waa kàtsüüm, kàsɛmà mubaar in'dyärà a làpin u mɛɛn.
Ntɔn bàsi ba muküünà mukun'fuul, Yɛsu kàsuub un'tswe, waa kàtɛn a ba naa: «Isàkal naa apà we anà mbuur mwɛy uboo a bɛ mpa aŋàtàkyer man'be akà ikikye, wɛy nde kun'käm un'kul atàtwɛb.»
Ungö, kàfàtsüüm nde, nde kàsön u mɛɛn.
Ungö bàwem ba ndaa ayi, ba bàsɛmà mutà upay umwɛy umwɛy, semà akà andweer. Wɛɛ Yɛsu kàsàsal aŋàyen, un'kaar kàkyàmbar kusà a nde.
Apan, Yɛsu kàsuub nde un'tswe, waa kun'fuul naa: «Un'kaar, bàken ba? Nkye akà mbuur akyapà ikwàndwà?» –
Nde kàfuur naa: «Ŋaa, Mwol, akà mbuur.» Waa Yɛsu kàtɛn a nde naa: «Mɛ sye, mɛ apà anki ikwàndwà. Kyen, twon an'fàkyer man'be.»
Yɛsu kàfàtɛn a ba naa: «Mɛ, mɛ in'wà pɛɛlà a mɛɛn. Mbuur ayan'lab, nde usàkyà anki u mpib akà ikikye, nde asàwal pɛɛlà làfàpà mɔ̈ɔ̈.»
Apan, Amfarisi bàtɛn a nde naa: «Ngye, ngye awàmutà imbäl angye ŋakwo. Imbäl angye kà kyà ndandaa anki.»

Yɛsu kafuur naa: «Yà ndandaa naa mɛ, mɛ in'wàmutà imbäl amɛ ŋakwo. Imbäl amɛ kyà ndandaa, ntɔn mɛ in'kyàyöb naa mɛ an'fà ken anà mɛ sye in'kyà ken. Wɛɛ bɛ, bɛ làyöb anki naa mɛ an'fà ken anà mɛ sye in'kyà ken.
Bɛ, bɛ nsaŋ làfàtsul unsà imbuur. Wɛɛ mɛ, mɛ in'fàtsüül anki mbuur nsaŋ.
Mpalabà, isàkal naa mɛ in'kyer atsul nsaŋ, ntsüül a nsaŋ amɛ yà balàbal, ntɔn mɛ kà in'wà aŋàyen anki, wɛɛ mɛ in'wà anà Taa, mbuur awà kan'töm.
Bàsön unsà Un'kɔɔn abɛ ŋakwo naa bàfàtɔn anki imbäl a baar bɔ̈ɔ̈l.
Mɛ, mɛ in'fàtà imbäl amɛ ŋakwo, Taa awà kan'töm afan'tɛɛl sye imbäl.»
Apan ba bàtɛɛnà a nde naa: «Wàken Taaràŋà wa?» Yɛsu naa: «Bɛ, bɛ mɛ lan'yöb anki, itàkal Taaràmɛ, bɛ lun'yöb anki. Ilàkal naa bɛ lan'yöb, bɛ sye Taaràmɛ làkyer alun'yöb.»
Ndaa ayi, Yɛsu ya kàtɛɛnà umpal kàlɔɔŋà nde u ndwà a Nzam, kà ikal a insak a an'kab. Akà mbuur mwɛy kàkwe anki mukun'kɔr, ntɔn taaŋ ande làkäl aŋàkwo anki.
Yɛsu kàfàtɛn a ba naa: «Mɛ, mɛ in'kyer ayàkyà, bɛ làkyer ayan'leŋ, wɛ bɛ, bɛ làsàkwà unsà ube abɛ. Bɛ làkwe anki mukyà mper in'kyà mɛ.»
Apan amfum a Ayudà bàtɛɛnà naa: «Nkye nde we anà an'kyän mudwa nde ŋakwo, ntɔn nde wàmutɛn naa: "Bɛ làkwe anki mukyà mper in'kyà mɛ"?»
Yɛsu kafuur naa: «Bɛ, bɛ làbà baar a indiir a mɛɛn mà. Wɛɛ mɛ, mɛ in'wà mbuur a indiir a dudu. Bɛ, bɛ làbà baar a mɛɛn mà, wɛɛ mɛ, mɛ kà in'wà mbuur a mɛɛn mà anki.
Undiir awun in'tɛn mɛ a bɛ naa bɛ làsàkwà unsà man'be abɛ. Abun, isàkal naa bɛ làkyey anki naa "Mɛ In'wà", bɛ làsàkwà unsà man'be abɛ.» –
Ba bun'fuul naa: «Ngye, ngye awà nà?» Yɛsu kafuur naa: «Mbuur akwà kàlakyään mɛ fà nsɛmà.
Mɛ, mɛ in'we anà indiir mbɔɔn mutɛn anà mutsul nsaŋ ntɔn bɛ. Wɛɛ mɛ in'fàkyään u mɛɛn nà ya akwà kàwem mɛ akà mbuur kan'töm, nde afàtɛn ndandaa.»
Wɛɛ ba bàyöbà anki naa nde ba kasaamà ntɔn Taa.
Apan, Yɛsu kàtɛn naa: «Utaaŋ làsàsɛɛn bɛ Mwan a mbuur, bɛ laa làsàyöb bɛ naa "Mɛ In'wà", anà mɛ in'fàkyer anki undiir kà ukwen amɛ ŋakwo: mɛ in'fàtɛn ya akwà kan'lɔŋ Taa.
Mbuur kan'töm wà anà mɛ: nde kan'wɛy anki aŋàyen, ntɔn mɛ, taaŋ lanswà mɛ in'fàkyer indiir ufàkwen nde.»
Umpal kàkäl nde mutɛɛnà abà, baar mbɔɔn bàsi làkwikilà amu nde.
Abun Yɛsu kàtɛn a Ayudà abà bàsi làkwikilà amu nde naa: «Isàkal naa bɛ, bɛ lan'lam u ndaa amɛ, ndandaa bɛ làbà alɔŋki amɛ.
Abun, bɛ làsàyöb ndandaa, waa ndandaa isàlabuul baar a nsaay.»
Ba bun'fuur naa: «Bi, bi ibà itoo a Abàlam, bi kàsàkal anki asɔ a mbuur mwɛy akà ikikye. Aben ngye, ngye atɛɛnà naa: "Bɛ làsàbulà baar a nsaay"?»
Yɛsu kafuur naa: «Ndandaa, ndandaa mɛ alàkyään: mbuur wanswà afàkyer man'be, nde wà un'sɔ a man'be.
Un'sɔ ufàbwaay anki ipepey u ndwà, wɛɛ mwan afàbwaay ipepey kwo.
Abun, isàkal naa Mwan kàmàlakɔɔr, bɛ làsàkal baar a nsaay bàndandaa.
Mɛ in'kyàyöb naa bɛ làbà itoo a Abàlam, wɛɛ bɛ làfàleŋ mukan'dwa, ntɔn ndaa amɛ ifàlatwà anki u mpem.
Mɛ, mɛ in'fàtɛn indiir kàmɛn mɛ akà Taa. Wɛɛ bɛ, bɛ làfàkyer indiir làwem bɛ akà taaràbɛ.»
Ba bun'fuur naa: «Abàlam wà taaràbi.» Yɛsu naa: «Kya bɛ làlàkal baan a Abàlam, bɛ làlikyerà isal a Abàlam.
Wɛɛ apanà, bɛ, bɛ làleŋà mukan'dwa, mɛ mbuur kàlakyään ndandaa ayà kàwem mɛ akà Nzam. Abàlam kàkyer anki abà!
Wɛɛ bɛ, bɛ làfàkyer isal a taaràbɛ.» Ba bun'fuur naa: «Bi kà ibà baan a inswem anki. Bi ibye awà Taa mwɛy mpɛl, Nzam.»
Yɛsu kafuur naa: «Yàlàkal naa Nzam wà Taaràbɛ, bɛ làlàkyer an'kwen. Ntɔn mɛ, mɛ an'too amu Nzam anà mɛ sye an'fà kwo. Mɛ, mɛ kàyi anki a ukwen amɛ ŋakwo, wɛɛ Nde kan'töm.
Ntɔn nkye mpa làkayöbà bɛ ntɛɛn amɛ? Ntɔn bɛ, bɛ làkwe anki muwem ndaa amɛ.

Bɛ, taaràbɛ ileŋ, bɛ làfàkwen mukyer ngyal a taaràbɛ. Nde wun'dwää fà nsɛmà, nde kàsàtsim anki uboo a ndandaa, ntɔn ndandaa amu nde yatɛy. Umpal ufàtà nde loor, nde la afàwal uboo a indiir ande ŋakwo, ntɔn nde wà ŋaloor anà taar a loor.
Wɛɛ, mɛ in'fàtɛn ndandaa, undiir awun mpa làfan'sà bɛ làkwikilà.
Nà uboo abɛ kan'kwo mukan'swaŋ naa mɛ an'kyer man'be? Ntɔn nkye lan'kɔɔn bɛ mukan'sà làkwikilà isàkal naa mɛ an'tɛn ndandaa?
Mbuur awà mbuur a Nzam, afàwem ndaa a Nzam. Wɛɛ bɛ, bɛ làfàwem anki, ntɔn bɛ kàlàbà baar a Nzam anki.»
Ayudà bun'fuur naa: «Nkye bi iböŋ kyatɛy mutɛn naa ngye awà un'nsi Samalya, anà ngye sye awe anà unsɔŋà?» –
Yɛsu kàfuur naa: «Mɛ, mɛ unsɔŋà watɛy. Wɛɛ mɛ, mɛ in'wàmusyäŋà Taaràmɛ. Wɛɛ bɛ, bɛ làkun'syäŋà anki.
Mɛ, mɛ in'fàleŋ anki làkoo amɛ ŋakwo. We anà mbuur afàpà la anà afàtsul mbar.
Ndandaa, ndandaa, mɛ alàkyään: isàkal naa mbuur kan'kaar ndaa amɛ, nde usàkwà anki akà ikikye.»

Apan, Ayudà nsil abà bàtɛn a nde naa: «Apanà, bi kan'yöb naa ngye awe anà unsɔŋà! Abàlam kàkyàkwà anà aŋangɔɔm sye, wɛ ngye atɛn naa: "Isàkal naa mbuur an'kaar ndaa amɛ, nde usàkwà anki akà ikikye."
Nkye ngye, ngye an'söön taaràbi Abàlam awà kàkü itaan? Aŋangɔɔm sye bàkyàkwà! Ngye, ngye akasii naa ngye awà nà?»
Yɛsu kafuur naa: «Isàkal naa mɛ, mɛ in'fàsà làkoo akà mɛ ŋakwo, la ndöŋ latɛy. Mɛ, mɛ in'fàsà làkoo a Taaràmɛ, nde akwà làfàtɛn bɛ naa: "Nde wà Nzam abi".
Bɛ nde lun'yöb anki, wɛɛ akà mɛ, mɛ in'kyun'yöb. Kya mɛ in'sàtɛn naa mɛ un'yöb anki, mɛ in'sàkal mbuur a loor asànaa bɛ. Mɛ in'kyun'yöb anà mɛ sye in'fàkaar ndaa ande.
Taaràbɛ Abàlam kàkäl kà un'sak unsà an'kyän muman ilä amɛ: nde kàkyàman kya, waa kàkü unsà un'sak.»
Ayudà waa bàtɛn a nde naa: «Nkye ngye akà mbul an'kwem an'tyeen awe ayà, waa ngye kàmɛn Abàlam!»
Yɛsu naa: «Ndandaa, ndandaa, mɛ alàkyään: kusà a mböör a Abàlam, "Mɛ In'wà".»
Apan, ba b 1 bür in'kul ntɔn mukun'kam. Wɛɛ Yɛsu laa kàkàyee nde, waa kàtoo u ndwà a Nzam.
U mbwo, Yɛsu kàmɛn baal mwɛy wàŋàkwàmii fà mböör ande.
Alɔŋki ande bun'fuul naa: «Rabi, nà kàkyer man'be ntɔn nde bun'bör wàŋàkwàmii, nkye nde lɛɛ aböör ande?»
Yɛsu kàfuur naa: «Kà nde anki, itàkal aböör ande, wɛɛ ntɔn isal a Nzam imɛnà amu nde.
Ibà bi pà u mwäänà, bi ikyer isal a mbuur kan'töm. Làpib làmubwà, taaŋ mpa usal mbuur.
Umpal in'wà mɛ pà u mɛɛn, mɛ in'wà pɛɛlà a mɛɛn.»
Ungö mutɛn indiir abi, nde kàtsül an'te u mɛɛn, kàkyer twar, waa kàkiir la u mii a ikwamii,
waa kàtɛn a nde naa: «Kyen, kaywɛb kà itɛy a Silɔwɛ.» Ikɔb aki ikaswaŋà naa «Ntööm». Ikwàmii kàkyen kwo, kàywɛy ntabwey, waa kàyimanà mpal kàyàfurà nde.
Baar a tsütsü anà nde anà baar bàfun'manà kusà wàmulɔlɔm, bàfuulà naa: «Nkye wà kà mbuur akwà kàkälà wà aŋàbwaay anà kàfalɔ̈lɔ̈mà anki?»
Amwɛy bàtɛɛnà naa: «Awà nde.» Bumwɛy naa: «Awà kà nde anki, mbuur asin kàmufwän.» Wɛɛ ikwàmii kàkyey naa: «Ndandaa, wà mɛ.»
Abun, ba bun'fuulà naa: «Mii angye myan'dubà aben?»
Nde kàfuur naa: «Mbuur awà bàfàbel Yɛsu kàkyer twar, kan'kiir la u mii, waa kàtɛn a mɛ naa: "Kyen Silɔwɛ, kaywɛb". Apan sye in'kyen mɛ, in'ywɛb mɛ, waa in'bulà muman!»
Ba bun'fuul naa: «Nde wàken, mbuur wa?» Nde kàfuur naa: «Mɛ in'yöb anki.»
Apan, ba bàtwääl mbuur kàkäl ikwàmii akà Amfarisi.
Kyekà, ilä akin kyàkäl ilä a saba akyà kàkyer Yɛsu twar, anà kun'duub nde mii.
Apan sye, Amfarisi bun'fuul sye naa mii angye myàdubà aben. Nde kafuur naa: «Nde kan'kiir twar u mii, in'ywɛb mɛ, waa mɛ an'man.»

Apan, uboo a Amfarisi amwɛy bàtɛɛnà naa: «Mbuur awà kà kan'fà akà Nzam anki, ntɔn nde saba ufàkyɛɛl anki.» Wɛɛ bumwɛy bàtɛɛnà naa: «Nkye mbuur a man'be kan'kwo ukäl anà ikɔ̈b akyer idiim a tub abi?» Nkaabà yàkyer abilà uboo a ba.
Apan, ba bàfàfuul ikwamii naa: «Waa ngye, ngye an'tɛn aben ntɔn mbuur kaduub mii?» Nde kàfuur naa: «Nde wà ŋangɔɔm.»
Wɛɛ amfum a Ayudà bàkyer atɔn musà làkwikilà naa nde kàkäl ikwàmii, waa nde kàbulà muman. Undiir awun, bàbel ba aböör ande
ntɔn mukafuul naa: «Nkye wà mwan abɛ akwà làwe bɛ naa nde bun'bör wàŋàkwàmii? Abun, nde kan'man aben apanà?»
Aböör ande bàfuur naa: «Bi, bi ikyàyöb ndandaa naa wà mwan baal abi, nde sye bun'bör wàŋàkwàmii.
Apanà nde kan'man aben, bi iyöb anki. Nà kun'duub mii? Bi iyöb anki. Lun'fuul, nde wàŋàyɛl, nde kan'kwo musam ntɔn nde ŋakwo!»
Aböör ande bàtɛɛnà ba abà, ntɔn ba bàtiinà Ayudà bɔɔmà. Ntɔn amfum a Ayudà bàdirà kusà muböŋ u ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà mbuur wanswà asàkyey naa Yɛsu wà Klistɔ.
Undiir awun aböör ande bàtɛn ba naa: «Nde wàŋàyɛl, lun'fuul!»
Amfarisi bàbel mbuur akwà kàkäl aŋàkwàmii mbalà yàyweel, waa bàtɛn a nde naa: «Pà làkoo akà Nzam! Bi, bi ikyàyöb naa baal wà wà mbuur a man'be.»
Nde kafuur naa: «Isàkal naa nde wà mbuur a man'be, mɛ in'yöb anki. Mɛ in'yöb undiir mwɛy mpɛl awà: mɛ kàkäl ikwàmii, apanà mɛ an'man.»
Ba waa bun'fuul naa: «Ininà nde kakyer? Nde ngye mii kaduub aben?»
Nde kafuur naa: «Mɛ ya akyàlakyään itaan, wɛɛ bɛ, bɛ làwem anki. Ntɔn nkye làkwen bɛ mufàwem mbalà asin? Nkye bɛ sye, bɛ làkwen mubulà alɔŋki ande?»
Apan, ba waa bàsɛmà mukun'to, mutɛn naa: «Ngye mbuur awà un'lɔŋki ande! Bi, bi ibà alɔŋki a Mɔsɛ.
Bi, bi ikyàyöb naa Nzam kàyääm a Mɔsɛ, wɛɛ mbuur wà, bi iyöb anki naa nde an'fà ken!»
Baal kafuur naa: «Le, ayi ndaa yubem: bɛ làyöb anki naa nde kan'fà ken, apan sye nde kàman'duub mii!
Bi ikyàyöb naa Nzam ufàwem anki baar a man'be. Wɛɛ isàkal naa mbuur afàkömà Nzam anà afàkyer ukwen ande, Nzam afàkyer un'wem.
Baar ŋàtàwem anki akà ikikye mutɛn naa mbuur mwɛy waa kàkɔɔr ikwàmii fà mböör ande.
Ilàkal naa mbuur awà kàfü anki akà Nzam, nde kàlàkwo anki mukyer akà undiir.»
Ba bun'fuur naa: «Ngye wanswà awà uboo a man'be fà mböör angye, waa ngye ilɔŋ!» Apan ba waa bun'tɔɔm u nsà.
Yɛsu kàwem naa ba nde bàkyer un'böŋ. Mpal kàbwey nde anà nde, nde kun'fuul naa: «Nkye ngye, ngye an'sà làkwikilà amu mwan a mbuur?» –
Nde kun'fuur naa: «Mwol, nde wà nà, waa mɛ in'sà làkwikilà amu nde?»
Yɛsu waa kàtɛn a nde naa: «Ngye amun'man, wa atɛɛnà awà apanà anà ngye, nde awà.»
Baal waa kàtɛn naa: «Mwol, mɛ, mɛ an'sà làkwikilà.» Apan, nde kàbü an'köm kusà a Yɛsu.
Waa Yɛsu kàtɛn naa: «Mɛ, mɛ kàyi u mɛɛn pà ntɔn ntsüül a nsaŋ mwɛy ikäl: ntɔn ikwàmii bàmɛn, baar bàfàman bàbulà ikwàmii.»
Amfarisi bàkäl tsütsü apà nde, bàwem ba indiir abi, waa bun'fuul naa: «Nkye bi sye, bi ibà ikwàmii?»
Yɛsu kafuur naa: «Yàlàkal naa bɛ làbà ikwàmii, bɛ làlàkal anki baar a man'be. Wɛɛ ntɔn bɛ làtɛn naa: "Bi ifàman", abun, man'be abɛ mà kapaa.»

Yɛsu kàtɛn naa: «Ndandaa, ndandaa, mɛ alàkyään: isàkal naa mbuur ubilà anki u munàmbwo a làböl a in'kɔk, wɛɛ naa nde kan'lar udu a ibä a làböl, u ntsü yumwɛy, nde wà mbüüb anà un'dwää.
Wɛɛ mbuur afàbilà u munàmbwo, nde wun'kyɛɛŋ a in'kɔk.
Un'leer kun'duub munàmbwo, in'kɔk myàwem ndaa ande. Nde afàbel in'kɔk ande umwɛy umwɛy kà ikɔb awa, waa utwey mya u nsà.
Utaaŋ utwey nde mya myanswà, uyikyà nde kusà a mya, mya myun'lab ungö, ntɔn mya myàkyàyöb ndaa ande.
Ikwe anki akà ikikye naa mya myàsàlab ungyey, mya ikyer asun'tiin, ntɔn mya myàyöb anki ndaa a angyey.»
Yɛsu katɛɛl nsim ayi, wɛɛ ba bàyöb anki naa indiir nà nde kàtɛɛnà.
Yɛsu kàfàtɛn naa: «Ndandaa, ndandaa mɛ alàkyään, mɛ in'wà munàmbwo a làböl a in'kɔk.
Baar banswà bàfwel kusà a mɛ bà mbüüb anà adwää, wɛɛ in'kɔk myawem anki.
Mɛ, mɛ in'wà munàmbwo. Isàkal naa mbuur kan'bilà u mbwo amɛ, nde asàwà mɔ̈ɔ̈, nde akyer asàbilà, akyer asàtoo, nde asàman byàdyà.
Mbüüb afàyà nà muyib, mudwa anà mupay. Wɛɛ mɛ, mɛ kàyi ntɔn baar bàwɛl mɔ̈ɔ̈ anà bàwɛl wa mbɔɔn.
Mɛ, mɛ in'wà un'kyɛɛŋ aŋàbwaŋ. Un'kyɛɛŋ aŋàbwaŋ afàpà mɔ̈ɔ̈ ande ntɔn in'kɔk ande.

Mbuur afàsal ntɔn ngim mpɛl, nde kà wà un'kyɛɛŋ a ndandaa anki, in'kɔk kà myànde anki. Kya nde usàman kyɛŋbɔl làmuyà, nde la usàkɔɔb nde in'kɔk, waa uwurà ntiin. Apan, kyɛŋbɔl la làsàbürà la mya, waa làsàtà làböl upay.
Le, nde wà un'syääl a ngim, nde undiir ukyɛr anki ntɔn in'kɔk.
Mɛ, mɛ in'wà un'kyɛɛŋ aŋàbwaŋ. Mɛ in'kyàyöb in'kɔk amɛ, mya sye myàkyan'yöb,
Taaràmɛ akyan'yöb, mɛ sye in'kyun'yöb. Mɛ in'fàpà mɔ̈ɔ̈ amɛ ntɔn in'kɔk amɛ.
Mɛ, mɛ in'we anà in'kɔk myumwɛy mpa amyà uboo a làböl alà. Mya sye mɛ in'kyer atwaal. Mya isàwem ndaa amɛ, làböl làsàkal làmwɛy, un'kyɛɛŋ mwɛy sye.
Taa akyan'kwen, ntɔn mɛ in'fàpà mɔ̈ɔ̈ amɛ, ungö waa in'fàwal wa.
Akà mbuur mwɛy tɛy afan'duum mɔ̈ɔ̈, wɛɛ mɛ, mɛ wa in'fàpà a ukwen amɛ. Mɛ in'we anà ikɔ̈b apà wa, anà ikɔ̈b afàwal wa. Ayi nswɛɛŋ kan'pɛ Taaràmɛ.»
U ndaa ayi, nkaabà yàkyer abilà uboo a amfum a Ayudà.
Bàmbɔɔn uboo a ba bàtɛɛnà naa: «Nde we anà unsɔŋà! Nde wà ŋukɔŋ! Ntɔn nkye lun'weemà bɛ?»
Wɛɛ bumwɛy bàtɛɛnà naa: «Mbuur awe anà unsɔŋà ufàtɛn anki abà. Nkye unsɔŋà kan'kwo muduub mii a ikwàmii?»
La làkäl paŋà làfakalà mpye mbɔɔn, baar bàkäl mukyɔm mpööŋ a ndwà a Nzam u Yɛlusàlɛm.
Yɛsu kàkäl mulàlyaaŋ u ndwà a Nzam, u myäy bàfàbel naa myäy a Salɔmun.
Apan, Amfum a Ayudà bàkyer un'diŋà, waa bun'fuul naa: «Tii mpal nà asikaar ngye unsà pfürà? Ikyään ubwaŋàbwaŋ isàkal naa ngye awà Klistɔ.»
Yɛsu kafuur naa: «Mɛ ya akyàlakyään itaan, wɛɛ bɛ, bɛ lan'si anki làkwikilà. Isal in'fàkyer mɛ kà ikɔb a Taaràmɛ, byàmutà imbäl ntɔn mɛ.
Wɛɛ bɛ lan'si anki làkwikilà, ntɔn bɛ kàlàbà in'kɔk amɛ anki.
In'kɔk amɛ myàfàwem ndaa amɛ. Mɛ in'kyayöb, mya sye myàkyer afan'lab.
Mɛ in'fapà mɔ̈ɔ̈ a mbul a in'tye, mya myàsàkyà anki bwà akà ikikye, akà mbuur mwɛy ukwe anki mugyɔɔr mya u kɔɔ amɛ.
Taaràmɛ, mbuur kan'pɛ mya, kan'söön baar banswà. Akà mbuur mwɛy ukwe anki mugyɔɔr mya u kɔɔ a Taa.
Taa anà mɛ, bi ibà mwɛy.»
Ayudà bàfàbürà in'kul ntɔn mukun'tà.
Apan, Yɛsu kàtɛn a ba naa: «Mɛ kàlamɛɛy isal a ntwɛn mbɔɔn byàfü akà Taa. Isal nà uboo a bya làkwen bɛ mukan'tà in'kul?»
Ayudà bun'fuur naa: «Kà ntɔn isal a ntwɛn anki waa bi katà in'kul, wɛɛ ntɔn mbɛɛy: ngye awà mbuur, wɛɛ ngye, ngye awàmukyey naa ngye awà Nzam!»
Yɛsu kafuur naa: «Nkye bàsön anki uboo a un'kɔɔn abɛ naa: "Mɛ, mɛ kàtɛn naa bɛ làbà bànzam."?
Bi ikyàyöb naa ikwe anki bàlwom indiir abyà uboo a Ndaa Aŋàsɔn. Kyekà, Nzam kàbel nde baar naa bànzam, ntɔn ndaa ande bàtöm akà ba.
Bɛ, bɛ làtɛn a baal kàsi Nzam an'kɔɔ anà kàtöm nde u mɛɛn naa: "Ngye awàmubɛy!", ntɔn an'tɛn mɛ naa mɛ in'wà Mwan a Nzam!
Isàkal naa mɛ in'fàkyer anki isal a Taaràmɛ, twon làman'sà làkwikilà.
Wɛɛ isàkal naa mɛ in'fàkyer bya, itàkal naa bɛ lan'sà anki làkwikilà, làsi làkwikilà unsà isal abi. Ntɔn bɛ làyöb anà làkyey naa Taa wà amu mɛ, mɛ in'wà amu Taa.»
Apan, ba bàfàleŋ mukun'kɔr, wɛɛ nde kàkwiyà kà an'kɔɔ aba.
Yɛsu kàfàfurà sim a Yɔrdan lumwɛy, kà ikal kàfadümà Ywan utàtwɛb, waa kàbwaay kwo.
Baar mbɔɔn bàyee akà nde, waa bàtɛɛnà naa: «Ywan kàkyer anki akà idiim mwɛy, wɛɛ ndaa yanswà kàtɛn nde ntɔn mbuur awà yàkäl ndandaa.»
Abun, baar mbɔɔn bàsi làkwikilà amu nde.
Kàkäl anà ŋukyal mwɛy ikɔb ande Lazar, un'si Bɛtanya, bul a Màlatà anà mpääŋ ande Màlye.
- Wawà Màlye akwà kàtsüül Mwol may a usɔŋ anà kun'kɔɔm in'kɔl a ntswe ande. Baal ande Lazar kàkäl anà ukyal. -
Abun, ampääŋ abà bàbɔ̈ɔ̈l bàtöm mbuur mwɛy mukàkyään Yɛsu naa: «Mwol, mbuur akwà afàkwen ngye we anà ukyal.»
Umpal kàwem Yɛsu làsaŋ alà, nde kàtɛn naa: «Abà kà ukyal akun'syen kà ukwà anki, wɛɛ ba bà ntɔn mupà làkoo akà Nzam: u mbwo a ba, Mwan a Nzam ayàwal làkoo.»
Kyekà, Yɛsu kàfakwenà Màlatà, anà mpääŋ ande, anà Lazar.
Umpal kàwem nde naa Lazar we anà ukyal, nde kàfàkyer ilä byeel kà ikal kàkäl nde.
Ungö apan nde kàtɛn a alɔŋki naa: «Tsweenà ifurà Yuday.»
Alɔŋki bun'fuur naa: «Un'lɔɔŋ, itaan a mbɔɔn tɛy, amfum a Ayudà bàleŋà mukatà in'kul, waa ngye akwen mufàfurà kwo?»
Yɛsu kàfuur naa: «Nkye an'taaŋ kwem aŋiyweel matɛy u mwäänà? Isàkal naa mbuur wàmuyikyà u mwäänà, nde uböl anki kyà, ntɔn lye anà pɛɛlà.
Wɛɛ isàkal naa mbuur wàmuyikyà u làpib, nde atɛbà kyà, ntɔn pɛɛlà latɛy.»
Ungö kàtɛn nde ndaa ayi, nde kàkwɛy naa: «Un'sam abi Lazar kàn'bɔ̈ɔ̈n, wɛɛ mɛ in'kyer akyà mukun'wiiy.»
Apan, alɔŋki bàtɛn a nde naa: «Mwol, isàkal naa nde wàŋàbɔ̈ɔ̈n, nde akyer ayàwà mɔ̈ɔ̈.»
Kutɛn aŋàbwaŋ, Yɛsu kàsam ukwà a Lazar, wɛɛ ba bàsii naa twaal a twaal.
Apan, Yɛsu kàtɛn a ba ubwaŋàbwaŋ naa: «Lazar kan'kwà.
Mɛ in'wà unsà un'sak ntɔn bɛ in'kɔ̈ɔ̈n akal mɛ kwo, ntɔn bɛ lan'si làkwikilà. Wɛɛ tsweenà akà nde.»
Apan, Tuma awà bàfàbel naa Didimɔ, kàtɛn a alɔŋki bumwɛy naa: «Tsweenà, kya ikäl naa ukwà, bi sye ikàkwà mbwo mwɛy anà nde!»
Mpal kàyàkɔlà Yɛsu, nde kàwem naa Lazar kàkyàkyer ilä inà kà an'dii.
Kyekà, Bɛtanya làkäl tsütsü a Yɛlusàlɛm, kà isii a an'kilɔmɛtre an'tär.
Ayudà bàyi mbɔɔn muyàlɛɛl Màlye anà Màlatà ntɔn nkweel a baal aba Lazar.
Umpal kàwem Màlatà naa Yɛsu wàmuyà, nde kàkàbwey anà nde, wɛɛ Màlye kàsàsal u ndwà wàŋàbwaay.
Màlatà kàtɛn a Yɛsu naa: «Mwol, ilàkal naa ngye akäl apà, baal amɛ kàlàkwà anki!
Wɛɛ mɛ, mɛ in'kyàyöb, itàkal apanà, naa undiir wanswà ayàlɔm ngye akà Nzam, Nzam akyer ayapà.»
Yɛsu kàtɛn a nde naa: «Baal angye akyer ayàwiyà.»
Màlatà kàfuur naa: «Mɛ in'kyàyöb naa nde asàkyer awiyà mbwo mwɛy a akü, kà ilä a ntsüü.»
Yɛsu kàtɛn a nde naa: «Mɛ, mɛ in'wà ngwiiyà anà mɔ̈ɔ̈. Mbuur wanswà an'sà làkwikilà amu mɛ asàkal anà mɔ̈ɔ̈, itàkal naa nde kan'kwà.
Mbuur wanswà awe anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ anà an'sà làkwikilà amu mɛ, nde usàkwà anki akà ikikye. Nkye ngye an'sà làkwikilà?» -
Nde kàfuur naa: «Inye, Mwol, mɛ an'sà làkwikilà naa ngye awà Klistɔ, Mwan a Nzam awasàyà pà u mɛɛn.»
Apan, Màlatà kàkàbel mpääŋ ande Màlye, waa kun'kyään unsinsi naa: «Un'lɔɔŋ kan'yà, nde sye wàmukabeelà.»
Pa kàwem Màlye abà, laa kàmbarà nde, kàkyen u ntiin akà Yɛsu.
Kyekà, Yɛsu kàkäl anki aŋàtàbilà uboo a bul, wɛɛ nde kàtàfàkal kà ikal kàkun'taan Màlatà.
Ayudà bàkäl anà Màlye u ndwà ntɔn mukun'lɛɛl, mpal bun'mɛn ba kan'barà anà kan'too u ntiin, laa bun'läb ba. Ntɔn ba bàsii naa nde wàmukyà an'dii mukàlel.
Umpal kàkɔlà Màlye kà ikal kàkäl Yɛsu, pa kun'mɛn nde, nde kàbü kà in'kɔl ande, waa kàtɛn a nde naa: «Mwol, ilàkal naa ngye akäl apà, baal amɛ kàlàkwà anki.»
Utaaŋ kàmɛn Yɛsu Màlatà anà Ayudà bàkäl anà nde bàmulel, mpem ande yàkyer atɛɛr, lingyoomà làkyer un'wal.
Nde waa kafuul naa: «Wa bɛ lun'tɔ̈ɔ̈l ken?» Ba bun'fuur naa: «Mwol, yamɛn.»
Yɛsu waa kàlel.
Abun, Ayudà bàtɛɛnà naa: «Làler naa nde kàfun'kwenà aben!»
Wɛɛ amwɛy uboo a ba bàtɛn naa: «Nde mbuur kàkɔɔr ikwàmii, nkye nde kàlàkyer anki sye naa Lazar ukɔ̈ɔ̈n akwà?»
Apan, Yɛsu kàfàtɛɛr u mpem ande, waa kàkyen an'dii, ma màkäl mɔɔ aŋàdübà a nkɔŋ.
Apan, Yɛsu kàtɛn naa: «Làlwom nkɔŋ yi.» Màlatà, mpääŋ a un'kü, kàtɛn a nde naa: «Mwol, apanà nde ayàkal aŋàfuurà nsɔŋ, ntɔn ŋàbà ilä inà awà nde apà.»
Wɛɛ Yɛsu kun'fuur naa: «Nkye mɛ in'tɛn anki a ngye naa isàkal naa ngye awe anà làkwikilà, ngye ayàman làkoo a Nzam?»
Abun, ba waa bàlwom nkɔŋ. Apan, Yɛsu kàler u du, waa kàtɛn naa: «Taa, mɛ amafuur an'tɔɔn ntɔn aman'wem ngye.
Ndandaa, mɛ in'kyàyöb naa ngye afàkyer an'wem taaŋ lanswà. Wɛɛ an'tɛn mɛ abà, ntɔn baar bàman'diŋà bà bàyöb naa ngye kan'töm.»
Ungö mutɛn abà, nde kàbel u ndaa a ngwal naa: «Lazar, yatoo!»
Un'kü sye waa kàyàtoo, in'kɔl anà an'kɔɔ myàŋàlàlal a ikaam a ipfɛy anà ntabwey yàŋàfwe a ipfɛy. Yɛsu kàtɛn a baar naa: «Lun'tsuuŋ, lun'wɛy ukyen.»
Apan, bàmbɔɔn uboo a Ayudà bàyi akà Màlye anà bàmɛn indiir kàkyer Yɛsu, ba bun'si làkwikilà.
Wɛɛ bumwɛy bàkàman Amfarisi, waa bakyään indiir kàkyer Yɛsu.
Apan, amfum a angaŋ anà Amfarisi bàköŋà làbay a nsaŋ a kölàköl, waa bàtɛn naa: «Ininà bi kan'kwo mukyer? Ntɔn baal wà wàmukyer idiim mbɔɔn!
Isàkal naa bi kàmuwɛy musin akyer abà, baar banswà bàyun'sà làkwikilà. Apan, Bàlɔmà bàyàyà mupay ndwà a Nzam abi anà nsi abi!»
Umwɛy uboo aba, ikɔb ande Kayifa, kàkäl undweer a angaŋ u mbul awun, nde kàtɛn a ba naa: «Bɛ, bɛ akà undiir mwɛy làkayöbà anki!
Nkye bɛ làmanà anki naa yubwaŋ naa mbuur mwɛy ukü ntɔn un'sɛŋ, waa nsi yanswà mpa ikyà bwà?»
Kyekà, nde kàtɛɛnà anki abà unsà ukwen ande ŋakwo, wɛɛ ntɔn kàkäl nde undweer a ngaŋ u mbul awun, nde kàtɛɛ ngɔɔm naa Yɛsu akyer asàkwà ntɔn un'sɛŋ ande,
kànà ntɔn un'sɛŋ mpɛl anki, wɛɛ sye ntɔn mutüüb baan a Nzam abà bàtɛ upay.
Fà ilä akin, amfum a Ayudà bàtsül mbar naa bàdwa Yɛsu.

Undiir awun, Yɛsu mpa kàfàfilyaaŋà nde kà imɛɛy u mii a amfum a Ayudà: nde kàkyen u mpey, kà itiir a nsi mwɛy tsütsü a nsye a ipɔl, u bul mwɛy ikɔb a la Ɛfalayimi, waa kàbwaay kwo anà alɔŋki ande.
Un'kyɔm a Pak a Ayudà kàkäl tsütsü. Baar mbɔɔn bàfwee kà itiir a nsi aki bàbeenà Yɛlusàlɛm kusà a un'kyɔm mukwo, ntɔn mukàpöŋ ndür.
Ba bàkäl muleŋà Yɛsu, wɛɛ umpal bàkäl ba u Ndwà a Nzam, ba bàtɛɛnà ba a ba naa: «Bɛ làsii aben? Nkye nde uyà anki un'kyɔm?»
Kyekà, andweer a angaŋ anà Amfarisi bàpɛ nswɛɛŋ naa: isàkal naa mbuur kan'yöb ikal awà nde, nde kakyään ntɔn ba bun'kör.
Ilä isyaam kusà a Pak mukwo, Yɛsu kàkyen Bɛtanya, kà ikal kàfakalà Lazar akwà kàwiiy nde uboo a akü.
Akun, Màlatà kun'pɛ isaa bun'lääm ba. Lazar kàkäl umwɛy uboo a baar bàkäl mbwo mwɛy anà Yɛsu mudyà u mɛsà.
Màlye kàwɛl boboo a litre mwɛy là may a usɔŋ màndandaa, màntal a mbɔɔn, nde kàsir ma kà in'kɔl a Yɛsu. Ungö waa kàkɔɔmà ma a ntswe ande. Apan, ndwà yanswà yàtiimà a usɔŋ a may.
Ungö apan, Yudasi Isikalyɔt - umwɛy uboo a alɔŋki ande, nde mbuur awayun'yälà, - kàtɛn naa:
«Ntɔn nkye mpa bàyälà ba may a usɔŋ amà unsà nkam tär yà itɛr a ngim, waa bàlàpà ya akà aŋàlàmbwà?»
Kàtɛɛnà nde abà, kà ntɔn nde kàkäl anà ngyɛb a aŋàlàmbwà anki, wɛɛ ntɔn nde kàkäl mbüüb: nde kàfakaarà bɔ̈ɔ̈n a ngim, waa kàfalwabà ngim bàsyee uboo mwo.
Apan, Yɛsu kàtɛn naa: «Un'si a duu! Kan'kyer nde abà, nde kan'tsweel kusà ntɔn ilä bàsan'dye.
Bɛ làwe anà aŋàlàmbwà ilä byanswà, wɛɛ mɛ, bɛ làbye anki anà mɛ ilä byanswà.»
Apan, un'sɛŋ a Ayudà mbɔɔn kàwem wa naa Yɛsu kàkäl u Bɛtanya, wa kàkyeenà kwo, kà nà ntɔn Yɛsu mpɛl anki, wɛɛ sye ntɔn mukàman Lazar akwà kàwiiy nde uboo a akü.
Apan, andweer a angaŋ bàdirà mudwa Lazar sye,
ntɔn Ayudà mbɔɔn bàtiinà Ikööŋ aba, waa bàsyee làkwikilà akà Yɛsu isin nà Lazar.
U taaŋtye, iköŋ a baar mbɔɔn akwà bàyi un'kyɔm a Pak, kyàwem naa Yɛsu wàmuyàbeenà Yɛlusàlɛm.
Ba bàwɛl an'laaŋ a an'bà, bàkyen mukàbwey anà nde, bàmuyisà in'kwɛŋ naa: «Ɔsana! Wɛy ukäl aŋàsaak mbuur awà ayà kà ikɔb a Mwol, Mfum a Isàlɛl.»
Yɛsu kàmɛn mwan a anɛ, waa kàbwaay udu a wa, asànaa ikyäänà Ndaa Aŋàsɔn naa:
«Bul a Siyɔn, twon an'man bɔɔmà! Le, Mfum angye wàmuyà, akyàbwaay udu a mwan a anɛ.»
U nsɛmà, alɔŋki ande bàkayöbà anki indiir abi. Wɛɛ umpal kàwɛl Yɛsu làkoo, apan ba bàyɔbà naa indiir abi bàsön ntɔn nde anà ba bya sye bàkyer ntɔn nde.
Baar banswà bàkäl anà Yɛsu mpal kàbel nde Lazar muyàtoo kà an'dii anà kun'wiiy nde uboo a akü, bun'tɛɛlà imbäl.
Kyakin, iköŋ a baar kyàkàbwey kya anà nde, ntɔn kya kyàwem naa nde kàkyer impà akin.
Apan, Amfarisi bàtɛn ba a ba naa: «Bɛ lan'man naa bɛ akà undiir làyàwal anki: le, baar banswà bàmun'lab!»
Yàmɛnà naa uboo a baar bàbeenà Yɛlusàlɛm mukömà umpal a un'kyɔm, bàkäl anà Angɛlɛki amwɛy.
Ba bàsin apà Filipo, un'nsi Bɛtesayidà a Ngalilɛ, waa bun'lɔ̈ɔ̈m naa: «Un'lɔɔŋ, bi ikwen muman Yɛsu.»
Filipo kàkàsam Andrɛ, ungö, ba bàbɔ̈ɔ̈l waa bàkàsam Yɛsu.
Yɛsu kafuur naa: «Mpalabà taaŋ lan'kwo alà uwal Mwan a mbuur làkoo.
Ndandaa, ndandaa, mɛ alàkyään, isàkal naa imbɛŋ a blɛ kyan'bwà u mɛɛn ikü anki, kya ikal kya mpɛl aŋàyen. Wɛɛ, isàkal naa kya kyan'kwà, kya ibɔr mbɛŋ mbɔɔn.
Mbuur akwen mɔ̈ɔ̈ ande aŋàsɔ̈ɔ̈n Nzam, wa akyà bwà, wɛɛ mbuur asàkɔɔb mɔ̈ɔ̈ ande u mɛɛn pà, nde asàkaar wa mbul a in'tye.
Isàkal naa mbuur kan'kwen mukan'syääl, wɛy nde kan'läb. Ikal in'wà mɛ, un'syääl amɛ asàkal kwo sye. Isàkal naa mbuur kàman'syääl, Taa asun'pà làkoo.
