«Papanà mpem amɛ yan'too! Waa ininà mɛ in'tɛn? Taa, ntsü mɔ̈ɔ̈ utaaŋ alà? Wɛɛ kiin amɛ, mɛ kàyi ntɔn taaŋ a mpay a tub alà!
Taa, pà ikɔb angye làkoo!» Apan, ndaa yàfü du, yàtɛn naa: «Mɛ kàkyàpà kya làkoo, mɛ in'kyer ayàfàpà kya làkoo.»
Iköŋ a baar kyàkäl pa anà kyàwem ndaa, kyàtɛɛnà naa: «Ipar kyan'bwà!» Bumwɛy naa: «Un'kyeey mwɛy kàmusam!»
Yɛsu kakyään naa: «Ndaa ayi kà ban'tɛn a mɛ anki, wɛɛ ban'tɛn a bɛ.
Papanà là taaŋ mutsul nsaŋ a mɛɛn mà, papanà mfum a mɛɛn mà bàyun'tɔɔm u nsà.
Wɛɛ akà mɛ, mpal bàsan'sɛɛn u mɛɛn pà, mɛ in'sànaan baar banswà akà mɛ.»
Kàtɛɛnà nde abà, nde kàswɛŋà naa nkweel ande isàkal aben.
Iköŋ a baar kyun'fuur naa: «Bi, bi kàlɔŋàkà unsà Un'kɔɔn naa Klistɔ asàkal anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ ipepey. Aben ngye an'kwo mutɛn naa Mwan a mbuur bàkyer asun'sɛɛn? Nà Mwan a mbuur awà?»
Yɛsu kàtɛn a ba naa: «Pɛɛlà làfàkal anki anà taaŋ mbɔɔn uboo a bɛ. Làlyaaŋ umpal làbà bɛ anà pɛɛlà, ntɔn mpib ikɔ̈ɔ̈n alabweel. Ntɔn mbuur afilyaaŋ u mpib, nde uyöb anki naa nde akyà ken.
Kyakin, mpal làbà bɛ anà pɛɛlà, làsi làkwikilà amu pɛɛlà, ntɔn bɛ làbulà baan a pɛɛlà.» Ungö kàsam nde ba abà, Yɛsu kàlwomà paa, waa kàkàyee ukwɛl apà ba.
Itàkal naa nde kàkyerà idiim mbɔɔn u mii a ba, ba bàsun'sà anki làkwikilà.
Abun yàkwe ndaa kàtɛn ŋangɔɔm Yɛsay: «Mwol, nà kàsi làkwikilà akà an'lɔɔŋ abi? Mwol ngwal ande kàswɛŋ akà nà?»
Yɛsay awà kàswɛŋ sye isin a ndaa mpa bàkwe ba musà làkwikilà:
«Nzam kàdwä mii aba, nde kàbuul mpem aba bwoor, ntɔn mii aba ikɔ̈ɔ̈n atääl, naa mpem aba ikɔ̈ɔ̈n ayöb, ntɔn ba bàkɔ̈ɔ̈n asàfyefurà akà mɛ ntɔn mɛ akɔɔr.»
Yɛsay kàtɛn nde indiir abi, ntɔn kàmɛn nde làkoo a Yɛsu, waa kàsam ntɔn nde.
Apanà sye, bàmbɔɔn uboo a amfum a Ayudà ŋakwo bàsi làkwikilà amu nde. Wɛɛ, ntɔn Amfarisi, ba bàkyey anki u mii a baar manà bàyatwey u ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà.
Ntɔn ba bàkwen làkoo lan'fà akà baar, akwànaa lan'fà akà Nzam.
Yɛsu kàsi un'kwɛŋ: «Mbuur asà làkwikilà amu mɛ, kà amu mɛ mpɛl anki nde kan'sà làkwikilà, wɛɛ amu mbuur kan'töm sye.
Mbuur aman'man, nde kan'man sye mbuur kan'töm.
Mɛ pɛɛlà, mɛ kàyi u mɛɛn, ntɔn mbuur wanswà asà làkwikilà amu mɛ, ukɔ̈ɔ̈n akal uboo a mpib.
Isàkal naa mbuur kan'wem ndaa amɛ, wɛ nde ya ufàsyääl anki, kà mɛ anki in'sàtsul nsaŋ ande, ntɔn mɛ kàyi anki mutsul nsaŋ a mɛɛn, wɛɛ ntɔn mukun'tswà mɔ̈ɔ̈.
Mbuur atɔn mɛ anà akɔ̈ɔ̈n akyey ndaa amɛ, nde we anà un'tsüül a nsaŋ ande: an'lɔɔŋ kàpɛɛ mɛ isun'tsüül mbar kà ilä a ntsüü.
Ntɔn mɛ kàtɛn anki unsà ukwen amɛ ŋakwo, wɛɛ Taa, mbuur kan'töm, kan'swɛŋ nde ŋakwo naa ininà mɛ in'tɛn, ininà mɛ in'kyään.
Waa mɛ in'kyàyöb naa nswɛɛŋ ande ifàpà mɔ̈ɔ̈ a mbul a in'tye. Kyakin indiir an'tɛn mɛ, mɛ bya an'tɛn asànaa kan'swɛŋ Taa.»
Yàmɛnà naa kusà a un'kyɔm a Pak, Yɛsu kàkyer ayöb naa taaŋ ande lan'kwo, taaŋ ntɔn mulwomà u mɛɛn pà anà mukyà akà Taa. Nde kàkwen bànde abà u mɛɛn pà, nde kakwen aŋàsöönà.
Kyekà, umpal bàkäl ba mudyà làsisye, ileŋ kàkyàbiil itaan an'kyän u mpem a Yudasi, mwan a Simɔn Isikalyɔt, ntɔn mukun'yälà.
Yɛsu kàyöbà naa indiir byanswà Taa kàpɛ kà an'kɔɔ ande, naa nde kàtoo amu Nzam, nde wàmufurà akà Nzam.
Yɛsu kàmbarà u mɛsà, kàlwom ipfey adu ande, waa kàwɛl làpye, kàbäm la u lɔŋ.
Ungö, nde kàsi an'dà u làlɔŋà, waa kàsɛmà muywɛy in'kɔl a alɔŋki ande, waa kàkɔɔmà mya a làpye kàbäm nde u lɔŋ.
Apan, kan'yàtol nde akà Simɔn Petɔlà, nde waa utɛn a nde naa: «Mwol, ngye, an'ywɛy in'kɔl!»
Yɛsu waa kun'fuur naa: «Undiir in'kyer mɛ wà, ngye wa ayöb anki apanà, wɛɛ ngye wa asàyöb ungö.»
Petɔlà kàtɛn a nde naa: «Aay, ngye mɛ in'kɔl an'ywɛy anki akà ikikye!» Yɛsu kun'fuur naa: «Isàkal naa mɛ mya aywɛy anki, ngye un'tüüb anà mɛ watɛy.»
Simɔn Petɔlà kàtɛn a nde naa: «Mwol, isàkal abwɛy, twon aman'ywɛy nà in'kɔl mpɛl, wɛɛ anà an'kɔɔ anà un'tswe sye!»
Yɛsu kàtɛn a nde naa: «Mbuur aŋàywab, nde mfun afàywab yatɛy, ntɔn ndür ande yanswà yàŋàpɔŋà. Bɛ, bɛ làbà aŋàpɔŋà, wɛɛ kà bɛ banswà anki.»
Nde kàkyer ayöb ubwaŋàbwaŋ naa nà kàlun'yälà, undiir awun kàtɛn nde naa: «Kà bɛ banswà anki làbà aŋàpɔŋà.»
Ungö kaywɛy nde in'kɔl, Yɛsu kàfàbwaar ipfɛy adu ande, nde kàfurà u mɛsà, waa kàtɛn a ba naa: «Nkye bɛ lan'yöb undiir amàlakyer mɛ?
Bɛ, bɛ làfan'bel "Un'lɔɔŋ" anà "Mwol", bɛ làbye anà iböŋ, ntɔn mɛ in'wà nde.
Abun, isàkal naa mɛ Mwol anà Un'lɔɔŋ, mɛ amàlaywɛy in'kɔl, wɛy bɛ, bɛ sye làywɛy in'kɔl bɛ a bɛ.
Mɛ amàlapà mbaan, ntɔn bɛ sye làkyer asànaa amàlakyer mɛ là.
Ndandaa, ndandaa, mɛ alàkyään: un'syääl ukwe anki ulyaaŋ nkum ande, itàkal naa ntööm ulyaaŋ mbuur kun'töm.
Isàkal naa bɛ lan'yöb indiir abi, bɛ làbà aŋun'sak isàkal naa bɛ lan'syääl bya.
Mɛ, mɛ in'tɛn anki ntɔn bɛ banswà, ntɔn mɛ in'kyàyöb baar kàsɔ̈ɔ̈l mɛ. Wɛɛ, wɛy Ndaa Aŋàsɔn ikwe: "Mbuur kàdyee làmpà anà mɛ, kàman'diŋà làkɔl mbaar."
Apanà, mɛ amàlakyään kusà a ndaa ayi muyà, ntɔn, umpal iyàyà ya, waa bɛ làyàsà làkwikilà naa "Mɛ In'wà".
Ndandaa, ndandaa mɛ alàsam: mbuur wanswà awal mbuur an'tɔm mɛ, nde kàman'wal sye. Mbuur kàman'wal, nde kan'wal sye mbuur kan'töm.»
Ungö mutɛn indiir abi, mpem a Yɛsu kàkyer ayɔɔ, waa kàtɛ imbäl ki: «Ndandaa, ndandaa mɛ alàkyään, umwɛy uboo abɛ akyer ayan'yälà.»
Apan, alɔŋki bàleerà ba a ba u mii, ukɔɔn ayöb naa nde atɛɛnà ntɔn nà.
Umwɛy uboo a alɔŋki, awà kàfakweenà Yɛsu, kàkäl ukɔl a nde.
Apan, Simɔn Petɔlà kun'bɛl imbweer: «Un'fuul, nde atɛɛnà ntɔn nà.»
Ungö, un'lɔŋki awà kàkàyiir kà itɔl a Yɛsu, waa kun'fuul naa: «Mwol, nà wa?»
Yɛsu kàfuur naa: «Mbuur awà in'yàpà mɛ itiir a làmpà in'yàdümà mɛ.» Apan sye, Yɛsu kàwɛl itiir a làmpà, kàdümà kya, waa kàpɛ kya akà Yudasi, mwan a Simɔn Isikalyɔt.
Pa kàyä Yudasi itiir a mampà kya, Satanà laa kun'bilà nde. Yɛsu kàtɛn a nde naa: «Yudasi, undiir awà ngye awà mukyer, kyer wa agyägyä!»
Baar bàkäl u mɛsà bàyöb anki, akà mbuur mwɛy, naa ntɔn nkye Yɛsu kun'kyään nde abwɛy.
Bàmbɔɔn bàsii naa ntɔn bɔ̈ɔ̈n a ngim làkälà a Yudasi, undiir awun Yɛsu kun'swɛŋ nde naa nde ukyen mukàsom indiir byàkäl mfun ntɔn un'kyɔm, itàkal naa mupà an'kab akà aŋàlàmbwà.
Pa kàwɛl Yudasi itiir a làmpà, nde kàtoo agyägyä. Làpib làkäl aŋàbwà.
Apan, ungö a ntoo a Yudasi, Yɛsu kàtɛn naa: «Apanà, làkoo a Mwan a mbuur lan'mɛnà, làkoo a Nzam sye lan'mɛnà amu nde.
[Isàkal naa làkoo a Nzam lan'mɛnà amu nde,] itaan a mbɔɔn tɛy, Nzam sye asàmɛɛy làkoo a Mwan amu nde ŋakwo.
Baan amɛ, mɛ in'fàsaal anki anà taaŋ mbɔɔn mukal anà bɛ. Bɛ, bɛ làkyer asan'leŋ, asànaa kàtɛn mɛ a amfum a Ayudà: "bɛ, bɛ làkwo anki muyà u mper ayà in'kyà mɛ", mɛ in'tɛn a bɛ sye apanà.
Mɛ amàlapà nswɛɛŋ akün: làkäl anà ukwen bɛ a bɛ. Asànaa kàlakwen mɛ, wɛy bɛ sye làkäl anà ukwen bɛ a bɛ.
Isàkal naa bɛ lan'kwen bɛ a bɛ, apan, baar banswà bàsàyöb naa bɛ làbà alɔŋki amɛ.»
Simɔn Petɔlà kàfuul Yɛsu naa: «Mwol, ngye ken akyà?» Yɛsu kun'fuur naa: «Apanà, ngye akwo anki muyà mper in'kyà mɛ, wɛɛ ngye asan'lab ungöngö.»
Petɔlà naa: «Mwol, ntɔn nkye mpa in'kwo mɛ muyalab apanà? Mɛ, mɛ an'kyey mupà mɔ̈ɔ̈ amɛ ntɔn ngye!»
Yɛsu naa: «Akɔɔb mɔ̈ɔ̈ angye ntɔn mɛ! Ndandaa, ndandaa, mɛ akyään, nkɔɔ mwɛy uyàtàkal aŋàbel anki, ayan'tɔn ngye mbalà tär.»
Yɛsu kan'tɛn naa: «Wɛy mpem abɛ ikɔ̈ɔ̈n akyɛɛr. Làsi làkwikilà amu Nzam, làsi làkwinkilà sye amu mɛ.
U ndwà a Taaràmɛ ikal byà mbɔɔn. Kya ilàkɔɔn akal abwɛy, mɛ in'làlakyään anki: Mɛ amàkàlalɔ̈ɔ̈n ikal.
Umpal in'sàkyà mɛ mukàlalɔ̈ɔ̈n ikal, mɛ insàfyefurà muyàlawal, ntɔn ikal in'wà mɛ, bɛ sye làkäl paa.
Mɛ, ntsü in'kyà mɛ, bɛ làkyàyöb mbwo.»
Tuma kàtɛn a nde naa: «Mwol, bi iyöb anki mper akyà ngye. Bi ban'kwo muyöb aben mbwo a ya?»
Yɛsu kun'fuur naa: «Mɛ, mɛ in'wà mbwo, ndandaa anà mɔ̈ɔ̈. Mbuur ukwo anki mukyà akà Taa ukɔɔn alyaaŋ u mbwo amɛ.
Ilàkal naa bɛ lan'yöb, bɛ làlàyöb sye Taaràmɛ. Fà apanà, bɛ làmun'yöb, bɛ làmun'man.»
Filipo kàtɛn a nde naa: «Mwol, iswɛŋ Taa, waa ya ikwo akà bi.»
Yɛsu kun'fuur naa: «Filipo, mɛ an'kal anà bɛ taaŋ mbɔɔn, wɛɛ ngye ŋàtan'yöb anki? Mbuur kàman'man, kan'man Taa. Ntɔn nkye an'tɛn ngye naa: "Iswɛŋ Taa"?
Làsi làkwikilà naa mɛ in'wà amu Taa, naa nde wà amu mɛ. Ndaa in'fàtɛn mɛ a bɛ banswà, kà mɛ ŋakwo in'fàbɔn anki, Taa awà amu mɛ afàkyer isal ande ŋakwo.
Làsi làkwikilà naa mɛ in'wà amu Taa, naa Taa wà amu mɛ. Naa tɛy, làsi làkwikilà ntɔn isal abi.
Ndandaa, ndandaa, mɛ alàkyään: mbuur awe anà làkwikilà amu mɛ, nde sye, nde asàkyer isal in'fàkyer mɛ. Nde asàkyer byàŋàsöön, ntɔn mɛ in'wàmukyà akà Taa.
Undiir wanswà làsàlɔm bɛ kà ikɔb amɛ, mɛ in'kyer asàkyer wa, ntɔn Taa uwɛl làkoo amu Mwan.
Isàkal naa bɛ lan'lɔm undiir mwɛy kà ikɔb amɛ, mɛ, mɛ in'kyer asàkyer wa.
«Isàkal naa bɛ làman'kwen, bɛ làsàsyääl nswɛɛŋ amɛ.
Waa mɛ, mɛ in'sàbɔɔn Taa, waa nde usàlatööm un'lɛɛl asin ntɔn nde ukäl anà bɛ ilä byanswà:
Dweelà a ndandaa mpa ban'kwo baar a mɛɛn muwal, ntɔn ba bun'manà anki, ba bun'yöb anki. Wɛɛ bɛ, bɛ làkyun'yöb, ntɔn nde wà apà bɛ, anà nde asakalà amu bɛ mbul a in'tye.
Mɛ in'sàlawɛy anki asànaa itii, mɛ in'kyer asàfyefurà akà bɛ.
Yan'saal ikikye, baar a mɛɛn bàsan'man anki, wɛɛ bɛ, bɛ làkyer asan'man ntɔn mɛ in'wà wàmɔ̈ɔ̈ anà bɛ, bɛ làsàkal bàmɔ̈ɔ̈ sye.
Kà ilä akin, bɛ làsàyöb naa mɛ in'wà amu Taaràmɛ, naa bɛ làbà amu mɛ anà mɛ in'wà amu bɛ.
«Mbuur awe anà nswɛɛŋ amɛ anà afàsyääl ya, wawun mbuur afan'kwen. Kyeka mbuur afan'kwen, Taa asàkyer un'kwen, mɛ sye in'kyer asun'kwen, waa mɛ ŋakwo in'sàmɛnà akà nde.»
Yudasi - kà Yudas mwan a Isikalyɔt anki - kun'fuul naa: «Mwol, ya yà aben naa ngye akyer asyemɛɛy akà bi, wɛɛ kà akà baar a mɛɛn mà anki?»
Yɛsu kun'fuur naa: «Isàkal naa mbuur mwɛy kàman'kwen, nde asàkaar ndaa amɛ, Taaràmɛ akyer asun'kwen. Bi isàyà akà nde, waa isàbwaay amu nde.
Mbuur mpa kan'kwen, ufàkyey anki ndaa amɛ. Ndaa lan'wem bɛ yi, kàyan'fà akà mɛ anki, wɛɛ yà Taa mbuur kan'töm.
Indiir abi, mɛ bya amàlakyään utaaŋ in'wà mɛ anà bɛ.
Dweelà In'kyɛɛl, un'lɛɛl, usàtɔm Taa kà ikɔb amɛ, nde asàlalɔŋ indiir byanswà, waa usàlayɔɔb ndaa yanswà kàtɛn mɛ a bɛ.
«Mɛ amàsàlawɛy duu, mɛ amàlapà duu amɛ. Mɛ la alapà anki asànaa bàfàpà baar a mɛɛn. Wɛy mpem a bɛ ikɔ̈ɔ̈n akyɛɛr, ikɔ̈ɔ̈n atɛɛr.
Bɛ làkyàwem, mɛ kàtɛn a bɛ naa: "Mɛ an'kyà anà mɛ in'kyer asàfyefurà akà bɛ". Yàlàkal naa bɛ làfàkyer an'kwen, bɛ làlàkal unsà un'sak ntɔn in'kyà mɛ akà Taa, ntɔn Taa kàman'söön.
Mɛ amàlawey indiir abi apanà, kusà a bya muyà, ntɔn umpal isàyà bya, waa bɛ làsàsà làkwikilà.
Mɛ in'sàfàyääm anki mbɔɔn anà bɛ, ntɔn mfum a mɛɛn mà wàmuyà. Itàkal abun, nde ikɔ̈b mwɛy kyatɛy udu a mɛ,
wɛɛ, ntɔn naa mɛɛn màyöb naa mɛ in'kwen Taa, anà mɛ in'fàkyer nswɛɛŋ kan'pɛ Taa. Làmbarà, tsweenà!
«Mɛ, mɛ in'wà un'te a vin a ndandaa, Taaràmɛ wà ŋawa.
Nde afàtsul kɔkà lanswà alà amu mɛ anà mpa làfàtwà, wɛɛ nde afàsaal la akwà làfàtwà, ntɔn la làbör mbɛŋ asin mbɔɔn.
Bɛ, bɛ làbà aŋàpɔŋà itaan ntɔn ndaa kàlakyään mɛ.

Làkäl amu mɛ, asànaa in'wà mɛ amu bɛ. Akà kɔkà làmwɛy làkwe anki mubɔr mbɛŋ la ŋakwo isàkal naa la kà là aŋànääm anki a mbiim a un'te, itàkal bɛ sye, bɛ làkwo anki mubɔr mbɛŋ, isàkal naa bɛ, bɛ làbà anki amu mɛ.
Mɛ, mɛ in'wà mbiim a un'te a vin, bɛ, bɛ làbà an'kɔkà. Mbuur awà amu mɛ, anà mɛ amu nde, nde afàbɔr mbɛŋ mbɔɔn. Ntɔn bɛ, bɛ làkwe anki mukyer akà undiir mwɛy ukɔɔn mɛ.
Mbuur mpa awà amu mɛ, nde wàŋàpiy u nsà, asànaa kɔkà, laa uyɔm nde. An'kɔkà aŋàyɔm bàkyer afàköŋà, bàtɔɔm u mbaa, waa ma ikuŋà.
Isàkal naa bɛ, bɛ làbà amu mɛ, ndaa amɛ sye yà amu bɛ, bɛ làsàlɔm undiir wanswà làsàkwen bɛ, bɛ làsàwal wa.
Ndaa ifàpà Taaràmɛ làkoo yà naa bɛ làbɔ̈r mbɛŋ mbɔɔn, waa bɛ làsàkal alɔŋki amɛ.
Abun, asànaa kan'kwen Taa, mɛ sye amàlakwen. Làkäl uboo a ukwen amɛ.
Isàkal naa bɛ làfàsyääl nswɛɛŋ amɛ, bɛ làbà uboo a ukwen amɛ, asànaa kàkwey mɛ nswɛɛŋ a Taaràmɛ, mɛ in'wà uboo a ukwen ande.»
«An'tɛn mɛ a bɛ abà, ntɔn un'sak amɛ ukäl uboo abɛ, anà wa sye ukäl wàŋàkwo.
Le nswɛɛŋ amɛ ayi: làkwen bɛ a bɛ asànaa in'fàlakwen mɛ.
Kà we anà mbuur mwɛy anki awe anà ukwen a kölàköl isàkɔɔn akal asànaa mukɔɔb mɔ̈ɔ̈ ande ntɔn asam ande.
Bɛ làbasam amɛ isàkal naa bɛ làfàkyer indiir in'fàlàswaŋ mɛ.
Mɛ alàbel anki asyääl, ntɔn un'syääl uyöb anki ayufàkyer nkum ande. Wɛɛ mɛ, mɛ alabel asam, ntɔn ndaa yanswà kàwem mɛ akà Taaràmɛ, mɛ ya akyàlaswaŋ.
Kà bɛ anki lan'sɔ̈ɔ̈l, mɛ kàlasɔ̈ɔ̈l, mɛ kàlasi ntɔn bɛ làkyen, làbör mbɛŋ, waa mbɛŋ abɛ ilam. Abun, undiir wanswà làsàlɔm bɛ akà Taa kikɔb amɛ, nde akyer asàlapà wa.
Undiir alàswaŋ mɛ awà: làkwen bɛ a bɛ.»
«Isàkal naa mɛɛn mà màmàlayiiŋ, làyöb naa mɛ in'wà mbuur atàtwɛb kàyiiŋ ma.
Ilàkal naa bɛ làkäl baar a mɛɛn, mɛɛn ikyer alàlakwen ntɔn bɛ làbà baar ama. Wɛɛ bɛ kà làbà baar ande anki: ntɔn kàlasi mɛ ukɔl, undiir awun mɛɛn màlayiiŋ ma.
Làyɔbà ndaa kàlakyään mɛ: "Un'lɔŋki ukwe anki ulyaŋ un'lɔɔŋ ande." Isàkal naa ba mɛ ban'mɛɛy nkwaaŋ, ba bɛ sye bàsàlamɛɛy nkwaaŋ. Isàkal naa ba bàkäär ndaa amɛ, ba bàsàkaar sye yàbɛ.
Wɛɛ indiir abi byanswà ba bàsàlakyer ntɔn ikɔb amɛ, ntɔn ba bàyöb anki mbuur kan'töm.
Ilàkal naa mɛ in'kɔ̈ɔ̈n ayà anà in'kɔ̈ɔ̈n akakyään, ba bàlàkal anki anà man'be. Wɛɛ apanà, ba undiir afàkur watɛy ntɔn man'be aba.
Mbuur kàman'yiiŋ, nde kan'yiiŋ sye Taaràmɛ.
Ilàkal naa mɛ in'kɔ̈ɔ̈n akàkyer isal abi uboboo a ba, isal mpa kàkwe mbuur asin mukyer, ba bàlàkal anki anà man'be. Apanà ba bàkyàman bya, wɛɛ ba bàmufiyiiŋ, mɛ anà Taaràmɛ.
Wɛɛ ya yà ntɔn ndaa bàsön uboo un'kɔɔn aba ikwe: "Ba ban'yiiŋ abunàbun."»
«Mpal usàyà un'lɛɛl in'sàlatööm mɛ kà ikɔb a Taa, Dweelà a ndandaa lan'fà akà Taa, nde asan'tɛɛl imbäl.
Anà bɛ sye, bɛ làsan'tɛɛl imbäl, ntɔn bɛ làbà anà mɛ fà nsɛmà.»
«Kàlakyään mɛ indiir abi, ntɔn bɛ làkɔ̈ɔ̈n abwiy làkwikilà abɛ.
Bàkyer asàlaböŋ u ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà. Yumwɛy ayi: taaŋ làmuyà, mbuur asàladwa asàsi naa nde wàmupà ibɔɔn akà Nzam.
Bàsàkyer ba abà, ntɔn ba bàyöb anki itàkal Taa, itàkal mɛ.
Wɛɛ kàlayäm mɛ indiir abi, ntɔn umpal làsàkwo taaŋ, bɛ, bɛ làsàyɔbà naa mɛ, mɛ kàkyàlayäm ya. «Mɛɛ ya kàlasam anki fà nsɛmà, ntɔn mɛ kàkälà anà bɛ.
Apanà, mɛ in'wàmukyà akà mbuur kan'töm, wɛɛ akà mwɛy uboo a bɛ kan'fuul anki naa: "Ngye ken akyà?"
Wɛɛ, ntɔn amàlasam mɛ abà, undiir awun mpem abɛ yan'yɔl ya a ngyɛb.

Mpalabà, mɛ amàlasam ubwaŋàbwaŋ: yan'söön mfun akà bɛ naa mɛ, mɛ in'kyen. Wɛɛ kya mɛ impàkyà anki, un'lɛɛl akwà alàyà mukàlabay, uyàfàyà anki akà bɛ. Wɛɛ isàkal naa mɛ an'kyà, mɛ in'kyer asàlatööm awà.
Waa mpal usàyà nde, nde asàswaŋ ubwaŋàbwaŋ muyöb man'be aba, balàbal anà nsaŋ a Nzam.
U ndaa iler man'be, ntɔn ba bàfàsà anki làkwikilà amu mɛ,
u ndaa iler balàbal, ntɔn mɛ in'kyà akà Taa anà bɛ làfàsan'man anki,
u ndaa iler nsaŋ, mfum afàyaal mɛɛn bàyun'tsüül nsaŋ.»
«Mɛ, mɛ in'we anà indiir mbɔɔn mukàlasam, wɛɛ papanà bɛ làkwo anki mukaar bya u mpem abɛ.
Utaaŋ usàyà Dweelà a ndandaa, nde asàlatwaal unsà ndandaa yanswà. Ntɔn nde usàtɛn anki kà ukwen ande ŋakwo, nde asàtɛn ndaa yanswà usàwem nde anà asàkyään ndaa yanswà isàyà.
Nde asan'sà làkoo, ntɔn nde asàwal ndaa amɛ, waa usàlakyään ya.
Indiir byanswà abyà byàtaa, bya sye byà byàmɛ. Undiir awun in'tɛn mɛ naa Dweelà asàwal unsà byàmɛ, waa usàlakyään bya.
«Itaan a mbɔɔn tɛy, bɛ làsàfan'man anki, apan sye, ungö a taaŋ ikikye, bɛ làkyer asàfan'man.»

Apan, amwɛy uboo a alɔŋki ande bàtɛɛnà ba a ba naa: «Ininà nde ukwen mutɛn a bi naa: "Itaan a mbɔɔn tɛy, bɛ làfàsan'man anki, apan sye, ungö a taaŋ ikikye, làkyer afàsan'man", anà sye: "Ntɔn mɛ in'kyà akà Taa"?
Taaŋ ikikye utɛɛnà nde ikaswaŋà aben? Bi ikayöbà anki naa ininà nde utɛɛnà!»

Yɛsu kàyöb nde naa ba bàkwen mukun'fuul, waa kàtɛn a ba naa: «Bɛ làbàmuleŋ uboo a bɛ muyöb naa mɛ ininà in'kwen mutɛn: "Itaan a mbɔɔn tɛy, bɛ làfàsan'man anki, apan sye, ungö a taaŋ ikikye, bɛ làkyer afàsan'man."
Ndandaa, ndandaa, mɛ alàkyään, bɛ, bɛ làkyer asàlel anà làsàsà un'saabà, mpal isàkal mɛɛn musaŋ. Bɛ làsàkal u ngyɛb, wɛɛ ngyɛb abɛ isàbulà un'sak.
Umpal ufàkal un'kaar anà in'swaŋ, mpem ande ifàkal udu udu ntɔn taaŋ ande lan'kwo. Wɛɛ isàkal naa nde kan'bɔr, nde afàdiimà usaay abà banswà, waa usaŋ ntɔn kan'bɔr nde mwan.
Lalan ŋàbawà bɛ làbà u ngyɛb mbɔɔn. Wɛɛ mɛ, mɛ in'kyer afàsàlaman, mpem abɛ isàkal unsà un'sak, mbuur asàladuum wa watɛy.
«Abun, ilä akin, akà undiir mwɛy bɛ làfàsan'fuul anki. Ndandaa, ndandaa, mɛ alàkyään, undiir wanswà làsàlɔm bɛ akà Taa, nde akyer asàlapà wa kà ikɔb amɛ.
Tii apanà, akà undiir mwɛy bɛ ŋàtàlɔm anki kà ikɔb amɛ. Làlɔ̈m, waa bɛ làsàwal, ntɔn un'sak abɛ ukàl wàŋàkwo.»
«Indiir abi mɛ kàtɛn a bɛ unsà nsim. Taaŋ làmuyà, alà mpa in'fàsàlasam mɛ abà, wɛɛ alà in'sàlakyään mɛ kà imɛɛy ndaa iler Taa.
Ilä akin, bɛ làsàlɔm akà Taa kà ikɔb amɛ, mɛ in'tɛn anki naa mɛ in'sàlalɔ̈ɔ̈m akà Taa,
ntɔn Taa akyàlakwen nde ŋakwo, ntɔn lan'kwen bɛ anà làsi bɛ làkwikilà naa mɛ kàfü akà Nzam.
Mɛ, mɛ kàtoo amu Taa, waa mɛ kàyi u mɛɛn. Apanà, mɛ in'wàmulwomà u mɛɛn anà mufurà akà Taa.»
Alɔŋki bàtɛn a nde naa: «Le, apanà ngye an'tɛn kà imɛɛy, ukɔɔn asyääl nsim.
Apanà bi kan'yöb naa ngye ayöb indiir byanswà, anà ngye mfun yatɛy naa mbuur kafuul ndaa. Undiir awun waa bi kan'sà làkwikilà naa ngye an'fà akà Nzam.»
Yɛsu kafuur naa: «Nkye apanà bɛ lan'sà làkwikilà?
Le, taaŋ làmuyà, apanà la lan'kwo, alà làsàtà bɛ upay, mbuur mbuur a mbwo ande, làsan'wɛy bɛ aŋàyen. Wɛɛ mɛ kà in'wà aŋàyen anki, ntɔn Taa wà anà mɛ.
Amàlakyään mɛ indiir abi ntɔn bɛ làkäl anà duu amu mɛ. Bɛ làbà uboo a lingyoomà u mɛɛn mà. Wɛɛ làkäl anà un'kanà, mɛ, mɛ mɛɛn akyun'wal iböŋ!»
Ungö kàtɛn nde abà, Yɛsu kàler u du, waa kàtɛn naa: «Taa, taaŋ lan'kwo, mɛɛy làkoo a Mwan angye, ntɔn nde sye umɛɛy làkoo angye.
Ngye kun'pɛ ikɔ̈b udu a baar banswà, ntɔn nde upɛ mɔ̈ɔ̈ a mbul a in'tye akà baar kun'pɛ ngye.
Wɛɛ mɔ̈ɔ̈ a mbul a in'tye wà naa ba bàyöb ngye mpɛl, Nzam a ndandaa, anà bàyöb Yɛsu Klistɔ, awà kàtöm ngye.
Mɛ, mɛ kàkyapà làkoo u mɛɛn. Mɛ akyàmay isal akyan'pɛ ngye mukyer.
Apanà, ngye, Taa, mpɛ làkoo akwà kàkäl mɛ alà akà ngye, kusà mɛɛn mukal.
Mɛ, mɛ ngye akyamɛɛy akà baar akwà kàtwey ngye u mɛɛn ntɔn mukan'pà. Ba bàkäl bàngye, waa ngye kan'mpɛ abà, waa ba bàkäär ndaa angye.
Apanà, ba ban'yöb naa indiir byanswà kan'mpɛ ngye, byan'fà akà ngye.
Ntɔn mɛ ba kapɛ ndaa kan'mpɛ ngye. Ba ya bàkyàwal. Ba bàkyàyöb ndandaa naa mɛ kàtoo amu ngye, waa ba bàsi làkwikilà naa ngye kan'töm.»
«Ngyamàkà amɛ yà ntɔn ba. Mɛ in'yamà anki ntɔn mɛɛn, wɛɛ ntɔn baar kan'pɛ ngye, ntɔn ba bà bàngye.
Indiir byanswà in'wà mɛ abyà, byà byàngye. Indiir awà ngye abyà, byà byàmɛ. Mɛ kàwɛl làkoo amu ba.
Mɛ in'fàkal anki u mɛɛn, wɛɛ ba, ba bà u mɛɛn. Mɛ in'wàmukyà akà ngye. Taa In'kyɛɛl, aler unsà ikɔ̈b a ikɔb angye, ikɔ̈b akwà kan'pɛ ngye, ntɔn ba bàkäl mwɛy asànaa ibà bi mwɛy.
Umpal kàkäl mɛ anà ba, mɛ, mɛ ba kàfalerà kà ikɔ̈b a ikɔb angye kan'pɛ ngye. Mɛ ba afàkyer atii, lalan, akà umwɛy kàdiimà anki, nà mwan aŋàdiimà mbwo, ntɔn Ndaa Aŋàsɔn ikwe.
Apanà, mɛ in'kyà akà ngye. Indiir abi mɛ an'tɛn umpal in'wà mɛ u mɛɛn, ntɔn ba bàkäl anà un'sak amɛ u mpem aba, un'sak wàŋàkwo.
Mɛ, mɛ kapɛ ndaa angye, baar a mɛɛn bàkyer ayiiŋ, ntɔn ba kà bà baar a mɛɛn anki, asànaa mɛ mpa in'wà mɛ wàmɛɛn.
Mɛ, mɛ in'löm anki naa ngye alwom u mɛɛn, wɛɛ mukatii ntɔn Ŋube.
Ba kà baar a mɛɛn anki, asànaa mpa in'wà mɛ mbuur a mɛɛn.
Asi ukɔl ntɔn ngye u mbwo a ndandaa: ndaa angye yà ndandaa.
Asànaa kan'töm ngye u mɛɛn, mɛ sye ba amatɔm u mɛɛn.
Mɛ an'sà ndür amɛ ŋakwo akà ngye ntɔn ba, ntɔn ba sye bàkäl bàngye ndandaa.»
«Mɛ in'yamà anki ntɔn ba mpɛl, wɛɛ sye ntɔn baar abà bàsàsà làkwikilà aba amu mɛ u mbwo a an'lɔɔŋ aba.
Wɛy ba banswà bàkäl mwɛy, asànaa ngye, Taa, ngye awà amu mɛ anà mɛ in'wà amu ngye, wɛy ba sye bàkäl mwɛy amu bi, ntɔn mɛɛn màyöb naa ngye kan'töm.
Mɛ, mɛ ba akyapà làkoo kan'pɛ ngye, ntɔn ba bàkäl mwɛy, asànaa naa bi ibà bi mwɛy:
mɛ amu ba, ngye amu mɛ, ntɔn ba bàkäl bàŋakwo mwɛy, waa mɛɛn màyöb naa ngye kan'töm, naa ngye ba akyakwen asànaa kan'kwen ngye.
Taa, mɛ in'kwen naa ikal in'wà mɛ, ba sye bàkäl paa, anà ba bàmɛn làkoo kan'pɛ ngye kusà a nkyeer a mɛɛn.
Taa a balàbal, mpal mpa mayöb mɛɛn, wɛɛ mɛ, mɛ kàkyayöb, ba abà bàkyàyöb naa ngye kan'töm.
Mɛ kàkyer naa ba bàyöb ikɔb angye, mɛ in'yàfàkyer naa ba bàyöb kya, ntɔn ukwen kan'kwen ngye bàkäl amu ba, anà mɛ in'käl amu ba.»
Ungö mutɛn abà, Yɛsu kàkyen anà alɔŋki ande u sim a un'lwɛy bàfàbel Sɛdrɔn. Akun làkäl anà làpaŋ làmwɛy, waa kàkàbilà kwo anà alɔŋki ande.
Kyekà Yudasi, mbuur kun'yälà, kàkyàyöb ikal aki, ntɔn Yɛsu kàfakyeenà kwo mbalà mbɔɔn anà alɔŋki ande.
Nde kàkäl kusà a un'lwaŋ a aŋità bun'pɛ andweer a angaŋ anà Amfarisi, waa kàbilà u làpaŋ anà isüü a mbaa, anà mwinà anà an'tà.
Apan, Yɛsu kàyöb indiir byanswà byun'yeel, nde kàkyen mper akà ba, anà kafuul naa: «Nà bɛ làyileŋ?»
Ba bun'fuur naa: «Yɛsu, un'nsi Nasàlɛr.» Yɛsu kàtɛn a ba naa: «Mɛ awà.» Kyekà, uboo a ba, Yudasi, mbuur kun'yälà, kàkäl mwo.
Umpal kàtɛn Yɛsu a ba naa: «Mɛ awà», ba bàfurà lingö, waa bàbü u mɛɛn.
Yɛsu kàfafuul naa: «Nà bɛ làyileŋ?» Ba naa: «Yɛsu, un'nsi Nasàlɛr.»
Yɛsu kafuur naa: «Mɛ in'kyàtɛn a bɛ, mɛ awà. Isàkal naa bɛ mɛ làyileŋ, abun lawɛy baar bumwɛy bà bàkyen kàba.»
Abun yàlàkwo ndaa kàtɛn Yɛsu naa: «Uboo a baar kan'pɛ ngye, mɛ akà umwɛy kàpiy anki.»
Apan, Simɔn Petɔlà kàkäl anà kɔm, nde kàswam la kà inkwà, kàkäm la un'tsüüŋ a undweer a angaŋ, waa la lun'ywaaŋ tsü là ibaal. Un'tsüüŋ awà ikɔb ande kyàkäl Malkusu.
Wɛɛ Yɛsu waa kàtɛn a Petɔlà naa: «Fuur kɔm angye uboo a inkwà a la. Nkye mɛ in'sànwà anki kɔɔb kan'pɛ Taa munwà?»
Apan, iköŋ a aŋità anà mfum aba, anà aleer a amfum a Ayudà, bàkör Yɛsu, waa bun'läl in'siŋ.
Ba bàtun'syen akà An. Nde kàkäl ukwà a Kayifa, undweer a angaŋ u mbul awun.
Kyekà Kayifa awà, wà mbuur kàpɛ amfum a Ayudà lwɛŋ naa: «Yà mfun naa mbuur mwɛy ukü ntɔn un'sɛŋ a baar.»
Simɔn Petɔlà anà un'lɔŋki wumwɛy bàyilabà Yɛsu. Undweer a Angaŋ kàkyun'yöb un'lɔŋki awà. Nde kàbilà mbwo mwɛy anà Yɛsu u làpaŋ a undweer a angaŋ.
Simɔn Petɔlà kàkäl u nsà, tsütsü a munàmbwo. Abun, un'lɔŋki awà kàyöb Undweer a Angaŋ, kàyàtoo nde, kàyäm a un'kaar kàkäl un'leer a munàmbwo, waa nde kàbiil Petɔlà.
Apan, un'syääl a un'kaar, un'leer a munàmbwo, kàtɛn a Petɔlà naa: «Nkye ngye, ngye sye kawumwɛy anki uboo a alɔŋki a mbuur awunà?» Petɔlà kun'fuur naa: «Aay, kà mɛ anki.»
Asyääl anà aleer bàyöbà böl a mbaa a an'kal, waa bàyörà ya, ntɔn mpye yàkyer akal. Petɔlà sye kàkäl paa muywar mbaa anà ba.
Apan, un'dweer a angaŋ kàfuul Yɛsu unsà ndaa iler alɔŋki anà an'lɔɔŋ ande.

Yɛsu kun'fuur naa: «Mɛ, mɛ kàtɛɛnà kimɛɛy akà baar. Taaŋ lanswà, mɛ kàyilɔɔŋà u ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà anà u ndwà a Nzam, ikal bàfàköŋ Ayudà banswà. Akundiir mwɛy wàŋàyee kàtɛn mɛ watɛy.
Ntɔn nkye an'fuulà ngye? Fuul baar bàwem ndaa kàtɛn mɛ, ba bàkyàyöb ubwaŋàbwaŋ ndaa kàtɛn mɛ!»
Umwɛy uboo a aleer bàkäl paa, umpal kàwem nde mfuur a Yɛsu ayi, waa kun'käm mbar, anà mutɛn naa: «Nkye ngye undweer a angaŋ un'fuur abwɛy?»
Yɛsu kun'fuur naa: «Isàkal naa mɛ an'tɛn ube, swaŋ ba. Isàkal naa mɛ an'tɛn ubwaŋ, ntɔn nkye aman'kam ngye mbar?»
Apan, An kun'töm wàŋàbäm in'siŋ akun'dweer a angaŋ Kayifa.
Utaaŋ nsil alan, Simɔn Petɔlà kàkälà paa, wàmuywar mbaa. Ba bun'fuul naa: «Nkye ngye sye awumwɛy uboo a alɔŋki ande?» Petɔlà waa kàtön: «Ŋaa, kà mɛ anki.»
Umwɛy uboo a asyääl a undweer a angaŋ, un'tɔŋ a mbuur awà kàywaaŋ Petɔlà tsü ande, kàtɛn naa: «Nkye mɛ kamɛn anki anà nde uboo a làpaŋ?»
Wɛɛ Petɔlà waa kàfun'tɔn. Utaaŋ nsil alan, nkɔɔ mwɛy waa kàbel.
Apan, ba bàsyen Yɛsu u ndwà a kuvɛrnɔ̈ɔ̈r fà ndwà a Kayifa. Yàkäl ututu. Baar bun'twäl bàkyer atɔn mubilà u ndwà a kuvɛrnɔ̈ɔ̈r, ntɔn mukɔɔn asà ndür aba làbiin anà ba bàdi Pak.
Abun, kuvɛrnɔ̈ɔ̈r Pilatu kàyaman u nsà, waa kafuul naa: «Undiir nà lan'füün bɛ mbuur wà?»
Ba bun'fuur naa: «Ilàkal naa mbuur awà ukɔ̈ɔ̈n akyer ube, bi ilatwääl awà anki.»
Abun, Pilatu kàtɛn a ba naa: «Lun'wɛl, lun'tsüül nsaŋ bɛ ŋakwo unsà un'kɔɔn abɛ.» Ba bun'fuur naa: «Bi ikɔ̈b mutsüül mbuur mbar a ukwà kyatɛy.»
Kyakin, yàkwe ndaa kàtɛn Yɛsu muswaŋ naa nde kàlàkwà aben.
Apan, Pilatu kàfurà u ndwà, waa kàswɛŋ naa bun'twääl Yɛsu. Nde kun'fuul naa: «Nkye ngye, ngye awà mfum a Ayudà?»
Yɛsu kàfuur naa: «Nkye ngye an'tɛn unsà an'kyän angye ŋakwo lɛɛ baar asin bàmakyään ntɔn mɛ?»
Pilatu kàfuur naa: «Nkye mɛ, mɛ in'wà Un'yudà? Baar a nsi angye anà amfum a angaŋ bàmayälà akà mɛ! Ininà ngye an'kyer?»

Yɛsu kàfuur naa: «Imwol amɛ kà kyà mɛɛn mà tɛy. Ilàkal naa kya ikäl kyà mɛɛn mà, asyääl amɛ bàlàkyer an'nwään naa bàkɔɔn an'yälà akamfum a Ayudà. Ŋaa, imwol amɛ kà kyà mɛɛn mà anki.»

Apan, Pilatu kàtɛn a nde naa: «Iswaŋà naa ngye awà mfum?» Yɛsu kun'fuur naa: «Ngye an'tɛn ngye ŋakwo naa mɛ in'wà mfum. Mɛ, bàkyer an'bɔr, waa mɛ kàyi u mɛɛn ntɔn mutà imbäl akà ndandaa. Mbuur wanswà awunsà ndandaa afàwem ndaa amɛ.» –
Pilatu kun'fuul naa: «Ndandaa ininà?» Ungö a ngɔk ayi, Pilatu kàfàkàman amfum a Ayudà u nsà, waa kàtɛn a ba naa: «Mɛ akà undiir in'mɛn anki kan'kwo mutsüül mbuur wà mbar a ukwà.
Wɛɛ asànaa akyà kya ifà abɛ naa mɛ alàwɛɛy mbuur mwɛy kun'kyɔm a Pak, nkye bɛ làkyàkwen naa mɛ in'wɛy mfum a Ayudà?»
Apan ba banswà bàfàsà in'kwɛŋ: «Ŋaa, kà nde tɛy, wɛɛ Banabasi!» Kyekà, Banabasi awà kàkäl un'dwää baar.
Apan, Pilatu kàswɛŋ mutwal Yɛsu anà mukun'kam an'füm.
Aŋità bàtöŋ nkar a nsyeenà, waa bun'bwä ya kun'tswe. Ba bun'bwä sye kàzak a tsöö.
Ba bàsinà tsütsü apà nde, waa bàtɛɛnà naa: «Mfum a Ayudà, mbɔr angye!» Ba bun'kämà mbar.
Pilatu kàkyer afàtoo, waa kàtɛn a amfum a Ayudà naa: «Làler, mɛ in'kyer alatwääl awà u nsà: bɛ làkyer ayöb naa mɛ in'mɛn anki ube kan'kyer nde.»
Abun, Yɛsu kàyàtoo wàŋàbwaar nkar a nsyeenà anà kàzak a tsöö. Pilatu kàtɛn a ba naa: «Le baal!»

Pa bun'mɛn andweer a angaŋ anà aleer, ba bàsi in'kwɛŋ: «Un'bɛɛrà u kulunsi! Un'bɛɛrà u kulunsi!» Pilatu kàtɛn a ba naa: «Lun'wɛl anà lun'bɛɛrà bɛ ŋakwo u kulunsi, wɛɛ akà mɛ, mɛ in'mɛn anki undiir kan'kwo mukun'tsüül mbar a ukwà.»
Amfum a Ayudà bun'fuur naa: «Bi iwe anà un'kɔɔn, mulab un'kɔɔn awà, nde akyer akwà, ntɔn nde kàkyeyà uyɔl naa nde wà Mwan a Nzam.»
Mpal kàwem Pilatu ndaa ayi, nde kàfàman bɔɔmà mbɔɔn.
Nde kàfurà u ndwà, waa kàfuul Yɛsu naa: «Ngye, ngye awà un'nsi nà?» Wɛɛ Yɛsu kun'fuur anki akundiir.
Apan, Pilatu kàtɛn a nde naa: «Ngye an'tɔn mukan'pà mfuur? Nkye ngye ayöb anki naa mɛ, mɛ in'we anà ikɔ̈b mukawɛy itàkal mukabɛɛrà u kulunsi?»
Wɛɛ Yɛsu kun'fuur naa: «Ngye ikɔ̈b alàkal akyà anki, ilàkal naa Nzam ukɔ̈ɔ̈n akapà kya. Undiir awun, mbuur awà kàman'yälà akà ngye, we anà man'be màŋàsöönà.»

Fà apan, Pilatu kàleŋà mukun'wɛy. Wɛɛ amfum a Ayudà bàsi in'kwɛŋ: «Isàkal naa ngye amun'wɛy, ngye kawà un'sam a Sɛzar anki! Mbuur wanswà afàkyey uyɔl naa nde wà mfum, nde kan'kyey naa nde wà ŋankir a Sɛzar!»
Mpal kàwem Pilatu ndaa ayi, nde kàsyen Yɛsu u nsà, kàbwaay u làbay a nsaŋ, kikal bàfàbel naa «Plase pavɛ» - unsà ɛbɛlyɔ naa «Ngabàtà».
Kya kyàkäl ilä mulɔ̈ɔ̈n un'kyɔm a Pak u midi. Pilatu kàtɛn a Ayudà naa: «Le mfum abɛ!»
Wɛɛ ba bàsɛmà musà in'kwɛŋ: «Ukü! Ukü! Un'bɛɛrà u kulunsi!» Pilatu kàfàtɛn a ba naa: «Nkye mɛ in'bɛɛrà mfum abɛ u kulunsi?» Andweer a angaŋ bàfuur naa: «Bi mfum asin watɛy, Sɛzar mpɛl.»
Apan Pilatu wa kapɛ awà ntɔn bun'bɛɛrà u kulunsi. Apan ba bàsyen Yɛsu.
Yɛsu kàyisyeenà kulunsi ande, nde ŋakwo, nde kàtoo u nsà a bul ntɔn mukyà ikal akyà bàfàbel naa «Bɔl a un'tswe», unsà ɛbɛlyɔ bàfàbel «Ngɔlɔngɔta».
Akun ba bun'bɛɛrà u kulunsi anà baar, baar bɔ̈ɔ̈l: mwɛy u kɔɔ a ibaal, mwey u kɔɔ a ikaar, Yɛsu uboboo.
Pilatu kàsön isɔn udu a kilàbää, waa kàbɛɛrà kya udu a kulunsi. Kya kyàkäl aŋàsön naa: «Yɛsu un'nsi Nasàlɛr, mfum a Ayudà.»
Ayudà mbɔɔn bàtäŋà isɔn abi, ntɔn ikal bàbɛɛrà Yɛsu u kulunsi kyàkäl tsütsü a bul, anà isɔn bya sye bàsön unsà ibɛlyɔ, unsà ilatɛ anà unsà ingɛlɛki.
Abun, andweer a angaŋ a Ayudà bàtɛn a Pilatu naa: «Twon an'sɔn naa "mfum a Ayudà", wɛɛ sɔn naa: "mbuur wà kàkyey uyɔl naa nde kàkäl mfum a Ayudà."»
Pilatu kàfuur naa: «Ayan'sɔn mɛ, mɛ an'sɔn ya.»

Mpal ban'may aŋità mun'bɛɛrà Yɛsu u kulunsi, ba bàwɛl ipfɛy ande, bàsi bya an'kab an'nà, mbuur mbuur kàwɛl kab làmwɛy. Làsàsal nà kàzak ande. La làkäl anki làŋàtsum: ipfɛy mwɛy fà du tii u ngyɛl.

Aŋità bàtɛɛnà ba a ba naa: «Wɛy bi ikɔ̈ɔ̈n akaam kya, wɛɛ bi itɔɔm löb, ntɔn muyöb naa nà awal kya.» Ntɔn naa Ndaa Aŋàsɔn ikwe: «Ba bàsi ipfɛy amɛ an'kab anà ba bàtɔɔm löb ntɔn kàzak amɛ.» Byabi indiir bàkyer aŋità.
Baar bàkäl tsütsü a kulunsi anà Yɛsu babà: ngwän, mpääŋ a ngwän, Màlye un'kyay a Kɔlɔpasi, anà Màlye un'nsi Makdalà.
Yɛsu kàmɛn nde ngwän anà un'lɔŋki kàfakweenà nde ukɔl a nde, nde kàtɛn a ngwän naa: «Un'kaar, le mwan angye wàbaal.»
Ungö waa kàtɛn a un'lɔŋki naa: «Le ngwa.» Fà apan, un'lɔŋki kun'wɛl u ndwà ande.
Ungö a ndaa ayi, nde kàyöb naa indiir byanswà byakyàkwo itaan, ntɔn Ndaa Aŋàsɔn ikwe, Yɛsu kàtɛn naa: «Mfwää yàman'kaar.»
Paa làkäl anà làbuuŋ aŋàyɔl a vin a nyän, ba bàbäm ikaam a ipfɛy aŋànwɛmà unsà vin a nyän alan u nswɛŋ a kɔkà a kite bàfàbel naa isɔp, waa bun'bämà kya u mun.
Pa kànü nde vin a nyän alà, nde kàtɛn naa: «Yanswà yan'kwo!» Abun, nde kàtsülà un'tswe, waa kàfuur mɔ̈ɔ̈.

Kya kyàkäl ilä ayöŋà un'kyɔm a saba. Ntɔn mukɔɔn awɛy ndom isinakalà u kulunsi ilä a saba, ntɔn kya kyàkäl ilä a kölàköl, amfum a Ayudà bàkàlɔm mbwo akà Pilatu ntɔn bàbɔ̈ɔ̈l ya in'kɔl anà bàlwom ya.
Apan, aŋità bàbɔ̈ɔ̈l in'kɔl a mbuur atàtwɛb anà myà mbuur wàyweel bàbɛɛrà u kulunsi mbwo mwɛy a Yɛsu.
Mpal bàkɔlà ba apà Yɛsu, ba bun'mɛn wàŋàkwà, waa mpa bun'bɔ̈ɔ̈l in'kɔl.
Wɛɛ umwɛy uboo a aŋità, kun'kül kwaŋ u bɛl a nsyäärà, apan sye an'kil anà an'dà waa màyàtoo.
Mbuur kàmɛn ya, kàtɛ imbäl. Imbäl ande kyà ndandaa. Nde, nde akyàyöb naa nde kan'tɛn ndandaa ntɔn bɛ sye làsi làkwikilà.
Abun, indiir abi byàyi ntɔn Ndaa Aŋàsɔn ikwe: «Bàsun'bɔɔl anki akun'kwo ande mwɛy.»
Ntsü yumwɛy, Ndaa Aŋàsɔn itɛn naa: «Ileer aba isàkal akà mbuur bàkül ba kwaŋ.»

Ungö a indiir abi, un'lɔŋki a Yɛsu mwɛy ikɔb ande Yɔsɛfi, un'nsi Alimatɛ, kàkyen akà Pilatu u nku, ntɔn bɔɔmà a Ayudà, mulɔm mbwo mulwom ndom a Yɛsu. Pilatu waa kàkyey. Abun, Yɔsɛfi kàkàlwom ya.
Nàkàdim sye, mbuur akwà kàkyen mukàman Yɛsu u mpib, kàtwäl isii an'kilɔ an'kwem an'tär mà may a usɔŋ mà mir àŋàtüüb anà alɔwɛ.
Ba bàbɔ̈ɔ̈l bàwɛl ndom a Yɛsu, bàläl ya ikaam a ipfɛy a linɔ, bàtyaŋ ya may a usɔŋ, asànaa awà ifà a Ayudà bàfàdyee ba akü aba.
Kikal bàbɛɛrà Yɛsu u kulunsi làkäl anà làpaŋ. Uboo a la màkäl anà an'dii akün, mpa amàŋàtàsà mbuur akikikye.
Abun, ba Yɛsu bun'tɔ̈l kwo, ntɔn ngyööŋ a Ayudà anà an'dii sye màkäl tsütsü.
Ututu a ilä atàtwɛb kyà mpɔsà, u kilàpib, Màlye un'nsi Makdalà kàkyen an'dii, waa kàmɛn nkɔŋ yàŋàlwomà.
Apan, nde kàwurà ntiin, kàkàman Simɔn Petɔlà anà un'lɔŋki kàfakweenà Yɛsu, waa kàtɛn a ba naa: «Mwol bàkyun'lwom kan'dii, bi iyöb anki naa bàmusà ken.»
Petɔlà anà un'lɔŋki wumwɛy waa bàkyen an'dii.
Ba bàbɔ̈ɔ̈l bàwurà ntiin, wɛɛ un'lɔŋki wumwɛy kàyiwurà aŋàlyaŋ Petɔlà, waa kàkàkɔlà mbuur atàtwɛb kan'dii.
Nde kànyee ntɔn muler, waa kàmɛn ikaam a ipfɛy a linɔ byàŋàtɔɔl u mɛɛn. Wɛɛ nde kàbilà anki uboo a an'dii.
Simɔn Petɔlà kàyun'labà nde, waa kàyàkɔlà sye. Nde kàbilà uboo a an'dii, waa kàmɛn ikaam a ipfɛy byàŋàtɔɔl u mɛɛn,
anà ipfɛy bàfwe un'tswe a Yɛsu. Kya kyàkäl anki ikal imwɛy anà ikaam a ipfɛy a linɔ, wɛɛ kya kyàkäl kyàŋàbwɛlà, kyàŋàtɔɔl ikal asin.
Apan, un'lɔŋki akwà kàkàkɔlà kusà kan'dii waa kabilà sye. Nde waa kàmɛn, waa kàsi làkwikilà.
Ntɔn ba bàkäl aŋàtàyöb anki Ndaa Aŋàsɔn ayà itɛɛnà naa Yɛsu kàkyer alàwiyà uboo a akü.
Ungö apan, alɔŋki bàfurà ndwà aba.
Màlye kàkäl u nsà, tsütsü a an'dii, wàmulelà. Umpal kàlelà nde, nde kànye ntɔn muler uboo a an'dii,
nde kàmɛn akyeey abɔ̈ɔ̈l bàkyàbwaar ipfɛy a pɛɛl, bàŋàbwaay kikal bàtɔ̈l ndom a Yɛsu, mwɛy ntsü a un'tswe, mwɛy ntsü a in'kɔl.
Akyeey bun'fuul naa: «Un'kaar, ntɔn nkye alelà ngye?» Nde kafuur naa: «Mwol amɛ bàmun'lwom, mɛ in'yöb anki naa bun'si ken.»
Ungö mutɛn abà, nde kàler ungö, waa kàmɛn Yɛsu kàkyàmbar paa, wɛɛ nde kàyöb anki naa awunà nde.

Yɛsu kàtɛn a nde naa: «Un'kaar, ntɔn nkye alelà ngye? Nà ngye aleŋà?» Wɛɛ nde kàsii naa un'syääl a làpaŋ kàkäl, waa kàtɛn a nde naa: «Mwol, isàkal naa ngye kun'lwom, nkyään, ngye kun'si ken, waa mɛɛ in'kun'wal.»
Yɛsu kàtɛn a nde naa: «Màlye!» Nde waa kàbulà, kun'fuur unsà Ibɛlyɔ naa: «Rabuni!», iswaŋà naa «Un'lɔɔŋ».
Yɛsu kàtɛn a nde naa: «Twon aman'ba, ntɔn mɛ ŋàtàbeenà anki akà Taaràmɛ. Wɛɛ kyen kakyään atɔŋ amɛ naa mɛ an'beenà akà Taaràmɛ awà Taaràbɛ sye, akà Nzam amɛ awà Nzam abɛ sye.»
Abun, Màlye un'si Makdalà kàkyen akalɔŋki, waa kasam naa: «Mɛ, mɛ an'man Mwol, le ndaa kan'kyään nde.»

Làsisye a ilä nsil aki, ilä atàtwɛb kyà mpɔsà, alɔŋki bàkàköŋ u ndwà, ibeenà byàkäl byàŋàdübà a in'kaŋàboo, ntɔn ba bàtiinà bɔɔmà a amfum a Ayudà. Yɛsu waa kàyi, kàmbär uboboo a ba, waa kàtɛn a ba naa: «Duu làkäl anà bɛ!»
Ungö mutɛn abà, nde kamɛɛy an'kɔɔ anà bɛl a nsyäärà ande. Alɔŋki banswà bàkäl unsà un'sak muman Mwol.
Yɛsu kàfàtɛn a ba naa: «Duu làkäl anà bɛ! Asànaa kan'töm Taa, mɛ, mɛ sye amàlatɔm.»
Ungö a ndaa ayi, nde kafül un'swey, waa kàtɛn a ba naa: «Làwɛl Dweelà In'kyɛɛl!
Akà baar abà làsàdwääl bɛ nkul a man'be aba, ba bàsàwal ndwääl a nkul. Wɛɛ akà baar mpa làsàdwääl bɛ nkul, ba ya sye bàsàwal anki.»
Kyekà Tuma awà bàfàbel Didimɔ, umwɛy uboo a Bàkwem Aŋiyweel kàkäl anki anà ba umpal kàyi Yɛsu.

Abun, alɔŋki bumwɛy bun'kyään naa: «Bi kan'man Mwol.» Wɛɛ nde kafuur naa: «Isàkal naa mɛ in'mɛn anki idiim a in'sàmar kan'kɔɔ ande, isàkal naa mɛ in'külà anki làpin amɛ kikal a in'sàmar anà kɔɔ amɛ u bɛl a nsyäärà ande, mɛ in'sà anki làkwikilà.»

Wɛɛ ungö a ilä naan, alɔŋki bàfàköŋ u ndwà, Tuma kàkäl anà ba. Ibeenà byanswà byàkäl byàŋàsà in'kaŋàboo. Yɛsu kàyi nde, kàmbär uboboo a ba, waa kàtɛn a ba naa: «Duu làkäl anà bɛ!»
Ungö waa kàtɛn a Tuma naa: «Sin làpin angye pà, ler an'kɔɔ amɛ. Sin sye kɔɔ angye, fwaar la u bɛl a nsyäärà amɛ. Wɛy mukal un'syeel a mbaaŋ, wɛɛ bulà aŋàlàkwikila!»
Tuma kun'fuur naa: «Mwol amɛ, Nzam amɛ!»
Yɛsu kàtɛn a nde naa: «Nkye ntɔn aman'man ngye, waa ngye an'sà làkwikilà? Un'sak mbɔɔn akà baar mpa bàmɛn, waa bàsi làkwikilà!»
Yɛsu kàkyer idiim asin mbɔɔn u mii a alɔŋki ande abyà mpa bàsön uboo a un'kaan awà.
Indiir abi bàsön ntɔn bɛ làsi làkwikilà naa Yɛsu wà Klistɔ, Mwan a Nzam, naa sye u mbwo a làkwikilà alà, bɛ làkäl anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ kikɔb ande.
Ungö a indiir abi, Yɛsu kàfàmɛnà akalɔŋki ande kun'kɔɔl a ɛwà a Tibɛryade. Le, nde kàyàmɛnà aben akà ba:
Simɔn Petɔlà, Tuma - bàfàbel naa Didimɔ, Natanayɛl un'nsi Kana u Ngalilɛ, baan a Zebeday anà alɔŋki bɔ̈ɔ̈l bumwɛy bàkäl ikal imwɛy.
Simɔn Petɔlà kàtɛn a ba naa: «Mɛ, mɛ awin'kyà in'kàlwab nsö.» Ba bàtɛn a nde naa: «Bi ikyà anà ngye!» Laa bàtoo ba, bàbilà ba u bwaar, wɛɛ u mpib ayin, ba akundiir bàsiim anki.
Taaŋ làkäl lan'tyà, Yɛsu kàkäl aŋàmbar paa kun'kɔɔl a an'dà. Wɛɛ alɔŋki bàyöbà anki naa awun Yɛsu kàkäl.
Apan, Yɛsu kàtɛn a ba naa: «Baan amɛ, nkye bɛ làwe anà undiir adyà?» Ba bun'fuur naa: «Ŋaa.»
Nde kàtɛn a ba naa: «Làtɔɔm an'tɛy u kɔɔ a ibaal a bwaar, waa bɛ làyàman.» Abun, waa ba bàtɔɔm ma, wɛɛ ba bàkwe anki munaan ma, ntɔn nsö yàkäl mbɔɔn.
Apan, un'lɔŋki kàfakweenà Yɛsu kàtɛn a Petɔlà naa: «Awà Mwol!» Pa kàwem Petɔlà naa Mwol kàkäl, nde kàbwäär ipfɛy, ntɔn nde kàkäl nsàpɔl, waa kàbü kan'dà.
Alɔŋki bumwɛy bàyi anà bwaar, ntɔn munaan an'tɛy màkäl aŋàyɔl a nsö: ba bàkäl anki kwɛl a nkankyel, isii a mɛtre nkam mwɛy.
Utaaŋ bàtɔlà ba u nkankyel, ba bàmɛn böl a an'kal a mbaa anà nsö udu, anà mampà.
Yɛsu kàtɛn a ba naa: «Làtwääl nsö yumwɛy uboo a nsö lan'siim bɛ.»
Simɔn Petɔlà kàbilà u bwaar, kànaan an'tɛy u mɛɛn, ma màkäl aŋàyɔl a nsö an'köl an'köl: nkam mwɛy a an'kwem an'tyeen aŋitär. Itàkal naa ya yàkäl un'kàbɔ, an'tɛy màkaamà anki.
Yɛsu waa kabel: «Yää, làdi.» Akà un'lɔŋki mwɛy kàkwe anki mukun'fuul naa: «Ngye, ngye nà?» Ntɔn ba bàkiyöbà naa awà Mwol kàkäl.
Abun Yɛsu kàsin nde, nde kàwɛl mampà anà nsö, waa kakääb.
Ayi yàkäl mbalà yàtär ayà kàmɛnà Yɛsu akalɔŋki ande, fà kàwiyà nde uboo a akü.

Ungö a udyà, Yɛsu kàfuul Simɔn Petɔlà naa: «Simɔn, mwan a Ywan, nkye ngye akyan'kwen aŋàsöön baar bà?» – Nde kàfuur naa: «Inye, Mwol, ngye akyàyöb ngye ŋakwo naa mɛ in'kyakwen.» Apan Yɛsu kàtɛn a nde naa: «Sey baan a in'kɔk amɛ.»
U mbalà yàyweel, Yɛsu kun'fuul naa: «Simɔn, mwan a Ywan, nkye ngye akyan'kwen?» Nde kàfuur naa: «Inye, Mwol, ngye akyàyöb naa mɛ in'kyakwen.» Yɛsu kàtɛn naa: «Kal nkyɛɛŋ a in'kɔk amɛ.»

U mbalà yàtär, nde kàtɛn a nde naa: «Simɔn, mwan a Ywan, nkye ngye akyan'kwen?» Petɔlà kàmɛn ngyɛb ntɔn kun'fuul Yɛsu mbalà yàtär naa: «Nkye ngye akyan'kwen?» Nde kun'fuur naa: «Mwol, ngye mbuur ayöb ndaa yanswà, ngye akyàyöb naa mɛ, mɛ in'kyakwen!» Yɛsu waa kàtɛn a nde naa: «Sey in'kɔk amɛ.

Ndandaa, ndandaa, mɛ akyään: mpal kàkäl ngye un'tö, ngye ŋakwo kàfabäämà un'kab, ngye kàkyeenà ntsü yanswà kàkweenà ngye. Wɛɛ mpal asàbulà ngye un'nün, ngye asayaamà an'kɔɔ angye, waa mbuur asin usabäämà un'kab, nde sye usasyeenà ntsü mpa akwen ngye.»
Kàtɛn nde abà, Yɛsu kàkwen muswaŋ naa nkweel a Petɔlà isàkal aben ntɔn mupà Nzam làkoo. Ungö mutɛn abà, nde kàtɛn a nde naa: «Yan'läb!»
Petɔlà kàler ungö, kàmɛn nde un'lɔŋki kàfakweenà Yɛsu - nde akwà kàkàyiir kitɔl ande umpal bàkäl ba mudyà anà kun'fuul naa: «Mwol, nà asayälà?»
Mpal kun'mɛn Petɔlà, nde kàfuul Yɛsu naa: «Mwol, atöl nde, ininà isàkal?»
Yɛsu kun'fuur naa: «Isàkal naa mɛ in'kwen naa nde ukäl anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ tii mpal in'sàyà mɛ, a akà ngye mwo nkye? Ngye, yan'läb!»

Fà apan, làsaŋ làpää akatɔŋ naa un'lɔŋki awà usàkwà anki. Kyekà, Yɛsu kàtɛn anki naa un'lɔŋki awà usàkwà anki, wɛɛ nde kàtɛn naa: «Isàkal naa mɛ in'sàkwen naa nde ukäl tii mpal in'sàyà mɛ, a akà ngye mwo nkye?»
Un'lɔŋki nsil awà, wàmutà imbäl a indiir abi anà kàsön bya, bi ban'yöb naa imbäl ande kyà ndandaa.
Yɛsu kàkyer indiir asin mbɔɔn. Yàlàkal naa bàsön bya imwɛy imwɛy, mɛ in'sii ikal kyàlàkal anki musà in'kaan myanswà bàlàsɔn.
ISAL
Un'sam Tyɔfil, Uboo a un'kaan amɛ wàtàtwɛb, mɛ kasam indiir byanswà kàsɛmà Yɛsu mukyer anà mulɔŋ
tii ilä bun'sɛɛn ba ungö mupà nswɛɛŋ u mbwo a Dweelà In'kyɛɛl akà Antööm kàsɔ̈ɔ̈l nde.

Yàlɔ̈m naa ungö a nkweel ande, nde kàyamɛnà nde ŋakwo akà ba ntɔn mukaswaŋ unsà mbwo yà ifà ifà naa ndandaa nde wà anà mɔ̈ɔ̈. Nde kàyàmɛnà akà ba ilä an'kwem an'nà mukakyään indiir a Imwol a Nzam.
Ilä mwɛy nde kàkäl mudyà anà ba, nde kaswɛŋ ndaa yi: «Twon lan'lwomà u Yɛlusàlɛm, wɛɛ làdil ilää kàpɛ Taa, kab a ngway kàlakyään mɛ.
Ntɔn Ywan kàyadümà kà an'dà, wɛɛ bɛ, bɛ bàyàladümà unsà Dweelà In'kyɛɛl ungö a ilä ikikye.»
Apan, baar bàyàköŋ apà nde bun'fuul naa: «Mwol, nkye taaŋ nsil alà ayàfuur ngye imwol akà Isàlɛl?»
Yɛsu kafuur naa: «Kà bɛ anki lan'kwo muyöb taaŋ anà ilä kàsi Nzam unsà ikɔ̈b ande.
Wɛɛ bɛ làsàwal ngwal taaŋ usyetyà Dweelà In'kyɛɛl udu a bɛ. Bɛ làsàkal ambäl amɛ u Yɛlusàlɛm, uboo a Yuday lanswà, u Samalya tii u ntsüü a mɛɛn.»
Utaaŋ kàmay nde mutɛn abwɛy, laa bun'sɛɛn ba, Antööm bàkäl mukun'lerà. Itööm mwɛy kyun'fwee u mii aba.
Umpal bàkäl ba mulerà u du ntsü kàkyen Yɛsu, kà imbürà, ba bàmɛn abaal bɔ̈ɔ̈l bàŋambwaar ipfɛy a pɛɛl bàŋàmbar apà ba,
waa bàtɛn a ba naa: «Baar a Ngalilɛ, ntɔn nkye lan'mbar bɛ apà mulerà u du? Yɛsu wa bàmàlalwom wà mubeenà du, afàsyefurà asànaa lun'mɛn bɛ mubeenà.»
Antööm bàlwomà u mɔŋ bàfàbel naa mɔŋ a in'te a olive, ba bàfurà Yɛlusàlɛm. Mɔŋ awà wà tsütsü a Yɛlusàlɛm kà isii a kilɔmɛtre mwɛy.

Mpal bàkɔlà ba, ba bàläär u suk adu, ikal bàfakööŋà ba. Ba bàkäl Petɔlà, Ywan, Zyak anà Andrɛ, Filipo anà Tuma, Bàtɛlàmay anà Màtay, Zyak mwan a Alefɛ, Simɔn Ŋinaŋ, anà Yudà mwan a Zyak.
Ba banswà bàkyer afabweyà mbɔɔn ntɔn muyamà, anà akaar, anà Màlye ngwän a Yɛsu anà atɔŋ ande.
Kà ilä abin, alɔŋki bàköŋ bàkal kà isii a nkam a an'kwem mɔ̈ɔ̈l. Petɔlà kàmbarà uboo a ba, waa kàtɛn a ba naa:
«Atɔŋ, yubwaŋ naa ndaa kàtɛn Dweelà In'kyɛɛl uboo Un'kaan ikwe: u mun a David, nde kàtɛn kusà ntɔn Yudasi mbuur kàtwääl baar ntɔn mukɔr Yɛsu.
Ntɔn nde kàkäl umwɛy uboo a bi, nde sye kàkyer awal kab uboo a isal bipɛ.
Nde kàsöm mɛɛn a ngim kàyälà nde Yɛsu. Nde kàbü kwo un'tswe lingyɛl, ndür ande yàbarà uboboo, in'swà ande myanswà waa myàpää.
Baar a Yɛlusàlɛm banswà bàkyer ayöb ndaa ayin: lalan bàbeelà ba mɛɛn aman u ndaa aba naa "akɛldamà", iswaŋà naa "mɛɛn a an'kil".
Wɛɛ, làwem ndaa bàsön uboo a un'kaan a an'diim: "Wɛy ndwà ande ikäl ipɔl, mbuur ukɔɔn abilà kwo." Waa bàfàkwɛy naa: "Wɛy mbuur asin uwɛl buur ande."
Abun, bye anà baar bàyikyeenà anà bi taaŋ lanswà kàyilyaaŋà Mwol abi Yɛsu kusà a bi
sɛmà ilä kun'dümà Ywan tii ilä kàlwomà nde uboo a bi. Lalan mbuur awun ayàkal mbäl ntɔn ngwiiyà a Yɛsu.»
Ba bàswɛŋ baar bɔ̈ɔ̈l: Yɔsefi bàfabeelà naa Barsàbas, bun'pɛ sye ikɔb naa Mbuur a balàbal, anà Màtyas.
Apan ba bàsi ngyamàkà yi: «Ngye, Mwol, ngye akyàyöb mpem a baar banswà. Iswɛŋ uboo a atɔŋ bà bàbɔ̈ɔ̈l ngye nà an'sɔɔl
ntɔn muwal uboo a isal a Antööm ikal kàsàwɛy Yudasi ki ntɔn mukyà ikal kàsɔ̈ɔ̈l nde.»
Ungö apan ba bàtɔ̈ɔ̈m löb, löb waa làbü udu a Màtyas. Nde mbuur kàtüüb anà Antööm bàkwem aŋimwɛy.
Ungö apan, mpal kyàkwe ilä a Pantɛkɔt, alɔŋki banswà bàkàköŋ ikal imwɛy.
Yàmɛnà naa kà imbürà, làso làfü du: la làkäl asànaa un'pöb a ngwal akayaa anà akayöölà ndwà yanswà bàkälà ba.
Taaŋ nsil alan, yàmɛnà anà ndem mwɛy asànaa ndem a mbaa. Ya yakyer akaabà, waa yàbwee udu a umwɛy umwɛy uboo a ba.
Apan sye Dweelà In'kyɛɛl kàwɛl ba banswà, ba waa bàsɛmà mutɛn unsà ndaa asin yà ifà ifà, mbuur mbuur asànaa Dweelà kàswɛŋà nde ba mutɛn.
Kyekà taaŋ nsil alan, Ayudà a mpem aŋàbwaŋ bàfü in'sɛŋ myanswà amyu mɛɛn, bàkäl u Yɛlusàlɛm.
Mpal bàwem ba làso alan, un'sɛŋ wanswà kàyi u ntiin. Ba bàkäl mubem, ntɔn mbuur mbuur kàweemà u ndaa ande ŋakwo bàtɛɛnà ba.
Ba bàkäl unsà lingyoomà anà ubem, waa bàtɛɛnà naa: «Làler, baar bàyäämà bà banswà, nkye ba kà baar a Ngalilɛ anki?
Iswaŋà aben naa bi ikaweemà umwɛy umwɛy u ndaa a bul ande ŋakwo?
Uboo abi, bi ibà anà bà Partɛs, bà Mɛdɛs, bà Ɛlamit, bi ifàkal u Mɛzɔpɔtami, u Yuday, u Kapadɔs, u Pɔn anà kà itiir a nsi a Azi,
u Frizi bàfàbel sye Pamfili, u Ngipiti, u Libi tsütsü a Sirɛn, u Lɔmà,
u Krɛt anà Arabi. Bi ibà Ayudà unsà mböör abi anà Ayudà unsà inzaam, wɛɛ mbuur mbuur uboo a bi wàmuweemà u ndaa ande ŋakwo indiir a kölàköl kan'kyer Nzam.»
Ba banswà bàkäl unsà lingyoomà anà isak isak. Ba bàtɛɛnà ba a ba naa: «Abà iswaŋà aben?»
Wɛɛ bumwɛy bàsɛɛ aŋàlàkwikilà, waa bàtɛn naa: «Ba bàŋàyɔr ubwaŋàbwaŋ!»
Apan, Petɔlà waa kàmbarà anà Bàkwen Aŋimwɛy, nde kàtɛn u ndaa a ngwal a baar mbɔɔn naa: «Abaal a Yuday anà bɛ banswà làfàkal u Yɛlusàlɛm, làwem ubwaŋàbwaŋ ndaa amɛ!
Aay, baar bà kàbàŋàyɔr anki asànaa làkasii bɛ, ntɔn bi ibà u taaŋ làwà làtutu.
Wɛɛ papà, ndaa kàkyään ŋangɔɔm Ywel yan'kwo:

Làler ndaa isàlyaaŋ kà ilä a ntsüü, mɛ in'sàtsuul Dweelà amɛ udu a mbuur wanswà, baan abɛ babaal anà bakaar bàsàtà ngɔɔm, mɛ in'sàtɛn kà imanmii akà baan ambɛy abɛ anà u ndwɛy akà anün abɛ.
2c021200a1	Ɛɛ, mɛ in'sàtsuul Dweelà amɛ itàkal udu a asyääl amɛ babaal anà bakaar kà ilä abin, mɛ in'sàtsuul Dweelà amɛ, ba bàsàtà ngɔɔm.
2c0213007a	Mɛ in'sàmɛɛy indiir a ubem untaal u du anà idiim ungyɛl udu a mɛɛn: an'kil, mbaa anà un'swey a un'diŋ a mbaa,
2c02140093	taaŋ làsàbulà mpib, nsöŋ asàbulà wàtsöö asànaa an'kil kusà a ilä a Mwol muyà, ilä a kölàköl anà kyàlàkoo.

Baar a Isàlɛl, làwem ndaa yi: Yɛsu un'nsi Nasàlɛr wà mbuur kàtöm Nzam ntɔn bɛ. Nde kàkyer isal a ngwal, indiir a ubem anà idiim uboo a bɛ asànaa làyöb bɛ ŋakwo,
mbuur awà bàkyer un'yälà kà an'kɔɔ a baar abɛ asànaa kàbön Nzam itaan unsà an'kyän ande. Wɛɛ bɛ, bɛ làkyer un'dwa, lun'bɛɛrà u kulunsi u kɔɔ a baar abɛ.
Wɛɛ Nzam kun'fuur u mɔ̈ɔ̈, kun'tsuuŋ unsà usaay a nkweel, ntɔn yàlàkwo anki naa an'lɔŋ mun'käär uboo a ikɔ̈b a ma.
Lalan David kàtɛn nde ntɔn nde naa: "Mɛ kàmɛnà Mwol taaŋ lanswà kusà a mɛ, ntɔn nde wà u kɔɔ amɛ là ibaal ntɔn mɛ in'kɔ̈ɔ̈n abwà.
Ntɔn ndaa ayi, mpem amɛ yà unsà un'sak anà mun amɛ wàmutwey ndaa a ntsà. Abun, ndür amɛ sye isàbɔ̈ɔ̈n unsà làkyän.
Ntɔn ngye, ngye mɛ asan'wɛy anki kà an'lɔŋ. Ngye asun'wɛy anki mbuur angye wàŋin'kyɛɛl upɔ̈ɔ̈n.
Ntɔn ngye mɛ kan'swɛŋ mbwo a mɔ̈ɔ̈ anà ngye asan'yööl a un'sak u mii a ngye."
Atɔŋ, wɛy mɛ alàkyään alää naa undweer David kàkyàkwà ndandaa, bàkyun'dyee. An'dii ande mà tsütsü apà bi tii ŋàbawà.
Wɛɛ nde kàkäl ŋangɔɔm anà kàkyer ayöbà naa Nzam kàdi kyän naa: "Mɛ in'sàsà ikyee angye u kir a imwol angye".
David kàyöb kusà ndaa iyàyà ntɔn ngwiiyà a Klistɔ, nde kàtɛɛnà naa Nzam asun'wɛy anki kà an'lɔŋ, nde sye usàwɛy anki ndür ande ipɔ̈ɔ̈n.
Yɛsu awà, Nzam kàkyun'wiiy, bi banswà ibà ambäl.
Abun, Nzam kun'sɛɛn, waa kun'si u kɔɔ ande là ibaal, nde kan'wal akà Taa Dweelà Inkyɛɛl kàbön nde, waa kàmun'tyaaŋ. Ayin ya làmanà anà làweemà bɛ yi.
Kutɛn aŋàbwaŋ, David kàbeenà anki du nde ŋakwo, wɛɛ nde kàtɛn naa: "Mwol kàtɛn a Mwol amɛ naa: Yabwaay u kɔɔ amɛ là ibaal,
tii mpal in'sàsà mɛ aŋankir angye u ngyɛl a in'kɔl angye."
Wɛy un'sɛŋ a Isàlɛl wanswà uyöb ndandaa naa Yɛsu akwà bɛ, lun'bɛɛrà bɛ u kulunsi, Nzam kàkyun'sà Mwol anà Klistɔ.»
Ndaa ayi yàpɛ mpay mbɔɔm akà baar bàwem ya. Ba bàfuul Petɔlà anà antööm bumwɛy naa: «Atɔŋ abaal, ininà bi kan'kwo mukyer?»
Petɔlà waa kafuur abà: «Làbuul mpem abɛ, wɛy mbuur mbuur uwɛl ndüümà kà ikɔb a Yɛsu Klistɔ, ntɔn bàladwääl nkul a man'be abɛ. Apan bɛ làsàwal kab a Dweelà In'kyɛɛl.
Ntɔn ilää kyà bɛ, ntɔn ikyee abɛ anà ntɔn in'sɛŋ a nsi a kwɛlàkwɛl usàbel Mwol Nzam abi tsütsü apà nde.»
Wɛɛ unsà ndaa yà ifà ifà, nde kàkweenà naa ba bàkyey ndaa kàtɛɛnà nde anà kalɔɔŋà nde naa: «Làkaabà a nkööl a lingyoomà yi.»
Abun baar bàkyey ndaa a Petɔlà bàwɛl ndüümà. Ilä akin baar bàbilà uboo a un'tüüb a aŋàlàkwikilà bàkäl kà isii a nsaab tär.
Wɛɛ ba bàsi muküünà mulab an'lɔɔŋ a Antööm, mukal un'tüüb ba banswà: ba bàkäbà, bàdyee anà bàyayamà ikal imwɛy.
Mbuur wanswà kàkäl u bɔɔmà, ntɔn Antööm bàkyerà impà anà idiim mbɔɔn.
Aŋàlàkwikilà banswà bàkälà ikal imwɛy, indiir aba byàkäl byà ba banswà.
Ba bàyälà mɛɛn anà indiir aba anà mukab bweel ba banswà mbuur mbuur u ngyal ande.
Unsà ukwen aba, ilä byanswà ba bàfabweyà u ndwà a Nzam. Unsà un'sak wanswà anà ukɔɔn nkyɛɛr u mpem, ba bàfadyaa ibööl u ndwà aba.
Ba bàfasyaŋà Nzam, baar banswà bakyer akweenà. Ilä byanswà Mwol kàkwɛyà kà Ikööŋ aba baar kàtswää nde mɔ̈ɔ̈.
Yàmɛnà naa ilä mwɛy Petɔlà anà Ywan bàkäl mubeenà ntɔn mukàyamà u ndwà a Nzam u taaŋ làtär ungö a midi.

Kyekà ilä byanswà ba bàfatwaalà ŋatoo mwɛy sɛmà mböör ande, waa bàfun'tɔɔlà u munàmbwo a ndwà a Nzam tsütsü a ibeenà bàfàbel naa «La Bɛɛl Pɔrte» ntɔn nde ulɔ̈ɔ̈mà ngim akà baar bàfabilà u ndwà a Nzam.
Umpal kàmɛn nde Petɔlà anà Ywan bàmubilà u ndwà a Nzam, nde kalɔ̈ɔ̈m ngim.
Petɔlà anà Ywan waa bun'syebà. Petɔlà kàtɛn a nde naa: «Iler.»
Mbuur awà kaler ubwaŋàbwaŋ. Nde kàsii naa nde awal undiir mwɛy akà ba.
Petɔlà waa kàtɛn a nde naa: «Mɛ ngim yatɛy, itàkal wɔl, wɛɛ undiir in'wà mɛ awà mɛ in'kyer apà wa: Kà ikɔb a Yɛsu Klistɔ un'nsi Nasàlɛr, mbarà, kyen.»
Apan nde kun'te mpi u kɔɔ ande là ibaal, waa kumbaar. Papan sye in'kɔl anà nkɔn a in'kɔl ande waa myàtsim,
nde waa kàfumà, kàmbarà, kàsɛmà mukyà dwaan. Nde kàbilà anà ba u ndwà a Nzam, wàmukyà, mufumà anà musyäŋà Nzam.
Baar banswà bun'mɛn mukyà dwaan anà musyäŋà Nzam.
Ba bàkyer ayöbà naa wà mbuur afàkal aŋàbwaay tsütsü a «La Bɛɛl Pɔrte» mulɔɔmà ngim. Muman ndaa yun'yeel, baar bàkäl mutɛɛr anà muman bɔɔmà aŋàkir.
Wɛɛ nde, nde kàsàwɛy anki Petɔlà anà Ywan. Un'sɛŋ wanswà kàyi wa, kàköŋ tsütsü apà ba u làpaŋ a ndwà a Nzam, ungyɛl a ta a ndwà a Salɔmun wàmutɛɛr a bɔɔmà.

Mpal kàmɛn Petɔlà abun, nde kàtɛn a un'sɛŋ naa: «Abaal a Isàlɛl, ntɔn nkye làkabemà bɛ ntɔn ndaa yan'lyaaŋ yi? Ntɔn nkye lileerà bɛ apɔŋaa asànaa u ngwal abi itàkal unsà inzaam abi waa bi kambaar mbuur wà?
Aay, wà Nzam a Abàlam, wà Izak anà Zakɔb, Nzam a bànkaa abi, kan'sà un'syääl ande Yɛsu làkoo, Yɛsu akwà bɛ, làyälà bɛ anà làtön bɛ u mii a Pilatu umpal kàkwen nde mukun'tsuuŋ.
Ɛɛ, bɛ, bɛ làkyer atɔn Ŋun'kyɛɛl anà wàbalàbal, wɛɛ bɛ, bɛ làsɔ̈ɔ̈l un'dwää baar mukun'tswà mɔ̈ɔ̈.
Abun bɛ làdwä aŋamɔ̈ɔ̈. Wɛɛ Nzam kun'twey kà ukwà, bi ibà ambäl a ndaa ayi.
Ntɔn làkwikilà amu ikɔb a Yɛsu, ngwal a ikɔb aki yan'fuur ngwal ambarà akà mbuur làmanà bɛ anà làyöb bɛ wà. Làkwikilà amu Yɛsu lan'kɔɔr ubwaŋàbwaŋ mbuur wà kusà a bɛ banswà.
Wɛɛ apanà, atɔŋ, mɛ inkyàyöb naa ntɔn ukɔɔn ayöb waa bɛ anà amfum abɛ sye làkyer abà akà Yɛsu.
Wɛɛ Nzam kan'kwey ndaa kàtɛn nde itaan u mun a aŋangɔɔm ande naa Klistɔ ande akyer asàman mpay.
Abun, làbuul mpem abɛ, làsɔɔm nkääl abɛ, ntɔn mubiiŋ man'be abɛ.
Apan, Mwol asàtwaal paŋà a duu, waa usàtɔm mbuur kàsɔ̈ɔ̈l nde kusà ntɔn bɛ: Klistɔ Yɛsu.
Wɛɛ apanà, Yɛsu atàkal u du tii mpal isàsɔɔmà ndaa yanswà asànaa kàkyään Nzam u mun a aŋangɔɔm inkyɛɛl ande itaan.
Lalan, unsà ndaa ayi Mɔsɛ kàtɛn naa: "Mwol, Nzam abɛ asàlatweey ŋangɔɔm asànaa mɛ, nde asàkal umwɛy uboo a un'sɛŋ abɛ. Bɛ làkyer asàkyey ndaa yanswà usàlakyään nde.
Mbuur wanswà asàkɔɔn awem ndaa a ŋangɔɔm awà bàkyer asun'böŋ kà un'sɛŋ a Nzam."
Wɛɛ aŋangɔɔm bàtɛn sɛmà Sàmwel, ba banswà umwɛy umwɛy, bàkyer akyäänà ilä abi.

Ilää kàsi Nzam u mbwo a aŋangɔɔm kyà ntɔn bɛ, bɛ sye làbye anà kab uboo a nkwà kàdi Nzam anà andweer abɛ mpal kàtɛn nde a Abàlam naa: "Mɛ in'sàsaak an'bɔr manswà u mɛɛn u mbwo a ikyee angye."
Abun, Nzam kàtwey un'syääl ande utàtwɛb ntɔn bɛ, nde kun'töm ntɔn nde kàlasaak anà kàlalwom unsà an'kyän abɛ man'be.»
Umpal bàkäl Petɔlà anà Ywan mukyäänà un'sɛŋ a baar, angaŋ, mfum a aleer a ndwà a Nzam anà Asadusi waa bàyi.
Ba bàkäl anki un'sak unsà an'lɔɔŋ aba akà un'sɛŋ anà mukun'kyään naa Yɛsu akyàwiyà kà an'lɔŋ ntɔn muswaŋ naa akü bàkyer asàwiyà.
Ba waa bakör, basi u bɔlokà tii taaŋtyà, ntɔn sisye làkäl aŋàkwo itaan.
Apan, bàmbɔɔn uboo a baar bàwem ndaa a Antööm bàkyer akyey ya. Abun abaal aŋàlàkwikilà bàkɔlà kà isii a nsaab tyeen.
Yàmɛnà naa taaŋtyà, amfum a un'sɛŋ, andweer anà alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn bàköŋ u Yɛlusàlɛm,
anà An, undweer a angaŋ, anà Kayifà anà Ywan anà Aleksandre anà baar banswà bàkäl u ywar a undweer a angaŋ.
Ba bàsi Antööm uboboo, waa bafuul naa: «Unsà ikɔ̈b nà itàkal kikɔb anà bɛ, bɛ làkyerà ndaa ayi?»
Apan Petɔlà kàkäl aŋàyɔl a Dweelà In'kyɛɛl, waa kàtɛn a ba naa: «Amfum a un'sɛŋ anà andweer,
isàkal naa ŋàbawà bàkifuulà ntɔn ubwaŋ kan'kyer bi ntɔn un'bɛy anà muyöb naa nde kan'kɔrà aben,

yubwaŋ naa bɛ anà un'sɛŋ a Isàlɛl wanswà làyöb naa unsà ikɔb a Yɛsu Klistɔ, un'nsi Nasàlɛr, mbuur akwà bɛ, bɛ lun'bɛɛrà u kulunsi anà kàtwey Nzam kà ukwà, waa mbuur wà kambar anà ngwal kusà a bɛ.
Mbuur awà wà nkɔŋ akwà làtön bɛ atööŋ anà kàbulà un'tswe a twɛrà a ndwà.
Lalan, ngweel a mɔ̈ɔ̈ yatɛy unsà mbuur asin, ntɔn uboo a baar u mɛɛn pà ikɔb a mbuur asin kyatɛy u mbwo a kya ban'kwo bi muwà mɔ̈ɔ̈.»
Baar a làbay a nsaŋ bàkäl mubem ntɔn bàmɛn ba uyɔl a Petɔlà anà Ywan anà muyöb naa ba bàkäl baar asànaa baar banswà, baar mpa bàtäŋ. Ba bàyöb naa ba bàyikalà ana Yɛsu.
Wɛɛ ba bàmɛnà sye mbuur kàkɔɔrà wà akyàmbar kusà a ba, ba undiir atɛn kàkäl anki.
Apan ba baswɛŋ mutoo u làbay a nsaŋ, waa bàbulà muyääm ba a ba, waa
bàtɛn naa: «Ininà bi kan'kwo mukyer anà baar bà? Ntɔn baar a Yɛlusàlɛm banswà bàkyàyöb ubwaŋàbwaŋ naa idiim aŋàmɛnà ba bàkyer. Bi ikwo anki mutɔn kya.
Wɛɛ ndaa ayi mukɔɔn apää uboo a un'sɛŋ wanswà, bi ikyer atsuŋ a ngwal ba mutɛn akà mbuur mwɛy kà ikɔb a akyɛy.»
Ba waa bàfabel, batsüŋ a ngwal mutɛn anà mulɔŋ kà ikɔb a Yɛsu.
Wɛɛ Petɔlà anà Ywan bafuur naa: «Làtsül bɛ ŋakwo, nkye yà balàbal u mii a Nzam, bi mulab ndaa abɛ anà mubɛy ndaa a Nzam?
Wɛɛ bi, bi iwɛy anki mukyään indiir kàmɛn bi anà kàwem bi.»
Baar a Làbay a nsaŋ bàläb mukasiinà a ngwal, waa bawɛy. Ba bàsàman anki mbwo mupà ba ntaaŋàmbar, ntɔn un'sɛŋ wanswà kàkäl musyäŋà Nzam ntɔn ndaa yàlyaaŋ.
Abun, mbuur awà kàkɔɔrà nkɔɔr impà kàkäl ayà mbul aŋàlyaŋ an'kwen an'nà.
Ungö batsuuŋ ba, ba bàkyen akà atɔŋ aba bumwɛy, waa bakyään indiir byanswà bàtɛn amfum a angaŋ anà andweer aba.
Ungö muwem ndaa ayi, ba bàlaal unsà un'tüüb akà Nzam, waa bàtɛn naa: «Mwol, ngye, ngye kàkyer du, mɛɛn, ngyäl anà indiir byanswà abyà uboo mwo,
u mbwo a Dweelà In'kyɛɛl, ngye kàten u mun a nkaa abi David, un'syääl angye naa: "Ntɔn nkye nsi yàbilà ya uboo a lingyoomà anà in'sɛŋ myàkyer mya indiir ikɔ̈ɔ̈n ndöŋ?
Amfum a mɛɛn bàkyer ayööŋ munwan, baar abye anà ikɔ̈b bàkyer aköŋ ntɔn munwan a Mwol anà Klistɔ ande.
Ntɔn, yà ndandaa naa Ɛlɔdi anà Pɔns Pilatu bàköŋ u bul alà anà angyey anà in'sɛŋ a Isàlɛl ntɔn mutɔn un'syääl angye wà in'kyɛɛl, Yɛsu kàsi ngye an'kɔɔ,
ntɔn mukyer indiir byanswà kàbön ngye anà kàkwen ngye kusà.
Wɛɛ apanà, Mwol, kyɛɛŋ ubwaŋàbwaŋ ndaa aba yàmbe, apɛ atsüüŋ angye mbwo mukyään ndaa angye unsà uyɔl.
Abun, swaŋ ngwal angye ntɔn nkɔɔr, impà anà idiim byàmɛnà kà ikɔb a un'syääl inkyɛɛl angye Yɛsu.»
Umpal bàmay ba muyamà, ikal bàkäl ba muköŋ kyàkyer atɛɛr, ba banswà bàyöl a Dweelà In'kyɛɛl, waa bàkyään ndaa a Nzam anà uyɔl.
Apan, un'sɛŋ a baar bàsi làkwikilà bàkäl mpem anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ mwɛy, akà umwɛy kàkyey anki naa indiir ande ikäl byànde mpɛl, wɛɛ indiir byanswà byàkäl byà un'sɛŋ.
Abun, unsà ngwal mbɔɔn, Antööm bàtɛɛ imbäl a ngwiiyà a Mwol Yɛsu, kab a ngway a kölàköl làkäl udu a ba.
Kyakin, akà mbuur umwɛy uboo a ba kàkɔ̈ɔ̈n anki undiir. Ntɔn baar bàkäl anà an'ywaŋ itàkal ndwà, bàkyer ayälà, bweel bàyälà ba indiir abin bàkyer atwaalà,
anà bàpɛɛ akà Antööm, ungö waa bàkäbà mbuur mbuur u ngyal ande.
Apan, Yɔsefi, Antööm bun'pɛ ikɔb a Barnabas, iswaŋà naa «Mbuur afàpà un'kanà.» Nde kàkäl un'lɛvi, un'nsi Sipriyɔt,
nde kayälà ywaŋ ande, waa kàpɛ ngim ayin akà Antööm.
Wɛɛ yàmɛnà naa mbuur mwɛy ikɔb ande Ananyas, ikɔb a un'kyay ande Safirà, ba bàyälà ywaŋ làmwɛy.
Ungö pa, un'tüüb mwɛy a un'kyay ande, nde kàyee yar a ngim làmwɛy, lumwɛy waa kàsyen, kàkàtɔl kà in'kɔl a Antööm.
Apan Petɔlà kàtɛn a nde naa: «Ananyas, ntɔn nkye Satanà uyööl nde mpem angye ntɔn ngye akür Dweelà Inkyɛɛl, waa ayee yar a ngim yan'fà u ngyäälà a ywaŋ?

Kusà ngye muyälà la, la kà làkäl làngye anki? Ungö ngye muyälà la, ngim ayin kà yàkäl kan'kɔɔ angye anki? Ntɔn nkye awel ngye an'kyän mukyer ndaa ayin? Ngye kà baar an'kur anki, wɛɛ ngye an'kur Nzam.»
Pa kàwɛm Ananyas ndaa ayi laa kàbü nde, waa kàkü. Baar banswà bàwem ndaa ayi, bɔɔmà làkyer akaar.
Apan atö laa bàmbarà ba, bun'läl ba ipfey, bun'syen ba u nsà, waa bun'dyee.
Yàmɛnà naa ungö a isii a an'taaŋ an'tär, un'kyay ande waa kàyàbilà, nde kàyöb anki ndaa yàlyaaŋ.
Petɔlà kun'fuul naa: «Nkyään, ngim làyälà bɛ ywaŋ abɛ, ayi?» Nde kàfuur naa: «Ɛɛ, ayi.»
Apan Petɔlà waa kàtɛn a nde naa: «Bɛ làtüüb aben an'kyän musi Dweelà a Mwol? Leer ntääm a baar bàkàdyee un'dim angye u munàmbwo, ba sye bàkyer asyen u nsà.»
Nde kàbü sye kusà a in'kɔl ande, waa kàkü. Atö bàyàbilà ba, bun'mɛn ba wàŋàkwà, waa bun'syen, bàkun'dyee tsütsü apà un'dim ande.
Apan, baar a ndwà a Nzam banswà bàmɛn bɔɔmà mbɔɔn anà baar bàwɛm ndaa ayi.
Apan, u mbwo a an'kɔɔ a Antööm, idiim anà impà mbɔɔn byàkyer amɛnà uboo a un'sɛŋ a baar. Ba banswà sye bàkälà un'tüüb mwɛy uboo a un'lwaaŋ a an'ta a Salɔmun.
Wɛɛ akà mbuur asin wà nsà kàkwe anki mutüüb anà ba, wɛɛ un'sɛŋ kàkyer akanà mbɔɔn.
Lalan un'sɛŋ abaal anà akaar mbɔɔn bàsye làkwikilà amu Mwol, bàtüübà anà ba.
Ba sye bàtweyà baar an'kyal u mbwo, basyee udu a bitäb, taaŋ lumwɛy udu a bipɔy, ntɔn utaaŋ uyàlyaaŋ Petɔlà, munii ande ufwee itàkal umwɛy uboo a ba.
Un'sɛŋ a baar mbɔɔn bàfwee an'bul a tsütsü a Yɛlusàlɛm, bàtwäälà baar an'kyal anà baar bàkäl anà dweelà a làbe, ba banswà bàkyer akɔɔrà.
Apan, undweer a angaŋ anà baar banswà bàkäl anà nde, baar a un'tüüb a Asadusi, bàyöm mpem ntɔn Antööm,
waa bakör, basi u bɔlokà a baar banswà.
Wɛɛ uboboo a mpib, un'kyeey a Mwol kàduub ibeenà a bɔlokà, waa katwey anà mukàtɛn a ba naa:
«Làkyen, làmbär uboo a ndwà a Nzam, waa làkyään akà un'sɛŋ ndaa a mɔ̈ɔ̈ ayi yanswà.»

Ba bàkyer un'wem: ba bàkyen ututu tutu u ndwà a Nzam, waa bàsɛmà mulɔŋ. Undweer a angaŋ anà baar bàkäl anà nde bàbel baar a làbay a nsaŋ a kölàköl anà un'syääl a andweer a baan a Isàlɛl, waa bàtöm baar muwal Antööm u bɔlokà.
Wɛɛ utaaŋ ban'yà ba u bɔlokà, ba bamɛn anki. Ban'furà ba, ba bakyään
anà bàtɛn naa: «Bi bɔlokà ikàman làŋàdübà a kwab kwab, aseey bàkäl kà ikal aba kusà a munàmbwo. Wɛɛ umpal kan'duub bi, bi mbuur imɛn anki uboo.»
Mpal bàwɛm ba ndaa ayin, mfum a aleer a ndwà a Nzam anà amfum a angaŋ bàkäl kà ubem anà muyweer naa ndaa nà yàyeel antööm.
Wɛɛ mbuur mwɛy kayi mukasam naa: «Làler baar làbiil bɛ u bɔlokà, ba abanà uboo a ndwà a Nzam mukalɔɔŋà un'sɛŋ ndaa aba.»
Apan, mfum a aseey anà asyääl bàkàwal antööm a duu ntɔn ba bàmɛnà bɔɔmà naa manà baar balom in'kul.
Ungö batwääl ba, ba batɔ̈l u làbay a nsaŋ a kölàköl. Mfum a angaŋ kafuul naa:
«Nkye bi kàlatsüŋ anki mulɔŋ kà ikɔb aki? Wɛɛ bɛ, bɛ lan'yööl Yɛlusàlɛm anà an'lɔɔŋ abɛ, bɛ làkwen muwɔm an'kil a mbuur awà udu a bi!»
Petɔlà anà Antööm bumwɛy bafuur naa: «Yubwaŋ mulab Nzam wɛɛ kà baar anki.
Nzam a andweer abi kàwiiy Yɛsu akwà làdwä bɛ mpal lun'bɛɛrà bɛ u kulunsi.
Mbuur akwà kàsɛɛn Nzam u kɔɔ ande là ibaal asànaa nkum anà Un'tswää a mɔ̈ɔ̈ ntɔn mupà mbwo akà baar a Isàlɛl musɔɔmà anà muwal ndwääl a nkul a man'be aba.
Wɛɛ bi, bi ibà ambäl a ndaa ayi, bi anà Dweelà In'kyɛɛl kàpɛ Nzam akà baar bàfun'lab.»
Mpal bàwem ba ndaa ayin, un'fur a nkyɛl kàkyer awal, waa bàkwen mukadwa.
Wɛɛ kàkäl anà Umfarisi umwɛy uboo a ba, ikɔb ande Ngàmàlyɛl, un'lɔɔŋ a un'kɔɔn kàfakwenà un'sɛŋ wanswà, kàkyer ambarà, waa kàswɛŋ naa batwey ikikye antööm,
waa kàtɛn a ba naa: «Abaal a Isàlɛl, làkäl kà igyɛɛŋ ntɔn bɛ ŋakwo unsà undiir làkwen bɛ mukyer akà baar bà.

Lalan, itaan a mbɔɔn tɛy, mbuur mwɛy ikɔb ande Tɛwudas kàkyer ayàmɛnà, waa kàkyey uyɔl naa nde wà un'byääl. Isii a abaal nkam nà bàkyer un'lab. Wɛɛ nde bàkyer un'dwa, baar banswà bàkyer apay. Akà undiir kàfàkal anki.
Ungö a nde, utaaŋ musɔn ikɔb, mbuur mwɛy un'nsi Ngalilɛ kàkyer ayàmɛnà, ikɔb ande Yudas. Nde kàsyen un'sɛŋ a baar u mpey. Nde sye bàkyer un'dwa, baar bàkäl anà nde banswà bàkyer apay.
Wɛɛ apanà, mɛ in'tɛn a bɛ naa twon laläb, lawɛy ba bàkyen. Isàkal naa an'kyän anà isal aba byan'fà akà baar, bya ikyer ayàdiimà.
Wɛɛ, isàkal naa bya byan'fà akà Nzam, bɛ làkwe anki mudwa bya, naa tɛy, bɛ làyànwan sye a Nzam!» Ba bàsyääl an'kyän ande.
Abun, ba bàbel Antööm, bakäm an'füm, batsüŋ mutà ikɔb a Yɛsu din, waa bawɛy.
Apan sye, ba bàlwomà u làbay a nsaŋ a kölàköl unsà un'sak wanswà muman naa bàmatwey an'yɔl muman ntaan ntɔn ikɔb a Yɛsu.
Abun, ilä byanswà uboo a ndwà a Nzam anà uboo a ndwà a baar, ba bàwɛy anki mulɔŋ anà mupay Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ là Klistɔ Yɛsu.
Kà ilä abin, ntal a alɔŋki yàkyer alaar, yàmɛnà naa bà Elɛnit bàkäl anki un'sak anà bà Ɛbɛlyɔ ntɔn akweel adim aba bayɔbà anki taaŋ lanswà unsà nkääb a indiir a ilä a ilä.
Lalan Bàkwem Aŋiyweel bàtüüb ba un'kàbɔ a alɔŋki, waa bàtɛn a ba naa: «Kà yubwaŋ anki naa bi iwɛy ndaa a Nzam ntɔn mukab isaa adyà.
Abun, làsɔ̈ɔ̈l uboo a bɛ baar nsambwaar abye anà imbäl aŋàbwaŋ bàŋàyɔl a Dweelà anà an'yeerà, waa bi iyapà isal aki.
Ntɔn bi, bi iyàlab mupà taaŋ abi u ngyamàkà anà mulɔŋ Ndaa.»

Nköŋ yanswà yàkyey an'kyän amà: Ba bàsɔ̈ɔ̈l Ityen, mbuur aŋàyɔl a làkwikilà anà Dweelà In'kyɛɛl, anà Filipo, Pɔlɔkɔr, Nikanɔr, Timɔnà, Palàmɛnas anà Nikɔlà un'nsi Antyɔsha kàbulà un'yudà unsà inzaam.
Ba baswɛŋ akà Antööm, Antööm bàyamà ntɔn ba, waa basi an'kɔɔ.
Apan, ndaa a Nzam yàpää aŋàsöönà. Ntal a alɔŋki yàbulà ya mbɔɔn a mbɔɔn u Yɛlusàlɛm, un'sɛŋ a angaŋ mbɔɔn kàläb làkwikilà.
Abun, Ityen kàkäl aŋàyɔl a kab a ngway anà ngwal, nde kàkyerà impà anà idiim a kölàköl uboo a un'sɛŋ.
Wɛɛ baar amwɛy uboo a baar a ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà bàfabeelà naa asɔ aŋàtsuŋà, anà baar a Sirɛn anà Alɛksandri anà Silisi anà Azi, ba bàsɛmà musyeel mbaaŋ anà Ityen.
Wɛɛ ba bàkwe anki mutɔn an'yeerà anà Dweelà kàsyäälà nde mutɛn.
Ba bàpɛɛ baar nsɛm ntɔn ba bàtɛn naa: «Bi kan'wem, nde wàmubɛy Mɔsɛ anà Nzam.»
Apan, ba bàsiinà un'sɛŋ anà andweer anà alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn, waa bàyi, bàkör Ityen kà imbürà, waa bun'syen u làbay a nsaŋ a kölàköl.
Akun, ba bun'twääl ambäl a loor bàtɛn naa: «Mbuur wà usàwɛy anki mutɛn ndaa a mbe akà ikal abi kyà in'kyɛɛl anà akà Un'kɔɔn.
Bi kàwem u mun ande naa Yɛsu, un'nazɔrya wà, ayàbwaab Ikal ki anà ayàsɔɔm nkääl abi kàsiwɛɛy Mɔsɛ.»
Apan baar banswà bàkäl mutsul nsaŋ u làbay a nsaŋ a kölàköl, ileer aba byàkäl akà Ityɛn, ba bàmɛn ntabwey ande asànaa ntabwey a un'kyeey.
Mfum a angaŋ kun'fuul naa: «Nkye ndaa ya bàkatɛɛnà yi a ngye yà ndandaa?»
Wɛɛ Ityen kàfuur naa: «Atɔŋ anà bàtaa, lan'wem. Nzam a làkoo kàyàmɛnà akà taaràbi Abàlam umpal kàkäl nde u Mɛsɔpɔtami, kusà nde mukàkal u Aran.
Waa nde kun'sam naa: "Lwomà u bul angye anà ywar angye, kyen bul alà in'yaswaŋ mɛ."
Abun, Abàlam kàlwomà u bul aba Syaldɛyɛn mukàkal u Aran. Akun, ungö a nkweel a taarànde, Nzam kàyun'tɔl u nsi làbà bɛ yi ŋàbà.
Abun, nde kun'pɛ anki akà ywaŋ mwɛy, itàkal itiir a mɛɛn, wɛɛ nde kun'pɛ ilää mukun'pà mɛɛn ande anà baan ande ungö a nkweel ande. Wɛɛ Abàlam kàkäl anki anà mwan.
Kyakin Nzam kun'kyään naa: "Ikyee ande bàsàkal u nsi a baar asin, ba bàsàbulà asɔ anà bàsatà an'kaal mbul nkam nà.
Wɛɛ mɛ in'sàtsul nsaŋ a nsi ayisàbuul ba asɔ. Ungö a indiir abi, ba bàkyer asàtoo anà bàsan'syaŋà kà ikal aki."

Ungö apan Nzam kàdi nkwà anà nde, idiim a wa kyàkäl nkyɛɛy. Kyakin Abàlam kàkyɛy nde mwan ande Izak kà ilä kyà naan ungö a mböör ande. Izak sye kàkyer abun akà Yakɔb, Yakɔb waa kàkyer akà ankum bà kwem aŋiyweel.
Ankum bàyöm mpem ntɔn Yɔsɛfi, ba bàkyer un'yälà ntɔn bun'syen Ngipiti. Wɛɛ Nzam kàkäl anà nde.
Abun, nde kun'lwom uboo a ngyɛb, waa kun'pɛ kab anà an'yeerà kusà a Falawɔ, mfum a Ngipiti, nde kun'si mfum ikikye u Ngipiti anà udu a ndwà ande yanswà.
Wɛɛ umpal ayin, ngyal mbɔɔn yàbilà u Ngipiti wanswà anà u Kanana. Ngyɛb yàkäl mbɔɔn, bàtaaràbi bàmɛnà anki isaa adyà.
Mpal kàyöb Yakɔb naa isaa byàkäl u Ngipiti, nde kàtöm bàtaaràbi u mbalà atàtwɛb.
U mbalà yàyweel, nde kàkyer naa atɔŋ ande bun'yöb, apan Falawɔ waa kàyöb ntsü kàfü Yɔsɛfi.
Ungö apan Yɔsɛfi katöm mukàbel taarànde Yakɔb anà ywar ande lanswà, ba bàkäl baar an'kwem nsambwaar aŋityeen.
Apan, Yakɔb kàtyà Ngipiti, waa kàkàkwà kwo anà bàtaaràbi,
waa basyen u Sishɛm, batɔ̈ɔ̈l uboo a an'lom kàsöm Abàlam a ngim akà baan a Amɔr, taar a Sishɛm.
Ungö apan, taaŋ kàsi Nzam ntɔn ilää kàpɛ nde akà Abàlam kyàkäl tsütsü mukwo, un'sɛŋ kàkyer ayɛl, baar bàbulà mbɔɔn u Ngipiti
tii umpal kàwɛl mfum asin imfum u Ngipiti. Nde Yɔsɛfi kàsun'yöb anki.
Mfum awà kàkür un'sɛŋ abi anà kàpɛ bànkaa abi mpay muswaŋ ba a ngwal mupiy baan a kɔɔ aba ntɔn ba bàkü.
Umpal ayin bàbör ba Mɔsɛ awà kàkäl ntwɛn mbɔɔn u mii a Nzam. Nde bun'bɔɔŋ ngɔn tär u ndwà a taarànde.
Mpal bàkun'tɔɔl ba, mwan a Falawɔ wun'kaar laa kun'wɛl nde, waa kun'ywaaŋ nkà.
Mɔsɛ bun'lɔŋ unsà an'yeerà a baar a Ngipiti manswà. Nde kàkäl un'te baal unsà ntɛɛn anà unsà nsyääl ande.
Mpal kàkölà nde mbul an'kwem an'nà, ankyän màyi u mpem ande mukàler atɔŋ ande baan a Isàlɛl.
Akun nde kàmɛn mbuur mwɛy wàmukyerà mwan a Isàlɛl mwɛy ube, nde kàwɛɛl mbuur bàkyeer ube wà, waa kàdwä Un'ngipiti wa.
Abun nde kàsii muswaŋ atɔŋ ande naa u mbwo ande Nzam kàlatswà mɔ̈ɔ̈, wɛɛ ba bàsàyöb anki.
Wɛɛ ilä kyàlääb paa, nde an'kàmɛnà akà ba mpal bàkäl ba munwan ba a ba, nde waa katsuuŋ, waa kàtɛn a ba naa: "Abaal, bɛ làbà atɔŋ, ntɔn nkye làkyerà bɛ ube bɛ a bɛ?"
Wɛɛ mbuur akwà kàkyerà un'tɔŋ ande ube kàtön Mɔsɛ, waa kàtɛn a nde naa: "Nà kasi mfum anà ntɛɛn udu a bi?
Nkye ngye akwen mukan'dwa asànaa kàdwä ngye un'ngipiti ywenà?"
Ntɔn ndaa ayi, Mɔsɛ laa kàtiin nde, waa kàkàbwaay u nsi a Madyani, mper kàbör nde baan abaal bɔ̈ɔ̈l.
Ungö a mbul an'kwem an'nà, un'kyeey mwey kàkàmɛnà akà nde u nsye a ipɔl yà mɔŋ a Sinayi uboo a làlɛm a mbaa a ibwiy.
Mpal kàmɛn Mɔsɛ abun, nde kàbem mbɔɔn ntɔn iman mii akin. Wɛɛ mpal kàsin nde tsütsü muler naa nkye ikalyaaŋà, nde kàwɛm ndaa a Mwol yàmutɛn naa:
Mɛ in'wà Nzam a bàtaaràŋà, Nzam a Abàlam, a Izak anà wà Yakɔb. Mɔsɛ kàkyer atɛɛr a bɔɔmà, kàfàkwo anki muler.
Apan, Mwol waa kun'sam naa: "Lwoom idyaar abyà kà in'kɔl angye, ntɔn ikal awà ngye kin mà mɛɛn in'kyɛɛl.
Mɛ kàkyàman mpay a un'sɛŋ amɛ u Ngipiti anà in'tär aba. Lalan mɛ an'yàtyà ntɔn mukatsuuŋ. Kyen apanà, mɛ inkwen mukatɔm u Ngipiti."
Mɔsɛ awà, ba bàkyer un'tɔn, waa bàtɛn a nde naa: "Nà kasi mfum anà ntɛɛn?" Nzam kàkyer un'tɔm asànaa mfum anà ntɛɛn, u mbwo a un'kyeey akwà kàyamɛnà akà nde uboo a ibwiy.
Nde mbuur awà kàtwey baan a Isàlɛl, mukyer impà anà idiim u Ngipiti, u ngyäl a tsöö anà u nsye a ipɔl mbul an'kwem an'nà.
Mɔsɛ nsil awà kàtɛn a baan a Isàlɛl naa: "Nzam ayàtwey ŋangɔɔm mwɛy asànaa mɛ uboo a atɔŋ abɛ."
Mbuur nsil awà, utaaŋ a nköŋ u nsye a ipɔl, nde kàkäl nkalsà a bànkaa abi anà un'kyeey akwà kàtɛɛnà a nde udu a mɔŋ a Sinayi, nde mbuur kàwɛlà ndaa a mɔ̈ɔ̈ ntɔn mupà akà bi.
Wɛɛ bànkaa abi bàkwen anki mukun'wem, ba bàkyer un'tɔn, an'kyän aba màfurà Ngipiti.
Abun, ba bàtɛn a Alɔn naa: "Ikyeer bànzam bàyàkal kusà abi, ntɔn bi iyöb anki naa Mɔsɛ akwà kà itwey u Ngipiti nkye kan'bulà."
Apan, ba bàkyer un'tö a ngɔɔmà, waa bàpɛɛ ibɔɔn akà wa, bàyakyerà un'kyɔm a indiir bàkyerà ba a an'kɔɔ aba.

Wɛɛ Nzam kapɛ ngö, waa kawɛy musyäŋà indiir a du, asànaa bàsön uboo a un'kaan a aŋangɔɔm naa: "In'sɛŋ a Isàlɛl, nkye kà akà mɛ anki bɛ làpɛɛ ntsür anà ibɔɔn asin mbul an'kwem an'nà u nsye a ipɔl?
Wɛɛ bɛ làbwäär ntɛn a Mɔlɔk anà mbwaar a nzam abɛ Rɛfan, abi itɛk làkyer bɛ ntɔn bɛ làsyeel bya làkoo. Kyakin, mɛ in'sàkàlasà asɔ lyaaŋ Babilɔn."
U nsye a ipɔl bànkaa abi bàkäl anà ntɛn a imbäl. Mbuur kàyäämà a Mɔsɛ kun'swɛŋ naa nde ukyer wa asànaa idiim kàmɛn nde.
Umpal bàwɛl bàtaa abi ya, ba anà Yɔswa bàbiil ya u mɛɛn a in'sɛŋ kàböŋ Nzam kusà aba. Ya yàkäl kwo tii upaŋà a David.
David kàwɛl kab angway akà Nzam, waa kàlɔ̈m akà nde ikal mutɔŋ ndwà in'kyɛɛl ntɔn ywar a Yakɔb.
Wɛɛ mbuur kun'tööŋ ndwà Salɔmun.
Wɛɛ Nzam a dudu afàbɔ̈ɔ̈n anki u ndwà bàtöŋ baar kà an'kɔɔ aba, asànaa kàtɛn nde u mun a ŋangɔɔm naa:

Du là kir a imfum amɛ, mɛɛn mà ikal in'fàsà mɛ in'kɔl amɛ. Ndwà nà bɛ lan'kwo mutööŋ mɛ? Itàkal naa ikal nà mɛ an'kwo muyöör?
2c0732003c	Nkye kà an'kɔɔ amɛ anki màkyer indiir abi byanswà?
Bɛ, baar a ibway aŋàbwà un'sey, mpa bàkyɛy mpem anà an'tsü, bɛ làfàmbäär Dweelà In'kyɛɛl taaŋ lanswà! Bɛ, bɛ làbà asànaa bànkaa abɛ.
Uboo a aŋangɔɔm banswà, nà bànkaa abɛ mpa bàmɛɛy nkwaaŋ? Ba bàdwä baar abà bàkyäänà kusà a ngyeel a mbuur a balàbal mwɛy mpɛl. Wɛɛ ŋàbawà bɛ, bɛ làmun'yälà anà làmun'dwa.
Bɛ baar làwɛl un'kɔɔn u mbwo a akyeey, wɛɛ bɛ, bɛ wa làfàlab anki!»
Mpal bàwem ba indiir abi, un'fur a nkyɛl kàwɛl mpem aba, waa bàkwoorà an'din.
Wɛɛ nde, nde kàkäl aŋàyɔl a Dweelà In'kyɛɛl, waa kàsyebà du, kàmɛn làkoo a Nzam anà Yɛsu kàkyàbwaay u kɔɔ a Nzam là ibaal.
Waa kàtɛn naa: «Làler, mɛ in'wàmumanà an'du màŋàduub, Mwan a mbuur wàŋàbwaay u kɔɔ a Nzam là ibaal.»
Apan, ba bàsi in'kwɛŋ, waa bàdübà an'tsü. Ba banswà waa bun'bürà,
bun'syen u nsà a bul, waa bun'kämà in'kul. Ambäl ipfɛy aba bàtɔ̈ɔ̈là kà in'kɔl a mwan baal mwɛy ikɔb ande Sɔl.
Mpal bàkäl ba mukun'lomà in'kul, Ityen kàyamà naa: «Mwol Yɛsu, wal dweelà amɛ!»
Apan, nde kàbü an'köm, waa kàlaal: «Mwol, twon an'tälà buur a ube bà udu a ba!» Ungö mutɛn abà, nde waa kàkü.
Wɛɛ Sɔl kàkyer akyey nkweel a Ityen. Ilä nsil akin nkwaaŋ a ngwal yàsɛmà ntɔn Ikööŋ a Yɛlusàlɛm. Baar bàkyey ndaa a Nzam banswà bàtɛ upay u Yuday anà u Samàlya. Antööm mpɛl bàsàsal.
Apan, baar a mpem aŋàbwaŋ bàdyee Ityen, waa bun'lel mbɔɔn.
Wɛɛ Sɔl kàkyer ngwal mudwa Ikööŋ, nde kàyibilà u ndwà mukɔr abaal anà akaar anà mukabiil u bɔlokà.
Baar abà bàpää bàyilyaaŋà ntsü anà ntsü mupay Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ là Ndaa.
Lalan Filipo kàkyen nde bul mwɛy là Samalya mukyään ba làsaŋ a Klistɔ.
Apan, unsà un'tüüb, in'sɛŋ a baar myàkäl maàŋàbääb u ndaa kàtɛɛnà Filipo ntɔn ba bàweemà anà bàmɛnà impà kàkyerà nde.
Abun, an'dweelà an'be màkyer atɔɔ akà baar bàkäl anà ma u ndaa a ngwal. Baar aŋàkwɛkà anà ikar bàkyer akɔɔrà.
Lalan, un'sak kàkäl wàmbɔɔn u bul alan.
Wɛɛ u bul alan kàfwel anà mbuur mwɛy ikɔb ande Simɔn. Nde kàfakyerà inwɛŋ anà kàbemà ngwal un'sɛŋ a Samàlya. Nde kakyeyà uyɔl naa nde mpɛl awà mbuur a kölàköl.
Apan, baar banswà, sɛmà baan akye tii akà andweer, bun'wemà unsà igyɛɛŋ kyanswà mutɛɛnà naa: «Mbuur awà wà ngwal a Nzam ayà bàfàbel naa: "Ngwal a kölàköl."»
Ba bun'weemà kà igyɛɛŋ, ntɔn ba bàbemà inwɛŋ ande taaŋ mbɔɔn.
Wɛɛ umpal bàkyey ba Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ là imfum a Nzam anà ikɔb a Yɛsu Klistɔ kàlɔɔŋà Filipo, abaal anà akaar bàwɛl ndüümà.
Simɔn ŋakwo sye kàsi làkwikilà, waa kàwɛl ndüümà, wɛɛ nde Filipo kun'wɛy anki, ntɔn nde kàkyer abemà muman idiim anà ndaa a ngwal yàlyaaŋà.
Mpal ban'wem Antööm bàkäl u Yɛlusàlɛm naa baar a Samàlya ban'kyey Ndaa a Nzam, ba batööm Petɔlà anà Ywan.
Mpal bàyàkɔlà ba u Samàlya, ba bàyamà ntɔn ba naa ba bàwɛl Dweelà In'kyɛɛl.
Ntɔn Dweelà In'kyɛɛl kàkäl aŋàtàyàtyà anki akà udu a umwɛy uboo a ba: ba badümà mpɛl kà ikɔb a Mwol Yɛsu.
Abun, Petɔlà anà Ywan bàsi an'kɔɔ, ba waa bàwɛl Dweelà In'kyɛɛl.
Abà kàmɛn Simɔn naa baar bàwɛlà Dweelà mpal basi Antööm an'kɔɔ, nde kàpɛ Petɔlà anà Ywan in'naaŋ,
waa kàtɛn naa: «Lan'pɛ mɛ sye ikɔ̈b, ntɔn taaŋ in'yasaa mɛ baar an'kɔɔ ba sye bàwɛl Dweelà In'kyɛɛl.»
Wɛɛ Petɔlà kun'fuur naa: «Wɛy ngim angye ikü anà ngye ŋakwo ntɔn ngye akasii naa kab a Nzam bàfàsom a in'naaŋ!
Uboo a ndaa ayi, ngye akà kitiir, akà yar latɛy, ntɔn mpem angye kà yàbalàbal anki kusà a Nzam.
Buul mpem angye, yamà Mwol ntɔn u taaŋ lumwɛy, nde akyer awem ngyɛb unsà an'kyän awà ngye amà.
Mɛ an'man naa ndandaa ngye awɛ anà ube bàŋàsöön anà ngye awà un'sɔ a ube.»
Waa Simɔn kàtɛn naa: «Bɛ ŋakwo làyamà Mwol ntɔn mɛ, ntɔn undiir mwɛy ukɔ̈ɔ̈n ayà unsà ya yanswà lan'tɛn bɛ yi.»
Ungö mutà imbäl anà mulɔŋ ndaa a Mwol, ba bàfurà Yɛlusàlɛm. U mbwo ba bàyipayà Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ uboo an'bul mbɔɔn mà Samàlya.
Yàmɛnà naa un'kyeey a Mwol mwɛy kàyääm anà Filipo, waa kàtɛn naa: «Mbarà, kyen ntsü a ngyɛl, u mbwo ifàtyà sɛmà Yɛlusàlɛm tii u Gaza. Mbwo ayi yà ipɔl.»

Apan Filipo waa kàmbarà, kàkyen agyägyä. Kyekà yɔl mwɛy wà Ɛtyɔpi, mbuur a isal a kölàköl, isal ande musyäl un'naaŋ a Kandase, mfum un'kaar a Ɛtyɔpi, nde kàfü Yɛlusàlɛm ntɔn mukàkömà Nzam.
Mpal kàfurà nde, nde kàkäl aŋàbwaay udu a shar wàmutaŋ un'kaan a ŋangɔɔm Yɛsay.
Dweelà waa kàtɛn a Filipo naa: «Sin, kabweey a shar lanà.»
Apan, Filipo kàkyà ntiin, waa kàwem mbuur a Ɛtyɔpi wàmutaŋ u ndaa a ngwal un'kaan a ŋangɔɔm Yɛsay. Filipo waa kun'fuul naa: «Nkye ngye akiyöbà ndaa akataŋà ngye yi?»
Nde kàfuur naa: «Mɛ an'kwo muyöb aben, isàkal naa mbuur kan'buul anki?» Nde kàlɔ̈ɔ̈m Filipo mulaar anà mubwaay ukɔl a nde.
Itiir a ndaa kàtäŋà nde kyaki: «Nde kàkäl asànaa un'kɔk bàfàsyen kà idwääl, asànaa mwan a un'kɔk mpa afàsà ndaa kusà a mbuur awà kun'kɔɔlà in'kà. Lalan nde mun ufàduub anki.
Uboo a làbɔ̈ɔ̈n ande, nde kàwɛl anki iböŋ. Nà kan'kwo mutɛn ntɔn ikyee ande? Ntɔn mɔ̈ɔ̈ ande bàkyer alwom u mɛɛn.»
Wɛɛ yɔl a Ɛtyɔpi kàfuul Filipo naa: «Mɛ amabɔɔn, nkyään, ntɔn nà ŋangɔɔm ukatɛɛnà nde abà? Ntɔn nde ŋakwo lɛɛ ntɔn mbuur asin?»
Filipo kàduub mun, waa kàsɛmà kà itiir a ndaa aŋàsɔn aki, mukun'kyään Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ là Yɛsu.
Ba bàkäl mulab mbwo aba, waa bàkɔlà kà ikal mwɛy kyàkäl anà an'dà. Yɔl awà kàtɛn naa: «Le an'dà, undiir nà kan'kɔɔn mukan'dümà?»
Apan, Filipo waa kàtɛn a nde naa: «Isàkal naa ngye an'kyey u mpem angye yanswà, ngye an'kwo awɛl ndüümà.» Mbuur awà waa kàfuur naa: «Mɛ an'kyey naa Yɛsu Klistɔ wà Mwan a Nzam.»
Apan nde kàswɛŋ mubäm shar ande. Ba bàbɔ̈ɔ̈l, Filipo anà yɔl, bàtɔlà kan'dà, waa Filipo kun'dümà.
Umpal bàtoo ba kà an'dà, Dweelà a Mwol kàsyen Filipo, yɔl kàfun'man anki. Wɛɛ nde kàläb mbwo ande unsà un'sak.
Apan, Filipo kàkàmɛnà u Azɔt, nde kàyipayà Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ kà an'bul manswà kàlyaaŋà nde tii u Sɛzarɛ.
Yàmɛnà naa utaaŋ alan, Sɔl kàkwen anki uwɛy mupà alɔŋki a Mwol mpay a ukwà. Nde kàkàman undweer a angaŋ,
ntɔn mulɔm in'kaan mubilà u ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà u Damas, isàkal naa nde kan'man baar, itàkal abaal itàkal akaar abà bàläbà Mbwo, nde waa kakɔr anà katwääl u Yɛlusàlɛm.
Wɛɛ mpal kàkäl nde u mbwo tsütsü a Damas, kà imbürà, un'ŋyäŋ a pɛɛlà kàfü du, waa kun'diŋà.
Nde kàbü u mɛɛn, waa kàwem ndaa yàmutɛɛnà a nde naa: «Sɔl, Sɔl, ntɔn nkye an'mɛɛyà ngye nkwaaŋ?»
Nde kàfuul naa: «Ngye awà nà, Mwol?» Ndaa waa itɛn naa: «Ɛɛ, mɛ in'wà Yɛsu akwà ngye, afàmɛɛy ngye nkwaaŋ.
Wɛɛ mbarà, bilà uboo a bul, bàkyer akakyään undiir ayàkyer ngye kwo.»
Abaal kàyilyaaŋà nde abà, bàkyer atsum mun, ba bàweemà ndaa, wɛɛ ba mbuur bàmɛn anki.
Sɔl kàsubà u mɛɛn, itàkal naa mii ande myàkäl myàŋàduub, nde undiir kàmɛnà anki. Ba bun'te mpi u kɔɔ ntɔn mukun'syen Damas.
Nde kàkäl ilä itär ukɔɔn aman, ukɔɔn adyà anà ukɔɔn anwà.
Kyekà kàkäl anà un'lɔŋki mwɛy u Damas ikɔb ande Ananyas. Mwol kàkàmɛnà akà nde unsà imanmii, waa kàtɛn a nde naa: «Ananyas!» Nde kàfuur naa: «Mɛ awà, Mwol.»
Mwol kàtɛn a nde naa: «Kyen uboo a balàbal bàfàbel balàbal a lää, u ndwà a Yudasi, fuul mbuur mwɛy wà Tarsɛ ikɔb ande Sɔl. Nde wàmukayamà taaŋ nsil alà,
wɛɛ uboo a imanmii, nde kan'man mbuur mwɛy ikɔb ande Ananyas wàmubilà anà kàmusà an'kɔɔ ntɔn nde ufàman.»
Ananyas waa ufuur naa: «Mwol, mɛ an'wem akà baar mbɔɔn ube banswà kàkyer mbuur awà akà aŋin'kyɛɛl angye u Yɛlusàlɛm.
Kyakin, apà nde kan'yà anà ikɔ̈b bun'pɛ amfum a angaŋ mukɔr baar banswà bàkayamà ikɔb angye.»
Wɛɛ Mwol kàtɛn a nde naa: «Kyen, ntɔn mbuur awà mɛ amun'sɔɔl asànaa un'syääl amɛ musyen ikɔb amɛ kusà a baar mpa abà Ayudà, kusà a amfum anà kusà a baan a Isàlɛl.
Mɛ ŋakwo in'yun'swaŋ indiir byanswà usàman nde mpay ntɔn mɛ.»

Ananyas waa kàkyen. Nde kàbilà u ndwà, kun'si an'kɔɔ, waa kàtɛn a nde naa: «Sɔl, un'tɔŋ amɛ, Mwol kàman'tɔm, Yɛsu akwà kàyàmɛnà akà ngye u mbwo kàfü ngye, ntɔn ngye afàman anà akäl aŋàyɔl a Dweelà In'kyɛɛl.»
Utaaŋ nsil alan, indiir imwɛy asànaa ibal byàbwee fà mii a Sɔl, laa kàfàman nde. Nde waa kambarà, waa bun'dümà.
Ungö apan nde kàkyer adyà, waa kàwɛl ngwal. Sɔl kàkäl ndam a ilä anà alɔŋki bàkäl u Damas.
Itaan a mbɔɔn anki, nde kàsɛmà mukyään uboo a ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà naa Yɛsu wà Mwan a Nzam.

Apan, baar banswà bàweemà nde bàkäl unsà ubem, waa bàtɛɛnà naa: «Nkye wunà kà mbuur akwà anki kàmɛɛyà baar bàfàbel ikɔb aki kwaaŋ u Yɛlusàlɛm? Nkye apà nde kàyi anki ntɔn mukɔr anà musyen ba akamfum a angaŋ?»
Wɛɛ Sɔl kàkäl ngwal mbɔɔn muswaŋ akà Ayudà bàkäl u Damas naa Yɛsu wà Klistɔ.
Ungö a ilä mbɔɔn, Ayudà banswà bàdirà mukun'dwa.
Wɛɛ Sɔl kàyöb ndaa ayin. Mpib anà mwäänà, ba bàkaseyà ibeenà a bul alà, ntɔn mukun'dwa.
Abun, alɔŋki a Sɔl bun'syen u mpib ntɔn mukun'sweey u ntsü yumwɛy yà ibää a bul. Ba bun'twey uboo a un'tɛr.
Mpal kan'kɔlà nde u Yɛlusàlɛm, Sɔl kàsi mutüüb anà alɔŋki. Wɛɛ ba banswà bàkäl u bɔɔmà, ntɔn ba bàkyey anki naa nde akyàbulà un'lɔŋki ndandaa.
Abun, Banàbasi waa kun'wɛl, kun'syen akà Antööm, waa kasam ndaa kàmɛn Sɔl Mwol u mbwo anà kàyääm nde anà nde. Nde kasam sye naa Sɔl kàlɔŋ anà uyɔl kà ikɔb a Yɛsu u Damas.
Sɛmà apan, Sɔl kàkälà anà ba u Yɛlusàlɛm anà mulɔŋà anà nuyɔl kà ikɔb a Mwol.
Nde sye kayakyäänà Ayudà bàfatɛɛnà Ingɛlɛki anà kàfasaa mbaaŋ anà ba. Wɛɛ ba bàlɛŋà mukun'dwa.
Mpal ban'wem atɔŋ ndaa ayi, ba bun'syen Sɛzarɛ, akun ba bun'töm Tarse.
U Yuday lanswà, sɛmà Ngalilɛ anà Samàlya, Ikööŋ kyanswà kyàkäl unsà duu, kyàwɛlà ngwal, kyàwemà Mwol bɔɔmà, anà kyàyɛlà u ngwal a Dweelà In'kyɛɛl.
Yàmɛnà naa Petɔlà kàfilyaŋà ntsü yanswà, waa kàtyà sye akà baar in'kyɛɛl bàkäl u Lidà.
Nde kàmɛn mbuur mwɛy kwo ikɔb ande Ɛnɛ, wàŋàbɔ̈ɔ̈n udu a ntäŋ, fà mbul naan nde kàkäl aŋàkwɛkà.
Petɔlà kàtɛn a nde naa: «Ɛnɛ, Yɛsu Klistɔ kàmakɔɔr! Mbarà, bwɛlà ntäŋ angye, ngye ŋakwo.» Apan sye, Ɛnɛ waa kambarà.
Mpal bun'mɛn baar a Lidà anà baar a Sarɔn banswà, ba bàbuul mpem aba amu Mwol.
U Yɔpɛ kàkäl anà un'lɔŋki mwɛy wà un'kaar ikɔb ande Tabità, ikaswaŋà naa Dɔkasi u ndaa aba, waa ifiswaŋà naa Nsey. Taaŋ lanswà nde kàfakyerà ndaa aŋàbwaŋ anà kàfabayà aŋàlàmbwà.
Umpal ayin, nde kàkyer abɛɛl, waa kàkü. Ungö mukun'ywɛy, ba bun'si u suk adu.
