Mpal bàwem alɔŋki a Yɔpɛ naa Petɔlà wà u Lidà, bul a tsütsü anà ba, ba bàtöm abaal abɔ̈ɔ̈l ntɔn mukun'bel anà mutɛn naa: «Bi kàmabɔɔn, yà akà bi làgyägyä.»

Apan, Petɔlà waa kàmbarà, waa kàkyen anà ba. Umpal kàkɔlà nde, ba bun'syen u suk adu. Akweel adim bàyi kusà a nde, bàmulel anà muswaŋ ba inkur anà ipfɛy a mpye kàfakyerà Dɔkasi mpal bàkäl ba banswà.
Apan, Petɔlà kàtwey baar banswà, nde kàbü an'köm, kàyamà, waa kàbulà ntsü yàkäl ndom anà mutɛn naa: «Tabità, mbarà!» Nde kàduub mii, mpal kàmɛn nde Petɔlà, waa kàbwaay.
Abun, Petɔlà kàsilà kɔɔ ande, waa kun'mbaar. Nde kàbel baar in'kyɛɛl anà akweel adim, waa kun'mɛɛy, wà mɔ̈ɔ̈.
Baar a Yɔpɛ banswà bàwem ba ndaa ayi, bàmbɔɔn bàsi làkwikilà akà Mwol.
Petɔlà kàkäl ilä mbɔɔn u Yɔpɛ akà un'kwaam a ibaan, ikɔb ande Simɔn.
U Sԑzarԑ kàkäl anà mbuur mwԑy ikↄb ande Kↄlↄnԑlyↄ. Nde kàkäl kaptԑn a iköŋ a aŋità a Lↄmà bàfàbel naa «iköŋ a Itali.»
Nde kàkäl anà inzaam, nde anà ywar ande lanswà bàweemà Nzam bɔɔmà. Nde kàfabayà baar mbɔɔn anà kàfayamà Nzam taaŋ lanswà.
Ilä mwԑy, u ntsü a taaŋ làtär ungö a midi, nde kàmԑn ubwaŋàbwaŋ unsà imanmii un'kyeey a Nzam mwԑy kan'yàbilà u ndwà ande, waa kan'tɛn a nde naa: «Kↄlↄnԑlyↄ!»
Kɔlɔnɛlyɔ kun'ler a lää, kun'wem bↄↄmà, waa kun'fuul naa: «Mwol, ininà abi?» Un'kyeey waa kun'fuur naa: «Ngyamàkà angye anà nkääb angye yàkyàbeenà u mii a Nzam, nde waa kan'yɔbà ya.
Wɛɛ apanà, tↄm baar u Yↄpԑ mukàbel mbuur mwɛy ikɔb ande Simↄn, bàfun'bel Petↄlà.
Nde afàbɔ̈ɔ̈n u ndwà a mbuur mwԑy ikɔb ande Simↄn, nde wà un'kwaam a ibaan a ntsür. Ndwà ande yà kà un'kɔɔl a ngyäl a kölàköl.»
Ungö a nkyeen a un'kyeey kàyun'kyään ndaa ayi, Kↄlↄnԑlyↄ kàbel asyääl ande abɔ̈ɔ̈l anà ŋità mwԑy kàkäl anà inzaam anà kàkäl wàŋàbääb anà nde taaŋ mbɔɔn.
Ungö mukakyään indiir byanswà byalyaaŋ, nde katöm Yↄpԑ.
U taaŋtyà, ba bàkäl u mbwo, tsütsü a Yↄpԑ, Petɔlà kàlär kà ikal bàfàyöör mper a midi ntↄn muyamà.
Nde kàwem ngyal, waa kàkwen mudyà. Mpal bàkäl ba mukun'läämà isaa, nde kàmԑn imanmii.
Nde kàmԑn du lan'dubà, undiir mwԑy asànaa yar a ipfԑy a kölàköl làŋàbääm in'siŋ kà an'twɛrà man'nà, lan'yàtyà anà lan'yàtↄlà u mԑԑn.
Uboo a la yàkäl anà ntsür a ifà ifà: ntsür a in'kɔl in'nà, ntsür ifilaan u mԑԑn anà nԑn a du.
Ndaa mwԑy yàtɛn a nde naa: «Petↄlà, mbarà, dwa anà dyà!»
Wԑԑ Petɔlà kàfuur naa: «Mwol, ikwo anki akà ikikye, ntɔn mԑ ŋàtàdyà anki undiir wanswà wàlàbiin anà wàŋingyäy.»
Wɛɛ nde an'fàwem ndaa mbalà yàyweel: «Ngye, twon an'bel ŋingyäy indiir kan'pööŋ Nzam.»
Ya yàkɔlà mbalà tär, ungö apan, undiir awun bàfuur u du.
Petↄlà kàkäl unsà lingyoomà anà muyweerà nde ŋakwo naa imanmii kàmԑn nde ki ikaswaŋà aben. Kyekà taaŋ nsil alan, baar kàtöm Kↄlↄnԑlyↄ bàkäl u munàmbwo bàmufuulà ndwà a Simↄn.
Ba bàbel u ndaa a ngwal, waa bàfuul naa: «Nkye Simↄn awà bàfàbel naa Petↄlà afàbɔ̈ɔ̈n apà?»
Apan Petↄlà kàkäl mukayweerà u mpem ande ntↄn imanmii akyà kàmԑn nde ki, Dweelà kàtɛn a nde naa: «Le, baar atär bàmukaleŋà.
Mbarà, tyà, kyen mbwo mwԑy anà ba ukɔɔn nkyɛɛr, ntↄn ba mԑ, mɛ amatↄm.»
Undiir awun, Petↄlà kàtɔlà nde, waa kàtɛn a baar aban naa: «Le, mԑ in'wà mbuur làleŋà bԑ. Ntɔn nkye làyi bɛ?»

Ba bàtɛn naa: «Kaptɛn Kↄlↄnԑlyↄ kàmitↄm. Nde wà mbuur mwԑy wà balàbal anà afàtiin Nzam bɔɔmà. Nde sye we anà imbäl aŋàbwaŋ akà un'sԑŋ a Ayudà wanswà. Un'kyeey in'kyɛɛl mwԑy kun'swԑŋ naa nde akyer ayabel u ndwà ande, ntↄn ngye awem ndaa awà nde ayà mukakyään.»
Apan, Petɔlà waa kabiil anà kapɛ ikal abɔ̈ɔ̈n. Taaŋtyà nde kàkyen anà ba mbwo mwɛy anà atɔŋ amwɛy bà Yɔpɛ.
Kà ilä kyàlääb, nde kàkɔlà Sɛzarɛ. Kɔlɔnɛlyɔ awà kàkäl mudilà ba, kàbel ywar ande anà asam ande bànkwen.
Umpal kàkɔlà Petɔlà, Kɔlɔnɛlyɔ kàyàbwey anà nde, waa kàbü kà in'kↄl ande ntɔn mukun'sà làkoo.
Petɔlà waa kumbaar, kàtɛn a nde naa: «Mbarà, ntↄn mԑ, mɛ sye in'wà kàmɛ mbuur.»
Apan, Petↄlà kàkäl muyiyääm a Kↄlↄnԑlyↄ umpal kàbilà nde u ndwà, waa kàmԑn baar mbɔɔn bàkyàköŋ.

Nde kàtɛn a ba naa: «Bԑ, bԑ làkyàyöb naa wà ikin naa un'yudà mwԑy utüüb itàkal usin tsütsü apà ungyey. Wԑԑ mԑ, Nzam kan'mɛɛy naa twon an'tɛn a mbuur naa nde wà làbiin itàkal naa ŋingyäy.
Undiir awun, mԑ an'yà mԑ ukɔↄn asà impeen u làbeel angye. Wɛɛ apanà, mԑ in'kwen muyöb ntɔn atöm ngye baar muyan'bel.»
Apan Kↄlↄnԑlyↄ kàtɛn a nde naa: «Ŋàbà ilä kyànà, mԑ kàkäl u ngyamàkà u ndwà amԑ, u taaŋ làtär ungö a midi, wɛɛ le, mbuur mwԑy kàkyàbwaar ipfԑy a iŋyäŋ akyàmbar kusà a mԑ,
nde kan'kyään naa: "Kↄlↄnԑlyↄ, Nzam akyàwem ngyamàkà angye, anà akyàyɔbà nkääb angye.
Tↄm baar u Yↄpԑ mukàbel Simↄn awà bàfàbeel Petↄlà. Nde wà u ndwà a Simↄn un'kwaam a ibaan a ntsür. Ndwà ande yà kà un'kↄↄl a ngyäl."
Làgyägyä, mԑ waa atööm baar muyabel. Ngye, ngye waa akyey muyà. Apanà bi, bi banswà ibà kusà a Nzam ntↄn muwem indiir byanswà kaswɛŋ Mwol.»
Abun, Petↄlà kàduub mun mutԑn naa: «Mԑ in'kyàyöb ndandaa naa Nzam un'kↄl aŋàyↄŋ afàkyer anki,
wԑԑ unsà un'sɛŋ wanswà, mbuur afun'man bɔɔmà anà afàkyer ndaa a balàbal, nde akyer afun'kyey.
Nde kàtöm ndaa ande akà un'sԑŋ a Isàlԑl, mukyään Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ là duu u mbwo a Yԑsu Klistↄ awà Mwol a baar banswà.
Bԑ, bԑ làkyàyöb ndaa yàsԑmà u Ngalilԑ anà yàpää u Yuday lanswà ungö a ndüümà kàlↄɔŋà Ywan.

Bԑ, bɛ làkyàyöb naa Nzam kàtsüül Dweelà In'kyɛɛl anà kàpɛ ngwal udu a Yɛsu un'nsi Nasàlɛr awà kàyilyaaŋà mukyer ubwaŋ anà mukɔɔr baar bàkäl uboo a ikɔ̈b a Satanà, ntɔn Nzam kàkäl anà nde.
Anà bi sye, bi ibà ambäl a indiir byanswà kàkyer nde u mɛɛn a Ayudà anà u Yɛlusàlɛm. Nde sye wà mbuur bàdwä ba anà bàbɛɛrà ba u kulunsi,
wɛɛ Nzam kun'wiiy kilä kyàtär, waa kun'pɛ mbwo muyàmɛnà,
kakun'sԑŋ wanswà anki, wԑԑ akà bi, bi baar abà kàsɔ̈ɔ̈l Nzam kusà asànaa ambäl, bi baar kàdi anà kànü anà nde ungö a ngwiiyà ande uboo a akü.
Apan Yɛsu kà iswԑŋ mukyään un'sԑŋ anà mutà imbäl naa Nzam nde kàsɔ̈ɔ̈l mukal nkalsà a baar a mɔ̈ɔ̈ anà akü.
Aŋangↄↄm banswà bun'tɛɛl imbäl, mutɛn naa mbuur wanswà asun'wal anà asàsà làkwikilà amu nde, bàsun'dwääl nkul a man'be ande u mbwo a ikɔ̈b a Ikↄb ande.»
Umpal kàkäl Petↄlà mutɛɛnà ndaa ayi, Dweelà In'kyɛԑl kàbü udu a baar banswà bàweemà ndaa kàlↄɔŋà nde.
Wԑԑ aŋàlàkwikilà bàŋàkyɛy abà bàyi mbwo mwԑy anà Petↄlà bàkäl unsà ubem muman naa Dweelà In'kyɛԑl kàpää sye udu a baar mpa abà Ayudà.
Abun, ba bàweemà naa ba bàmutԑɛnà u ndaa a ingyey anà bàmusyäŋà Nzam. Apan, Petↄlà kàtԑn naa:
«Taaŋ alà, nkye we anà mbuur kan'kwo mutsuŋ an'dà a ndüümà akà baar ban'wal Dweelà In'kyɛԑl bà asànaa bi?»
Apan, nde kàswԑŋ naa badümà kà ikↄb a Yԑsu Klistↄ. Ba bun'lɔ̈ɔ̈m naa nde ubwaay ndam a ilä apà ba.
Antööm anà atↄŋ bàkäl u Yuday bàwem naa baar mpa abà Ayudà sye ban'wal Ndaa a Nzam.
Wԑԑ mpal kàbeenà Petↄlà Yԑlusàlԑm, baar bàŋàkyԑy bàkäl musà mbaaŋ anà nde.
Ba bàtԑn a nde naa: «Ngye an'kàbilà u ndwà a baar bàkɔ̈ɔ̈n aŋàkyԑy anà an'kàdyà ikal imwԑy anà ba.»
Apan, Petɔlà kàsԑmà mukakyään ndaa yanswà pànsi pànsi asànaa yàlyaaŋ ya. Waa kàtɛn a ba naa:
«Mԑ, mɛ kàkäl uboo a Yↄpԑ muyamà, laa kàkabà mɛ, waa kàmԑn imanmii: undiir mwԑy kan'fà du wàŋàbäm in'siŋ a bwԑlàbwԑl kà an'twԑrà man'nà asànaa yar a ipfԑy.
Mpal kàsyeebà mɛ boo awa ubwaŋàbwaŋ, mɛ kàmԑn ntsür a in'kↄl in'nà, ntsür a ndwaŋ, ntsür ifilaan u mɛɛn anà nԑn a du.
Apan, mɛ kàwem ndaa mwԑy yàmukan'kyäänà naa: "Petↄlà, kyen, dwa, dyà."
Wԑԑ mԑ kàtԑn naa: "Aay, Mwol, akà undiir mwԑy wà ikin itàkal wàŋingyäy ŋatàbilà anki u mun amԑ."
Ndaa yan'fàfà du mbalà yàyweel, yan'fuur naa: "Indiir kàpɔŋà Nzam, twon an'bel bya mbiin."
Ndaa ayi yàkyer abà mbalà tär. Ungö, indiir byanswà byàfurà du.
Kyekà taaŋ nsil alan, abaal atär bàyàkↄlà u ndwà kàkäl bi. Ba ban'tööm abà u Sɛzarɛ.
Apan, Dweelà kan'kyään naa mԑ in'kyen mbwo mwԑy anà ba ukɔɔn nkyɛɛr. Atɔŋ bà basyaam bàyan'swà. Bi banswà kàkàbilà u ndwà a mbuur awun.
Nde kà ikyään naa un'kyeey kàyàmԑnà aben u ndwà ande anà kun'kyään naa: "Tↄm mbuur mwey u Yↄpԑ mukàbel Simↄn awà bàfàbel naa Petↄlà.
Nde ayakyään ndaa yanswà iyàtswà ngye mɔ̈ɔ̈ anà ndwà angye yanswà."
Pa kàsɛmà mɛ mutԑn, Dweelà kàyàtyà udu a ba asànaa kàyàtyà nde udu a bi u nsɛmà.
Apan, mɛ kàyↄbà ndaa kàtԑn Mwol naa: "Ywan kàfadümà kà an'dà. Wԑԑ bԑ, bԑ bàsàladümà u Dweelà In'kyԑɛl."
Abun, Nzam kapԑ kab nsil la asànaa kàpԑ nde bi umpal kàsi bi làkwikillà amu Yԑsu Klistↄ, mԑ, mɛ kàkäl nà mutsuŋ Nzam?»
Ungö bàwem ba ndaa ayi, ba bàkäl a duu, bàsi Nzam làkoo, waa bàtԑn naa: «Abà Nzam kan'pà mbwo sye akà baar mpa abà Ayudà musↄↄmà nkääl aba anà muwal mɔ̈ɔ̈.»
Yàmԑnà naa aŋàlàkwikilà bàkyer atà upay mper yanswà ntɔn nkwaaŋ bamɛɛy mpal bàdwä Ityen. Ba bàkàkɔlà anà u Fԑnisi, u Shipԑlɛ anà Antyↄsha. Wԑԑ ba Ndaa a Nzam bàyilↄɔŋà Ayudà mpԑl.
Wԑԑ bumwԑy bàkäl baar a Shipԑlɛ anà Sirԑn. Umpal bàtöl ba Antyↄsha, ba bàkyäänà Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ là Mwol Yɛsu akà Angԑlԑki sye.
Kↄↄ a Mwol làkäl anà ba, undiir awun baar mbↄↄn bàsi ba làkwikilà anà bàbuul ba mpem akà Mwol.
Mpal kyàwem Ikööŋ a Yԑlusàlԑm ndaa ayi, ba bàtöm Banabasi u Antyↄsha.
Umpal kàtöl nde anà kàmԑn nde kab a ngway a Nzam, nde kàmԑn un'sak, nde kàlɔ̈ɔ̈m ba banswà mukal uboo a un'tüüb a Mwol u mpem aba yanswà.
Ntɔn nde kàkäl mbuur mwԑy wàŋàbwaŋ, wàŋàyↄl a Dweelà In'kyɛԑl anà làkwikilà. Apan, un'kàbɔ a baar kàyàtüüb anà Mwol.
Ungö apan, Banabasi kàkyen Tarsis mukàleŋ Sↄl.

Umpal kun'mԑn nde, nde kun'twääl u Antyↄsha. Ba bàkyer mbul mwԑy aŋun'kiinà musal mbwo mwԑy anà mulↄŋ iköŋ a baar uboo a Ikööŋ. Ya yàkäl mbalà atàtwԑb u Antyↄsha bàbel ba alↄŋki naa aklistↄ.
Kà ilä abin, aŋangↄↄm bàfü Yԑlusàlԑm bàyàtyà Antyↄsha.
Wԑԑ umwԑy uboo aba, ikↄb ande Agabüs, kàkyer ambarà, waa kàkyään u mbwo a Dweelà naa ngyal mbɔɔn ikyer ayàbilà u mԑԑn manswà. Ya sye yàkäl abun u paŋà a Kɔlↄde.
Abun, alↄŋki bàtsül mbar naa mbuur mbuur upԑ kab kan'kwo nde mupà ntɔn mutööm atↄŋ abà u Yuday.
Ba bàkyer abun sye, waa bàtöm an'kab aman akà andweer u mbwo a Banabasi anà Sↄl.
Yàmԑnà naa utaaŋ alan, mfum Ɛlↄdi kàsԑmà mumԑɛy baar a Ikööŋ bàmwɛy nkwaaŋ.
Nde kàdwä Zyak, un'tↄŋ a Ywan wàbaal, a kↄm.
Mpal kàmԑn nde naa ya yan'pà Ayudà un'sak, nde kàfàkɔr Petↄlà ilä a mampà ikɔ̈ɔ̈n ful.
Ungö mukun'kɔr, nde kun'tↄↄm u bɔlokà, kun'pԑ kan'kↄↄ a itsuŋ inà bye abyà aŋità anà uboo a imwɛy ntɔn mukun'kaar. Nde kàkwen mukun'sà u làbay a nsaŋ u mii a un'sɛŋ ungö mukyɛɛl Pak.
Petↄlà bun'käär u bↄlokà. Wԑԑ Ikööŋ kyàyɔ̈n anki musà ngyamàkà akà Nzam ntↄn nde.
Wԑԑ u mpib, kusà a ilä kàbön Ɛlↄdi mutsul nsaŋ ande u mii a un'sɛŋ, Petↄlà kàkäl wàŋàbɔ̈ɔ̈n uboboo a aŋità abɔ̈ɔ̈l, wàŋàbääm an'dwaaŋ mɔ̈ɔ̈l. Aseey a bↄlokà bàkäl u munàmbwo.

Wԑԑ kà imbürà, un'kyeey a Mwol mwԑy waa kàyàmԑnà, bↄlokà waa làpԑԑlà. Un'kyeey kàni Petɔlà u làbɛm, kun'wiiy, waa kàtɛn a nde naa: «Mbarà agyägyä!» Apan, an'dwaaŋ màkäl kà an'kↄↄ ande waa màbü.
Un'kyeey kàtɛn a nde naa: «Bäm un'kab angye, bwaar idyäär angye.» Nde waa kàkyer abun. Nde kàfàtɛn a nde naa: «Bwaar ipfɛy angye, yan'läb.»
Nde kàkyer atoo, waa kun'läb. Wԑԑ nde kàyöb anki naa ndaa kàkyerà un'kyeey yàkäl ndandaa. Nde kàsii naa kya kyà imanmii.

Apan ba bàlyaaŋ ikal a nseey kyàtàtwԑb, bàfàlyaaŋ kyàyweel, waa bàtöl u munàmbwo awe anà ibeenà a in'naan ifàler mper a bul. Ibeenà aki kyàdubà kya ŋakwo kusà a ba. Ba waa bàtoo, bàyikyeenà u balàbal làmwey. Apan, un'kyeey kàsun'wɛy kà imbürà.
Mpal màfurà an'kyän a Petↄlà, nde kàtԑn naa: «Apanà mԑ an'yöb naa ndandaa Mwol kàtöm un'kyeey ande, nde kàman'tsuuŋ kà an'kↄↄ a Ɛlↄdi anà akà yinà yanswà kàdiilà un'sԑŋ a Ayudà.»
Ungö kàyöb nde abun, nde kàkyen ndwà a Màlye, ngwän a Ywan awà bàfàbel Malakↄ. Akun, baar mbɔɔn bàkyer aköŋ anà bàkäl muyamà.
Mpal kàbԑԑrà nde kà ibeenà a munàmbwo, un'syääl mwɛy wà un'kaar ikↄb ande Lↄdԑ waa kàsin muwem.
Nde kàyöb ndaa a Petↄlà. Wԑԑ unsà un'sak ande, nde kàduub anki ndwà, nde kàkyen u ntiin ntↄn mukàkyään naa Petↄlà wàŋàmbar u nsà.
Wԑԑ ba bàtԑn a nde naa: «Ngye awe anà nukↄŋ.» Wԑԑ nde kàsi muküünà mutɛn naa yà ndandaa. Apan, ba bàtɛn naa: «Un'kyeey ande ayàkal.»
Wԑԑ Petↄlà kàsi muküünà mubԑԑrà. Ba bàduub ndwà, waa bàbem mpal bun'mɛn ba.

Wɛɛ akà nde, nde kadübà mun a kↄↄ ntɔn mukaswaŋ naa ba bàkäl a duu, nde kakyään naa Mwol kàkyer aben mukun'twey u nsà a bↄlokà. Nde kàtԑn sye naa: «Kyen kàlakyään Zyak anà atↄŋ bumwԑy indiir abi.» Apan, nde waa kàtoo, kàkyen mper asin.
Wԑԑ mpal làtyà taaŋ, lingyoomà làbü uboo a aŋità, ba bàtԑn ba a ba naa Petↄlà nkye byàmubweel?
Ɛlↄdi kàkäl muyun'leŋ, wԑԑ nde kun'mɛn anki. Nde kàfuul aleer, waa kàswɛŋ naa basyen anà badwä. Ungö nde kàlwomà u Yuday, waa kàtyà Sԑzarԑ. Nde kàkäl ndam a ilä kwo.

Ɛlↄdi kàkäl nkyԑl mbↄↄn akà baar a Tir anà Sidↄn. Wԑԑ ba bàkäl un'tüüb mwԑy ntↄn mukun'man. An'yääm a ba anà Balàstüs, mbuur kàfaleerà suk a mfum, màkyer abwaŋ. Ungö ba bàkàlɔm mfum Ɛlↄdi musà duu uboo a ba, ntↄn udyà aba bàfafaa nsi a mfum Ɛlↄdi.
Mpal kyàkwe ilä bàsi ba, Ɛlↄdi kàbwäär ipfԑy a imfum, laa kàbwaay de kà un'syäl, waa kàtɛɛnà a ba u mii a un'sԑŋ.
Apan, un'sԑŋ kàtԑn u ndaa a ngwal naa: «Ayi ntɛɛn a nzam mwɛy, wԑԑ kà yà mbuur anki.»
Wԑԑ utaaŋ nsil alan, un'kyeey a Mwol waa kun'düb, ntↄn nde Nzam làkoo kun'pԑ anki. In'swab myàkyer un'dyà, laa kàkü nde.
Apan, Ndaa a Nzam waa yàyԑl, waa yàpää.
Wԑԑ akà Banabasi anà Sↄl, mpal bàmay ba isal aba u Yԑlusàlԑm, ba bàkyer akyà, waa bàsyen anà Ywan awà bàfàbel Malakↄ.
Kà Ikööŋ a Antyↄsha bàkäl anà aŋangↄↄm anà alɔɔŋ asànaa Banabasi, Simԑyↄ awà bàfàbel Nizyԑr anà Lusyus un'nsi Sirԑn, Manayԑn un'sam a Ɛlↄdi fà imbԑy, anà Sↄl.
Mpal bàkäl ba musyäŋà Mwol anà mukin mbɔr, Dweelà In'kyԑԑl kàtԑn naa: «Lasi Banabasi anà Sↄl ukↄl, ntↄn mukyer isal kabel mԑ.»
Abun, ungö ukin mbɔr anà uyamà, ba basi an'kↄↄ, waa bapɛ mbwo mukyà.
Wɛɛ akà Banabasi anà Sɔl, Dweelà In'kyɛɛl katöm nde, ba bàtyà Sԑlusi, akun ba bàwԑl an'swà mukyà isaŋ a Shipԑlɛ.
Mpal bàtöl ba u Salamin, ba bàkyäänà ndaa a Nzam uboo a ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà. Ywan kàkäl anà ba sye ntɔn mukabay.
Ungö mulyaaŋ uboo a isaŋ kyanswà tii u Pafↄsi, ba bàbweey anà un'kyeer a inwɛŋ mwԑy, ŋangↄↄm a loor wà un'yudà, ikↄb ande Bar Yԑsu,
nde kàkälà tsütsü a Pawulus Sԑrzyus, mfum a Isaŋ a Shipԑle. Nde kàbel Banabasi anà Sↄl ntↄn mukakyään naa nde we anà ngyal muwem Ndaa a Nzam.
Wԑԑ un'kyeer a inwɛŋ Ԑlimasi, ayi mbuul a ikɔb ande, laa kàtön nde, ntↄn nde ndaa aba kakyeyà anki, nde kàleŋà naa mfum ukɔɔn akal anà làkwikilà.
Apan, Sↄl awà bàfàbel sye Pↄl, awà kàkäl aŋàyↄl a Dweelà In'kyɛԑl, kun'paam mii,
waa kàtɛn naa: «Ngye awàŋàyↄl a an'yeerà anà an'kyän an'be, mwan a ileŋ, un'yiiŋ a ndaa a balàbal yanswà, taaŋ nà ngye asàwԑy mubääm an'kyän a balàbal mà Mwol?

Wԑԑ papanà, wem: Mwol akyer akam un'swaŋ, ngye abulà ikwàmii, u ndam a an'taaŋ, ngye mwäänà aman anki.» Utaaŋ nsil alan, un'böŋ anà làpib myun'bweel u mii, nde kàbulà muyoyoolà, wàmuyileŋ naa mbuur kun'twääl u kↄↄ.
Undiir awun, mpal kàmԑn mfum ndaa yàlyaaŋ yi, nde kàsi làkwikilà, ntↄn an'lɔɔŋ a Mwol màkyer un'bilà ubwaŋàbwaŋ.
Pↄl anà baar bàyikyeenà anà nde, bàwԑl an'swà u Pafɔs ntɔn mukyà Pɛrzɛ u Pamfili. Ywan kàkaabà anà ba, waa kàfurà Yԑlusàlԑm.
Wԑԑ ba, ba bàläb mbwo aba: bàlwomà ba u Pԑrzɛ, ba bàkyen Antyↄsha u Pisidi. Ilä a saba, ba bàbilà u ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà, waa bàbwaay.
Ungö mutaŋ un'kɔɔn anà aŋangↄↄm, amfum a ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà balɔ̈ɔ̈m naa: «Atↄŋ, kya isàkal naa bԑ làbye anà undiir atԑn akà baar ntↄn mukalɛɛl, làtԑn!»
Apan, Pↄl waa kàmbarà, kàswɛŋ isii a kɔɔ, waa kàtԑn naa: «Bԑ baar a Isàlԑl anà bԑ bumwԑy làfàtiin Nzam bↄↄmà, làwem!
Nzam a un'sԑŋ a Isàlԑl wà, kàsɔ̈ɔ̈l bàtaa abi. Nde kàbuul wa wàkölàköl mpal kàkäl wa u mɛɛn a Ngipiti. Wԑԑ u ngwal a kↄↄ ande, nde kun'twey kwo.
Wԑԑ nde ba kasyen kà isii a mbul an'kwem an'nà mpal bàkäl ba u nsye a ipↄl.
Ungö, kàmay nde in'sԑŋ nsambwaar u mɛɛn a Kanana, nde kakääb mԑԑn mukal un'naaŋ aba
kà isii a mbul nkam nà a an'kwem an'tyeen. «Ungö apan, nde kapԑ ntɛɛn tii utaaŋ a ŋangↄↄm Sàmwel.
Wɛɛ semà apan, ba bàlöm mfum, kyakin Nzam kapԑ nde Sawul, mwan a Kisi, umwԑy uboo a mbil a Bԑnsàmԑn. Nde kàyaal mbul an'kwem an'nà.
Wԑԑ ungö, Nzam waa kun'tön, waa kàtwey David mukal mfum aba. Ntɔn nde, nde kàtɛ imbäl ki: "Mԑ aman David, mwan a Yɛsɛ, mbuur kan'kwen mpem amԑ, nde ayakyerà ndaa yanswà in'kwen mԑ."
Unsà ikyee ande, Nzam kàtwey Yԑsu, Un'tswää a mɔ̈ɔ̈ a Isàlԑl, asànaa kàpɛ nde ilää.
Kusà a ngyeel ande, Ywan kàlɔŋ un'sԑŋ a Isàlԑl wanswà ndüümà a mbuul a mpem.

Wԑԑ mpal kàkäl Ywan mumay isal ande, nde kàtɛɛnà naa: "Bԑԑ làsii naa mԑ in'wà nà? Mԑ kà in'wà mbuur làdilà bԑ anki! Wԑԑ làwem: we anà mbuur ayàyà ungö amԑ, mԑ in'kwe anki musɔↄl idyäär kà in'kɔl ande."»
«Atↄŋ abaal, baan a ywar a Abàlam, anà bԑ bumwԑy làfàtiin Nzam bↄↄmà, Ndaa a mɔ̈ɔ̈ ayi bàtöm akà bi.
Wɛɛ abun, baar a Yԑlusàlԑm anà amfum aba, bun'kyey anki Yԑsu. Wɛɛ mpal bun'tsüül ba mbar, ba bàkwey ndaa a aŋangↄↄm bàfàtaŋ saba lanswà.
Wɛɛ, itàkal ba bàmɛn anki undiir ban'kwo mukun'dwa, ba bàlɔ̈m akà Pilatu mulwom mɔ̈ɔ̈ ande.
Ungö bàmay ba mukyer ndaa yanswà bàsön ntↄn nde, ba bun'tↄɔl u kulunsi, waa bun'tɔ̈ɔ̈l uboo a an'dii mwɛy.
Wԑԑ Nzam kun'twey uboo a akü,
nde kàyàmԑnà ilä mbɔɔn akà baar abà bàbeenà anà nde, sԑmà Ngalilԑ tii Yԑlusàlԑm. Ŋàbawà ba bà ambäl ande kusà a un'sԑŋ a Isàlɛl!
Wɛɛ bi, bi ikàlakyäänà Ndaa Aŋàbwaŋ yi: ilää kàpԑ Nzam akà bàtaaràbi,
nde kya kan'kölà ubwaŋàbwaŋ apanà ntↄn bi baan aba, muwiy Yԑsu, asànaa bàsön uboo a diim làyweel naa: "Ngye, ngye awà Mwan amԑ, Ŋàbawà, mԑ amabɔr."
Nzam kun'wiiy uboo a akü, ntɔn nde ukɔↄn afàfurà unsà upɔɔn. Abun nde kàtԑn naa: "Mԑ in'sàlapà indiir in'kyɛԑl anà byàndandaa kàbön mɛ mupà David."
Undiir awun kàfàtԑn nde kà itiir a ndaa asin: "Ngye asàpà anki mbwo naa mbuur angye wà in'kyɛԑl upɔ̈ɔ̈n."
Wɛɛ, David, utaaŋ ande, nde kàsyääl ukwen a Nzam. Ungö, waa kàkü, ba bun'dye kà an'dii a bàtaarànde, nde kàkyer apↄↄn.
Wԑԑ mbuur kàwiiy Nzam, nde kàpɔ̈ɔ̈n anki.
Undiir awun, atↄŋ, làyöb naa u mbwo ande bàkyàlakyään ndwääl a nkul.
U mbwo ande, mbuur wanswà awà wasà làkwikilà atoo wàbalàbal unsà indiir byanswà mpa kàkwe un'kↄↄn a Mↄsԑ mukyer.
Kyakin, làkäl kà igyɛԑŋ manà ndaa bàtԑn aŋangɔɔm iyàlabweel:
Làler, bԑ baar aŋàyↄl a un'köl, làkäl unsà ubem anà làyaalà, ntɔn mԑ in'kyer undiir mpal làwà bɛ anà mɔ̈ɔ̈, undiir mpa lan'kwo bԑ mukyey isàkal naa mbuur mwԑy kàmàlakyään wa!»
Mpal bàtoo Pↄl anà Banabasi, ba balɔ̈ɔ̈m muyàlɔŋ ndaa nsil ayin u saba làlääb.
Ungö a nköŋ, Ayudà mbↄↄn anà baar bàkyey inzaam a Ayudà, ba bàläb Pↄl anà Banabasi. Ba bàyäämà ba a ba, waa bapɛɛ un'kaay mubääb anà kab angway a Nzam.
Ilä a saba kyàlääb, bul lanswà làkàköŋ ntↄn muwem Ndaa a Mwol.
Wԑԑ mpal bàmԑn Ayudà in'sԑŋ ami, ba bàwem un'köl, bàtön ndaa a Pↄl, waa bun'bɛyà.

Wԑԑ Pↄl anà Banàbasi bàtɛn a uyɔl naa: «Ya yàlɔ̈m naa ndaa a Nzam bàtàkyään bԑ. Wԑԑ, ntɔn lan'tↄn bɛ ya, bԑ ŋakwo lan'swaŋ naa bԑ làkwe anki muwal mɔ̈ɔ̈ a mbul a in'tye. Apanà bi ntabwey abi ibuul akà baar mpa abà Ayudà.
Abun, Mwol kà iswԑŋ abà: "Mԑ ngye kasi pԑԑlà ntɔn baar mpa abà Ayudà, ntↄn ngye asyen mɔ̈ɔ̈, tii mper màkàtsü mɛɛn."»
Wԑԑ mpal bàwem baar mpa abà Ayudà ndaa ayi, ba bàmɛn un'sak, ba bàsɛmà musà ndaa a Mwol làkoo. Baar banswà basɔ̈ɔ̈l muwal mɔ̈ɔ̈ a mbul a in'tye, ba bàsi làkwikilà.
Abun, ndaa a Mwol yàpää kà itiir a nsi akin kyanswà.
Wԑԑ Ayudà bàkàkul usey akà akaar aŋun'naaŋ bàfasyäŋà Nzam anà akà abyääl a bul, ba bàsiinà baar mupà Pↄl anà Banabasi nkwaaŋ, ba baböŋ kà itiir a nsi aba.
Apan, ba bàkyen Ikɔn bàmusakɔɔb un'twà a in'kɔl aba.
Wԑԑ akà alↄŋki, ba bàkäl aŋàyↄl a un'sak anà Dweelà In'kyɛԑl.
U Ikↄnyum Pↄl anà Banabasi bàbilà sye u ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà, waa bàlↄɔŋà. Abun, un'kàbɔ a Ayudà anà Angԑlԑki basi làkwikilà.
Wԑԑ Ayudà bàtön an'lↄↄŋ, waa bàsiinà baar mpa abà Ayudà mutɔŋ mpem ambe akà atɔŋ.
Itàkal abun, ba kwo bàkäl ilä mbↄↄn bàmulɔŋ a uyɔl ntɔn làkwikilà aba akà Mwol. Nde kapԑ ikɔ̈b mukyer impà anà idiim anà mutà imbäl u ndaa a kab angway ande.
Wԑԑ un'sԑŋ a bul waa kàkaabà: amwԑy bàbü a Ayudà, bumwԑy bàbü a Antööm.
Baar mpa abà Ayudà anà Ayudà anà amfum aba, ba bàbön mumԑɛy ba nkwaaŋ anà mukam ba in'kul.
Pa bàyöb ba ndaa ayi, ba bàkyer akàyee, waa bàkyen ntsü a Likayɔni, Listre, Dԑrbԑ anà Likↄnya anà an'bul a tsütsü.
Akun sye, ba bàkäl mukyään Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ.
U Listre kàkäl anà ŋàkwɛkà mwԑy, nde kàkäl ikar, sԑmà mböör ande, nde kàsàkyà anki dwaan.
Ilä mwɛy nde kàkäl mulab ndaa kàlɔɔŋà Pↄl. Pↄl kun'paam mii, waa kàmԑn naa mbuur awà kàkäl anà làkwikilà ntɔn nde ukɔↄrà.
Apan, nde kàtɛn a nde u ndaa a ngwal naa: «Mbarà, kal aŋàtsim unsà in'kↄl angye!» Mbuur awà waa kàfumà, waa kàkyen.
Mpal bàmԑn in'sԑŋ ndaa kàkyer Pↄl, ba bàsi in'kwԑŋ kà Ilikↄnya, waa bàtɛn naa: «Bànzam ban'bulà baar, waa ban'yàtyà mper akà bi.»
Ba bàpԑ Banabasi ikↄb a «Zösi» Pↄl bun'pԑ ikↄb a «Ɛrmԑsi» ntↄn ndaa yanswà yàkäl anà nde.
Ndwà a nzam a ngaŋ a Zösi yàkäl u nswɛŋ a bul. Nde kàtwääl in'dim a ngɔɔmà anà in'siŋ a iful u minàmbwo a ndwà ayi ntɔn nde kàkwen naa nde anà un'sɛŋ, ba bàpɛ ibɔɔn.
Wԑԑ mpal bàwem Antööm ndaa ayi, ba bàkaam ipfԑy aba, waa bàkyen u ntiin ntsü kàkäl un'sԑŋ a baar, bàmusà in'kwɛŋ

anà mutɛn naa: «Abaal, ntↄn nkye lan'kyer bԑ indiir a tub abi? Làyöb naa bi sye, bi ibà baar asànaa bԑ. Ndaa Aŋàbwaŋ ikàlakyään bi yà naa bԑ làwԑy itԑk, wԑԑ bԑ làyi akà Nzam a mɔ̈ɔ̈ awà kàkyer du, mԑԑn, ngyäl a kölàköl anà indiir byanswà abyà uboo.
U nkööl yàlyaaŋ, nde kàwԑy in'sԑŋ myanswà mulab ndaa aba ŋakwo.
Itàkal abà, nde kàkɔ̈ɔ̈n anki mutà imbäl a ubwaŋ ande, mukàlapà fà du, mbul anà mbɛŋ kà an'paŋà a bya, mukàlapà isaa anà muyööl mpem abԑ a un'sak.»
Wԑԑ itàkal bàtԑn ba ndaa ayi, yàkäl mpay antööm mutsuŋ un'sԑŋ a baar mukɔɔn akapà ibↄↄn.

Apan, Ayudà bàfü Antyↄsha anà Ikↄn, ba bàsi muküünà akà un'sɛŋ a baar. Un'sɛŋ a baar awà kàkyey an'kyän aba, waa bàtԑ Pↄl in'kul ntↄn mukun'dwa. Ungö ba bàkun'wɔm u nsà a bul. Ba bàsii naa nde kan'kwà.
Wԑԑ mpal bàkàköŋ alɔŋki umbil a Pↄl, laa kàmbarà nde, kàbilà nde uboo a bul. Taaŋtyà, ba bàkyen Dԑrbԑ anà Banabasi.
Ungö bàlↄŋ ba baar Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ u bul alà anà baar mbↄↄn bàbulà ba alↄŋki, ba bàfurà Listre, Ikↄn anà Antyↄsha.
Ba bàpԑɛ alɔŋki ngwal anà bàlɔ̈ɔ̈mà naa ba bàsi muküünà u làkwikilà anà mutɛn naa: «Ilↄↄmà naa bi itwab atàman mpay mbↄↄn mubilà kà imwol a Nzam.»
Ba bàsɔ̈ɔ̈l andweer kà Ikööŋ imwԑy imwɛy. Ungö muyamà anà mukin, ba bapԑ kà an'kↄↄ a Mwol awà bàsi ba làkwikilà.
Ungö apan, ba bàsoonà Pisidi mukyà Pamfili.
Ungö mulɔŋ Ndaa u Pԑrzԑ, ba bàtyà Atalya.
Akun, ba bàwԑl an'swà, waa bàkyen Antyↄsha, ikal akyà basi u kab a ngway a Nzam ntɔn isal bàkyer ba.
Mpal bàtöl ba, ba bàbel Ikööŋ, bàkyään ndaa yanswà kàkyer Nzam akà ba, anà kaduub nde sye mbwo a làkwikilà akà baar mpa abà Ayudà.
Abun, ba bàkäl ilä mbↄↄn anà alɔŋki.
Ndam abaal bàfü Yuday, bàlɔɔŋà atɔŋ naa: «Isàkal naa bɛ bàlakyɛy anki asànaa ukaswaŋà un'kɔɔn a Mɔsɛ, bɛ làkwe anki muwà mɔ̈ɔ̈.»

Yàmɛnà naa an'sye anà mbaaŋ a kölàköl yàkyer abwà uboo a Pɔl anà Banabasi asye anà ba. Ba bàtsül mbar naa Pɔl anà Banabasi anà ndam a baar bumwɛy, bàbeenà Yɛlusàlɛm akà Antööm anà andweer, ntɔn mutsul ndaa ayin.
Wɛɛ akà ba, Ikööŋ kyapɛ indiir byàkäl mfun ntɔn nkyeen aba, ba bàsoonà Fɛnɛsi anà Samàlya, bàmuyisam mbuul a mpem a baar mpa abà Ayudà. Ndaa ayi yàpɛɛ un'sak mbɔɔn akà atɔŋ banswà.
Mpal bàtöl ba Yɛlusàlɛm, Ikööŋ anà Antööm anà andweer bawɛl ba, ba bàsam ndaa yanswà kàkyer Nzam u mbwo anà ba.
Wɛɛ, ndam a Amfarisi amwɛy abà bàbula aklistɔ bàmbarà ntɔn mutɛn naa baar mpa abà Ayudà bàkyer akyɛy anà bàkyer aswaŋ mulab un'kɔɔn a Mɔsɛ.
Antööm anà andweer bàköŋ ntɔn muler ndaa ayi.

Ungö a mbaaŋ a bwɛlàbwɛl, Petɔlà laa kàmbarà nde, waa kàtɛn naa: «Atɔŋ abaal, bɛ, bɛ làkyàyöb naa sɛmà itaan Nzam kàsɔ̈ɔ̈l uboo abɛ naa u mun amɛ, baar mpa abà Ayudà bàwem Ndaa a Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ anà bàsi làkwikilà.
Waa Nzam awà ayöb mpem a baar, katɛɛl imbäl mukapà Dweelà In'kyɛɛl asànaa akà bi.
Nde sye nsöön kàsi anki uboo a bi anà ba: nde kàpöŋ mpem aba ntɔn làkwikilà aba.
Apanà, ntɔn nkye lan'lwab bɛ Nzam, lan'sà bɛ buur u bway a alɔŋki, buur mpa bàkwe bànkaa abi itàkal bi ŋakwo musɛn?
Wɛɛ, ntɔn ngyɛb a Mwol Yɛsu awà ifàsà bi làkwikilà, bi kàwü mɔ̈ɔ̈ sye asànaa ba.»
Abun, un'sɛŋ wanswà kàkäl a kul, ba bàkäl muwem Banabasi anà Pɔl bàkäl mukyäänà ba idiim anà impà byanswà kàkyɛr Nzam akà baar mpa abà Ayudà u mbwo a Antööm.
Mpal bàmay ba mutɛn, Zyak kàwɛl ndaa, waa kàtɛn naa: «Atɔŋ abaal, lan'wem!
Simɔn kàmiyɔɔb naa u nsɛmà Nzam kàkyer aben musɔɔl un'sɛŋ umwɛy uboo a in'sɛŋ myanswà mpa amyà Ayudà ntɔn muwal ikɔb ande.
Ya yan'bwà balàbal asànaa ndaa bàsön aŋangɔɔm naa:

Mwol kan'tɛn naa: Ungö apan, mɛ in'sàkyer asàyàfurà ntɔn musuub ndwà a David ayà yàbü. Mɛ in'sàlɔɔn indiir aya byàtäy, mɛ in'sàmbaar ya.
2c0f110095	Abun, ndam abaal ayisàsal waa isàleŋ Mwol, anà baar a in'sɛŋ myanswà myàfàtà ikɔb amɛ din. Ayi ntɛɛn a Mwol afàkyer indiir abi
2c0f120020	abyà bàyöb sɛmà itaan.
Kyakin mɛ, mɛ in'kasii naa kà ubwaŋ anki mupà mpay akà baar mpa abà Ayudà ban'buul mpem aba akà Nzam,
wɛɛ basöön un'kaan naa ba bàkɔɔn asin tsütsü apà ŋingyäy a itɛk, anà inswem, anà ntsür mpa aŋàtsul kil anà an'kil.
Ntɔn, sɛmà nkööl yàlyaŋ itaan, bye anà baar bàfalɔŋ un'kɔɔn a Mɔsɛ u bul lanswà, ntɔn bàfàtaŋ wa ilä a saba kyanswà u ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà.»

Abun yan'söön ubwaŋ naa Antööm anà andweer anà Ikööŋ kyanswà bàsɔ̈ɔ̈l baar uboo aba anà batöm Antyɔsha mbwo mwɛy anà Pɔl anà Banabasi. Ba bàsɔ̈ɔ̈l Yudɛ awà bàfàbel naa Balàsàbasi anà Silasi, baar bàkäl anà ikɔ̈b uboo a atɔŋ.
Ba bapɛ un'kaan mwɛy awà bàsön ba abà: «Akà bɛ atɔŋ mpa abà Ayudà làfàkal kà Antyↄsha u Siri anà Silisi, Antööm, andweer anà atɔŋ bàmàlapà mbɔr!
Bi kan'wem naa baar amwɛy bàfü uboo a bi, waa bàyàtwaal lingyooma akà bɛ unsà ntɛɛn aba anà bàpɛ mpem abɛ mpay, wɛɛ bi ba katöm anki.
Lalan kàmɛn bi anà kàkyey bi banswà naa yubwaŋ bi isɔ̈ɔ̈l abaal anà bi katöm akà bɛ. Ba bàyà mbwo mwɛy anà nkween abi Banabasi anà Pɔl.
Baar abà bàbɔ̈ɔ̈l, bàkyàyälà mɔ̈ɔ̈ aba ntɔn ikɔb a Mwol abi Yɛsu Klistɔ.
Abun, bi kàmàlatööm Yude anà Silasi, ba bàyàlakyään u mun aba ndaa nsil ayi.
Yàmɛnà naa yubwaŋ naa Dwelà In'kyɛɛl anà bi ŋakwo, bi kàtsül mukɔɔn akàlatälà buur asin udu a indiir a mfun bi:
utɔn in'twaŋ a ntsür bàfàpà ibɔɔn akà itɛk, anà an'kil, anà ntsür mpa yàŋàtsul kil, anà ipasàsɛ. Bɛ làsàlab ndaa ayi, bɛ lan'kyer ubwaŋ. Làkäl ubwaŋ!»
Apan ba bàkaabà anà Ikööŋ, waa bàtyà Antyɔsha. Akun ba bàtüüb un'sɛŋ a aŋàlàkwikilà, waa bapɛ un'kaan.
Ungö ban'taŋ ba wa, atɔŋ bàmɛn un'sak, ntɔn wa kapɛ ngwal.
Yude anà Silasi, ba ŋakwo sye bàkäl aŋangɔɔm, ba bapɛɛ an'lwɛŋ mbɔɔn ntɔn ba bàwɛl un'kanà anà ngwal.
Ba bàkäl ndam a taaŋ paa, atɔŋ waa bafuur unsà duu akà baar batöm.
Wɛɛ Silasi kàsàsal paa.
Wɛɛ akà Pɔl anà Banabasi, ba bàsàsal u Antyɔsha anà baar asin mbɔɔn mulɔɔŋà anà mukyäänà Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ là Ndaa a Mwol.
Ungö a an'taaŋ, Pɔl kàtɛn a Banabasi naa: «Tsweenà bi ifurà mukàler atɔŋ kà an'bul manswà kàyilɔɔŋà bi Ndaa a Mwol, ntɔn muyöb naa ba kwo bà aben.»
Banabasi kàkwen musyen sye anà ba Ywan, awà bàfabeelà sye Malakɔ.
Wɛɛ Pɔl kàmɛn naa kà ubwaŋ anki ba mukyà anà mbuur awà kàsawɛy sɛmà Pamfili anà mpa kàsabay unsà isal aba.
Apan, an'sye màkäl màngwal uboo a ba bàbɔ̈ɔ̈l, undiir awun bàkaabà ba. Banabasi kàwɛl Malakɔ, waa bàbilà anà nde kà an'swà ntɔn mukyà isaŋ a Shipɛlɛ.
Wɛɛ akà Pɔl, nde kàsɔ̈ɔ̈l Silasi, waa kàkyen anà nde, ungö bun'si atɔŋ u kab angway a Mwol.
Nde kàyilyaaŋà u Siri anà Silisi ntɔn muyipà Ikööŋ ngwal.
Pɔl kàkɔlà Dɛrbɛ anà Listre. Akun, kàkäl anà un'lɔŋki mwɛy ikɔb ande Tumàtɛ, mwan a un'kaar un'yudà kàbulà un'klistɔ, taarànde kàkäl un'ngɛlɛki.
Atɔŋ abà u Listre anà u Ikɔn bun'tɛɛl imbäl aŋàbwaŋ.
Pɔl kàkwen mukun'syen. Ungö akun'wal, nde kàkyer un'kyɛy, ntɔn Ayudà bàkäl kwo bàkyer ayöbà naa taarànde kàkäl un'ngɛlɛki.
Kà an'bul bàyilyaaŋà ba, ba bàyiswaŋà atɔŋ mulab ndaa bàtsül Antööm anà andweer u Yɛlusàlɛm.
Abun, Ikööŋ byàbulà ngwal unsà làkwikilà anà byàkwɛyà ntal a aklistɔ ilä a ilä.
Dwelà In'kyɛɛl kàkyer atsuŋ mukyään Ndaa u mɛɛn a Azi, abun ba bàsoonà nsi a Filizi anà Ngalàtyà.
Mpal bàtöl ba tsütsü a Misi, ba bàsii mubilà u Bitini, wɛɛ Dweelà a Yɛsu mbwo kapɛ anki.
Lalan bàsoonà ba Misi, waa bàtyà Tɔlɔwasi.
U mpib mwɛy, Pɔl kàmɛn imanmii: un'nsi Masɛdwan mwɛy kàkäl aŋàmbar, waa kun'bɔ̈ɔ̈n, waa kàtɛn naa: «Lyaaŋ u Masɛdwan, yibay!»
Ungö a imanmii aki, kà imbürà, nde kàleŋ bi mukyà Masɛdwan, ntɔn bi kàyöb naa Mwol kàmibel mukàkyään Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ akà baar a mper ayin.
U Tɔlɔwasi, bi kàbilà kà an'swà mukyà ipey isaŋ a Samɔtalasi. Taaŋtyà bi kàtoo kà an'swà u Nɛyapɔlisi.
Fà apan, bi kàkyà Filipe, bul a kölàköl là itiir a nsi Masɛdwan, la làkäl nsal a Lɔmà. Bi kàkäl ndam a taaŋ u bul alà.
Ilä a saba, bi kàtoo u nsà a bul ntɔn mukyà kà un'kɔɔl a an'dà, ntɔn bi kàsii naa bi ikàman ikal a ngyamàkà. Bi kàbwaay paa, anà kàyamà anà akaar bàköŋ paa.

Umwɛy uboo a akaar abà, ikɔb ande Lidi, bul ande Tyatir, nde kàkäl un'yääl a ipfɛy a tsöö, nde kàfasyäŋà Nzam. Nde kàkyer iweemà, waa Mwol kun'duub mpem ntɔn nde uwem ubwaŋàbwaŋ indiir kàtɛɛnà Pɔl.

Umpal kàwɛl nde ndüümà, nde anà ndwà ande, nde kà ibɔ̈ɔ̈n, waa kàtɛn naa: «Kya bɛ làsàman naa mɛ in'wà ŋàlakwikilà a Mwol, wɛy bɛ làbilà anà làkäl u ndwà amɛ.» Nde kàsi muküünà naa bi ikyey.

Ilä mwɛy bi kàkäl mukyà ikal a ngyamàkà, un'syääl mwɛy wà un'kaar kàkäl anà bwoo a nkwee, nde kàyi akà bi. Nde kàfakɔlà myee anà kàfakyäänà baar ndaa iyàyà kusà. Isal ande aki kyàpɛɛ bweel mbɔɔn akà ankum ande.
Nde kàsɛmà muyilab Pɔl anà bi. Nde kàyikuubà in'kwɛŋ, waa kàtɛɛnà naa: «Baar làman bɛ bà, ba bà asyääl a Nzam a Dudu! Ba bàmuyàlakyään mbwo a mɔ̈ɔ̈!»
Nde kàfakyerà abà ilä mbɔɔn. Ya yàpɛ Pɔl làkyämun, lalan kàbulà nde, waa kàswɛŋ dweelà alan naa: «Kà ikɔb a Yɛsu Klistɔ, mɛ amaswaŋ, too uboo a un'kaar wà.» La waa làtoo taaŋ nsil alan.
Mpal bàmɛn ankum ande naa undiir kàfapaa ba ubwaŋ kan'too, ba bàkör Pɔl anà Silasi, waa basyen kà un'syäl kusà a antɛɛn.
Ba baswɛŋ akà amfum a antɛɛn, waa bàtɛn naa: «Baar bà, bàmuyitwaal lingyoomà uboo a bul abi. Ba Bayudà,
ba bàyikyään nkääl a ingyey mpa ban'kwo bi mulab ntɔn bi ibà baar a Lɔmà.»
Un'sɛŋ a baar kàmbarà u nkyɛl ntɔn mutɔn ba, antɛɛn batöm mukasɔl ipfɛy, waa baswɛŋ naa bapɛ an'füm.
Ungö mukadüb iki mbɔɔn, ba batɔɔm u bɔlokà, waa bàswɛŋ un'leer a bɔlokà mukasey ubwaŋàbwaŋ.
Pa kàwɛl nde nswɛɛŋ ayi, nde kasi u bɔlokà làboboo, waa kabäm ibiŋ a in'te kà in'kɔl aba.
Tsütsü a boboo a mpib, Pɔl anà Silasi bàkäl muyamà anà mutɔl an'diim musyäŋà Nzam. Baar a bɔlokà bumwɛy bàkäl muweemà ba.
Kà imbürà, mɛɛn màni a ngwal, an'sin an'ta a bɔlokà màkyer atɛɛr, apan ibeenà byanswà waa byàdubà, in'siŋ a baar a bɔlokà banswà waa myàtsuŋà.
Umpal kàwiyà un'leer a bɔlokà u twaal anà kàmɛn nde naa ibeenà a bɔlokà byàŋàdubà, nde kàtwey kɔm ande ntɔn mudwa mɔ̈ɔ̈ ande, ntɔn nde kàsii naa baar a bɔlokà ban'tiin.
Wɛɛ Pɔl kàtɛn u ndaa a ngwal naa: «Twɔn an'dwa mɔ̈ɔ̈ angye, bi banswà ibà paa!»
Un'leer a bɔlokà kàlɔ̈m mwinà, kàbilà uboo a ndwà u ntiin, waa kàbü a matɛɛr kà in'kɔl a Pɔl anà Silasi.
Apan, nde katwey u nsà, waa kàtɛn naa: «Amwol, ininà mɛ in'kyer muwal mɔ̈ɔ̈?»
Ba bun'fuur naa: «Sà làkwikilà akà Mwol Yɛsu, waa ngye ayàwà mɔ̈ɔ̈, ngye anà ndwà angye yanswà.»
Abun, ba bun'kyään ndaa a Mwol, anà baar banswà bàkäl u ndwà ande.
Taaŋ nsil alan u mpib, nde kasyen mukàsɔŋ iwà aba. Ungö apan nde kàwɛl ndüümà, nde anà baar ande banswà.
Nde kasyen u ndwà ande, kàyöŋà mɛsà, waa kàsäŋà anà ndwà ande yanswà ntɔn kàsi nde làkwikilà amu Nzam.
Mpal làyaanà taaŋ, antɛɛn bàtöm asyääl ntɔn mutɛn a un'leer a bɔlokà naa: «Awɛy baar ban.»
Un'leer a bɔlokà kàkyään Pɔl ndaa ayi, waa kàtɛn naa: «Amfum antɛɛn ban'tɔm ndaa naa bàlatwey u bɔlokà. Apanà, làtoo anà làkyen unsà duu.»
Wɛɛ Pɔl kàtɛn naa: «Ungö mukikam an'füm u mii a baar ukɔɔn akifuul un'lɔɔn, bi Alɔmà, ba bitɔɔm u bɔlokà. Apanà waa ba bitɔɔm u nsà u nku! Ya ikal anki abwɛy! Wɛy ba ŋakwo bàyitwey!»
Asyääl bàkàkyään ndaa ayi akà amfum a antɛɛn. Mpal bàwem ba naa ba bàkäl Alɔmà, bɔɔmà waa lawɛl.
Ba waa bàyi, babɔ̈ɔ̈n, batwey anà balɔ̈ɔ̈m mutoo u bul.
Mpal bàtoo ba u bɔlokà, ba bàkàbilà u ndwà a Lidi. Ungö mubwey anà atɔŋ, ba bapɛ ngwal, waa bàkyen.
Pɔl anà Silasi bàlyaaŋ kà Amfipolisi anà Apɔlɔni, ba bàkɔlà Tɛsalɔnikà. Akun Ayudà bàkäl anà ndwà a nköŋ aba.
Pɔl kàbilà kwo asànaa nkääl ande. An'saba an'tär màlääb, nde kàkäl muyäämà anà ba ntɔn Ndaa Aŋàsɔn,
wàmubuul anà muswaŋ naa Klistɔ kàkyer alàman mpay anà kàkyer alàwiyà uboo a akü. Klistɔ wà Yɛsu wa alàkyäänà mɛ wà.
Ndam a baar uboo a ba bàkyey ba, ba bàtüüb anà Pɔl anà Silasi, anà un'kàbɔ a Angɛlɛki bàfasyäŋà Nzam, anà akaar a nkaay mbɔɔn.

Wɛɛ Ayudà bàwem un'köl, ba bàwɛl baar a bunàbun bàmbàmbärà kà an'balàbal ntɔn musà binköŋ mbɔɔn uboo a un'sɛŋ anà lingyoomà uboo a bul. Ba bàkàyɔl u ndwà a Yasɔn, ntɔn muleŋ Pɔl anà Silasi anà mukasyen akà un'sɛŋ a baar.

Ba bamɛn anki, apan ba bàwɛl Yasɔn anà ndam a atɔŋ bàkäl anà nde, ba batwääl akà abyääl a bul, bàmusà in'kwɛŋ anà mutɛn naa: «Baar bà ban'twaal lingyoomà u mɛɛn manswà, wɛɛ ŋàbawà ba ban'yàkɔlà apà!
Yasɔn kawɛl u ndwà ande. Ba banswà bàkwen anki mulab in'kɔɔn a Sɛzar, ba bàmutɛɛnà naa we anà mfum asin ikɔb ande Yɛsu.»
Ndaa ayi yàtwääl lingyoomà akà un'sɛŋ a baar anà akà abyääl a bul.
Ungö muwal nkwiy kà an'kɔɔ a Yasɔn anà mà baar bumwɛy, ba waa bawɛy.
U mpib, atɔŋ bàtöm Pɔl anà Silasi u Bɛrɛ. Umpal bàtöl ba, ba bàbilà u ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà.

Ayudà a Bɛrɛ bàkäl anà mpem aŋàbwaŋ akwànaa Ayudà a Tɛsalɔnikà. Ba bàwɛl Ndaa unsà mansyäär, ba sye bàfasyeebà Ndaa Aŋàsɔn ilä byanswà ntɔn muyöb naa nkye indiir bakyäänà byàkäl ndandaa.
Baar mbɔɔn uboo a ba bàsi làkwikilà, anà akaar angɛlɛki a nkaay, anà abaal mbɔɔn.
Wɛɛ mpal bàyöb Ayudà a Tɛsalɔnikà naa Pɔl wàmukyäänà ndaa a Nzam sye u Bɛrɛ, ba bàyi ntɔn musà lingyoomà uboo a baar banswà.
Apan, làgyägyä, atɔŋ bàkàswà Pɔl u ntsü a ngyäl a kölàköl, wɛɛ akà Silasi anà Tumàtɛ, ba bàsàsal paa.
Baar bàsyen Pɔl, bàkàtsü kà Atɛn. Ungö bàyàfurà ba, ba bàkyään Silasi anà Tumàtɛ nswɛɛŋ katööm Pɔl: nde kalɔ̈m naa ba bun'läb agyägyä.
Umpal kàkäl Pɔl mudilà ba kà Atɛn, mpem ande yàlalà mbaa muman naa bul la làkäl aŋàyɔl a itɛk.
Nde kàyäämà anà Ayudà anà baar mpa abà Ayudà abà bàfasyäŋà Nzam uboo a ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà, anà baar banswà kàbweeyà nde abà kà un'syäl ilä byanswà.

Ndam a baar a an'yeerà, baar a Epikür anà baar a Stɔyi bàyäämà anà nde. Amwɛy bàtɛɛnà naa: «Ŋamun awà ininà ukwen mutɛn?» Bumwɛy naa: «Nde ayàkal un'lɔɔŋ a bànzam a ingyey» ntɔn nde kàkyäänà Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ là Yɛsu anà ngwiiyà a akü.
Apan waa bun'kör, bun'syen kà un'syäl a Arɔpazɛ, waa bàtɛn a nde naa: «Nkye bi ikyàkwo muyöb, an'lɔɔŋ nà màkün ayikyään ngye mà?
Ntɔn ngye awà mukyäänà bi indiir a ingyey. Bi ikwen muyöb naa bya iswaŋà aben.»
Abun, baar a Atɛn banswà anà angyey bàfàkal kà Atɛn, taaŋ aba mbɔɔn làlyaaŋà mutɛn itàkal muwem indiir akün.
Pɔl kàkäl umbär uboboo a Arɔpazɛ, waa kàtɛn naa: «Abaal a Atɛn, mɛ an'man naa mɔ̈ɔ̈ abɛ wanswà wà unsà inzaam.

Ntɔn an'yilyaaŋ mɛ uboo a bul abɛ anà an'syebà mɛ indiir a in'kyɛɛl abɛ, mɛ an'man idwà imwɛy bàkyàsɔn naa: "Akà nzam mpa bàyöb baar!" Wɛɛ nde wa làfàsyänà bɛ wà anà làkɔ̈ɔ̈n ayöb bɛ, mɛ amàyàlakyään wa.
Nzam awà kàkyer du anà mɛɛn anà indiir byanswà abyà uboo, nde wà Mwol a du anà mɛɛn, nde ufàkal anki uboo a ndwà a nzam ayà bàkyer kà an'kɔɔ a baar,
nde baar bàfun'bay anki, asànaa nde kà we anà mfun a undiir aben undiir. Ntɔn nde wà mbuur afàpà mɔ̈ɔ̈ anà un'swey akà baar banswà anà indiir byumwɛy.
Fà mbuur mwɛy nde kàkyer in'sɛŋ a baar ntɔn ba bàkäl udu a mɛɛn manswà, nde kàtsül an'mpaŋà anà ndel a nsi bàtöŋ ba.
Nde kàkwen naa baar bàleŋ Nzam, taaŋ lumwɛy naa ba bun'mɛn unsà ileleŋ aba. Kutɛn aŋàbwaŋ nde kwɛl watɛy anà umwɛy umwɛy uboo a bi,
ntɔn: "U mbwo ande, bi ibye anà mɔ̈ɔ̈, ibàmubar anà mukal." Ya yà asànaa bàtɛn asöön abɛ amwɛy naa: "Bi sye ibà itoo ande."
Undiir awun, ntɔn ibà bi itoo a Nzam, bi ikwe anki muyweer naa nde ukäl asànaa itɛk a wɔl, kyà arza anà kyà un'kul kàkyer mbuur unsà an'kyän ande.
Wɛɛ Nzam, ukɔɔn alab taaŋ a ingyöy, apanà nde wàmubel baar banswà u ntsü yanswà mubuul mpem,
ntɔn nde kàkyàtsul ilä mwɛy akyà usàtsüül nde mɛɛn manswà nsaŋ unsà balàbal u mbwo a mbuur kàsɔ̈ɔ̈l nde, awà kaswɛŋ nde idiim mukun'wiiy kà ukwà.»
Mpal bàwem ba «ngwiiyà a akü», baar amwey waa bun'sɛɛ, wɛɛ bumwɛy bàtɛɛnà naa: «Bi iyàfawem mutɛn ndaa ayi u mbalà asin.»
Apan, Pɔl waa kàsawɛy.
Wɛɛ ndam a baar bumwɛy bàbääb anà nde, ba bàsi làkwikilà: uboo a ba, Dɛnis mbuur a Arɔbazɛ, anà un'kaar mwɛy ikɔb ande Damalis, anà baar asin sye.
Ungö apan, Pɔl kàlwomà kà Atɛn, waa kàkyen Kɔlintɔ.

Nde kwo kàbwey anà Un'yudà mwɛy ikɔb ande Akilasi, un'nsi Pɔnt, kàfü Itali itaan a mbɔɔn tɛy anà un'kyay ande Pilàsilà, ntɔn Kɔlɔdɛ kàswɛŋ naa Ayudà banswà bàkyer atoo u Lɔmà, nde kàbääb anà ba,
ntɔn nde kàkäl akyà isal mwɛy anà ba, nde kàkäl apà ba ntɔn mukyer isal: ba bàkäl akyeer a ntɛn.
Pɔl kàyäämà kà ilä a saba kyanswà u ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà. Nde kàkyer ngwal naa Ayudà anà Angɛlɛki bàkyey.
Wɛɛ utaaŋ bàfü Silasi anà Tumàtɛ Masɛdwan anà bàyàkɔlà ba, Pɔl kàpɛ mɔ̈ɔ̈ ande wanswà mulɔŋ Ndaa anà mutà imbäl akà Ayudà naa Yɛsu wà Klistɔ.

Ayudà bàsyee mbaaŋ, waa bun'töö. Pɔl kàkɔɔb ipfɛy ande, waa kàtɛn a ba naa: «Wɛy an'kil abɛ màbü udu a un'tswe abɛ ŋakwo! Mɛ un'bar ankye akwɛy watɛy. Sɛmà apanà mɛ in'kyà akà baar mpa abà Ayudà.»
Apan, nde kàtoo akun, waa kàbilà u ndwà a mbuur mwɛy ikɔb ande Tityüs Züstüs, nde kàfasyäŋà Nzam, ndwà ande yàkäl yàŋàbääb a ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà.
Apan, Krispüs, un'leer a ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà, kàsi làkwikilà amu Mwol anà ndwà ande yanswà. Bàkɔlintɔ mbɔɔn bàweemà Pɔl, bàsi làkwikilà anà bàwɛlà ndüümà.
U mpib mwɛy, Mwol kàkyään Pɔl unsà imanmii naa: «Twɔn an'man bɔɔmà, lab mukyään, twɔn an'kal a duu.
Ntɔn mɛ, mɛ in'wà anà ngye, akà mbuur mwɛy ukwe anki mukakyer ube, ntɔn un'sɛŋ amɛ wà mbɔɔn u bul alà.»
Nde kàkyer mbul mwɛy a ngɔɔn syaam mulɔŋ ndaa a Nzam uboo a ba.
Wɛɛ umpal kàkäl Galyɔn mfum u Akayi, unsà un'tüüb mwɛy, Ayudà bàtwääl lingyoomà ntɔn mutɔn Pɔl. Apan, ba bun'syen u làbay a nsaŋ,
waa bàtɛn naa: «Mbuur wà wàmuyisyen baar musyäŋà Nzam ukɔɔn alab un'kɔɔn.»
Umpal kàlàduub Pɔl mun, Galyɔn kàtɛn a Ayudà naa: «Kya ilàkal ndwääl itàkal ube a kölàköl, mɛ in'kyer alawem, oo Ayudà.
Wɛɛ isàkal naa mbaaŋ yà ntɔn ndaa anà ikɔb anà un'kɔɔn abɛ ŋakwo, ayin iler bɛ ŋakwo. Mɛ, mɛ in'kwen anki mukal ntɛɛn a indiir abi!»
Apan, nde waa kafuur.
Lalan bàkör ba Sɔstɛn, mfum a ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà, waa bun'düb kusà a làbay a nsaŋ. Wɛɛ Galyɔn indiir abi kàsi anki u mpem.
Pɔl kàfàkal ilä mbɔɔn u Kɔlintɔ. Ungö, nde kàsàwɛy atɔŋ, waa kàwɛl an'swà ntɔn mukyà Siri anà Pilàsilà anà Akilasi, ungö mukɔɔl ntswe ande u Sanshres ntɔn nde kàdi kyän.
Ba bàtöl Ԑfɛsɔ, Pɔl kàsàwɛy atɔŋ bàkäl anà nde paa. Nde kàbilà nde ŋakwo u ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà, waa kàyäm anà Ayudà.
Ba bun'lɔ̈ɔ̈m naa nde ukäl ilä mbɔɔn apà ba, wɛɛ Pɔl kàkyey anki,
wɛɛ nde kàsawɛy nde, waa kàtɛn naa: «Nzam usàkwen, mɛ in'kyer afàsyefurà apà bɛ.» Nde kàbilà kà an'swà mukyà Ԑfɛsɔ.
Nde kàtoo kà an'swà u Sɛzarɛ. Nde kàtàbeenà mupà Ikööŋ mbɔr, waa kàtyà Antyɔsha.
Ungö kàkyer nde ndam a an'taaŋ paa, nde kàkyen anà kàsoonà Ngalàtyà anà Frizi muyipà alɔŋki banswà ngwal.
Un'yudà mwɛy ikɔb ande Apɔlɔsi, un'nsi Alɛksandri, kàyàkɔlà kà Ɛfɛsɔ. Nde kàkäl aŋun'yɛnà, kàyöb utwɛɛy ubwaŋàbwaŋ anà kàkäl ngwal u Ndaa Aŋàsɔn.
Nde kàwɛl un'yɛnà u mbwo a Mwol, anà mbämà unsà dwelà, nde kàyikyäänà anà kàyilɔɔŋà anà nwɛŋ indiir iler Yɛsu, itàkal naa nde kàyöb nà ndüümà a Ywan mpɛl.
Nde kàyääma unsà uyɔl uboo a ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà. Wɛɛ Pilàsilà anà Akilasi bun'wem ba, ba bun'wɛl ukɔl, ntɔn ba bun'swɛŋ ubwaŋàbwaŋ Mbwo a Nzam.

Nde kàkwen mulyaaŋ kà Akayi, atɔŋ bun'pɛ ngwal mukyer abun, ba bàsön un'kaan akà alɔŋki ntɔn ba bun'wɛl. Mpal kàtöl nde, unsà kab a ngway, nde kàmɛnà mbuur a ndöŋ akà baar bàbulà aŋàlàkwikilà
ntɔn nde kàtön Ayudà ipepey a ngwal yanswà u mii a baar: nde kàswɛŋà u mbwo a Ndaa Aŋàsɔn naa Yɛsu wà Klistɔ.
Yàmɛnà naa mpal kàkäl Apɔlɔsi u Kɔlintɔ, Pɔl, ungö kàsoonà nde itiir a nsi a myɔŋ, nde kàtyà Ԑfɛsɔ. Nde kwo kàbwey a ndam a alɔŋki, nde kafuul naa:
«Nkye bɛ làkyàwal Dwelà In'kyɛɛl umpal làbulà bɛ aŋàlàkwikilà?» Ba bun'fuur naa: «Bi kàwem anki akà làsaŋ làmwɛy naa we anà Dweelà In'kyɛɛl.»
Apan nde kafuul naa: «Ndüümà nà bɛ làwɛl?» Ba naa: «Ndüümà a Ywan.»
Waa Pɔl kàtɛn naa: «Ndüümà a Ywan yà ndüümà a mbuul a mpem, nde kàkyäänà un'sɛŋ naa ba bàsi làkwikilà akà mbuur awà ayàyà ungö a nde, iswaŋà naa Yɛsu.»
Ungö bàwem ba ndaa ayi, ba bàwɛl ndüümà kà ikɔb a Mwol Yɛsu.
Ungö kasi Pɔl an'kɔɔ, Dweelà In'kyɛɛl kàyi udu a ba, waa ba bàsɛmà mutɛn unsà ndaa yà ifà ifà anà mutà ngɔɔm.
Ba banswà bàkäl isii a baar kwem aŋiyweel.
Ungö apan, Pɔl kàbilà u ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà, nde kàtɛɛnà anà uyɔl ngɔɔn tär, wàmuyämà anà musiinà baar bàweemà nde naa ba bàkyey ndaa a Imwol a Nzam kàlɔɔŋà nde.

Wɛɛ bumwɛy uboo a ba bàkäl baar a un'tswe bwoor, ba bàtön musà làkwikilà anà bàsɛɛ Mbwo u mii a nköŋ a baar. Apan Pɔl kàkaabà anà ba, waa kàwɛl alɔŋki ukɔl ntɔn muyäämà anà ba ilä a ilä u ndwà a nkaan a Tiranüs.
Ya abà yàkölà mbul yweel, abun baar banswà bàkäl kà Azi, Ayudà anà a Angɛlɛki, bàkyer awem Ndaa a Mwol.
Nzam kàkyerà impà a ifà asin u mbwo a an'kɔɔ a Pɔl.
Undiir awun, bàsyee ba ipfey itàkal itɛɛnà a ipfɛy byàböölà ndür ande udu a abɛy: an'kyal aba waa màwüü, an'dweelà an'be waa màtoo.
Ndam a Ayudà bàyilyaaŋà ntsü yanswà ntɔn muböŋ an'dweelà an'be uboo a baar, bàbulà sye mutà ikɔb a Mwol Yɛsu din anà mutɛn naa: «Mɛ amaswaŋ, too kà ikɔb a Yɛsu awà ufàkyään Pɔl wà!»
Baar bàkyerà abun bà baan a Tsɛva babaal bànsambwaar. Tsɛva kàkäl Un'yudà, kàkäl sye undweer a angaŋ.
Wɛɛ dweelà a làbe kafuur naa: «Mɛ Yɛsu in'kyun'yöb, mɛ in'kyàyöb naa Pɔl wà nà. Wɛɛ bɛ, bɛ làbà bànà?»
Apan, mbuur kàkäl anà dweelà a làbe kabweel u ndür, kàsöön ba banswà u ngwal. Unkiiŋ kàkü bɛy, lalan bàtiin ba ndwà ande bànsàpɔl anà iwà u ndür.
Baar banswà bàkäl kà Ɛfɛsɔ, Ayudà anà Angɛlɛki, bàkyer ayöb ndaa ayi, bɔɔmà waa lawɛl, ikɔb a Mwol Yɛsu kyàkäl kyàŋàsyäŋà.
Baar mbɔɔn uboo a baar bàbulà aŋàlàkwikilà, bàyee mukyey anà mukyään nsyääl aba.
Baar mbɔɔn uboo a baar bàfasyäälà inwɛŋ, bàtwääl in'kaan aba, waa bàsyee mya mbaa kusà a baar banswà. Mpal bàyilà ba ntal a mya, ya yàbü nsaab an'kwem an'tyeen myà itɛr a ngim.
Undiir awun, unsà ngwal a Mwol, Ndaa yàkyer ayɛl anà yàkäl ngwal.
Ungö byàlyaaŋ indiir abi, Pɔl kàwɛl an'kyän unsà dweelà musoonà Masɛdwan anà Akayi ntɔn mukyà Yɛlusàlɛm, waa kàtɛn naa: «Mɛ insàfur atol paa, mɛ in'kyer aman Lɔmà sye.»
Ungö mutɔm Masɛdwan abɔ̈ɔ̈l uboo a baar basälà anà nde, Tumàtɛ anà Ԑlastɛ, nde ŋakwo kàsàkyer ndam a ilä kà Azi.
Umpal ayin, lingyoomà a ngwal làkyer atoo ntɔn Mbwo.
Kàkäl anà un'kyeer a in'tak mwɛy ikɔb ande Dɛmɛtrüs, kàfakyerà bikwom a idwà a Artɛmisi anà arza. Abun asyääl ande bàwɛlà bweel mbɔɔn.
Nde kàtüüb ba anà baar asin bàfakyerà isal imwey anà ba, waa kàtɛn naa: «Abaal, bɛ làkyàyöb naa ubwaŋ abi bàfàfà unsà isal ki.

Wɛɛ bɛ ŋakwo làkimanà anà làkiweemà: kànà kà Ԑfɛsɔ mpɛl anki, wɛɛ kà isii a Azi kyanswà, Pɔl awà wàmuni an'kyän a un'sɛŋ mbɔɔn anà musiinà ba, asànaa ukatɛɛnà nde, naa bànzam akwà bàfàfà kà an'kɔɔ abi kàbà bànzam anki.
Kà nà isal abi mpɛl anki iyàtäy, wɛɛ sye ndwà a nzam abi wàkölàköl wà un'kaar Artɛmisi ikɔ̈ɔ̈n afàyàkal anà làkoo a nzam wa bàfàsyäŋà wà kà Azi anà u mɛɛn manswà!»
Ndaa ayi yàpɛ nkyɛl mbɔɔn akà baar bàwem ya, ba bàsi in'kwɛŋ, waa bàtɛn naa: «Artɛmisi wà nzam un'kaar wàkölàköl wà baar a Ԑfɛsɔ!»
Bul lanswà làbilà uboo a lingyoomà. Baar mbɔɔn bàkyen u ndwà a itaŋà, bàkör Gayüsi anà Aristarkà, baar a Masɛdwan abɔ̈ɔ̈l bàyilyaaŋà anà Pɔl.
Pɔl kàkwen mukàmɛnà kusà a un'sɛŋ, wɛɛ alɔŋki waa bun'tsüŋ.
Andweer a isal amwɛy bàkäl asam ande, ba bàtöm baar mukun'lɔm naa nde ukɔɔn akàpà ndür ande u ndwà a itaŋà.
Baar baar bàkäl mutɛn a ngwal unsà làkyamun, lingyoomà làkyer abilà uboo a nköŋ, bàmbɔɔn bàyöb anki isin a ndaa bàköŋ ba.
Apan, baar uboo a un'sɛŋ bàkyään ndaa ayin akà mbuur mwɛy ikɔb ande Alɛksandre awà bàsi Ayudà nkalsà. Alɛksandre kàsɛn kɔɔ udu ntɔn muwɛɛl ba kusà a nköŋ.
Wɛɛ mpal bàwem ba naa nde kàkäl un'yudà, ba banswà, u mun mwɛy, bàsi in'kwɛŋ tsütsü a an'taaŋ mɔ̈ɔ̈l: «Artɛmisi a Ɛfɛsɔ wàkölàköl!»
Apan, ungö mukyäämà un'sɛŋ, nde kàtɛn naa: «Abaal a Ԑfɛsɔ, nà mpa ayöb naa Ԑfɛsɔ là bul làfàler ndwà a nzam a Artɛmisi a kölàköl anà itɛk ande kyàfü du anà kyàyàbwà u mɛɛn?
Ntɔn ndaa ayi, akà mbuur asà ya mbaaŋ watɛy, làkäl a duu, twɔn lan'kyer agyägyä.
Wɛɛ baar bà, bɛ làmatwaal apà, baar mpa bàkyer ube akà nzam abi wà un'kaar, anà mpa bun'bɛy.
Isàkal naa Dɛmɛtrüs anà baar kàsälà nde abà bàkwen mufüün mbuur mwɛy, ye anà mbay a nsaŋ anà ntɛɛn: wɛy baar baar bakàfüün kwo.
Kya isàkal naa bɛ làwe anà undiir asin mulɔm, wɛy un'syäl a balàbal ulɔ̈n wa.
Naa tɛy, baar bàyiwal asànaa baar a lingyoomà ntɔn nköŋ abi yàŋàbà, ntɔn akà undiir mwɛy kan'kwo mupà bi iböŋ ntɔn nköŋ ayi watɛy.»
Ungö apan, nde kàpay baar bàköŋ.
Mpal làwü làso lanswà, Pɔl kàtüüb alɔŋki. Ungö mukapà ngwal, laa kàsawɛy nde, waa kàkyen Masɛdwan.
Nde kàlyaaŋ kà in'tà amin mupà alɔŋki ngwal unsà an'yääm mbɔɔn. Ungö nde kàkyen Ngɛlɛsi
mper kàkyer nde ngɔɔn tär. Nde kàbön muwal an'swà ntɔn mukyà Siri, wɛɛ Ayudà bàdirà mukun'kyer ube. Undiiràwun kàsɔɔm nde an'kyän mufàsoonà u Masɛdwan.

Baar bàkyen muyisal anà nde tii kà Azi babà: Sɔpatrɔs, mwan baal a Pirüs un'nsi Bɛrɛ, Aristark anà Sɛgɔn ansi Tɛsalɔnikà, Gayüs un'nsi Dɛrbɛ, Tumàtɛ anà Tishik anà Trɔfim baar a un'tà a Azi.
Ba banswà bàkyen kusà a bi, ba bàkidil u Tɔlɔwasi.
Wɛɛ bi, bi Filipe kàlwomà ungö a ilä a mampà iköön ful, bi kàbilà kà an'swà mukàtaan ba ungö a ilä ityeen u Tɔlowasi, ikal kàkyer bi ilä nsambwaar.
Ilä atàtwɛb ungö a saba, bi kàkäl ikal imwɛy ntɔn mutsul mampà, Pɔl kàkäl muyäämà anà ba. Ntɔn ya yàlɔ̈m naa nde akyà taaŋtyà, nde kàläb an'yääm ndaay tii uboboo a mpib.
Minà myàkäl mbɔɔn u suk adu kàköŋ bi.

Kyekà, un'tö mwɛy ikɔb ande Ötik, kàkäl wàŋàbwaay u mun a nɛl. Umpal kàkäl Pɔl mulab an'yääm ndaay, nde kàkuur a twaal. Twaal alà lun'syen nkuur, waa kàbü fà ndwà yàtär udu. Mpal bun'suub ba, nde kàkäl wàŋàkwà.
Pɔl laa kàtɔlà nde, waa kàkyà ntiin mper kàkäl un'tö awà. Nde kun'wɛl kà an'kɔɔ, waa kàtɛn naa: «Twɔn lan'tɛɛr, mɔ̈ɔ̈ ande wà mwo!»
Ungö mubeenà, Pɔl, kàtsül làmpà, waa kàdi. Apan, waa kàfàlab an'yääm tii làtyà taaŋ. Apan, laa kàkyen nde.
Wɛɛ akà un'tö awà, ba bun'syen anà mɔ̈ɔ̈. Ya yàpɛ ngwal mbɔɔn akà baar banswà.
Wɛɛ bi, bi kàwɛl an'swà kusà mukyà Asɔsi, bul kàkàwal bi Pɔl, ntɔn nde kàkwen mukyà u mbwo a mɛɛn.
Mpal kàyitaan nde u Asɔsi, bi kun'wɛl kà an'swà ntɔn mukyà Mitilɛn.
Fà apan, bi kàläb mbwo a an'dà taaŋtyà, bi kàkàtol tsütsü a Kyɔ. Ilä kyàlääb pa, bi kàsoonà u Samɔsi. Ungö a ilä mwɛy, bi kàtöl Milɛ ungö mukɔm u Trɔzilyɔn.
Ntɔn, Pɔl kàkwen mulyaaŋ ifaŋ kà Ԑfɛsɔ, ntɔn mukɔɔn adwa taaŋ kà Azi: nde kàdüül mukal u Yɛlusàlɛm ilä a Pantɛkɔt, kya mbwo yàlàkal.
Mpalàbà, u Milɛ, Pɔl kàtöm baar mukàbel andweer a Ikööŋ a Ԑfɛsɔ.
Utaaŋ bàyàkɔlà ba apà nde, nde kàtɛn a ba naa: «Bɛ, bɛ làkyàyöb naa mɛ anà bɛ in'fàkal aben sɛmà ilä atàtwɛb kàtɔ̈l mɛ Azi.
Mɛ kàsyääl Mwol unsà làbɔ̈ɔ̈n lanswà uboo a nsaaŋ anà uboo a in'taam myàfü u ndiirà a Ayudà.
Mɛ kàyee anki akà undiir mwɛy kan'kwo mukal wàndöŋ ntɔn bɛ. Wɛɛ mɛ kàkyer alakyään anà kàkyer alalɔŋ u mii a baar anà uboo a ndwà,
mukyään Ayudà anà Angɛlɛki mbuul a mpem akà Nzam anà musà làkwikilà amu Mwol abi Yɛsu.
Wɛɛ apanà, mɛ, mɛ in'wà aŋàbämà anà Dweelà, lalan in'kyà mɛ Yɛlusàlɛm, ukɔɔn ayöb naa ndaa nà ikan'bweel kwo.
Wɛɛ undiir mwɛy mpɛl Dweelà In'kyɛɛl ukan'swaŋà: u bul lanswà in'siŋ anà mpay aŋàkir yàmukan'diilà.
Wɛɛ akà mɛ, mɛ ndöŋ mbɔɔn in'paa anki akà mɔ̈ɔ̈ amɛ, undiir mwɛy awà kan'söön ubwaŋ wà mulab mbwo amɛ anà mumay isal kan'pɛ Mwol Yɛsu: utà imbäl a Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ là kab a ngway a Nzam.
Sɛmà apanà, mɛ, mɛ in'kyàyöb naa bɛ ntabwey amɛ làyàfàman anki, bɛ banswà baar abà kàlyaaŋà mɛ uboo a bɛ muyikyään Imwol a Nzam.
Lalan, mɛ, mɛ an'kwo in'tɛ imbäl ŋàbawà kusà a bɛ naa umwɛy uboo abɛ usadiimà mbwo, nsaŋ ande ŋakwo.
Ntɔn mɛ akà undiir mwɛy kàyee anki, wɛɛ mɛ, mɛ kàlakyään an'kyän a Nzam manswà.
Làkäl kà igyɛɛŋ ntɔn bɛ ŋakwo anà ntɔn làböl kàlapɛ Dweelà In'kyɛɛl muler, làkäl aseey a Ikööŋ a Nzam kàwɛl nde u mbwo a an'kil ande ŋakwo.
Mɛ, mɛ inkyàyöb naa ungö a nkyeen amɛ, in'kyɛŋ a nkyɛl mpa myàsàwem ngyɛb a làböl myàkyer asàbilà uboo a bɛ,
itàkal uboo a itsuŋ abɛ ŋakwo baar bàkyer asàmbarà mutɛn ndaa a loor ntɔn alɔŋki baläb.
Lalan, làtsim, làyöb naa u mbul tär, mpib anà mwäänà, isal amɛ kyàkäl mutɛn a bɛ anà nsaaŋ u mii.
«Waa apanà, mɛ amàlapà kà an'kɔɔ a Nzam anà akà ndaa a kab a ngway ande alye anà ngwal atɔŋ anà mupà kwal akà baar aŋàkyɛɛl banswà.
Mɛ kàsàwem anki un'köl ntɔn ngim itàkal wɔl itàkal ipfey a mbuur.
Bɛ, bɛ ŋakwo làkyàyöb naa an'kɔɔ mà, ma màsäl ntɔn indiir kàkäl bi abyà ndöŋ, mɛ anà baar bàkäl anà mɛ.
Mɛ kàlaswɛŋ taaŋ lanswà naa yubwaŋ musal abun ntɔn mubay baar abà u ngyal, muyɔbà ndaa kàtɛn Mwol Yɛsu ŋakwo naa: "Un'sak afàkal mbɔɔn mupà akwànaa muwal!"»
Ungö mutɛn abwɛy, nde kàbü an'köm mbwo mwɛy anà ba banswà, waa kàyamà.
Apan ba banswà waa bàlel, bun'bweel u bway ntɔn mukundüür.
Ngyɛb aba yàmbɔɔn yàfü unsà ndaa kàtɛn nde naa ba ntabwey ande bàfàsàman anki. Apan ba bàkun'swà tii kà an'swà.
Yàmɛnà naa ungö mukaabà anà ba a mpay anà muwal an'swà, bi kàkyen ipey tii u Kɔs, taaŋtyà bi kàkɔlà Rɔdɛ, apan bi kàkyà Patara.
Paa, bi kàmɛn an'swà màmukyà Fɛnɛsi, laa kàbilà bi, kàkyen bi.
Mpal kàtääl bi isaŋ a Shipɛlɛ, bi kàsàwɛy kya u kɔɔ a ikaar, waa kàwɛl mbwo mukyà mper a Siri, bi kàtɔlà u Tir, ikal màtwey an'swà buur ama.
Akun bi kàmɛn alɔŋki, bi kàbwaay paa mpɔsà mwɛy. U mbwo a Dweelà ba bàtɛn a Pɔl naa nde ukɔɔn abeenà Yɛlusàlɛm.
Wɛɛ mpal byàkwe ilä abi, bi kàfàwal mbwo mukyà. Ba banswà anà akyay aba anà baan aba bàkiswà tii u nsà a bul. Mpal kàtöl bi kà un'kɔɔl a an'dà, bi kàbü an'köm, waa kàyamà.
Ungö mupɛɛl mbɔr a ntsüü anà atɔŋ, bi kàbilà kà an'swà, wɛɛ ba bàfurà ndwà aba.
Wɛɛ akà bi, bi kàmay mbwo abi yanswà sɛmà Tir tii Petɔlɛmayis, bi kàpɛ atɔŋ mbɔr, waa kàbwaay apà ba ilä mwɛy.
Taaŋtyà, kàtoo bi, bi kàkyen Sɛzarɛ. Akun, bi kàbilà u ndwà a Filipo un'paylàsaŋ a Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ, umwɛy uboo a Nsambwaar, waa bi kàbwaay paa.
Nde kàkäl abà baan akaar ankɔr anà. Ba bàfataa ngɔɔm.
Bi kàkäl paa ilä mbɔɔn, umpal kàyi ŋangɔɔm mwɛy kàfü Yuday ikɔb ande Agabüs.

Nde kayi akà bi anà kàwɛl un'di a lɔŋ a Pɔl, nde kàbäm wa kà in'kɔl anà kà an'kɔɔ ande ŋakwo, waa kàtɛn naa: «Làwem, Dweelà In'kyɛɛl an'tɛn naa mbuur aŋun'di wà, Ayudà bàsàkyer un'bäm u Yɛlusàlɛm asànaa an'bäm mɛ là, waa bàsun'yälà kà an'kɔɔ a angyey.»
Mpal bàwem bi indiir abi, bi ŋakwo anà atɔŋ a bul alan, bi bàbɔ̈ɔ̈n Pɔl mukɔɔn abeenà Yɛlusàlɛm.
Apan, Pɔl kàfuur naa: «Undiir nà làlelà bɛ anà làkaamà bɛ mpem amɛ? Wɛɛ akà mɛ, mɛ an'kyey, kà nà mukan'bäm in'siŋ mpɛl anki, wɛɛ anà mukwà u Yɛlusàlɛm ntɔn ikɔb a Mwol Yɛsu.»
Bi bàsàkwo anki musɔɔm an'kyän ande, bi bàkäl akul, waa bàtɛn naa: «Wɛy ukwen a Mwol bàkäl.»
Ungö a ndam a ilä, bi bàlɔ̈ɔ̈n indiir abi, waa kàbeenà Yɛlusàlɛm.
Ndam a alɔŋki uboo alɔŋki a Sɛzarɛ bàkiswà anà bisyeen mukàbɔ̈ɔ̈n u ndwà a un'nsi Shipɛle mwɛy ikɔb ande Mnasɔn. Nde kàkäl un'lɔŋki fà itaan.
U ntööl abi u Yɛlusàlɛm, atɔŋ biwɛl unsà un'sak wanswà.
Taaŋtyà, Pɔl kàkyen anà bi u ndwà a Zyak, ikal bàköŋ andweer banswà.
Ungö kapɛ nde mbɔr, nde kakyään pànsi pànsi indiir byanswà kàkyer Nzam akà baar mpa abà Ayudà u mbwo a isal ande.
Ungö mukun'wem, ba bàsi Nzam làkoo, waa bàfuur akà Pɔl naa: «Un'tɔŋ, ngye akimanà, Ayudà nsaab kwe ban'sà làkwikilà, ba banswà ban'pà mɔ̈ɔ̈ aba unsà un'kɔɔn.

Wɛɛ ntɔn ngye, ba bàwem in'ŋün naa ngye ayilɔŋ ndaa a nkɔɔl, naa Ayudà bàfàkal uboo a baar mpa abà Ayudà bàtön Mɔsɛ, anà mukakyään naa ba bàkɔɔn akyɛy baan aba anà bàkɔɔn alab nkääl a Ayudà.
Bi waa ikyer aben? Itàkal kaben, ba bàkyer ayàyöb naa ngye an'yà.
Undiiràwun, ngye akyer asànaa kaswaŋ bi: bi ibye abà abaal anà bàkyàdyà kyän.

Asyen, kadi nkwà anà ba. Fur sye ngim aba ntɔn ba bàkɔɔl ntswe aba. Abun baar banswà bàyàyöb ba naa ndaa yanswà bàwem ba ntɔn ngye kàyà ndandaa anki, wɛɛ ngye, ngye ŋakwo sye afàlab Un'kɔɔn.

Akà baar mpa abà Ayudà bàbulà aŋàlàkwikilà, bi, bi kàkyasöön mbar kàtsül bi: ukɔɔn adyà in'twaŋ ifàfà unsà ibɔɔn bàfàpà akà itɛk, anà an'kil, anà in'twaŋ mpa bàtsül kil, anà ukɔɔn akyer ipasasɛ.»
Apan, Pɔl kàsyen baar abà, waa kàdi nkwà anà ba taaŋtyà. Nde kàbilà u ndwà a Nzam ntɔn mukyään ilä isàwà nkwà anà bàsàpà ibɔɔn ntɔn umwɛy umwɛy uboo a ba.
Wɛɛ ilä nsambwaar byàkäl tsütsü mukwo mpal bun'mɛn Ayudà a Azi u ndwà a Nzam. Apan ba bàsi lingyoomà uboo a un'sɛŋ a baar wanswà, waa bun'kör,

bàkuub in'kwɛŋ, waa bàtɛn naa: «Baar a Isàlɛl, kàlayää libay! Le mbuur akwà ayinwan anà un'sɛŋ anà un'kɔɔn abi, anà ikal ki unsà ndaa uyilɔŋ nde mper yanswà anà akà baar banswà! Nde sye kàkyàbiil Angɛlɛki uboo a ndwà a Nzam ntɔn mubɛy ikal in'kyɛɛl ki!»
Ntɔn ba bàtwab atàman Trɔfimɛ un'nsi Ԑfɛsɔ anà nde uboo a bul, lalan bàsii ba naa Pɔl kun'biil u ndwà a Nzam.
Bul lanswà waa làni, un'sɛŋ waa kàyàköŋ. Baar bàkör Pɔl, waa bun'twey u ndwà a Nzam, apan ba bàdübà ibeenà agyägyä.
Ba bàleŋà mbwo mukun'dwa, mpal làkàtöl làsaŋ akà mfum a aŋità nsaab a Lɔmà naa Yɛlusàlɛm lanswà lan'bilà u lingyoomà.
Taaŋ nsil alan, nde kàwɛl aŋità anà an'kaptɛn, waa kàkyà ntiin mupay un'sɛŋ u mper bàkäl ba. Mpal bàmɛn ba mfum a aŋità nsaab anà aŋità, ba bàwɛy mudüb Pɔl.
Apan mfum a aŋità kàsin tsütsü apà nde, waa kun'kör, kàswɛŋ mukun'bäm an'dwaaŋ. Ungö apan, nde kàkwen muyöb naa nde wà nà anà nde sye ininà kan'kyer.

Wɛɛ, uboo a un'sɛŋ a baar, baar baar bàkäl mukuub in'kwɛŋ. Unsà isak isak aki, mfum a aŋità kàsàyöb anki akà undiir mwɛy. Undiir awun, kàswɛŋ nde naa Pɔl bun'syen u Fɔrtɛrɛs a aŋità a Lɔmà.
Mpal kàkɔlà nde udu a ikaar, aŋità bàkyer un'syɛn ntɔn nkyɛl a un'sɛŋ a baar yàkäl mbɔɔn,
ntɔn un'kàbɔ a baar kàkäl muyun'lab anà musà in'kwɛŋ naa: «Ukü!»
U taaŋ bàlun'biil ba u Fɔrtɛrɛs, Pɔl kàtɛn a mfum a nsaab naa: «Nkye mbwo ikyàkal mɛ mutɛn undiir mwɛy a ngye?» Mfum a aŋità kun'fuul naa: «Nkye ngye akyàyöb Ingɛlɛki?
Nkye ngye, kà ngye anki awà un'ngipiti awà kàtwääl ipaay mfwen anà kàsyen adwää baar nsaab nà u nsye a ipɔl?»
Pɔl kàtɛn naa: «Mɛ? Mɛ in'wà un'yudà, bul a mɛ Tarsisi u Silisi, bul làmwɛy là làkoo. Mɛ amabɔɔn, mpɛ mbwo muyääm a un'sɛŋ.»
Mfum a nsaab waa kun'pɛ mbwo. Pɔl kàkäl umbäär udu a ikaar, kàkyer isii a kɔɔ, un'sɛŋ a baar wanswà waa kàkäl a duu. Apan nde kàkyään ba unsà Ɛbɛlyɔ, waa kàtɛn naa:
«Atɔŋ abaal anà bàtaa, làwem un'lɔn in'kwen mɛ musà kusà a bɛ apanà.»
Mpal bàwem ba Pɔl wàmutɛn u ndaa a Bɛbɛlyɔ, Ba bàkäl akul. Apan Pɔl waa kàtɛn naa:

«Mɛ, mɛ in'wà un'yudà, mɛ ban'bör u Tarsis a Silisi, wɛɛ mɛ ban'bɔŋ u bul alà, ban'lɔŋ kà in'kɔl a Ngamalyɛl asànaa awà un'kɔɔn a andweer, mɛ kàkäl anà un'kanà mbɔɔn ntɔn Nzam asànaa naa làbà bɛ banswà ŋàbawà.
Mɛ awà, mɛ kàyiiŋ Mbwo ayi ngwal tii u nkweel, mɛ kàbäm abaal anà akaar in'siŋ anà katɔɔm u bɔlokà.
Undweer a angaŋ anà itsuŋ a andweer bà ambäl amɛ: mɛ kàwɛl anà in'kaan akà ba ntɔn mukyà Damas mukɔr atɔŋ bàkäl kwo anà mukasyen Yɛlusàlɛm ntɔn bapɛ ntaaŋàmbar.
«Yàmɛnà naa kàkäl mɛ u mbwo anà kàtöl mɛ tsütsü a Damas, kà imbürà, mper a midi, un'ŋyäŋ a pɛɛlà mwɛy kàfü du, waa kan'diŋà.
Mɛ kàbü u mɛɛn, umpal kàwem mɛ ndaa mwɛy itɛɛnà a mɛ naa: "Sɔl, Sɔl, ntɔn nkye ayan'mɛɛy ngye nkwaaŋ?"
Mɛ kàfuur naa: "Mwol, ngye nà?" Nde kàtɛn naa: "Mɛ, mɛ in'wà Yɛsu Nazorye akwà afàmɛɛy ngye nkwaaŋ."
Baar bàkäl anà mɛ bàkyàman un'ŋyäŋ a pɛɛlà, wɛɛ ba bàwem anki ndaa a mbuur kàyäämà anà mɛ.
Mɛ kàtɛn naa: "Mwol, ininà mɛ an'kwo mukyer?" Mwol kàtɛn a mɛ naa: "Mbarà, kyen Damas, bàkyer akasam yinà yanswà kàmaswaŋ Nzam mukyer."
Wɛɛ un'ŋyäŋ a pɛɛlà awun kan'dwä mii, baar bàkäl anà mɛ ban'ntɛ mpi u kɔɔ tii kàtöl mɛ Damas.
«U Damas, kàkäl anà mbuur mwɛy ikɔb ande Ananyas, nde kàkäl anà inzaam anà kàläbà un'kɔɔn ubwaŋàbwaŋ. Ayudà banswà bàkälà paa bun'tɛɛlà imbäl.
Nde kàkyer ayan'man, waa kàtɛn a mɛ naa: "Un'tɔŋ amɛ Sɔl, fàman. Taaŋ nsil alan mɛ waa kàfàman, waa kun'mɛn.
Nde kàtɛn naa: "Nzam a bàtaaràbi kasɔ̈ɔ̈l kaa usà ntɔn muyöb ukwen ande, muman Ŋabalàbal anà muwem ndaa itoo u mun ande,
ntɔn ngye asàkal mbäl ande u mii a baar banswà unsà indiir kàmɛn ngye anà kàwem ngye.
Wɛɛ apanà, ininà ngye afidilà? Mbarà, wal ndüümà anà mpɔɔŋà a man'be angye mutà ikɔb ande din.
«Yàmɛnà naa kàfurà mɛ Yɛlusàlɛm, ilä mwɛy, mɛ kàkäl muyamà u ndwà a Nzam, waa kàmɛn imanmii.
Mɛ kàmɛn Mwol, nde kàtɛn a mɛ naa: "Kyer agyägyä, too apanà u Yɛlusàlɛm, ntɔn ba imbäl angye ntɔn mɛ bàyàkyey anki."
Wɛɛ mɛ kàtɛn naa: "Mwol, ba ŋakwo bàkyàyöb naa mɛ, mɛ kàyisaa baar u bɔlokà anà kàyikamà baar bàkäl anà làkwikilà akà ngye an'füm uboo a ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà yanswà.
Mpal bàdwä mbäl angye Ityen, mɛ ŋakwo kàkäl paa, mukyey baar bun'dwä anà mukaar ipfɛy aba.
Wɛɛ nde kàtɛn a mɛ naa: "Kyen, mɛ, mɛ ŋakwo in'yatɔm ukwɛl mper akà baar mpa abà Ayudà."»
Ba bàkäl mukun'weemà tii mpal kàtɛn nde ndaa ayi, ba bàkuub in'kwɛŋ, waa bàtɛn naa: «Lun'lwom u mɛɛn mbuur atub awà, nde ukwe anki mukal anà mɔ̈ɔ̈!»
Ba bàkuubà in'kwɛŋ, bàkaamà ipfɛy aba anà bàfuumà un'twà u du.
Mfum a nsaab kàswɛŋ naa bun'biil u fɔrtɛrɛs anà bun'fuul in'lɔɔn a an'füm ntɔn nde uyöb ndaa kàkyer nde ntɔn ba bàsi in'kwɛŋ ntɔn nde.
Wɛɛ mpal bun'bäm ba in'siŋ ntɔn bun'käm an'füm, Pɔl kàtɛn a kaptɛn kàkäl paa naa: «Nkye bɛ làbye anà mbwo mukam un'lɔmà an'füm ukɔɔn un'fuul un'lɔɔn?»
Kaptɛn kàwem nde abwɛy, waa kàkàkyään mfum a nsaab: «Ngye pà akyer aben? Mbuur awà wà un'lɔmà.»
Apan, mfum a nsaab kàyàsin apà Pɔl, waa kun'fuul: «Nkyän, nkye ndandaa ngye awà un'lɔmà?» Nde naa: «Ɛɛ.»
Mfun a nsaab waa kàtɛn naa: «Mɛ, mɛ kàfür ngim mbɔɔn ntɔn mubulà un'lɔmà.» Pɔl waa kàtɛn naa: «Mɛ, mɛ un'bar anki, ilɔmà amɛ bàkyer an'bɔr anà kya.»
Kà imbürà, baar bàlun'kam an'füm ntɔn nde usi ndaa, waa bàtɛ upay. Wɛɛ mfum a nsaab kàwem bɔɔmà naa kyekà mbuur kàbäm nde in'siŋ wà, wà un'lɔmà.
Lalan taaŋtyà kàkwen nde muyöb ubwaŋàbwaŋ undiir bun'füün Ayudà, nde kun'sɔɔl isiŋ ntɔn nde usi un'lɔɔn kusà a ba.
Pɔl kàler làbay a nsaŋ a kölàköl a tɔŋtɔŋ, waa kàtɛn naa: «Atɔŋ abaal, yà unsà an'kyän a duu mɛ kàsyääl Nzam tii ŋàbawà.»
Wɛɛ Undweer a ngaŋ Ananyas kàswɛŋ baar bàkäl tsütsü apà nde mukun'kam mbar u mun ande.
Pɔl kàtɛn a nde naa: «Ubwaŋ a nsà, Nzam ayapà mbar! Ngye an'bwaay mukan'tsüül nsaŋ unsà un'kɔɔn, wɛɛ ngye, ngye awàmubɛy un'kɔɔn, ngye aswaŋ baar ban'käm mbar!»
Baar bàkäl tsütsü apà nde bàtɛn a nde naa: «Ngye awàmuto undweer a angaŋ a Nzam!»
Pɔl kàtɛn naa: «Atɔŋ, mɛ in'yayöb anki naa nde wà undweer a angaŋ, ntɔn bàsön naa: "Ngye asun'to anki mfum a un'sɛŋ angye!"»

Pɔl kàkyer ayöb naa Làbay a Nsaŋ a kölàköl làkäl an'kab mɔ̈ɔ̈l: ndam yà Asadusi, ndam yà Amfarisi. Lalan kàkuub nde in'kwɛŋ kusà a ba: «Atɔŋ abaal, mɛ, mɛ in'wà un'mfarisi, mwan a amfarisi. Ntɔn làkyän unsà ngwiiyà a akü, ba bàman'sà u làbay a nsaŋ.»
Pa kàmay nde mutɛn, mbaaŋ yàbü uboo a Amfarisi anà Asadusi, lalan nköŋ yàkaabà ya.
Ntɔn Asadusi bàfàtɛn naa itàkal ngwiiyà kà ukwà, itàkal un'kyeey, itàkal dweelà batɛy, wɛɛ Amfarisi bàfàkyey naa ba bà mwo.

In'kwɛŋ myàkyer asöönà mbɔɔn, alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn amwɛy uboo a Amfarisi waa bàmbarà, bàtɛn a ngwal naa: «Bi akà ndaa mwɛy yà ube imanà anki unsà mbuur wà. Taaŋ lumwɛy dweelà làmwɛy akɔ̈ɔ̈n sye un'kyeey mwɛy kun'kyään ndaa!»
Mbaaŋ yàbulà yà ngwal. Ntɔn bɔɔmà muman naa ba ban'kwo musay Pɔl, mfum a nsaab kàswɛŋ aŋità ande mutyà anà mukun'lwom uboo a ba anà mukun'syen u fɔrtɛrɛs.
U mpib yàlääb paa, Mwol kàyàmɛnà akà Pɔl, waa kàtɛn a nde naa: «Tsim! Ngye an'tà imbäl amɛ apà u Yɛlusàlɛm, ngye akyer afàkàtà sye u Lɔmà.»
Taaŋtyà, Ayudà bàkyer adirà, waa bàdi kyän naa ba bàdyà anki anà bànwà anki tii mpal bàsàdwa ba Pɔl.
Baar bàdirà ndaa ayi bàkäl aŋàsöön ankweem an'nà.
Apan, ba bàkàman amfum a angaŋ anà andweer, waa bàtɛn naa: «Bi kan'bɔl un'kaan anà kan'dyà kyän naa bi undiir idyà anki kusà mudwa Pɔl.

Wɛɛ akà bɛ apanà, mbwo mwɛy anà Làbay a Nsaŋ a Kölàköl, làkyen kàlalɔ̈m mfum a aŋità naa nde kàlatwääl awà asànaa bɛ làkwen mulab ndaa ande pànsi pànsi. Wɛɛ bi, bi indiir byanswà ikyàlɔn ntɔn mukun'dwa kusà nde muyàkɔlà apà.»
Wɛɛ mwanàmpääŋ a Pɔl wàbaal kàwem ndiirà ayi, nde kàkyen fɔrtɛrɛs, waa kàbilà ntɔn mukyään Pɔl naa nde ukäl kà igyɛɛŋ.
Pɔl kàbel umwɛy uboo a aŋità, waa kàtɛn a nde naa: «Lun'syen mwan baal wà akà mfum a aŋità ntɔn nde we anà ndaa mukun'kyään.»
Kaptɛn awà kàsyen mwan baal awun akà mfum a nsaab, waa kàtɛn naa: «Mbuur a bɔlokà Pɔl akyer an'bel, waa kan'lɔ̈ɔ̈m mukatwääl mwan baal wà awe anà undiir akakyään.»
Mfum a nsaab kàtɛ mwan baal awun mpi u kɔɔ, kun'syen u mpey, waa kun'fuul naa: «Ininà ngye awe awà mukan'kyään?»
Nde kun'fuur naa: «Ayudà ban'lwɛɛŋ naa ba bàyàlɔm akà ngye naa ngye asyen Pɔl nkàswo u Làbay a Nsaŋ a Kölàköl asànaa ba bàkwen ulab ndaa ande pànsi pànsi.

Wɛɛ ngye, ngye twɔn amakyey, ntɔn aŋàsöön baar an'kwem an'nà uboo a ba bàkun'diil ndɔɔŋ u mbwo. Ba bàdi kyän naa ba bàdyà anki anà bànwà anki tii mpal bàyun'dwa ba. Ba ndaa yanswà ban'yöŋà, yan'sal nkyeey angye mpɛl.»
Apan mfum a nsaab kàfuur mwan baal awun ungö akun'swaŋ naa: «Twɔn an'kyään akà mbuur mwɛy naa mɛ an'yöb ndaa ayi.»

Ungö apan, mfum a nsaab kàbel baar bɔ̈ɔ̈l uboo a an'kaptɛn, waa kàtɛn a ba naa: «Làsɔ̈ɔ̈l aŋità nkam yweel, asyeen a mpoonà an'kwem nsambwaar anà aŋanwɛŋ nkam yweel, ntɔn u taaŋ làwà là mpib ba bàkyà Sɛzarɛ.
Làlɔ̈ɔ̈n sye mpoonà ntɔn musyen Pɔl ntɔn nde ukàtol unsà ubwaŋ banswà akà kuvɛrnɔ̈ɔ̈r Filikisi.»
Apan, nde kàsön un'kaan abà:
«Kɔlɔdɛ Lizyasi akà mwol Filikisi, làköm angye!
Mbuur wà, Ayudà bakyer un'kɔr anà bàkyer alun'dwa. Mpal kàwem mɛ naa nde wà un'lɔmà, mɛ kàkyen anà aŋità ntɔn mukun'lwom kan'kɔɔ aba.
Mɛ kàkwen muyöb isin a ndaa bun'füün ba, lalan kun'syen mɛ kusà a Làbay a Nsaŋ a Kölàköl.
Mɛ, mɛ kàmɛn naa ba bun'füün ntɔn ndaa a un'kɔɔn aba, wɛɛ akà ube mwɛy kàkyer nde batɛy ntɔn bun'dwä itàkal bun'bäm in'siŋ.
Kan'wem mɛ sye naa Ayudà bàmulɛɛ untaam, lalà amatööm mɛ awà anà an'swaŋ mɛ baar bun'füün naa ba ŋakwo bun'füün akà ngye.»
Aŋità bàläb ndaa baswɛŋ, waa bàwɛl Pɔl, bun'syen u mpib u Antipatris.
Taaŋtyà, ba bàwɛy asyeen a mpoonà mulab mbwo anà Pɔl, waa bàfurà fɔrtɛrɛs.
Mpal bàtöl ba Sɛzarɛ, asyeen a mpoonà bàpɛ mfum un'kaan, waa bun'swɛŋ Pɔl sye.
Ungö kàtäŋ nde un'kaan, nde kàfuul naa Pɔl wà mbuur a itiir a nsi nà. Mpal kàwem nde naa nde wà mbuur a Silisi,
nde kàtɛn naa: «Mɛ in'yawem mpal bàyàyà sye baar bafüün.» Apan, nde kàswɛŋ naa bun'si u làpaŋ a Ɛlɔdi.
Ungö a ilä ityeen, mfum a angaŋ Ananyas anà andweer anà nkalsà mwɛy ikɔb ande Tɛrtülüs, bàtyà ntɔn mufüün Pɔl akà kuvernɔ̈ɔ̈r.
Apan, ba bàbel Pɔl. Tɛrtülüs kàsɛmà mukun'füün abà: «Mwol Filikisi, mbɔr angye. Ntɔn ngye anà ndaa akün an'kyer ngye ntɔn musyen nsi unsà ubwaŋ banswà, lalan ibà bi uboo a duu aŋàkwo.
Taaŋ lanswà anà ntsü yanswà, bi ibàmukömà ubwaŋ angye.
Wɛɛ mukɔɔn akà adwääl taaŋ mbɔɔn, mɛ in'tɛn ikikye, lalan mɛ amalɔm mukan'wem unsà igyɛɛŋ kyanswà asànaa kayöb bi.
Bi kan'man naa mbuur wà, wà fway, nde wàmuyisà lingyoomà uboo a Ayudà banswà u mɛɛn manswà ntɔn nde wà mfum a Bànazɔrye.
Nde sye alàkwen mubɛy un'kyɛɛl a ndwà a Nzam, undiir awun bun'kör bi. Bi bàkwen mutsul nsaŋ ande asànaa ukalɔɔmà un'kɔɔn abi,
wɛɛ mfum a nsaab waa kàyun'duum a ngwal yanswà kà an'kɔɔ abi.
Abun, ngye, ngye ŋakwo asun'fuul un'lɔɔn, ngye akyer akyey naa ndaa kàmun'füün bi yà ndandaa.»
Ayudà banswà bàkyey naa ndaa yanswà kàtɛn Tɛrtülüs yà abwɛy.

Apan kuvɛrnɔ̈ɔ̈r kun'swɛŋ musà ndaa, Pɔl waa kàfuur abà: «Mɛ in'kyàyöb naa sɛmà mbul mbɔɔn ngye afàswaŋ balàbal akà un'sɛŋ abi: undiirawà, waa mɛ an'sà làkyän akà ngye, mɛ in'sà un'lɔɔn amɛ kusà angye.
Ngye an'kwo ayim ubwaŋàbwaŋ: ilyaaŋ anki ilä kwem aŋiyweel kàbeenà mɛ Yɛlusàlɛm ntɔn mukàsyäŋà.
Itàkal u ndwà a Nzam, itàkal u ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà, itàkal uboo a bul, akà mbuur mwɛy kan'mɛn anki musà mbaaŋ anà mbuur itàkal musiinà un'sɛŋ a baar mukyer lingyoomà.
Ba bàkwo anki mukaswaŋ apanà indiir bàkan'füünà ba.

Wɛɛ mɛ, ndaa in'yöb mɛ kusà angye ayi: mɛ in'fàsyääl Mbwo ayà bàmanà ba naa yà loor. Mɛ in'fàsyääl Nzam a andweer abi. Làkwikilà amɛ là unsà ndaa yanswà bàsön uboo a Un'kɔɔn anà uboo a Aŋangɔɔm.
Làkyän amɛ là akà Nzam, ba ŋakwo sye bàkyer afàkyey la, naa baar mpa abà balàbal anà baar a balàbal bàkyer asàwiyà.
Lalan mɛ sye in'fàsà mɛ ngwal taaŋ lanswà mukal anà an'kyän mpa ban'kwo mubɛy kusà a Nzam anà kusà a baar.
Ungö a mbul mbɔɔn, mɛ kàyàfurà u Yɛlusàlɛm ntɔn mubay un'sɛŋ amɛ anà mupà an'kab.
Apan ba bàyan'man u ndwà a Nzam ungö a mpɔ̈ɔ̈ŋ amɛ: akà nköŋ mwɛy itàkal làso làmwɛy làkäl anki.
Wɛɛ Ayudà amwɛy bà Azi bàkäl paa, ba baar bàlàkwo muyàmɛnà kusà a ngye mukan'füün ilàkal naa ba bàkäl anà undiir atɛn a mɛ.
Itàkal ba abà, ba ŋakwo bàtɛn ndaa a ube bàmɛn ba mpal kasi mɛ un'lɔɔn u Làbay a Nsaŋ a Kölàköl.
Taaŋ lumwɛy ndaa mwɛy mpɛl kàsi mɛ umbäär kusà a ba naa: "Yà ntɔn ngwiiyà a akü lalan bàman'füün ba ŋàbawà kusà a bɛ!"»
Filikisi kàkyer ayöb ubwaŋàbwaŋ ndaa a Mbwo, waa kàsin mutsul ungö anà mutɛn naa: «Mɛ ndaa abɛ in'yàtsul mpal uyàtyà mfum a nsaab.»
Apan nde kàswɛŋ kaptɛn mwɛy mukaar Pɔl u bɔlokà anà mukun'pà mbwo naa atɔŋ ban'kwo mukun'bay.
Ungö a ndam a ilä, Filikisi kàkäl anà un'kyay ande Dulàsiye, un'kaar un'yudà, nde kàtöm baar mukàbel Pɔl. Nde kàkwen mukun'wem ntɔn ndaa a làkwikilà unsà Klistɔ Yɛsu.

Wɛɛ mpal kàsɛmà Pɔl mutɛn ndaa mukal anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ a balàbal anà nkääŋ a mpem anà nsaŋ isàyà kusà, Filikisi kàwem bɔɔmà, waa kàtɛn naa: «Apanà ngye an'kwo afurà. Taaŋ làsàkal mɛ in'kyer afasàbel.»
Nde kàsii naa Pɔl ayun'pà ngim, undiir awun kàfatɔmà nde baar mbalà mbɔɔn mukun'bel u bɔlokà ntɔn muyäm anà nde.
Ungö a mbul yweel, Filikisi bun'kiir akà Pɔrsyus Fɛstüs. Wɛɛ, ntɔn muswaŋ ubwaŋ ande akà Ayudà, nde kàsàwɛy Pɔl u bɔlokà.
Ungö a ilä itär a ngyeel ande kà itiir a nsi akin, Fɛstüs kàbeenà Yɛlusàlɛm fà Sɛzarɛ.
Amfum a angaŋ anà andweer a Ayudà bayi mufüün Pɔl akà nde.
Ba bàsi muküünà mulɔm naa nde kakyeer ndam a ubwaŋ mubel Pɔl u Yɛlusàlɛm. Kutɛn aŋàbwaŋ ba bàdirà mukun'dwa u mbwo.
Wɛɛ Fɛstüs kàfuur naa bɔlokà a Pɔl là u Sɛzarɛ, anà nde ŋakwo kàkäl u mbwo mufurà.
Nde kàkwɛy naa: «Wɛy baar a an'yeerà uboo a bɛ bàtüüb anà mɛ, ntɔn bi ityà Sɛzarɛ. Kya isàkal naa we anà undiir un'be mbuur awà kàkyer, waa ba bun'füün.»
Fɛstüs kàkäl aŋàsöön ilä naan akɔ̈ɔ̈n kwem apà ba, ungö waa kàtyà Sɛzarɛ. Taaŋtyà, nde kàbwaay u làbay a nsaŋ, waa kàswɛŋ naa bun'twääl Pɔl.
Mpal kàyàkɔlà nde, Ayudà bàfü Yɛlusàlɛm bàkyer un'diŋà, waa bun'füün ndaa a ngwalàngwal mbɔɔn, wɛɛ ba bàsàswaŋ anki naa ya yà ndandaa.
Wɛɛ Pɔl kàsi un'lɔɔn ande, waa kàtɛn naa: «Mɛ akà undiir mwɛy wà ube in'kyer anki, itàkal unsà Un'kɔɔn a Ayudà, itàkal u ndwà a Nzam, itàkal akà Sɛzar.»
Ntɔn mumɛnà mbuur aŋàbwaŋ kusà a Ayudà, Fɛstüs kàfuul Pɔl naa: «Nkye ngye akyàkwen mubeenà Yɛlusàlɛm ntɔn bàtsül ndaa angye u mii amɛ?»
Wɛɛ Pɔl kàfuur naa: «Mɛ in'wà u làbay a nsaŋ a Sɛzar, nsaŋ amɛ bàkàtɛn kwo. Akundiir mwɛy wà ube an'kyer mɛ Ayudà watɛy asànaa ngye ŋakwo ayöb ngye ubwaŋàbwaŋ.

Isàkal naa ndandaa mɛ kàkyer ube mwɛy ban'kwo mutwaal ukwà, mɛ ukwa in'tɔn anki. Wɛɛ, isàkal naa ndaa ban'füünà baar ndɔ̈ŋ aya yatɛy, akà mbuur mwɛy ukwe anki mukan'pà kà an'kɔɔ aba. Mɛ an'lɔm naa Sɛzar utsül ndaa amɛ.»
Apan, ungö mulwɛɛŋ anà ntɛɛn ande, Fɛstüs kàfuur naa: «Ngye an'lɔm muman Sɛzar, ngye akyer akyà kusà a Sɛzar.»
Ungö a ilä, mfum Angilàpà anà Bɛrnis bàyi u Sɛzarɛ ntɔn mupà Fɛstüs mbɔr.
Ba paa bàkyer ilä mbɔɔn, lalan Fɛstüs kàkyään nde mfum ndaa a Pɔl mutɛn naa: «We anà baal mwɛy Filikisi kàsàwɛy u bɔlokà.
Umpal kàbeenà mɛ Yɛlusàlɛm, amfum a angaŋ anà andweer a Ayudà bàkyer ayà mukun'füün, ba bàkwen naa bun'dwä ndwà.
Mɛ ba kafuur naa: "Kya kà ifà a baar a Lɔmà anki mupà mbuur kà an'kɔɔ a baar, isàkal naa kusà ande baar bun'füün batɛy, isàkal sye naa nde un'lɔɔn ŋàtàsà anki."
Ba bàyi apà anà mɛ. Mukɔɔn afàsà ilä, taaŋtyà mɛ kàbwaay u làbay a nsaŋ, mɛ kàlɔ̈m naa bun'twääl mbuur awun.
Ayiiŋ ande bàyi ba, ba bàsàmɛɛy anki akà undiir mwɛy wà ngwal uboo indiir ibe kàyweerà mɛ.
Undiir mwɛy bàkäl ba awà anà nde yà mbaaŋ ntɔn inzaam aba ŋakwo, sin sin ntɔn mbuur mwɛy ikɔb ande Yɛsu, nde kàkyer akwà, wɛɛ Pɔl akakyeyà uyɔl naa nde we anà mɔ̈ɔ̈.
Ya yàkäl mpay akà mɛ mutsul ndaa a tub ayi, lalan kàpɛ mɛ Pɔl lwɛŋ mubeenà Yɛlusàlɛm ntɔn bàkàtsul nsaŋ ande kwo.
Wɛɛ Pɔl kàlɔ̈m naa ndaa ande bàkàtsul kusà a Sɛzar. Lalan kàswɛŋ mɛ naa bun'käär u bɔlokà tii mpal in'sun'tɔm mɛ akà Sɛzar.»
Waa Angilipà kàtɛn a Fɛstüs naa: «Mɛ ŋakwo sye in'kwen muwem mbuur awà.» Fɛstüs kun'fuur naa: «Ngye ayun'wem nkàswo.»
Taaŋtyà, Angilipà anà Bɛrnis bàyi unsà làso lanswà, waa bàbilà u làbay a nsaŋ mbwo mwɛy anà amfum a nsaab anà abyääl a bul. Fɛstüs kàswɛŋ naa bun'twääl Pɔl.

Fɛstüs kàtɛn naa: «Mfum Angilipà, anà bɛ banswà làbà pà anà bi, bɛ làkyun'manà mbuur wà. Un'kàbɔ a Ayudà kàyun'füün akà mɛ, itàkal u Yɛlusàlɛm, itàkal apà, bàmusà in'kwɛŋ naa nde ufàkwo anki mukal anà mɔ̈ɔ̈.
Wɛɛ akà mɛ, mɛ in'sàman anki undiir un'be kàkyer nde ntɔn nde ukyà an'lɔŋ. Wɛɛ nde ŋakwo kàlɔ̈m naa nde ukyà akà Sɛzar, mɛ kàtsül naa mɛ in'kyer un'tööm awà.
Itàkal abwɛy, mɛ in'manà anki undiir in'söön mɛ Sɛzar, lalan, an'kwen mɛ naa nde usi un'lɔɔn u mii a bɛ, sin sin u mii a ngye Mfum Angilipà, ntɔn mɛ in'wɛl undiir asɔn ungö a nköŋ ayi.
Ntɔn akà mɛ, ya ikamɛnà naa kà yubwaŋ anki naa mɛ in'töm mbuur a bɔlokà ukɔɔn aswaŋ ubwaŋàbwaŋ ube kàkyer nde.»
Angilipà kàtɛn a Pɔl naa: «Bàmapà mbwo musà un'lɔɔn angye.» Apan nde kàsen kɔɔ ntɔn musà un'lɔɔn ande:
«Mfum Angilipà, mɛ an'man un'sak mbɔɔn musà un'lɔɔn kusà a ngye ŋàbawà ntɔn indiir byanswà bàman'füün Ayudà,
sin sin ngye akyàyöb ubwaŋàbwaŋ nkääl a Ayudà anà nsyeel a mbaaŋ aba. Kyakin mɛ amalɔm mukan'wem anà igyɛɛŋ unsà nkääŋ a mpem yanswà.
«Ntɔn mɔ̈ɔ̈ amɛ, sɛmà imbɛy, Ayudà banswà bàkyàyöb wa, ntɔn mɛ kàkäl u Yɛlusàlɛm uboo a un'sɛŋ amɛ.
Ba ŋakwo bàkyàyöb fà itaan, ba ban'kwo bàtɛ imbäl, kya ba bàsàkwen, naa mɛ in'wà umwɛy uboo a Ikööŋ a Amfarisi ifàlab inzaam abi pànsi pànsi.
Apanà, mɛ bàman'füün ntɔn làkyän amɛ unsà ilää kàpɛ Nzam akà andweer abi.
In'sɛŋ abi myanswà myàkwem aŋiyweel myàfàsyääl Nzam uboo a muküünà mpib anà mwäänà ntɔn muman nkölà a ilää aki. Ɔɔ Mfum, ntɔn làkyän alà, Ayudà waa bàman'füün!
Ntɔn nkye mpa làkyeyà bɛ naa Nzam afàwiy akü?
Mɛ ŋakwo, mɛ kàyweerà naa yubwaŋ munwan a ngwal yanswà anà ikɔb a Yɛsu Nazɔrye.
Undiir nsil awà mɛ kàkyer u Yɛlusàlɛm. Mɛ kàbiil baar in'kyɛɛl mbɔɔn u bɔlokà mpal kàwɛl mɛ ikɔ̈b akà andweer a angaŋ, mɛ sye kàkyer akyeyà naa badwä.

Mɛ kàyibilà mbalà mbɔɔn u ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà yanswà ntɔn mukapà ntaaŋàmbar anà mukasiinà a ngwal yanswà ba mubɛy làkwikilà aba. Uboo a nkyɛl amɛ yanswà, akà ba, mɛ ba kàyalabà tii kà an'bul a ingyey.»
«Lalan ilä mwɛy mɛ kàkyà Damas anà ikɔ̈b aŋàkwo anà isal ban'pɛ amfum a angaŋ.
Ɔɔ Mfum, ilä mwɛy ntsü a midi, mɛ kàkäl u mbwo, mɛ anà atɔŋ bàkäl anà mɛ, mpal kàmɛn mɛ un'ŋyäŋ a pɛɛlà wàŋàsöönà taaŋ kan'fà du, waa kan'diŋà.
Bi banswà kàbü u mɛɛn, waa mɛ kàwem ndaa mwɛy ikan'kyäänà unsà Ibɛlyɔ naa: "Sɔl, Sɔl, ntɔn nkye ayan'mɛɛy ngye nkwaaŋ? Yà mpay akà ngye mutɔn un'swaaŋ!"
Mɛ kàfuur naa: "Mwol, ngye awà nà?" Mwol waa kan'fuur naa: "Mɛ, mɛ in'wà Yɛsu akwà ayimɛɛy ngye nkwaaŋ.
Wɛɛ mbarà, tsim kà in'kɔl angye. An'yàmɛnà mɛ akà ngye ntɔn mɛ kàkyasɔɔl kusà mukal un'syääl anà mbäl unsà indiir kàmɛn ngye anà unsà indiir in'yàfamɛɛy mɛ.
Mɛ ngye akyasɔɔl uboo a un'sɛŋ wà anà uboo a baar mpa abà Ayudà mper amatɔm mɛ.

Mɛ ngye amatɔm ntɔn ngye aduub ba mii, alwom ba u mpib anà atwääl u pɛɛlà anà akà Nzam fà ikɔ̈b a Satanà, ntɔn ba bàwɛl ndwääl a man'be aba anà kwal uboo a aŋin'kyɛɛl u mbwo a làkwikilà amu mɛ."»
«Unsà ayi yanswà, mfum Angilipà, mɛ kàtön anki imanmii kyàfü du ki.
Wɛɛ mɛ kàtàlɔŋ baar a Damas, u Yɛlusàlɛm, kà itiir a Yuday kyanswà, anà akà in'sɛŋ mpa abà Ayudà, ntɔn ba bàbuul mpem anà bàpɛ mɔ̈ɔ̈ aba akà Nzam anà muswaŋ nsɔɔmà ayi u nsyääl aba.
Undiir awun Ayudà ban'kör ba mpal kàkäl mɛ u ndwà a Nzam, laa bàleŋ ba mukan'dwa.
Wɛɛ Nzam laa kan'tii nde, lalan mɛ in'wa mɛ anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ tii ŋàbawà, mɛ in'wàmuyità imbäl kusà a ambɛy anà andweer ndaa bàtɛn aŋangɔɔm anà Mɔsɛ naa ya isàkyer ayà,
muyöb naa Klistɔ kàkyer alàman mpay, naa nde, nde alàkal mbuur atàtwɛb mutoo uboo a akü, naa nde akyään pɛɛlà akà un'sɛŋ anà akà baar mpa abà Ayudà.»
Pɔl kàkäl musà un'lɔɔn ande mpal kàsi Fɛstüs in'kwɛŋ naa: «Pɔl, ngye awà ŋun'kɔŋ! Un'yɛnà angye wà mbɔɔn kàmatwääl ukɔŋ!»
Wɛɛ Pɔl kun'fuur naa: «Un'byääl Fɛstüs, mɛ kà in'wà ŋukɔŋ anki. Ndaa in'kyäänà mɛ yi yà ndandaa anà yan'kyän aŋàbwaŋ.

Ntɔn Mfum awà in'kakyäänà mɛ unsà uyɔl banswà, akyàyöb indiir abi ubwaŋàbwaŋ. Mɛ in'we anà iböŋ muyweer naa undiir mwɛy udiimà nde watɛy, ntɔn ndaa ayi yàlyaaŋ anki kunku, kà ikal aŋàyee.
Mfum Angilipà, nkye ngye afàsà làkwikilà akà aŋangɔɔm? Mɛ in'kyàyöb naa ngye awe anà làkwikilà.»
Angilipà waa kàtɛn a Pɔl naa: «Le, ngye akwen mukan'buul un'klistɔ!»

Nde kàfuur naa: «Mɛ in'kwenà naa itàkal naa taaŋ ikikye, naa taaŋ mbɔɔn, wɛy Nzam ukyer naa kà nà ngye mpɛl anki, wɛɛ sye anà baar banswà bàweemà mɛ ŋàbawà, bɛ làbulà asànaa mɛ ukɔɔn in'siŋ mii.»
Mfum waa kàmbarà, anà kuvɛrnɔ̈ɔ̈r, Bɛrnis anà baar banswà bàtɛɛnà nsaŋ.
Ba bàkyen nku, waa bàtɛn ba a ba naa: «Mbuur wà undiir mwɛy kan'kyer nde watɛy ntɔn nde uwɛl ukwà itàkal in'siŋ.»
Apan, Angilipà kàsam Fɛstüs naa: «Mbuur wà bàkyer alun'wɛy ilàkal naa nde ukɔ̈ɔ̈n alom muman Sɛzar.»
Mpal bàtsül mbar naa bi iwal an'swà mukyà Itali, ba bàpɛ Pɔl anà baar a bɔlokà amwɛy akà kaptɛn mwɛy ikɔb ande Zülyüs, umwɛy uboo a itsuŋ a Lɔmà bàfàbel naa Itsuŋ a Sɛzar.
Bi kàbilà kà an'swà a Adalamit màyilyaaŋà à kun'kɔɔl a Azi, waa kàkyen. Un'nsi Masɛdwan a Tɛsalɔnikà mwɛy ikɔb ande Aristark kàkäl anà bi.
Taaŋtyà, bi kàmbär u Sidɔn. Zülyüs kàwɛlà Pɔl unsà ubwaŋ banswà, nde kun'pɛɛ mbwo mukàler asam ande ban'kwo mukun'bay.
Kan'lwomà bi apan, bi kàläb kà an'dà, kàlyaaŋ kà un'kɔɔl a Shipɛlɛ ntɔn un'pöb kiyeelà lisà.
Apan bi kàbwel ngyäl a kölàköl tsütsü a Silisi anà Pamfili, waa kàtɔlà u Mira a Lisi.
Akun, kaptɛn kàmɛn an'swà a Alɛksandri màmukyà Itali, laa kibiil nde.
Bi kàkyer ilä mbɔɔn ntɔn an'swà màyikyeenà ikye ikye, a mpay yanswà bi, kàkàtöl bi tsütsü a Snide. Ntɔn un'pöb kàyee wa lisà, bi kàlyaaŋ u ngyɛl a isaŋ a Krɛte, tsütsü a Salmɔnɛ.
Bi kya kàlyaaŋ a mpay yanswà tii kàkàtol bi kà ikal mwɛy bàfàbel Bo Pɔr, tsütsü a bul làmwɛy ikɔb a la Lasàyà.
Taaŋ làmwɛy làbwɛlàbwɛl làlyaaŋ, nkyeen udu a an'dà yàbulà yà bɔɔmà, ntɔn ilä a ukin udyà a Ayudà kyàkäl aŋàlyaaŋ itaan, Pɔl waa kakyään,
kàtɛn naa: «Asam amɛ, mɛ in'manà naa nkyeen udu a an'dà itwaal ube mbɔɔn, indiir mbɔɔn ikyà bwà, kànà isaa anà an'swà mpɛl anki, wɛɛ anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ a baar abi sye.»
Wɛɛ mfum a nsaab a Lɔmà mpem ande kàpɛ akà kaptɛn a an'swà anà akà ŋan'swà, akwànaa akà ndaa a Pɔl.

Yumwɛy ayi: làbuŋ alà làkwe anki naa baar bàkäl paa u paŋà a mpye. Lalan baar mbɔɔn bàkäl ba an'kyän mwɛy naa ba bàläb mbwo aba anà muleŋ mukɔlà Fɛniksi, làbuŋ làmwɛy là Krɛt bàduub mper làfàminà taaŋ ntɔn isà ilyaaŋ kwo.
