Nkyɛɛy yundiir a bunàbun, ukɔɔn nkyɛɛy wundiir a bunàbun, wɛɛ undiir a mfun wà mulab nswɛɛŋ a Nzam.
Wɛy mbuur mbuur ukäl asànaa kàkäl nde utaaŋ bun'bel.
Nkye ngye kàkäl un'sɔ utaaŋ babel? Twon an'kyɛɛr. Wɛɛ, itàkal naa ngye an'bulà nsaay, syääl isɔ angye.
Ntɔn, un'sɔ bàbel uboo a Mwol, nde wà nsaay a Mwol. Ifà imwɛy sye, mbuur bàbel wà nsaay, nde wà un'sɔ a Mwol.
Mbuur mwɛy kàkyàfur ntal a nkwiy ntɔn bɛ. Twon lan'fàbulà asɔ a baar.
Atɔŋ, wɛy mbuur mbuur ukäl kusà a Nzam asànaa kàkäl nde utaaŋ bun'bel.
Ntɔn ankɔr, mɛ nswɛɛŋ a Mwol yatɛy: mɛ an'kyän in'pà, an'kyän a mbuur mwɛy ban'kwo musà làkyän, u nsyääm a Mwol.
Ntɔn mpay a taaŋ alà, mɛ in'manà naa yubwaŋ naa mbuur mbuur ukäl asànaa awà nde.
Nkye ngye awàŋàtüüb anà un'kaar? Twon an'leŋ mukaabà. Nkye ngye kawàŋàtüüb anki anà un'kaar? Twon an'leŋ un'kaar.

Isàkal naa ngye an'bääl, ngye akyer anki man'be. Isàkal naa unkɔr un'kaar kan'bääl, nde man'be ukyer anki. Wɛɛ baar bàŋàbääl bye anà buur a ndür mbɔɔn, wɛɛ mɛ in'kwen naa bɛ làkɔ̈ɔ̈n akal anà buur a ndür abà.
Atɔŋ, mɛ in'kwen mutɛn abà: taaŋ lan'bulà ikökö. Sɛmà apanà, wɛy mbuur wanswà awe anà un'kyay ukäl asànaa nde wa watɛy,
baar bàlelà asànaa ba bàlelà anki, baar bàsaŋà asànaa ba bàsaŋà anki, baar bàsoomà asànaa ba undiir watɛy,
baar bàsyäälà indiir a mɛɛn mà asànaa ba bya bàsyäälà anki. Ntɔn mɛɛn mà abà, mà mulyaŋ.
Mɛ in'kwen anki naa bɛ làkäl anà nkyɛɛr. Mpfwe mɔ̈ɔ̈ ande wanswà wà unsà indiir a Mwol: nde afàleŋ naa nde Mwol un'sak kun'pà aben.
Wɛɛ, baal aŋàbääl an'kyän mà unsà indiir a mɛɛn, nde aleŋà naa nde un'kyay ande un'sak kun'pà aben,

anà mpem ande yàŋàkaabà. Ifà imwɛy sye, un'kaar unkɔr asànaa un'sye, an'kyän ande mà unsà indiir a Mwol, ntɔn nde ukäl ŋun'kyɛɛl u ndür anà u dweelà. Wɛɛ un'kaar aŋàbääl an'kyän ande mà mɛɛn, nde afàlɛŋ naa nde un'dim ande un'sak kun'pà aben.
Mɛ an'tɛn mɛ abà, ntɔn ubwaŋ abɛ ŋakwo, kà ntɔn mukàlalɛɛ untaam anki, wɛɛ ntɔn bɛ làkyer undiir aŋàbwaŋ, anà bɛ làkäl aŋàbääb a Mwol, u mpem abɛ wanswà.

Isàkal naa un'tö mwɛy kan'man naa nde ukwe anki mukaŋ mpem kusa a ŋàtàntüüm ande, isàkal naa nde wàŋàyɔl a ilään mukal anà nde anà indiir byàmulab mbwo a bya, wɛy nde ukyer ayukwen nde. Nde ukyer anki man'be: wɛy ba bàbääl.
Wɛɛ, mbuur kan'tsul u mpem ande, ukɔ̈ɔ̈n akun'siinà a ngwal, unsà ukwen ande banswà, muwal an'kyän mukɔɔn atüüb ndür a ŋàtàntüüm ande, nde kan'kyer ubwaŋ.
Abun, mbuur kan'bääl ŋàtàntüün ande, nde kan'kyer ubwaŋ, wɛɛ mbuur mpa kun'bääl kan'kyer ubwaŋ aŋàsöönà.
Un'kaar wàŋàtüüb anà un'dim ande taaŋ lanswà awà nde anà mɔ̈ɔ̈. Isàkal naa un'dim kan'kwà, nde kan'bulà wà nsaay mubääl mbuur ukwen nde, wɛɛ uboo a Mwol mpɛl.
Kyekà, kà an'kyän amɛ, nde ayàkal unsà un'sak mbɔɔn, isàkal naa nde kan'kal asànaa awà nde. Mɛ sye, mɛ in'we anà an'kyän mukal anà Dweelà a Nzam.
Ntɔn ndaa ayà iler in'twaŋ bàfàlääm itɛk, bi banswà ikyàyöb naa bi iwe anà ngyööb. Ngyööb ifàpà ngaal, wɛɛ ukwen bàkyer afàtɔŋ.
Isàkal naa mbuur mwɛy akasii naa nde ayöb undiir mwɛy, nde ŋàtàyöb anki asànaa bàkyer ayöb.
Wɛɛ isàkal naa mbuur akwen Nzam, Nzam akyun'yöb.
Abun, nkye ngye an'kwo adi in'twaŋ bàfàlääm itɛk? Bi ikyàyöb naa itɛk u mɛɛn kyà undiir a bunàbun anà nzam asin watɛy, Nzam wà mwɛy.
Ntɔn, ndandaa bye anà indiir bàfàbel naa bànzam, itàkal u du, itàkal u mɛɛn, asànaa bànzam anà bàmwol bà mbɔɔn,
wɛɛ akà bi, Nzam wà mwɛy, Taa anà Nkyer a indiir byanswà anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ abi wà ntɔn Nde, anà Mwol mwɛy, Yɛsu Klistɔ. Indiir byanswà bàkyer u mbwo a Nde anà bi ibà anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ u mbwo a Nde.

Wɛɛ baar banswà ngyööb yatɛy. Bamwɛy bàkyàyii u nsyääl aba yà itɛk tii ŋàbawà, mudyà in'twaŋ a ibɔɔn asànaa naa ndandaa mya bàlääm itɛk, anà an'kyän aba mà gyɔ̈ɔ̈là, màŋàbwà ŋingyäy.
Kyekà, bya kà isaa ifàsin bi tsütsü a Nzam anki: isàkal naa bi idi anki bya, bi undiir ayàkyà bwà watɛy, isàkal naa bi kan'dyà bya, undiir aŋàsöön iyàwal bi watɛy.
Wɛɛ làkäl kà igyɛɛŋ naa nsaay abɛ ayi ikɔ̈ɔ̈n abulà mbwo a mbweel ntɔn aŋagyɔ̈ɔ̈là.
Ntɔn, isàkal naa ngye bàmaman, ngye mbuur awe anà ngyööb, u mɛsà uboo a ndwà a nzam a itɛk, nkye an'kyän ande iyun'syen anki, nde ŋagyɔ̈ɔ̈là, mudyà in'twaŋ bàlääm mupà ibɔɔn akà itɛk.
Abun, ŋagyɔ̈ɔ̈là awà, ntɔn ngyööb angye, wà un'tɔŋ awà kàkü Klistɔ ntɔn nde.
Mukyer man'be abun akà atɔŋ abɛ anà muyɔɔl mpem aba yà gyɔ̈ɔ̈là, bɛ làbàmukyer man'be akà Klistɔ.
Kyakin, isàkal naa isaa mwɛy ibwiy un'tɔŋ amɛ, mɛ in'yàfàdyà anki akà ikikye in'twaŋ ntɔn mukɔɔn abwiy un'tɔŋ amɛ.
Nkye mɛ kà in'wà mbuur a nsaay anki? Nkye mɛ kà in'wà ntööm anki? Nkye mɛ kun'mɛn anki Yɛsu, Mwol abi?
Isàkal naa akà baar bumwɛy mɛ kà in'wà ntööm anki, wɛɛ ntɔn làbà bɛ unsà un'tüüb a Mwol, iswaŋà naa ndandaa mɛ in'wà ntööm.
Un'kal amɛ kusà a baar bàfan'pɛl awà:
Nkye bi ikwe anki mudyà anà munwà?
Nkye bi ikwe anki musyen un'klistɔ a un'kaar, asànaa antööm bumwɛy, atɔŋ a Mwol anà Sɛfas?
Nkye mɛ mpɛl anà Banàbà ibye anà mbwo mukɔɔn asal?
Nà afàsal isal uboo a ità a ngim ande ŋakwo? Nà afàkɔn un'te a vin, ukɔɔn adyà imbɛŋ a wa? Itàkal naa, nà afàdii böl a ngɔɔmà ukɔɔn anwà an'bɛɛl a böl a ngɔɔmà alan?
Nkye unsà imbuur mpɛl mɛ in'tɛɛnà indiir abi? Nkye un'kɔɔn sye ufàtɛn anki abwɛy?
Kyekà, unsà un'kɔɔn a Mɔsɛ bàsön naa: «Twon an'bäm mun a ngɔɔmà utaaŋ udyaarà wa imbɛŋ.» Nkye Nzam we anà ngyɛb a ngɔɔmà?
Nkye nde utɛɛnà anki ntɔn bi mpɛl? Ɛɛ ya bàsön ntɔn bi, ntɔn mbuur afàlem anà mbuur afàtswà imbɛŋ bàkäl anà làkyän muwal kab aba.
Isàkal naa bi kàkön indiir a dweelà ntɔn bɛ, nkye yà ndaa a kölàköl naa bi ibwe indiir a mɛɛn mà uboo a bɛ?

Isàkal naa baar bumwɛy bàfàsyääl ikɔ̈b aki udu a bɛ, ntɔn nkye mpa ikal kya kyàŋàsöönà akà bi? Wɛɛ bi, bi kàsyääl anki ikɔ̈b aki. Bi ifàkaŋ mpem ntɔn indiir byanswà, naa tɛy, bi iyàkal asànaa kyà ntɔn Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ a Klistɔ.
Nkye bɛ làyöb anki naa baar bàfàsal isal u ndwà a Nzam, ndwà a Nzam ifadii, naa baar bàfàsal u mɛsà bàfàpà ibɔɔn, ba bye anà kab aba unsà undiir bàfàpà baar?
Ifà imwɛy, Mwol kàswɛŋ baar bàfàkyään Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ naa udyà aba bà unsà Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ.
Wɛɛ mɛ, mɛ kàsàsyääl anki akà ikɔ̈b mwɛy uboo a bya. Kà ntɔn mulɔm bya anki ntɔn mɛ, waa mɛ an'sɔn un'kaan wà. Ubwaŋ mɛ in'yerakwà! Akà mbuur mwɛy tɛy kan'kwo mulwom làkoo amɛ alà!
Akà mɛ, ukyään Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ kà undiir muswaŋ ngaal anki, ntɔn kya isal ban'pɛ a ngwal: ngyɛb akà mɛ isàkal naa mɛ Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ in'kyään anki!
Kya ilàkal naa isal aki mɛ ŋakwo kàsɔ̈ɔ̈l, mɛ in'kyer alàwal làfur. Wɛɛ, ntɔn an'kyän amà màfü anki akà mɛ, kyakin mɛ in'wà mukölà buur ban'pɛ.
Apan làfur amɛ làken? La là ntɔn mukyään Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ là ngway, ukɔɔn asyääl ikɔ̈b kan'paa Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ alà.
Ndandaa, itàkal naa mɛ in'wà nsaay kusà a baar banswà, mɛ kàkyer naa mɛ in'bulà un'sɔ a baar banswà, ntɔn musyen baar mbɔɔn akà Mwol.

Mɛ kàkäl uboo a Ayudà asànaa un'yudà, ntɔn muwal Ayudà, uboo a baar abà u ngyɛl a un'kɔɔn asànaa mbuur awà ungyɛl a un'kɔɔn, - wɛɛ mɛ ŋakwo in'wà anki ungyɛl a un'kɔɔn, - ntɔn muwal baar abà ungyɛl a un'kɔɔn,
uboo a baar bàkɔ̈ɔ̈n un'kɔɔn asànaa mɛ an'kɔɔn un'kɔɔn, - kyekà mɛ in'kɔ̈ɔ̈n anki un'kɔɔn a Nzam, ntɔn Klistɔ wà un'kɔɔn amɛ, muwal baar bàkɔ̈ɔ̈n un'kɔɔn.
Mɛ kàbulà ŋàgyɔ̈ɔ̈là ntɔn aŋàgyɔ̈ɔ̈là, ntɔn muwal aŋàgyɔ̈ɔ̈là. Ntɔn baar banswà mɛ kàbulà indiir byanswà ntɔn mutswà mɔ̈ɔ̈ a amwɛy uboo a ba.
Kyekà, indiir abi byanswà, mɛ in'fàkyer ntɔn Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ ntɔn mɛ in'wɛl kab uboo mwo.
Nkye bɛ làyöb anki naa aŋantiin, ubɔɔ a iboon, ba banswà bàfàtsumà ntiin, wɛɛ umwɛy mpɛl afàwal undiir a ntal? Làtsumà ntiin ntɔn muböŋ.
Aŋan'taam a ngwiy banswà bàfàkaŋ mpem unsà ya yanswà, ba bàfàkyer ntɔn muwal mpà ifàtay, wɛɛ bi, ntɔn mpà mpa ifàtay.
Abun, mɛ in'tsumà anki ntiin aŋàdübà mii, mɛ in'kam anki iki a bunàbun.
Wɛɛ mɛ infàpà ndür amɛ mpay, mɛ infàbuul ya asànaa un'sɔ. Kya naa tɛy, ungö mukyään làsaŋ akà bumwɛy, mɛ ŋakwo in'kɔ̈ɔ̈n awal iböŋ.
Atɔŋ, mɛ in'kwen naa bɛ làyöb ndaa yi: bànkaa abi banswà bàkäl ungyɛl a un'böŋ, ba banswà bàtsül ngyäl,
anà ba banswà bàwɛl ndüümà a Mɔsɛ uboo un'böŋ anà uboo a ngyäl.
Ba banswà bàdyee isaa a dweelà,
anà ba banswà bànwee kɔɔb a dweelà làmwɛy, ntɔn ba bànwee unsà un'kul a dweelà kàyikyeenà anà ba, un'kul awun kàkäl Klistɔ.
Wɛɛ, Nzam kàkäl anki un'sak anà bàmbɔɔn uboo a ba, lalan bàkü ba u nsye a ipɔl.
Ndaa ayi yanswà yà ntɔn naa ya ikäl mbaan, ntɔn bi ikɔ̈ɔ̈n aleŋ ube asànaa bàleŋà ba.
Twon lan'bulà baar a itɛk, asànaa bumwɛy uboo aba, kyakin bàsön naa: «Un'sɛŋ kan'bwaay ntɔn mudyà anà munwà, waa ba bàmbarà ntɔn mutaam.»
Bi sye ipà anki ndür abi mukyer ndaa a nswɛn, asànaa bàkyerà bumwɛy uboo a ba: kà ilä imwɛy mpɛl bàkü baar nsaab an'kwem mɔ̈ɔ̈l aŋitär.
Bi twon kun'sii Klistɔ, asànaa bàkyer bumwɛy uboo a ba: ntäy yàkyer adwa.
Twon lan'ŋüŋün asànaa bàŋüŋün bumwɛy uboo a ba: un'dwää kàkyer adwa.
Kyekà, indiir abi byàyeel ba ntɔn bya ikäl mbaan, bya bàsön ntɔn mulɔŋ bi, bi baar ibà u taaŋ a ntsüü.
Abun, wɛy mbuur akasii naa nde wà umbäär, ukäl kà igyɛɛŋ ntɔn nde ukɔ̈ɔ̈n abwà.

Ndɛb mwɛy tɛy ifàyeel bɛ ayà mpa ifàyeel mbuur. Nzam wà lää, nde upà anki mbwo naa bàlasii yàŋàlyaaŋ ngwal abɛ. Anà ndɛb, nde ayàlɔ̈ɔ̈n sye mbwo mutoo amu ya anà ayàlapà ngwal mukaŋ mpem.
Kyakin, nkween amɛ, làtiin muyamà itɛk.
Mɛ in'yäämà anà bɛ asànaa a baar abye anà an'kyän aŋàbwaŋ: làtsül bɛ ŋakwo ndaa in'tɛɛnà mɛ.
Kɔɔb a nsaak alà ifàsaak bi udu a la, nkye la làfisà anki unsà un'tüüb anà an'kil a Klistɔ? Làmpà ifàtsul bi, nkye la làfisà anki unsà un'tüüb anà ndür a Klistɔ?
Ntɔn làmpà là làmwɛy mpɛl, bi banswà ibà ndür mwɛy mpɛl: ntɔn bi banswà ifàkab làmpà mwɛy alan.
Wɛɛ làler baar a Isàlɛl, baar bàfàdyà in'twaŋ bàpɛ ibɔɔn, nkye ba un'tüüb watɛy anà mɛsà a ibɔɔn?
Ininà mɛ in'kwen mutɛn? Nkye in'twaŋ bàpɛ ibɔɔn akà itɛk lɛɛ itɛk bya ŋakwo ibye anà mfun?
Ŋaa! Wɛɛ, asànaa ibɔɔn aba bàkyàpà akà insɔŋà, kà akà Nzam anki, mɛ in'kwen anki naa bɛ làbilà unsà un'tüüb anà insɔŋà.
Bɛ làkwo anki munwà mbalà mwɛy ya u kɔɔb a Mwol anà u kɔɔb a insɔŋà. Bɛ làkwo anki mudyà mbalà mwɛy ya u mɛsà a Mwol anà u mɛsà a insɔŋà.
Nkye bi ikwen mumbaar un'köl a Mwol? Nkye bi ibye anà ngwal yan'lyaaŋ yà Nde?
«Byanswà bàkyàpà mbwo mukyer», wɛɛ kà bya byanswà anki ibye anà ndöŋ. «Byanswà bàkyàpà mbwo mukyer», wɛɛ kà bya byanswà anki byàfàtɔŋ.
Wɛy mbuur ukɔ̈ɔ̈n aleŋ ubwaŋ ande ŋakwo mpɛl, wɛɛ uleŋ sye ubwaŋ a baar bumwɛy.
Indiir byanswà bàfàyälà u yà, làdi bya làkɔɔn asà mfuul ntɔn mukɔɔn atay an'kyän,
ntɔn bàsön naa: «Mɛɛn anà indiir byanswà abyà uboo, byà Mwol.»
Isàkal naa mbuur mpa awe anà làkwikilà kàmàlabel anà bɛ lan'kyey mukyà, làdi indiir byanswà kàlapà nde, ukɔɔn asà mfuul ntɔn mukɔɔn atay an'kyän.
Wɛɛ, isàkal naa mbuur an'tɛn abɛ naa: «Mi in'twaŋ myan'fà unsà ibɔɔn bàpɛ akà itɛk», twon lan'dyà wa, ntɔn mbuur kàlaweey anà ukɔɔn atay an'kyän.
Apà mɛ in'tɛɛnà anki ntɔn an'kyän abɛ, wɛɛ mànde. Ntɔn nkye an'kyän a mbuur asin itsüül ma nsaay amɛ nsaŋ?
Isàkal naa mɛ in'fàfuur an'tɔɔn ntɔn isaa in'fàdyà mɛ, ntɔn nkye in'bulà mɛ mbuur atwee ntɔn undiir an'fuur mɛ an'tɔɔn?
Abun, itàkal naa bɛ làkyer adyà, itàkal naa bɛ làkyer anwà, itàkal undiir wanswà làkyer bɛ, làkyer wanswà ntɔn làkoo a Nzam.
Twon lan'kal kyà ntɔn mbuur: itàkal ntɔn Ayudà, itàkal ntɔn Angɛlɛki, itàkal ntɔn Ikööŋ a Nzam.
Kyakin, mɛ ŋakwo in'fàkyer ngwal mupà un'sak akà baar banswà unsà indiir byanswà, kà ntɔn muleŋ ubwaŋ amɛ aŋàyen anki, wɛɛ ntɔn ubwaŋ a baar mbɔɔn, ntɔn ba bàwü mɔ̈ɔ̈.
Lan'yööl, asànaa mɛ ŋakwo in'fàyööl mɛ Klistɔ.
Mɛ amàlakan: bɛ làfàyɔbà mɛ unsà indiir byanswà anà mulab nswɛɛŋ asànaa kàlalɔŋ mɛ.
Apanà, mɛ in'kwen naa bɛ làyöb abà: Klistɔ wà mfum a mbuur wanswà, baal wà mfum a un'kaar, Nzam wà mfum a Klistɔ.
Baal wanswà afàyamà, itàkal afàtà ngɔɔm, un'tswe wàŋàfwee, nde afàpà nswɛn akà mfum ande.
Wɛɛ un'kaar wanswà afàyamà, itàkal afàtà ngɔɔm, un'tswe wà ipɔl, nde afàpà nswɛn akà mfum ande, ntɔn yà asànaa ntswee ande yàŋàkɔɔl.
Isàkal naa un'kaar ufwee anki un'tswe, wɛy bun'kɔɔl ntswe! Wɛɛ, isàkal naa yà nswɛn ntɔn un'kaar bun'tsül itàkal bun'kɔɔl ntswe, wɛy nde ubwäär itàmbalà!
Abun, baal ufwe anki un'tswe ande, nde wà ifà anà làkoo a Nzam, wɛɛ un'kaar wà làkoo a baal.
Ntɔn, kà baal anki bàtwey amu un'kaar, wɛɛ un'kaar bàtwey amu baal.
Baal bun'kyer anki ntɔn un'kaar, wɛɛ un'kaar bun'kyer ntɔn baal.
Lalan, un'kaar akyer abwaar isii a ikɔ̈b kà un'tswe ande, ntɔn akyeey.
Apan, un'kaar ukaabà anki anà baal, baal sye ifà imwɛy akà un'kaar, uboo a Mwol.
Ntɔn, isàkal naa un'kaar bun'twey amu baal, baal sye un'kaar kàmubɔr, yanswà yan'fà akà Nzam.
Làtsül bɛ ŋakwo, nkye yubwaŋ naa un'kaar uyamà Nzam ukɔɔn afwe un'tswe?
Nkye mɛɛn ŋakwo ifàlalɔŋ anki naa làkoo latɛy akà baal mukal anà ntswe a bwɛlàbwɛl?
Kyekà yà làkoo akà un'kaar, ntɔn ntswe bun'pɛ musyääl asànaa itàmbalà.
Wɛɛ isàkal naa mbuur akwen mutɔn nkääl ayi, bi ifà aki kyatɛy, itàkal kà Ikööŋ a Nzam sye.
Ntɔn ndaa ilääb yi, mɛ alakan anki, ntɔn nköŋ làfàsà bɛ, ya ifàlakyer anki ubwaŋ, wɛɛ ube.
Musɛmà, mɛ an'wem naa ye anà nkaabà uboo a bɛ umpal làfàsà bɛ nköŋ, mɛ an'kyey ikikye naa yà ndandaa:
yàkäl ubwaŋ naa nkaabà ikäl uboo a bɛ, ntɔn muyöb naa bànà abà aŋàlàkwikilà a ndandaa.
Wɛɛ umpal làfàkal bɛ u nköŋ, bɛ kà isaa a Mwol anki làfàdyà.
Ntɔn, utaaŋ adyà, mbuur mbuur afàdüül muwal isaa aŋàsöön ukɔɔn ayɔbà bumwɛy. Abun, umwɛy we anà ngyal, umpal wumwɛy wàmuyɔr.

Nkye bɛ ndwà yatɛy ntɔn mudyà anà munwà? Itàkal naa, nkye bɛ làbɛyà Ikööŋ a Nzam anà làkwen mumɛɛy baar bàkɔ̈ɔ̈n undiir nswɛn? Ininà mɛ alakyään? Nkye mɛ in'kyer alasyäŋà? Aay, u ndaa ayi, mɛ alàsyaŋà anki.
Ntɔn, le an'lɔɔŋ kàwɛl mɛ akà Mwol anà kàlalɔŋ mɛ: Mwol Yɛsu, u mpib bun'yälà, nde kàwɛl làmpà,
ungö mufuur an'tɔɔn, nde kàtsül la, waa kàtɛn naa: «Yi yà ndür amɛ, ayà ntɔn bɛ, làkyerà abà muyɔbà mɛ.»
Nde kàkyer abun, nde kàwɛl kɔɔb, ungö udyà mutɛn naa: «Kɔɔb là, là Nkwà akün unsà an'kil amɛ. Làkyer abun taaŋ lanswà làyanwaa bɛ, ntɔn muyɔbà mɛ.»
Ntɔn, taaŋ lanswà làdyaa bɛ làmpà alà anà lànwaa bɛ kɔɔb alà, bɛ làwàmukyään nkweel a Mwol, tii mpal usyefurà nde.
Lalan, mbuur wanswà asàdyà làmpà itàkal asànwà kɔɔb a Mwol ukɔɔn akal wàŋàpɔŋà, nde asàkal wàŋàlɛl kusà a ndür anà an'kil a Mwol.
Wɛy mbuur mbuur uler mpem ande ŋakwo kusà mudyà làmpà alà anà munwà kɔɔb alà.
Ntɔn mbuur adyaa anà anwaa ukɔɔn asà ndür nsɔ̈ɔ̈l, wàmudyà anà wàmunwà mbar ande ŋakwo.
Kyakin, uboo a bɛ bàŋukyal anà aŋatoo bà mbɔɔn, anà ndam yumwɛy yàkyàkwà.
Isàkal naa bi kan'syebà bi ŋakwo, bi nsaŋ bàlitsüül anki.
Wɛɛ Mwol afitsüül nsaŋ ntɔn mukifuur u mbwo, ntɔn bàkɔɔn akitsüül mbar mbwo mwɛy anà mɛɛn.
Kyakin, atɔŋ amɛ, utaaŋ làfàtüüb bɛ ntɔn mudyà, làdil bamwɛy anà bumwɛy.
Isàkal naa mbuur we anà ngyal, wɛy nde udi u ndwà ande, ntɔn nköŋ abɛ ikɔ̈ɔ̈n akàlatwääl ntaaŋàmbar. Ntɔn indiir byumwɛy, mɛ insàlɔ̈ɔ̈n utaaŋ in'sàyà mɛ.
Atɔŋ, mɛ in'kwen naa bɛ làkäl anà ngyööb ntɔn ndaa iler indiir a Dweelà.
Bɛ làkyàyöb naa umpal làkäl bɛ baar mpa abà Ayudà, bàlasyeenà ukɔɔn ayöb, ntsü akà bànzam a itɛk abà nkiin.

Kyakin mɛ alàkyään naa: akà mbuur mwɛy tɛy awà kan'kwo mutɛn u mbwo a Dweelà a Nzam naa: «Wɛy Yɛsu ukäl wàŋàküül!» Mbuur mwɛy tɛy kan'kwo mutɛn naa: «Mwol Yɛsu!», isàkɔɔn akal Dweelà In'kyɛɛl.
An'kab a kab a ngway mà mbɔɔn, wɛɛ Dweelà nsil wa.
Isal byà mbɔɔn, wɛɛ Mwol nsil wa.
Nsyääl yà mbɔɔn, wɛɛ Nzam nsil wa afàkyer indiir byanswà amu baar banswà.
Amu mbuur mbuur Dweelà afàmɛnà u mbwo a kab ntɔn ubwaŋ a baar banswà.
Dweelà afàpà akà mbuur umwɛy ndaa a an'yeerà, akà wumwɛy, Dweelà nsil awà afàpà ndaa a ngyööb,
Dweelà mwɛy nsil awà afàpà akà umwɛy làkwikilà, akà wumwɛy ikɔ̈b mukɔɔr aŋukyal.
Dweelà afàpà ngwal akà umwɛy mukyer impà, akà wumwɛy kab mutà ngɔɔm, akà wumwɛy musà nsɔ̈ɔ̈l unsà an'dweelà, akà wumwɛy mutɛn ndaa a ifà ifà, akà wumwɛy ntɔn mubaal ndaa ya.
Dweelà nsil mwɛy awà mpɛl afàkyer indiir abin byanswà, mupà akà mbuur mbuur kab a nsöön, asànaa ukwen nde.
Ndür yà mwɛy, itàkal naa itiir byà mbɔɔn. Wɛɛ itiir a ndür byanswà, itàkal naa bya byà mbɔɔn, bya ikyerà ndür mwɛy mpɛl. Abà, ya sye yà asànaa Klistɔ.
Ntɔn, bi banswà kàwɛl ndüümà unsà Dweelà mwɛy mpɛl amu ndür mwɛy mpɛl, itàkal Ayudà itàkal Angɛlɛki, asɔ itàkal baar a nsaay, bi banswà kànü unsà Dweelà mwɛy awunà.
Abun, ndür kà yàŋàkyer anki itiir mwɛy mpɛl, wɛɛ yà itiir mbɔɔn.
Isàkal naa làkɔl lan'tɛn naa: «Asànaa mɛ kà in'wà kɔɔ anki, mɛ uboo a ndür watɛy», nkye la làkyer ayàlwomà mukal itiir a ndür?
Isàkal naa tsü lan'tɛn naa: «Asànaa mɛ kà dii anki, mɛ kà in'wà uboo a ndür anki», nkye la làkyer ayàlwomà mukal itiir a ndür?
Yàlàkal naa ndür yanswà ikäl dii, ngweem ilàkal ken? Yàlàkal naa ya yanswà ikäl tsü, usɔŋ bàliweemà ken?
Wɛɛ Nzam kàsi itiir itiir unsà ndür, asànaa kàkwen nde.
Yàlàkal naa byanswà ikäl itiir mwɛy mpɛl, ndür yàlàkal ken?
Apà, itiir byà mbɔɔn, wɛɛ ndür yà mwɛy mpɛl.
Dii taaŋ atɛn tɛy a kɔɔ naa: «Mɛ mfun a ngye yatɛy», itàkal un'tswe utɛn a in'kɔl naa: «Mɛ mfun abɛ yatɛy.»
Kyekà, itàkal itiir a ndür ifàmɛnà naa bya byà gyɔ̈ɔ̈là gyɔ̈ɔ̈là, bya byà mfun,
abyà ifàman bi naa ndöŋ a mbɔɔn byatɛy u ndür, akà bya bi ifàpà nsyäŋà aŋàsöönà. Abyà ifàman bi naa bya ntwɛn yatɛy, bi bya ifàlɔ̈ɔ̈n ubwaŋàbwaŋ,
kyekà, itiir abye anà ntwɛn, byàfàkal anki anà mfun mulɔɔn bya. Wɛɛ Nzam ndür kàboom naa nsyäŋà mbɔɔn ikäl akà itiir abyà ifàmɛnà naa bya ndöŋ byatɛy:
ntɔn nkaabà ikɔ̈ɔ̈n akal u ndür, wɛɛ itiir byanswà ikäl ngyal mwɛy bamwɛy anà bumwɛy.
Isàkal naa itiir imwɛy kyà anà usaay, itiir byanswà byan'kab usaay aban. Isàkal naa itiir imwɛy bàmusyäŋà, itiir byanswà byan'saŋ anà nde.
Kyekà, bɛ làbà ndür a Klistɔ, umwɛy umwɛy wà itiir a ndür ande.
Kyakin, uboo a Ikööŋ, Nzam kàsi bàtàtwɛb antööm, bàyweel aŋangɔɔm, bàtär alɔɔŋ, ungö apan, kab a impà, kab a nkɔɔr, là mbaay, là ntwasà, anà kab mutɛn ndaa a ifà ifà.
Nkye ba banswà bà antööm? Nkye ba banswà bà aŋangɔɔm? Nkye ba banswà bàkyer afàlɔŋ? Nkye ba banswà bàfàkyer impà?
Nkye ba banswà bye anà kab a nkɔɔr? Nkye ba banswà bàfàtɛn ndaa a ifà ifà? Nkye ba banswà bàfàbaal ndaa?
Abun, làkäl anà ngyal a ngwal yan'kab masöönà ndöŋ. Ungö apan, mɛ in'yàlaswaŋ mbwo yan'söön ubwaŋ.
Isàkal naa mɛ an'tɛn amu ndaa a baar anà yà akyeey, wɛɛ isàkal naa mɛ ukwen batɛy, mɛ in'wà asànaa ishabà ifàsà làso itàkal nguŋ ifàsà làso.

Isàkal naa mɛ in'we anà kab mutà ngɔɔm, muyöb ngyee yanswà anà là ngyööb yanswà, isàkal naa mɛ in'we anà làkwikilà lanswà lan'kwo mutsum myɔŋ, wɛɛ isàkal naa mɛ ukwen batɛy, mɛ in'wà wà bunàbun!
Isàkal naa mɛ an'kab indiir amɛ byanswà akà aŋangyal, itàkal naa mɛ an'pà ndür amɛ u mbaa ntɔn muwal nsyäŋà, wɛɛ isàkal naa mɛ ukwen batɛy, akà undiir mwɛy in'wal mɛ watɛy.
Ukwen bà nkääŋ a mpem anà ubwaŋ, ba un'kɔl aŋàyɔŋ watɛy, bàfàswaŋ anki ngaal, bàfàkyey anki uyɔl,
bàfàkyer anki ndaa ikɔ̈ɔ̈n ndöŋ, bàfàleŋ anki bweel a ba ŋakwo, bàfàwem anki nkyɛl, bàfàfuur anki ube,
bàfàsaŋ anki unsà ndaa ikɔ̈ɔ̈n balàbal, wɛɛ bàfàsaŋ unsà ndandaa.
Ukwen bàfàfwe indiir byanswà, bàfàsà làkwikilà unsà indiir byanswà, bàfàsà làkyän unsà indiir byanswà, bàfàsɛn buur a indiir byanswà.
Ukwen bàfàkwà anki. Nkye ngɔɔm? Ya ikyer asàwà. Nkye ndaa a ifà ifà? Ya ikyer asàtsü. Nkye ngyööb? Ya ikyer asàwà.
Ntɔn ngyööb abi yà ndam, ngɔɔm abi yà ndam.
Wɛɛ mpal isàyà yàŋàkwo, undiir a ndam akyer asàtsü.
Mpal kàkäl mɛ umbɛy, mɛ kàfatɛɛnà asànaa umbɛy, mɛ kàfasii asànaa umbɛy, mɛ kàfayweerà asànaa umbɛy. Wɛɛ mpal kàbulà mɛ undweer, mɛ kàwɛy indiir byanswà byà imbɛy.
Apanà, bi imanà unsà làman abunaa, wɛɛ ilä kyàpaa isàman bi u mii a mii. Apanà, ngyööb amɛ yà itsu, ilä kyàpaa, mɛ in'sàyöb ubwaŋàbwaŋ asànaa Nzam kan'yöb nde.
Abun, apanà indiir byà indiir itär: làkwikilà, làkyän anà ukwen, wɛɛ, wà kölàköl uboo a bya, ukwen.
Làleŋ ukwen, làkäl anà un'kanà ntɔn indiir a Dweelà, sin sin ngɔɔm.
Ntɔn, mbuur afàyäm unsà ndaa mpa bàfàyɔb baar, ufàyäm anki anà baar, wɛɛ anà Nzam. Ntɔn akà mbuur mwɛy ufàyöb anki ndaa ande. Kyekà, u ngwal a Dweelà, nde afàkyään indiir aŋàyee.
Wɛɛ mbuur afàtà ngɔɔm afàyäm anà baar ntɔn mutɔŋ anà mupà ngwal.
Mbuur afàyäm u ndaa mpa bàfàyöb baar, afàtɔŋ nde ŋakwo, wɛɛ mbuur afàtà ngɔɔm afàtɔŋ nkööŋ.

Mɛ in'kwen naa bɛ banswà làtɛn u ndaa mpa bàfàyöb baar, wɛɛ mɛ inkwen mbɔɔn naa bɛ làsöönà mutà ngɔɔm. Mbuur afàtà ngɔɔm kan'söön mbuur afàyäm u ndaa mpa bàfàyöb baar, nà isàkal naa nde kan'baal ya ntɔn mutɔŋ làkwikilà a Ikööŋ.

Atɔŋ, bi itàsii apanà naa mɛ in'yàlaler anà mɛ in'yäm anà bɛ u ndaa mpa bàfàyöb baar, nkye mɛ in'sàkal mfun nà akà bɛ, isàkal naa ndaa amɛ yàlatwääl anki itàkal imɛɛy, itàkal ngyööb, itàkal ngɔɔm, itàkal an'lɔɔŋ?
Abun, ya yà ifà imwɛy asànaa indiir a ikwɛŋ, asànaa saay a mfuŋ itàkal naa nkwaay: Isàkal naa bya ikatoo anki byànsöön, abun baar bàyàyöb aben naa saay a mfuŋ anà nkwaay ininà itɛɛnà?
Abun, isàkal naa saay a mfuŋ làtwey anki ndaa ubwaŋàbwaŋ, nà kan'kwo muyöŋà ntɔn ità?
Ya ye abun sye ntɔn bɛ: isàkal naa làlem abɛ làtweyà anki ndaa a un'yɛnà, baar bàyàyöb aben ndaa làtɛɛnà bɛ? Bɛ làyàyäm amu un'pöb.
U mɛɛn mà ndaa a ifà ifà yà mbɔɔn, wɛɛ akà mwɛy tɛy uboo a ya ikɔ̈ɔ̈n mbuul.
Abun, isàkal naa mɛ in'yöb anki mbuul a ndaa, mɛ in'yàkal ungyey akà mbuur ayäämà, mbuur ayäämà ayàkal ungyey akà mɛ.
Abun bɛ sye, ntɔn bɛ làfàkal anà ngyal mbɔɔn yà indiir a Dweelà, làleŋ mukal abyà byàŋàsöönà, wɛɛ bya ikäl ntɔn ntööŋ a Ikööŋ.
Kyakin mbuur afàyäm u ndaa a ingyey akyer ayamà ntɔn muwal kab abaal ndaa ayin.
Isàkal naa mɛ an'yamà u ndaa a ingyey, dweelà amɛ làkayamà, wɛɛ un'yɛnà amɛ ubɔr anki undiir.
Waa mɛ in'kyer aben? Mɛ in'sàyamà unsà Dweelà, wɛɛ mɛɛ in'sàyamà sye anà un'yɛnà, mɛ in'sàtɔl an'diim unsà Dweelà, wɛɛ mɛ in'sàtɔl an'diim sye anà un'yɛnà amɛ.
Ntɔn, isàkal naa ngye an'sà nsaak anà Dweelà mpɛl, nkye mbuur awà uboo a baar bàkɔ̈ɔ̈n ngwem, an'kwo utɛn naa: «Abwɛy» unsà ngyamàkà angye yà an'tɔɔn? Ntɔn nde uyöb anki ndaa atɛɛnà ngye.
Yà ndandaa naa mfuur a an'tɔɔn angye yà ntsà, wɛɛ mbuur wumwɛy uyɛl anki unsà làkwikilà ande.
Mɛ an'fuur an'tɔɔn akà Nzam ntɔn in'yäämà mɛ u ndaa a ingyey yàŋàlyaaŋ bɛ banswà,
wɛɛ uboo a Ikööŋ, mɛ in'kwen mutɛn ngɔk tyeen unsà un'yɛnà amɛ, ntɔn mulɔŋ bumwɛy sye, akwànaa ngɔk nsaab kweem unsà ndaa a ingyey.
Atɔŋ, unsà an'kyän, twon lan'kal ambɛy. Ndandaa, làkäl ambɛy ntɔn ube, wɛɛ ntɔn an'kyän, làkäl andweer.
Unsà un'kɔɔn bàsön naa: «Mwol kan'tɛn naa: Akà un'sɛŋ wà, Mɛ in'sàtɛn u mbwo a baar a ndaa asin anà u mbwo a mun a angyey. Itàkal abun, ba mɛ bàsan'wem anki."»
Abun, ndaa mpa bàfàyöb baar yà idiim ntɔn baar mpa abà aŋàlàkwikilà, wɛɛ kà ntɔn aŋàlàkwikilà anki. Ngɔɔm yà idiim ntɔn aŋàlàkwikilà, wɛɛ kà ntɔn baar mpa abà aŋàlàkwikilà anki.

Isàkal naa Ikööŋ kyanswà kyan'köŋ, anà baar banswà bàyäm u ndaa a ingyey, isàkal sye naa baar asin itàkal baar bàkɔ̈ɔ̈n làkwikilà bà mwo, nkye ba bàyàtɛn anki naa bɛ làbà anà ukɔŋ?
Mper yumwɛy, isàkal naa ba banswà bàmutà ngɔɔm, mbuur asin itàkal mbuur akɔ̈ɔ̈n làkwikilà kan'bilà kwo, nde ayàman naa ba banswà bàtɛɛnà a nde anà bàtsüülà nde mbar.

Indiir aŋàyee u mpem ande imɛnà u mii, nde ayàkömà Nzam anà ayàkyään naa Nzam wà uboo a nde, nde ayàtüüb ntabwey ande anà mɛɛn, nde ayàkömà Nzam anà ayàkyään naa ndandaa Nzam wà uboo a bɛ.
Atɔŋ, bi itsülà aben? Utaaŋ làfàköŋ bɛ, mbuur mbuur uboo a bɛ an'kwo mutɔl diim, mutwaal an'lɔɔŋ itàkal imɛɛy, mutɛn ndaa a ingyey itàkal mubaal ya: wɛy ya yanswà ikäl ntɔn mutɔŋ Ikööŋ.
Isàkal naa baar bàyäm u ndaa a ingyey, wɛy abɔ̈ɔ̈l itàkal atär mpɛl bàyäm, anà bàkyer umwɛy ungö a wumwɛy, anà mbuur abaal ya ukäl.
Isàkal naa un'baal watɛy, wɛy un'tɔŋ ukäl a duu uboo a nköŋ, wɛy nde uyäm a nde ŋakwo anà a Nzam.
Akà aŋangɔɔm, wɛy abɔ̈ɔ̈l itàkal atär bàwɛl ndaa, wɛy bumwɛy bàsyebà.
Isàkal naa umwɛy uboo a nköŋ kan'wal imɛɛy, wɛy mbuur ayäämà ukäl a duu.
Bɛ banswà lan'kwo mutà ngɔɔm, wɛɛ mbuur mbuur utaaŋ ande, ntɔn baar banswà bàlɔŋàkà anà bàwɛl ngwal.
An'dweelà a aŋangɔɔm mà ungyɛl a aŋangɔɔm.
Ntɔn Nzam kà wà Nzam a lingyoomà anki, wɛɛ Nzam a duu. Asànaa bàfàkyer ya uboo a Ikööŋ byanswà byà aŋin'kyɛɛl,
wɛy akaar bàkäl a duu uboo a nköŋ: ba mbwo bapɛ anki mutɛn. Wɛy ba bàläb ayà itɛɛnà Un'kɔɔn.
Isàkal naa ba bàkwen muyöb undiir mwɛy, wɛy mbuur mbuur ufuul un'dim ande u ndwà. Ntɔn yà nswɛn naa un'kaar usi ndaa uboo a nköŋ.
Nkye ndaa a Nzam yàfü akà bɛ? Nkye ya bɛ mpɛl làwɛl?
Isàkal naa mbuur asii naa nde wà ŋangɔɔm itàkal wàŋadweelà, wɛy nde ukyey naa indiir in'kàlasöönà mɛ byà nswɛɛŋ mwɛy yà Mwol.
Wɛɛ isàkal naa mbuur mwɛy ukyeyà anki ya, iswaŋà naa Nzam kun'yöb anki.
Kyakin, atɔŋ amɛ, làkäl anà ilɛɛm mukal aŋangɔɔm, twon lan'tsuŋ mbuur mutɛn unsà ndaa mpa bàfàyöb baar.
Wɛɛ, wɛy indiir byanswà ikäl u mbwo anà byàswalaa.
Atɔŋ, mɛ alàyɔɔb Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ kàlakyään mɛ, alà làwɛl bɛ, alà làpɛ bɛ mɔ̈ɔ̈ amu la,
anà u mbwo a la bɛ làsàwà mɔ̈ɔ̈ isàkal naa bɛ lan'kaar la asànaa kàlakyään mɛ, kya naa tɛy, bɛ làlàsà làkwikilà a bunàbun.
Mɛ kàtàlalɔŋ indiir atàtwɛb kàwɛl mɛ ŋakwo naa: Klistɔ kàkü ntɔn man'be abi, asànaa itɛɛnà Ndaa Aŋàsɔn.
Nde bàkyer un'dyee, waa kàwiyà kà ilä kyàtär.
Nde kàyàmɛnà akà Petɔlà, ungö akà Bàkwem Aŋiyweel.
Ungö apan, nde kàyamɛnà umbàla mwɛy akà atɔŋ aŋàsöön nkam tyeen. Bàmbɔɔn uboo a ba bye anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ tii papanà, bamwɛy bàkyàkwà.
Ungö nde kàkàmɛnà akà Zyak, anà akà antööm banswà.
Ungöngö a ba banswà, nde kàyàmɛnà akà mɛ sye, mɛ mwan mpa kàkölà nsöŋ.
Ntɔn mɛ in'wà wà ikikye uboo a an'tööm, mɛ in'kwe anki ban'bel ntööm, ntɔn mɛ kàmɛɛy Ikööŋ a Nzam nkwaaŋ.

Wɛɛ in'wà mɛ abà, mɛ in'wà ntɔn kab a ngway a Nzam, anà kab a ngway ande alà akà mɛ làkäl anki làbunàbun. Wɛɛ mɛ kàsäl aŋasöön ba banswà: kà mɛ anki, wɛɛ kab a ngway a Nzam alà amu mɛ.
Kyakin, itàkal mɛ, itàkal ba, undiir ikyäänà bi awà, undiir làsi bɛ làkwikilà.
Isàkal ban'kyään naa Klistɔ kàwiyà uboo a akü, ntɔn nkye bamwɛy uboo a bɛ ban'kwo ba mutɛn naa ngwiiyà a akü yatɛy?
Isàkal naa ngwiiyà a akü yatɛy, abwɛy Klistɔ kàwiyà anki,
isàkal naa Klistɔ kàwiyà anki, an'lɔɔŋ abi mà màbunàbun, làkwikilà abɛ sye là làbunàbun.
Apan, imɛnà naa bi ibà ambäl a Nzam bàloor, ntɔn bi kàtwääl imbäl asin mutɛn naa Nzam kàwiiy Klistɔ, wɛɛ nde kun'wiiy anki, kya isàkal naa ndandaa akü bàfàwiyà anki.
Isàkal naa akü bàfàwiyà anki, Klistɔ sye kàwiyà anki.
Ntɔn, isàkal naa Klistɔ kàwiyà anki, làkwikilà abɛ là làbunàbun, tii lalà bɛ làbà uboo a man'be.
Abun sye, baar bàkü amu Klistɔ bàkyàkyàbwà.
Isàkal naa bi kàsi làkyän abi amu Klistɔ ntɔn mɔ̈ɔ̈ awà mpɛl, bi ibà baar a ngweel a ngyɛb aŋàsöön baar banswà.
Wɛɛ yà ndandaa naa Klistɔ kàwiyà uboo a akü anà wà mbɛŋ atàtwɛb uboo a baar bàkü.
Ntɔn, u mbwo a mbuur mwɛy ukwà waa bayi, abun u mbwo a mbuur mwɛy sye ngwiiyà a akü waa yàyi.
Ifà imwɛy baar banswà bàfàkwà amu Adam, amu Klistɔ sye baar banswà bàsàwal mɔ̈ɔ̈,
wɛɛ mbuur mbuur kà un'lwaaŋ ande: sɛmà akà Klistɔ, ungö, baar abà amu Klistɔ, utaaŋ a ngyeel ande.
Apan, ntsüü waa isàyà, mpal usàfuur nde imwol akà Taa Nzam, ungö mudwa imfum kyanswà, ikɔ̈b kyanswà, ngwal yanswà.
Ntɔn nde akyer ayaal, tii mpal usàsà nde ayiiŋ ande banswà ungyɛl a in'kɔl ande.
Un'yiiŋ a ntsüü bàsàdwà wà ukwà.
Ntɔn, nde indiir byanswà kàsi ungyɛl a in'kɔl ande. Wɛɛ utɛɛnà nde naa: «Indiir byanswà byà ungyɛl a in'kɔl», iswaŋà naa mbuur kun'syeel bya ungyɛl a in'kɔl mwo watɛy.
Umpal naa indiir byanswà ban'sà ungyɛl a Klistɔ, apan Mwan ŋakwo asàkal ungyɛl a mbuur kun'syeel indiir byanswà ungyɛl, ntɔn Nzam ukäl ya yanswà amu baar banswà.
Yàlàkal naa kà abwɛy anki, baar bàfàwal ndüümà ntɔn akü, ininà bàlàleŋ? Isàkal yà ipepey naa akü bàwiyà anki, ntɔn nkye bàfàwal ba ndüümà ntɔn ba?
Wɛɛ bi ŋakwo, ntɔn nkye taaŋ lanswà ibà bi u mpay?
Wɛɛ mɛ in'fàkwà ilä byanswà, yà ndandaa sye, atɔŋ, naa bɛ làbà uyɔl amɛ amu Yɛsu Klistɔ, Mwol abi.
Ininà mɛ kàlàwal munwan a ntsür u Ifɛsɔ isàkal naa mɛ kàkäl unsà imbuur? Isàkal naa akü bàwiyà anki, wɛy bi idi anà inü, ntɔn nkàswo bi ikyer akwà.
Twon bàlakür: isam ibe ifàbwiy nkääl aŋàbwaŋ.
Làfuur an'kyän ubwaŋàbwaŋ, làwɛy mukyer man'be. Ntɔn bamwɛy Nzam bàyöb anki, mɛ ya an'tɛn ntɔn nswɛn abɛ.
Wɛɛ mbuur mwɛy ayàtɛn naa: «Akü bàyàwiyà aben? Ndür nà ba bàyàfurà ayà?»
Insil! Ngye, imbɛŋ afàkɔn ngye, kya mumɛn itwab afàtàkwà.
Undiir afàkɔn ngye, kà un'tɛ awà uyàmɛn anki, wɛɛ imbɛŋ a ipɔl, kyà blɛ itàkal kyà undiir asin.
Ungö, Nzam kun'pà ndür, asànaa ukwen nde anà akà imbɛŋ imbɛŋ a ndür akya ŋakwo.
Akà ndür mwɛy balàbal yatɛy anà yumwɛy: ye anà nsöön uboo a ndür a baar, yà ntsür, yà nɛn, yà nsö.
Ye anà ndür a du anà ndür a mɛɛn, un'nyäŋ a ya wà nsöön,
umwɛy un'nyäŋ a taaŋ, umwɛy wà nsöŋ, umwɛy wà mbwaar. Mbwaar mwɛy wà nsöön a mbwaar wumwɛy unsà un'nyäŋ.
Ya ye abwey sye ntɔn ngwiiyà a akü: bàfàkɔn ndür ifàpɔɔn, ifàwiyà ndür mpa ifàpɔɔn.
Bàfàkɔn ndür a nswɛn, ifàwiyà unsà làkoo, bàfàkɔn unsà gyɔ̈ɔ̈là, ifàwiyà aŋàyɔl a ngwal.
Bàfàkɔn ndür a ntsür, ifàwiyà ndür a dweelà. Isàkal naa ye anà ndür a ntsür, ye anà ndür a dweelà sye.
Kyakin, bàsön naa: «Adam, mbuur atàtwɛb, kàkäl ntsür a mbuur, Adam wà ntsüü wà mbuur a dweelà afàpà mɔ̈ɔ̈.»
Wɛɛ undiir wàtàtwɛb, wà ntsür a mbuur, ungö, mbuur a dweelà.
Mbuur atàtwɛb kàfü u mɛɛn, mbuur wàyweel kàfü du.
Baar a mɛɛn bà ifà imwɛy anà mbuur bàboom a tɔm, baar a du bà ifà imwɛy anà mbuur kàfü du.
Ifà imwɛy naa bi kàbwäär ifà a tɔm, bi isàbwaar sye ifà a mbuur a du.
Atɔŋ, ndaa in'tɛn mɛ ayi: in'twaŋ anà an'kil màkwe anki mubilà kà Imwol a Nzam, itàkal undiir afàpɔɔn ufàwal anki undiir mpa afàpɔɔn.
Wɛɛ mɛ inkwen mukàlakyään ngyee mwɛy. Bi banswà isàkwà anki, wɛɛ bi banswà ikyer asàsɔɔmà,
u mbalà mwɛy, kà imbürà imbürà u saay a mfuŋ. Ntɔn saay a mfuŋ a ntsüü làkyer asàbɛɛr, akü bàkyer asàwiyà anà ndür aba mpa isàpɔɔn, wɛɛ bi, bi ikyer asàsɔɔmà.
Kyakin, yà naa ndür ifàpɔɔn ibwäär ndür mpa ifàpɔɔn, ndür ifàkwà ibwäär ndür mpa ifàkwà.
Utaaŋ ndür ifàpɔɔn ayi isàbwaar ya ndür mpa ifàpɔɔn, anà ndür ifàkwà isàbwaar ya ndür mpa ifàkwà, abun isàkwo ndaa bàsön naa: «Iböŋ kyan'min ukwà.
«Ukwà, kyàken iböŋ angye? Ukwà, kyàken ikɔ̈b angye?»
Ukwà ngwal a ba man'be, ngwal a man'be, un'kɔɔn.
Wɛɛ bi ifuur an'tɔɔn akà Nzam, nde mbuur afàpà iböŋ u mbwo a Mwol abi Yɛsu Klistɔ.
Kyakin, atɔŋ amɛ bànkwen, làkäl ngwal, làkäl aŋàtsim, làpɛ mɔ̈ɔ̈ taaŋ lanswà unsà isal a Mwol, làyöb naa isal abɛ unsà Mwol kà kyà bunàbun anki.
Ntɔn ndaa a an'kab bàköŋà ntɔn aŋin'kyɛɛl, bɛ sye làläb nswɛɛŋ kàpɛ mɛ akà Ikööŋ a Ngalàtyà.
Kà ilä atàtwɛb kyà mpɔsà wanswà, wɛy mbuur mbuur usi ukɔl u ndwà ande undiir kàkwe nde muyee ntɔn mukɔɔn adil ngyeel amɛ mukɔŋ an'kab.
Utaaŋ in'yàkal mɛ akun, mɛ in'yàtɔm baar làyàsɔɔl bɛ anà in'kaan ntɔn musyen an'kab abɛ u Yɛlusàlɛm.
Isàkal naa yà ubwaŋ sye naa mɛ ŋakwo in'kyen, ba bàsàkyà anà mɛ.
Mɛ in'yàyà akà bɛ musoonà Masɛdwan, ntɔn mɛ in'yàlyaaŋ kwo.
Taaŋ lumwɛy mɛ in'yàkal ndam a ilä itàkal paŋà a mpyee lanswà apà bɛ, ntɔn bɛ lan'pɛ indiir byan'kwo mɛ mulab mbwo amɛ.
Mbalà ayi mɛ in'kwen anki, mukàlaman taaŋ alyaaŋ mɛ mpɛl, mɛ in'kwen mubwaay anà bɛ ndam a ilä, isàkal naa Mwol an'pà mbwo.
Wɛɛ mɛ in'yàbwaay u Ɛfɛsɔ tii kà un'kyɔm a Pantɛkɔt,
ntɔn mbwo a kölàköl yan'dubà ntɔn mɛ mukyer isal a ngwal, itàkal naa ayiiŋ bà mbɔɔn.
Isàkal naa Tumàtɛ kan'yà, làkyer naa nde ukäl anà duu uboo a bɛ, ntɔn nde afàkyer isal a Mwol asànaa mɛ.
Abun, wɛy mbuur ukɔ̈ɔ̈n un'bɛy. Lun'pɛ byàŋàkwo ntɔn nde uyàfurà apà mɛ, ntɔn mɛ anà atɔŋ ibà mukun'dilà.
Ntɔn un'tɔŋ abi Apɔlɔs, mɛ kun'lɛɛl muyà akà bɛ anà atɔŋ bumwɛy, wɛɛ nde ukwen anki akà ikikye muyà apanà, nde asàyà mpal usàman nde mbwo.
Làkäl kà igyɛɛŋ, làkäl aŋàtsim unsà làkwikilà, làkäl anà un'kanà, làkäl ngwal.
Làkyer indiir abɛ byanswà unsà ukwen.
Atɔŋ, nswɛɛŋ yumwɛy ayi: bɛ làkyàyöb naa Sɛràfan anà ywar ande bà baar atàtwɛb mubuul mpem kà Akayi. Ba bàpɛ mɔ̈ɔ̈ aba musyääl aŋin'kyɛɛl.
Lakyey, baar atub abà anà mbuur wanswà akääbà isal aba anà mpay aba.
Mɛ in'we anà un'sak muman Sɛràfan, Fɔrtünatüs anà Akayiküs. Ba bàfwe nkɔ̈ɔ̈n abɛ,
ntɔn ba bàlɛɛl mɛ anà bɛ. Làyöb mukan baar atub abà.
Ikööŋ a Azi byàmàlapà mbɔr. Akilas anà Priskà, anà Ikööŋ ifàköŋ u ndwà aba bàmàlatöm mbɔr mbɔɔn unsà Mwol.
Atɔŋ banswà bàmàlapà mbɔr. Làpɛɛl mbɔr bɛ a bɛ unsà ndüür a in'kyɛɛl.
Mbɔr ayi yà kɔɔ amɛ ŋakwo, mɛ Pɔl.
Isàkal naa mbuur ukwen anki Mwol, wɛy nde ukäl aŋàküül! Mwol abi, yà!
Wɛy kab a ngway a Mwol Yɛsu làkäl anà bɛ.
Mɛ bɛ banswà in'kyàlakwen amu Yɛsu Klistɔ.
2 KƆLINTƆ
Pɔl, ntööm a Klistɔ Yɛsu unsà ukwen a Nzam, anà un'tɔŋ Tumàtɛ, akà Ikööŋ a Nzam akyà u Kɔlintɔ, anà akà aŋin'kyɛɛl banswà abà u Akayi wanswà.
Wɛy Taaràbi Nzam anà Mwol Yɛsu Klistɔ bàlapɛ kab a ngway anà duu.
Nsaak ikäl akà Nzam, Taar a Mwol abi Yɛsu Klistɔ, Taa a nsyääm anà Nzam a ndɛɛl yanswà,
nde afàlɛɛl bi unsà mpay abi yanswà, ntɔn mukipà ngwal mulɛɛl baar abà u mpay mbɔɔn, u mbwo a ndɛɛl ayà ifàwal bi ŋakwo akà Nzam.
Ntɔn, asànaa ifàman bi mpay mbɔɔn amu Klistɔ, abun sye u mbwo a Klistɔ, ndɛɛl abi yà mbɔɔn.

Isàkal naa bi ibà uboo a mpay mbɔɔn, yà ntɔn ndɛɛl abɛ anà ngweel a mɔ̈ɔ̈ abɛ. Isàkal naa bi ibà aŋàlɛɛl, yà ntɔn naa bɛ sye làwɛl ndɛɛl ntɔn bɛ làkwe mukaŋ mpem anà muküünà, ifà imwɛy a mpay ifàman bi.
Abun, bi ibye anà làkyän a ngwal akà bɛ, ntɔn bi ikyàyöb naa làmanà bɛ mpay mbwo mwɛy anà bi, bɛ sye làwalà ndɛɛl mbwo mwɛy anà bi.
Atɔŋ, ntɔn bi ikwen naa bɛ làyöb naa mpay aŋàdiir nà bi kàbweey ayà kà Azi: ya yàkü kir, yàŋàlyaŋ ngwal abi ukwɛl, lalan ilwom ya làkyän mufàkal anà mɔ̈ɔ̈.
Bi kàmɛn amu bi ŋakwo naa bàmitsüül mbar a ukwà. Ntɔn bi ikɔ̈ɔ̈n afàsà làkyän amu bi ŋakwo, wɛɛ amu Nzam afàwiiy akü.
Nde mbuur kàduum bi kukwà abà anà akyer afàsiduum. Bi kan'sà làkyän amu nde: nde bi akyer afàsiduum.
Bɛ sye làkyàbilà mwo u mbwo a ngyamàkà abɛ ntɔn bi. Abun, kab a ngway alisàwal bi u mbwo a ngyamàkà a baar mbɔɔn, làsàbulà, ntɔn bàmbɔɔn, an'tɔɔn ntɔn bi.
Ntɔn, ngaal abi yimbäl a an'kyän abi aki: u mɛɛn, sin sin akà bɛ, bi kàkäl unsà ndandaa anà unsà un'kyɛɛl a Nzam, kà nà an'yeerà a imbuur anki, wɛɛ u mbwo a kab a ngway a Nzam.
Kyakin, bi indiir asin bɛ ifàlasöön anki, nà indiir làfàtaŋ bɛ anà làyöb bɛ. Wɛɛ mɛ an'sà làkyän naa bɛ làsàyöb aŋàkwo,
ntɔn bɛ làyöb ndam: bi ibà ngaal abɛ, asànaa làbà bɛ yà bi kilä a Mwol Yɛsu.
Unsà kam alan, mɛ kàkwen mutàlyaŋ akà bɛ ntɔn mukàlawɛɛl kab a ngway làyweel,
anà, fà apà bɛ, mɛ in'kyen Masɛdwan, anà fà Masɛdwan mufyefurà akà bɛ, ntɔn muwal akà bɛ indiir in'yàkal mɛ abyà mfun mukyà Yuday.
Umpal kàsi mɛ un'yɔŋ awà, nkye mɛ kàkyer upool? Itàkal naa nkye nswaal amɛ yà yimbuur, ntɔn ya ikäl umbalà mwɛy «inye» anà «ŋaa»?
Nzam awà lää, wà mbäl: Ndaa itɛɛnà bi a bɛ kà yumbalà mwɛy «inye» anà «ŋaa» anki.
Ntɔn Mwan a Nzam, Klistɔ Yɛsu awà kàlakyään bi, Silàvɛ, Tumàtɛ anà mɛ, kàkäl anki «inye» anà «ŋaa», wɛɛ amu nde yà «inye» mpɛl.
Abun, ilää a Nzam byanswà, byàmɛn «inye» a bya amu nde. Kyakin mbwo ande sye bi ifàtɛn naa «yabwɛy» akà Nzam ntɔn làkoo ande.
Wɛɛ, mbuur afàpà bi anà bɛ ngwal amu Klistɔ anà kisi an'kɔɔ, wà Nzam,
nde mbuur kibɛɛrà inyɛm ande sye anà kàbiil Dweelà u mpem abi asànaa mbööl a indiir aŋàbwaŋ abyà iyàyà.
Akà mɛ, mɛ an'wal Nzam mbäl udu a mɔ̈ɔ̈ amɛ: ntɔn mukàlatii waa mɛ mpa kàyàfurà u Kɔlintɔ.
Kà ntɔn muyaal làkwikilà abɛ anki, wɛɛ bi ibà mbaay ntɔn un'sak abɛ, ntɔn làkwikilà waa bɛ lan'tsim.
Ntɔn, akà mɛ, mɛ an'tsülà abà: Mɛ in'yàfurà anki akà bɛ unsà ngyɛb.
Isàkal naa mɛ amàlasà u ngyɛb, nà afàsampà un'sak? Nkye kà mbuur awà kàpɛ mɛ ngyɛb anki?
Akin isin a ndaa a un'kaan amɛ, mutiin naa u ngyeel amɛ, mɛ in'kɔ̈ɔ̈n aman ngyɛb akà baar bàlan'pà un'sak. Ndandaa, mɛ an'kyey, ntɔn bɛ, naa un'sak amɛ wà wàbɛ banswà sye.
Abun, uboo a mpay aŋàdiir, anà u mpem a ngyɛb anà nsaaŋ mbɔɔn, mɛ kàlasöön kà ntɔn mukàlapà ngyɛb anki, wɛ ntɔn bɛ làyöb naa ukwen nà mɛ in'we abà ntɔn bɛ.
Isàkal naa mbuur kàkäl isin a ngyɛb, nde kà mɛ usi anki u ngyɛb, wɛɛ bɛ banswà, taaŋ lumwɛy ndam, mukɔɔn asweey.
Ntɔn mbuur atub awà, ubwaŋ pɛl làkäl là baar mbɔɔn,
lalan, apanà, lun'dwääl nkul anà lun'pɛ ngwal, manà nde ubilà u ngyɛb aŋàdiir.
Kyakin sye mɛ amàlalɔm, muswaŋ ukwen abɛ akà ande,
ntɔn, kàlasöön mɛ sye, mɛ kàkwen mukàlasi naa nkye unkyeey abɛ unsà indiir byanswà wàŋàkwo.
Mbuur lan'dwääl bɛ nkul, mbuur in'dwääl mɛ sye nkul! Isàkal naa mɛ kàdwääl nkul, ikäl sye naa mɛ kàkäl anà ipöl mukyer abun, mɛ kàkyer ntɔn bɛ, kusà a Klistɔ,
ntɔn Satanà mukɔɔn akikur, ntɔn bi ikyàyöb an'kyän ande.
Utaaŋ kàkɔlà mɛ Tɔlɔwas ntɔn mukyään Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ là Klistɔ, itàkal naa Mwol kan'duub mbwo a kölàköl,
mpem amɛ yàkäl anki a duu, ntɔn mɛ un'tɔŋ amɛ Titɔ kun'mɛn anki. Abun laa kàsawɛy mɛ, waa kàkyen Masɛdwan.
Wɛy an'tɔɔn màkäl akà Nzam afisyen taaŋ lanswà unsà iböŋ ande u mbwo a Klistɔ anà u mbwo abi, afàtsul may a usɔŋ a ngyööb ande u mper yanswà.
Ntɔn bi ibà ntɔn Nzam, usɔŋ aŋàbwaŋ a Klistɔ, ntɔn baar bàfàwà mɔ̈ɔ̈ anà ntɔn baar bàfàdiimà,
ntɔn bamwɛy usɔŋ a ukwà bàfàsyen kukwà, ntɔn bumwɛy, usɔŋ a mɔ̈ɔ̈ bàfàsyen u mɔ̈ɔ̈. Abun, nà kan'kwo unsà isal atub aki?
Abun, bi kibà anki asànaa baar bumwɛy bàfàyälà ndaa a Nzam, wɛɛ unsà ndandaa, kikɔb a Nzam, kusa a Nzam, unsà Klistɔ waa bi iyäämà.
Nkye bi ifàsɛmà muswɛɛŋ bi ŋakwo? Itàkal naa nkye bi iwe anà mfun, asànaa bumwɛy, yà in'kaan muswɛɛŋ ntɔn bɛ, itàkal myàfà akà bɛ?
Wɛɛ bɛ làbà un'kaan abi, bàsön uboo a mpem abi, awà bàyöb anà bàtäŋ baar banswà.
Inye, yà ndandaa naa bɛ làbà un'kaan a Klistɔ bàsön ntɔn isal abi, bàsön anki anà tiin, wɛɛ anà Dweelà a Nzam a mɔ̈ɔ̈, kudu a mɛsà a nkɔŋ anki, wɛɛ udu a mɛsà a in'twaŋ, udu a mpem.
Lalà kam iwà bi alà kusà a Nzam u mbwo a Klistɔ.
Bi ikyey anki uyɔl naa bi ŋakwo kan'kwo mukyer undiir mwɛy u ngwal abi ŋakwo, wɛɛ ngwal abi yan'fà akà Nzam.
Nde sye mbuur kibuul bàŋàkwo mukal asyääl a Nkwà akün, kà ntɔn un'kaan anki, wɛɛ ntɔn Dweelà, ntɔn un'kaan akyer afàdwa, wɛɛ Dweelà afàpà mɔ̈ɔ̈.
Kyekà, isàkal naa isal a ukwà, bàsön a ngɔk udu a in'kul kyàpɛ làkoo, abun baar a Isàlɛl bàkwe anki musyebà mbɔɔn ntabwey a Mɔsɛ ntɔn làkoo làkäl u ntabwey ande, làkoo mpa làläm.
Ntɔn nkye isal a Dweelà mpa ikal kya anà làkoo aŋàsöönà?
Isàkal naa isal ifàpà ntaaŋàmbar kyàkäl anà làkoo, ntɔn nkye isal a balàbal mpa iwal kya làkoo aŋàsöönà?
Abun, undiir kàkäl anà làkoo kàwɛl anki làkoo, ntɔn làkoo aŋàbà làŋàsöönà.
Ntɔn, isàkal naa undiir mpa afàlam kàpɛ làkoo, aben undiir afàlam mpa upà wa làkoo aŋàsöönà?
Ntɔn bi ibye anà làkyän atub alà, waa bi iwe anà làkyän a mbɔɔn.
Bi ikyer anki asànaa Mɔsɛ kàfafwee ntabwey ande a ipfɛy a swaa ntɔn baar a Isàlɛl bàkɔ̈ɔ̈n aman ntsüü a un'nyäŋ mpa afàlam.
Wɛɛ, un'yɛnà aba kàkäl aŋàbwà làpib, tii ŋàbawà, kya bàsàtaŋ Nkwà Itaan, làpib alà là kapaa. La ŋàtàlwomà anki, ntɔn la làsàyaalà amu Klistɔ.
Inye, tii ŋàbawà, taaŋ lanswà bàfàtaŋ ba Mɔsɛ, làpib là u mpem aba.
Wɛɛ mbuul a mpem akà Mwol mpɛl ifàlwom làpib.
Ntɔn Mwol wà Dweelà, ikal awà Dweelà a Mwol, ikal ayà nsaay.
Bi banswà, baar ibye anà ntabwey aŋàlwom làpib, bi iwàmumɛɛy làkoo a Mwol, bi ibà aŋàsɔɔmà unsà isii nsil aki, anà làkoo làŋàsöön kölàköl taaŋ lanswà u mbwo a Mwol, awà Dweelà.
Ntɔn sye, u mbwo a nsyääm, bi ban'kaar isal aki bi ikwamà anki.

Wɛɛ bi kan'tɔn an'yee a nswɛn, bi, bi ifàsyääl anki impeenà anà bi ifàbübünà anki Ndaa a Nzam, wɛɛ mumɛɛy ndandaa ubwaŋàbwaŋ, waa bi ifàswɛɛŋ bi ŋakwo u nsyeebà a mbuur wanswà kusà a Nzam.
Isàkal naa apà Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ abi làŋàfwe, la làŋàfwe ntɔn baar bàfàdiimà,
ntɔn baar bàkɔ̈ɔ̈n làkwikilà, waa nzam a mɛɛn mà kàsi làpib unsà un'yɛnà ntɔn baar bàkɔ̈ɔ̈n aman kyɛɛy a Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ alà làkoo a Klistɔ, awà imɛɛy a Nzam.
Ntɔn, kà bi ŋakwo anki bi ifàkyään, wɛɛ bi ifàkyään naa Yɛsu Klistɔ wà Mwol anà bi ŋakwo ibà asyääl abɛ ntɔn Yɛsu.
Ntɔn Nzam awà kàtɛn naa: «Pɛɛlà làsànyäŋ uboo a làpib!», wà Nde ŋakwo kànyäŋ u mpem abi, ntɔn ngyööb a làkoo ande ipɛ kyɛɛy u ntabwey a Klistɔ.
Wɛɛ, un'naaŋ awà, bi wa ifàsyen unsà an'buuŋ, ntɔn ngwal aŋàsöönà ayi ikäl yà Nzam, wɛɛ kà yà bi anki.
Bi ibà aŋàküünà mper yanswà, wɛɛ bi kibà aŋàbwanà anki, unsà lingyoomà, wɛɛ bi ilwom anki làkyän,
bakyer afilab, wɛɛ bàfikaar anki, bàkyer afidüb, wɛɛ bàfimaay anki,
taaŋ lanswà ndür abi ye anà nkweel a Yɛsu ntɔn naa mɔ̈ɔ̈ ande ukäl sye wàŋàmɛnà u ndür abi.
Kyakin, taaŋ lanswà, bi aŋamɔ̈ɔ̈, bàkiyälà kukwà ntɔn Yɛsu, ntɔn mɔ̈ɔ̈ a Yɛsu sye umɛnà u ndür abi yukwà.
Abun, ukwà bàmukyer isal amu bi, wɛɛ mɔ̈ɔ̈ amu bɛ.
Kyekà, asànaa ibà bi anà Dweelà mwɛy la, dweelà a làkwikilà, abun bàsön naa: «Mɛ kàsi làkwikilà, kyakin kàyäm mɛ», bi sye, bi kan'sà làkwikilà, kyakin waa bi iyäämà.
Ntɔn bi ikyàyöb, mbuur kàwiiy Mwol Yɛsu, nde sye akyer afàsiwiiy anà Yɛsu, waa usisà anà bɛ tsütsü apà nde.
Ntɔn indiir abi byanswà byàyi ntɔn bɛ, ntɔn kab a ngway làbɛy, waa làsweey an'tɔɔn a baar mbɔɔn ntɔn làkoo a Nzam.
Kyakin, bi iyɔn anki, itàkal naa amu bi, imbuur a nsà kyàmutay ikye ikye, imbuur a boo ifàbulà kyàkün ilä a ilä.
Ntɔn, mpay mbɔɔn imanà bi yi, yikaay anà yàlyaŋ, kusà a làkoo a kölàköl là mbul a in'tye kilɔ̈ɔ̈nà mpay mbɔɔn ayi.
Abun, isin a an'kyän abi kà kyà unsà indiir byàfàmɛnà anki, wɛɛ unsà indiir mpa bàfàman. Indiir bàfàman byàfàlam anki, wɛɛ undiir mpa bàfàman byàfàlam mbul a in'tye.
Bi ikyàyöb ubwaŋàbwaŋ, isàkal naa ndwà abi u mɛɛn yà ntɛn yan'kwà, bi iwe anà ndwà, ntööŋ a Nzam, ndwà a mbul a in'tye, u du, mpa bàtöŋ kan'kɔɔ a mbuur.
Abun sye bi ibà mufuur koo, unsà ngyal aŋàdiir mubwaar, udu a yumwɛy, ndwà abi yà du,
yubwaŋ naa bimɛn bàŋàbwaar, kà bànsàpɔl anki.
Ntɔn, bi baar ibà uboo a ntɛn ayi, bi kan'fuur koo, kan'sil a buur. Ntɔn bi ikwen anki isɔ̈l ipfɛy, wɛɛ ibwäär ipfɛy udu a kyumwɛy, ntɔn undiir afàkwà, mɔ̈ɔ̈ kun'min.
Nzam ŋakwo kilɔ̈ɔ̈n mukal abun, nde kipɛ Dweelà ande asànaa mbööl.
Lalan bi ibà aŋàyɔl a làkyän taaŋ lanswà. Bi ikyàyöb naa utaaŋ ibà bi uboo a ndür yi, bi ibà u nsà a ndwà abi, ukwɛl a Mwol,
ntɔn bi ifàkyà unsà làkwikilà, kunsà mɛɛy anki.
Ndandaa, bi ibà aŋàyɔl a làkyän anà bi iyàkwen mulwomà u ndür yi, ntɔn mukàkal apà Mwol.
Lalan sye bi ikyer ngwal mukun'pà un'sak, itàkal naa bi ibà u ndür ayi, itàkal naa bi kan'too amu ya.
Ntɔn, bi banswà ikyer asàkàmɛnà kusà a làbay a nsaŋ a Klistɔ, ntɔn mbuur mbuur uwɛl kab a indiir kàkyer nde, itàkal amubwaŋ, itàkal amube, utaaŋ kàkäl nde u mɔ̈ɔ̈ a ndür ande.
Abà iyöb bi bɔɔmà a Mwol, bi ifàsyääl mbwo yanswà naa baar bàkyey. Kusà a Nzam, bi ibà aŋàmɛnà ubwaŋàbwaŋ. Mɛ in'sii naa mɛ sye in'wà aŋàmɛnà ubwaŋàbwaŋ unsà an'kyän abɛ.

Apan, bi iyàfàswɛɛŋ anki bi ŋakwo akà bɛ, wɛɛ bi ikwen mukàlapà ipöl bɛ mukal bàngaal ntɔn bi, ntɔn bɛ làkwe mupà mfuur akà baar bàfàsà ngaal aba unsà indiir ifàmɛnà u mii, wɛɛ kà byà boo a mpem anki.
Kyakin isàkal naa bi kàkäl insil, bi kya kàkäl ntɔn Nzam, isàkal naa bi ikàmɛnà asànaa aŋun'yɛnà, yà ntɔn bɛ.
Ukwen a Klistɔ bàmikɔr, bi baar ikyeyà naa ndandaa mbuur mwɛy kàkü ntɔn baar banswà, lalan baar banswà bàkyàkwà.
Nde kàkü ntɔn baar banswà, ntɔn aŋamɔ̈ɔ̈ bàkɔ̈ɔ̈n afàkal anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ ntɔn ba ŋakwo, wɛɛ ntɔn mbuur awà kàkü anà kàwiyà ntɔn ba.
Kyakin, fà apanà bi ifàyöb anki kà mbuur mwɛy unsà imbuur. Isàkal naa bi kàyöb Klistɔ unsà imbuur, apanà bi ifun'yöb anki abun.
Abun sye, isàkal naa mbuur wà amu Klistɔ, nde kan'bulà ikyeer akün. Indiir itaan byan'lyaŋ, le, indiir byanswà byan'bulà byàkün.
Indiir byanswà ifàfà akà Nzam, nde mbuur kàfuur un'tüüb abi anà nde u mbwo a Klistɔ anà kipɛ isal mufuur un'tüüb.
Ntɔn, Nzam kàkäl amu Klistɔ, kàfuur un'tüüb a mɛɛn anà nde ŋakwo, mukɔɔn alab ibii a baar anà musà amu bi ndaa mufuur un'tüüb.
Abun, bi ibà akyeey ntɔn Klistɔ. Ye asànaa Nzam nde ŋakwo abeelà u mbwo a bi: Kikɔb a Klistɔ, bi kàmàlabɔɔn, wɛy bɛ làfuur un'tüüb anà Nzam.
Mbuur mpa kàkyer man'be, Nzam kun'tälà buur a man'be abi, ntɔn amu nde bi ibulà bàbalàbal kusà a Nzam.
Ntɔn bi ibà abaay ande, bi kàmàlalɛɛl mukɔɔn awal kab a ngway a Nzam a bunàbun.
Ntɔn nde an'tɛn naa: «Utaaŋ aŋàbwaŋ, mɛ kàkyer awem, kilä a ngweel a mɔ̈ɔ̈, mɛ kàkyer abay.» Le, apanà là taaŋ aŋàbwaŋ. Le, apanà kyilä a ngweel a mɔ̈ɔ̈.
Bi ikwen anki, itàkal kaben, mubööl mbuur kyà, ntɔn bàkɔ̈ɔ̈n apɛl isal abi.
Wɛɛ akà bi, unsà ya yanswà, bi iswɛɛŋà bi ŋakwo naa ndandaa bi ibà asyääl a Nzam u mbwo a muküünà mbɔɔn amu mpay mbɔɔn, amu an'kyà, amu bɔɔmà aŋàdiir,
amu iki, amu an'bɔlokà, amu lingyoomà, amu yɔ̈ɔ̈n, amu nkɔ̈ɔ̈n a twaal, amu nkiin a isaa,
u mbwo a pɛɛl, u mbwo a ngyööb, u mbwo a nkääŋ a mpem, u mbwo a ubwaŋ, u mbwo a Dweelà In'kyɛɛl, u mbwo a ukwen a ndandaa,
u mbwo a ndaa a ndandaa, u mbwo a ngwal a Nzam, inwään abi byànwään anà byigyɛɛŋ, yà mukyer ndaa a balàbal u mii a Nzam,
amu làkoo anà nsaal, amu in'tswe anà nsyäŋà, bàfiwal asànaa aŋatwee, kyekà bi ibà bàndandaa,
bàfiwal asànaa biyöb anki, kyekà bàkiyöb ubwaŋàbwaŋ, bàfiwal asànaa akü, kyekà bi ibà anà mɔ̈ɔ̈, bàfiwal asànaa baar abuntaaŋàmbar, kyekà bi kàkü anki,

bàfiwal asànaa aŋangyɛb, kyekà taaŋ lanswà bi ibà kun'sak, bàfiwal asànaa aŋàlàmbwà, kyekà bi ifàkyer aŋin'naaŋ mbɔɔn, bàfiwal asànaa bi undiir watɛy, kyekà bi ibye anà indiir byanswà!
Atɔŋ a Kɔlintɔ, bi kàyäm anà bɛ u nsaay yanswà, bi kàladuub mpem abi kölàköl.
Bi kàladübà anki mpem abi, wɛɛ bɛ lidüüb mpem abɛ.
Apanà sye, mɛ in'tɛn a bɛ asànaa akà baan amɛ, bɛ sye làduub mpem abɛ kölàköl!
Twon lan'tüüb anà baar bàkɔ̈ɔ̈n làkwikilà. Un'tüüb nà kan'kwo mukäl uboo a balàbal anà ube? Un'tüüb nà uboo a pɛɛlà anà làpib?
Nkwà nà ayà uboo a Klistɔ anà Bɛlyar? Isam nà akyà uboo a ŋàlàkwikilà anà mbuur mpa awà ŋàlàkwikilà?

Undiir nà wun'tüüb uboo a idwà a Nzam anà bànzam a itɛk? Ntɔn bi, bi ibà idwà a Nzam a mɔ̈ɔ̈ asànaa kàtɛn Nzam ŋakwo naa: «Mɛ in'sàkal anà in'sàlyaŋ uboo a ba, mɛ in'sàkal Nzam a ba, ba bàsàkal un'sɛŋ amɛ.»
Kyakin, «Làtoo uboo a baar aban, làkäl ukɔl, twon lan'ba akà undiir mwɛy wàŋingyäy, waa mɛ in'sàlawal.
Mɛ in'sàkal taa ntɔn bɛ waa bɛ làsàkal baan abaal anà bakaar ntɔn mɛ.» Mwol aŋangwal yanswà.
Nkween amɛ, ntɔn bi kan'kaar ilää a tub abi, bi ipɔŋà bi ŋakwo u ŋingyäy yanswà yà ndür anà yà dweelà. Wɛy bi imay mubulà aŋin'kyɛɛl unsà bɔɔmà a Nzam.
Lipɛ ikal u mpem abɛ! Bi mbuur ube kàkyer anki, bi mbuur kàtay anki, bi undiir a mbuur kàduum anki.
Kà ntɔn mukàlapɛl anki waa mɛ in'tɛɛnà abwɛy, ntɔn mɛ ya kàkyàtàtɛn: bɛ làbà u mpem abi unsà ukwà anà u mɔ̈ɔ̈.
Làkyän amɛ là mbɔɔn amu bɛ, mɛ in'we anà uyɔl mbɔɔn ntɔn bɛ, mɛ in'wà aŋàyɔl a ndɛɛl, mɛ in'wà unsà un'sak mbɔɔn uboo a mpay abi yanswà.
Kyakin, utaaŋ ban'kɔlà bi u Masɛdwan, bi kànyäm anki, bi kàbwey a mpay yifà ifà: ngwiy u nsà, bɔɔmà uboo abi.
Wɛɛ Nzam, mbuur afàlɛɛl bàŋàlàbɔ̈ɔ̈n, nde kàlɛɛl bi u mbwo a ngyeel a Titɔ,

kà nà u mbwo a ngyeel ande mpɛl anki, wɛɛ u mbwo a ngwal kàwɛl nde akà bɛ, nde kàkyer isaam ntɔn ukwen abɛ bà ngwal. Nde kiyäm ngyal abɛ yà ngwal, yà nsaaŋ abɛ, yun'kanà abɛ ntɔn mɛ. Ya yanswà yàfan'pà un'sak aŋàsöönà.
Inye, isàkal naa un'kaan amɛ kàlapɛ ngyɛb, mɛ in'kyɛɛrà anki. Yàlàtàkal naa mɛ in'kyɛɛr, ntɔn mɛ imanà naa un'kaan awà kàlapɛ ngyɛb u taaŋ làmwɛy,
apanà mɛ an'man un'sak, kà ntɔn ngyɛb abɛ anki, wɛɛ ntɔn nsɔɔmà kan'bɔr wa. Ntɔn ngyɛb abɛ yàkäl unsà ukwen a Nzam. Kyakin, akà bi, bɛ làsàman anki akà ube mwɛy.
Ntɔn, ngyɛb unsà ukwen a Nzam ifàbɔr nsɔɔmà ayà ifàsyen u ngweel a mɔ̈ɔ̈ anà ifàwɛy anki ipöl akà nkyɛɛr. Wɛɛ ngyɛb ntɔn mbääb a mɛɛn mà, ifàbɔr ukwà.

Làler apà undiir kàbör ngyɛb akà bɛ unsà ukwen a Nzam: muküünà nà! ndwääl a ube nà! ntöön a ube nà! bɔɔmà nà! ilään nà! un'kanà nà! ntaaŋàmbar nà! Unsà ndaa ya yanswà bɛ ŋakwo làkyàmɛɛy naa bɛ làbà akuun amu ya.

Abun, isàkal naa mɛ kàkyer alasöön, kà ntɔn mbɛɛy anki, itàkal kà ntɔn mbuur kàkyer ube anki, itàkal kà ntɔn mbuur bàmukyer ube anki, wɛɛ ntɔn muswaŋ kusà a bɛ, u mii a Nzam, un'kanà abɛ ntɔn bi.
Awà undiir kilɛɛl. Bi kà nà ndɛɛl aŋàyen mpɛl kàwɛl anki, bi kàsäŋ aŋàsöönà muman un'sak anà Titɔ ntɔn lun'tɔɔl bɛ mpem.

Ntɔn, isàkal naa kusà a nde, mɛ kàswɛŋ ngaal ntɔn bɛ, bɛ mɛ nswɛn lan'mɛɛy anki! Wɛɛ, asànaa ifàkyään bi bɛ ndandaa taaŋ lanswà, lalan ngaal kàswɛŋ bi ntɔn bɛ kusà a Titɔ yàmɛnà naa yà ndandaa,
ukwen ande akà bɛ bàŋàsöön mbɔɔn, sin sin nde usàyɔbà unkyeey abɛ banswà, ntɔn bɛ lun'wɛl unsà bɔɔmà anà matɛɛr.
Mɛ in'wà unsà un'sak musà làkyän amɛ amu bɛ.
Atɔŋ, bi ikwen naa bɛ làyöb kab a ngway alà kàpɛ Nzam akà Ikööŋ a Masɛdwan.
Itàkal naa ba bàkäl u mpay mbɔɔn, wɛɛ un'sak aba kàkäl mbɔɔn, lalan bàpɛ ba indiir aŋàsöönà, itàkal naa ba bàŋàlàmbwà aŋàdiir.
Mɛ in'wà mbäl: asànaa bään aba, itàkal aŋàsöönà, u mpem aba wanswà,
unsà mbɔ̈ɔ̈n yanswà, ba bilɔ̈ɔ̈m, asànaa kab a ngway, mubilà unsà isal mutɔm mbaay akà aŋin'kyɛɛl a Yuday.
Ba bàpɛ yàŋàlyaŋ an'kyän abi: ba bàpɛɛl ba ŋakwo, kusà akà Mwol, ungö akà bi, u mbwo a ukwen a Nzam.
Kyakin kàlɛɛl bi Titɔ mumay akà bɛ isal a nkääb aki, asànaa kàsɛmà nde kya.
Wɛɛ, ntɔn bɛ làbà aŋàyɔl mbɔɔn a indiir byanswà, làkwikilà, kab a ndaa, ngyööb anà mbämà yà ifà ifà anà yukwen làwɛl bɛ akà bi, làkäl sye bàŋàyɔl a nkääb ayi.
Mɛ kà nswɛɛŋ anki alapaa: wɛɛ alàyäämà mɛ mbämà a baar asin, mɛ amàlapà ipöl mumɛɛy naa ukwen abɛ bà ndandaa.
Ntɔn bɛ làkyayöb kab a ngway a Mwol abi Yɛsu Klistɔ: nde mbuur kàkäl ŋun'naaŋ, nde kàbulà ŋàlàmbwà, ntɔn bɛ, ntɔn, u mbwo a làmbwà ande, bɛ làbulà aŋin'naaŋ.
An'kyän amɛ ntɔn nkääb amà: yubwaŋ naa bɛ làsi muküünà, ntɔn bɛ làbà bàtàtwɛb, kà ntɔn mukyer mpɛl anki, wɛɛ sye ntɔn muwal an'kyän mukyer isal a nkääb aki sɛmà mbul kàlyaŋ.
Wɛɛ apà, làmaay, mukyer wa, abun nswaal abɛ yàŋàbwaŋ ikäl balàbal sye mumay unsà ukwen abɛ.
Isàkal naa an'kyän mà ndandaa ubwaŋ, Nzam afàkyey kab alà paa, ukɔɔn aler undiir mpa awà paa!
An'kyän abi kà mupfiy anki ntɔn un'sak a baar bumwɛy, wɛɛ ntɔn nsöön ikɔ̈ɔ̈n akal uboo a bɛ.
Apanà làbà bɛ anà un'naaŋ, bɛ lan'kwo mubay baar ban'kɔɔn wa. Ntɔn sye, ilä làsàkɔɔn bɛ wa anà ba bàsàkal anà wa, ba bàsàlabay. Abun, nsöön isàkal anki uboo a bɛ.
Kyakin bàsön naa: «Mbuur kàbwe mbɔɔn kàwɛl anki byàŋàsöön, mbuur kàbwe ikikye, undiir kàkɔ̈ɔ̈n anki.»
Mɛ an'fuur an'tɔɔn akà Nzam awà kan'sà u mpem a Titɔ un'kanà nsil awà amu bi ntɔn bɛ.
Titɔ kàkyey ndɔ̈ɔ̈m abi, unsà un'kanà wanswà, waa kàkyen mper akà bɛ unsà ukwen ande ŋakwo.
Mbwo mwɛy anà nde, bi ban'tɔm un'tɔŋ awà bàfàkan Ikööŋ byanswà ntɔn isal ande unsà Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ.
Yà sye naa, Ikööŋ byun'sɔ̈ɔ̈l mukal un'baay abi u nkyeen uboo a nkääb ayi, isal ifàkyer bi ntɔn làkoo a Mwol ŋakwo anà muswaŋ an'kyän abi màŋàbwaŋ.
Bi ikal kigyɛɛŋ mutiin an'pɛl unsà nsyääl a un'kàbɔ a ngim ibà bi anà buur awa.
Ntɔn bi, bi ileŋà mukyer ubwaŋ, kusà a Mwol mpɛl anki, wɛɛ kusà a baar sye.
Mbwo mwɛy anà ba, bi ban'tɔm un'tɔŋ abi, awà ifàkyey bi un'kanà ande mbalà mbɔɔn, anà kan'fàswaŋ wa aŋàsöönà, ntɔn nde kan'sà kam akà bɛ.
Abun, Titɔ wà mbuur afàtüüb anà mɛ unsà làkwikilà anà un'baay amɛ unsà isal apà bɛ. Ntɔn atɔŋ bumwɛy ban'tüüb mbwo anà nde, ba bà antööm a Ikööŋ, ba bàfàsal ntɔn làkoo a Klistɔ.
Kusà a Ikööŋ, làswɛŋ naa bɛ làbye anà ukwen, naa bi kàkäl anà ibɔŋ muswaŋ ngaal kusà a ba.
Mfun yatɛy naa mɛ alàsöön ntɔn mbaay akà aŋin'kyɛɛl.
Mɛ in'kyàyöb an'kyän aŋàbwaŋ abɛ, waa mɛ kàswɛŋ ngaal ntɔn bɛ kusà a baar a Masɛdwan. Mɛ kakyään naa: «Akayi wàŋàyöŋà fà mbul kàlyaŋ», anà un'kanà abɛ kàwiiy nkääb a Ikööŋ mbɔɔn.
Apan, mɛ amàlatööm atɔŋ naa uyɔl in'we mɛ abà ntɔn bɛ bàkɔɔn akal bàbunàbun unsà ndaa ayin, ntɔn bɛ làkäl bàŋàyöŋà, asànaa kàtɛn mɛ.
Abun, mɛ in'yàman bɔɔmà, isàkal naa baar a Masɛdwan ban'yà anà mɛ, anà ba bàmɛn naa bɛ bàŋàtàyöŋà anki, naa mpem ifàlasyeel bi ibulà nswɛn abi, mukɔɔn atɛn naa yà bɛ.

Abun, mɛ kàmɛn naa yubwaŋ mulɔm akà atɔŋ abà mufwel akà bɛ kusà a mɛ ntɔn muköŋà an'kab abɛ, isal a an'kab làpɛ bɛ ilää kusà. Kyakin, ma iyàkal màŋàyöŋà utaaŋ in'yàyà mɛ, anà iyàswaŋ naa bɛ làfàpà unsà un'sak, wɛɛ kumpem un'be anki.
Apan, làyöb naa: mbuur afàkɔn ikikye, afàbwo sye ikikye, mbuur afàkɔn mbɔɔn, afàbwo sye mbɔɔn.
Wɛy mbuur mbuur upɛ asànaa kan'tsul mpem ande, kunkyɛɛr anki, itàkal unkaak a ngwal anki, ntɔn Nzam afàkwen mbuur afàpà unsà un'sak.

Nzam we anà ikɔ̈b mukàlayööl a an'kab a ngway mifà ifà, ntɔn u taaŋ lanswà anà unsà ndaa yanswà, bɛ làwɛl indiir làbà bɛ abyà mfun, anà làfàkal anà indiir aŋàsöönà ntɔn isal aŋàbwaŋ kyanswà,
asànaa bàsön naa: «Nde kàkyer akab, nde kàpɛ akà aŋàlàmbwà, balàbal ande lipepey.»
Kyekà mbuur afàpà nkɔɔn akà un'köön anà làmpà adyà, asàlapà sye nkɔɔn, nde asàbuul ya mbɔɔn, anà asàyɛɛl mbɛŋ a balàbal abɛ.
Abun, bɛ làyàkal aŋin'naaŋ ntɔn nkääb yanswà, nkääb ifàbɔr an'tɔɔn akà Nzam, u mbwo a bi.
Ntɔn, isal a nkääb aki kà iyàkal ntɔn mumay ngyal aŋin'kyɛɛl mpɛl anki, wɛɛ musweey ngyamàkà a an'tɔɔn mbɔɔn akà Nzam.
Mpal bàyàman ba ntal a isal aki, ba bàyàsà Nzam làkoo ntɔn unkyeey làswaŋà bɛ ntɔn Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ a Klistɔ, anà ntɔn nkääb abɛ akà ba anà akà baar banswà.
U ngyamàkà aba ntɔn bɛ, ba bàyàlaswaŋ ukwen aba, ntɔn kab a ngway aŋàsöön kàlapɛ Nzam.
An'tɔɔn akà Nzam ntɔn kab ande lifà asin.
Mɛ, Pɔl, mɛ an'lɔm akà bɛ, unsà làbɔ̈ɔ̈n anà ubwaŋ a Klistɔ, - bää mɛ in'fàkal unsà un'kaay u mii abɛ, wɛɛ wàŋàtsim mpal in'fàkal mɛ ukwɛl,
mɛ amàlabɔɔn: twon làman'siinà a ngwal utaaŋ in'yàkal mɛ paa, ntɔn ndaa a ngwal in'kwo mɛ muswaŋ akà baar bàfàsi naa nsyeel a mpem abi yunsà imbuur.
Ndandaa, bi ibà baar, wɛɛ bi ifànwan anki unsà ndür.
Ntɔn an'tà ifànwan bi amà kà mimbuur anki, wɛɛ ngwal ama yan'fà akà Nzam ntɔn mubwiy ikal a ngwal. Bi ifàpay an'yweerà an'be,
anà ngwal yanswà ifàmbäär ngyööb a Nzam. Bi ifàkɔr an'kyän manswà ntɔn ma ikyey Klistɔ.
Bi ibàŋàyöŋà mupà ntaaŋàmbar akà unkwem banswà, umpal làsàmɛy bɛ unkyeey abɛ wàŋàkwo.
Làler indiir asànaa ibyà bya. Isàkal naa we anà mbuur akakyeyà uyɔl naa nde wà Klistɔ, wɛy nde uyweer anà uyöb naa: bi sye ibà bà Klistɔ asànaa nde!
Abun, itàkal naa mɛ in'we anà uyɔl aŋàsöönà ikye unsà ikɔ̈b kipɛ Mwol ntɔn mutɔŋ, kà ntɔn mudwa anki, mɛ nswɛn in'yàman anki.
Mɛ in'kwen anki mukal anà ifà mupà bɛ bɔɔmà unsà in'kaan amɛ,
ntɔn, bàfàtɛn naa: «In'kaan ande myàfàkal ngwal anà myàfàpà bɔɔmà, wɛɛ umpal awà nde paa, nde wàgyɔ̈ɔ̈là, ndaa ande ndöŋ yatɛy.»
Wɛɛ mbuur akatɛɛnà abwɛy, uyöb ubwaŋ naa: asànaa ibà bi unsà in'kaan abi ukwel, bi sye iyàkal abun u nsyääl abi utaaŋ iyàkal bi uboo a bɛ.
Ndandaa, bi ikwe anki musi a baar bumwɛy abà bàfàswɛɛŋ ba ŋakwo. Ba bà insil: ba bàfàwal ba ŋakwo asànaa isii musi a ba ŋakwo.
Wɛɛ akà bi, bi iyàlyaŋ anki isii unsà ngaal ifàswaŋ bi, wɛɛ bi, bi iyàsyääl isii a ndel a isal kisyeel Nzam, mukitwääl sye tii akà bɛ.
Ntɔn, bi ilyaŋ anki ndel abi, asànaa bi kàyi anki akà bɛ. Ndandaa bi ibà baar atàtwɛb bàtöl apà bɛ anà Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ là Klistɔ.
Abun, bi ngaal aŋàsöönà ifàswaŋ anki unsà isal a mbuur asin, wɛɛ bi ibye anà làkyän naa làkwikilà abɛ làsàyɛl, bi iyàfàyɛl aŋàsöönà uboo a bɛ, unsà ndel a isal abi,
mukyään Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ uboo a itiir abyukwel anà bɛ, mukɔɔn aswaŋ ngaal unsà isal bàkyer u ywaŋ a baar asin.
Apan sye, bàsön naa: «Wɛy mbuur aswaŋà ngaal, uswɛŋ ngaal ande unsà Mwol.»
Abun, kà bàfàkyey mbuur afàswɛɛŋ nde ŋakwo anki, wɛɛ mbuur awà ufàswɛɛŋ Mwol.
Aa! Mɛ amàlabɔɔn mukaŋ mpem ntɔn undiir akamɛnà asànaa kikɔŋ amɛ! Ndandaa, làkäŋ mpem ntɔn mɛ!
Mɛ in'we anà un'köl ntɔn bɛ, un'köl kan'fà akà Nzam, ntɔn mɛ kàlatɛɛl ntüün a baal mwɛy mpɛl, ntɔn mukàlaswaŋ akà Klistɔ asànaa un'kaar mpa aŋàtàyöb baal, wàŋàpɔŋà.
Wɛɛ, mɛ in'we anà bɔɔmà muman naa an'kyän abɛ itäy anà ukwen abɛ ntɔn Klistɔ bàdiimà, asànaa ntäy kàkür nde Ɛva u mbwo a impeenà ande.

Kyakin, bɛ làkyer akyeyà ubwaŋàbwaŋ naa mbuur mwɛy uyàlakyään Yɛsu a nsöön a Nde akwà kàlakyään bi. Bɛ làfàkyey sye muwal dweelà anà làsaŋ a nsöön a Dweelà anà Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ làwɛl bɛ akà bi.
Kyekà, mɛ in'sii naa mɛ kin'wà kimbuur anki kusà a antööm akwà bàfàkyey naa ba bà baar a baar.
Isàkal naa mɛ in'kwo anki unsà tweey, wɛɛ mɛ in'we anà ngyööb. Bi bàkyàlaswaŋ yanswà ubwaŋàbwaŋ amu indiir byanswà.
Nkye mɛ kàkyer man'be mutyà mɛ ŋakwo ntɔn bɛ làlär, umpal kàlakyään mɛ a ngway Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ a Nzam?
Mɛ kàmay un'naaŋ a Ikööŋ byumwɛy, muwal làfur akà ba ntɔn musyääl bɛ.

Umpal kàkäl mɛ akà bɛ, anà kàkäl mɛ anà ngyal a undiir, mɛ kàpɛ anki buur amɛ kan'kɔɔ a mbuur mwɛy, ntɔn atɔŋ bàfü Masɛdwan ban'pɛ undiir wanswà kàkäl mɛ awà mfun. Unsà ya yanswà, mɛ kàkäl kigyɛɛŋ mukɔɔn akal buur ntɔn bɛ, mɛ in'yàlalà abun ubwaŋàbwaŋ.
U mbwo a ndandaa a Klistɔ ayà amu mɛ, mɛ an'kyey naa: kà mbuur mwɛy watɛy kan'duum ndaa a làkoo ayi kitiir a Akayi.
Ntɔn nkye? Ntɔn mɛ bɛ kàlakwen anki? Nzam akyàyöb!
Abun, mɛ in'yàlalà mukyer asànaa in'kakyerà mɛ apanà, ntɔn mudübà mbwo akà baar bàleŋà mbwo mukyey uyɔl naa ba bà asànaa bi!
Ntɔn baar aban bà antööm a loor, baar a isal a loor bàŋàyee ungö a antööm a Klistɔ.
Wa kundiir a ubem anki: Satanà ŋakwo afàyee amu un'kyeey a pɛɛlà.
Abun, kundiir a kölàköl anki ntɔn asyääl ande bàyee uboo a asyääl a balàbal. Ntsüü aba isàkal asànaa isal aba.
Mɛ an'fàfuur, mbuur twon an'si naa mɛ in'wà ŋukɔŋ. Itàkal abwɛy, làkyey naa mɛ in'käl ŋukɔŋ, ntɔn mɛ sye in'kyey ndam a uyɔl.
Ayà in'kwen mɛ mutɛn, kasànaa ukwen Mwol anki, wɛɛ asànaa ŋukɔŋ, ntɔn ya yà ntɔn muswaŋ ngaal.
Ntɔn bàmbɔɔn bàfàswaŋ ngaal unsà ndaa a imbuur, mɛ sye in'swaŋ ngaal.
Bɛ aŋan'yeerà, bɛ làfàkyey baar bàkɔ̈ɔ̈n an'yeerà ukɔɔn apeen.
Abun, bɛ làfàkaŋ mpem naa bàlabuul asɔ, bàlamɛɛy ntaan, bàlapfiy, bàlasaal, bàlakäm mbar u ntabwey.
Mɛ in'wà u nswɛn mutɛn naa: bi kàswɛŋ naa bi ibà aŋagyɔ̈ɔ̈là. Kyekà, mbuur usàkyer kyääl mutɛn, - mɛ in'tɛn asànaa ŋukɔŋ - mɛ sye in'kyer kyääl mutɛn.
Nkye ba bà Bɛbɛlyɔ? Anà mɛ sye. Nkye ba bà Bisàlɛl? Anà mɛ sye. Nkye ba bikyee a Abàlam? Anà mɛ sye.

Nkye ba basyääl a Klistɔ? Mɛ in'tɛn asànaa ŋukɔŋ, mɛ in'wà aŋàsöön ba! Ntɔn, mɛ kàmɛn mpay aŋàsöönà, mɛ kàbilà bɔlokà mbalà mbɔɔn, mɛ ban'düb aŋàsöönà mbɔɔn, mbalà mbɔɔn mɛ kàbweey a igɔnsà a ukwà.
Ayudà ban'käm iki an'kwem an'tär aŋiwà mbalà tyeen,
an'füm mbalà tär, in'kul mbalà mwɛy, mɛ kàminà kan'dà mbalà tär, mɛ kàkyer mwäänà mwɛy anà mpib mwɛy uboo a ngyäl.

Mbalà mbɔɔn mɛ kàkäl u nkyeen kin'kɔl, mɛ kàbweey a igɔnsà mbɔɔn: igɔnsà a ngyäl, igɔnsà a baar abɛ, igɔnsà a atɔŋ a itoo amɛ, igɔnsà a baar mpa abà Ayudà, igɔnsà uboo a an'bul, igɔnsà u nsye a ipɔl, igɔnsà udu a ngyäl anà igɔnsà uboo a atɔŋ a loor,
amu yɔ̈ɔ̈n anà mpay mbɔɔn, mbalà mbɔɔn ukɔɔn twaal, amu ngyal anà mfyää, mbalà mbɔɔn amu nkin a isaa, amu mpye anà làmbwà.
Ukɔɔn aler indiir byumwɛy, buur amɛ bilä a ilä bà nkyɛɛr ntɔn ikööŋ byanswà.
Nà awe anà gyɔ̈ɔ̈là, waa mɛ in'kɔ̈ɔ̈n gyɔ̈ɔ̈là? Nà kan'bwà u man'be, waa mɛ in'kɔ̈ɔ̈n akyɛɛr?
Isàkal naa mɛ in'swaŋ ngaal, mɛ ngaal in'swaŋ unsà gyɔ̈ɔ̈là amɛ.
Nzam, Taar a Mwol Yɛsu, awàŋasaak ntɔn mbul a in'tye, akyàyöb naa mɛ loor in'taa anki.
Mpal kàkäl mɛ u Damas, kuvernɔ̈ɔ̈r kàkäl un'kyeey a mfum Arɛtas kàsi aseey u minàmbwo a bul ntɔn mukan'kɔr.
Wɛɛ, u mbwo a mun a nɛl a ibää a làpaŋ, laa ban'tyeey ba uboo a un'tɛr, waa mɛ kàsɔrà kan'kɔɔ ande.
Nkye yubwaŋ muswaŋ ngaal? Ŋaa, ndöŋ yatɛy! Wɛɛ apanà, wɛy mɛ in'tɛn ntɔn ndaa kan'swɛŋ Mwol u imanmii anà u imɛɛy.

Mɛ in'yöb mbuur mwɛy amu Klistɔ awà, yan'lyaŋ mbul kwem aŋinà, bun'syeen tii u du làtär, nkye yàkäl amu ndür ande? mɛ in'yöb anki, nkye yàkäl u nsà a ndür ande? mɛ in'yöb anki, Nzam ayöb ya.
Ndandaa, mɛ in'yöb naa mbuur awà, - nkye yàkäl amu ndür ande? nkye yàkäl anki amu ndür ande? mɛ in'yöb anki, Nzam ayöb ya, -
bun'syen tii u paladisɔ, waa kàwem ndaa mpa bàfàbuul, ndaa mpa bàpɛ mbuur mbwo muywel ya.
Ntɔn mbuur atub awunà mɛ in'swaŋ ngaal, wɛɛ ntɔn mɛ, mɛ ngaal amɛ in'yàswaŋ nà unsà gyɔ̈ɔ̈là amɛ.

Yàlàkal naa mɛ in'kwen muswaŋ ngaal, mɛ kàlàkal anki ŋukɔŋ, ntɔn mɛ kàlàtɛn ndandaa. Wɛɛ mɛ an'tɔn mukyer abun, ntɔn mukɔɔn aman amu mɛ an'kyän aŋàsöön amà bàfàman ba itàkal bàfàwem ba akà mɛ.
Apan sye, ntɔn mɛ in'kɔ̈ɔ̈n ayɔl a uyɔl ntɔn kàwɛl mɛ imɛɛy kyan'söön ubwaŋ, ban'si itoor u ndür, asànaa un'kyeey a Satanà bàsɔ̈ɔ̈l mukan'düb anà mukan'dübà mbwo mukyey uyɔl.
Mɛ kàbɔ̈ɔ̈n Mwol mbalà tär ntɔn mukan'lwom itoor aki.

Wɛɛ nde kan'fuur naa: «Kab a ngway amɛ lan'kwo akà ngye, ntɔn ngwal amɛ ifàmɛnà yàŋàkwo unsà gyɔ̈ɔ̈là.» Abun, unsà un'sak wanswà, mɛ in'yàswaŋ ngaal amɛ unsà gyɔ̈ɔ̈là amɛ, ntɔn ngwal a Klistɔ ikäl amu mɛ.
Kyakin un'sak amɛ wamu gyɔ̈ɔ̈là, amu in'tswe, amu in'siinà, amu nkwaaŋ anà amu bɔɔmà aŋàdiir ntɔn Klistɔ. Ntɔn umpal in'wà mɛ unsà gyɔ̈ɔ̈là, apan sye in'wà mɛ anà ngwal.
Le mɛ an'bulà ŋukɔŋ! Bɛ lan'siinà a ngwal, bɛ baar làlan'tɛɛl imbäl. Ntɔn, itàkal naa mɛ in'wà undiir a bunàbun, mɛ kin'wà anki u ngyɛl a antööm abà bàfàmɛnà naa ba bà udu.
Idiim abyà ifàswaŋ naa mbuur wà ntööm byàmɛnà uboo abɛ: nkääŋ a mpem unsà ndɛb yanswà, idiim, impà anà isal a ngwal.
Undiir nà bɛ mpa làwɛl asànaa ikööŋ byumwɛy, nà mɛ mukɔɔn akal buur ntɔn bɛ? Lan'dwääl nkul ntɔn nkɔ̈ɔ̈n a balàbal ayi!

Le, mɛ in'wà tsütsü muyà akà bɛ mbalà yàtär, anà mɛ in'yàkal anki buur abɛ: ntɔn mɛ in'lɛŋà anki indiir abɛ, wɛɛ bɛ ŋakwo. Kà buur a baan anki musà indiir ukɔl ntɔn aböör, wɛɛ aböör ntɔn baan.
Ntɔn mɛ, mɛ in'pà indiir amɛ byanswà anà mɛ ŋakwo wanswà ntɔn bɛ. Isàkal naa mɛ in'fàlakwen mbɔɔn, nkye mɛ bàyan'kwen ikikye?
Itàkal naa mɛ kàkäl anki buur ntɔn bɛ, wɛɛ bàtɛn naa mɛ in'wà ikur baar, waa mɛ kàlakör u mbwo a impeenà.
Aben, nkye mɛ kàkyer alapfiy u mbwo a umwɛy uboo a baar kàlatööm mɛ?
Mɛ kàlɔ̈m akà Titɔ muyà akà bɛ, anà mɛ kàtöm mbwo mwɛy anà nde un'tɔŋ awà làyöb bɛ. Nkye Titɔ kàkyer alapfiy? Nkye nde anà mɛ, bi kàkäl anki an'kyän an'mwɛy, anà mulab mbwo mwɛy?
Fà itaan, nkye bɛ làsii naa bi ifàtwey balàbal bi ŋakwo kusà a bɛ? Ŋaa, bi ifàyäm kusà a Nzam, amu Klistɔ. Indiir abi byanswà, nkwen amɛ, byà ntɔn làkwikilà abɛ làyɛl.

Abun, bɔɔmà amɛ bà naa, umpal in'yàyà mɛ, mɛ in'kɔ̈ɔ̈n ayàlaman asànaa in'kwen mɛ, naa bɛ sye làkɔ̈ɔ̈n akan'man asànaa làkwen bɛ. Mɛ in'manà bɔɔmà naa mɛ in'yàtaan uboo a bɛ: an'sye, un'köl, nkyɛl, isür, ntwee, itetɛɛn, in'tswe anà lingwoomà.

Mɛ imanà bɔɔmà naa in'yàfàyà mɛ, Nzam amɛ ayàmɛɛy nswɛn kusà abɛ, anà mɛ in'lel ntɔn bàmbɔɔn abà bàkyer man'be kusà anà mpa bàbuul mpem u ŋingyääy, u ndaa a nswɛn anà unsà induumà bàkyer ba.
Yi mbalà yàtär in'yà mɛ akà bɛ. Asànaa bàsön ya naa: «Ndaa yanswà bàyàtsul unsà imbäl a baar bɔ̈ɔ̈l itàkal atär.»

Mɛ kàkyàtàtɛn kusà, asànaa umpal kayi mɛ mbalà yàyweel, mɛ in'fàfuur ya ŋàbawà mpa in'wà mɛ paa, akà baar bàkyer man'be kusà anà akà bumwɛy: isàkal naa mɛ an'fàyà, mɛ akà mbuur mwɛy in'sàyee anki,
ntɔn bɛ làleŋà isii naa Klistɔ afàyäm amu mɛ. Nde kà wàgyɔ̈ɔ̈là anki kusà a bɛ, wɛɛ nde afàswaŋ ngwal amu bɛ.
Ndandaa, nde bun'bɛɛrà u kulunsi unsà gyɔ̈ɔ̈là ande, wɛɛ nde we anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ u ngwal a Nzam. Bi sye ibà bàgyɔ̈ɔ̈là amu nde, wɛɛ bi isàkal anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ anà nde u ngwal a Nzam ntɔn bɛ.

Làpɛl bɛ ŋakwo, làler naa nkye bɛ làbà uboo a làkwikilà, làler bɛ ŋakwo ubwaŋàbwaŋ. Nkye bɛ làfàkayöbà anki naa Yɛsu Klistɔ wà amu bɛ? Nà isàkal naa bɛ làkɔ̈ɔ̈n awal iböŋ unsà ndeer ayi.
Apan, mɛ an'sà làkyän naa bɛ làkyer asàyöb naa bi, bi kàbü anki kusà a ndeer ayi.
Bi ifàyamà Nzam naa bɛ làkɔ̈ɔ̈n akyer akà ube mwɛy. Bi ikwen anki mumɛɛy iböŋ abi, wɛɛ muman naa bɛ lan'kyer ubwaŋ, itàkal naa bi ikamɛnà bàŋàkwàndwà.
Ntɔn bi ikɔ̈b mumbäär ndandaa kyatɛy, wɛɛ bi iwe anà ikɔ̈b mukölà kya mpɛl.
Wɛɛ bi ibà unsà un'sak, taaŋ lanswà ibà bi bàgyɔ̈ɔ̈là anà làbà bɛ aŋangwal. Waa bi ikalɔɔmà u ngyamàkà abi naa bɛ làbulà bàŋàkwo.
Kyakin, amàlasöön mɛ ndaa ayi yanswà umpal in'wà mɛ ukwel, ntɔn umpal in'sàyà mɛ, ya ikɔ̈ɔ̈n amɛnà naa ndaa amɛ yà bwoor musyääl ikɔ̈b kan'pɛ Mwol ntɔn mutɔŋ, kà ntɔn mudwa anki.
Atɔŋ, làkäl unsà un'sak, làsäl ntɔn mukwo, làpɛɛl ngwal bɛ a bɛ, làkäl an'kyän an'mwɛy, làkäl unsà duu, waa Nzam a ukwen anà duu uyàkal anà bɛ.
Làpɛɛl mbɔr u mbwo a ndüür in'kyɛɛl.
Aŋin'kyɛɛl banswà bàmàlapà mbɔr.
Wɛy kab a ngway a Mwol Yɛsu Klistɔ, ukwen a Nzam, anà un'tüüb a Dweelà In'kyɛɛl byàkäl anà bɛ banswà.
NGALÀTYÀ
Pɔl, ntööm, kà unsà ngwal a baar itàkal u mbwo a mbuur mwɛy anki, wɛɛ u mbwo a Yɛsu Klistɔ anà Taa Nzam awà kun'wiiy uboo a akü,
anà atɔŋ banswà abà anà mɛ, mɛ an'pà mbɔr akà Ikööŋ abyà u Ngalàtyà:
Wɛy kab a ngway anà duu a Taaràbi Nzam anà Mwol Yɛsu Klistɔ byàkäl anà bɛ.
Klistɔ kàpɛ mɔ̈ɔ̈ ande ŋakwo ntɔn man'be abi, ntɔn mukigyɔɔr u mɛɛn an'be mà, unsà ukwen a Nzam, awà Taaràbi.
Wɛy làkoo làkäl anà nde mbul a in'tye! Wöwöö.
Mɛ in'wà unsà ubem muman naa bɛ làbà nswɛy musàkɔɔb mbuur awà kàlabel u mbwo a kab a ngway a Klistɔ, ntɔn mulab Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ lànsöön.
Ŋaa, Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ asin lànsöön latɛy, wɛɛ bà anà baar uboboo abɛ bàkwen mukàlatwääl lingyoomà anà musɔɔm Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ abar là Klistɔ.
Wɛɛ ŋàbawà, isàkal naa we anà mbuur mwɛy, itàkal bi, itàkal sye naa un'kyeey kan'fà du, kàmàlakyään Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ lànsöön anà la akwà kàlakyään bi, wɛy ŋakaan kun'käär!
Bi kàkyàtɛn ya itaan, mɛ ya an'fàtɛn apanà naa: isàkal naa we anà mbuur mwɛy kan'yà mukàlakyään Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ lànsöön anà la akwà làwɛl bɛ, wɛy ŋakaan kun'käär!

Ntɔn, apanà, nkye mɛ in'wàmuleŋ ubwaŋ akà baar lɛɛ akà Nzam? Naa nkye, mɛ in'kwen musà làbɔ̈ɔ̈n akà baar? Ilàkal naa mɛ alàkwen musà làbɔ̈ɔ̈n akà baar, mɛ alàfàkal anki un'syääl a Klistɔ.
Ntɔn, atɔŋ, mɛ alàkyään naa: Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ kàlakyään mɛ, la kà là an'kyän a mbuur a mɛɛn anki.
Ntɔn la kà mbuur kan'pɛ anki, itàkal naa mbuur kan'lɔ̈ɔ̈ŋ, wɛɛ u mbwo a imɛɛy a Yɛsu Klistɔ.
Ntɔn, bɛ làkyàwem itaan nkääl kàkäl mɛ ayà uboo a iyudà: naa sye un'fur a nkyɛl nà mɛ kàkäl awà, umpal kàmɛɛyà mɛ Ikööŋ a Nzam nkwaaŋ ntɔn mupay kya.
Mɛ, mɛ kàkyen usà unsà iyudà, mulyaaŋ bàmbɔɔn uboo a nkööl amɛ anà uboo a làfuun amɛ u mbwo a un'kanà amɛ ntɔn nkääl a ankaa amɛ.
Wɛɛ Nzam, unsà kab a ngway ande, nde kan'sɔ̈ɔ̈l fà an'bäl a maa anà kan'bel mukun'syääl, nde kàmɛn naa yà ubwaŋ
nde kan'mɛɛy Mwan ande, ntɔn mɛ in'kyään Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ ande akà baar mpa abà Ayudà, ukɔɔn alab an'lwɛŋ a mbuur,
itàkal mubeenà Yɛlusàlɛm ntɔn mukàbweey anà baar abà bàbulà antööm kusà a mɛ, mɛ kàkyen Arabi. Ungö apan mɛ kàfurà Damas.
Ungö a mbul tär, mɛ kàbeenà Yɛlusàlɛm ntɔn mukàbweey anà Petɔlà. Mɛ kàkyer ilä kwem aŋityeen apà nde.
Mɛ kàmɛn anki ntööm asin, nà Zyak mpɛl, un'tɔŋ a Mwol.
Ya amàlasöön mɛ yi, mɛ an'tɛn u mii a Nzam, kà loor anki.
Apan, mɛ kàkyen itiir a Silya anà Silisi.
Wɛɛ Ikööŋ a aklistɔ abyà u Yuday byàyöb anki ntabwey amɛ.
Bya byàwem mpɛl naa: «Mbuur akwà kàyimɛɛyà bi nkwaaŋ sɛmà itaan, ŋàbawà nde wàmuyilɔɔŋ làkwikilà alà kàsi nde muküünà mudwa la.»
Wɛɛ bya byàsyee Nzam làkoo ntɔn mɛ.
Ungö a mbul kwem aŋinà, mɛ kàfàbeenà Yɛlusàlɛm anà Banabas, mɛ kàsyen sye anà Titɔ.

Kyekà, mɛ kàbeenà ntɔn imɛɛy kàwɛl mɛ, anà mɛ ba kasam Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ in'fàlɔɔŋ mɛ akà baar mpa aba Ayudà. Mɛ la sye kàyisaamà u mpey akà andweer a Ikööŋ, manà naa isal kàkyer mɛ anà in'yàkyer mɛ apanà ikɔ̈ɔ̈n akal ndöŋ.
Wɛɛ ya yàmɛnà naa itàkal Titɔ, un'gɛlɛki kàyisalà anà mɛ, bun'siinà anki a ngwal muwal nkyɛɛy,
itàkal abwɛy, atɔŋ abɛ abà bàyàbilà uboboo abi, bàtwääl ipaay unsà nsaay abi yan'fà akà Yɛsu Klistɔ, ba bàkwen mukibuul asɔ a un'kɔɔn.
Wɛɛ bi, bi kàkyey anki isɔ a baar aban akà ikikye, itàkal mutüüb anà ba u kitaaŋ, ntɔn ndandaa a Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ yàkäl ipepey ntɔn bɛ.
Baar bàkäl asànaa bàntal, bàkäl kaben, mɛ kwo watɛy. Ntɔn Nzam ufàler anki ntabwey a baar. Wɛɛ akà mɛ, ba sye ban'swɛŋ anki akà undiir mwɛy a ngwal.
Kyekà, ba bàkyàman naa mɛ ban'pɛ buur a Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ ntɔn baar mpa abàŋàkyɛy, asànaa bàpɛ akà Petɔlà ntɔn baar aŋàkyɛy.
Ntɔn mbuur kàkyer naa Petɔlà ukäl ntööm ntɔn baar aŋàkyɛy, mbuur nsil sye wa kàkyer naa mɛ in'käl ntööm ntɔn baar mpa abà Ayudà.

Umpal bàyɔ̈b Zyak, Petɔlà anà Ywan abà bàkäl asànaa an'ta a Ikööŋ, naa kab a ngway alà bàpɛ akà mɛ, ba bipɛ an'kɔɔ, mɛ anà Banabas, muswaŋ un'tüüb uboo a ba anà bi, ntɔn bi ikyen akà baar mpa abà Ayudà, wɛ ba bàkyen akà baar aŋàkyɛy.
Yàlɔ̈m naa bi ikyer undiir mwɛy mpɛl: muyɔbà aŋàlàmbwà. Mɛ wa sye kàkyàkyer agyägyä.
Wɛɛ mpal kàyi Petɔlà kà Antyɔsha, mɛ kàtön ndaa ande u mii a baar, ntɔn nde kàkäl anà ikwàndwà.

Ntɔn, kusà a ngyeel a baar abà kàtöm Zyak, nde kàdyee ikal imwɛy anà baar mpa abà Ayudà. Wɛɛ mpal bàyàkɔlà ba, nde kàkaabà anà baar mpa abà Ayudà, waa kàkäl u mpey, ntɔn nde kàmɛn bɔɔmà a Ayudà aban.
Ayudà bumwɛy bàbilà uboo a pfürà ande, kyakin Banabas nde ŋakwo sye kàbilà uboo a pfürà alà.

Wɛɛ mpal kàmɛn mɛ naa nkääl aba yàkäl anki balàbal anà Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ, mɛ kàtɛn a Petɔlà u mii a baar banswà naa: «Isàkal naa ngye mbuur awà Un'yudà, nkääl angye yà asànaa yà baar mpa abà Ayudà, kà yà Ayudà anki, aben ngye akaswaŋà baar mpa abà Ayudà naa ba bàkäl nkääl mwɛy ya anà Ayudà?»
Bi, bi ibà Ayudà fà mböör, wɛɛ bi kà ibà baar mpa abà Ayudà anki, baar a man'be bà.

Mpalàbà, bi kan'yöb naa akà mbuur a balàbal mwɛy watɛy naa ntɔn nde afàlab isal a un'kɔɔn, wɛɛ unsà làkwikilà amu Yɛsu Klistɔ mpɛl. Bi, bi sye kàsi làkwikilà amu Yɛsu Klistɔ, ntɔn bi ikäl bàbalàbal unsà làkwikilà amu Klistɔ, wɛɛ kà unsà isal a un'kɔɔn anki. Ntɔn, akà mbuur mwɛy usàkal anki balàbal unsà isal a un'kɔɔn.
Wɛɛ, isàkal naa bi kàleŋà mukal bàbalàbal amu Klistɔ, bi sye bàmɛnà naa bi ibà baar a man'be. Nkye Klistɔ kàlàkal un'syääl a man'be? Ikwo anki akà ikikye.
Kyakin, isàkal naa mɛ an'fàtɔŋ ya akwà kàbwaab mɛ, abun, ikaswaŋà naa mɛ in'wà un'bɛɛy a un'kɔɔn.
Ntɔn yà u mbwo a un'kɔɔn wa mɛ kàkü unsà un'kɔɔn, ntɔn mɛ in'käl anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ amu Nzam. Mɛ, mɛ in'wà aŋàbɛɛrà u kulunsi anà Klistɔ,
mɛ in'we anà mɔ̈ɔ̈, wɛɛ kà mɛ anki, Klistɔ awe anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ amu mɛ. Ntɔn mɔ̈ɔ̈ amɛ wà imbuur, wa wà unsà làkwikilà, làkwikilà amu Mwan a Nzam awà kan'kwen anà kàpɛ mɔ̈ɔ̈ ande ntɔn mɛ.
Mɛ in'piy anki kab a ngway a Nzam bwà. Ntɔn, kya isàkal naa yà unsà mbwo a un'kɔɔn mbuur kan'kwo mukal wàbalàbal umii a Nzam, abun Klistɔ kàkü wà bunàbun.
Ɔ insil a Angalàtyà! Nà kàlalɔ̈? Kyekà, Yɛsu Klistɔ awà bàbɛɛrà u kulunsi bun'swɛŋ u mii a bɛ.
Mɛ alàsà mfuul mwɛy mpɛl: Nkye bɛ Dweelà làwɛl ntɔn làsyäälà bɛ un'kɔɔn lɛɛ ntɔn làwem bɛ Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ anà làsi bɛ làkwikilà amu la?
Abà, nkye bɛ làbà insil? Utàtwɛb bɛ làsɛmà a Dweelà, nkye ŋàbawà bɛ làkwen mukàtsü a ndür?
Nkye mbɔɔn a mpay làmɛn bɛ yàkäl yà bunàbun? Ikwo anki naa ya ikäl yà bunàbun!
Mbuur afàlapà Dweelà anà afàkyer impà uboo a bɛ, nkye nde bya afàkyer ntɔn làfàlab bɛ Un'kɔɔn lɛɛ, ntɔn làwem bɛ làsaŋ a làkwikilà?
Ntɔn Abàlam kàkäl anà làkwikilà amu Nzam, kyakin kàmɛnà nde wàbalàbal.
Làyöb abun naa: baar abye anà làkwikilà bà baan a Abàlam.
Abà sye, Ndaa Aŋàsɔn yàtɛn naa Nzam asàkyey baar mpa abà Ayudà, ntɔn làkwikilà aba. Kyakin bàsam ba Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ alà kusà akà Abàlam naa: «In'sɛŋ myanswà myàsàwal nsaak amu ngye.»
Kyakin, baar abà anà làkwikilà ban'wal nsaak mbwo mwɛy anà Abàlam, aŋàlàkwikilà.
Ntɔn, asyääl a un'kɔɔn banswà bà unsà un'küül. Ntɔn bàsön naa: «Wɛy ŋakaan udi mbuur wanswà afàkɔɔn asà muküünà mukwey ndaa yanswà bàsön uboo a Un'kaan a un'kɔɔn.»
Yà ndandaa naa akà mbuur mwɛy wàbalàbal watɛy kusà a Nzam u mbwo a un'kɔɔn, ntɔn bàsɔn naa: «Mbuur a balàbal asàkal anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ ntɔn làkwikilà.»
Kyekà, un'kɔɔn làbɛɛŋ latɛy anà làkwikilà, asànaa itɛɛnà Ndaa Aŋàsɔn naa: «Mbuur asàkwey nswɛɛŋ a un'kɔɔn awà, asàkal anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ amu wa.»
Klistɔ kàfür ntɔn mukitwey unsà un'küül a un'kɔɔn, nde ŋakwo kàbulà un'küül ntɔn bi, ntɔn bàsön naa: «Wɛy ukäl aŋàküül mbuur wanswà ban'bɛɛrà kà un'te.»
Yà abun naa làsaak a Abàlam làsàtööl akà baar mpa abà Ayudà u mbwo a kab a ngway a Yɛsu Klistɔ, naa bi banswà isàwal Dweelà kàpɛ Nzam ilää u mbwo a làkwikilà.
Atɔŋ, mbar bi itàtɛn unsà imbuur: isàkal naa kyän kàsön mbuur là u mbwo a la, akà mbuur mwɛy ukwe anki mulwom itàkal mukwɛy undiir uboo a la.
Abun, ilää bàpɛ akà Abàlam anà akà ngyääl ande, bàtɛn anki naa: «anà akà akyee ande» asànaa ya iler un'kàbɔ, wɛɛ ntɔn mbuur mwɛy mpɛl unsà itoo a Abàlam, ikaswaŋà naa Klistɔ.
Abun, le an'kyän amɛ: kyän a balàbal, Nzam la kàdi kusà. Un'kɔɔn kàsàyà ungö a mbul nkam nà a an'kwem an'tär, ukwe anki mudwa kyän alà. Naa tɛy, ilää aki isàbulà undiir a bunàbun.
Ntɔn, isàkal naa kwal bàfàwal u mbwo a Un'kɔɔn, abun ifàkal anki naa u mbwo a ilää. Wɛɛ kyekà ilää aki Nzam kya kàpɛ akà Abàlam unsà kab a ngway ande.
Apanà, mfun a un'kɔɔn nkye? Wa kàyi ntɔn muswaŋ ube a baar, tii kunà usàyà ikyee a Abàlam awà bàpɛ ilää. Ilää aki akyeey bàkyään u mbwo a mfurboo mwɛy.
Kyekà, nkalsà awà kà wà ntɔn mbuur mwɛy mpɛl anki, wɛɛ Nzam wà mwɛy.
Abun, nkye Un'kɔɔn afàmbäär ilää a Nzam? Ŋaa, akà ikikye! Wɛɛ yàlàkal naa Un'kɔɔn we anà ikɔ̈b apà mɔ̈ɔ̈, abun balàbal sye làlàfà u mbwo a wa.
Wɛɛ Ndaa Aŋàsɔn yàkyàsà mɛɛn manswà ungyɛl a ikɔ̈b man'be. Kyakin, unsà làkwikilà amu Yɛsu Klistɔ, ilää waa isàkwo akà aŋàlàkwikilà.
Kusà a ngyeel a làkwikilà, bi kàkäl atsüüŋ a un'kɔɔn, tii umpal làlàmɛnà làkwikilà alà.
Kyakin, un'kɔɔn kàkäl un'leer abi tii u ngyeel a Klistɔ, ntɔn bi ikäl bàbalàbal u mbwo a làkwikilà.
Wɛɛ, ungö a ngyeel a làkwikilà, bi ifàkal anki kà an'kɔɔ a un'leer awà.
Ntɔn bɛ banswà, bɛ làbà baan a Nzam u mbwo a làkwikilà amu Yɛsu Klistɔ.
Inye, bɛ banswà abà làwɛl ndüümà amu Klistɔ, bɛ làkyàbwaar Klistɔ.
Kyakin, Un'yudà itàkal Un'gɛlɛki ufàkal anki. Un'tsüüŋ itàkal un'nsaay ufàkal anki. Baal itàkal un'kaar ufàkal anki. Ntɔn bɛ banswà làbà mwɛy amu Yɛsu Klistɔ.
Kya isàkal naa bɛ làbà baar a Klistɔ, bɛ làbà itoo a Abàlam anà aŋakwal unsà ilää.
Mɛ in'tɛn abà: isàkal naa un'kyee a kwal wà mwan umbɛy, nde nsöön watɛy anà un'tsüüŋ, itàkal naa nde wà nkum a indiir byanswà,
wɛɛ nde wà ungyɛl a baar bàfàkaar indiir ande anà baar abye anà buur a bya, tii mpal isàkwo ilä kàsi taarànde.
Bi sye, mpal kàkäl bi ambɛy, bi kàkäl atsüüŋ.
Wɛɛ umpal làkwe taaŋ, Nzam kàtöm Mwan ande: bun'bör akà un'kaar mwɛy, bun'bör ungyɛl a un'kɔɔn,
ntɔn mutsuuŋ baar bàkäl ungyɛl a un'kɔɔn, ntɔn bi ibulà baan aŋàywaaŋ nkà.
Ntɔn làbà bɛ baan, Nzam waa kàtöm Dweelà a Mwan ande uboo a mpem abi, Dweelà afàsà un'kwɛŋ naa: «Aba» iswaŋà naa Taa!
Kyakin, ngye afàkal un'tsüüŋ anki, wɛɛ mwan. Ngye sye awà ikyee asànaa amà an'yilà a Nzam.
Itaan, umpal mpa layöbà bɛ Nzam, bɛ làkälà atsüüŋ a itɛk, kutɛn aŋàbwaŋ bya kà bànzam anki.
Wɛɛ mpalàbà lan'yöb bɛ Nzam, anà nde sye kàmàlayöb, aben lan'fàfurà bɛ akà indiir ikɔ̈ɔ̈n ngwal anà byànswɛn abyà ifàyaal mɛɛn? Nkye bɛ làkwen mufàbulà atsüüŋ a bya?
Bɛ, bɛ làfàkyɛɛl ubwaŋàbwaŋ ilä, nsöŋ, an'paŋà anà mbul!
Bɛ, bɛ làman'pà bɔɔmà: nkye isal kàkyer mɛ amu bɛ ikyà bwà?
Atɔŋ, mɛ amàlabɔɔn, làbulà asànaa mɛ, ntɔn mɛ kàkyàbulà asànaa bɛ. Akà ube mwɛy lan'kyer bɛ batɛy.
Bɛ làkyàyöb ubwaŋàbwaŋ naa u mbalà atàtwɛb kàlakyään mɛ Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ, mɛ kàkäl anà ukyal.
Ukyal abà bàkäl nsii ntɔn bɛ. Wɛɛ bɛ lan'saal anki, lan'piy anki. Kyekà, bɛ lan'wɛl asànaa un'kyeey a Nzam, asànaa Klistɔ Yɛsu.
Abun, wàken un'sak kàkäl anà bɛ? Ntɔn mɛ amàlatɛɛl imbäl ki: kya bɛ làlàkwo, bɛ làlàswaam mii abɛ ntɔn mukan'pà!
Ŋàbawà, nkye mɛ an'bulà ŋankir abɛ ntɔn amàlakyään mɛ ndandaa?
Ukwen aŋàsöön abà akà bɛ kà bà mpɛlàmpɛl anki, wɛɛ ba bàkwen mpɛl mukàlakaab anà mɛ, ntɔn bɛ làbääb anà ba.
Yubwaŋ muswaŋ ukwen abye anà imbäl aŋàbwaŋ taaŋ lanswà, wɛɛ kà nà utaaŋ kàkäl mɛ apà bɛ mpɛl anki,
baan amɛ, abà in'fàkamanà mɛ un'swaŋ abɔr tii umpal usàmɛnà Klistɔ amu bɛ.
Apanà, mɛ in'kwen mukal apà bɛ, ntɔn mulɔ̈ɔ̈n ntɛɛn amɛ akà bɛ, ntɔn mɛ in'yöb anki naa mɛ ininà in'kyer ntɔn bɛ!
Lan'kyään, bɛ baar làkwen mukal u ngyɛl a un'kɔɔn: nkye bɛ làfàwem anki ndaa ufàtɛn un'kɔɔn awà?
Ntɔn bàsön naa Abàlam kàbör baan abaal bɔ̈ɔ̈l: mwɛy a un'syääl un'kaar, mwɛy a un'kaar a nsaay,
mwan baal a un'syääl un'kaar bun'bör unsà imbuur. Wɛɛ mwan baal a un'kaar a nsaay bun'bör u mbwo a ilää.
Apà kye anà ikɔk a ndaa: abun, akaar abà bà nkwà yweel. Mwɛy, Agar, kàfü mɔŋ a Sinayi, kan'bɔr un'tsüüŋ:
